dialogue: You can't have it with an Ioun Stone either, by the way. It's one or the other.

name: ORION
dialogue: (stammering) I thought that was a...

name: MATT
dialogue: It's a head slot.

name: ORION
dialogue: And for Ioun Stones I can have up to three in the head slot?

name: MATT
dialogue: Correct.

name: ORION
dialogue: Okay.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Maybe give it to Scanlan. Scanlan, do you have anything in your head slot?

name: SAM
dialogue: "Just my cunning wit!" I don't even know what a head slot is.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's where a hat goes.

name: ORION
dialogue: Then for the time being, I take off the Ioun Stone and I (fzzt) dissipate it and... put it on.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, can you share?

name: ORION
dialogue: This essentially allows me to--

name: MATT
dialogue: Anyone who wears it.

name: ORION
dialogue: (stammering) Anyone who wears it can maintain two concentration spells for two rounds.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, that's great for you.

name: MATT
dialogue: It's great for a lot of people.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Could you do that cheer where I feel a lot better after you do it?

name: MATT
dialogue: Pike comes up and says, "I'm sorry! I'm sorry, Grog," goes over and places her hands upon you. As she's about to, Kima pushes her aside, and says, "I've got this." Walks up, and you can see this divine glowing energy. It fills her hands. She reaches out and touches you and this warmth fills-- this warmth fills your torso. Using her Lay On Hands ability, Lady Kima of Vord heals you for 38 points of damage.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Did I find anything on the other people?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Thank you, Kima.

name: MATT
dialogue: You look through the bodies. It looks like most of their adornments, other than the natural armor and weapons they have, nothing of particular interest. Make an investigation check.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, wait, I get to go twice because it's Underdark. That was great. 16.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. 16? Yeah, you're not able to really pull anything from their bodies, unfortunately. However, after Kima finishes healing you, Kima walks over to the dwarf corpse as you're inspecting it and gives it a look-over and shakes her head.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What do you see, Kima?

name: MATT
dialogue: (sighs) "This was one of my companions."

name: LAURA
dialogue: (gasps) Oh, no.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, judging by the scars across his body, he had already been made a thrall of one of the "illithid. Most likely the one that we finished back there."

name: SAM
dialogue: Killed her friend?

name: LAURA
dialogue: He was already a thrall.

name: MATT
dialogue: "There wasn't much to really bring him back at this point, I fear."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Is that what they would've done to Grog?

name: MATT
dialogue: And as you guys all look at Grog now, you can see him, he has hundreds upon hundreds of small scars across his body: fresh wounds that have just barely sealed. It looks like they've done a number on him with a bunch of small blades, hooks, razors-- it's hard to tell. But he is coated with small cuts.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It's been interesting.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You look really manly now.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Now?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (laughs) Have we done some healing? Has healing been done?

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys can short rest if you want to heal yourselves with your hit dice.

name: LIAM
dialogue: This is the time for an intermission.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, it is?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Is it? What time is it?

name: SAM
dialogue: It's only just begun.

name: LIAM
dialogue: (singing) We've only just begun. (speaking) Because we went right into battle.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I wanted to talk to my team. Can we talk now or talk after break? It's up to you.

name: SAM
dialogue: Let's talk now.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Vax is walking off into the distance to urinate on a stalagmite or stalactite, whatever's the one on the ground.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, we'll wait for Vax to get back.

name: SAM
dialogue: We'll bring him up to speed later.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Just talk loudly.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, I don't-- Where's Kima?

name: LAURA
dialogue: She's right here.

name: MATT
dialogue: Kima's with you. Kima's still looking over the body of the dwarf that's fallen.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Speak!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Oh, that's a relief! Oh!

name: LAURA
dialogue: (whispering) Do you not want to talk in front of Kima?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (whispering) I don't want to talk in front of Kima. (speaking) Kima? Earmuffs, Kima.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, that's awkward.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You want me to distract her?

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's the longest pee ever.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'll distract her! I'll distract Kima.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Grog goes and distracts Kima.

name: SAM
dialogue: I might be better at that. Kima, can you take a walk with me? I would like to persuade you to take a walk with me.

name: MATT
dialogue: Go ahead and roll persuasion.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Kima gives you a concerned look and goes--

name: SAM
dialogue: There's this thing on my body. I thought maybe you could take a look at it and you could tell me if it's good or bad? I don't know.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh dear. No, please."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Scanlan, do not drop the mack.

name: MATT
dialogue: And the two of you begin to walk away for a moment, away from the party. Briefly, while the rest of you are left behind.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Scanlan, do you have an earring?

name: SAM
dialogue: I have an earring.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay, so Scanlan can hear.

name: SAM
dialogue: I use my Minor Illusion to create a purple third nipple on me that I show her and ask her if it's okay, or if it's--

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, things are getting a little weird.

name: SAM
dialogue: Is this normal?

name: MATT
dialogue: "None of this is normal. At all."

name: SAM
dialogue: It's just, I trust you. I feel like I know you. You know we had that thing back there and then Keyleth was yelling at you. What was that all about?

name: MATT
dialogue: "We're all under duress."

name: SAM
dialogue: Let's girl talk.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We're under a lot of duress. The more and more things-- people have emotions and I "understand that. It's all right." And she pulls the leather gloves off that are part of the full leather armor set and begins to inspect you. In the meantime, you guys can continue your discussion.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I think we should get out of here.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What? Why?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, we've got Grog. We've got Kima. We came here to find Kima. That was our mission. I don't trust her.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We found her, but we can't leave without her.

name: LIAM
dialogue: So I'm walking back from my pee and I've overheard this. "We were sent here to bring back Kima."

name: LAURA
dialogue: And now you want to abandon her?

name: LIAM
dialogue: She's not going to come with us until we've killed this K'Varn.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Keyleth, what's your problem with Kima?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, look. She's been... She just gave me the wrong vibe, up front.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay, vibe. What did she do?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: She's been very rude--

name: LAURA
dialogue: She's been very tortured. Tortured, Keyleth.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Right. But look what happened. She's brought countless people down here, only to meet their end.

name: ORION
dialogue: Well, none of those people are us.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Right.

name: LAURA
dialogue: They're dead because they got captured. We're stronger.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Do you know something we don't, Keyleth?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Look, all I know is that only a fool believes that his path is the most virtuous. See? And he's got an intelligence of six.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I want to use my-- I would like to do a check on Keyleth.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I want to see her intentions.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (squealing) Ooh, inside-the-group check! I love it!

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's a 14.

name: MATT
dialogue: A 14. All right.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (laughing) Sneaky, sneaky Keyleth.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: The whisper! The first whisper!

name: SAM
dialogue: Get on camera. Get on camera. Over here, over here.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Whisper on camera. He used to do this all the time. When shit goes down and all of us can't know, he whispers. And he sticks his tongue in your ear a little bit.

name: ORION
dialogue: It's really nice.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I can't cheat, but I really want to listen.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What was that shit about now I'm manly?

name: LAURA
dialogue: You are manly. I meant more manly.

name: SAM
dialogue: Hey everyone, buy a t-shirt! Subscribe to Geek & Sundry. Support Felicia Day.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you finish your statement as well, Keyleth, Clarota steps up and says, "I "wholeheartedly agree. She is unstable and cannot be trusted in her state."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Hold on a second, that's unfair.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Why?

name: LIAM
dialogue: It has been a long road. Keyleth, I know you have had a hard time. We all have. I know we're miles below the surface of the world. But we're together. We are family. And everyone here is here for you as you have been for us. Now, I say we camp for the night inside this schmuck's tent. We stay here, we rest up, sleep on it, and see how we're all feeling in the morning. We're here for you, Keyleth, and we'll protect you as you have protected us. You've got a family with us.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (crying) How do we know we are doing the right thing? We've killed a lot of people, you guys. We've killed a lot of people.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Who in this world is without fault? Who hasn't made mistakes? We certainly all have.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Keyleth, we're keeping him, K'Varn, from killing even more.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: How do we know we're not just interfering with issues that aren't our own? We didn't know any of this until we came down here, and look she wants to take the horn. She wants the horn, and she wants to take it back herself.

name: LIAM
dialogue: The bottom line is, all of this insanity is going to bubble up to the surface if someone doesn't stop it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: All those creatures that have been coming up, Keyleth?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Remember, think back. It has already begun, and no one is here to stop it except for Vox Machina. Us.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We promise, we will heed your warning, but we can't run. We will heed it, though.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We've got your back.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We made a deal."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And we made a deal.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We did make a deal.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I understand you, Clarota, and I'm on your side. I swear. But a lot of people-- there have been a lot of murderers who said they did the things that they did because their gods told them to do it. Right?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We'll be cautious, and we'll have you to protect us.

name: ORION
dialogue: I dissipate invisible, and I approach Keyleth. "Your Highness. By the honor of all "Stormwinds, I will let nothing happen to you. I swear it. I will fight until my death, and I have "ways, of course, to get us all out of here whenever I damn well please. Do not worry."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I just have a bad feeling. This horn can't make it back up to the surface. You guys have to promise me that.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We'll keep the horn from leaving.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: She wants to take it back. Why? If it's that bad, why does she want it?

name: LIAM
dialogue: That may be so, but the evil that is brewing beneath the surface of the world will stretch up to everything we know. And I know that you have made mistakes. I have certainly made mistakes. That is to live. There is more at stake right now, and we are the front line. We're the only ones who can stop it. Mistakes are all right.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The god in darkness will blot out the light.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I just hope we're not the darkness.

name: ORION
dialogue: Oh, do you need light? (fwoosh)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, god. ORION Oh, is that-- I'm sorry

name: LAURA
dialogue: Thanks, Tiberius.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm not sure what this is. I'm sorry."

name: SAM
dialogue: "There's one more thing I need you to look at, it's just..." I cast Polymorph on myself, giving myself a gigantic dick, and I slowly pull down my pants...

name: MATT
dialogue: Kima immediately turns around and says, "Okay!" And walks back to the group.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What did I say? You can't keep it in for two seconds. Not that I blame you! My god!

name: LIAM
dialogue: I think we are all a little frayed. I think we need to rest. Let's set up camp.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, let's camp.

name: MATT
dialogue: Kima steps in at this point and says, "I agree. (sigh) We have quite a journey ahead of us." At which point, Clarota pipes up and says, "Indeed. We're not too far from Yug'Voril. Let us rest."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Kima. I... just wanted to apologize.

name: MATT
dialogue: "What for?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I came across too harshly that night.

name: MATT
dialogue: She puts her hand up and... in a matronly way. "It's honestly not a worry. War is stressful, "and all of us have been through a lot for this experience. I understand. I've been where you've "been, and it's not uncommon to question everything around you, and with good reason: that's what "keeps you alive. Were you to believe every person that crossed your path, you would not have made it "past your 15th season. I can assure you, as best as I can, that I mean the best for all of us. I "just know that if we don't do what we're here to do, far more people will suffer than the few I've "brought down here to protect me and for me to protect. I'm not asking for your trust. I'm just "asking for your patience."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, I can grant you that. Only if you promise to grant us respect in return, because I feel you were a little untrusting of what we were doing up front, which I once again understand.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You caught me at a rough time."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Same here.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, thank you."

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm sorry, Scanlan, what is that?

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, this bulge down here?

name: MATT
dialogue: "That's bedtime is what that is. All right, everyone, let's go ahead and find ourselves a rest." All right. So as everyone goes to camp for the evening we are going to go ahead and take a break. Potty break for folks. We'll be back here in about ten or so minutes.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Could you un-Polymorph your tripod, for god's sake?

name: ORION
dialogue: Before we go to sleep, I cast a bunch of spells in stuff.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right, guys. Awesome See you in a little bit. [dramatic music]

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Pike grew up on the outskirts of town, near the Bramblewood. Her ancestors were a family of deep gnomes with quite an unfavorable reputation. Thievery, destruction, and trickery left them with the curse of the last name Trickfoot. Sarenrae, the goddess of healing and redemption, had other plans for Pike's great-great-grandfather Wilhand, who left his family at a young age after a dream: a dream that changed the course of the Trickfoot family. Wilhand devoted his life to Sarenrae and pledged from then on that him and his family would live a life of service and devotion. As a child, Pike seemed to have an affinity to heal. Whether it was animals, people, or even flowers, she felt she had a purpose in making things whole that had once been broken. She studied and learned the ways to heal though divine magic. She lived a peaceful life, quiet and simple, until one day, Wilhand was captured and almost killed by a group of goliath barbarians. One of the goliaths took a stand against the murder of the innocent gnome and he himself was beaten, bloodied, and left for dead, abandoned by his herd. Wilhand went to Pike for help. She prayed and healed this barbarian as best she could, bringing him back to life. When he awoke, she discovered his name was Grog Strongjaw. After that, they were best of friends, a rather unlikely pair. Little did she know that in a few years' time, Grog would soon return the favor and bring her back from the clutches of death. (roar, crunch) After being killed in battle, Pike felt angry. She wanted to be stronger so that it would never happen again. She spent four months at sea training with the men and women aboard a ship called the Broken Howl. Gripping her holy symbol in one hand, and her morningstar in the other, this time, Pike is ready.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Right, Listen up! If you have ale, then you have a friend in Grog Strongjaw. A goliath of towering height and size, this barbarian has an appetite for the two great loves in his life: combat, women, and ale! (chuckle) (record scratch) Wait. Easily the brains of the group, Grog is often consulted for his vast knowledge of shapes, colors, and (chuckle) shiny things! Also ale. In his early years, armed with his two-handed great axe, Grog often enjoyed proving his might amongst the ranks of his family's wandering herd. But after coming upon an unsuspecting elderly gnome-- [music] Right, Listen up! If you have ale, then you have a friend in Grog Strongjaw. A goliath of towering height and size, this barbarian has an appetite for the two great loves in his life: combat, women, and ale! (chuckle) (record scratch) Wait. Easily the brains of the group, Grog is often consulted for his vast knowledge of shapes, colors, and (chuckle) shiny things! Also ale. In his early years, armed with his two-handed great axe, Grog often enjoyed proving his might amongst the ranks of his family's wandering herd. But after coming upon an unsuspecting elderly gnome in the woods, he objected to the killing of such an innocent life. A creature of impulse, Grog felt only pity for this-- well, this terrified little thing. And his disobedience cost him dearly. Beaten bloody and banished by the herd leader, his uncle Kevdak, Grog was abandoned and left to die, exiled from his herd. It was then that the relative of the very gnome he fought to save, saved him. It was the kindness of a gnome cleric named Pike that healed Grog, bringing him back from death's edge. And they have remained close friends ever since. Most nights, Grog can be found challenging entire taverns to wrestling matches! Ha! Or accompanying Scanlan to the nearest house where you pay for lady favors. Also ale!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: A first impression of Keyleth would leave you with little information on the half-elven druid. You might even think that her social awkwardness due to her sheltered upbringing is kind of sweet. (chuckle) Of course, it would be unwise to underestimate her based on first impressions. (thunder) Under that unintimidating petite frame is a vicious beast waiting to be unleashed, whose natural powers have made even the fiercest of champions pee their pants, literally! (soft chuckle) Born to the Air Tribe of the Ashari people, Keyleth was raised with a deep love of nature and the elemental magics. It is her people's inherent duty to protect the delicate areas in Tal'Dorei where the four elemental planes begin to bleed with this realm. Since she was a little girl, she had quite a knack for air manipulation and beast shaping abilities. Well, if you consider kittens and flying squirrels to be little beasts. Which, I do. (clears throat) Anyways, it wasn't long before the headmaster of the tribe, her father, Korren, realized her true prodigious abilities and she was inveterated to succeed him as the next headmaster. Just like that, her jovial childhood was stripped and replaced with endless spell memorization, teachings from ancient traditions, and exceedingly high expectations. Every druid leader to be must embark on a journey to seek out the sister tribes in order to introduce and establish respect amongst the fellow headmasters. They call this the Aramente, or Noble Odyssey. When her father felt she was ready, he set her on the path to truly discovering herself, not knowing when, or if, she will ever return. As she hiked down the mountain towards Stillben, she meditated on the task ahead. Part of the Aramente is proving yourself a strong warrior, a valiant protector, and a wise and compassionate leader. With this knowledge, one thought plays on repeat in her mind: Is she even worthy?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Percy was the third of seven children, born to a noble family who lived far to the north in the ancient castle of Whitestone. With so many siblings to share the burdens of lordship, Percy turned his attentions to the sciences, engineering, and naturalism. One day, a mysterious couple named Lord and Lady Briarwood came to court. During a feast held in their honor, the Briarwoods violently took control of the castle, killing or imprisoning everyone who would stand in their way. Percy awoke chained in the dungeon, only to be freed by his younger sister. Together they fled, chased by the Briarwoods' men. As they ran, Percy's sister took several arrows to the chest and fell. Percy kept running, eventually jumping into a freezing river and floating unconscious to freedom. He did not remember waking up on a fishing boat. He barely remembered the next two years, as he slowly made his way as far south as possible. Then one night, Percy had a dream. A roaring cloud of smoke offered him vengeance against those who destroyed his family. When he awoke, Percy began to design his first gun. (gunshot)

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, you haven't heard of Scanlan Shorthalt? Well, gird your loins, ladies, because he has his eye on you. A talented musician, master of disguise, and dashingly handsome in his own mind, Scanlan sings songs almost as much as he sings his own praises. Born a poor gnome, Scanlan used his endless charm and soaring tenor voice to croon for coin and support his single mother. One day he was discovered by a half-orc promoter, and joined Dr. Dranzel's Spectacular Traveling Troupe, where he learned the ways of the world, and honed his skills as a bard extraordinaire. A loner much of his life, Scanlan has never quite come to terms with the violent death of his mother at the hands of a goblin invasion. While his years on the road provided many, shall we say, educational experiences with the opposite sex, deep down, Scanlan yearns for the one thing he's never known: the true love of a fellow gnome. Still, Scanlan considers himself a lover first, performer second, and fighter distant third. On the battlefield, he'll support his allies, but rarely draws blood, unless it's to protect fellow gnome, Pike. Count on Scanlan for a hearty laugh, a rollicking song, and a twinkle in his eye that melts hearts and makes the females swoon.

name: ORION
dialogue: Greetings and salutations. I am Tiberius Stormwind. I hail from a town called Ty'rex, located in the heart of Draconia. From a politically respected family, at the age of 15, I succeeded in passing the Sorcerer's Rite, showing prodigy-like control of my magic. The judges and the Draconian high council were amazed at how powerful my spells were for how long I had been training. At 20 years old, I was the youngest appointed member of the magic guild in Draconian history. For the next few years, I almost went mad from the malaise of being a guild member, as it's rather boring. However, one day I happened upon a chamber, unused for quite some time. In the room were stacks of books and maps of the surrounding cities and areas around the known world. For months, I would frequent the chamber, and learned of artifacts from legend. After a long period of research, I made a list of artifacts that caught my eye. I brought these findings to the high council and was told that all of the information in the chamber I had stumbled upon was either believed to be fiction, or unsolvable mysteries, and hence were lost forever. I found those answers to be unacceptable. A year later, I devised a ruse and managed to convince the city council to lend support in me leaving Draconia on a mission of peace and diplomacy for the surrounding kingdoms, going from town to town and making friends and allies, in and for the name of Draconia. Being a red dragonborn, I had quite the task on my hands in that respect, but it was exactly what I needed so I could explore the world and find these artifacts, as I felt the truth was out there. Some may describe me as buffoonish, but I say poppycock to all that. I am much sharper than most give me credit for. I just don't pay attention to things sometimes. I've also been known to be rather cunning, loyal, happy-go-lucky, and well, dangerous. I can't help but show my true scales every now and then. But overall, I think I'm quite friendly for a dragonborn!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Never entirely welcome in the company of elves or men, Vax'ildan learned at a young age to skip past formality, preferring instead to invite himself in your door. Along with twin sister Vex'ahlia, Vax was born by a chance encounter between elven royalty and human peasantry. Raised by their mother in their early years, the twins were eventually sent off to their father in the elven capital of Syngorn. But their cool reception among the elves there never warmed, and their time in the capital didn't last. The siblings stole away one autumn night and set out on the open road. After a few years of wandering, they eventually decided to return to their mother, and journeyed back to the lands of their youth. But instead of finding their childhood home, they returned to a pile of rubble. Their mother was gone, their home burned to ash. Pressing the townspeople for answers, they learned of the day the dragon came. (roar) With their ties all severed, Vax'ildan and his sister set out to find their fortune together in Tal'Dorei. An outsider since birth, Vax quickly learned to solve life's challenges in his own particular way, often by side-stepping them entirely. And when his knack for circumventing adversity isn't enough, (knife scraping) the way of blades the elves schooled him in more than makes up the difference.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Like so many half-elves, Vex'ahlia has spent most of her life suffering the cool reception of a people who don't fully accept her. Born of a human mother and an elven father who only later in life took an interest in their existence, Vex'ahlia and her twin brother Vax'ildan quickly realized the only people they could truly rely on in this world were each other. It was at the age of ten when the two were taken from their mother and brought to live in Syngorn, the isolated elven city for which their father was an ambassador. He quietly took them in, but always kept an icy distance, and after too many years of disdainful looks, the pair decided to leave his indifference behind, and set out on their own. Vax took to the cities, stealing small trinkets and learning the ways of the thief, while Vex kept to the woods; she preferred the isolation. Always the keen observer, she learned to hunt and to track, to spy and to shoot. And through a series of fateful events, earned herself a companion in the form of a bear-- her own stolen Trinket-- to fight alongside her and protect her fiercely. Also, he is adorable, and gives expert massages. [dramatic music]

name: MATT
dialogue: Welcome back, everyone. We've been sufficiently rested. First, we're going to say thank you and welcome to all our new viewers. Welcome to Critical Role and all of its chaos: A bunch of voice actors playing Dungeons & Dragons. I also want to congratulate the first winner of our TableTop promo kit this evening, Zargross won. Well done. We'll be giving out another one at 2,750. So 2,750 subscribers and someone else in the chat room will win another promo kit. So that's cool.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We will be here every week, so subscribe.

name: MATT
dialogue: Also, t-shirts on sale, as of today. They are a limited run for two weeks. We are trying to get to our goal of 1,000 before that's done, hopefully. So you can just scroll down to the bottom of the Twitch page; you'll find a button there that will get you to that shop. So go for it!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Wait! Also, the PayPal is working again, for donations.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right, so the 826 donation's working again. Yay! Let us begin. So after an evening's rest, taking your respective turns keeping watch, all of you come to consciousness once more. Clarota anxiously sits at the edge of the camping facility, looking deeper into the tunnel ahead, keeping his eyes peeled in the darkness.

name: SAM
dialogue: I check under my belt because the spell has worn off. And I'm back down to my normal one and a half inches. Which on a gnome is pretty big.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Thank you.

name: SAM
dialogue: Length! And girth.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh god, what?

name: SAM
dialogue: It's like a square. Like a cube.

name: MATT
dialogue: Anyway, you guys eventually come to consciousness and finish cooking whatever bits of food you've managed to muster at this point in time in the Underdark.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's doughnuts.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, it is doughnuts. Under-doughnuts.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And Indian food, apparently.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Under-Indian.

name: MATT
dialogue: By the way, all of those who contributed to getting us food tonight, thank you so much.

name: ALL
dialogue: Thank you!

name: MATT
dialogue: Clarota seems slightly impatient as everyone is waking up and goes, "Come! Ahead, we shall find "it's Yug'Voril."

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's your city?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Beautiful city of secrets."

name: LAURA
dialogue: I thought your people had thrown you out. Why so eager to get back?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Without the colony, I serve no purpose. I am wandering, aimless. I wish to return to the "Elder Brain."

name: LIAM
dialogue: And to be fair, he was only thrown out once K'Varn took over the Elder Brain. Correct?

name: MATT
dialogue: "No. They threw me out long before, for my gift." And you see a little spark of arcane blue filter out of his fingers in the air and then (poof). Small spark. "It is an abomination to my "people. I am considered anathema. But to save them! To save my city, then they shall have me "back a hero."

name: LAURA
dialogue: And if they don't?

name: MATT
dialogue: "They will. I can sense it."

name: ORION
dialogue: Well, yes, it makes perfect sense, Clarota. I would think they would grant you a hero's welcome, as well.

name: LAURA
dialogue: If not, you have a home with us.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Thank you. Forward, we will find shrouded in the forest of fungus our destination. Come." It begins to drift down into the dark tunnel further below.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We follow.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, we follow.

name: ORION
dialogue: I follow behind them and call out to him, "Are you using Levitation, or what? How are you-- "is this how you--"

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's how we get around, dragonborn."

name: ORION
dialogue: Oh, okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: His tentacles flicker at his face for a second. As you guys continue forward in silence, K'Varn seems to be more chatty than usual, almost like the proximity is-- this is excitement to him, instinctually.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Did you mean Clarota? You said K'Varn.

name: MATT
dialogue: I meant Clarota.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Slip of the tongue!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I was like, "oh shit."

name: LAURA
dialogue: See, he slipped-of-the-tongue before and he screwed us over with a sneaky-sneaky!

name: MATT
dialogue: It's been a long week. I know. Sorry. As Clarota drifts, "Our people, we are a structured "society. Together we provide for each other. Broken into creeds, we function rather "pleasantly." And he drifts forward again at full pace.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Clarota seems pretty excited to get home. I'm worried for him.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Worried for him?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes.

name: LIAM
dialogue: What, for his effect on the group?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm worried that they won't take him back, what that will do to his state.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, the bottom line is, (sighs) we have a pretty clear goal at hand. Everything else will have to be figured out afterward.

name: ORION
dialogue: I still follow Clarota. I'm like, "So is it-- do you do it with your mind, or is it just "like-- were you all taught as a child to be able to levitate, because it seems--"

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's inherent, much like your gifts. It's just how we get around."

name: ORION
dialogue: Good to know. Understood.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: K'Varn, the god in darkness. I want to wrack my brain to think if I've ever had any lessons or if that name has ever come up in any of my reading.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. It'd be a history check. Like a super-super history check.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: History check?

name: LIAM
dialogue: A super history check.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No whammies. That's a 13.

name: MATT
dialogue: 13? The name is as fresh to you as it was the day you heard it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, fiddlesticks.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I walk over to Lady Kima and I say, "How's that that greatsword been treating you?"

name: MATT
dialogue: She walks and she's using it almost like a stick in the dirt as she takes a step. "You know, "it's served its purpose so far, I just (sighs) I wish... I wish that vault wasn't lost. Leather isn't "my idea of defensive."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Would you fancy a trade, Kima? I have elven chainmail, if that would help you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Perhaps?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: I could take that leather armor off your hands?

name: SAM
dialogue: But you'll be vulnerable, won't you?

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, actually. The chainmail isn't right for me.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Certainly." (laughs) She looks to you, specifically. (laughs)

name: LAURA
dialogue: (laughs) Stick figure... (laughs)

name: ORION
dialogue: Stick figure! (all laugh)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Got it! Got it. We're good.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Perhaps we'll find a more modest place to swap, but yes, I agree."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Dang it, I should've done that before we--

name: SAM
dialogue: I can make you a modest spot to change?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Grog, are you skinning a boar over there? What are you doing?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, that's what they call it in some countries. (all laugh)

name: MATT
dialogue: Some of you summon the stapler straw.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Summon the staples!

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughs) All right, so. As you continue to press forward deeper into this tunnel network, the air begins to grow steadily colder and colder. The temperature, it's-- you begin to see your breath a little bit in the air.

name: ORION
dialogue: Am I mistaken? You're really damaged still?

name: LIAM
dialogue: We slept!

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, you guys all slept overnight.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'm up to full, yeah.

name: ORION
dialogue: So, the scars are...?

name: LAURA
dialogue: The scars are cool!

name: MATT
dialogue: I mean, the visual scars are still there but he's at full hit points. They're healing slowly.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, don't you fix these.

name: ORION
dialogue: As I notice, I go, "Anybody with (mumbling) knowledge of medicine should give a whack at "cleaning some of those."

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, you know what, though? Before we go any further, I remind Pike that Vax's foot damage needs daily repair, doesn't it?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh! Yes, of course!" She comes over and you guys take a slight break as Pike comes and sets you down.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's not pretty to look at.

name: LAURA
dialogue: She's seen it already, brother.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh, I've seen worse."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Wait, what happened to your foot?

name: LAURA
dialogue: It got melted off. Aw, come on, not again!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh my god! (laughs) That looks awful. Really awful.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's fine, except the pinkie toe

name: LAURA
dialogue: He's got a little pinkie nubbin!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Pinky toe's a nubbin now, yeah

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You know, we could just take care of the whole thing right now, if you want.

name: ORION
dialogue: No, Grog, that defeats the purpose.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No? Rash? ...all right.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I need Percy to make me a replacement first.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Make a little metal toe?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Pike, could you hook a brother up?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Certainly." She sets the foot down, she begins to gather up her runes, and she's casting a 4th-level spell.

name: LAURA
dialogue: She should've done it before we went to sleep.

name: MATT
dialogue: Aye, but alas, she's not here. Sorry, Ashley. So that would be the equivalent of about 32 hit points. She's also going to attempt a medicine roll, as well. Okay. You notice there is some progress that is slow, but some of the burn scarring from the dip in the magma is beginning to slowly subside. Fresh skin is beginning to show, but it's still pretty rough.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It still smells amazing, so if you could just--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It does smell amazing, actually.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's like a weasel on your leg.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Clarota, are we planning on going to your village before we go see K'Varn, or are we going after K'Varn first? I'm confused.

name: MATT
dialogue: "K'Varn resides within the city, the temple."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, is he a mind flayer, then? I mean, is he like you?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I have not seen him myself, since I was cast out before he took the star, took my people "under his spell."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Just to be clear, the temple of what?

name: MATT
dialogue: He leans forward for a second. "The temple. We don't know its original purpose. The city we "acquired, we found, we took root. Yug'Voril existed long before our colony did."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Okay. That's good to know. That's very good to know. Thank you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Very well..." He continues floating forward. The air, still chilly, with steadily more and more moisture. The rock walls become less and less jagged, growing smoother from endless years of condensation, mineral drip, and slow erosion. Begin to give that smooth inner cave look to the outsides of this tunnel.

name: LIAM
dialogue: As we walk, Vax falls in next to Keyleth. "Keyleth?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes? What?

name: LIAM
dialogue: We're walking. Are you all right?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm doing okay.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You are?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah. Why?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Everything we said last night was true. We're here for you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm here for you, too.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We're having a discussion of how best to go about this.

name: LAURA
dialogue: While that happens, can I use my Primeval Awareness to sense if I sense any dragons in the city coming up in front of us?

name: MATT
dialogue: Certainly. As you're walking, the group slows with you, as you have to really maintain concentration on this. You close your eyes and you consider. You sense no sources of dragon within the radial of your ability to sense in this cavern structure.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are our feet leaving footprints?

name: MATT
dialogue: Subtle ones, but yeah.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Son of a bitch! Dust of Tracelessness everywhere! (all laugh) Good!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Missed our little flower girl.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I know! So glad we have him back.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I want to just put something out on the headsets really quickly. "When we get into the "city, I need everyone to promise that we're not going to enter the temple. No one rush in, no one "be brash. No one make a poor decision. We're going to wait. No matter what happens, don't enter the "temple until we've all had a moment to figure out what's happening."

name: LIAM
dialogue: No one be a yahoo.

name: ORION
dialogue: Agreed.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I think it's a trap.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: If there's going to be a trap, it's going to be getting us into the temple.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He wants us. He wants us there.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: He literally invited us into the temple.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So don't go to the temple.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We walk to the temple, we don't enter the temple.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So enter the temple. Understood.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Understood. Excellent.

name: MATT
dialogue: At this point, beginning to notice the tunnel itself, the cavern, is swaying back and forth a little bit with this. As opposed to a straight path, the tunnel is beginning to arc left and right. There's little pockets and crevices beginning to show at certain points, and you start seeing small bits of bluish crystal jutting in small pockets out of cracks in the rock.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Did you say that there was mushrooms? A mushroom forest, a fungus?

name: MATT
dialogue: Clarota yesterday mentioned a fungal forest.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But we haven't seen it yet. But we're starting to go into the crystal caverns.

name: MATT
dialogue: Starting to find bluish crystals, which Pike makes a motion. "Yes, I saw this in my vision, too!"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can I touch some of the crystals? Are they removable?

name: MATT
dialogue: You reach out and touch the crystal. As you do, go ahead and-- no. (all laugh)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Dick move!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I love it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: The greed! The greed gets me.

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughs) You reach out and touch the crystal, and it's cold to the touch, as is most of the stone wall, and you can see there's condensation on it that gets on your fingers a bit. It's smooth, except for the jagged points where the natural formation juts out. You tug on the crystal a little bit, find if there's any place there that's moveable, and it's pretty solid in that rock wall.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Does it appear to be producing cold?

name: MATT
dialogue: No, the temperature doesn't seem different at all to the air. There doesn't seem to be a source at all; it's the same temperature as the rest of the tunnel.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can I do a nature check to figure out what kind of crystal this may be?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, sure.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Tiberius, these look like the crystals on your staff.

name: ORION
dialogue: "Hm? Oh, ooh, yes! They're pretty." I take out one of my daggers-- yes, I do have daggers-- and (clicking noise) I'm going to chip away a couple of chunks.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Actually, let's grab a few chunks. I may have an idea for later.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: 13 for my nature check? Not that great, it's all right.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Throw a few into the Bag of Holding.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. I will say, go ahead and make an Arcana check as well?

name: ORION
dialogue: Oh, yeah, okay. (mumbling) 14.

name: MATT
dialogue: 14? Okay. It's hard-pressed to find out where these crystals came from, what their source is, or if they naturally are here or if they're put there through some other means, but the crystals do have a very, very faint magical residual energy to them. Useless, almost. It's the equivalent of finding crumbs at the bottom of a cereal box. It's there. You can see at one point there was something magical about their presence or their creation, but it is long faded.

name: ORION
dialogue: Cool. Sweet.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Do you still want more of them?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'll take a few.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I go Hong Kong Phooey on the wall of crystals with my axe and I just (snarling).

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Thank you!

name: MATT
dialogue: When the noise dies down, you gather shards and pieces. Probably enough to fill a small bucket. You can indeed fill your small bucket, should you have one. That is your prerogative, Grog.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I don't, but I have a fancy robe. And I put it in there and I bundle it up.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay! If you had a stick, you could be a crystal hobo.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: A fancy bundle of crystals.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We also have a fancy Bag of Holding.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's in the bag. It's all in the bag.

name: MATT
dialogue: About a half an hour further down this tunnel, both Vax and Vex simultaneously notice a part of the wall to the left that is actually visibly cracked and what appears to be almost a narrow passage that juts off to the left. However, there is a large boulder, solid stone, that is wedged into this. Apparently blocking the passage.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Grog, we need you over here.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Could you possibly move this very large, very heavy boulder for us?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Scanlan, you as well.

name: SAM
dialogue: Of course.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I need your help.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Pike!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I would like to move the boulder.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can I perception around it before we do anything?

name: MATT
dialogue: Certainly! Go ahead and roll perception.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It's in the path?

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's a side path that's been blocked.

name: LIAM
dialogue: 15 for Vax.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, did you see it?! It was there and it went like that! It was a 20 and then it went (squeaky noise) because it was on the side. But that's okay. 20 is what it ended up as.

name: MATT
dialogue: 20? Okay. Both of you guys take a look. There's nothing immediately dangerous at all. It just looks like this rock was not naturally formed here, of course. It looks like it was wedged in. Like it was actually placed there intentionally.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: 26? On the strength check?

name: MATT
dialogue: On the strength check? So as you guys are explaining, "This seems to be a fairly--" You don't even get to finish your sentence before Grog goes-- grabs the boulder, gets underneath and, lifting with the knees, Atlas-style. Puts the weight on the back and (groans)--

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm singing to help him, to inspire him. "(singing) Push it, push it real good! Push it, "push it real good!"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (singing) Push it, push it real good.

name: MATT
dialogue: With a resounding (scraping sound) scraping sound and a large crack, some of the rocks that it's wedged in break off and tumble to the sides, and you get the boulder free and you're now clutching it on top of you. And it's very, very heavy.

name: ORION
dialogue: Oh! I use my Mage Hand and I push it, too.

name: MATT
dialogue: You lose your balance over the boulder as it's now shoved off of its axis.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh no!

name: MATT
dialogue: It falls behind you, slamming into the wall, blocking half the passage, the passage you guys were going down immediately. You can still pass it, you just have to walk around it. And you may have tweaked something in your back a little in the process.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, Grog, how's your back?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I roll over on my stomach and I ask Trinket to step on my back.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, Trinket, give him a massage. He's really good at it!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I roll over and have Trinket step on my back.

name: MATT
dialogue: Trinket gets up, pushes on you with the bear claws.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Make biscuits, Trinket. Make biscuits on Grog's back.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (groans in relief)

name: MATT
dialogue: You can hear the cracks.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can I look down the passageway that was opened up?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Thank god.

name: MATT
dialogue: You can. The passage is very, very thin. It can maybe fit you individually. It can barely fit Grog when you actually go through the passage proper.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's pretty spacious in here, I think. (all laugh)

name: MATT
dialogue: For a gnome, yes. But yeah, it's pitch black going forward. Which means you guys can see. It's equivalent of low light for you in pitch darkness. About 30 feet ahead of you, you can see the path continues for a little bit and then widens up into what looks like a small chamber. But you'd have to get closer.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Is it dangerous at all?

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a perception check.

name: ORION
dialogue: Everywhere is dangerous.

name: SAM
dialogue: How far is the chamber?

name: MATT
dialogue: About 30, 35 feet back. So?

name: MATT
dialogue: Best you can tell, it just looks like a chamber and it looks like a hallway.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We should investigate.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It just looks like a death trap.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: If this is a tomb, I'm going to be so pissed at the two of you.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Tiberius, can you send a little light down that passageway?

name: ORION
dialogue: Yeah, sure. You want to shoot an arrow for me, love?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Let's do it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Vax chases the arrow.

name: SAM
dialogue: You're just going to go down the hall?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, stealth.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right, so, as the light-- the arrow shaft vibrantly bursts into bright, Tiberius-created light. It arcs slightly down the hallway. Only a 35-foot distance. It goes pretty quickly and then (sound of arrow embedding itself) into what looks like a piece of rock, actually wedging itself into a piece of rock before falling to the ground, chipping a chunk upon impact. As it hits, you can see it's a small, roundish, oval chamber. You can see what looks like small piles on the ground at the far end. Still hard to make out from this distance, but you are welcome to enter.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I followed it.

name: MATT
dialogue: You followed it in?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, I rolled a 26 on stealth.

name: MATT
dialogue: Right. You rush in.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Follow up the arrow.

name: SAM
dialogue: Bear trap! (all laugh)

name: MATT
dialogue: First thing you understand: the air smells faintly of ancient untouched dust and mildew.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh no, what did we just let loose?

name: MATT
dialogue: You glance at the floor and notice what appear to be six long-dead bodies strewn across the ground.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: How long-dead?

name: MATT
dialogue: Skeletal and covered in webs.

name: SAM
dialogue: Who's in there? Just Vax right now?

name: MATT
dialogue: Just now Vax.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm going to check out the very first, the closest body to the exit.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, go ahead and make an investigation check.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Nah, it's fine. They're dead.

name: MATT
dialogue: 19, okay. As you look across the body, I mean there's nothing formal about this area, there's no fine, chiseled structure. It looks like a natural formation. It just appears to have been the final destination for whoever these individuals were. And you do notice, the way they're adorned, they were an adventuring party. They were people who came down here long ago for whatever reason and the last destination was this small cavernous space.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You said they're covered in webs?

name: MATT
dialogue: There are webs on them, but the webs themselves are small, natural spider.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Small, natural. So not Bilbo Baggins.

name: MATT
dialogue: But you do notice that each one of their skulls has a giant hole bored into the bone itself. Different places in the skull.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm just going to start searching all of them.

name: MATT
dialogue: Anyone else want to do anything?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm going to make my way, as well.

name: ORION
dialogue: I thought we were all following.

name: MATT
dialogue: The rest of you make your way in one by one. It's a small room.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm staying outside with Trinket and Grog.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, you guys hang out there.

name: SAM
dialogue: I feel like Pike wouldn't want us to do too much damage to these bodies. I just feel like she wouldn't want us to disturb them.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I don't give a shit about these bodies. I care about what they are carrying.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, looking at it, you notice that they have been here for at least 200 years. Two of the bodies are male humans. There are two dwarven bodies: one male, one's female.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Armor. Look for armor!

name: MATT
dialogue: One female gnome and one half-orc.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Wait, wait. What? (all laugh)

name: ORION
dialogue: Half-orc.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Half-orc? Okay. Hang on. You listed all that off.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm going to inspect the gnome.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You're not even in the room.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, so you enter the room. Roll an investigation check.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Looking at her, you find that most of these bodies have already been for the most part turned over and looted. Some of them have no armor. They're either in plain clothes or it looks like their bodies have been tossed and taken whatever was on them, off. You do find, buried in the dirt under the gnomish female what looks to be a pristine ruby. Worth probably quite a bit.

name: ORION
dialogue: I'm going to do an arcana check of 22. Just on the pile of bodies.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, I'll get to you in just a second. You, as you're inspecting the bodies on the other side, you come across the dwarven male is still fully armored.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Ooh!

name: ORION
dialogue: Nice.

name: MATT
dialogue: Welcome, everyone, to this Thursday's episode of Critical Role, where a bunch of us nerdy-ass voice actors get together and play Dungeons & Dragons. This will be our 10th episode, I think, which is awesome. For all the classic folks that have been coming every week, good to see you again; for a bunch of newcomers out there as well, welcome and thank you. I hope you enjoy. We're going to cut to some videos here. Probably the last time that we run the character backstories at the start of the show. We usually use it as partially a stall method when some of our players haven't gotten here on time. (clears throat) i.e., Scanlan. But he's on his way, I'm sure. But also since we have a lot of new people watching, and we figured it would be cool for them to actually get an idea of the character backgrounds, as well, but going forward, we'll just be playing them for the intermission break. So we'll be back here in about 10 minutes or so. In the meantime, enjoy the character backstories. We'll see you guys in just a moment. [dramatic music]

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Pike grew up on the outskirts of town, near the Bramblewood. Her ancestors were a family of deep gnomes with quite an unfavorable reputation. Thievery, destruction, and trickery left them with the curse of the last name Trickfoot. Sarenrae, the goddess of healing and redemption, had other plans for Pike's great-great-grandfather Wilhand, who left his family at a young age after a dream, a dream that changed the course of the Trickfoot family. Wilhand devoted his life to Sarenrae and pledged from then on that him and his family would live a life of service and devotion. As a child, Pike seemed to have an affinity to heal. Whether it was animals, people, or even flowers, she felt she had a purpose in making things whole that had once been broken. She studied and learned the ways to heal though divine magic. She lived a peaceful life, quiet and simple, until one day, Wilhand was captured and almost killed by a group of goliath barbarians. One of the goliaths took a stand against the murder of the innocent gnome and he himself was beaten, bloodied, and left for dead, abandoned by his herd. Wilhand went to Pike for help. She prayed and healed this barbarian as best she could, bringing him back to life. When he awoke, she discovered his name was Grog Strongjaw. After that, they were best of friends, a rather unlikely pair. Little did she know that in a few years' time, Grog would soon return the favor and bring her back from the clutches of death. (roar, crunch) After being killed in battle, Pike felt angry. She wanted to be stronger so that it would never happen again. She spent four months at sea training with the men and women aboard a ship called the Broken Howl. Gripping her holy symbol in one hand, and her morningstar in the other, this time, Pike is ready.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Right, Listen up! If you have ale, then you have a friend in Grog Strongjaw. A goliath of towering height and size, this barbarian has an appetite for the two great loves in his life: combat, women, and ale! (chuckle) (record scratch) Wait. Easily the brains of the group, Grog is often consulted for his vast knowledge of shapes, colors, and (chuckle) shiny things! Also ale. In his early years, armed with his two-handed great axe, Grog often enjoyed proving his might amongst the ranks of his family's wandering herd. But after coming upon an unsuspecting elderly gnome in the woods, he objected to the killing of such an innocent life. A creature of impulse, Grog felt only pity for this-- well, this terrified little thing. And his disobedience cost him dearly. Beaten bloody and banished by the herd leader, his uncle Kevdak, Grog was abandoned and left to die. Exiled from his herd, it was then that the relative of the very gnome he fought to save, saved him. It was the kindness of a gnome cleric named Pike that healed Grog, bringing him back from death's edge. And they have remained close friends ever since. Most nights, Grog can be found challenging entire taverns to wrestling matches! Ha! or accompanying Scanlan to the nearest house where you pay for<U+FFFD> lady favors. Also ale!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: A first impression of Keyleth would leave you with little information on the half-elven druid. You might even think that her social awkwardness due to her sheltered upbringing is kind of sweet. (chuckle) Of course, it would be unwise to underestimate her based on first impressions. (thunder) Under that unintimidating petite frame is a vicious beast waiting to be unleashed, whose natural powers have made even the fiercest of champions pee their pants, literally! (soft chuckle) Born to the Air Tribe of the Ashari people, Keyleth was raised with a deep love of nature and the elemental magics. It is her people's inherent duty to protect the delicate areas in Tal'Dorei where the four elemental planes begin to bleed with this realm. Since she was a little girl, she had quite a knack for air manipulation and beast shaping abilities. Well, if you consider kittens and flying squirrels to be little beasts. Which, I do. (clears throat) Anyways, it wasn't long before the headmaster of the tribe, her father, Korren, realized her true prodigious abilities and she was inveterated to succeed him as the next headmaster. Just like that, her jovial childhood was stripped and replaced with endless spell memorization, teachings from ancient traditions, and exceedingly high expectations. Every druid leader to be must embark on journey to seek out the sister tribes in order to introduce and establish respect amongst the fellow headmasters. They call this the AraMente, or Noble Odyssey. When her father felt she was ready, he set her on the path to truly discovering herself, not knowing when, or if, she will ever return. As she hiked down the mountain towards Stillben, she meditated on the task ahead. Part of the AraMente is proving yourself a strong warrior, a valiant protector, and a wise and compassionate leader. With this knowledge, one thought plays on repeat in her mind: Is she even worthy?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Percy was the third of seven children, born to a noble family who lived far to the north in the ancient castle of Whitestone. With so many siblings to share the burdens of lordship, Percy turned his attentions to the sciences, engineering, and naturalism. One day, a mysterious couple named Lord and Lady Briarwood came to court. During a feast held in their honor, the Briarwoods violently took control of the castle, killing or imprisoning everyone who would stand in their way. Percy awoke chained in the dungeon, only to be freed by his younger sister. Together they fled, chased by the Briarwoods' men. As they ran, Percy's sister took several arrows to the chest and fell. Percy kept running, eventually jumping into a freezing river and floating unconscious to freedom. He did not remember waking up on a fishing boat. He barely remembered the next two years, as he slowly made his way as far south as possible. Then one night, Percy had a dream. A roaring cloud of smoke offered him vengeance against those who destroyed his family. When he awoke, Percy began to design his first gun. (gunshot)

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, you haven't heard of Scanlan Shorthalt? Well, gird your loins, ladies, because he has his eye on you. A talented musician, master of disguise, and dashingly handsome in his own mind, Scanlan sings songs almost as much as he sings his own praises. Born a poor gnome, Scanlan used his endless charm and soaring tenor voice to croon for coin and support his single mother. One day he was discovered by a half-orc promoter, and joined Dr. Dranzel's Spectacular Traveling Troupe, where he learned the ways of the world, and honed his skills as a bard extraordinaire. A loner much of his life, Scanlan has never quite come to terms with the violent death of his mother at the hands of a goblin invasion. While his years on the road provided many, shall we say, educational experiences with the opposite sex, deep down, Scanlan yearns for the one thing he's never known: the true love of a fellow gnome. Still, Scanlan considers himself a lover first, performer second, and fighter distant third. On the battlefield, he'll support his allies, but rarely draws blood, unless it's to protect fellow gnome, Pike. Count on Scanlan for a hearty laugh, a rollicking song, and a twinkle in his eye that melts hearts and makes the females swoon.

name: ORION
dialogue: Greetings and salutations. I am Tiberius Stormwind. I hail from a town called Ty'rex, located in the heart of Draconia. From a politically respected family, at the age of 15, I succeeded in passing the Sorcerer's Rite, showing prodigy-like control of my magic. The judges and the Draconian high council were amazed at how powerful my spells were for how long I had been training. At 20 years old, I was the youngest appointed member of the magic guild in Draconian history. For the next few years, I almost went mad from the malaise of being a guild member, as it's rather boring. However, one day I happened upon a chamber, unused for quite some time. In the room were stacks of books and maps of the surrounding cities and areas around the known world. For months, I would frequent the chamber, and learned of artifacts from legend. After a long period of research, I made a list of artifacts that caught my eye. I brought these findings to the high council and was told that all of the information in the chamber I had stumbled upon was either believed to be fiction, or unsolvable mysteries, and hence were lost forever. I found those answers to be unacceptable. A year later, I devised a ruse and managed to convince the city council to lend support in me leaving Draconia on a mission of peace and diplomacy for the surrounding kingdoms. Going from town to town and making friends and allies, in and for the name of Draconia. Being a red dragonborn, I had quite the task on my hands in that respect, but it was exactly what I needed so I could explore the world and find these artifacts, as I felt the truth was out there. Some may describe me as buffoonish, but I say poppycock to all that. I am much sharper than most give me credit for. I just don't pay attention to things sometimes. I've also been known to be rather cunning, loyal, happy-go-lucky, and well, dangerous. I can't help but show my true scales every now and then. But overall, I think I'm quite friendly for a dragonborn!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Never entirely welcome in the company of elves or men, Vax'ildan learned at a young age to skip past formality, preferring instead to invite himself in your door. Along with twin sister Vex'ahlia, Vax was born by a chance encounter between elven royalty and human peasantry. Raised by their mother in their early years, the twins were eventually sent off to their father in the elven capital of Syngorn. But their cool reception among the elves there never warmed, and their time in the capital didn't last. The siblings stole away one autumn night and set out on the open road. After a few years of wandering, they eventually decided to return to their mother, and journeyed back to the lands of their youth. But instead of finding their childhood home, they returned to a pile of rubble. Their mother was gone, their home burned to ash. Pressing the townspeople for answers, they learned of the day the dragon came. (roar) With their ties all severed, Vax'ildan and his sister set out to find their fortune together in Tal'Dorei. An outsider since birth, Vax quickly learned to solve life's challenges in his own particular way, often by side-stepping them entirely. And when his knack for circumventing adversity isn't enough, (knife scraping) the way of blades the elves schooled him in more than makes up the difference.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Like so many half-elves, Vex'ahlia has spent most of her life suffering the cool reception of a people who don't fully accept her. Born of a human mother and an elven father who only later in life took an interest in their existence, Vex'ahlia and her twin brother Vax'ildan quickly realized the only people they could truly rely on in this world were each other. It was at the age of ten when the two were taken from their mother and brought to live in Syngorn, the isolated elven city for which their father was an ambassador. He quietly took them in, but always kept an icy distance, and after too many years of disdainful looks, the pair decided to leave his indifference behind, and set out on their own. Vax took to the cities, stealing small trinkets and learning the ways of the thief, while Vex kept to the woods; she preferred the isolation. Always the keen observer, she learned to hunt and to track, to spy and to shoot. And through a series of fateful events, earned herself a companion in the form of a bear-- her own stolen Trinket-- to fight alongside her and protect her fiercely. Also, he is adorable, and gives expert massages. [dramatic music]

Looking inside, it all looks like a natural cavern interior. The light is the same glowing white light that you're used to. Once it enters the deep part of the cave, the light almost gets a purplish hue before it's snuffed out.

name: LAURA
dialogue: This doesn't seem very good.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Wait, the light gets a purplish hue?

name: MATT
dialogue: The white light becomes purple and then (ffft) is snuffed.

dialogue: I want to do an arcana check. 18. Check for any nasty magic.

name: MATT
dialogue: At this distance, it's hard to make out any sort of source. You don't sense anything directly, at your distance. You'd probably have to get deeper in the cave to make a true assessment of the magical source.

dialogue: Oh, you didn't add ten to your stealth. Pass Without a Trace.

dialogue: You have Pass Without a Trace now, too?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, I already-- yeah.

name: LIAM
dialogue: So my stealth was at a 41.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Good to know. (laughs)

dialogue: What do we do? We've got to get-- someone's going in.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Want me to go in?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, man! Go in!

name: OTHERS
dialogue: No!

name: LIAM
dialogue: No, if anyone's going in, send me. I'm at a 41 stealth, and if we stay on the beach, we're in view of the main island.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We've got to try to hide a little bit.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: So the arrow's not still lit? It just went through? Can you Light, Tiberius?

dialogue: Just get some light in there. Can you put Daylight in there?

dialogue: Tiberius, my dagger. Do the dagger.

dialogue: Well, sure, but it means that thing will be bright the whole time.

dialogue: Non-magical.

dialogue: Yeah, throw a torch in.

dialogue: Yeah, let's just toss a torch.

name: ORION
dialogue: (fire breath noise)

dialogue: You see nothing in particular. You catch what looks almost like small whiffs of almost a mist or a fog, but it's like, (ffft) then vanish, (shh).

name: LAURA
dialogue: I don't think we should go in there.

name: MATT
dialogue: Almost like there's this perpetually materializing and dematerializing tufts of small clouds of smoke.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Forget this. Forget this cave. Keyleth, can you do that thing you do where you make the beach look like an empty beach, or something other than it is? Can we camp on the beach instead of going in there?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I can.

name: ORION
dialogue: Let's do that. I agree. I'm tired.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What if this is a clue or something important?

dialogue: Yeah, we've never shied away from a confrontation before.

name: ORION
dialogue: Pike, can you sense if there's any nasties down there?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Can I use Dispel Magic?

dialogue: You can attempt to, yeah.

dialogue: Okay, I'll attempt.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. So Pike, as you step up to the mouth of the cave, looking where the torchlight is, you cast Dispel Magic. As you formulate your divine energy, grasping onto your symbol of Sarenrae around your neck, you can see this strange pulsing shimmer of divine energy that clears out the area. The purplish hue to the light vanishes and the light becomes a natural torchlight for a moment and all the wisps of smoke vanish... then slowly filter back into the space.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We don't need to go in there.

name: LAURA

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, but she'll be fine!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Wall it up!

dialogue: Should we check for traps?

dialogue: It's hard to tell. You can't see the entire cavern from this distance, because the cavern opens up and then curves around. There's a whole portion you can't see without entering it.

dialogue: Here's what I think, all right? We don't need to whack every problem over the head, and we have something far more important than whatever's in there.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Right, Lady Kima?

dialogue: "I think we have a specific goal at this point in time, "and who knows what dangers or terrors roam these tunnels "aside from our specific directional choice at this moment."

dialogue: The only question is, do we want to try to rest here under some sort of illusion, or do we go to the island we can see?

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, because the island's way over back here.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We rest here. We take shifts. We should be fine.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We could sail there to the northwestern edge of the island. There's some sort of structure there.

dialogue: I think we rest up before we do that.

dialogue: What if there's something in this cavern that could help us, though?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can you wall it up?

dialogue: Oh. Hello.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh. Okay.

dialogue: All right. We'll all be ready to attack on the outside.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Maybe? Okay?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Go for it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yeah, let's go for it. This is a terrible plan. I think it's a great idea.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Let's do it. I like it.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, let's send in one person.

name: ORION
dialogue: As soon as I see Her Royalty go in--

dialogue: All right. You all gather yourself on the exterior of the cave. You get into defensive positions and prepare--

dialogue: Can I ask one quick question before we go? Regardless of what happens, if there is something shitty in here or not, are we camping here afterward?

dialogue: Yes.

dialogue: We're sure? Okay. Then I click my Boots of Haste.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right.

dialogue: I'm going to go ahead and cast Enhance Ability on myself before I do that, and give myself... extra wisdom.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right, extra wisdom.
