dialogue: A first impression of Keyleth would leave you with little information on the half-elven druid. You might even think that her social awkwardness due to her sheltered upbringing is kind of sweet. (chuckle) Of course, it would be unwise to underestimate her based on first impressions. (thunder) Under that unintimidating petite frame is a vicious beast waiting to be unleashed, whose natural powers have made even the fiercest of champions pee their pants, literally! (soft chuckle) Born to the Air Tribe of the Ashari people, Keyleth was raised with a deep love of nature and the elemental magics. It is her people's inherent duty to protect the delicate areas in Tal'Dorei where the four elemental planes begin to bleed with this realm. Since she was a little girl, she had quite a knack for air manipulation and beast shaping abilities. Well, if you consider kittens and flying squirrels to be little beasts. Which, I do. (clears throat) Anyways, it wasn't long before the headmaster of the tribe, her father, Korren, realized her true prodigious abilities and she was inveterated to succeed him as the next headmaster. Just like that, her jovial childhood was stripped and replaced with endless spell memorization, teachings from ancient traditions, and exceedingly high expectations. Every druid leader to be must embark on a journey to seek out the sister tribes in order to introduce and establish respect amongst the fellow headmasters. They call this the Aramente, or Noble Odyssey. When her father felt she was ready, he set her on the path to truly discovering herself, not knowing when, or if, she will ever return. As she hiked down the mountain towards Stillben, she meditated on the task ahead. Part of the Aramente is proving yourself a strong warrior, a valiant protector, and a wise and compassionate leader. With this knowledge, one thought plays on repeat in her mind: Is she even worthy?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Percy was the third of seven children, born to a noble family who lived far to the north in the ancient castle of Whitestone. With so many siblings to share the burdens of lordship, Percy turned his attentions to the sciences, engineering, and naturalism. One day, a mysterious couple named Lord and Lady Briarwood came to court. During a feast held in their honor, the Briarwoods violently took control of the castle, killing or imprisoning everyone who would stand in their way. Percy awoke chained in the dungeon, only to be freed by his younger sister. Together they fled, chased by the Briarwoods' men. As they ran, Percy's sister took several arrows to the chest and fell. Percy kept running, eventually jumping into a freezing river and floating unconscious to freedom. He did not remember waking up on a fishing boat. He barely remembered the next two years, as he slowly made his way as far south as possible. Then one night, Percy had a dream. A roaring cloud of smoke offered him vengeance against those who destroyed his family. When he awoke, Percy began to design his first gun. (gunshot)

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Pike grew up on the outskirts of town, near the Bramblewood. Her ancestors were a family of deep gnomes with quite an unfavorable reputation. Thievery, destruction, and trickery left them with the curse of the last name Trickfoot. Sarenrae, the goddess of healing and redemption, had other plans for Pike's great-great-grandfather Wilhand, who left his family at a young age after a dream: a dream that changed the course of the Trickfoot family. Wilhand devoted his life to Sarenrae and pledged from then on that him and his family would live a life of service and devotion. As a child, Pike seemed to have an affinity to heal. Whether it was animals, people, or even flowers, she felt she had a purpose in making things whole that had once been broken. She studied and learned the ways to heal though divine magic. She lived a peaceful life, quiet and simple, until one day, Wilhand was captured and almost killed by a group of goliath barbarians. One of the goliaths took a stand against the murder of the innocent gnome and he himself was beaten, bloodied, and left for dead, abandoned by his herd. Wilhand went to Pike for help. She prayed and healed this barbarian as best she could, bringing him back to life. When he awoke, she discovered his name was Grog Strongjaw. After that, they were the best of friends, a rather unlikely pair. Little did she know that in a few years' time, Grog would soon return the favor and bring her back from the clutches of death. (roar, crunch) After being killed in battle, Pike felt angry. She wanted to be stronger so that it would never happen again. She spent four months at sea training with the men and women aboard a ship called the Broken Howl. Gripping her holy symbol in one hand, and her morningstar in the other, this time, Pike is ready.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, you haven't heard of Scanlan Shorthalt? Well, gird your loins, ladies, because he has his eye on you. A talented musician, master of disguise, and dashingly handsome in his own mind, Scanlan sings songs almost as much as he sings his own praises. Born a poor gnome, Scanlan used his endless charm and soaring tenor voice to croon for coin and support his single mother. One day he was discovered by a half-orc promoter and joined Dr. Dranzel's Spectacular Traveling Troupe, where he learned the ways of the world and honed his skills as a bard extraordinaire. A loner much of his life, Scanlan has never quite come to terms with the violent death of his mother at the hands of a goblin invasion. While his years on the road provided many, shall we say, educational experiences with the opposite sex, deep down, Scanlan yearns for the one thing he's never known: the true love of a fellow gnome. Still, Scanlan considers himself a lover first, performer second, and fighter distant third. On the battlefield, he'll support his allies, but rarely draws blood, unless it's to protect fellow gnome, Pike. Count on Scanlan for a hearty laugh, a rollicking song, and a twinkle in his eye that melts hearts and makes the females swoon.

name: ORION
dialogue: Greetings and salutations. I am Tiberius Stormwind. I hail from a town called Ty'rex, located in the heart of Draconia. From a politically respected family, at the age of 15, I succeeded in passing the Sorcerer's Rite, showing prodigy-like control of my magic. The judges and the Draconian high council were amazed at how powerful my spells were for how long I had been training. At 20 years old, I was the youngest appointed member of the magic guild in Draconian history. For the next few years, I almost went mad from the malaise of being a guild member, as it's rather boring. However, one day I happened upon a chamber, unused for quite some time.

name: MATT
dialogue: Welcome back. We got a little refresher here and apparently our Overlord has an announcement.

name: ZAC
dialogue: You guys, we're only four away from another giveaway, which is--

name: LUCAS
dialogue: Two away!

name: ZAC
dialogue: Two away, you know what, I'm guessing this is, we're going to get that before I even get back to my seat, so we're going to go do the giveaway. It's the shirt, the dice, the handbook, and the starter set. The handbook and the shirt will be signed by the cast.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yep.

name: ZAC
dialogue: And we still have, if we get to 400, correct, next? Lucas?

name: ZAC
dialogue: If we get to 3,400 by the end of the night, we'll give away a whole other kit like this, with the signed stuff, so you get to subscribe and it supports the channel, keeps us running. I'm not going to interrupt these guys, so when we hit the number I'm just going to give it away through the chat room.

name: MATT
dialogue: Awesome, guys. Well done and congrats to whoever ends up getting that, real fast I hope. So, thank you Overlord.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh wait, this is in here. Can I throw this? Oh no.

name: MATT
dialogue: Pass it off, it's fine.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You get the horn.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can I hold it for a second?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No.

name: ORION
dialogue: No. Oh, I mean in real life. Yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No.

name: ORION
dialogue: I was like, don't touch it.

name: MATT
dialogue: So. Eventually you all manage to make your way towards the outer wall of Emon to the southern portion of the city. The guards let you through. Two of them recognize you from the Winter's Crest celebration that occurred about seven months beforehand. Don't do that, that's going to end poorly. You make your way around the bend to the large grass hill that is surrounded by the river that skirts the outer southern portion of Greyskull Keep. Looking up, you can see against the moonlight the very welcome sight of your home there, beckoning to you to rest. You make your way to the front gates that surround the outskirts of it, and an iron bell kind of goes off for a second, and as you look up, you hear a voice go, "Who goes there? Speak your mind, or a bolt to the "throat you'll find."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Shayne, is that Shayne?

name: ORION
dialogue: Is it dark right now?

name: MATT
dialogue: It's dark, yes.

name: ORION
dialogue: I cast Light. "It's us!"

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, a light pierces off, and you guys look up and you can see, sitting on kind of the watchtower perch--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Or wait, is that Jarett?

name: MATT
dialogue: No, you see up there, short, rough red hair, Shayne Tranter, one of the mercenaries you hired--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, it is Shayne, I was right the first time!

name: MATT
dialogue: She's got her crossbow ready to go, and she's just kind of sitting back and pointing it at the group, and she goes,

name: LIAM
dialogue: Hello! Hi!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Hope you remember us!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Shayne!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We're drunk!

name: SAM
dialogue: We pay you!

name: MATT
dialogue: She laughs. Takes her crossbow, sets it to her side.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: We forgot our key!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, aren't you a sight for sore eyes? It's been nearly a week since you left."

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's it?

name: SAM
dialogue: Feels like a month.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Feels like three months.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Feels like eleven weeks. It feels like a very long time.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, it's probably closer to two weeks. Fair enough. Either way. Open the gates! Cordell, "open the gates!"

name: SAM
dialogue: Cordell? I don't remember the names of any of our guards.

name: MATT
dialogue: Cordell, he's one of the other half-orc guards that you hired when you left.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We have Shayne, Cordell, Jarett, Kendrick, and Nitebe.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Jarett was the one we appointed as the head guard, right? Captain?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Jarett? I think so. I didn't write that part down.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I don't remember about the little fellow.

name: SAM
dialogue: Our staff is so unappreciated, guys.

name: MATT
dialogue: So as the gate slowly opens, Cordell walking out, this is the hearty half-orc merc dressed in scale armor, and he has a large sword slung on his back, just shoves it open to about a two-foot distance. "Come on. Welcome home." As each of you guys walk through, he kinda claps you on the back as you walk in. You make your way into the small courtyard leading to-- making your way into Greyskull Keep. Towards the front door, as you get there, the front door opens on its own as you're about ten feet away and peering from the inside of the low-lit interior you see a woman's face, a plump blond woman's face, peek through. This is Laina. Laina goes, "Oh, you're back, fantastic! It's "early." And she rubs her face and you see as she pushes the door open a little more, she's wearing her nightgown, and she's excited but still very tired. "Come in, come in, come in, please, please! "Who's that?" And points to the large stone statue you're dragging behind you.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, we decided to get a statue for the garden.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Garden gnome.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Very well, very well, come in."

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Hey! (laughter)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: He's drunk.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm drunk!

name: MATT
dialogue: So the human woman leads you all back in.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Put the gun down, Percy.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Bad News.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's not Cinco de Mayo.

name: MATT
dialogue: She steps back with her knitted boots; she's definitely in comfortable mode. She eagerly hugs each of you as you enter, happy that you've all arrived, she's like, "I swear it's-- I've not had "an employer leave so quickly after my hiring. But glad to see you're all safe. Shall I make everyone "a meal, are you hungry?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Starving.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'll get right to it." And she turns around, and you see further down the hallway Erwen Dastell, your older halfling servant who shuffles up with his nightcap on, it's long and dangling off his shoulders, he's got this long night robe on, he's kinda carrying a small candle. "My "goodness. The hour is late of your arrival, but I can't say I am not excited to see you. Come in, "your beds are ready, everything's been cleaned and made to your specifications. Laina! To food!" "I'm already on it, Erwen." She kinda smacks him on the back. He says, "Very well, then."

name: SAM
dialogue: I love their banter.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, they're so cute.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I will go back to bed, if that's fine with you."

name: SAM
dialogue: Is there any urgent, oppressing news, any visitors that we should know about who came while we were gone, anything before you retire for the evening?

name: MATT
dialogue: "No, I believe your friend, the mage woman with the blue robes came by once."

name: SAM
dialogue: Allara?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Allura. She came by a couple days ago, just to see if you had returned. But I didn't know "where you were, and she said she'd try again later."

name: SAM
dialogue: Any packages, mail, post?

name: MATT
dialogue: "None that I know of, no. In fact it's been very quiet."

name: SAM
dialogue: All right, thank you.

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Quiet is good.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Back to my quarters." And he shuffles off, goes towards his bed. You guys make your way into the main dining chamber of your Keep, four large round tables set out with the chairs around it. You can see, for the most part, it's been untouched other than a couple of chairs that are set ajar, probably by your mercenary soldiers who've been eating and/or have been keeping up. There's a couple of empty tables set on the side that immediately Laina goes, "I'm so sorry, I "guess I should've taken care of this." And she stumbles off towards the kitchen and you guys all eventually find yourselves sitting, sore, exhausted, mildly intoxicated, around these chairs and take a very deep-breathing sigh of relief at being back home here in Emon in Greyskull Keep.

name: SAM
dialogue: Should we un-stone Kima, or should we sleep on it?

name: ORION
dialogue: I stand up and I head towards the sleeping quarters and I just say, "Leave her to stone "tonight, we'll deal with it tomorrow." And I go to bed.

name: SAM
dialogue: I turn him into a rat.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Dispel Magic.

name: MATT
dialogue: Go ahead and make a wisdom saving throw, Tiberius.

name: ORION
dialogue: Hold on a sec. I can still cast as an animal, right?

name: SAM
dialogue: Nope.

name: MATT
dialogue: Nope, you cannot talk.

name: ORION
dialogue: Oh. I still go to bed. (laughter) So yeah.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Hoo baby.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's adorable.

name: MATT
dialogue: You go under your covers, go to sleep, nuzzle in.

name: ORION
dialogue: In between my pillow.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's quite comfy sleeping like an animal.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: He's a little rat and he still went in his big bed.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I pick up the sleeping rat and just kinda scritch him.

name: LAURA
dialogue: He's in bed.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's all right, he's fine. Look, see, his leg's going, he's dreaming about something nice.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We ate already, right?

name: MATT
dialogue: You snacked a bit as you made it through the town, but for the most part like, a meal's being prepared. You begin to smell now the cooking of meat, Laina's setting it up for you guys.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You're dreaming of magical artifacts, aren't you?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Quick question, friends: So we kind of started a war, am I right?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah. Pretty sure we did.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Kraghammer is potentially in grave danger, am I right?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We might want to let them know.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We should probably let them know as soon as possible.

name: LIAM
dialogue: First of all, Clarota was lying through his noodles, and second, even if he wasn't, which he was, he's now fucking pissed off--

name: LAURA
dialogue: He's dead.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, they're all one hive-mind, right? Listen. This is number five tonight.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They weren't particularly connected until the very end, he was dead before they were actually connected.

name: LIAM
dialogue: They're angry. They were following us.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They may not know who we are.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's interesting.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You don't think they're going to scurry up the bottom of Kraghammer and tear that place apart?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We'll let them know, but we may have time, we hurt them very badly.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It took us about a week to get from Kraghammer in, so we've got about a week.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, why don't we do some research, I mean, this was the first time.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, we'd have to stop them on the way out the hole, right? There's only one way in and out.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Don't the dwarves already know that they were there, and they were already prepping for battle?

name: SAM
dialogue: They don't really know what's coming for them.

name: LIAM
dialogue: They don't know anything about mind flayers, they know about weird things coming out, but not the mind flayers.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: So let's send a pigeon or something.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The mind flayers have been down there for ages. There's nothing new.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You don't think they'll come up and attack?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: To be fair, we also did sort of release the mind flayers from their evil dictator.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, they seemed very grateful.

name: SAM
dialogue: We could stop them on their way out.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think this will also be a conversation that Lady Kima will have some--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay, well, the thing we then need to immediately decide, before we un-stone Lady Kima, is what're we going to do with the Horn?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think if we have Allura here, and begin that conversation, then we can have Allura's insight.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Before we un-stone Lady Kima?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes. I think we tell Allura before we un-stone Lady Kima. Everything that's happened--

name: LIAM
dialogue: The only person, the only person that would remotely know is you, Tiberius, and I don't think--

name: SAM
dialogue: He's a rat.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Oh, that's a good boy.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: And he's asleep.

name: LIAM
dialogue: He didn't seem to know anything, I think Allura is the person to go to right now.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, you need to share it with us.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Wake up from bed!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: He's sleeping.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, let's wait until Allura's here, I think, and we can--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Do we tell her, do we tell her we have the Horn? Or do we not?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes, yes, we do.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Why don't we just wake up Tiberius?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Tiberius. Little darling!

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm still punishing him.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm still cuddling him.

name: ORION
dialogue: Did they wake me up?

name: LIAM
dialogue: No! I'm holding you.

name: ORION
dialogue: Okay.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I don't want to wake you up.

name: MATT
dialogue: You start to wake up, and then he scritches the side of your cheek and you go right back to sleep.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Damn it, he's so cute. I don't know what to do.

name: MATT
dialogue: Laina comes out with plates for you guys and sets up these--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Thank. God.

name: MATT
dialogue: They're not pretty, but functional meals of cooked pork, some fine mashed potatoes.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I would like to eat.

name: MATT
dialogue: And you do ravenously, and this is the first warm meal you've really truly had in five, six days.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I take Lady Kima's portions and I--

name: MATT
dialogue: There were no portions made for your garden structure.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Never know.

name: MATT
dialogue: That's okay, there's plenty more.

name: SAM
dialogue: So talk to Allura first, then unfreeze Lady Kima?

name: LIAM
dialogue: She sent us after Kima. Kima thinks that she's in the middle of a fight, the moment she comes out she'll be all hot and bothered--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay, hang on, hang on. That's true, she did send us after Kima, so what if they're both on the side that we don't--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, Allura's going to unfreeze Kima.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We're going to have to trust somebody.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Why don't we just hold onto the Horn for a second and see what they do without it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Why don't we tell them we didn't find it? Why don't we just hide the Horn?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We just hold onto it in the bag.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Don't we have a safe? Didn't we build a safe in our Keep?

name: MATT
dialogue: You did not have a safe built, but you could possibly have that done.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Wait, so why are you guys so against giving the Horn to Kima?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I just feel like if it's so terrible, why does she want it for herself?

name: LAURA
dialogue: She doesn't, she wants to hide it.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Does she want to destroy it?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Maybe she wants to destroy it, maybe she wanted to get it up above ground so she could destroy it.

name: SAM
dialogue: There's a second Horn, maybe she has the other one and wants the matching set.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Do we know that there's a second horn?

name: LAURA
dialogue: She's a paladin, she's good, paladins are good by--

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm fine trusting her. I was fine trusting Clarota.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Do you want to wake up, do you have something important to say?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Right, because no one of the church has ever been bad before.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We didn't trust Clarota. We were using him as much as he was using us.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Some of us truly trusted Clarota.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It went south. Well, most of us.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: All right, fuck it, I walk over and I take the rat out of Vax's hands and I shake it awake.

name: SAM
dialogue: He's still a rat!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I shake it a lot.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I undo his Polymorph, I undo his Polymorph.

name: SAM, MATT
dialogue: With what?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: By Polymorph.

name: MATT
dialogue: You re-Polymorph him?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can I release Polymorph by using Polymorph?

name: MATT
dialogue: No. It's his incantation.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I spit on Tiberius's head and rub it in vigorously.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Scanlan, come on. We need to talk to him.

name: ORION
dialogue: I'm trying to bite Grog. I am not happy.

name: MATT
dialogue: It's like this viscous Grog spit mixed with chunks of pork and mashed potato rubbed in your fur.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Scanlan, he's nipping! Scanlan. Tiberius is nipping. Please.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right, fine. He's a human thing again.

name: LIAM
dialogue: He's not human at all.

name: SAM
dialogue: A dragonborn.

name: ORION
dialogue: Why did you wake me up? I was so comfy being furry! (laughter) I always have scales. It was nice having fur!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I told you. It's nice being cuddly.

name: ORION
dialogue: I was so soft.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Tiberius, we're sorry to wake you.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Tiberius, we're having a lovely breakfast. Tell us a story.

name: ORION
dialogue: Have I rested? What's going on?

name: MATT
dialogue: No, it's been ten minutes.

name: ORION
dialogue: What the fuck? (laughter)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Vex has a question for you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We're all still drunk and awake. We don't want to go to bed yet! Just, just talk with us.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I just want to hear your lovely little explanation, darling, about what the Horn is and why you don't trust Kima.

name: ORION
dialogue: Oh!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Tell us a story.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Tell us a story!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Please. You haven't told any of us anything.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We haven't talked to you in a week.

name: ORION
dialogue: The Horn of Orcus.

name: MATT
dialogue: Horn of Orcus.

name: ORION
dialogue: This thing comes from a devil, a demon. Nothing good could ever come from anything it made in existence. It needs to be destroyed. And I'm sorry. Let me articulate these words a little bit more. There is nothing that you can use this particular artifact for any reason of good. The fact that it is even here is a very bad sign because it was taken from one of these beasts.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: So why don't we destroy it?

name: ORION
dialogue: That's exactly what we need to do.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Isn't that what Kima wanted?

name: LAURA
dialogue: What if they want to destroy it?

name: ORION
dialogue: I don't think they wanted to bring it back.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Question. Why?

name: ORION
dialogue: Because there is-- the liquid hot magma that was below where it was being held was very sufficient for it to be thrown in.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's true. See, I'm with him.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Wait, but your crushing fist couldn't destroy it, so maybe lava can't destroy it, so maybe it needs something extra special that only they know about.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It needs the Sword of Gryffindor.

name: ORION
dialogue: No. Pike could destroy it.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Ex-squeeze me? I don't think that's true.

dialogue: Right, Listen up! If you have ale, then you have a friend in Grog Strongjaw! A goliath of towering height and size, this barbarian has an appetite for the two great loves in his life: combat, women, and ale! (record scratch) Wait. Easily the brains of the group, Grog is often consulted for his vast knowledge of shapes, colors, and shiny things! ...also ale. In his early years, armed with his two handed great axe, Grog often enjoyed proving his might amongst (brawling sounds) Grog often enjoyed proving his might amongst the ranks of his family's wandering herd. (brawling sounds) the ranks of his family's wandering herd. But after coming upon an unsuspecting elderly gnome in the woods, he objected to the killing such an innocent life. A creature of impulse, Grog felt only pity for this... well, this terrified little thing. And his disobedience cost him dearly. (weapon crack) Beaten bloody, and banished by the herd leader, Beaten bloody, and banished by the herd leader, his uncle Kevdak, Grog was abandoned and left to die. Exiled from his herd, it was then that the relative of the very gnome he fought to save, saved him. It was the kindness of a gnome cleric named Pike, that healed Grog, bringing him back from death's edge. And they have remained close friends ever since. Most nights, Grog can be found challenging entire taverns to wrestling matches! Ha! ...or accompanying Scanlan to the nearest house, where you pay for... lady favors. Also ale!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: A first Impression of Keyleth would leave you with little information on the half-elven druid. You might even think that her social awkwardness due to her sheltered upbringing is kind of sweet. (chuckle) Of course, it would be unwise to underestimate her based on first impressions. (thunder crack) based on first impressions. Under that unintimidating petite frame is a vicious beast waiting to be unleashed, whose natural powers have made even the fiercest of champions pee their pants, literally! (soft chuckle) Born to the Air Tribe of the Ashari people, Keyleth was raised with a deep love of nature and the elemental magics. It is her people<U+FFFD>s inherent duty to protect the delicate areas in Tal'Dorei where the four elemental planes begin to bleed with this realm. Since she was a little girl, she had quite a knack for air manipulation and beast shaping abilities. Well, if you consider kittens and flying squirrels to be little beasts. Which, I do. (clears throat) Anyways, it wasn't long before the headmaster of the tribe, her father, Kohren, realized her true prodigious abilities and she was inveterated to succeed him as the next headmaster. Just like that, her jovial childhood was stripped and replaced with endless spell memorization, teachings from ancient traditions, and exceedingly high expectations. Every druid leader to be must embark on a journey to seek out the sister tribes in order to introduce and establish respect amongst the fellow headmasters. They call this the Aramente, or Noble Odyssey. When her father felt she was ready, he set her on the path to truly discovering herself. Not knowing when, or if she will ever return. As she hiked down the mountain towards Stillben, she meditated on the task ahead. Part of the Aramente is proving yourself a strong warrior, a valiant protector, and a wise and compassionate leader. With this knowledge, one thought plays in repeat in her mind: Is she even worthy?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Percy was the third child of seven children, born to a noble family who lived far to the north in the ancient castle of Whitestone. With so many siblings to share the burdens of lordship, Percy turned his attention to the sciences, engineering, and naturalism. One day, a mysterious couple, named Lord and Lady Briarwood, came to court. During a feast held in their honour, the Briarwoods violently took control of the castle, killing or imprisoning everyone who would stand in their way. Percy awoke chained in the dungeon, only to be freed by his younger sister. Together they fled, chased by the Briarwoods<U+0092> men. As they ran, Percy<U+0092>s sister took several arrows to the chest and fell. Percy kept running, eventually jumping into a freezing river and floating unconscious to freedom. He did not remember waking up on a fishing boat. He barely remembered the next two years, as he slowly made his way as far south as possible. Then one night, Percy had a dream. A roaring cloud of smoke offered him vengeance against those who destroyed his family. When he awoke, Percy began to design his first gun. (gun cocks and fires)

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Pike grew up in the outskirts of town, near the Bramblewood. Her ancestors were a family of deep gnomes with quite an unfavorable reputation. Thievery, destruction, and trickery left them with the curse of the last name Trickfoot. Sarenrae, the goddess of healing and redemption, had other plans for Pike's great-great-grandfather, Wilhand, who left his family at a young age after a dream. A dream that changed the course of the Trickfoot family. Wilhand devoted his life to Sarenrae and pledged from then on that him and his family would live a life of service and devotion. As a child, Pike seemed to have an affinity to heal. Whether it was animals, people, or even flowers, she felt she had a purpose in making things whole that had once been broken. She studied and learned the ways to heal though divine magic. She lived a peaceful life, quiet and simple, until one day, Wilhand was captured and almost killed by a group of goliath barbarians. One of the goliaths took a stand against the murder of the innocent gnome and he himself was beaten, bloodied, and left for dead, abandoned by his herd. Wilhand went to Pike for help. She prayed and healed this barbarian as best she could, bringing him back to life. When he awoke, she discovered his name was Grog Strongjaw. After that, they were best of friends, a rather unlikely pair. Little did she know that in a few years' time Grog would soon return the favor and bring her back from the clutches of death. (creature growl and snapping) After being killed in battle, Pike felt angry. She wanted to be stronger so that it would never happen again. She spent four months at sea training with the men and women aboard a ship called the Broken Howl. Gripping her holy symbol in one hand, and her morningstar in the other, this time, Pike is ready.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, you haven<U+0092>t heard of Scanlan Shorthalt? Well, gird your loins, ladies, because he has his eye on you. A talented musician, master of disguise, and dashingly handsome in his own mind, Scanlan sings songs almost as much as he sings his own praises. Born a poor gnome, Scanlan used his endless charm and soaring tenor voice to croon for coin and support his single mother. One day he was discovered by a half-orc promoter, and joined Dr. Dranzel<U+0092>s Spectacular Traveling Troupe where he learned the ways of the world and honed his skills as a bard extraordinaire. A loner much of his life, Scanlan has never quite come to terms with the violent death of his mother at the hands of a goblin invasion. While his years on the road provided many, shall we say, educational experiences with the opposite sex, deep down Scanlan yearns for the one thing he<U+0092>s never known: the true love of a fellow Gnome. Still, Scanlan considers himself a lover first, performer second, and fighter distant third. On the battlefield, he<U+0092>ll support his allies, but rarely draws blood unless it<U+0092>s to protect fellow gnome, Pike. Count on Scanlan for a hearty laugh, a rollicking song, and a twinkle in his eye that melts hearts and makes the females swoon.

name: ORION
dialogue: Greetings and salutations. I am Tiberius Stormwind. I hail from a town called Ty'rex, located in the heart of Draconia, born from a politically respected family. At the age of 15, I succeeded in passing the Sorcerer<U+0092>s Rite, showing prodigy-like control of my magic. The judges and the Draconian high council were amazed at how powerful my spells were for how long I had been training. At 20 years old, I was the youngest appointed member of the magic guild in Draconian history. For the next few years, I almost went mad from the malaise of being a guild member, as it<U+0092>s rather boring. However, one day I happened upon a chamber, unused for quite some time. In the room were stacks of books and maps of the surrounding cities and areas around the known world. For months, I would frequent the chamber and learned of artifacts from legend. After a long period of research, I made a list of artifacts that caught my eye. I brought these findings to the high council and was told that all of the information in the chamber I had stumbled upon was either believed to be fiction, or unsolvable mysteries, and hence were lost forever. I found those answers to be unacceptable. A year later I devised a ruse and managed to convince the city council to lend support in me leaving Draconia on a mission of peace and diplomacy for the surrounding kingdoms. Going from town to town and making friends and allies, in and for the name of Draconia. Being a red dragonborn, I had quite the task on my hands in that respect, but it was exactly what I needed so I could explore the world and find these artifacts, as I felt the truth was out there. Some may describe me as buffoonish, but I say poppycock to all that. I am much sharper than most give me credit for. I just don<U+0092>t pay attention to things sometimes. I<U+0092>ve also been known to be rather cunning, loyal, happy-go-lucky, and well, dangerous. I can<U+0092>t help but show my true scales every now and then. But overall, I think I<U+0092>m quite friendly for a Dragonborn.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Never entirely welcome in the company of elves or men, Vax'ildan learned at a young age to skip past formality, preferring instead to invite himself in your door. Along with twin sister Vex'ahlia, Vax was born by a chance encounter between elven royalty and human peasantry. Raised by their mother in their early years, the twins were eventually sent off to their father in the Elven capital of Singorn. But their cool reception among the elves there never warmed, and their time in the capital didn<U+0092>t last. The siblings stole away one autumn night and set out on the open road. After a few years of wandering, they eventually decided to return to their mother, and journeyed back to the lands of their youth. But instead of finding their childhood home, they returned to a pile of rubble. Their mother was gone, their home burned to ash. Pressing the townspeople for answers, they learned of the day the dragon came. (roaring) With their ties all severed, Vax'ildan and his sister set out to find their fortune together in Tal'Dorei. An outsider since birth, Vax quickly learned to solve life<U+0092>s challenges in his own particular way, often by sidestepping them entirely. And when his knack for circumventing adversity isn<U+0092>t enough, (sword unsheathing and slashing) the way of blades the elves schooled him in more than makes up the difference.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Like so many half-elves, Vex'ahlia has spent most of her life suffering the cool reception of a people who don<U+0092>t fully accept her. Born of a human mother and an elven father who only later in life took an interest in their existence, Vex'ahlia and her twin brother Vax'ildan quickly realized the only people they could truly rely on in this world were each other. It was at the age of 10 when the two were taken from their mother, and brought to live in Singorn, the isolated Elven city for which their father was an ambassador. He quietly took them in, but always kept an icy distance, and after too many years of disdainful looks, the pair decided to leave his indifference behind and set out on their own. Vax took to the cities, stealing small trinkets and learning the ways of the thief, while Vex kept to the woods. She preferred the isolation. Always the keen observer, she learned to hunt and to track, to spy and to shoot. And through a series of fateful events, earned herself a companion in the form of a bear -- her own stolen Trinket -- to fight alongside her and protect her fiercely. Also he is adorable and gives expert massages.

dialogue: Pike grew up on the outskirts of town, near the Bramblewood. Her ancestors were a family of Deep Gnomes with quite an unfavorable reputation. Thievery, destruction, and trickery left them with the curse of the last name Trickfoot. Sarenrae, the goddess of healing and redemption, had other plans for Pike's great-great-grandfather Wilhand, who left his family at a young age after a dream, a dream that changed the course of the Trickfoot family. Wilhand devoted his life to Sarenrae and pledged from then on that him and his family would live a life of service and devotion. As a child, Pike seemed to have an affinity to heal Whether it was animals, people, or even flowers, she felt she had a purpose in making things whole that had once been broken. She studied and learned the ways to heal through divine magic. She lived a peaceful life, quiet and simple, until one day Wilhand was captured and almost killed by a group of goliath barbarians. One of the goliaths took a stand against the murder of the innocent gnome, and he himself was beaten, bloodied, and left for dead, abandoned by his herd. Wilhand went to Pike for help. She prayed and healed this barbarian as best she could, bringing him back to life. When he awoke, she discovered his name was Grog Strongjaw. After that, they were the best of friends, a rather unlikely pair. Little did she know that in a few years' time, Grog would soon return the favor and bring her back from the clutches of death. After being killed in battle, Pike felt angry. She wanted to be stronger so that it would never happen again. She spent four months at sea, training with the men and women aboard a ship called the Broken Howl. Gripping her holy symbol in one hand and her morningstar in the other, this time, Pike is ready.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, you haven't heard of Scanlan Shorthalt? Well, gird your loins, ladies, because he has his eye on you. A talented musician, master of disguise, and dashingly handsome in his own mind, Scanlan sings songs almost as much as he sings his own praises. Born a poor gnome, Scanlan used his endless charm and soaring tenor voice to croon for coin and support his single mother. One day he was discovered by a half-orc promoter, and joined Dr. Dranzel's Spectacular Traveling Troupe, where he learned the ways of the world, and honed his skills as a bard extraordinaire. A loner much of his life, Scanlan has never quite come to terms with the violent death of his mother at the hands of a goblin invasion. While his years on the road provided many, shall we say, educational experiences with the opposite sex, deep down, Scanlan yearns for the one thing he's never known: the true love of a fellow gnome. Still, Scanlan considers himself a lover first, performer second, and fighter distant third. On the battlefield, he'll support his allies, but rarely draws blood, unless it's to protect fellow gnome, Pike. Count on Scanlan for a hearty laugh, a rollicking song, and a twinkle in his eye that melts hearts and makes the females swoon.

name: ORION
dialogue: Greetings and salutations. I am Tiberius Stormwind. I hail from a town called Ty'rex, located in the heart of Draconia. From a politically respected family, at the age of 15, I succeeded in passing the Sorcerer's Rite, showing prodigy-like control of my magic. The judges and the Draconian high council were amazed at how powerful my spells were for how long I had been training. At 20 years old, I was the youngest appointed member of the magic guild in Draconian history. For the next few years, I almost went mad from the malaise of being a guild member, as it's rather boring. However, one day I happened upon a chamber, unused for quite some time. In the room were stacks of books and maps of the surrounding cities and areas around the known world. For months, I would frequent the chamber, and learned of artifacts from legend. After a long period of research, I made a list of artifacts that caught my eye. I brought these findings to the high council and was told that all of the information in the chamber I had stumbled upon was either believed to be fiction, or unsolvable mysteries, and hence were lost forever. I found those answers to be unacceptable. A year later, I devised a ruse and managed to convince the city council to lend support in me leaving Draconia on a mission of peace and diplomacy for the surrounding kingdoms, going from town to town and making friends and allies, in and for the name of Draconia. Being a red dragonborn, I had quite the task on my hands in that respect, but it was exactly what I needed so I could explore the world and find these artifacts, as I felt the truth was out there. Some may describe me as buffoonish, but I say poppycock to all that. I am much sharper than most give me credit for. I just don't pay attention to things sometimes. I've also been known to be rather cunning, loyal, happy-go-lucky, and well, dangerous. I can't help but show my true scales every now and then. But overall, I think I'm quite friendly for a dragonborn!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Never entirely welcome in the company of elves or men, Vax'ildan learned at a young age to skip past formality, preferring instead to invite himself in your door. Along with twin sister Vex'ahlia, Vax was born by a chance encounter between elven royalty and human peasantry. Raised by their mother in their early years, the twins were eventually sent off to their father in the elven capital of Syngorn. But their cool reception among the elves there never warmed, and their time in the capital didn't last. The siblings stole away one autumn night and set out on the open road. After a few years of wandering, they eventually decided to return to their mother, and journeyed back to the lands of their youth. But instead of finding their childhood home, they returned to a pile of rubble. Their mother was gone, their home burned to ash. Pressing the townspeople for answers, they learned of the day the dragon came. (roar) With their ties all severed, Vax'ildan and his sister set out to find their fortune together in Tal'Dorei. An outsider since birth, Vax quickly learned to solve life's challenges in his own particular way, often by side-stepping them entirely. And when his knack for circumventing adversity isn't enough, (knife scraping) the way of blades the elves schooled him in more than makes up the difference.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Like so many half-elves, Vex'ahlia has spent most of her life suffering the cool reception of a people who don't fully accept her. Born of a human mother and an elven father who only later in life took an interest in their existence, Vex'ahlia and her twin brother Vax'ildan quickly realized the only people they could truly rely on in this world were each other. It was at the age of ten when the two were taken from their mother and brought to live in Syngorn, the isolated elven city for which their father was an ambassador. He quietly took them in, but always kept an icy distance, and after too many years of disdainful looks, the pair decided to leave his indifference behind, and set out on their own. Vax took to the cities, stealing small trinkets and learning the ways of the thief, while Vex kept to the woods; she preferred the isolation. Always the keen observer, she learned to hunt and to track, to spy and to shoot. And through a series of fateful events, earned herself a companion in the form of a bear-- her own stolen Trinket-- to fight alongside her and protect her fiercely. Also, he is adorable, and gives expert massages. [dramatic music]

name: ORION

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, so let's actually start this game, guys. Thank you for being patient with our intro here. We've been gone for two weeks. We have a lot to talk about, so thank you for letting us get that out. So picking up where we left off, the party completed the venture of taking the horn of Orcus to a place of safety and sealing it away, hopefully for eternity, with the help of Lady Kima, to the scalebearers. After heading to the basement of the Platinum Sanctuary in the city of Vasselheim, they've succeeded to do so. Vasselheim, which is a distant city to the far northwest of the continent they're used to. This city is a very devout, religion-based city, and currently considered the oldest bastion of civilization in the known civilized world. After taking a skyship across the ocean to get there, sealing the Horn, you guys also discover upon doing so that the ruins, long-forgotten ruins, of what appears to be an ancient temple to Sarenrae were recently discovered. While Sarenrae does not have a strong following in this city, the few that are trying to raise it ask for Pike's help to stay back and help build it and bring it to its former glory. Hopefully to re-establish a basis of worship in this city, and she decided to help these folks. The party then steps away from the ruins of the tower, sad but understanding of the circumstance.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Perhaps we could sit on a nearby rooftop and watch Pike work.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Just for the next eight months?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'd be all right with that.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's not creepy at all.

name: MATT
dialogue: Critical Role all of a sudden becomes the greatest grass-watching game of all time. As you all stand there, you have to decide your next course of action. You stand in the muddy road, taking in the cold dusk air as the sun slowly sets to the west. Now, this area of the city has a vastly different feel than the Platinum Sanctuary. In the haste to make it to the ruin, you've passed out of the section that seems to be under Bahamut's watch and into a different area. In this area, most of the buildings are reinforced with ruddy iron plates. Plumes of smoke rise up from a handful of heavy smokestacks. You can see over the rooftops in the distance toward the center of this section what looks like a massive dark red statue of a muscular bearded man.

name: LIAM
dialogue: The beauty of this game is I have no idea what the shit we're going to do right now.

name: SAM
dialogue: So we're standing outside the place where we just left Pike?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, the ruins of the tower.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So we're essentially standing in the middle of a town being like, now what?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Should we go look at that statue, then?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I want to see if there's an inscription.

name: MATT
dialogue: If you'd like to.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes, that would be lovely.

name: SAM
dialogue: While he's doing that, Scanlan is feeling still terribly sad about leaving Pike. So overcome with emotion that he must step into the ruins one last time, just to see the place where she's going to be for the next several months, years. And before I do so, I drink one of my potions that I bought from what's-his-butt. Gilmore, the glorious Gilmore. Yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right.

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't know how it works, but I'm going to drink it anyway.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, you drink it.

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay, I drink it. I go inside the ruins and look around and touch some of the walls and look at the stonework and everything. I want to see where she's going to be so I know she's safe. Overcome with a little bit of verklempt emotion, I shed a single tear.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you quietly take this moment to yourself amongst the ruins, you can hear the clattering of stonework as the small band of Sarenrae worshipers are now being helped by Pike, who's gathered them into a plan as to how to remove and restore portions of the building that are currently visible from the dirt and earth that it's embedded in. Hearing her voice echo through the hallway, it's a very comforting sense. You feel a rumbling in your stomach.

name: SAM
dialogue: I feel uncomfortable. It must be the emotion.

name: MATT
dialogue: It's probably the emotion.

name: SAM
dialogue: I find a side chamber or a little nook. Somewhere where I can have some privacy.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. You find your way back towards the makeshift wooden plank stairway and there was a small alcove not far from there within the earth wall that looks to be relatively private. There's little to no light, and it does have a view of the current ruin.

name: SAM
dialogue: I say a little prayer, and I take a big dump on the floor.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (laughing) No you do not!

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, my stomach was rumbling.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (laughing) You're in a temple, man!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Pike's probably going to have to be the one to clean that up!

name: SAM
dialogue: Sometimes it just affects me. I have weak nerves. And as I'm squatting, I hum to myself. (singing) How do I say goodbye to what we almost had?

name: ORION
dialogue: This is not romantic at all, you know that, right?

name: MATT
dialogue: Welcome back, guys.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I've missed you guys so much.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you finish your business, you step away from the alcove back to the stairway. The contents of the potion seem to have had some effect, as the remnants of what you leave behind have a very soft blue glowing hue to them.

name: SAM
dialogue: I left a magic dump.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Do we need to collect the dump?

name: SAM
dialogue: Nope. We should leave the dump.

dialogue: Are you going to be able to see through the dump?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: He's covering his face. I think we need the blue shit.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can you cast Detect Magic on the poo?

name: SAM
dialogue: It's already magical poo.

name: ORION
dialogue: Are we there? We're not there.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We're not there. It's just Scanlan.

name: ORION
dialogue: Okay. So he's just shitting.

name: LAURA
dialogue: He's just leaving it.

name: SAM
dialogue: So I leave and rejoin my fellows, wiping the tear from my eye and the poo from my bottom.

name: ORION
dialogue: Well, I love you Ashley. I do.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: This is what happens when we don't have any direction.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: But what's the purpose of the potion? To make your poo blue?

name: SAM
dialogue: I took a potion that will let me see through my poo and check in on Pike from time to time.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Will she realize you can see her through the poop?

name: SAM
dialogue: I certainly hope not.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Wouldn't that be great if she could just talk to you through the poo?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Why aren't the priests going to shovel that shit up?

name: SAM
dialogue: As long as some of my cellular remains are there, I might be able to see a little bit into the room.

name: LIAM
dialogue: What's "cellular?"

name: SAM
dialogue: (laughs) It's poo.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Oh, you mean little flakes of poo.

dialogue: For the sake of brevity in story progression here, and to dissuade a 30-minute conversation about Scanlan's excrement. After you've rejoined the party, the sun is now set. The cold air is beginning to really sweep in through the streets. The clouds overhead begin to slowly rumble and you can hear distant thunder, and you get the feeling due to the moisture in the air, you're not too far away from a rain.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Should we bunk for the night before we head out in the morning?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I say we head to the ship.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Wasn't there a guy with a red beard we were supposed to go see?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I wanted to wander over to the statue while Scanlan was dumping.

name: SAM
dialogue: I feel great right now, by the way.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Finding some relief in the situation.

name: ORION
dialogue: Damn it. Just when I was starting to like you, gnome.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Moving on. Let's go take a look at this statue.

name: MATT
dialogue: (chuckling) All right.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's magic poo!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Don't change, Scanlan.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you guys make your way through the center of this district--

name: LAURA
dialogue: I feel like it's dark now.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. You get the sense that this area, most of the people that live in this area are more rough-and-tumble than the already-rough people who live in Vasselheim, from what you've encountered. The buildings themselves all seem to be reinforced with iron plates and it looks like there is a very heavy trade in metalwork, and a lot of the construction of anything metallic appears to be coming through or from this portion of the town. As you approach closer to this statue, it's not just a statue. You see it is actually sitting atop what looks to be a large, blocky fortress-like temple. Unlike the Platinum Sanctuary, which is a very beautiful but simple array, this one has a crenellated top to each of these walled structures. You can see braziers blasting flame every 20 or so feet along the top of it. You can see, as you approach the front of this, there are two giant stone doorways with steps that look up to it and what looks to be two gargantuan war horns that spiral along the sides and then open up outward towards the entire city in front of it. I'm going to ask you guys to make a religion check, if you could.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh, I got this.

name: ORION
dialogue: Natural 20!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yeah! Natural 20.

name: TALIESIN, ORION
dialogue: Boom!

name: ORION
dialogue: That's so cool.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Natural four.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Because we know our shit.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you guys begin your approach, even in the darkness, you can see the figure, this human-like man. Barrel-chested. Massive muscles. What looks almost like iron bracers around his wrists. He is carved or sculpted from solid iron or plates that have been put together from some sort of iron initial structure. The beard is long and goes to about mid-chest. He carries in one hand this long, thick shortsword and has furs and leathers about his legs and midsection. You recognize this to be a very hefty depiction of the deity Kord.

name: LAURA, SAM, TRAVIS
dialogue: Kord?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I admire his beard.

name: MATT
dialogue: It is a beard worth admiring.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: How might one spell Kord?

name: MATT
dialogue: K-O-R-D.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Simple. I like that.

name: SAM
dialogue: He's a god of some sort?

name: MATT
dialogue: He is, indeed.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Tell us of this Kord. Try to find your notes of this Kord.

name: LAURA
dialogue: He's a dwarven god?

name: MATT
dialogue: Not dwarven.

name: LIAM
dialogue: A man. Human.

name: MATT
dialogue: Kord is essentially a deity of warfare, combat, and storms. A god that has been long-worshipped by tribal cultures from long past that enjoyed the essence of battle and challenge and combat.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Did you say storms, Tiberius? War and combat and storms?

name: ORION
dialogue: Storms, yes. Storms and winds.

name: MATT
dialogue: And quickly, the motif of this section of the town comes into play. This, you assume, is the portion of the city that is dedicated to the temple of Kord, this being the structure before you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Does it seem to be a central theme across the whole town? This town worships Kord?

name: MATT
dialogue: No. You've only really been to two sections. The first one you were brought to was primarily under the worship of Bahamut, the Platinum Dragon.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay. (giggles)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Getting the giggles out.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Did you look at it? Did you use your fancy eyes to look at it?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, my question is, is this a temple? If it is a temple to Kord, is this a place of battle? Is this somewhere where people go watch battles and fighting?

name: MATT
dialogue: From the exterior, and it is a closed-off temple, it looks like a large, blocky, obstinate fortress that is nearly impenetrable from the way it's constructed and reinforced. You don't know what's inside of it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: There's a big gate or door at the front?

name: MATT
dialogue: Two large iron doors about 20 feet tall that are currently shut. It's about five or six steps getting up to it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And it's nighttime?

name: MATT
dialogue: It is nighttime currently, yes.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Are there any citizens out right now, or are we alone in the dark?

name: MATT
dialogue: As it has gotten to dusk, it's thinned out a little bit, but there are a few individuals walking by, carrying pickaxes over one shoulder and passing by.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'd like to walk over to the nearest one and ask.

name: SAM
dialogue: To who?

name: LIAM
dialogue: To a passerby.

name: MATT
dialogue: The two gentlemen, one's in his mid-20s. The one that turns to you initially probably looks a little older than that. Late 30s, grizzled. Shaven, but the five-o'clock shadow has definitely kicked in. Longer, tousled hair, dirt on the face. Simple clothing, pickaxe over his shoulder and what looks like a leather belt that carries other tools.

name: SAM
dialogue: These are dwarves?

name: MATT
dialogue: These are human. "Yes? I heard you calling."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Excuse me, good sir. My friend over here, the dragonborn. He seems to think that this is some sort of temple or edifice to the god Kord. I just want to know, is he correct?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Is this your first time in the Braving Grounds?"

name: ORION
dialogue: In Dwarvish, I say--

name: SAM
dialogue: They're not dwarves.

name: MATT
dialogue: You can still say it, though. (laughter)

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes, absolutely! This is our first time. We literally just rolled into Vasselheim. What can you tell us of this? It's an impressive structure.

name: MATT
dialogue: The younger gentleman next to him, similarly dressed, begins to speak up. He puts his hand up and goes, "The Braving Grounds is the area of this city that is built around the worship of the great "god Kord. His protection and strength he bestows upon those who live for the sake of challenge. To "prove oneself better with each passing day, that is the basis of the Braving Grounds."

name: LAURA
dialogue: So it's like a battleground?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's a community that when called to battle can definitely defend itself. "What you see before you--" He looks up at the giant structure. "This "is called the Trial Forge. It is the oldest known temple to Kord and has been built and rebuilt for "many, many hundreds of years."

name: ORION
dialogue: (chuckles) Hence forge, right?

name: LIAM
dialogue: And does one need to be a priest or cleric of this faith to challenge oneself? Or can anyone--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Worship?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Anyone is able to worship what deity they wish in this town. We have an understanding. If "you're looking for a tussle, what you're looking for is the Crucible."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yes. What else can you tell us about this Crucible?

name: MATT
dialogue: "The Crucible is a fighting pit. I mean, there is a sacred arena within the temple, but "that's reserved for very, very special occasions. If you're looking to just get your fight on and "punch someone in the face, the Crucible is what you're looking for." He spits off to the side and points a little ways down the roadway.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I think Grog wants to go.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Beyond that way, you'll see a tavern known as the Bellows' Respite."

name: SAM
dialogue: Bellows' Respite.

name: MATT
dialogue: "One of the finer inns you'll find in the Braving Grounds proper, but I take it if you walk "that direction, you'll see the Crucible before too long."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Have you ever fought in the Crucible?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Me? No. Too busy. Too many people better fighters than me in there. "I'll just stick to the mines."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Are these battles to the death?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Nah. These are battles of honor. Death belongs in a true war. Mind you, there have been "some folks unfortunately who may have fallen to a hit on the head too hard, and that's "understandable. But the purpose of Kord is not necessarily to smite your foes unless they've "given you damn good reason. Other than that, contest of strength is how we live."

name: ORION
