dialogue: Hey, does anyone want to come to my room and look through my shit to see how Pike's doing?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay, yeah!

name: ORION
dialogue: Let's look through your shit. Scanlan.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Pike would have been proud of you, Grog.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Thank you. And if there had been weapons I'd be in deep shit. I'll be at the bar.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, Grog, come on.

name: SAM
dialogue: That's not even chicken, that's just a piece of wood. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: And yet it doesn't stop him as he, bite by bite, makes his way through the piece of driftwood he found by the bar.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I slap down another five gold to the bartender and say, that's for that barstool.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Thank you." Which, the barstools, by the way, have a thick, crusty wool on them, so there's a unique flavor to the piece you've chewed through.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: The frying on this chicken is exquisite.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you all take your evening of rest in your respective groups, Grog, eating and drinking away your worries until eventually you are unable to make conversation, you sloppily make your way to the third floor to a room in the brothel that has been prepared and awaiting for you, paid for by the Bellows' Respite, and you find yourself sloppily disappointing a woman until you pass out in your own sorrow. (laughter) And with that, we're going to take a quick break, but we'll be back here in about ten minutes, guys, right after Overlord has a few.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Fuck!

name: LAURA
dialogue: He's so upset. He's really upset.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I've never seen him this upset.

name: ORION
dialogue: Yeah, isn't it weird when other people get upset?

name: ZAC
dialogue: He's definitely not a challenge for Overlord status, that's for sure. Guys, so in case you're wondering what all of this 5k hype is that you keep seeing, if you're watching from home and you tuned in after we started. Megiyama in the chatroom has challenged you guys, the audience, if we get up to 5,000 subscribers tonight, he will buy a very large, and by very large I mean eight feet tall. It is massive. He sent me a picture; it is massive, I don't know where we will put it. We'll figure it out somehow. He will buy that for us and ship it to us, it's a very, very generous thing to help get us to 5,000 subscribers, and I was told from some people in the chat that I should also contribute in some way, shape, or form, so I have agreed to dress up as Pengulord tomorrow all day if we reach this goal. And for those who don't know, there was a very large war this morning in team No Stream, the chatroom, while we were offline. Someone thought it would be funny to put my face on a penguin. I did not think it was funny, and I timed out and banned every single person that referenced it, and exalted all of my power as Overlord, so it pains me to agree to do this, very much so, because it completely diminishes everything I've strived so hard for in world domination. Penguins are the least-threatening animals on the planet, and I despise them.

name: MATT
dialogue: Wow, that is an intensity. Pengulord, guys.

name: ZAC
dialogue: Good for you guys.

name: MATT
dialogue: Pengulord, I like the sound of that.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: They like to snuggle.

name: ZAC
dialogue: Well, good for them. No.

name: MATT
dialogue: We could fit Pengulord on a license plate, right?

name: ZAC
dialogue: No. Too many letters.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: If we get you in this outfit, will you waddle? That's really the question.

name: ZAC
dialogue: I said 5,000 subs, not my dignity and everything. I will put on the damn outfit at 5,000. That's all I have to offer. I'm already still working on a damn music video, so all I have left to offer is my dignity and every ounce of pride I have in anything.

name: MATT
dialogue: So if we somehow get to 5,000 subscribers, we get an eight-foot Trinket and Pengulord gets to rule the stream tomorrow. We'll be back in about five, ten minutes, guys, please stick around, we have more interesting things to see.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh wait, before we log off, we have this ready to go. Follow our amazing artists. Also, follow Espionage Cosmetics because they're amazing supporters of the show. Tweet at them and be like, thank you so much for supporting Critical Role. Because they're awesome. Okay. [dramatic music]

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Right, listen up! If you have ale, then you have a friend in Grog Strongjaw. A goliath of towering height and size, this barbarian has an appetite for the two great loves in his life: combat, women, and ale! (chuckle) (record scratch) Wait. Easily the brains of the group, Grog is often consulted for his vast knowledge of shapes, colors, and (chuckle) shiny things! Also ale. In his early years, armed with his two-handed great axe, Grog often enjoyed proving his might amongst the ranks of his family's wandering herd. But after coming upon an unsuspecting elderly gnome in the woods, he objected to the killing of such an innocent life. A creature of impulse, Grog felt only pity for this-- well, this terrified little thing. And his disobedience cost him dearly. Beaten bloody and banished by the herd leader, his uncle Kevdak, Grog was abandoned and left to die, exiled from his herd. It was then that the relative of the very gnome he fought to save, saved him. It was the kindness of a gnome cleric named Pike that healed Grog, bringing him back from death's edge. And they have remained close friends ever since. Most nights, Grog can be found challenging entire taverns to wrestling matches! Ha! Or accompanying Scanlan to the nearest house where you pay for lady favors. Also ale!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: A first impression of Keyleth would leave you with little information on the half-elven druid. You might even think that her social awkwardness due to her sheltered upbringing is kind of sweet. (chuckle) Of course, it would be unwise to underestimate her based on first impressions. (thunder) Under that unintimidating petite frame is a vicious beast waiting to be unleashed, whose natural powers have made even the fiercest of champions pee their pants, literally! (soft chuckle) Born to the Air Tribe of the Ashari people, Keyleth was raised with a deep love of nature and the elemental magics. It is her people's inherent duty to protect the delicate areas in Tal'Dorei where the four elemental planes begin to bleed with this realm. Since she was a little girl, she had quite a knack for air manipulation and beast shaping abilities. Well, if you consider kittens and flying squirrels to be little beasts. Which, I do. (clears throat) Anyways, it wasn't long before the headmaster of the tribe, her father, Korren, realized her true prodigious abilities and she was inveterated to succeed him as the next headmaster. Just like that, her jovial childhood was stripped and replaced with endless spell memorization, teachings from ancient traditions, and exceedingly high expectations. Every druid leader to be must embark on a journey to seek out the sister tribes in order to introduce and establish respect amongst the fellow headmasters. They call this the Aramente, or Noble Odyssey. When her father felt she was ready, he set her on the path to truly discovering herself, not knowing when, or if, she will ever return. As she hiked down the mountain towards Stillben, she meditated on the task ahead. Part of the Aramente is proving yourself a strong warrior, a valiant protector, and a wise and compassionate leader. With this knowledge, one thought plays on repeat in her mind: Is she even worthy?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Percy was the third of seven children, born to a noble family who lived far to the north in the ancient castle of Whitestone. With so many siblings to share the burdens of lordship, Percy turned his attentions to the sciences, engineering, and naturalism. One day, a mysterious couple named Lord and Lady Briarwood came to court. During a feast held in their honor, the Briarwoods violently took control of the castle, killing or imprisoning everyone who would stand in their way. Percy awoke chained in the dungeon, only to be freed by his younger sister. Together they fled, chased by the Briarwoods' men. As they ran, Percy's sister took several arrows to the chest and fell. Percy kept running, eventually jumping into a freezing river and floating unconscious to freedom. He did not remember waking up on a fishing boat. He barely remembered the next two years, as he slowly made his way as far south as possible. Then one night, Percy had a dream. A roaring cloud of smoke offered him vengeance against those who destroyed his family. When he awoke, Percy began to design his first gun. (gunshot)

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Pike grew up on the outskirts of town, near the Bramblewood. Her ancestors were a family of deep gnomes with quite an unfavorable reputation. Thievery, destruction, and trickery left them with the curse of the last name Trickfoot. Sarenrae, the goddess of healing and redemption, had other plans for Pike's great-great-grandfather Wilhand, who left his family at a young age after a dream: a dream that changed the course of the Trickfoot family. Wilhand devoted his life to Sarenrae and pledged from then on that him and his family would live a life of service and devotion. As a child, Pike seemed to have an affinity to heal. Whether it was animals, people, or even flowers, she felt she had a purpose in making things whole that had once been broken. She studied and learned the ways to heal though divine magic. She lived a peaceful life, quiet and simple, until one day, Wilhand was captured and almost killed by a group of goliath barbarians. One of the goliaths took a stand against the murder of the innocent gnome and he himself was beaten, bloodied, and left for dead, abandoned by his herd. Wilhand went to Pike for help. She prayed and healed this barbarian as best she could, bringing him back to life. When he awoke, she discovered his name was Grog Strongjaw. After that, they were the best of friends, a rather unlikely pair. Little did she know that in a few years' time, Grog would soon return the favor and bring her back from the clutches of death. (roar, crunch) After being killed in battle, Pike felt angry. She wanted to be stronger so that it would never happen again. She spent four months at sea training with the men and women aboard a ship called the Broken Howl. Gripping her holy symbol in one hand and her morningstar in the other, this time, Pike is ready.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, you haven't heard of Scanlan Shorthalt? Well, gird your loins, ladies, because he has his eye on you. A talented musician, master of disguise, and dashingly handsome in his own mind, Scanlan sings songs almost as much as he sings his own praises. Born a poor gnome, Scanlan used his endless charm and soaring tenor voice to croon for coin and support his single mother. One day he was discovered by a half-orc promoter and joined Dr. Dranzel's Spectacular Traveling Troupe, where he learned the ways of the world and honed his skills as a bard extraordinaire. A loner much of his life, Scanlan has never quite come to terms with the violent death of his mother at the hands of a goblin invasion. While his years on the road provided many, shall we say, educational experiences with the opposite sex, deep down, Scanlan yearns for the one thing he's never known: the true love of a fellow gnome. Still, Scanlan considers himself a lover first, performer second, and fighter distant third. On the battlefield, he'll support his allies, but rarely draws blood, unless it's to protect fellow gnome, Pike. Count on Scanlan for a hearty laugh, a rollicking song, and a twinkle in his eye that melts hearts and makes the females swoon.

name: ORION
dialogue: Greetings and salutations. I am Tiberius Stormwind. I hail from a town called Ty'rex, located in the heart of Draconia. From a politically respected family, at the age of 15, I succeeded in passing the Sorcerer's Rite, showing prodigy-like control of my magic. The judges and the Draconian high council were amazed at how powerful my spells were for how long I had been training. At 20 years old, I was the youngest appointed member of the magic guild in Draconian history. For the next few years, I almost went mad from the malaise of being a guild member, as it's rather boring. However, one day I happened upon a chamber, unused for quite some time. In the room were stacks of books and maps of the surrounding cities and areas around the known world. For months, I would frequent the chamber, and learned of artifacts from legend. After a long period of research, I made a list of artifacts that caught my eye. I brought these findings to the high council and was told that all of the information in the chamber I had stumbled upon was either believed to be fiction, or unsolvable mysteries, and hence were lost forever. I found those answers to be unacceptable. A year later, I devised a ruse and managed to convince the city council to lend support in me leaving Draconia on a mission of peace and diplomacy for the surrounding kingdoms, going from town to town and making friends and allies, in and for the name of Draconia. Being a red dragonborn, I had quite the task on my hands in that respect, but it was exactly what I needed so I could explore the world and find these artifacts, as I felt the truth was out there. Some may describe me as buffoonish, but I say poppycock to all that. I am much sharper than most give me credit for. I just don't pay attention to things sometimes. I've also been known to be rather cunning, loyal, happy-go-lucky, and well, dangerous. I can't help but show my true scales every now and then. But overall, I think I'm quite friendly for a dragonborn!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Never entirely welcome in the company of elves or men, Vax'ildan learned at a young age to skip past formality, preferring instead to invite himself in your door. Along with twin sister Vex'ahlia, Vax was born by a chance encounter between elven royalty and human peasantry. Raised by their mother in their early years, the twins were eventually sent off to their father in the elven capital of Syngorn. But their cool reception among the elves--

name: MATT
dialogue: Welcome back, guys. All right, so we had a little break here. Remember to follow our awesome artists on the Twitter. So, let's go ahead and get back to the game so we can-- we have a lot to do tonight. All right. As morning comes to, the rest of you wake up, the first thought, of course, being the heartache for your friend Grog, who is not in any of the rooms.

name: LAURA
dialogue: The heartache for our lost money.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, more the money probably for Vex-- but as you wake up, Grog is nowhere to be found in your rooms, of course. He wandered off to presumably the third floor.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Is that a euphemism?

name: MATT
dialogue: It can be.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm still in Minxie form. I slept in Minxie form. I'm going to go look for him, see if I can find him in any of the rooms on the third floor.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. A giant white saber-toothed tiger wandering the interior does set off a few minds. I mean, an armored bear being escorted is one thing, but a lone saber-toothed tiger? As soon as you make your way through the hallway, you can see one of the patrons comes out of the room and goes, (startled sound) and goes and pulls his blade out, like, "Help! Help, there's a tiger! "There's a tiger in the inn!"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Why does this always happen to me?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Hearing yelling, I run up the stairs and say, hey, has anyone seen a-- oh, there you are. Come on, Snibbles, come on. We've got to go back downstairs.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Hey, keep that thing on a leash, sir."

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm really sorry.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Liable to kill someone!"

name: LIAM
dialogue: Chews through her rope all the time. Come on, Snibbles.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I roll over on my back, and I'm like those cats you see on YouTube who hate being on leashes. Just dragging.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I start going, on the tummy.

name: MATT
dialogue: Goes back in his room and closes the door.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm pretty sure you just groped her.

name: MATT
dialogue: At about this time, you hear a heavy footfall. A second heavy footfall. A third heavy footfall. And from around the corner of the staircase, descending from the third floor, you see a very hungover and expressionless Grog squinting and making his way down.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Morning, big guy. Have fun last night?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: God. You're not going to puke, are you?

name: MATT
dialogue: You hear (meowing).

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I never puke.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Do you need some breakfast or ale?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What, food? I think I'm good.

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I think you need an ale.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Little hair of the dog? Yeah?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Now that sounds like a plan.

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys head down. The rest of you manage to eventually wake and make your way down to the tavern, where Grog is already in the process of consuming his liquid breakfast.

name: ORION
dialogue: Hold on, I haven't come out of the room yet, right?

name: MATT
dialogue: Not until you want to.

name: ORION
dialogue: So I do, I see Grog going there, drinking his thing, I use my Mage Hand and I whack the ale out of his hand.

name: MATT
dialogue: Your tankard goes flying out of your hand, on the ground, it spills across the front--

name: ORION
dialogue: I make my way down to the thing and I tell the bartender, give this warrior water. This might be your problem, Grog. You lost for a reason, and you're a warrior.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes, but he's named after beer. (laughter)

name: ORION
dialogue: Yes, I know that, Vax. I'm just saying.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And you are what you eat.

name: ORION
dialogue: I cast Invisibility.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Tiberius vanishes. The barkeep hands over a big mug of clear water and sets it in front of Grog.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, this is the very special beer.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's the water that was requested by your friend. Who disappeared."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Water?

name: LAURA
dialogue: It'll get you super drunk.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Can you feel it? You can feel it, right? You can totally feel it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It's pretty smooth. (laughter) Keep it coming.

name: MATT
dialogue: Meals are ordered, you guys are fed as per your purchase of the evening's inn stay. Your meal's still covered by the tavern. Eventually, you find yourselves full and about, I'll say roughly ten, 11 in the morning it would be.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm no longer Minxie to eat breakfast with my friends.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Hi, good to see you, Keyleth.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Are you a dwarf again?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No. I should to talk to more dwarves before I try to... yeah.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That was a little racist.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It was a little racist.

name: SAM
dialogue: Remind me, what was on our plate? What's on our plate?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, we have multiple things we can be doing. We can go meet Keyleth's druid family in the mountains, right? Fire, brimstone, stuff like that. We have a lot of money waiting for us.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I think we have to go back on the airship to go get it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: In Kraghammer, yes, but there is 25,000 gold waiting for us, so that's always an option.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: The Braving Grounds, we could see if they need any-- since we-- I lost us a lot of (tearing up) money.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Here, Grog. Have some clear beer.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Some more? Okay. We can see if they need anyone for hire, go and have a... (tearing up again) being strong.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I would feel it very hard to leave Pike behind in the city. Are we really going to leave and go to Kraghammer?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, we don't have to. I don't want to go yet. We traveled several days here. While we're in this side of the country, I should probably go, you know. Do the things I was set out to do.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Plus we have the poo cell phone.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Good job, Scanlan.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's more of a poo walkie-talkie.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I don't know what either of those things are.

name: SAM
dialogue: Just know that there's poo involved.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Does the poop talk like my earring? Because that I understand.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes, it's like a poop earring.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's like a poop earring. Why didn't you say that in the first place? You talk through it? You talk to poo?

name: SAM
dialogue: You see through it.

name: MATT
dialogue: Hashtag poop earring.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So yes. There's multiple things.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, multiple things. There's just go back to Kraghammer and get money, or go where Keyleth wants to go.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We can look for work here, we can go back to Bahamut, see if they want--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Keyleth's got family. We can visit her family.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's what I'm talking about, yes. Fire, brimstone, volcanoes. Druids.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Keyleth, do you have an opinion?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I mean... I guess if you guys don't have anything else to do, yeah.

name: LIAM
dialogue: How far are they from here?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm not sure. We'd have to start asking around. They're remote. We're secluded people.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Secrety.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We're a little secrety, yeah, and we haven't heard-- I just want to clarify, you know. I haven't talked to them in a long time, so I hope they're nice. And I'm sure they're--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Family stuff can be tricky.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It seems a shame to have a family and not take advantage of it.

name: SAM
dialogue: What's family for other to take advantage of?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: To hit. To kiss.

name: LAURA
dialogue: To kiss? You kiss your family?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, I'm a goliath. What about it?

name: LAURA
dialogue: There are things about goliaths I did not want to know. That water has a good effect on him.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Do you feel drawn to your parents, though? Do you want to go?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I have to go. I don't have a choice.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Then we should go.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay. I just don't want to inconvenience anybody.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Inconvenience, schminconvenience.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, is that Dwarvish?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes. It's actually Underdark. I'm fluent.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh wait, that was Dwarvish? Inconschmenience.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Your accent's amazing.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm trying to work on learning more Dwarvish. Okay.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I have a question for you, Vax. The Braving Grounds that are here, would it be to our benefit to collect maybe some coin and practice our (gets choked up) fighting before we go to the maybe-friendly fire jugglers' village?

name: LIAM
dialogue: You want to go back in there? It's awfully fresh.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Not the Crucible. Don't rub my face in it. Not in the Crucible, to the Braving Grounds.

name: LIAM
dialogue: The Braving Grounds. We were just in the pub. I mean, that was just a backyard brawl, basically. He's talking about going to the temple.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Was that the Crucible I was in?

name: MATT
dialogue: The Crucible was the pit you were in. The temple you were at is the Trial Forge. The whole area you guys are in, this district of Vasselheim, is known as the Braving Grounds.

name: LIAM
dialogue: This is what I think, Grog. It's too fresh. You need some time away from it. We should absolutely come back and you should break that guy's fucking face, no question.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (choked up) I could've. Totally could've.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You almost did.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah. Next time, bite his nose off right away before it's concave.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I saved it for too late. I did it too late. But then in the balls...

name: LAURA
dialogue: The balls-- good effort.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We've come a very long way. Keyleth is near her family. She needs to see where that road lies.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We should take care of each other.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And once we do, we'll come back and fucking kill that guy.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: And we can use weapons if they suck, right?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Speaking of weapons, aren't we in a perfect weapons-buying district?

name: SAM
dialogue: Is that true?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yes! Can we go find an armory or somewhere that sells pointy things?

name: MATT
dialogue: You can certainly try. Yeah. As a note, too, as you're having this conversation, you reach into your pocket, Grog. As you're feeling around in your pocket, you realize that you saved in your drunken state the upper lip. It's rubbery and dry, but it's there.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I tuck that inside of my belt-beard. Just so it's nice there. One little part of it just flapping out.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What about your beard? Is he growing his beard?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh, it is a new day.

name: MATT
dialogue: You get to go ahead and roll a percentage dice.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Nine, 90.

name: MATT
dialogue: 99. No beard this morning. It goes the other way.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It goes the other way?!

name: MATT
dialogue: Lower percentage.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: My life is shit! I can't do anything!

name: MATT
dialogue: It's a rough day for Grog.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'm hanging myself. Where's the bridge?

name: SAM
dialogue: There's no bridge here.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Actually, I don't know about anybody else, but I'm incredibly low on funds at the moment.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Perhaps shopping is not the best path.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We did just do a lot of shopping.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, let's go adventuring.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We haven't had an awkward parental confrontation in what feels like months.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay. You guys, I'm so nervous.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You really are?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, I mean, it's a big thing.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Have you seen them, ever?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: The first time I left home was when I met up with you guys.

name: MATT
dialogue: (impact) You guys suddenly hear this slamming sound that echoes throughout the nearby city. You hear this impact, like this distant crashing of stone against stone. A few seconds later, you hear this low (horn sound), this horn that's just bellowing out, this deep echoing horn. The rest of the tavern looks around, confused. A couple of individuals step outside to look.

name: ORION
dialogue: I'm at the dock, right?

name: MATT
dialogue: You've been walking away for a while, and you get about roughly ten minutes away before you hear this impact and these horns going off in the distance.

name: SAM
dialogue: I turn to the barkeep and say, well, what was that? Do you know? Have you heard that before? What is that?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's the horn of the Trial. Means there's some sort of attack."

name: SAM
dialogue: Attack? Where? How do we know where?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't know, but I'm getting ready." And he starts going to the back room.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Getting ready where? What are we doing?

name: ORION
dialogue: I'm going to cast Fly on myself and see what's going on.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, so you become visible and begin lifting up into the air--

name: ORION
dialogue: No, I'm still invisible for a round.

name: MATT

dialogue: Forever besties?

dialogue: That was not as good a kiss as usual. I was worried, but it was special.

dialogue: You can. You can also help with this roll.

dialogue: I will sing something. I don't know what. I'm so out of it. We just killed a dragon! (laughter) I go over to her and I'm like, (incoherent, impressed stammering). And that's all I got.

dialogue: It was a group effort.

dialogue: Between the two of you working together, that would give you advantage on the checks. Which one are you going for first? Are you going for the eyes? Choose which portion you're harvesting first.

dialogue: Yeah, but which part are you harvesting first? You choose with each roll. You have eyes, heart--

dialogue: That's nine plus--

dialogue: As you pull each eye out, it's like holding the coldest orb you've ever held. It actually burns your fingers as you clutch it. (gasp) Throw it inside and have to shake your hand off.

dialogue: I jiggle them around in the bag. Just because.

name: FELICIA
dialogue: We have a special crate?

dialogue: Yeah, I'm holding it.

dialogue: The tongue would be next.

dialogue: All right, go ahead and roll for that.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Plus another roll for advantage. Ooh, that's way better. Plus six. 23.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: A heart.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Two rolls.

name: MARY
dialogue: 12. 14. Plus six is 20.

dialogue: Oh, 20! 20 is just what you needed. You pry in and crack open a portion of its body, and you begin to slowly carve out the portion, the heart, and the dragon heart itself is massive. It's huge, and it takes three of you to pull it out.

dialogue: How do we fit it in this bag? Is it magic?

dialogue: You don't know, but it's not going to fit in that satchel.

dialogue: How heavy is it?

dialogue: I'd say it probably weighs a good 200 pounds.

dialogue: I should know what people would do in the guild situation if they had an organ that wouldn't fit in the bag, right? We have to preserve it.

dialogue: Travel back quickly or have preservation magic. Whether it would be a necromancy-based magic.

dialogue: Nope.

dialogue: We could roll it up in one of our fancy robes, though, and hold on to it. And pack it in-- oh, we, yeah! Let's chisel out some of the ice.

dialogue: Claws and teeth.

dialogue: Teeth. Yes, roll to carve. Seven. 13.

dialogue: Another one.

dialogue: Spider Pig.

dialogue: Can I tell what it is?

dialogue: You pull out the arrow. It appears to be a deep forest green, and the actual shaft of the arrow has a texture to it, almost a rough metallic texture.

name: SAM, MARY, TRAVIS
dialogue: Take it!

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm taking it! Are you kidding me?

name: MATT
dialogue: If you wish to bring those over to Lyra. Lyra, make an arcana check.

dialogue: This is a very interesting arrow. I haven't seen one of these like this. Oh, wait, maybe I have. 27.

dialogue: It's too bad it didn't work for them.

name: FELICIA
dialogue: That's very pleasant.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, right? What is the saving throw?

name: SAM
dialogue: You'll see. You're going to get the paper.

dialogue: So at this point, you guys have taken probably a good hour and a half or so in this cavern. You start seeing water drip.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, we should get out.

name: MATT
dialogue: It's beginning to thaw in the absence of Rimefang.

dialogue: Well, what's good is, I believe we're within the three days of the contract, yes?

dialogue: Possibly.

dialogue: Well, we got the contract. We completed it within three days. Now, we have to get back.

name: MARY
dialogue: Yes, we've killed it, so let's go home.

dialogue: Percy, you go and you pull out the contract real fast to inspect it, and you can see that the arcane sigils that were built into it are faded, and where it looks like each piece of the dragon that you harvested correctly, has seemingly had a strange, glimmering gold shimmer from the actual text on the contract.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Lyra, they're going to love you.

dialogue: It's so exciting. I can't wait to go to the mess hall and tell everybody, many times, over and over, how this happened together. And you guys, this has been an amazing journey. Thank you.

dialogue: Mertin, we did it.

dialogue: "Show me your contract. Show me this contract."

dialogue: I don't know why you'd doubt us. Really, it's right here.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well done." And he puts his hand out to shake your hand.

name: FELICIA
dialogue: Oh my gosh. I start crying. This is the most proud moment of my life, Mertin. I've admired you for so long and the fact (cries) thank you. And then I just hug him.

dialogue: Okay. He hugs you. "I appreciate it very much. You lost me 200 gold pieces, but well done. "You've proven to be more than I expected. Let me get the Huntmistress. dialogue: Oh my god, that is so sweet, Vanessa.

dialogue: "Keep the emotions in check. We have to put up a face here. No one wants to see a member of "the guild cry. Now, for the rest of you, I would like to humbly ask if you wish to join the "Slayer's Take guild."

dialogue: Yeah, sure, that'll work. The bear, too?

dialogue: "The bear, as well. Best not show him the back room. We have a few trophies back there that "might freak him out."

dialogue: Thank you so much.

dialogue: Vanessa goes, "Lyra, I would recommend this course of action to not be taken. I would think "that would reflect poorly-- I mean, your personal time is your own, but nevertheless, my dear, this "is a very pious house--"

dialogue: Oh, no. Not you. You're such a friend to me. I can't ruin that.

dialogue: Vanessa walks up and puts her hand on your shoulder and goes, "We're going to have a talk, "woman to woman."

dialogue: (whispers) Oh my god, you guys, I'm in!

dialogue: Be straight with her, will you? Please.

dialogue: "I'm going to make sure she doesn't embarrass the rest of us. So with the contract "completed, provide what you've harvested from your quarry, and payment will be delivered."

You instinctively take and slap it down underneath, and then refocus your vision, your eyes closed. And you can see what looks like a pulsing energy, like a very dark flame. Something that itself, you can already smell the sulfur. You can smell the lineage, the devil lineage that this entity is. And there is indeed one not too terribly far from where you currently are. It's faint, which means that it is on the outskirts. And you know this lasts for a good thousand feet or so. But it does give you a northeastern direction. And the spell fades.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Northeastern direction.

name: WILL
dialogue: We should go northeast. It is also unfortunately, or fortunately, depending on how you look at it, closer than we thought.

name: LIAM
dialogue: In the walls of the city?

name: WILL
dialogue: Not in the walls, but very close to them.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do we have any type of plan of attack? Does anyone know how to fight these things? Any earthly clue?

name: WILL
dialogue: Leader boy?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Leader boy?

name: WIL
dialogue: I'm sorry, are you talking to me?

name: ORION
dialogue: Thorbir is what they meant to say.

name: WILL
dialogue: Listen to Stormfather over here.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I take my social cues from other people. I'm sorry.

name: WIL
dialogue: In my experience, there has not been a problem invented that can't be solved with an axe.

name: ORION
dialogue: That's true. We've seen that.

name: WILL
dialogue: Wonderfully helpful. Thank you.

name: WIL
dialogue: You're welcome.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Follow the axe.

name: WIL
dialogue: Now what I want you to do is imagine an hourglass. You got that? Good picture of an hourglass in your heads? See all that sand draining out? Let's get a move on.

name: ORION
dialogue: Okay. What am I doing with this sand?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I agree with that. Are we supposed to do something with the sand?

name: WIL
dialogue: Yeah, count it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, that would take so long. Can we tag-team this?

name: WIL
dialogue: She always like this?

name: ORION
dialogue: Yes.

name: WILL
dialogue: Stormcloud's counting sand. I don't know what she's doing over here. Northeast. How about let's start walking that way and see what happens? Can we give that a shot?

name: ORION
dialogue: I agree. You did the fancy spell.

name: WILL
dialogue: It's not as fancy as you might think.

name: WIL
dialogue: I've pulled my axe out and I'm sort of holding it like a walking stick. And just very deliberately, very demonstratively walking ahead in that direction.

name: MATT
dialogue: With each footfall, you know that what was once, probably hundreds of years ago, a nice cobblestone roadway in the center of the city has been slowly hit with mud, dirt, snow, sleet, and so each step is a slight moisture with each footfall.

name: ORION
dialogue: I'm assuming there's no stables around.

name: MATT
dialogue: Not immediately, those are usually to the very outside of the city.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Why are you jonesing for a horse?

name: ORION
dialogue: So I don't get all dirty.

name: MATT
dialogue: Thorbir, leading forward in the northeastern direction that was given by Brother Kash, eventually brings you around the side of the bazaar. And you can now see why it's called the Quad Roads, there are two main roads that meet right where the bazaar occurs and then they spread off into the other sections of the city. To the northeastern section, from your guys' perspective, the district begins to drift into another district that you have not previously visited. This district is, you've heard it mentioned before, known as the Duskmeadow. Now, previous sections you've been in have been worshipers of Bahamut, the Platinum Dragon. There was the Braving Grounds, which worships Kord, the god of strength and warfare and honor. The Quad Roads, which is under Erathis, the deity of civilization and invention. The Duskmeadow falls under the watchful eye of the Raven Queen, the goddess of death. That large obsidian-type structure that you were led to earlier is the temple that resides in the center of this district. And you've heard mention before of a few of the things that exist here. That being probably Raven's Crest, which is the main temple to the Raven Queen. This is also where the Amaranthine Oubliette is located, which is essentially the prison of the entire city of Vasselheim.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: The what?

name: MATT
dialogue: The Amaranthine Oubliette.

name: ORION
dialogue: Hammertime oubliette.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, there it is.

name: MATT
dialogue: This is also where most of the dead of the city are interred into a series of catacombs that are built deep beneath this section of the city. Far enough away from the oubliette to the point where isn't crossover and is enough of an escape, because that apparently has happened in the past history of the city. As you begin pushing towards the edge of where the two districts meet, you can see that there is an area of the town that, for lack of better term, it's a more jovial than expected area. There are a series of stands put up along the side of the road. There's a lot of beggars sitting on the side of the street that are currently panhandling to those who walk by. There are a number of taverns. You can hear music coming from various establishments. And it seems almost the closer you get to the death-oriented district on the border of the Quad Roads, the more and more it pushes into a shadier Mardi Gras-type experience. So you make your way towards that dividing line there. What you would like to do?

name: ORION
dialogue: What say you, Thorbir?

name: WIL
dialogue: Let's ask around and see if anything has been a little out the ordinary, or maybe, in the ordinary.

name: ORION
dialogue: Yes, I like that phrasing.

name: WILL
dialogue: Have to imagine anywhere this thing goes, there's going to be strange deaths associated with it. We might as well look there.

name: ORION
dialogue: That's actually a good idea, as well.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And where we're walking, are there shops and stands, as well, or is it residential?

name: MATT
dialogue: There are many that sell jewelry, many that sell very well-made clothing, some of them party attire, there are some that sell exotic fruits that have been imported in various states of ripeness.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Is anyone selling any masks?

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a perception check.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Passive or active?

name: MATT
dialogue: That would be an active perception check as you're seeking it.

name: MATT
dialogue: 21. You do glance around and there is one cart that carries costume, party attire supplies. It doesn't seem to have too many customers right now, but they do have a couple of masks that are on display.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Are there any masks that look like tiger masks?

name: MATT
dialogue: Looking at it, there are none that are tiger-specific, no. They seem to be molded leather and some more impish, goblin-y in appearance.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Is there someone working the stand?

name: MATT
dialogue: There is, yes. You see a woman in her forties or so, thin, with a big toothy smile. Her hair is pulled back into tight bun. You can see there's little bit of her blondish hair turning to gray on the sides around her ears, Reed Richard-style.

name: ORION
dialogue: Did you say this was the Bahamut part of town, too?

name: MATT
dialogue: The Bahamut section is far away. That's another section of the city. You are now on the line between the Duskmeadow and the Quad Roads, so it's Erathis and the Raven Queen.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm pulling a mask off the wall. This is a beautiful piece. Do you make them yourself?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I do. I do, I make them myself by hand, hence the price."

name: LIAM
dialogue: They are quite beautiful. We're travelers here. I've never seen a neighborhood like this. Is there a festival going on here, or is this pretty much the basic fare of the day here?

name: MATT
dialogue: "This is the localized festival of the city. If you've been around Vasselheim long enough "you've seen there is little interest in celebration depending on some places. But, at "least on this line, some people can appreciate the fleetness that is life and grasp it by the roots "and make it its own before it's snuffed out."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Here particularly, there seems to be electricity in the air almost. It's very bustling. This is the norm around here?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Consistently. That's why I come and bring my business here. I wouldn't do very well up "north, I'll tell you that. All them dragon types--" Looks to you. "No offense. All them "silver dragon lovers have an issue with things as celebratory."

name: LIAM
dialogue: And I pull out ten gold, and I spread them on her desk.

name: MATT
dialogue: "How many masks?"

name: LIAM
dialogue: Oh, none.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, I would like one.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Take your pick."

name: LIAM
dialogue: I slide one coin away from the other nine, and then dragging my finger across those say, is there anything out of the ordinary these days?

name: MATT
dialogue: Go ahead and make a persuasion roll.

name: MATT
dialogue: 15? She gives you a look like she's trying to read you, looks about left and right. Glances at you and looks a little ugh. Glances at you and looks really taken aback, and then comes back to you with a escape of comfort.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Watching her, I pull out another five and spread them in front of the first nine.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, I mean, some businesses here are a bit shady, I won't lie. And there are some "long-standing businesses that have quarrels. Usually, they end in small scuffles, or one "purchases the other and ousts them from the city. This is one of the few areas in which the more adult pleasures can be "found, so there's a lot of money to be had. But recently, there's been, at least from what I've "heard, a series of bodies have turned up. There were a few found, fished out by the Bastions in "the water trough on the outskirts of the Duskmeadow."

name: LIAM
dialogue: The Bastions: what are they?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Bastions who are the guardians of the city. From what I hear, they had been mauled by some "sort of strange beast."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Mauled?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Now, beasts on the outside of the city, that I can see. But on the inside, that is the "stuff of nightmares. Is it not?"

name: ORION
dialogue: Yes, I would agree.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Have you had invaders like this before?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I mean, death is not an uncommon occurrence for certain areas of the city." And she gestures off to the distant temple. "Some people invite it, even. But such violent death like this is usually "kept to the outside of the city, at least with some sort of cause. This seems to be a murderous "rampage that, me personally, I don't want to go out at night without protection."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Is there is any indication of the cause of death on these corpses? How do they find them?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't know. I've not investigated. Perhaps you have to ask the Bastions yourself "that. Or anyone who was in the vicinity."

name: LIAM
dialogue: And can you point us in the right direction?

name: MATT
dialogue: She looks around, and points off. And you can see, there isn't a whole lot of Bastion presence in this portion of the city, especially since the Bastions are more of a voluntary guard. People from the different clergies, the different temples, train to become Bastions, and fit themselves with whatever their deity's armor is. You do see there are two Bastions armored in a very dark, dark brown leather that carry a symbol of what looks like a silver raven that is embroidered on one shoulder of a cloak that is tossed to one side.

name: LIAM
dialogue: These guys are right here, essentially?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. Oh. They're across the road about maybe a block up. "I believe they're Bastions from "the Duskmeadow. Perhaps you could ask them."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Does she have any masks that look like a raven? A raven mask?

name: MATT
dialogue: She does actually have one that looks like a raven.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I want that one.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Very well. A good choice. It doesn't quite match the color of your attire, but perhaps I have "an outfit that could match for you?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh!

name: WILL
dialogue: Oh my god, we're going clothes shopping.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do you have a little cloak as well? A little cape?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Cloaks I don't, but there but there is a cloakery about four blocks that way on your left. "They can probably help you there."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Thank you so much.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Of course."

name: LIAM
dialogue: I notice a serpent-shaped mask on the wall. I just pick it up and put it on and say, thank you, madam. Much obliged. And walk off and clap Thorbir on the shoulder and keep walking.

name: WIL
dialogue: Thorbir hangs back a little bit and waits for them to get to the door. And he looks at the shop keep and, do you have any masks that might fit a little girl?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes, of course, friend dwarf." And she goes and rummages through a small bag and pulls out a mask. This little purple mask that seems to have small fake gems forming the outside, with a couple of ribbons that dangle where it would tie around the head. It's simple, but it's pretty. "Unfortunately, not many people bring children to this side of the district. They don't sell very "well. But if you would like one, I would be happy to part with for two gold?"

name: WIL
dialogue: One gold.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a persuasion roll.

name: MATT
dialogue: "One gold. Guess it is better to sell it than not at all. Here you are. I must say, I won't "tell anyone, but purple is a pretty color on you."

name: WIL
dialogue: Yes, it is. He walks out.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. A few moments pass as you wonder where your dwarven leader has vanished to, he steps out through the front of the establishment.

name: WIL
dialogue: Let's go.

name: ORION
dialogue: Great. Do you have potions? Are you all potioned up? Are you good on items, Thorbir?

name: WIL
dialogue: I'm all right. Are you all right?

name: ORION
dialogue: I'm just fine.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, we're in a rush, but if it's easy. How do you come by potions in this town?

name: WIL
dialogue: Do I know the answer to that?

name: MATT
dialogue: You do. They're either provided, from some of your experience, by the Slayer's Take, but those are usually offered at the start of a contract. The fact that they weren't offered on this means either they don't have any currently at their disposal, or they felt that this contract probably wouldn't require it with the construct of this group being set out. Other than that, they are a little hard to come by. A lot of them are controlled by the main temples and are pretty much given straight to the Bastions. There aren't a lot of individuals that are in need of them within the city, and those that travel out are either members of the Slayer's Take or members of the Bastion forces. So they are little hard to come by.

name: WIL
dialogue: I think that if we're going to find them anywhere, it might be around here. Might be we can take some through trade. Maybe some might fall off a Bastion or two.

name: ORION
dialogue: Well, let's go talk to one then, shall we?

name: WILL
dialogue: Thought that's what we were doing. Are going to the two Bastions over there or what?

name: ORION
dialogue: Yes, Kashaw.

name: WILL
dialogue: Good. One other thing you need to know about them: they're horribly paid, so money talks with these people.

name: ORION
dialogue: Very well.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: As he goes ahead, I keep up my pace until I trail behind him a little bit.

name: WILL
dialogue: Wonderful.

name: LIAM
dialogue: My hood goes up, and I'm gone.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. As you guys step across the way. It's about a block up. One of them is partially inside the alley between two of the buildings. You can see he has one hand up on the wall and the other down. One of them is relieving himself on the side of the building, while the other is keeping watch, arms crossed, looking out across the road. The one that's immediately present, or before you, you can see is human, a scruffy brown beard around the edge of the chin. The hair itself is cut very short. A little heavier in appearance. A little muscle, a little layer of winter padding, but the black leather armor definitely gives you the appearance of somebody who is a Bastion of the Raven Queen. As you approach, the hooded half-elf, the dwarf walking with the giant axe, and the bumbling dragonborn, the human cleric with a very angry disposition, and the awkward half-elf druid stepping in pace with him. Gives you all a cursory look and immediately puts a hand to his side where you can see that there is a rapier currently sheathed. "Aye, you walk with purpose."

name: WIL
dialogue: We walk for the Guild.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Slayer's Take it is?"

name: WIL
dialogue: It is.

name: MATT
dialogue: "What business have you on this side of town, then? Aren't you supposed to be out past the "walls killing creatures and such?"

name: WIL
dialogue: Our business takes us where our business takes us. Our business brings us here today.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right, then what's your business?"

name: WIL
dialogue: You might be having some trouble?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Aye."

name: WIL
dialogue: What's causing you trouble and what's going to get us out of here might be the same thing.

name: MATT
dialogue: The gentleman to the left of him finishes shaking off the rest of his alleyway journey.

name: WILL
dialogue: Any more than twice and you're just playing with it, pal.

name: MATT
dialogue: He turns around and throws his tunic over. "Excuse me, it's official Bastion business. "Anyway." And he nods over to the bearded gentleman who's standing there. "There are certain bits of business that are official in this town. I don't know how honestly "right it is to be talking with common folk, or even the Guild who does what it likes."

name: WIL
dialogue: I'm sorry, you're not talking to common folk.

name: WILL
dialogue: He wants money.

name: WIL
dialogue: I know what he wants.

name: WILL
dialogue: Well, then give to him so we can get out of here.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm circling around.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a stealth check.

name: MATT
dialogue: I'm not even going to roll. I'm going to ask you to go ahead and you can choose if you want persuasion or intimidation on this. You're riding that line.

name: WIL
dialogue: I'm equally bad at both of them. But I think that Thorbir wants to go intimidation. I'll give that a try. There it is!

name: WIL
dialogue: What's the exact opposite of that? (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: You know, I've heard about it for so long.

name: WIL
dialogue: I know, right? You can't believe that it's a real thing until you're actually there.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Everybody talks about spontaneous combustion, but I'd never believed it.

name: WIL
dialogue: It's silly. It's so silly to do this.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Dice shame.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Naughty.

name: MATT
dialogue: I don't know what ancient Aztec deity's temple you defaced when you were a child, but man. All right, so as you lean forward--

name: WIL
dialogue: Please, just let me step into a bucket. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: We'll get to that. As you lean forward, forcing your presence on this Bastion, his hand's still holding the edge of his rapier. He steps forward into you, to the point where you're almost forehead to forehead. "Sorry, I have to lean down to reach your level. But if you're going to go "about asking questions and not offering proper compensation for information, well, then. I think "we have no business here."

name: WIL
dialogue: If it's compensation you're looking for, let's just speak plain. And I pull out four gold.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And while he has their attention, I'm going to check out his pockets.

name: MATT
dialogue: Go ahead and make a perception check.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Ew, that's not good. I'm going to use Luck. That's better. That's all right. Perception, you said? 28.

name: MATT
dialogue: 28? Taking a moment as you sneak up behind the one he's talking to-- the two guys are shoulder to shoulder, squaring off with the rest of this group. The one that had been relieving himself in the alleyway is a little bit closer to you. You can see as he put his tunic right and everything, he jostled around and revealed a couple of small pouches on his side. One of which, you heard a clinking of glass on the inside. Go ahead and make a sleight-of-hand check.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Go rogue, go.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Because I'm wearing a Cloak of Elvenkind, which I know affects stealth checks but not--

name: MATT
dialogue: Not sleight of hand, no.

name: LIAM
dialogue: That's all right. 20.

name: MATT
dialogue: 20. All right. You reach over and find the edge of the leather loop that attaches itself to the side of this Bastion's belt. You tug ever so gently to the side and the loop releases and you pull it off, seemingly without any noticing. As you pull out the four gold from inside, the Bastion looks out and scoffs and goes, "Clearly, pittance fee for this. What's to let me think "that you aren't actually part of this murder scheme? You just walk up and try and start asking "questions like this. First off, where did you hear about it? Second, you look like the kind that "would go ahead and be mauling folks in the street, do you not, sir dwarf? You got the eyes of one "who's probably done a few dark deeds."

name: WIL
dialogue: Oh, I have. More than you can imagine.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Then explain to me why we shouldn't take you in for questioning right now." And he pulls his rapier out.

name: ORION
dialogue: Hold on. Everybody calm down. Hi, I'm Tiberius Stormwind. My friend Thorbir here didn't mean to offend, of course.

name: MATT
dialogue: The blade up toward your face. And he says, "Look, dragon man, I was talking to the dwarf. "You, I have no business with at the moment. So. You've got ten seconds before we take you in."

name: WIL
dialogue: I reach into my pocket and rattle my coins around a little bit. Maybe I could buy us some time. And I drop ten gold out into my other hand.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a persuasion roll.

name: WILL
dialogue: One! No, it isn't.

name: MATT
dialogue: Three.

name: WIL
dialogue: That's funny. I rolled a three on this die. So that's going to be a six. Guys, I think we're fighting the Bastions. I feel like maybe it's going that way.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You rolled a one?

name: MATT
dialogue: I rolled one.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You all have really low self-confidence.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you push forward the coins, in a semi-awkward forceful manner, the Bastion himself also seems to be caught off-guard, and looks down, and looks about. Realizing that now it looks like you are visibly out in the open, paying money to the Bastions. He looks back. "People don't stand "out in public and do it!" And he pulls you all off into the alleyway to the side of the complex. Out of the middle of the area into the shade between the buildings. He reaches over and takes the coins from your hand and hurries them into a pocket. "All right, look. I'll tell you what we know. But "if you're going to be messing around with this investigation, I ask that you don't let anyone "know that you spoke with us. This is all on your own. And if you do say anything, we'll deny it and "we'll make sure to put you in the Oubliette yourself for this. All right?"

name: ORION
dialogue: Fair enough.

name: WIL, WILL
dialogue: All right.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Now, we have found a series of bodies over the past few years, scattered about. A few months at "a time between. All with a similar pattern of death to them. We found large portions, the meaty "portions of the body had been torn away, some of them apparently eaten. There are marks that are "indicative of some sort of beast ravaging the corpses, but no signs of a beast coming or going. "And we've had many of our finest trackers looking for any sort of sign of a creature that may have "found its way into the city. They've been in the rooftops, the gutters, perhaps even the sewers. No "sign of any such creature traveling amongst any of these scenes. "Now, all of the bodies have been found wrapped up and discarded in the canals. A lot of them "surrounding the Abundant Terrace." Looks at the rest of you. "That's where Melora's eye is "watchful. What's really got us confused of late is, the most recent murder that we found was a "very powerful merchant lord from Ank'harel, one that's been in this city for no more than a month. "He's well-known in these parts as bringing in a lot of business. His caravans come through via "various skyships. And he brings with himself an influx of much-needed mercantile in the city."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What's his name?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm not allowed to say."

name: WILL
dialogue: You're not allowed to say?

name: MATT
dialogue: "The merchant's name is Tyrell."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Tyrell. Lord Tyrell. If you say any of this to any of our people, I swear I'll make your life "the hardest it's been in months. And from the looks of you, you've had a very hard few months. "Lord Tyrell's body was found, but apparently during the murder. We have one beggar that "apparently caught sight of this the murderer. As best as we can tell, it was some sort of "lycanthrope. The beggar was babbling, but it seemed there was some sort of wolf-like creature. "It was seen bipedal walking a man, but tore this man right through the throat, most of his chest. "But when spotted, didn't run, just vanished. Disappeared. No longer in his sight. No tracks "left behind. Just gone. Didn't know if it was angry poltergeist, ghost. But the last place he "was staying is at a recent establishment, only been here a couple of years. Referred to as "the Velvet Cabaret. The Velvet Cabaret is a very high-end place."

name: WILL
dialogue: I know it well.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You do?" He gives you a look of--

name: WILL
dialogue: I've heard about it from somewhere else.

name: ORION
dialogue: Scanlan? Have you been talking to Scanlan?

name: WILL
dialogue: Don't know who that is, Stormshadow.

name: ORION
dialogue: He likes whores. Okay. It's weird.

name: MATT
dialogue: "The fact that that the lord had been staying at the Velvet Cabaret for some time, and "we were feeling pretty close to possibly finding the source of these murders. Our bastion force "from the Duskmeadow worked with the Quadroads and we actually raided it. Found nothing. Nothing but "the patrons, no sign of any sort of foul play. We were forced to leave empty handed. That's all "we've got."

name: WILL
dialogue: I have a question about the bodies. Have you seen them?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I've only seen the most recent. The rest, I've just heard of."

name: WILL
dialogue: Anything similar with them? Are they all men? Are they all women? Are they children?

name: MATT
dialogue: "No children. Most of them seem to be well off to do folk. Dressed well."

name: WILL
dialogue: Wealthy men and women? And you say you've searched everywhere, including the catacombs?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Most. Catacombs themselves are sealed off. We've asked around, and there's been no sign of "movement in or out. And gods forbid, anyone stays in those places. "That's a nasty place to be staying."

name: WILL
dialogue: It is, indeed.

name: ORION
dialogue: Is there a way that the bastions could organize some kind of gathering of sorts? Perhaps a mandatory town meeting, where all would have to gather for maybe an announcement or something official?

name: MATT

dialogue: It's a dex save.

name: WILL, MARISHA
dialogue: (laugh)

dialogue: What's that weird James Gandolfini breathing next to me? It's really bizarre.

dialogue: I'm clarifying this because the spell says this. They make a dex saving throw, or they're lifted by the pillar. If they make a save, they are not touched by the pillar.

dialogue: Right. That means they don't get pinned by it.

name: MATT
dialogue: No, they don't take any damage. If they make their save, they dodge out of the way. That's how the spell is designed.

name: ORION
dialogue: All right.

name: MATT
dialogue: It's primarily intended to be a defensive spell that can occasionally be used offensively, if they fail their save. The shield guardian takes the damage.

name: ORION
dialogue: And he's pinned.

name: MATT
dialogue: And he's pinned, currently. Yep.

name: WIL, WILL
dialogue: Nice move.

name: WILL
dialogue: Get him, Stormchaser.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. The rakshasa dodges out of the way, and there is now a giant pillar in the middle of the room.

name: ORION
dialogue: I look at him, and I'm like--

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. That ends your turn, Tiberius? Thorbir, you're up.

name: WIL
dialogue: Can I hit the guardian?

name: MATT
dialogue: Currently, it is pinned against the ceiling, so you cannot hit it.

name: WIL
dialogue: Right, so I can't do anything. Can I just delay?

name: MATT
dialogue: You can if you want to. You can use your action to hold off until something triggers, which could be moving into range, in case you could then take your action on it.

name: WIL
dialogue: I'll do that. I can't get the rakshasa.

name: MATT
dialogue: Not from that distance, no. So you'll wait for this thing to try and find its way out. All right, cool. So that brings us to the top: the rakshasa's turn.

name: WIL
dialogue: Oh, but I am calling out, and yelling at, and taunting at the guy. And it's just this. (mouthing words)

name: ORION
dialogue: Oh, because of the Silence. I'll dissipate the spell so I can hear him. Were you trying to say something, Thorbir?

name: WIL
dialogue: (shouting) And I will be naked and riding through the desert-- (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: The rakshasa finishes scanning the room for a second, and he says, "Well, this has been a lot "of fun. I appreciate this little scuffle. However, I have other business to attend to. Looking at the "rest of you, at least I know where to hit you all the hardest. I know you have a father you seek. I "know you have family in Draconia. I know you have a sister that is not too far from here. And you. I "know you have one you hold dear to your heart. I can now see your minds, see their faces, and I "will see them soon. However, I must say adieu." And he begins to cast--

name: ORION
dialogue: 4th-level Counterspell!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Tiberius!

name: MATT
dialogue: You already used one 4th-level Counterspell from your ring earlier.

name: ORION
dialogue: Yeah, and I have two stored in there.

name: MATT
dialogue: How do you have two 4th-level Counterspells in a ring that can carry up to four levels of a spell?

name: ORION
dialogue: No. I can carry five up to 4th-level spells. It's my Ring of Spell Storing. It can carry up to five spells that go up to 4th level.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No, that's not how it works.

name: MATT
dialogue: It can carry up to four levels of spells.

name: ORION
dialogue: I don't understand that.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You can do four level-1 spells. You can do one level-4 spell. You can do two level-2 spells.

name: ORION
dialogue: That's not how it worked before.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah. That's how my ring works, as well. It's a level-5 Ring of Storing.

name: MATT
dialogue: Welcome to Dungeons and Dragons. It's all good. You have Counterspell as a spell you know, though, right?

name: ORION
dialogue: Yeah. Still 4th-level Counterspell.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Good to know. That makes a difference. Let me double-check one thing real fast, because this will make or break the circumstance, really.

name: ORION
dialogue: As a matter of fact, no. 6th-level Counterspell. (growling) You will go nowhere!

name: MATT
dialogue: All right.

name: ORION
dialogue: That's far as I can go.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We go to 11.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. It is a 7th-level spell, so let's go ahead and roll.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Come on.

name: ORION
dialogue: Do I have advantage or anything?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I don't think so.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Don't roll yet.

name: ORION
dialogue: Okay.

name: WILL
dialogue: (laughs) That's awesome. Okay. He's in charge!

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, so roll a d20 and your spell-casting ability is five for this.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Don't piss off Tetsuo, man.

name: MATT
dialogue: So you roll a d20. Add a five. I will say you have advantage on this because you were expecting and waiting for this, so go ahead and make your first roll. Roll one at a time.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: 19? All right.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, take that 19.

name: MATT
dialogue: 19? All right. To counter this spell as a level seven, you needed to roll a 17 or higher. You are targeting the spell, not the rakshasa itself. As you can see, its form begins to shimmer, and you see a small gate begin to open around its form. You, as a reaction, reach up and unleash your torrent of countering arcane energy. It hits this opening gate. The gate then fluctuates and shuts. At which point, the rakshasa goes, (quiet growl) and for the first time, really, in this entire battle, looks genuinely scared.

name: WILL
dialogue: Yeah!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Fucking kill it!

name: LIAM
dialogue: You were saying something about my sister?

name: ORION
dialogue: (shouting) No one threatens a goddamn Stormwind!

name: WILL
dialogue: What he said.

name: ORION
dialogue: I think I just broke my hand. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: Don't break your hand! It's going to fly-- actually, it's going to fly toward the door.

name: WILL
dialogue: Towards the door?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. That's all the movement it can get, there, but it is heading towards the exit.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, he's fucking trying to leave!

name: LIAM
dialogue: He suddenly turns pink and says, (Snagglepuss impression) exit stage right, even! (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: He's gliding toward the doorway over everybody. That brings us to Vax's turn.

name: WILL
dialogue: Come on, Vax! Don't let this bitch leave!

name: LIAM
dialogue: How far is he from that statue?

name: MATT
dialogue: From this statue here? At that height, I'd say it's about 30 feet.

name: LIAM
dialogue: 30 feet? Okay. He's not paying attention to me. Can I use my bonus action to go stealth?

name: MATT
dialogue: You're partially obscured by the statue. I'd say you can do that.

name: LIAM
dialogue: All right. With advantage. Come on, you fucking motherfucker. That is 28. And I'm throwing daggers at the back of his head. Yes. That is a 27. Do we call that sneak attack?

name: MATT
dialogue: He did not see you stealth, actually. He did not roll high enough perception, so you have sneak attack on him.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Ugh, I'm out of alcohol. It's the worst time to be out.

name: WIL
dialogue: Druid needs booze badly.

name: MATT
dialogue: 30 damage? How do you want to do this? (cheering)

name: LIAM
dialogue: I've got the dagger in my hand, right? I see him flying away. I'm crouched down. I flip it over so the blade's in my hand. I don't go fast. I just take my time, pull back, throw it harder than I usually do, through its neck, out the front.

name: MATT
dialogue: The dagger hits it in the back of the neck and the spine. It doesn't quite cut through the spinal column. You see it comes out the front of the throat. (choking noise) The spell falters. (thud) It falls to the ground, taking a serious impact fall and is now, (grunts) dragging itself towards the exit of the room as you start walking up to collect your blade. (coughing, gasping) It brings up its hand to start trying to cast a spell. (wet choking sound) It coughs this big pool of blood onto the ground.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I grab it by the ear and lift its head back. You talk about my sister again.

name: MATT
dialogue: (death rattle) With a spray of crimson across the ground and this horrible sucking sound, you pull back the head as the life force of the rakshasa comes spraying across the stone floor. As you release it and leave it to the ground with the last bit of life left in its body leaves its form, you hear this chuckle. "I'll find you."

name: LIAM
dialogue: And I boot it into the acid.

name: WILL
dialogue: No, we need the eyes!

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughs) The body tumbles into the acid. (sizzling sound) You guys run over really quickly and pull it out.

dialogue: What were you thinking?! (laughs)

dialogue: Don't push my buttons, man.

dialogue: I'm going to take my dagger out, and I'm going to shave trimmings from his fur and his whiskers. I'll take those.

dialogue: You currently have a vial of rakshasa shave scum.

dialogue: I take the jeweled dagger, and I walk down to the corpse of the rakshasa. I drive the dagger through one of the eye sockets, and I say, you will never harm my daughter.

dialogue: The dagger is left there as a proclaiment, and all of you feel the weight behind that whispered statement and decide it might be best to leave that dagger where it sits.

dialogue: Let us conclude our business.

dialogue: Very good.

dialogue: We have to break through those first. Fireball, fireball, fireball. Breaky, breaky, breaky.

dialogue: That's a terrible idea. Creating explosions in small, enclosed, earthen tunnels is a really good idea.

name: WILL
dialogue: (laughs) No problem.

dialogue: They completed the contract, but then all suffocated due to a sudden cave-in. It was so unfortunate, the second team.

name: ORION
dialogue: I had a bottle of air!

dialogue: Everyone's just permanently breathing air. It is the worst fate ever for a PC.

dialogue: Gather around. Watch what I can do! (laughter)

dialogue: It takes you a long time to retrace your steps and find your way through the entrapment, especially since as you remove the iron pillars, the boulder then begins to roll past, so you carve your way through. name: WIL
dialogue: Fuck yes, we do.

name: WILL
dialogue: Yeah, I think absolutely.

dialogue: All right. (boof) The door slams open and you all step into the center of the Velvet Cabaret. As you do, two of the guards turn and see you exit. "Hey! Hey, wait! What are you doing?" And they go for their blades to the side.

name: WILL
dialogue: Seriously?

name: ORION
dialogue: I turn around and go like, you really don't want to do that, friend. Trust me, please.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make an intimidation check.

name: ORION
dialogue: Oh, what is that? 14.

dialogue: 14? He rolled a three. He looks to the other guy. "As long as you're leaving."

name: ORION
dialogue: (garbled) Draconian again. (laughter)

name: WIL
dialogue: Thorbir just keeps walking.

name: MATT
dialogue: He sheathes the sword, and they give a wide berth. You can hear the music playing, and everyone's laughing. As you enter the room, the music comes to a stop.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Right before we leave, I turn and have a piece of pelt from the rakshasa, and I throw it at the guard's feet, and I say, here. That's what's left of your boss.

name: MATT
dialogue: He steps back for a second. Some of the other patrons are watching this. Some look scared; some look intrigued by this whole sudden arrival of strange warriors covered in various ichor. Watching as you step out, a swarm of them look at the feet, and one of them goes, "Oh! They killed "some sort of tiger!" That's not an accent. (laughter) Another who's watching says, "They bought that down at the market." The guards take it and lift it up with the blade and look strangely, and you see, coming out of the far corner, the bashful owner of the establishment that you had previously knocked unconscious, looks out. Not wanting to engage, just watching you as you leave with a look of fear on his face. You step out onto the thoroughfare, close the door behind you, back into the Quad Roads district, making your way towards the Slayer's Take guildhall.

name: LIAM
dialogue: On the way out, I grab two glasses of ale, and I hand one to this guy and just walk and don't say shit.

name: MATT
dialogue: No one argues.

name: WIL
dialogue: Thorbir is genuinely touched by this gesture.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you sip, you make your way through the main thoroughfare back to the center of the Quad Roads to the Slayer's Take guildhall. "I assume that this means the contract went well, right?"

name: WIL
dialogue: It's done.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I take a canvas bag and I plop it on the table, full of the rakshasa bits.

dialogue: (excited chuckles) He shows it to the Huntmaster. She glances down with a smile. "Very "good. I am glad that we gave you such a trusted member as your overseer. You did well, Thorbir. "Thank you for your effort in keeping these fledglings alive."

name: ORION
dialogue: One more insult, madam, and you will find your whole establishment on fire.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Tiberius.

name: ORION
dialogue: I'm not in the mood.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's not meant as an insult. I'm sorry, perhaps you do not understand that we speak with "terms of endearment."

name: ORION
dialogue: Oh. Well, in that case, I take it as a compliment.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Very well. So, looking at the contract. Is everything hopefully in order?" She takes it from you, looks into the contents of the bag. "Very well. You shall be paid out in full and scattered "amongst your party as you see fit."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And our counterparts? The rest of our party, have they returned? Have they checked in yet?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Not yet. They are still out at the moment. They've been gone for about as long as you have "been. You've returned faster than they have. Let us hope that they are safe. But I have faith. They "seemed very intent on completing this without issue, so I would not be too worried. I will "notify you upon their return, though."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Please do.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Where are you staying?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Where are we staying?

name: WILL
dialogue: I thought as members of the Take, you got to stay here?

name: MATT
dialogue: "You could, if you like. We have room, and technically, as of this contract, you are all "officially members of the Take. You may stay here, if you wish."

name: ORION
dialogue: I need a bed. And I motion towards the thing. I'm sleepy.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We'll wait here.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Very well. We shall hold off the ceremony for when the rest of your team arrives."

name: WIL
dialogue: If the rest of this team is half as good as these members, the Take has grown much stronger this day. They're worthy.

name: MATT
dialogue: She crosses her arms and her usual jovial, passive attitude grows a little more stern. She gives a nod of genuine respect towards Thorbir. And for the first time she looks about the rest of you with a slightly intense look of really understanding the essence of strength between and behind each of you. "I believe you're correct. I think there will be great things ahead for us. "Welcome to the Slayer's Take." She reaches down, brings up a small wooden chest. Sets it on the edge and opens it.
