dialogue: She looks over at her.

name: LIAM
dialogue: She started before we got here. Just keep it coming. Thank you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right, all right."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: How much are they?

name: MATT
dialogue: "For your strongest? Per glass, I'll put that at about--"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Don't tell him the price of anything.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Very well."

name: LIAM
dialogue: I lift up the cup and keep putting it in, and say, a round of the strongest on me. I've got that, as well.

name: ORION
dialogue: I'll take a water.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. You get water, you all managed to get your drinks. A very, very thick, syrupy mead-type alcohol. Altogether for those drinks, Vax, it comes down to 15 gold for alcohol, which is expensive for a round. This is very fine.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Should've let me haggle that down. I would have got it to 19 gold.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Hey, you're thinking about it the wrong way, Grog. It's the other way. You want to go down, not up.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I love you, guys.

name: MARISHA, ORION, ASHLEY
dialogue: I love you, too.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I missed you all so much.

name: ORION
dialogue: Pike, if we're to just be roundabout and mill about today, is that what you wish, Pike? After our tavern? What would you care to do?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Stay-cation.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Well, wait. Where's Scanlan?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He went to the park.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You know, he needed a little-- it was really rough going, from what I hear anyway, and he needed a little therapy?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Oh, he needed a massage?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I thought he was going to the house where they--

name: ORION
dialogue: Lady favors.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I get it.

name: ORION
dialogue: Well, we could do whatever you wish. If you care to wish the keep, let's go back to the keep. We could easily get there and take an airship back, if we choose to.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We were also talking about visiting Keyleth's family. Can you get away long enough to--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Maybe start the trip with us?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I think I can. And then, if I have to leave, at least I can maybe meet your family for a little bit.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, Never-Been-Kissed. How's that sound?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Are they your family, technically?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: They're our sister tribe. Because we all separated.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Tell us again. Sorry, explain it again.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Essentially, about 900 years ago or so, roughly a thousand years ago, we were a nomadic people. And then there was some sort of great sundering-- we're actually still not 100% sure; a lot of information was lost. And the elemental planes started bleeding with this plane, and oh, Vex is falling asleep.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Whoa. Hey, Stubby. Wake up.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Anyway. Long story short, we separated into four separate tribes to protect the places where the elemental planes bleed into this realm. Once every generation, someone is nominated to go out and make contact with the sister tribes in order to establish further communication, check in, learn about each other's cultures.

name: ORION
dialogue: Interesting.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We're from the same people, but we each have our individual cultures because we've been separated for so long, at this point.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So these ones are Fire.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: These ones are Fire, yes, so they're located in a volcanic region, and you can start to feel an energy from where the planes start to shift, and it gets a little unbalanced. That's where we each live, and I'm from the ones where we protect the Air portals.

name: ORION
dialogue: Lady Keyleth, did you just say where the planes shift?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes, because where all the planes-- almost like a Venn diagram, if you want to think about it.

name: ORION
dialogue: Who is this, who is Van Diagram.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (stuttering) Well, he was a great philosopher, of one of our peoples. But he described it as being these overlapping circles. What's that?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: He was one of the Ashari?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He was.

name: ORION
dialogue: Van Diagram was one of the Ashari.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Very great man.

name: ORION
dialogue: Quick question about the planes. Will we travel there, is there any way to, perhaps, get to the fey woods through these planes.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We don't necessarily overlap with the fey. We protect where it overlaps. You could get to the fire elemental plane easier from this place, and my town you can get to the plane of Air--

name: LAURA
dialogue: (belches)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's a good one, Grog!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Nope. Not me.

name: ORION
dialogue: That was Vex.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: That was a good one.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's nappies time. Nappy time.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Are you feeling okay, Vex?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Just give her an hour. She'll be fine.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: She just needs some time.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Side note: I'm two inches taller, and I've always called you Stubby.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Come here, Stubby.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But anyway, the last person to go on the Aramente was my mother, and she never returned, so we haven't really had contact with the Fire Ashari for a while.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: So you're pretty anxious to go, then, yeah?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I have no idea what they're going to be like.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: But you know about where they are, right?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I've gotten rough directions. We'll have to probably figure it out along the way.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are we hoofing it? Are we flying?

name: ORION
dialogue: We could do whatever you wish, Grog. Do you have a particular ability called Magic Weapon?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Well, I have Spiritual Weapon. So I guess, yes?

name: ORION
dialogue: They're different things.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Well. What do you want? What are you looking for?

name: ORION
dialogue: I wanted you to bless my quarterstaff. Make it magical. I need my staff enchanted. I would like you to enchant my staff, Pike.

name: ASHLEY, TRAVIS
dialogue: Whoa!

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I know what that means.

name: MATT
dialogue: You've been around Scanlan long enough.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: The holy symbol goes (shattering sound).

name: ORION
dialogue: I mean in a strictly platonic, arcane sense.

name: MATT
dialogue: What little knowledge you have of enchanting items, from your experience, and you had this a little bit as well from your own enchanting: the process of enchanting a weapon into what would be considered a magical weapon is a weeks-long process. It's doable, definitely, but it's one of those things where you would have to have somebody sit down with it over a period of time, and daily instill it with that magical energy until it finds its permanence within the object.

name: ORION
dialogue: Is there anybody in town I could leave that with and pay to do that?

name: MATT
dialogue: Probably?

name: ORION
dialogue: A mage?

name: MATT
dialogue: Mage, maybe not so much. There are other clerics.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It'd be expensive, though. It's somebody's time for a week.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It also seems like this is one of those towns where things are expensive. Things are expensive here.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Not if you know how to handle them.

name: ORION
dialogue: Right. I'll hold off on that.

name: MATT
dialogue: But yes, it is totally doable.

name: ORION
dialogue: Is it a thing that I can like start to do, hourly for a long, long time?

name: MATT
dialogue: If you wanted to yourself, yeah.

name: ORION
dialogue: Okay, I'm going to start that process right now.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Here's what I think. Lady Keyleth has been talking about this for a long time. It's calling to her, and we're a family now, and it's her moment. We're here. They're right nearby. There's no use putting it off. Let's go to her family.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I am so nervous, you guys. I'm so scared.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Let's go. Should we go in the morning, or should we go now? Let's go now.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We'll go in the morning.

name: ORION
dialogue: No, let's sleep it off.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: We'll take just a small nap.

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right. Small nap, and then first thing in the morning.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I walk up behind Vex and I tap on her opposite shoulder and pull my hand away.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Who's there? Hi, Pike! I'm so glad you're here.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Could she have one more? You need one more, Stubby, then you'll go to bed, all right? Then you'll go to bed.

name: MATT
dialogue: At which point the bartender at the tavern goes, "Are you sure about that?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, one more!

name: ASHLEY, MARISHA
dialogue: One more!

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right. But you're cleaning my floor." And he goes and fills everyone's drink.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I tip him five gold and I give him a wink.

name: MATT
dialogue: He happily takes it, and the wink is a strong wink. He smiles back, but also gives you the look of like, time for bed. You all eventually finish your drinks and find your way back to your respective rooms for the evening and have a good night's rest. And on that note, we're going to go ahead and take a five-minute restroom break on our end. We'll be back here about five minutes or so, so don't go too far, and we'll kick back in the following morning for what appears to be a journey towards the Pyrah tribe of the Ashari.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm so scared! I'm so nervous!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You're going to do great! [break]

name: MATT
dialogue: Hey guys, welcome back! We've had our break, so as the party comes to consciousness the following morning, a very heavy hangover coming from Vex for the evening of lamenting the loss of a number of financial things.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I whip her up a little herbal tonic. Here. Drink this.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm taking Trinket for a walk. For dookies.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. Go ahead and make your beard roll.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Come on, you son of a bitch. Yes! Two, two! 22!

name: MATT
dialogue: 22. As you come to consciousness, Grog wakes up and shakes his head for a minute, and you look, and there is a good solid two-inch beard. Where was once the somewhat clear, stringy, fishing-line-type scruff, you're starting to see a little color come into it. This thick black root is now starting to appear at the base of the beard.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (singing) I feel so happy. So happy!

name: MATT
dialogue: It is like horsehair bristles, it's very thick, and you could probably clean dishes against it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Is it like an Abe Lincoln beard, or do I also have a mustache?

name: MATT
dialogue: Actually, for you it's only coming in as a chinstrap beard, at the moment.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Oh, wow.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Don't judge.

name: ORION
dialogue: I see Vex's condition and I run out to get her a coffee from the bazaar, and then do my perception check on the thing.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you're glancing about and getting coffee for her, you manage to see a cart that's just setting up this early in the morning in the bazaar. You hear some squeaking and growling and a couple of bird chirps. You look over to the side and there is one small setup that has a number of creatures and small animals and stuff set up in cages.

name: ORION
dialogue: Oh! As I'm running by because the coffee's hot. Hot. Oh, excuse me, would you happen to have any particular dragonites for sale? Male, preferably, but I will take female if you have one. (quietly) I'm just making it hotter when I blow on it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's funny. It took a second.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What are dragonites?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Little baby dragons?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Like a pseudodragon.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You going to have a little pet, too?

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. She glances at the coffee in your hand, "Well, I mean, we've got two that are a bit "sickly, but they're for purchase if you like."

name: ORION
dialogue: I would love one. Give me whichever's the least sickly of the two.

name: MATT
dialogue: "They're both green; it's hard to tell."

name: ORION
dialogue: Oh, I'll take the darker green one.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Okay. That one's probably more sick, but I'll take it." (laughter) Takes the cage down, and you can see there is this lethargic-looking tiny dragonite that's curled up on this small perch, and as she lifts it off, it goes (lizard noises) and scoffs at the cage. "That'll be 200 gold pieces."

name: ORION
dialogue: Oh, very good.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No, don't pay full price for a sick dragon!

name: MATT
dialogue: "There you are, sir. Have a good day."

name: ORION
dialogue: Thank you very much. Any particular tips, food-wise?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Don't let it die. Feed it. Give it water. Good day, sir."

name: ORION
dialogue: Okay, so I run back and I go, oh, here you are.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, thank you.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Oh, who's that?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What is that?

name: ORION
dialogue: I think I'm going to name him Lockheed.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Trinket looks very interested in Lockheed.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He looks a little-- oh...

name: MATT
dialogue: Trinket's nose goes up to the cage (sniffs).

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Is he sick?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't think it's supposed to make that noise.

name: ORION
dialogue: Do you want to do some healing?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Yeah, I'll do just a small healing.

name: MATT
dialogue: Medicine check? Okay, go for it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Your bear shat like a fountain. Wasn't solid. I don't know what you're feeding him. It was a little runny, sorry. Roughage. He needs roughage.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Trinket, get some vegetables in your diet.

name: MATT
dialogue: (groans, growls)

name: LAURA
dialogue: He likes meat, what can I say?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: What was I rolling for?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I missed Pike.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Checking about the health. I rolled a seven.

name: MATT
dialogue: He doesn't look the healthiest.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: He looks really sick!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can I check him out? Is he considered an animal?

name: MATT
dialogue: No.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can I check him out?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Oh, but he's a little cutie, isn't he?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I like him. Can I put my finger in the cage?

name: ORION
dialogue: Lockheed.

name: MARISHA, LAURA
dialogue: Lockheed.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I put my finger in the cage and go, hello, Lockheed!

name: MATT
dialogue: As soon as your finger gets to the edge, (snaps) he bites on the finger.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: He's a real peach.

name: MATT
dialogue: You take a point of damage.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Son of a bitch!

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Maybe you should name him Lockheed Peach.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Aw, Lockheed Peach.

name: ORION
dialogue: I think Lockheed is good enough.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can I do a check on him and see if I make him feel better?

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a medicine check.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Medicine check? Oh that's not bad. 19 total.

name: MATT
dialogue: You gather this may be some sort of a general illness that lingers for a couple of weeks. Properly fed and taken care of, would probably be able to get it through its system.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I reach in my pouch and pull out a few Goodberries.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. You feed him through the cage. Reluctant to eat the first piece. Eventually, it takes a bite and then begins to eat the rest through the cage as you continue through breakfast.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can you speak with animals, Keyleth?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I can, but he's not an animal. He's a dragon-guy.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Is he starting to look any better? Could I try healing him a little bit?

name: MATT
dialogue: You can try healing. It's more of a disease-based illness.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Just feed him, lots of water--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I have some dry food rations if you want to give him a nibble.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I gave him some Goodberries. I'll make up some more Goodberries.

name: ORION
dialogue: We have a bunch of food and stuff. We'll be fine. We can move on with the journey.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So, it's groggy, but we decided to go see your family, right? Right now?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I mean, I don't want to inconvenience anyone.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We're going, Keyleth.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: We're doing it!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: There's fire.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I've always wanted to see a volcano, anyway.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes, it sounds lovely.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm sure they're all as charming as you are.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You'll win them over.

name: ORION
dialogue: You'll be fine.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: What's the worst that could happen? Oh, never mind. That was rhetorical. Don't actually want to know what the worst that could happen would be.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I have to do a trial and meet their headmaster.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Royal stuff.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Keyleth, I saw you pile-drive a beholder. Pretty sure you're going to be all right.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's true.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Yeah, you're going to do it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's not even that. It's sometimes learning about your past can be equally as terrifying. I don't know what I'm going to find.

name: ORION
dialogue: Well, let's go discover it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, from what I heard, we head south towards Sunder Peak. Towards the southwest, it's volcanic territory.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Should we ask how far it is?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Maybe. I only got vague directions.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Can we see Sunder Peak from here?

name: MATT
dialogue: The landscape is very heavily wooded, and the canopy of the forest tends to rise and lower about the height of the wall itself. You can't really see anything beyond the wall of the city of Vasselheim, anyway.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So remember that way, we found a hydra, so we might come across some terrible things.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: One of you wordsmiths go talk to somebody and ask directions.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I flag down the nearest person.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make an investigation check.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's happening. There's nothing you can do to stop this anymore. Embrace the inevitable.

name: MATT
dialogue: Asking around and gathering a few folks and asking them questions, eventually you flag down one guy at the far end of the tavern; he's an amateur cartographer who's in the middle of sketching out the nearest area. He talks to you for a bit and you mention Sunder Peak Mountains and he goes, "Oh yeah, yes, no. Sunder Peak. It's not too far from Vasselheim. It's about two days' "travel, on horseback southwest. The Sunder Peak Mountains themselves, be careful; they're pretty "steep. I haven't actually gone within the mountain range myself, but I've been within a few miles of "it just to make sure that I can mark it on my map, but yeah. It should be fine. Stay on the road."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay, stay on the road.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do you actually have a map that we could use? Borrow?

name: MATT
dialogue: "This is not done. And I need to finish it before I can give it to a printer to make more."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What's your girlfriend's name?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I should go." And he folds up his map.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, wait! We'll be on the lookout for key things in the landscape to maybe give you information for your maps?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, that would be very helpful."

name: LAURA
dialogue: What's your name?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Tyriok."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Tyriok?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Tyriok."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Matthew, we've been doing this for three years, and you still fucking blow me away game after game. I'm sorry. Tyriok, I meant to say.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Anything you come across, please do take note of it. If you require a small piece of "parchment, I can perhaps provide that as well."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, yeah. Yeah.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Wait, what happens if you don't stay on the road?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, forests tend to-- "

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I mean I have an idea, but--

name: MATT
dialogue: "There are things that live there that are generally pretty dangerous. They've had people "who've travelled on these routes and at some point they've been attacked. Or worse, never came "back."

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Wow. Do you know what they've been attacked by?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I haven't."

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: You don't know.

name: LAURA, MARISHA
dialogue: Hydra.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Hydra?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We fought a hydra, Pike.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Not as in the-- I understand.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Like, five heads.

name: MATT
dialogue: Glances back over at Grog's ominous stare towards him again. "I should be leaving."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Parchment.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes." Hands you this rolled-up piece, relatively well-made.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We will use this to make notes.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I appreciate that greatly."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You wouldn't happen to have a compass, would you?

name: MATT
dialogue: "No? Not that I can lend out."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We could make a compass if we really needed one. It's not hard to make a compass.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Anyway. I'm usually here in the morning. Just going about my business. So whenever you need "to find me--"

name: LAURA, MARISHA
dialogue: Tyriok.

name: MATT
dialogue: He goes and heads off. You guys are welcome to prepare as you wish.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, we need horses, right? We don't want to walk.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Don't we have horses from our previous--

name: MATT
dialogue: Your team has horses. This team does not.

name: LAURA
dialogue: But we have enough horses for all of us, from our previous run.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We had two extra horses.

name: MATT
dialogue: You did.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah. Let's just take those horses. We don't even have to pay for them.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Awesome.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I need a new horse, because mine's back, the horse--

name: LAURA
dialogue: The back buckled?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You can ride the bear.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, he can't.

name: MATT
dialogue: It was pretty rough getting you there, even as a warhorse. You weigh a lot.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: So probably a new horse.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Wait. You drove the horse into the ground?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay, so we need two extra horses.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Oh, we're getting more? Did you bust up the last one?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: He's all like this.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay. Let's go find a couple of horses. I'm going to ride Trinket, so we only need one extra horse.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: A warhorse for Grog.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes? I go get a horse for Grog.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. The cost of the warhorse. Initially, when you get there, the stablehand who you talked to originally, "You've gone already through it. I can offer you another war horse. We're starting to "run a little low, if you keep tearing through them at this rate."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, we'll say we're covered though, yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh, that's 400 gold to purchase yourself a warhorse."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, 400. Darling, remember who we are. We gave you excellent business before. I have no idea what I'm saying.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Come on, this is your thing. Come on.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I think, as a return customer, you can offer us more of a deal than that.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a persuasion check.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Come on. Natural 20! (shouting)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It's verified. That's a 20.

name: MATT
dialogue: He goes, "Here. How about this. I will, based on your previous patronage, and if you can "ensure that you would continue to send business my way, I would be happy to give it to you at half "price."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Of course. Half price is a very fair deal. Grog. Pay the man.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Would you be interested in negotiating? Right. 200 gold.

name: MATT
dialogue: (chuckling) Mark off 200 gold.

name: ORION
dialogue: Wait, for two horses? Don't we need two?

name: MATT
dialogue: There was a warhorse for him, and then there's two amongst you. I don't know if you wanted to become a horse and run.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I was going to ride Trinket so that there were three for them.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You could take the busted-up horse. It just can't carry me anymore.

name: LIAM

name: MATT
dialogue: As you all back away, the front wall of stone that was put up before you, that the eyes were looking through, suddenly (crashing) crumbles into a pile on its own, revealing the caldera before you, once again. There stand about ten individuals, all dressed in what looks like dark brown and black hides and leathers, with sections of what looks like obsidian-tipped weapons, certain arrows are cocked at the ready against the rest of you, and one individual, the one that was speaking to you earlier comes forward. You see all of these people, they are from varying races: dwarves, halflings, humans, about three half-elves among them, when an elven man comes forth, and you recognize through the eyes and the tone of voice, this is the one that spoke to you through the slit in the stone. He has no hair. Completely bald of all hair. Tattooed darkness around his eyes and you can see his entire left arm is covered in a long-healed but horrible burn scar. He steps up and gives you a nod of affirmation. "Then you shall tell this to the Flamespeaker. If you are "indeed Ashari, he will know what to do with you. Come with us."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And what, might I ask, is your name?

name: MATT
dialogue: Glances back over his shoulder. "Calhoun. But I'm not the one you wish to speak with."

name: ORION
dialogue: Hi, I'm Tiberius Stormwind.

name: MATT
dialogue: He turns around and continues walking back towards the forest.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Let me do all the talking this time.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Would you like us to follow you, Your Majesty?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, you don't-- yes, family, my brothers and sisters.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Got it.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys continue walking alongside Keyleth, and as you do, most of the druids flank you to each side, about four of them, with arrows still drawn, walking behind you as you progress. They are still armed and keeping a close eye on you as you travel.

name: LAURA
dialogue: This is really not necessary.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Just let them do it.

name: MATT
dialogue: Calhoun leads the way and you guys continue traveling for about half an hour or so until eventually you begin to reach an area where you see more of these rock structures, but many of them have been carved out, or a series of stones have been gathered to build small huts and abodes. You can see this is essentially a village built from all the materials that were scavenged from or brought to this caldera to construct Pyrah, the realm of the Fire Ashari. As you move through the town, silence still claims the entirety of the druids that are escorting you, with Calhoun leading the way. You can see other druids begin coming out of their abodes, glancing around and watching you as you approach. No scowls, no smiles, just a general air of indifference amongst them as they carefully watch the strange outsiders stepping through their homestead. You are then led through the village to the outskirts of this forest. Now, the forest you see, as you get closer, all the trees are long dead and petrified. There is not a leaf among them, and most of the wood you see is either gray or black from being charred, burned, or dying over time and being petrified. As you head towards the edge of the forest, Calhoun stops and turns around and just crosses his arms and stares at you. "Sh." At which point, the ground (explosion) shudders and you can see, in the distance, from within the forest almost, you see a large spray of molten rock disappear into the loose canopy of the burned trees before you, some sort of brief volcanic eruption seems to have sprayed out from the center of this cluster of dead trees. About 20 seconds later, you see a shape begin to emerge from the dead forest. Stepping out of the shadows, you see a man standing there. Human, very thick, sturdy build. No shirt, brass-colored bracers, long, billowing pants of a deep maroon color, with gold trim and designs. His skin is very darkened, whether by blood or by sun. He has a very dark complexion to him. His hair is long and jet black. You see his jaw is very square, and his cold black eyes show no emotion as he ignores the rest of you and steps toward Keyleth. (heavy footsteps) He walks right up to you. Now he's looking down at you. He's standing probably a good foot and a half taller. Once again, no emotion, no expression. "You are kin of Vilya, are you?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm... King of Vilya?

name: ORION
dialogue: Kin.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, kin of Vilya. Yes, I am.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I am Cerkonos, the Flamespeaker of Pyrah, the guardian of this rift. Welcome to Pyrah, my "child. I must ask: why have you come?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I am here to complete my Aramente. I have already been to the Earth tribe.

name: MATT
dialogue: He crosses his arms for a moment.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: My mother, Vilya, never returned to Zephra. MATT "For you to be here on your Aramente, it is proof that she did not complete hers, or at least "is no longer with us. I am sorry. She was strong of heart." So she came through here?

name: MATT
dialogue: "She did. She completed the trial, the challenges, and moved on to continue her Aramente "about ten or so years back."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Only ten years ago! She's been gone for close to 20.

name: LAURA
dialogue: How long was she here?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes, how long was she here?

name: MATT
dialogue: "She stayed naught but three or four days... and then her journey took her. I'd hoped wherever "she was, she was safe."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can I check him to see if he is telling the truth? 22.

name: MATT
dialogue: He seems stern, but honest. His words, genuinely, come from a place of worry and a tinge of regret at the knowledge that he's just received. "Your mother was strong of heart and was very "fierce. She could stir the heart of the mountains themselves with a word. She was very well "respected amongst us."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: She was better than I am.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I hope not." At this moment his face becomes a little darker and he says, "Korren? I "assume he is well?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He is. As stubborn as always.

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughs) "Well, you come with compatriots. You trust them?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes. These are my traveling companions, Vox Machina. They've proven themselves time and time again. We've been together for almost over a year now.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Do you trust them?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I do. We actually have a keep now in Emon.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Good. You'll need trust. You are here to learn, then, for your Aramente. To be tested, yes?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Correct.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Then speak what you've learned to seek, what you wish to learn. What do you lack? What "will be your death?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I have actually seen a vision of my death. From not having the will to do what is necessary, for fear of harming others, instead of protecting myself.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Then the test begins now, without preparation. Do you also wish to join her in this "task?"

name: TRAVIS, TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: For the first time, you see a smile across his face. Beneath it, you can see the gleaming, white, toothy grin of the man that acknowledges some sort of honor. "Then the trial shall "commence. Come, within Cindergrove." He turns around and heads back into the forest. The rest of the druids have stepped back now. They've left you to your own devices.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: A vision of your death?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Part of one of the ceremonies that the Earth tribe gives is called the Alore ceremony. It's a tea that they make that is derived from a local plant that-- It's essentially a vision quest tea; it gives you visions. It's a cultural tradition, I guess. I saw two paths. One was an older woman, who was wise and hardened and brave, and she had a line of young Ashari behind her. And I ran away. I feel like she was me. And I ran away, and I went down another path. There was a tree. It was young, but strong, and it had a familiarity. As I reached out and touched it, my vision was taken through the path of the roots, and I could see the world, and I could see how everything was connected, and it took me to you all. And you were strong and fighting and proud, and then Vax yelled out, "This one is for Keyleth!" I wasn't with you. And then Grog yelled out, "This is for our princess!" And it broke away, and I realized that I was that tree, and it was my death. And as I ran to the other side, I went back to the old woman, and all of my people slowly started fading behind her, and as she looked at me, she said, "Your future is as "important as it is fragile. Protect it." And she, too, faded away. I realized she was me. And when I came out of my vision, I talked with the Earth Headmaster Patisse, and she told me that if I was going to survive, I needed to have the will to do what was necessary, and the strength. And ever since the child, it's been hard. I was there for a long time at the Earth Tribe, longer than most stay on their Aramente. I couldn't get through the trial; every time I used a natural magic, every time I tried to fight, I just saw flashes of that child's eyes. I was blocked. Normally, they save the Alore ceremony for the final testament, but they actually started me with the Alore ceremony in order to help hopefully unlock my spiritual blocking that I was having. But I don't know...

name: ORION
dialogue: So what now, Your Highness?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Continue on and hope I don't make a fatal mistake. Hope that I can learn.

name: ORION
dialogue: We won't let that happen.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I hope I don't let you guys down.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We face this together.

name: MATT
dialogue: (explosion) There's another shake of the ground as you see another spray of molten rock, (spraying) and you hear pattering in the distance of the forest.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We'll do this together.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We're with you to the end.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I love you all.

name: MATT
dialogue: You all move together into the Cindergrove forest, pushing through the hardened, blackened tree trunks to the left and the right of you. The actual floor of the forest, what appears to be piles and piles of burnt-away brush, ash, and whatever else once was considered life amongst the boughs of these trees when they grew there. Eventually, you find your way to the center of the forest, and you can see now the source of these molten rock sprays. There is a large crevasse bisecting the center of the forest, about 35 to 40 feet across and about five feet wide that is a pool of slowly roiling lava. You can see the actual air around it is heavily warped by this intense heat that's being released, and all the trees that are immediately around it are all warped and bent and have been burnt to near lack of recognition. Standing there, amongst the edge of it, is Cerkonos with his arms crossed, trained on you, Keyleth. You see occasionally a couple of bubbles (lava bubbling) in the lava behind him, and even his form is shifting from behind as the air itself ripples and changes. He looks at you and says, "Sit. Focus. Ask permission."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I do as he says.

name: MATT
dialogue: Go ahead and make a wisdom check. Roll a d20. Add your wisdom bonus.

name: MATT
dialogue: 27. As you sit down and close your eyes, you begin to focus your mind towards the center of this mountain, the heart of the fire that gives it its life, and as you all watch, a minute passes of silence before suddenly the ground shifts again and you can see the lava begin to grow more and more active, sending off little spittles of rock.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I push it out and continue to focus.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys begin to see now the lava is shifting and beginning to roil and you're almost afraid it's going to start bubbling over and fill the area, and this nervousness grips your heart. Especially you, Vax, who had previously had some unhappy run-ins with molten rock. It's a genuine fear that you hadn't quite acknowledged since that moment, and you begin to feel really uncomfortable being this close to this opening. As you continue to focus, you hear Cerkonos's voice again, calm and methodical. "Ask permission." I'd like you to go ahead and roll a nature check.

name: MATT
dialogue: 19. (rock scraping) The ground shifts again. You can now watch the lava. Strangely enough, it's beginning to billow upward but not spill over the edges of the crevasse. It's actually slowly circling. You hear this strange sucking sound, almost like sludge is being pulled through a tube, and the lava beginning to slowly spin and spin. Cerkonos is still-- the back of him you can only imagine is either burnt to a crisp by the sheer proximity of the heat, but he is unmoved.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I push it out and continue to focus. Just focus and meditate on asking permission.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Keyleth of the Air Ashari. Ask permission!" Go ahead and roll one more wisdom check. d20 plus five. This time, with advantage.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh my god, I rolled the same thing twice. Wisdom, five. 18.

name: MATT
dialogue: 18. At this point, you guys notice one final shift of the ground, and the trees actually crack, and you see bits of broken branch and tree begin to fall and hit the ground around you. The air is beginning to pick up, and even though you try and cover your face the ash is still pushing through and your eyes are starting to hurt. You feel suddenly this blockage, this tension, like the mountain was fighting you, give way. And in that moment you (gasps) breathe in and open your eyes, and you all notice that the lava that has been slowly circling now (whoosh) pulls down into a vortex that disappears into the crevasse and is now a spinning whirlpool of molten rock in the crevasse, as Cerkonos still stands there. Cerkonos now steps aside and seems to vanish from your sight in but an instant, his voice lingering in the air, saying, "Now, you may enter." Looking down, you lean over and you can see this slow spiral of molten rock. It seems to disappear 15 to 20 feet below, you cannot see the bottom of it, and when you try and lean forward the heat is so intense that you have to close your eyes; you're forced to. There is a leap of faith here.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Before I leap down, I cast Protection from Flame on myself? Or Protection from Energy, and I'm going to use fire.

name: MATT
dialogue: Which gives you fire resistance?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Gives me fire resistance.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, good to know. And then... Keyleth?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I close my eyes and let myself fall.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys watch as Keyleth steps forward and tumbles off the edge, into the vortex of molten rock. (whoosh) She's gone.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I look to my sister and grab her by the shoulder and squeeze. Then I dive in.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, shit. Are we doing this?

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a wisdom saving throw, as this is fighting a very strong fear of yours.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Because we had the Heroes' Feast, are we not frightened?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh my god, that's true. You have advantage on all of our wisdom saving throws, from the Heroes' Feast.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. You shrug it off, and the thought of your sister, the thought of Keyleth, the thought of the moments of connection you guys have had, you push through that pain and you leap and swan dive into the vortex.

name: ORION
dialogue: I cast Stoneskin. (whoosh)

name: MATT
dialogue: You leap off. Tiberius dives in, as well. All of you guys jump in. You don't need to roll anything. It was only because of his fear he had to. The rest of you leap into this vortex.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Trinket! Jump? Come. I smack him on the butt, and I jump in after him.

name: MATT
dialogue: And Trinket (roaring) leaps in, looking over his shoulder at you like, what have you done?!

name: LAURA
dialogue: You're brave! Very brave!

name: MATT
dialogue: As you all individually leap through, it's interesting. There's a falling sensation, and then gravity seems to shift. You're facing downward, but you feel gravity begin to pull you to the side, and your feet find purchase on what seems like the lava spiral, but it doesn't burn. You step on it like it's hard rock, shifting slowly beneath your feet, where you have to continuously change your step, like a slowly rotating tunnel you're walking through, and you're walking downward, downward, this way. And you see light before you, very bright light, and you move towards it and move towards it, and your eyes try and focus, and you cover your vision, and eventually you step out of this tunnel and it takes a moment for your eyes to focus, and looking around you, you see a vast barren wasteland of black cinders, embers, and ash, for miles and miles around you. Thin rivers of lava cut across the plains like blood splatter.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh my god, we're in the Plane of Fire.

name: MATT
dialogue: The wind blows extremely strongly, and the atmosphere is dry and nearly unbearably hot, like the hottest desert you've ever imagined. An intolerably blazing sun is coming to rest near a distant mountain range, but your eyes catch an even more distant danger: a black, roiling cinderstorm a few miles off, red lightning flashing within its turbulent ash clouds. It looks to be moving away from you, thankfully, but you do indeed find yourself standing in the center of the Elemental Plane of Fire. A voice echoes from behind you, and you look over your shoulder, and you can see there is a circular doorway still held aloft there, shifting slowly, the vortex you stepped out of still locked in place. A voice says, "Stay together. Follow the footsteps. When "you find the stone spire, there you will find your trial."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay...

name: ORION
dialogue: Just to note: when I cast Stoneskin, I didn't do the concentration. I let go of the Alter Self.

name: MATT
dialogue: Right. That was illusion dust, so it's fine.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, we follow footsteps; I can track footprints.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay, sure. Yeah. He might mean more metaphorically. I'm not sure. It could be either. It's hard to tell. Can I sit and take a minute to meditate, and see if I can connect with my mother and see if I can find some sort of trace? Essence?

name: MATT
dialogue: Make another wisdom check.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And I want to use Primeval Awareness.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I have advantage, right? I'll take that 15. Thank you. It was a one. So that's 28.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can I use Primeval Awareness to see if there's any aberrations, celestials, elementals, fiends, undead? Any scary things? Dragons? Within six miles. No. A mile.

name: MATT
dialogue: You sense there is a very, very faint comfort in this path, so you know it's been walked before. You're unable to glean anything beyond that, but you know you're on the right path, but your mother's been gone a long time. Surprising you've even caught wind of this type of an essence lingering.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Any direction of which way the essence might be blowing?

name: MATT
dialogue: It's hard to tell. Make an investigation check. You sense within the mile-- because it's not like blips on a radar, you just generally sense something nearby. In three different directions, elemental presence. Strong elemental presence. You glance up. Very strong elemental presence as all of you can see, about a quarter mile, half mile away, you see there's something drifting in the sky that is burning like a beacon.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's a fire elemental.

name: MATT
dialogue: What did you roll?

name: MATT
dialogue: 16. Glancing about, trying to gather a sense of direction, you look and notice that there's no footsteps. There's no sign of any sort of stepping. The wind that blows through here, and there's a strong wind, and all of you are having to keep your eyes closed and arms up to try and block your vision from the wind. And it is a perpetual difficulty to even just breathe here. Every inhale burns the inside of your lungs.

name: ORION
dialogue: Oh! (pop)

name: MATT
dialogue: There you go. Tiberius has a big old bottle in his mouth now. Like a magical pacifier, and you've got your mask on, which is helping. It is still very hot here, and under all the armor you're wearing, you immediately break into a very heavy sweat. You notice though that, through your investigation and the connection with your mother and the directional sense, while there are no tracks, there are small pools of lava that progress in a pattern, one that would even resemble footsteps of a giant or some sort of large creature.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Let's head that way. Let's follow this lava trail. Looks promising.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We're behind you.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. You guys begin pushing forward, blazing sun bearing down on you, heading towards the direction of these pools of lava, and they scatter a bit, but there is a general direction you are able to follow.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (quietly) There's no way to stealth here, is there? Cover ourselves in ash or something to make us less visible?

name: MATT
dialogue: What are you doing?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Is it possible to cover us in ash and try to make us less visible to the elementals?

name: MATT
dialogue: You can certainly try.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do you have Pass Without a Trace right now?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I do have Pass Without a Trace. I can cast that on us.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. So you cast Pass Without a Trace on the group. As you do, the magic pools, a bunch of the ashes (whoosh) from the ground surround each of you, and there's this gentle cloud of ash that just tends to drift off your body and perpetually replace itself from the surrounding terrain. It does offer you some blanket of visual obscuring from any sort of high vantage point or distant vantage point. Up close, not so much. I'll have all of you guys roll a stealth check. With a plus ten bonus from the spell.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Cloak of Elvenkind is with advantage; would that take place here?

name: MATT
dialogue: It would, yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: With the disadvantage? Because you have heavy armor on.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Let me do it again.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: The feast thing? No?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Natural 20.

name: MATT
dialogue: But you still get the other one, which is still good.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Plus ten, 38.

name: MATT
dialogue: (mocking) Oh, I'm such a rogue. What did you get?

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. As you guys continue moving forward, the wind still buffeting you to the side, you hear this (distant animal screeching). You glance in the distance and you can see, flying through the sky, a very, very large, ancient even, red-scaled draconic beast. For those who are familiar with the training, the Elemental Plane of Fire does seem to be a very prominent home to such dragons as the red. You guys notice this and stop in place and keep low. As time passes, eventually it moves past, heading towards the distant mountain range. Thank god you cast that spell. You wait a little while, until it's out of sight and beyond your vision. You keep pushing forward another 20 to 30 minutes or so through this hellish landscape. The heat is starting to get to you guys. I need everyone to go ahead and make a constitution saving throw.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do I get anything for having my protection from fire?

name: MATT
dialogue: I'll say, give you advantage for this.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: My mask doesn't give me any advantage, does it?

name: MATT
dialogue: Not for heat. This is the general atmospheric heat.

name: MATT
dialogue: You all are feeling the heat starting to get to you, but currently it doesn't seem to be fully affecting you; you get the feeling the longer you stay here, the more it's going to have an effect on you. However, you're still pushing through without a problem. You push on for another ten minutes or so before you come across a few more of these streams of lava, and there, about 20 to 30 feet ahead of you, you see a single stone obelisk that rises out of the ground about 15 feet up, and towards the top you see embedded in it a single, mildly glowing, what looks like a fist- or heart-sized ruby that is embedded into it like a beacon, or a small fiery lighthouse in the center of this open plain.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's pretty.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That looks like a stone spire to me.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well, it's shiny.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's rather shiny, yeah. Let's go there.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. As you guys approach, stepping towards the obelisk, around the back of it, make a perception check.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. So. As you begin to step forward, you instinctively stop as you see figures step out from behind the spire. Three normal humans-- in fact, immediately you recognize stepping from behind it is Cerkonos and two of the other druids that you had accompany you into this. Cerkonos walks towards you, arms still crossed, in front of the spire. You see his wind being blown to the side from the sheer force of the heated winds that are blowing through this barren landscape. He looks about the rest of you. "You've done well. But there is not much time." And he looks off to the side, and you can now see the cinderstorm that was once heading away has changed course and is now making its way in the direction of you and the spire. You can see it's probably about a half a mile to a quarter mile off, and you can see the red arcing bolts of energy floating through it, and it's starting to darken the landscape beneath it. "Show me what it is you've learned." And with that, the form of all three druids suddenly burst into flames and grow in size, Cerkonos becoming astronomically large for even the elementals you've encountered. Everybody roll initiative. (groaning)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, Jesus ballsacks. All right.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, sweet baby Jesus.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Oh, Jesus Ballsacks, who art in heaven.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No. Don't.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Does this make you feel better?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh no.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (giggling) Yes.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: God damn it, Wheaton.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: God damn it, Wheaton. Here.

name: ORION
dialogue: Do you need me to light that on fire again for you?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, it's going.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Got to get my dice in order.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh my god, they're on fire. We have walls!

name: MATT
dialogue: Broken, ruined walls that appear from the landscape. I need... some initiative scores from you guys.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Jeez Louise.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. So we have 25 to 20?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh no.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Crickets. Crickets have 25 to 20.

name: MATT
dialogue: You had 19? All right.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's addictive, isn't it?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, it's fun to say. Thanks, bud.

name: MATT
dialogue: 15 to ten?

name: MATT
dialogue: All right, 15, Tiberius. All right. Ten to five?

name: ASHLEY, TALIESIN
dialogue: Nine.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (laughs) Hi!

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Hi.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Five!

name: MATT
dialogue: All right, who's left?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Five.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I rolled a one.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He rolled a one, too.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We're sitting here like, is this a Cirque du Soleil thing?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We're like, oh cool! It's fire.

name: TALIESIN, MARISHA
dialogue: Burning Man!

name: MATT
dialogue: Top of the round, Cerkonos in his oversized fire elemental form darts forward towards the center (flame sounds). An unnatural pace of movement as the flames seem to flicker and dart and reform at the foot of the rest of the group, at which point he brings his arms in and (roaring flame) releases a torrent of flame that bursts out in a 20-foot radius from him, catching all of you.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We have immunity to what, now?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: She has immunity.

name: MATT
dialogue: Poison, disease, and fright. All right. I need everyone to roll a dexterity saving throw.

name: ORION
dialogue: Hey! Internet! There's my natural one.

name: LAURA, ASHLEY
dialogue: No!

name: ORION
dialogue: Suck it. It happens.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's better.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Stealth. Dexterity. Damn it.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. So. Percy, what did you roll?

dialogue: Down over by the bad lands?

name: MATT
dialogue: Tiberius, you are on the cusp of completing your ritual.

name: ORION
dialogue: Oh, I choose Emon.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. The sigil flashes with arcane energy and opens up. You see a small doorway that's sparkling across the ground.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He's just making the sigil.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We can just pop over to Emon.

name: MATT
dialogue: You can see the sigil shimmering as the energy is beginning to fade.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We should go in.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Let's go!

name: SAM
dialogue: What about the airship? What about Captain Damon?

name: LAURA
dialogue: The airship was only going to take us to Emon, anyway.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I walk right through it and say, Tiberius, where are we going?

name: ORION
dialogue: Emon. I go through, too.

name: SAM
dialogue: Captain Damon--

name: ORION
dialogue: I'll hold it for a minute.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Good thinking, Tiberius!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And I just jump in, woohoo!

name: MATT
dialogue: You all leap through the sigil--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I keep jumping into things.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I like jumping into things. I like leap of faiths. They're exciting.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys find yourself once again in a small, white room. Familiar; the place that was your immediate sigh of relief when you returned from the Underdark.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Guys, it feels good to be home.

name: MATT
dialogue: You push through the doorway, returning once again to the 80-foot circular chamber of white stone, where a vibrant crystal chandelier hangs from the ceiling. There are five other doors around the room, and you are currently in the center of the Traverse Junction within the Alabaster Lyceum.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I mean, we just did this. It wasn't too long ago.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So it's okay, we popped out. Is the same guy there?

name: MATT
dialogue: Indeed. Gatekeeper Xanthus is there waiting for you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: How long have we been gone?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Hold on, Tiberius wants to say something.

name: ORION
dialogue: To explain the travel schematic, it would take us a few days to come back on the airship to this particular area if want to go back to Kraghammer. It would be much more efficient if we teleport, as we have, and take a transport to Kraghammer, which is only north of here, as well, which will only probably take a day, right?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Five days.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh shit, did we leave Trinket?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Trinket is with us.

name: ORION
dialogue: Airship. From here.

name: MATT
dialogue: Oh. It is nearly a week to travel from Emon to Vasselheim in the airship, yes.

name: ORION
dialogue: To Kraghammer?

name: MATT
dialogue: No, to Kraghammer from here, it's about a three-day travel on horseback.

name: ORION
dialogue: Right. The airship, right?

name: MATT
dialogue: There is no airship to Kraghammer.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, but it would have dropped us off in Emon anyway.

name: ORION
dialogue: So we just shaved off five days.

name: SAM
dialogue: Good job, Tiberius.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I pop on out and I say, hello again.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes? Oh, you. You've returned."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes, we have.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, this time, I would like you to fill out the proper paperwork."

name: LAURA
dialogue: This time, of course, you already know ahead of time that we are dear friends of Uriel, and we do not need to.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That is not true. I had my ass chewed out by Headmaster Thurmond the last time you came "through and told me that. So--" and he fumbles underneath his desk-- (boof) slams down what looks to be a cluster of about 20 to 25 papers. "I require you to fill these out so I do not lose my "job here in the Lyceum."

name: LIAM
dialogue: All right, Vax pulls it over and starts filling it out and says, all right, but you know, we're kind of a big deal here--

name: LAURA
dialogue: I was saying, Percy is so good at paperwork.

name: ORION
dialogue: I can split the load.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I thought we had a lawyer for this. I thought we had Burt Reynolds, esquire.

name: ORION
dialogue: We're doing the paperwork.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I've got it, Burt. Just because you didn't like paperwork, or Elven, doesn't mean I don't. I've got it. But Uriel's not going to be pleased.

name: LAURA
dialogue: He's going to be super pissed.

name: LIAM
dialogue: But don't worry, I'll do it.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I look forward to it. Great."

name: ORION
dialogue: Well, there you are, and here's my--

name: SAM
dialogue: Do you have a bathroom around here?

name: ORION
dialogue: Oh, Scanlan, hold it.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Down the hall to the left."

name: SAM
dialogue: All right. I might make it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Vax fills out the entire thing, except for the final signature, and says, Scanlan, could you put the final signature on this?

name: ORION
dialogue: Notarize it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Tiberius is helping.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh boy. Buttoning up my fly. Final signature? I'll just sign my name.

name: LIAM
dialogue: That works, too.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Thank you kindly. You are free to go."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Thank you so much.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh, it's been a pleasure."

name: LAURA
dialogue: A real pleasure.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Very much so, thank you."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Thank you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Thank you."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Thank you so much.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Thank you so much."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Okay, here we go. We'll go out this way.

name: SAM
dialogue: You know what I think? I think you guys hate each other, actually.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Be on your way. Goodbye. Please, leave now. Go."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Emon is so beautiful--

name: SAM
dialogue: Don't worry, I shat in the hallway.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What time of day is it?

name: MATT
dialogue: As you guys leave the Lyceum, you enter the main courtyard that leads into it. You are currently within the Cloudtop District of Emon, a clear blue sky dotted with clouds ahead of you. You gather it's probably around 2:00 or 3:00 in the afternoon. No time has passed, since the travel was instantaneous, thanks to teleportation.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You are so good, you.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Why don't we take a day or two to recuperate and then make our way to Kraghammer?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We are officially drunk in two different cities!

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm not drunk.

name: SAM
dialogue: Is our next destination Kraghammer?

name: ORION
dialogue: Yes. Collect our money.

name: SAM
dialogue: Let's take a night and then go set off in the morning.

name: ORION
dialogue: What time is it right now, in the day?

name: MATT
dialogue: It's about 4PM.

name: ORION
dialogue: Could we ride, maybe? Drunk riding.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well... (whining) We haven't been home in so long.

name: ORION
dialogue: We can go to the keep and say hi to everyone.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I need to water the garden. It's probably half dead.

name: ORION
dialogue: No, we have servants that do that.

name: SAM
dialogue: To the keep!

name: TALIESIN, TRAVIS
dialogue: To the keep.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. You guys make your way through the Cloudtop District to the southern edge of Emon, to the lower slums outside of the city, along the southern wall to Greyskull Keep. The visual is welcoming. It looks standing, clean, and in the distance you can see a figure walking across the top of the wall, keeping watch. As you get closer, you can see it is the image of Cordell, the half-orc individual that you guys hired along with Shayne. As you approach the front gate, you see what looks like a tent: a large, thick burlap or linen, brown tent is set up right outside of you guys'--

name: LIAM
dialogue: That wasn't there before--

name: LAURA
dialogue: What? What is that?

name: SAM
dialogue: Cordell. Cordell! What is this tent?

name: MATT
dialogue: Cordell is looking over the edge as you approach and he gives you a wave. "Hello." And you can see Shayne runs up next to him off the top. She has her crossbow at the ready. She goes, "Oh! "Finally, you've arrived. I'm so glad you could make it. Yes, this has been here for about two "weeks now."

name: SAM
dialogue: Is someone inside of it?

name: MATT
dialogue: At which point, you hear sudden rustling from inside of the tent and a face pops out, briefly. You can see what looks like humanoid features, and suddenly darts back inside. And you hear more rustling. It sounds like pots and metals clinking around.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I immediately go over there and throw open the--

name: MATT
dialogue: As you throw open the tent, at that moment, you see another person is pushing out of the tent. And you both have this awkward moment where you both (awkward noises) and he pushes off of you instinctively and rights himself. The tent half collapses behind him and he catches himself and stands there at the ready. You see before you what looks to be a young man, probably in his late teens, 19 to 20 years old. Haphazardly dressed in scale mail armor, a longsword, crossbow, and handaxe, and buckler all dangling from his belts, weighing him down slightly. His dark brown eyes peer from beneath his short, tousled ash-blond hair. And a nervous yet excited smile flashes across his face. "Oh! You've returned! Ah. You! You, Percival. Percival, the great one who streaks "fire from his tube. And the great druid princess. Keyleth, right? And you. You, the dragonborn who "controls the elements himself. Tiberius of the Stormwind family, yes. Yes, I've heard of you. "Scanlan. Scanlan I've heard your tales across the land. Your womanizing does not reach ears too far "from the city."

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, I'm... Men, too.

name: MATT
dialogue: "And you, the twins. Vax'ildan and Vex'ahlia. Oh, the many bodies you've lain at your "feet of the evil that crossed your path. And the mighty, muscled Grog. Oh, I am beside myself. I've "been waiting for this--"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Grog the Victorious. Get it right.

name: MATT
dialogue: "The Victorious. Yes, of course!"

name: SAM
dialogue: And you are, young man?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I am Kynan Leore, son of Harold the butcher, and I wish to join you in your travels."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, darling! You're so brave and strong.

name: ORION
dialogue: Well, you're welcome to do so--

name: SAM
dialogue: No! No, not at all.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Really? It would be my honor. It really, truly would be."

name: SAM
dialogue: No. This is not an open membership situation. Vox Machina has been together for many years, and we've forged our bonds of friendship--

name: MATT
dialogue: "I can forge my way. I can prove myself."

name: ORION
dialogue: What is your skill, sir?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well. My father, Harold the butcher, is well known throughout these lands."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: For?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Butchering, I believe.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: He's a good butcher. Yep.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, he is an actual butcher in the upper slums. But! I have been training day and night for "months until I was ready to fight alongside you all and I humbly offer my sword "as part of Vox Machina."

name: ORION
dialogue: Ah, your sword?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes, I am a skilled swordsman!"

name: LAURA
dialogue: You are?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I trained under old Leonard Fyke, an ex-guard captain of Emon, himself. "He was a friend of--"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Wait. What was his name? Linen Fyken?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Leonard Fyke. He was once--"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Leonard Fyke.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Leonard Fyke, yes."

name: ORION
dialogue: As he's talking, I motion to open the gates.

name: MATT
dialogue: You hear a shift as Shayne and Cordell begin to pull the top of the gates, the chains clenching. (metal creaking)

name: LIAM
dialogue: Is he talking to Vex? Are they talking together?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm using insight on him as he's talking.

name: MATT
dialogue: Go ahead and roll insight.

name: LIAM
dialogue: How close are they?

name: MATT
dialogue: They're about four feet across.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Four feet apart? I flip a dagger in my hand and I go (impact noise) to the back of his head, is what I do.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Just to knock him out?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah. I did it. It's done.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. Roll an attack.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Don't worry. I'm using the flat end. Oh, good. That's a 17.

name: SAM
dialogue: Plus whatever.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Plus a high number.

name: MATT
dialogue: Oh, you rolled a 17?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: Go ahead and roll sneak attack damage. It's a critical because he hasn't acted.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, but it's the back end of the dagger, all right?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. Go ahead and roll sneak attack times two.

name: ORION
dialogue: I go inside the keep.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And you're touching my dice!

name: LIAM
dialogue: The boy needs a lesson. This is not a life for a child. Okay, that's good.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh Jesus. It's like a million.

name: MATT
dialogue: Times two.

name: LIAM
dialogue: 28 on the sneak attack damage only.

name: MATT
dialogue: Is that times two? Or is it 28 times two?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Oh, times two. So that's--

name: SAM
dialogue: Dead!

name: LIAM
dialogue: No, he's not.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You cleaved his head off with the blunt end of the knife.

name: LAURA
dialogue: If he's a level one, you killed him.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's 56. Just the sneak attack damage alone.

name: MATT
dialogue: And then add the d4 and the modifier for the dagger.

name: LIAM
dialogue: That's ten.

name: MATT
dialogue: So a total of 66 damage.

name: LIAM
dialogue: 66 damage, yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: 66 damage. As you're having this conversation, you (whoosh) behind him and (whack) right to the temple. He's like, "I'm a swordsman. I'm trained. I'm--" (impact noise). And he goes straight down into a pile.

name: LIAM
dialogue: With my bonus action, I pull out one of my remaining healing potions, right? And I shove it in his mouth like this, and it'll go glug-glug-glug down him.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That happened so fast.

name: MATT
dialogue: Eventually he's like, (panting)

name: LAURA
dialogue: Hi, darling.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I take him by the lapels. Things move very fast with us. I don't think you understand what you're asking for. If you think you can handle that--

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh, Vax'ildan." (laughter)

name: SAM
dialogue: This is why he's single.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I've heard of your work for quite some time. Show me your ways."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Illithid, all right? Beholders. Large white dragons. I know it's cool to see her flash her boobs and this one sing a song. It's all excitement and craziness and all the rock and roll that the kids are talking about. But listen to me. It's dangerous. You could die any given day. So could I, so could she, so could him. Maybe not him, but the rest of us, sure. Are you really interested in this?

name: MATT
dialogue: Make an intimidation check.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Why?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Tough love. That's called tough love. It's not bad. That's a ten plus-- can somebody pass me that shit over there?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Plus six.

name: MATT
dialogue: He looks at you for a second. His brow comes together, and you can see there's a quiver to his bottom lip. He goes--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Wait, wait. There. There's his heart breaking.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I thought you were heroes. I waited two weeks to meet you."

name: LAURA
dialogue: How could you do that to him?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Tell me your name again.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Kynan.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It doesn't matter. It doesn't matter at all. You're right." And he puts his hand up and pushes you away. He pulls out of your hands and takes a few steps away and looks over his shoulder. You can see now, there's tears welling up in his eyes. He goes, "I just wanted to be a hero."

name: SAM
dialogue: Wait.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Kynan! Kynan.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Train him up.

name: SAM
dialogue: Send him on a mission.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Come back when you're ready.

name: SAM
dialogue: No, send him on a mission.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Come back when you're ready. Come back again. Train yourself, and I, personally, will be your mentor.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a persuasion roll.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, you'd better roll good because I'm going to be so mad at you if you hurt him.

name: LIAM
dialogue: What's my persuasion? Oh, you passed it down. All right. I make a seven.

name: MATT
dialogue: He looks back at you, and the tears--

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm going to use Luck!

name: MATT
dialogue: All right.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's a 20 on that one!

name: MATT
dialogue: Natural 20?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: He looks at you with the tears welling up in his eyes. He blinks them away for a second. (sniffs) "You mean that?"

name: LIAM
dialogue: I do. You will be my right-hand man. I promise.

name: MATT
dialogue: He looks over at the rest of you. Looks at Percy. Looks at Keyleth. Tiberius isn't there; Tiberius has already walked into the keep. Looks at Scanlan. Looks at Vex'ahlia. Looks at Grog. He grasps the sword that's currently sheathed at his side. "I will. I'll make you proud. I will be Vox "Machina with you. I swear it. I swear it!" He runs back to his tent, and you see him start gathering up his things, and he begins tearing it down, and you can see the tears are still coming, but he's steeled his expression.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I walk over to him. These people can't hear this. I kneel down next to him, and I put my hand on his shoulder and say, I was once like you and didn't know what I wanted or where I was going. I just want you to be ready. We've got some shit to do. When we come back, we'll start over. You're starting from ground zero. Starting from the basement, you'll work your way up. And I promise, I will be ready for you no matter what Mercer throws at me. I promise.

name: SAM
dialogue: Mercer's our god.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Don't question it. And I take him by the hair. Don't question it. Come back. Right on his forehead.

name: MATT
dialogue: He gathers the rest of his tent and things, piles it up, and he's speechless at this point. You can see he's partially torn between wanting to look hard and ready to do this, and also still blown away by the fact that he's even encountered you guys after all this time. He takes the rest of his stuff and holds it in one arm and darts off down the path towards the river, hops over it, and then makes his way towards the rest of Emon and vanishes into the distance.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You know, you might have just sent him to his death.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Why did you have to knock him out?!

name: LIAM
dialogue: To go home and train?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We could have trained him!

name: LIAM
dialogue: We almost died ourselves in that temple, in that pyramid.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You just put expectations in his head!

name: ORION
dialogue: Are they inside yet?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, we're walking inside.

name: LIAM
dialogue: So we should have made him a full-fledged member today, right now?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No, that's not what I'm saying at all.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Make him a butler? He doesn't want to do that.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you guys are having this conversation, you turn into the entrance of the keep, and there standing, arms behind his back, is Tiberius. Serious-faced.

name: ORION
dialogue: I look right at Vax. Why did you do that to that young man?

name: LIAM
dialogue: He wasn't ready!

name: ORION
dialogue: Stop it. It was aggressive beyond necessity. We should have trialed the boy.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That was his trial.

name: ORION
dialogue: That was not a trial!

name: SAM
dialogue: We'll see, if he comes back.

name: ORION
dialogue: You are far more powerful, Vax. You know that. This boy was a fan, at best. We could have put him to work, or something.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do you think he would have been happy with work? I'm not even happy that he told him to go off and continue training. I think telling him to go off and continue training is a bad idea.

name: LIAM
dialogue: He now knows the facts. He knows his skill level. He knows where he stands. He will either go back to being a fishmonger--

name: SAM
dialogue: Son of a butcher.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Son of a butcher, well. Everyone has their own personal path. Or he will come back to me, and if he comes back to me, I will train him. If not, it wasn't meant to be.

name: ORION
dialogue: And if he comes for your head?

name: LAURA
dialogue: He won't.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh, he won't?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'll deal with that, as well.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Did you never see The Incredibles? (laughter)

name: ORION
dialogue: Vax.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes, Tiberius?

name: ORION
dialogue: You and Grog I respect and fear the most out of all of us. You are cunning.

name: SAM
dialogue: What am I, chopped liver?

name: ORION
dialogue: I could crush you in one blow, Scanlan.

name: SAM
dialogue: Let's leave it at that.

name: ORION
dialogue: Vex, I fear you and am slightly attracted to you, as well. Grog and Vax, you are the strongest and most noble and cunning--

name: SAM
dialogue: You live because I let you live. Just needed to say that out loud.

name: ORION
dialogue: You believe what you believe. I'm just saying, when it comes to things, sometimes you really rush into stuff, and stop. Because you could just be chill sometimes. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: At which point, you hear a voice ring out from across the courtyard of the keep. "Ah! You've "all returned!" And you see across the way, Laina, your joyful housekeeper, comes rushing out, arms open to greet you all. You can see there's a little bit of dirt on the front of her apron, like she's been cutting the hedges or doing some sort of garden work. She rushes out and hugs you. "It's "been so long. It's been far too long. It's so good to see all of you."

name: ORION
dialogue: As I see her, I turn to greet, but I want to give Vax a little pinch on the butt. A little friendly pinch.

name: MATT
dialogue: A little tweak. A little dragonborn tweak. "Oh! Sorry, that reminds me. Hold on." And she pulls out a little piece of paper. You recognize it: it's used in various arcane messaging. She pulls out a small quill and dabbles it and starts writing a quick message on it. Closes the lid (fire burst noise). It disappears.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What was that?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm sorry. I was given that, just in case you all returned--"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Who gave you that? What was that?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Seeker Asum Emring of the council. The ranger. He said as soon as you all returned, I'm "supposed to let him know. He had very important business with you."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Maybe for the future, don't do that until we tell you it's okay to do that?

name: SAM
dialogue: Seeker Emring, you said? Of the council of Tal'Dorei?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes."

name: SAM
dialogue: He's an ally.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, he's fine. It's just, maybe we wanted to take a little nap or something.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes, ask us first.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm sorry, I was-- oh. Okay. My apologies. I was given implicit instructions by him."

name: ORION
dialogue: It's all right, we forgive you. I give her a hug. Sorry, I'm very scaly.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh! Ah, it's good to see you, too, Lord Tiberius Stormwind."

name: SAM
dialogue: Could you instruct the security guard-- we can take care of it. We should instruct the security guards: if there's a tent outside the keep, they should just burn it down.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh, that nice boy! I brought him biscuits every morning. He was so sweet, that one."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You brought him biscuits? Oh, she fed the stray. That's adorable.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Do me a favor. Roll up his tent, keep it inside. If he comes back to ask for it--

name: MATT
dialogue: He already rolled up his tent when he took off.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Did he leave anything?

name: MATT
dialogue: There was a couple of small pots and pans and things that he left.

name: LIAM
dialogue: If he comes back, let him in. If I'm not here, let him use my room for as long as he likes, and I'll pay for it.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Okay, it'll be done."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Feeling guilty that you knocked him out, brother?

name: LIAM
dialogue: No, I feel perfectly justified.

name: ORION
dialogue: Oh, you shouldn't.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Can we rest before we go see this ranger?

name: SAM
dialogue: Let's do it.

name: MATT
dialogue: Right. You guys make your way into the keep. Laina immediately rushes off to the kitchen and begins preparing a welcome back meal for all of you. You can smell, after the next ten to 15 minutes pass by, that scent of freshly-cooked meats and baking bread begins to fill the air around Greyskull Keep. The halls are kept nice and warm. It's very clean, and it's a very welcome sight to be back home.
