You take time to rest and exhale and go over the sequence, and as you walk by, you see across the right from the main foyer, you can see a little bit of the light echoing through from the temple of Sarenrae, the stained glass, itself, and for a moment you all take a sad memory of Pike, whereever she is, hopefully to return to you very soon.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's just not home without her.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Here's the thing, Scanlan, how do you look through your poo? Can you look through it anywhere, or is it perhaps from the--

name: SAM
dialogue: If you'd like to. I'm feeling a little bit Pike-sick right now. I could concentrate very hard.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Just concentrate for a moment and see what she's doing.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Would we be able to see, as well?

name: SAM
dialogue: No, I'd have to describe to you what I see.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Tell us what you see. Unless she's naked, in which case, stop looking.

name: SAM
dialogue: Of course, I would definitely stop looking if I saw her naked in front of my poo. Definitely.

name: MATT
dialogue: Are you...?

name: SAM
dialogue: Sure, I'm going to try to scry through my poo.

name: MATT
dialogue: You sit down and close your eyes and begin to concentrate, and as you begin to focus your energy, the sense of the arcane mind itself has gathered between the center of the head and the center of the chest. You begin to join these in the center, and your consciousness begins to glide downward towards your bowels. Eventually, you find a point of connection and you feel your vision transcending this single point on the prime material plane. You are brought through the small channel across the astral sea to connect, and suddenly your vision takes place. What looks like a cluster of dirt to one side and a darkened chamber that is lit by a series of torches. Before you, you see, still and slightly muddled, the Temple of Sarenrae as partially uncovered. You can see the large stone archway that is the front of the partially collapsed temple. You can see now there is stone being brought down the wooden staircase, and it is being used to slowly build up and reconstruct what was once a beautiful and very well-revered structure. You can see in the distance a small, white-haired gnome figure that is currently acting as foreman for this whole construction process and is giving orders and shouts to the other individuals here. Glancing about, you see her step over, and one person trips and drops a stone, and she walks up to them and takes them by the shoulder and lifts them back up and gives them a little hug, and then picks up the stone and carries it with them over to where it belongs on the side of one of the walls.

name: SAM
dialogue: She should fire that person, but okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: A few more moments pass and you gather that this is a slow-moving, but a consistent moving, renovation of the temple of Sarenrae, based on the limited number of people that she has at her disposal to help with the process. But it seems to be going well.

name: SAM
dialogue: (gasps)

name: LAURA
dialogue: What did you see?

name: SAM
dialogue: She was definitely naked.

name: ORION
dialogue: Really?

name: SAM
dialogue: No, she was supervising her crew in a fair, but firm way. She was just being Pike: driven, radiant, beautiful, and empowered by the spirit of Sarenrae. She's everything that we think of her and more. She's beautiful and charming. Let's just let it be known that I could kill Tiberius if I wanted to. Just going to say that.

name: ORION
dialogue: It's fine. Yes, you can, Scanlan.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes. I mean, that's beside the point. Pike was glorious and wonderful and confident, and I miss her so much. I hope from time to time I can look in on her.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Anytime you want.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Look through your shit.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, it's really any bodily fluid, I believe. I could piss. I could barf.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Ooh! Any time ever?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Is this real? Is it a real thing? Is it real? He can do this?

name: MATT
dialogue: There is a gradual fade to the effect.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm raising my flask, and I say: To Pike.

name: ALL
dialogue: To Pike.

name: LIAM
dialogue: The best in all of us.

name: SAM
dialogue: She really was, and is.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Our own little inspirational poster, inside each and every one of us.

name: SAM
dialogue: She's not little, but yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you all drink, a familiar voice echoes from across the hallway.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Pike?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Your food is ready, everyone." (groaning) And you see Erwen Dastell, your elderly halfling manservant, is there standing in his attire, smiling, happy to see you all. "Laina would like you all to know that your meal is "ready. This way, please."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Thank you, Erwen.

name: MATT
dialogue: He leads you to the dining hall. The food is already prepared, and you sit down to eat. The meal is very welcome; it's the best food you've had in a while. Comparable to Southern comfort food. There's gravy, biscuits-- it's beautiful.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Fried chicken.

name: MATT
dialogue: (chuckles) It's delightful. A little ways into the meal, you can see Cordell steps into the room and glances in for a second. "I am sorry to interrupt, but we have a visitor."

name: SAM
dialogue: Is it a councilor from Tal'Dorei?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It is. The halfling."

name: ORION
dialogue: Invite him in for dinner.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Does he want some fried chicken?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I could ask."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Tell him if he's okay with us being a little tipsy.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Still?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, I figured we just kept going.

name: MATT
dialogue: A moment goes by, and you see Seeker Asum Emring arrives at the doorway. He's wearing dark, looks like studded leather armor, a very deep green cloak about his shoulders. Even at the council meetings, he's dressed for utility. He seems to be that individual who has his eye in many places in the room at once; he's a ranger by trade, and paranoid by nature. His head is shaved bald, and he has tattoos across one side of his halfling face. As he walks in, he gives a swift bow and says to everyone, "Greetings. I'm sorry to interrupt your meal. I was notified that you have "arrived, and I have business I would like to discuss, if you have a moment."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (groans) Is it bad news? We're not in the mood for bad news.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm all right. It's not bad news, it's just something I wanted to run by the rest of you."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Please feel free to speak.

name: MATT
dialogue: He steps and finds a chair at one of the nearby tables, clustered towards the center, where you guys have pushed your dining tables together. "Now, while you were gone, a venture has "been put into motion. In celebration of the agreed-upon construction of a grand bridge across "the Shearing Channel to the eastern continent of Wynandia, a dinner is being held here within a "week. This venture is helmed by one Lord and Lady Briarwood of Whitestone, as the bridge would be "set at the edge of the Alabaster Sierras. They are probably en route as we speak. The bridge shall "open trade routes with the kingdom of Wildmount across the way. I'm here because few things escape "my eye. Percival, when last we were company, you had shifted so very uncomfortably at the mention "of these two. May I ask why?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Had I? I hadn't noticed.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, I did."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I have had dealings with them before. I find them... untrustworthy.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I have my reservations, as well. My network has been watching their acquisition of Whitestone "since the de Rolo family fell to disease, and there are far more questions than answers. I've "sent operatives to inquire, but each has sent me a letter of resignation instead of choosing to stay "within Whitestone under my employ. Now, our sovereign requested that I extend an invitation to this "coming dinner-- per your request to him, Percy-- to you, Vox Machina. I am here to ask if you will "attend, and if so, if I can trust you to keep an eye while I do my work."

name: LAURA
dialogue: What say you, Percy?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It's Percy's call.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (sighs) Yes, we will attend.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Very good. I will contact you in the next few days and shall discuss further. Until then, "enjoy the rest of your meal, and thank you." He sits up from his seat.

name: SAM
dialogue: We're having bread pudding for dessert.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm good, thank you."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Wait, when did you say this dinner was taking place?

name: MATT
dialogue: "In about a week, they should be arriving."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Excuse me. I have a bit of work to do downstairs.

name: SAM
dialogue: Can we go to Kraghammer in that?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Seven days in a week or in a week, like five days?

name: MATT
dialogue: "They are expected to arrive in the next five to seven days. The dinner is set for seven to "eight days from now."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Got it.

name: SAM
dialogue: Thank you for your information.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Of course. We shall discuss further."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Percy--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I've already gone.

name: ORION
dialogue: Oh, what is the attire for the event?

name: MATT
dialogue: "As formal as one may muster. If you do not have suitable attire, it will be provided, but "please do notify the council."

name: SAM
dialogue: I could lend you one of my jackets.

name: ORION
dialogue: I'd like to see what they propose.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I don't really do formal, so?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Don't worry, Grog. We have a wonderful tailor.

name: LIAM
dialogue: The fancy clothes in the bag.

name: LAURA
dialogue: In your Bag of Holding.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We've got like two left, and they wouldn't fit me.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You can figure this out amongst yourselves. I have business to attend to. Have a good night."

name: LIAM
dialogue: We'll be there. Thank you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Of course." And with that, he turns around and leaves. He's one of those individuals where as he walks away, and this catches your eye in particular, for a moment you have to admire the fact that he takes naught but two steps and for a second, you swear he was walking, he had about 15 feet to the door, and he's just gone.

name: LAURA
dialogue: He's good.

name: MATT
dialogue: And with that, we shall end this week's session. (groaning)

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, but I want to talk to Percy!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I know! Percy just ran off to the basement, to his workshop.

name: MATT
dialogue: We'll pick up directly from this moment next week.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Guys, I feel like we need to have a conversation with Percy.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, that needs to happen.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (screams) (laughter)

name: LIAM
dialogue: So, Percy, do you want to strike off in a random direction and just go and go and go?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: So, that money that we're owed. Why don't we do that? I think we have time for that.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Maybe we could send an errand-boy to get it?

name: SAM
dialogue: We're back, guys. We're back! [end of captions]

name: MATT
dialogue: Hello, everyone, and welcome to tonight's episode of Critical Role, where a bunch of us nerdy-ass voice actors play Dungeons and Dragons. I think this is our 24th episode, which is ridiculous. We've been doing this since March, and it gets more and more ridiculous every week. Glad you guys can join us. The new guys, welcome to our chaos. For all the old folks, glad you could come and join us again. Quick thing I want to mention: last week we were talking about the changes to Critmas, because we had stresses on scheduling and we had crew here, and when things go long, we were talking about possibly moving to Periscope on a different day, separate medium. Well, the fanbase has spoken very loudly and very intently about their reaction to that, and so what we're doing, to still make it so people aren't kept here for ridiculous hours weekly, we're still going to have Critmas on the stream, but it's going to be once a month. It's probably going to be the first Thursday of every month, and we're going to make it an extensive day for that month where we open everything that evening. We still get to experience and share that with you guys, but also not keep these guys here way too late unpaid every Thursday night. So I think that's the plan we're going with forward. Hopefully, that's cool with everyone, because we love it, too, and we want to make sure we still share that with you guys. All right, couple of other announcements. First and foremost, I wanted to mention again-- we mentioned it last week, as well-- there's that Hasbro game design contest, design the next party game. That's still up until end of this month, I believe. So if you want to check it out, you can go ahead and tweet at me, last week's episode or search for the Hasbro game design contest. That's still happening. Also, there's a film series that I'm a part of called Mythica. It's like a high fantasy film series where I play the main villain, the necromancer Zorloc. It's fun times. It's like awesome, fun, fantasy genre film. And they're currently putting up a Kickstarter to finish the post on the third film, so you should check that out. Search Mythica on Kickstarter and you should find it there. Also, WeLoveFine is still running their DND t-shirt contest for their Rage of Demons release for Wizards of the Coast, where you can submit your own t-shirt designs that fit within the Rage of Demons theme. I am one of the judges on that, so if you submit your art to this, there is a cash prize. All the rules are up there on the WeLoveFine contest site. And I'll be able to judge your artwork and hopefully put you through to the end. So there's that. Trying to get through these as fast as possible. Our TeeSpring shirt for Is It Thursday Yet? is still up. It has one more week. So if any of you guys want to get the limited edition Critical Role Is It Thursday Yet? shirt, that is only available for one more week and then it'll be gone forever, so get it while you can. Let's see. I'm doing my best to get through this as fast as possible. No worries. Not everything. Also, Ashley's show Blindspot is premiering this coming Monday. (cheering) Which is so exciting. You can check out Ashley on Blindspot where she'll maybe be sneaking Critical Role stuff into the show, hopefully. We're trying to push her to do that. So you should go support her. See it. It's awesome. And all of us lament that's the reason she's away from us. Someone want to handle our other cool--

name: LAURA
dialogue: But it's not on us yet. Oh look, now you can see us.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Why don't I go, and then you can go. Hey, you guys. I just want to make sure all of you are aware-- this is going to be so awkward-- I want to make sure you're all aware of a Kickstarter that's out there that is put up by a good friend of mine named Joe Madureira. Now if you don't know who Joe is, he is a comic book rock god and a game developer. When I was a teenager, he made a comic book called Battle Chasers. Look, here's mine. From when I was 16, Joe. I fell in love with it. Nobody does art like Joe Mad does, and I've followed his art for years and years. Even when I fell out of comic books, I was checking in with Hellboy and I was checking in with Joe Mad. And then, years later, I got cast in a game called Darksiders as one of the Horsemen of the Apocalypse. I played War, and I walked into the room and Joe Mad was in the fucking room, and then we became friends. So that game was amazing. Darksiders is a beautiful game. It just reeked of Joe's art style and now he has formed another company called Airship Syndicate and they have a Kickstarter up. They are making a game called Battle Chasers. Oh shoot! I didn't put the thing that comes-- oh, Nightwar! Battle Chasers: Nightwar. They've already hit their goal, but there are stretch goals. They are making an RPG, sort of in the ilk of JRPGs, like Final Fantasy and Chrono Trigger. And it's just going to be bathed in the glory of Joe Mad's amazing art style. So they've hit their goal, but the bigger the budget, the better the game is going to be. I backed it already. And you guys should at least go check it out. A lot of love for Joe Mad.

name: ORION
dialogue: Yeah, me too. I'm on the same end. I knew Joe Mad through meeting Liam for a while, and later realizing that this guy I knew as an amazing voice director and an amazing producer has inked some of my favorite issues of Excalibur, and I crapped my pants. I have four of yours, Joe, in my box right now at home. He's an amazing guy and awesome thing to back. Check it out, please.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And one, the main character from Battle Chasers kind of looks like Pike!

name: LAURA
dialogue: She does! I thought that, too.

name: MATT
dialogue: That's sweet. Wunderbar!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I got something. Next weekend, September 26 and 27, I'm going to be at a con! In Anchorage, Alaska.

name: ORION
dialogue: That means "convention".

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That means moose. I'm so excited. Senshi Con in Anchorage. I'll be there. I know we at least have, like, three fans at the very least in Alaska. Come on by. I'd love to see you. It'll be awesome.

name: MATT
dialogue: Fantastic. Speaking of conventions, guys.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh man, drop it like it's hot.

name: MATT
dialogue: For those of you upper East Coast folks, we've recently been able to announce that we will be at and running some events at New York Comic Con in October. All of us, the entire Critical Role team will be at Comic Con. We're going to have signing, panel and all kinds of fun stuff throughout the weekend. And we'll be there. And if you're in the area, or if it's drivable, or even if it's not, you should come anyway, cause we'd like to see you. If it's trainable, if it's flyable.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: If you steal a horse, steal a horse and ride it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: If you want to ride a bear there, I wouldn't judge you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And what weekend is New York Comic Con?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Eight, nine, ten, 11.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: October 8th, 9th, 10th and 11th. So you've got three weeks to prepare.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, so excited to be there. Excited to see you there. And it'll be a lot of fun. A lot of fun.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Primarily doing stuff Saturday that we know. We're waiting to see what's going on Sunday weekend.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Saturday is for sure.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: With more of us than are even here.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Bring your swag. Bring your friends.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Not even all of us were at San Diego. Well, we were all there, just not all at one point at one time.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Because we were missing Sam.

name: MATT
dialogue: The first full Critical Role con appearance. Boom.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: The unicorn appears.

name: ORION
dialogue: I'm going to get a hot dog.

name: MATT
dialogue: Orion's going to get a hot dog. Awesome. Any other announcements? Or did you have something, you said?

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, I was just so excited about New York Comic Con, I wanted to be a part of that announcement.

name: ORION
dialogue: I would like to announce that I feel pretty good.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm terrified, personally, but--

name: ORION
dialogue: I know, but maybe that's why I feel so good.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You were right. It is awful.

name: ORION
dialogue: I'll get shunned for it happening, then I'm like, oh, cool. I don't have to worry about me right now.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So much pressure.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Should we say that we have Kit here?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, we shouldn't tell them that we have Kit here. Let's hold that back.

name: MATT
dialogue: Kit Buss is not here.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We also have both of our artists here.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Kit and Wendy.

name: MATT
dialogue: Kit and Wendy.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Kit and Wendy. Come here! But come here!

name: RYAN
dialogue: There's a 30-second lag.

name: MATT
dialogue: We'll eventually have them say hello to everyone, but Kit Buss, our official CritRole artist who did all the original character designs, continues to produce amazing art for this show, is here visiting Los Angeles for the next week. So she's here on the set and we'll drag her out in front of the camera and embarrass her shortly.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I've been curious precisely how long the lag is, because--

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's about 30 seconds.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We learned when we killed the carpet.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah. (muffled yelling)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Just time that. Time that.

name: MATT
dialogue: I guess also an announcement for all you League players out there: awesome character just got announced called Kindred. Kind of a two-part thing. That wolf that's the part of Kindred sounds pretty cool so you should play it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I heard that. It's subtle.

name: MATT
dialogue: Real subtle. It's a good one. I think that's it, isn't it? I think we're good on announcements, and we can start.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I feel like we have, do we have an address? Address?

name: MATT
dialogue: Oh, the PO Box?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Do we have that?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It's up. Yeah, he's got it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's up and in the chat?

name: RYAN
dialogue: The mods are posting it in the chat.

name: MATT
dialogue: The mods got that covered. Now diverting all Critmas images and the boxes, and we have arrived. Our nefarious Scanlan--

name: SAM
dialogue: Whoa. Were you just talking about me?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah!

name: SAM
dialogue: Whoa, that's crazy. I was just talking about me, too.

name: MATT
dialogue: As was the website, because your interview went up today.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, that's right. I saw. Some of that I had my ghostwriter write for me. I have a biographer and a ghostwriter.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Is that a ghostwriter on retainer that we can also use?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, sure.

name: MATT
dialogue: Good to know. Well, fantastic. Do you have any announcements you want to make, Sam, or shall we jump in?

name: SAM
dialogue: No. Just that I don't have any dice but I can use Orion's and they're going to be awesome.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I have so many dice. Take this giant bag and just fish some out.

name: SAM
dialogue: Great. Thanks.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The Bag of Disagreeable Dice.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, let him find them.

name: MATT
dialogue: All righty, then in just a minute, let us begin this next episode of Critical Role. [dramatic music] Welcome back. All right, so to give you guys a little heads-up of what has recently transpired in the story. The party, after completing their business in the city of Vasselheim, on the far-off northwest continent. Grog, of course, having an epic battle in the Crucible fight pit against Kern, reclaiming his honor.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (singing) I am the champion, my friends.

name: MATT
dialogue: Pike left back there to finish up the renovation of the temple of Sarenrae that was discovered. The rest of the party moved on back to Emon, the rest of their business complete. Within Emon, they returned to Greyskull Keep, where they encountered a fan, apparently, of Vox Machina, that had been camping for two weeks outside, who was promptly bludgeoned in the temple by Vax to teach him a lesson. Brought back from the brink, and taught that hard lesson-- that this is a dangerous field-- managed to seemingly reach out and touch the heart of this young, intrepid, wannabe adventurer to possibly try and better himself before he throws himself into danger's way. And he ran off to train harder.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Dagger, dagger, hug.

name: MATT
dialogue: Indeed. Upon returning to the keep, notice was sent off to one of the other members of the Council of Tal'Dorei, Seeker Asum, who is the halfling head of whispers and all sorts of subterfuge across the countryside, who came to you notifying you that within a week's time, the Briarwoods, Lord and Lady Briarwood, are supposed to be arriving here within Emon for a feast to discuss building a bridge and a more political joining between Emon, the Tal'Dorei royal family, and these up-and-coming lords and ladies, who have a very dark history with Percy's character. You've been asked to join as part of this feast as you previously requested with sovereign Tal'Dorei, that should anything involved the Briarwoods that you be included. You have a week to figure out what you want to do in advance of that. And that is where we left off.

name: ORION
dialogue: What time of the day is it?

name: MATT
dialogue: Right now, after this discussion, you guys' arrival, I'd say it's probably mid-afternoon. First things first, though, after this discussion with Seeker Asum, who leaves the keep, you do have a brief moment of awkward silence as most of the people that work within your keep turn to you. Laina looks about the rest of you and goes, "By the way, we've been working here for about six "weeks on the pay of four. We're coming close to our next pay scheme, and you tend to leave "often and for extended periods of time. We would also like to be paid, if possible."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Most definitely, dear. Yes. We are definitely going to pay you. Does anybody remember how much we are supposed to pay them?

name: ORION
dialogue: Pardon, what is the total of the staff's payment?

name: MATT
dialogue: She thinks to herself for a moment, at which point you see Erwen, the elderly servant in the back says, "Actually, you had previously said it was both of our services was 50 gold each for the "month. And if I recall, the other mercenaries or guardians that you've hired to watch the walls of "the keep were at a discussed 100 gold for the month's wages. Each."

name: LAURA
dialogue: And how many of those guys do we have?

name: MATT
dialogue: "You currently have five on your payroll, yes. 600 gold pieces total per month for the "services for everyone keeping your keep."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Tell you what, I will front this from my personal funds for this month. Just because we don't have enough in the party funds to cover that.

name: SAM
dialogue: We don't have 600 gold?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We do not!

name: SAM
dialogue: Who's our treasurer?!

name: LAURA
dialogue: I am, but you bitches keep spending money!

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'll go halfsies.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Halfsies? Lovely. Twinsies will pay halfsies. Here you go! 300 for each.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Thank you so much. I'll make sure this gets to the appropriate individuals immediately. "They'll be very happy to not have to walk away. "

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes, don't worry, you will always be paid from Vox Machina.

name: MATT
dialogue: Erwen steps in. "And by the way, if you do intend to leave for an extended period of time "again, I would recommend perhaps paying that in advance. There was a bit of unrest last time."

name: SAM
dialogue: Should we pay another month?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Not yet. Not just yet.

name: ORION
dialogue: I'll pay him in advance right now, just to get it out of the way. 600, out of here, phew, there you go.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Very well, sire! I shall disseminate this amongst the others."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Traditionally, the head of the house does dispense out the stipends anyway. That would be appropriate. I'm not even in the room, am I? Never mind! Sorry.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, you're down in the workshop.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can I go find Percy?

name: MATT
dialogue: You can.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Actually, we should all go find Percy. We should all talk to Percy.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Thank you kindly, Tiberius. Thank you." And he wanders off and begins counting out change into a smaller purse.

name: ORION
dialogue: When they start to go, I'd like to go to the temple with the sigils and talk to the guy who runs the place.

name: MATT
dialogue: Oh, you mean the Lyceum?

name: ORION
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, the Alabaster Lyceum.

name: ORION
dialogue: Yeah, because I learned something new this week and I was like, I'm dumb. But that's where I would like to head.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. So you make your way towards the Alabaster Lyceum. The rest of you head down into Percy's workshop. So you head around the outskirts of the inner portion of the keep itself, down the stairway that leads to the basement floor, which contains a small cell, like a holding cell that you had constructed for you in case you had somebody to take prisoner at some point. To the right. To the left of you, there's a small turning hallway that leads to the workshop. The workshop contains a series of various tools, workbenches. It actually has a working forge, with anvil and various blacksmithing tools. And as you guys come down, the heat is already blasting from it, and you can see Percy madly diving into work of some kind.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What are you doing, Percy? You making more mousetraps? Guess not.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm a bit busy. I am making more ammo. I'm working on a few projects that have been rolling around in my head for quite some time now.

name: ORION
dialogue: (whispers) Don't forget the bolt.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The bolt is on the list, yes.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Quite the worker.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I've got a lot to do.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes. Darling...

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: How many of you are down here right now?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I think we're all here. I'm moving through his stuff.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I let Trinket forage around the courtyard, so he's not down here at the moment.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I think we need a little history lesson here--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Grog, don't touch that!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Why not? But it moves!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Don't touch anything.

name: ORION
dialogue: Matthew, I took some fine meats before I left and I'm feeding them to Lockheed along the way.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Lockheed enjoys them thoroughly. They're delicious. Comfort food crafted by the finest of cooks in Greyskull Keep.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Percy, it's hard not to clearly notice that you're quite distressed, and we're concerned. And you know, we were talking about it-- not that we were talking about you or anything, behind your back or anything-- but we never really found out why you were in that prison cell when we found you.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We've never questioned it before. We've never wanted to make you uncomfortable. But we're about to walk into a party, and I feel like we need a bit of a history lesson.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Ugh. I know you're right. (sighs)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Should we guess? Was it public nudity?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: A bit. I've never had to say this out loud before. I've never actually had this discussion with anyone.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's okay. It gets better.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Do I get an inspiration die for that?

name: MATT
dialogue: I'll give you a d6 inspiration die. (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The Briarwoods, Lord and Lady Briarwood, are responsible for the death of my entire family. Whitestone was my home. Many years ago-- I don't want to get into the details. I came from a big family. I came from a proud family. One night, they were invited into our home, and over the course of that night, they slaughtered everybody. They are evil. They are corrupting. The few survivors of Castle Whitestone who did survive only survived through deceit and by working for the Briarwoods, turning on their masters. Thankfully, the de Rolo family still has standing elsewhere, and there's other branches of the family other than my father's. (sighs) I was lost for quite a while after that happened. I had nothing else in my life other than my family. I was never really going to inherit anything. I was not going to run anything. I was idle. And at some point, I made the decision that, if nothing else, I survived to, maybe, extract some vengeance. Maybe set something right. Maybe stop whatever it was that they were doing. I don't know. There was one of their party, Dr. Ripley. She was in charge of something during the murder. I don't know what. I chased her. I chased her down. It took a year, and I had my gun, and I discovered where she was and where she was working on some ruins, and I approached her. I never even saw her face. Her guards captured me, beat me up. Didn't even bother taking my things. They just threw me in that dungeon. I never even got close enough to see her face.

name: SAM
dialogue: You know her name, but you've never seen her before?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I saw her when she was interrogating me in my home.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, so you could recognize her.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh yes.

name: LAURA
dialogue: How did you get away when they-- with the rest of your family?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: My sister Cassandra, my younger sister. She somehow evaded capture. I don't know how. She set me free. I don't know what became of her. I don't know what became of any of my siblings. Probably nothing reasonable. Nothing good.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You witnessed none of these deaths?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I saw bodies of a few of them. It's all a bit shady. It's all a bit of a blur.

name: SAM
dialogue: How many years ago was this?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (sighs) Four now. Five now.

name: LAURA
dialogue: If you know that they murdered your family, how are they still part of society?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't know. (sighs) I could have gone home. I could have gone home at any point, at this point. I'm scared.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Did they take over Whitestone? Are they still there?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I discovered approximately a week ago that they're still at Whitestone.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Will they recognize you?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't know.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: And these pricks are in good standing with the council?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (sighs) I don't know what to do. I'm preparing for anything. When I got thrown into that dungeon, I came to the realization that maybe I wasn't doing this the right way. I wasn't being responsible, and I prayed to whatever it is I pray to that maybe I would have a sign of what I should be doing, and then there you were. I've been trusting that Vox Machina will take me where I need to go, and maybe what I need to do is confront this, but I don't know what this is, and I'm terrified.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And the remains of your family, were they killed by the sword?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't know. There was an interrogation. Dr. Ripley was asking questions. I assumed, for all these years, that that's what became of my family.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What was she asking questions about? What did they want? Was it just a political coup?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Asking questions about the castle, about things about the castle. It was a long time ago, and I was not equipped for torture. I don't remember much.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Do you want them dead?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think so.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Should we interrogate them first? Find out more about your family?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Or just skip ahead to the dead part?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I put down my gun, and I turn the barrel, and of the six barrels, five of them have names, and Lord and Lady Briarwood are two of those names. Dr. Ripley is another.

name: SAM
dialogue: What are the other ones?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Sir Stonefell is the other, and Professor Anders is the other, and then there's one blank one.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Are they all members of the same party? They travel with the Briarwoods?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't know.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Wait, what were the names? The Briarwoods, Ripley, Sir Kerrion Stonefell. Who is he?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: He was the captain of their guard.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And Professor Anders? Who's that?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Professor Anders was my teacher. He was my tutor, and he was in collusion with them, and he was the one that I believe allowed them to take the castle in the night.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And do you remember why they were invited to Whitestone to begin with?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They were traveling. They were on the road. It was my brother Julius and my sister Vesper who handled matters of court. I was studying. I didn't think.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And how many brothers and sisters do you have?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I had six.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You might have six. We don't know what happened to them.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You said you saw a few bodies of family?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's all very much a blur. (sighs) There's things you just forget.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, this is certainly tragic, but looking forward, what do we know of this meeting? Event? Party? What are we doing?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, I think we need to do some spying.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, do they know Percy's among us?

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's the thing. I don't know if they do.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You don't have to get involved in this.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, we are so involved.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (laughing) Yeah, we do. You said you want them dead.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We've got your back, darling.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Percival, you don't really have a choice in the matter. My sister and I know a little piece of your pain. I'm not going to get into it, but there's nothing she and I can do. We can find reparations for you. We will.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Percy, is this what you want?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There's only one way to find out.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: SAM
dialogue: And if we kill them, how much will you pay us? Just kidding. We ask other people that.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Something I do need to know. Percy. If we see them, and we're not ready to show our faces, will you be able to contain yourself?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think so.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And would they be able to recognize your face?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Which is why I was planning on-- I know we have a cap of disguise.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh! We do.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Scanlan has it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't even know if they would recognize me. My hair was different.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Less purple?

name: SAM
dialogue: We could go into town, and find you a bushy mustache. It's worked for me many times.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't think I wear one as well as you do.

name: LIAM
dialogue: How does that cap work?

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, that cap is more of a hat. While wearing this hat you can use an action to cast Disguise spell. Oh. Cast a Disguise spell? Do you have to be a spellcaster to use it?

name: MATT
dialogue: You do not have to, no.

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I see a shiny tool. I don't know what it does.

name: MATT
dialogue: You reach over and grab it, and it's a large set of tongs, used for gripping large, heavy pieces of metal, either for the actual forge itself, or to bend and manipulate on the workbench.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I take it (yawns) and put it in the Bag of Holding.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a sleight of hand check.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Stealing from the workshop that you partially own?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: There are lots of cool stuff in there! What was the check?

name: MATT
dialogue: Sleight of hand.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Where's sleight of hand-- 17!

name: LAURA
dialogue: My passive perception is 21.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, this could be funny, let this happen.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I give him the evil eye.

name: MATT
dialogue: She gives you the evil eye.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It hurts. I put it back.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Out of curiosity, what did you pick up, what did it look like?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It was a big thing of tongs. I didn't know what it did, I just wanted it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: A big thing of tongs? What would I have to roll to find out if it was covered in some basic sulfuric acid? If it was one of the things I was using for casting.

name: MATT
dialogue: Ah, interesting. You know your tools very well in your workshop, and yeah, the metal is scarred and pockmarked from use with the various corrosive chemicals.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That'll take about ten minutes to take effect. All right. (gasping)

name: ORION
dialogue: Stupid.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You're not there.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well this Hat of Disguise, Percival, it requires some attunement. I don't know how capable you are with magical items.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I can find out.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We got seven days. I can make you look like anything. I can talk to the right people and get you the right paperwork and you can be anyone and no one will know a fucking difference.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Calm down there.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I can forge paperwork, as well.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh yes, he can. He's actually the guy we go to.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He is that guy you meet on the corner of Sandy Alley.

name: SAM
dialogue: I can make us all into birds.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are we supposed to go meet with the council right away?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, in a week.

name: SAM
dialogue: What do we do in the week? Prepare. Recon?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We can do things. How long of a ride is it to Kraghammer?

name: MATT
dialogue: To Kraghammer, on horseback? It's about two and a half days.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Solo style, if you're fast, and back?

name: MATT
dialogue: Fast and back? I'd say just under two days, probably.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: How about the giant eagle flies?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, what if you're flying?

name: MATT
dialogue: I'd say, well, the horse is probably a little bit faster than the eagle.

name: LAURA
dialogue: But you don't have to stick to the road as an eagle.

name: MATT
dialogue: I'd say it'd put you there about the same pace, about two days on eagle, because you can just go straight through. I mean, you want to take the road because you know that there's a lot of dangerous things that wander the wild that are between there.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What do you think? Is it stupid to go and ride hard and try to get there and back before--?

name: SAM
dialogue: Wait, we're going to get cash and come back?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We don't all have to go. A couple of us can make a fast ride.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Tiberius is working on it, I have a feeling deep down inside.

name: ORION
dialogue: (laughs) Why would you say that?

name: MATT
dialogue: You know I deduct points for metagaming.

name: ORION
dialogue: I didn't do anything!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I agree we should send someone for the money. I agree.

name: SAM
dialogue: And it won't take us a whole week to prepare for this party. All we need is a couple disguises.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, but we need to do research. You barely know who the Briarwoods are.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We don't know if these people are straight up gangster, or if there's something supernatural, seriously supernatural, about them. That hat would probably work on 80% of people, but I don't know. We don't know anything about them.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, they're not going to recognize any of us, are they?

name: SAM
dialogue: We could go do some recon.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Besides, have we seen all the brothels in Emon? I don't think so.

name: SAM
dialogue: We should do some research, some reconnaissance while someone goes for the money.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Or should we wait? I really want the money.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: People get married in my family for money. I think it's perfectly reasonable.

name: SAM
dialogue: Listen, we could all go get the money and be back in four days, right?

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, because some people need to do some work. We need to send some people off.

name: SAM
dialogue: Split the party?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Hopefully be back in time.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There's four days. We can each do our part. Five days.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Keyleth, can you-- Kiki.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes? Sorry.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Can you and Scanlan fly to Kraghammer?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes. I would like to stop and talk to Gilmore first, though, before I leave. Do I have time for that? I can fly.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Our illustrious god just told us it's better to stick to the road because there's bad things--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: In the air? There's air traffic? I have to worry about air traffic?

name: MATT
dialogue: By horseback, you want to stick to the road. By air--

name: SAM
dialogue: By air, though. Check yourself, Kiki--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What?

name: SAM
dialogue: You, I would assume, use Polymorph as I do.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No, I use my Beast Shaping.

name: SAM
dialogue: Ooh. That's so sexy. Does that last for longer than a day?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It lasts as long as I want it to last.

name: SAM
dialogue: Damn!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I go up to the kitchen and look for something to eat.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's in my blood.

name: SAM
dialogue: You can be an animal as long as you want?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Where are you going with this, Scanlan?

name: MATT
dialogue: You can stay in Beast Shape for a number of hours equal to half your druid level. Five hours right now, you can transform for.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So when I mean as long as I want, I mean, long enough to where I've never had to really think about it before now.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well then, like me, flying there would not be an option. We'd have to stop, rest, walk, sleep.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, that would slow it down a lot.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, I could get ten hours, because I can use two Beast Shaping abilities.

name: LAURA
dialogue: But that's still a two days' flight--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Two days is the horse, riding hard. What about an eagle?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No, I get my druid shapes back after a short rest.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, okay.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Because Circle of the Moon, bitch.

name: MATT
dialogue: So you could Beast Shape twice, rest 30 minutes, Beast Shape twice.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can I make a stop first, and then I'll run an errand?

name: LIAM
dialogue: We don't really have a lot of money at the moment.

name: LAURA
dialogue: She might have some.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, I've got my personal fundsies.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Can you leave me an earpiece so that I can keep in contact? I'm not leaving my workshop.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I have an earpiece, right?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We'll leave you alone, Percy. To work.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Is there anything else you need from us, Percy? Is there anything you need while I'm out and about?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Leave me an earpiece, and I'll call if I need anything else.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Percy, is there anything in this shop that you want in the Bag of Holding for later?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Not yet. Thank you, Grog.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Do you not have an earpiece?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'll give him mine.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: How many minutes has it been? I'm wondering if his hands are starting to itch yet.

name: MATT
dialogue: About this time, you start to get this weird tingling sensation around your fingers.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Do they crave blood?

name: MATT
dialogue: No, they crave some sort of an agent that will prevent the now slight burning sensation.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Ow. Quick question. Sorry, I kept something from falling in the shop-- really quick reflexes-- it's making my bits tingle. Do you have anything for that?

name: LIAM
dialogue: You haven't been scratching yourself, have you?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, I had that before. Not the same thing.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There's a bucket of water in the corner. You can try that.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I go over to the bucket of water and I stick my hands in the water.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It'll make it worse.

name: MATT
dialogue: It does. The slight burning sensation now has turned into a very vibrant burning white hot on the skin, and you can see bits of the skin start to peel back a little bit, beginning on the edges.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I hand him a small bag of powder. Now you've learned not to touch things if you don't know what they are.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What do I do with a bag of powder?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I pour the powder on his hands.

name: MATT
dialogue: It foams up a little bit in places, but it is neutralized.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You're a good friend.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Can I leave now? I go to the kitchen to eat.

name: MATT
dialogue: All righty. You easily get another meal mustered for you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm going to go make a trip to Gilmore's. Anybody want to join?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I should probably tag along.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'll come, too.

name: MATT
dialogue: You're working in the workshop, you're eating, you guys are going to Gilmore's. All right. So as this is happening, Tiberius, you make your way over to the Alabaster Lyceum. You come up to the front main area of the structure itself. It's an arcane college. You make your way to the front clerk, who looks up to you, a nice young fellow, looks like he's trying to work through his credit in school through his training. He's dressed in the ceremonial robes of somebody who is a student, who is currently stuck with the job of working as a clerk. He's like, "Hi, can I help you?"

name: ORION
dialogue: Yes, hi, if you do not remember me, I am Tiberius Stormwind, from Draconia. Moreover, Vox Machina, over at Greyskull Keep.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Where have I heard that--"

name: ORION
dialogue: Well, we told you multiple times before. We met with you using your sigil of teleport-- it's fine. I've come here on a matter of business anyway, so that's neither here nor there. I was wondering if I may procure an address, or number as it were, for a sigil to Kraghammer. I believe the Thunderbrands would have some facility near theirs or on their own premises where their sigil could be channeled through the Circle of Teleportation spell.

name: MATT
dialogue: "If you're talking about sigils for teleportation, you would probably have to discuss "that with Gatekeeper Xanthas."

name: ORION
dialogue: Where is he? I thought that was you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "No. I'm the clerk. I run the front of the-- follow me." And he gets up and leads you further into the structure to the central circular room, the white-marbled room that contains all the doors around, and in the center there is the Traverse Junction. This is the place you guys have stumbled into every single time you've teleported back to Emon. And there you see the elven wizard who you recently bothered naught but maybe five hours ago, who is currently setting up some sheets, comes back. "Oh. Hello, again."

name: ORION
dialogue: Hi. I'm Tiberius Stormwind, from Draconia. Moreover, Vox Machina over at Greyskull Keep. I was wondering-- and I asked your clerk here because I thought he did what you actually do here-- if I may procure, for coin or perhaps some kind of favor of sorts, the address or number or code or whatever it is that would work for the Kraghammer sigil of my Circle of Teleportation.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I get an understanding here that you're seeking access to one of our many sigil-based "rooms of transference. Those rooms are currently under very protected lock and key, approval by the "headmaster Thurmond Adalum himself."

name: ORION
dialogue: Okay, where is he?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh my god. It's like calling Time Warner Cable.

name: ORION
dialogue: Can you take me to him? Where is he at?

name: MATT
dialogue: Glances over at the clerk, who goes, "Right this way, Mr. Stormwind." He leads you back to a long, long hallway with arched ceiling. You can see the marble itself has these carvings and sculptures of various dead-looking faces of long-passed mages that either were built or held in high esteem in the halls of this lyceum. At the very end, it opens up into a pretty well-decorated, almost over-the-top decorated office room for the headmaster himself. The interior is lined with large, large 15, 20-foot-tall bookshelves around this oval room with sliding ladders that are attached to them that slowly glide on their own, like they're on some sort of arcane-based pattern that puts them back and forth. There is a large chandelier of brightly colored orbs that sits 35, 40 feet in the air, that slowly rotates on its own that keeps this slowly fluctuating changing color of the room. And in the center there is a circular desk, and sitting there at the desk you can see is Headmaster Thurmond, who is this extremely elderly human male. Shaved face, very short, curved bald head with a little bit of hair in the back, hunched forward and is currently collecting a series of books into his arms. Looks like he's about to get up. And he turns and looks over. "Can I help you?"

name: ORION
dialogue: Hello.

name: ORION, SAM
dialogue: I'm Tiberius Stormwind from Draconia.

name: ORION
dialogue: Moreover, Vox Machina over at Greyskull Keep here in Emon. We are the saviors of this town and whatnot. Anyway, that's neither here nor there. I went through this fellow, who I thought was the job of this fellow, but it wasn't either of those jobs, it was you who I've been needing to talk to, I'm assuming?

name: MATT
dialogue: "What do you require from me, then?"

name: ORION
dialogue: I'm hoping to procure an address or access to the sigils of Kraghammer through my Circle of Teleportation spell and whatnot using your arcane gates. That's about it. (laughter)

name: SAM
dialogue: Well put!

name: MATT
dialogue: "If you're asking for access to one of our closely guarded sigils for the Thunderbrands, you "say, within Kraghammer?"

name: ORION
dialogue: Yes, yes. We'll have to speak with them as well.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, then I will-- just one moment." And he reaches into a pouch and pulls out this mirror, this oval mirror and sets it onto his desk. Reaches underneath and pulls out a small chest. Opens up the chest, and you can see in this chest that there are probably two dozen of these tiny little marbles, all different colors, some different shapes, and he goes, these little labels you can't really see from your perspective. He takes one out, places it in the top of the mirror, and as he does, the mirror all of a sudden shimmers for a second, and what was originally a normal reflection is now this light, glowing blue, slightly glowing water-like surface. He takes it and lifts it up to himself. "Hello. Hello? Hello!" A moment later, you hear this distant voice echoing with this strange warbling filter over it. "I'm coming, what's taking your time. Yes, "Headmaster, what do you require?" "Well, there's a gentleman here, dragonborn, who is requesting use of your sigil of teleportation. "Do you know this gentleman?" Turns it around, and you can see in there, this is the same long-bearded dwarven individual that met you at the actual Thunderbrand house, and had a bit of an argument with you early in your travels in Kraghammer.

name: ORION
dialogue: We've got things for you, this time, like we said we would get for you. In the Underdark. It's really inconvenient, but we have things that we need to get to you quickly.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Now, listen here. Last we spoke, you and your friends stormed into our lair, nearly "destroyed our precious arcane defenses of our homestead--"

name: ORION
dialogue: He was drinking. He's an alcoholic. He's got help since then.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a deception check.

name: ORION
dialogue: What is it?

name: MATT
dialogue: This is deception. Well, you are an alcoholic, but that wasn't what he meant.

name: MATT
dialogue: 20. (laughs) He goes, "Either way, we can't just let anyone willy-nilly knowing how to directly "appear in the center of our homestead."

name: ORION
dialogue: (in same accent as Matt) Of course. Oh, sorry, I started to sound like you. (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Bring me another accent, aye.

name: ORION
dialogue: Of course. I wouldn't expect you to. I'm Tiberius Stormwind, from Draconia. My father Kruvanis Stormwind has helped the Council for over two generations. We come from a noble house, and I give you my word that I will never abuse-- abuse?-- however you pronounce it in your tongue. The privilege of quickly traveling to your stead to do business with you, and there would be no other intrusion otherwise. I guarantee it as my name as a Stormwind.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a persuasion roll.

name: SAM
dialogue: Chief negotiator!

name: ORION
dialogue: That's 11.

name: MATT
dialogue: 11. His head turns to the side a little bit, peering through you with a slight scowl. "Last we "talked, the reason we didn't report you to the guard for breaking through our defenses was you "promised to look beneath the city and bring back various artifacts you were in search of."

name: ORION
dialogue: Ooh, we found one!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Did you, now?"

name: ORION
dialogue: A couple, yes. And we killed a bunch of those buttholes.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Can I see one of these artifacts?"

name: ORION
dialogue: I don't have it on me right now.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We're done here, Headmaster." And the mirror shimmers and closes suddenly.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Wait. No?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Good try!

name: LAURA
dialogue: We can bring-- oh, we're not there.

name: MATT
dialogue: The headmaster takes the marble out and says, "I'm sorry that didn't seem to go your way."

name: ORION
dialogue: It's fine, Headmaster. I'll be back in about 15 minutes with the proper proof that we did procure the things that the man, that needed to have proof, did. Excuse me! And I get the hell out of there. And as soon as I get out of there, I cast Fly on myself, and I Gandalf (whoosh) right back to the keep.

name: MATT
dialogue: All righty. You're eating. You're crafting. Are you going with the rest of them to Gilmore?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I don't know. I guess so.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. You guys make your way to the outside of Gilmore's Glorious Goods.

name: SAM
dialogue: As we walk, do we see Tiberius fly over our heads?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Actually, I'm staying at the Keep.

name: ORION
dialogue: Well, Travis is my target, right? Are you still at the Keep?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, I'm eating.

name: MATT
dialogue: As far as time goes, you haven't quite gotten to that point yet, for these guys. You get to Gilmore's. You enter the interior. You can see that for the most part, there aren't a lot of people in here. It's getting later in the day, and a lot of the customer business seems to be happening almost earlier, either pre-noon, or around noon. There's no current sign of Gilmore. You do see, across the way-- what's her name, again?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Sherri.

name: MATT
dialogue: Thank you. Sherri, the mousy helper who runs the shop in Gilmore's absence, or at least runs the first portion of it, with her thick glasses up on her nose, and she's sitting there with her elbows over the top of the main desk. She looks up as you enter, and takes her glasses and pokes them for a second. "Hello? Hi."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Do you remember us?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Right, I do."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: From Vox Machina? We're sponsored by Gilmore. He put the brand on my armor that my mother gave me.

name: MATT
dialogue: "And you should be wearing it proudly, yes? Now, what can I help you with?"

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, is Gilmore around?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes, I was hoping to catch up with him. We've been gone a while, and I was hoping to trade news with Glorious Gilmore. Is he not in at the moment?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Gilmore's in Westruun, currently setting up the expansion of the Gilmore's Glorious Goods "business. If this is important, I can certainly summon him here."

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'd hate to pull him away from business. I don't want to get in the way of his business. I mean, I am rather sad not to see him, but no, I don't think that would be a course of action we'd want to take. Let him continue to set up.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right, I suppose."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Can you get a message to him, though?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes, I can, actually."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, tell him Vax'ildan and friends visited. We're in the city for a week.

name: MATT
dialogue: She pulls out a small sheet of what looks like a rough-around-the-edges piece of parchment, and starts the inkwell, scribbling down.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Vax'ildan. That's with an A, not an E. We're here for a week. I don't know if he's going to be back from Westruun before then, but if he is, tell him to get word to me. I'm very interested in exchanging news for the past few weeks.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right." (foreign words) It flashes and disappears in front of her. "Well then, he'll be "receiving the message right about now. We'll pass that on, and whenever he returns, I'm certain he "will get back to you and deal with whatever business is necessary."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Thank you. We're here late in the day; are you still open for business?

name: MATT
dialogue: "We are open, yes."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I was just curious if you guys had a chance to think about the alchemy workshop that we talked about before, or if you maybe had any alchemy books that came in that I was requesting?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's possible. We haven't completely restocked the shelves, as of late. I know we had "some new things come in. I can go check." And as she turns, all of a sudden there's a large, vibrant, white flash of light and a sound from the back room. The beaded curtains shift, for a second, and you hear heavy footsteps. And pushing through the beaded curtain, you see before you, with a bead of sweat on his head, Gilmore! "I'm so glad you came back!"

name: SAM, MARISHA
dialogue: Gilmore!

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm sorry. I was out and about, running some business a ways away."

name: LIAM
dialogue: You didn't have to go to all that trouble to come back here.

name: MATT
dialogue: "How could I miss seeing my fine-- there's not as many of you as usual."

name: LIAM
dialogue: No, we're seeing to different bits of business. I turn back to him, I walk forward with hands out. I walk up to him, take him by the head, give him a good European-style kiss just about here-- right there-- come back, and say, there is so much to talk about. Where can we be alone?

name: MATT
dialogue: He looks over at the rest of the group. "Well, I mean--" (laughter) MATT "But of course."

name: LIAM
dialogue: See to whatever business you need to.

name: SAM
dialogue: We'll just peruse, yeah. We'll window shop.

name: MATT
dialogue: He walks back through the beaded curtain, giving you this look over his shoulder. As he does, the curtain falls behind him.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Those beads.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh jeez!

name: LIAM
dialogue: I walk right in. Follow him in.

name: MATT
dialogue: And you can see now, as the glow gently fades, there is a rug that is pushed to the side, and on the floor of his room there is a familiar sigil, similar to the one that you've seen Tiberius scrawl before in some of his spells. That's apparently how he got here so quickly. But he walks in, and he kicks the rug back over it, sits down on the edge of his bed, puts his hands up and goes, "What seems to be troubling you?"

name: LIAM
dialogue: I walk over and I sit down opposite him, and I say: Before we talk about anything, I feel like I should apologize because although we didn't have any sort of written agreement, you and I are friends, aren't we?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes."

name: LIAM
dialogue: And I was supposed to help bring your brand wherever we went. And I thought that would be possible. We came back from the Underdark. We had a very hard time, some of the hardest weeks of my life. I haven't delivered on my promise. And I mean to, but I haven't yet. I apologize wholeheartedly. I'm sorry.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That's all right. I understand: people grow busy. There are things you must tend to, and "that's all right. And I appreciate you being so honest, I really do."

name: LIAM
dialogue: In addition to that, I am changed, and promises mean more to me, even more than they did before. And I promise to follow through. In the interest of time for the game, DM, Vax tells the whole story of the Underdark, of the horn, of how close it was.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Ugh, what is taking him so long, Scanlan?

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't know.

name: MATT
dialogue: While that's happening, the rest of you are left there awkwardly staring about.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Did Sherri find my book? Sherri?

name: MATT
dialogue: A few minutes go by. Sherri comes back. She brings two books over. "Best I can tell, these may be what you're looking for? I can't quite--" She sets them down. One is a book that is the properties of various liquids, chemicals, and things that are found on this plane and otherwise. It's a good way to locate and identify phantom liquids, should you come across any.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That would be good for Scanlan.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: He is the source of a lot of phantom liquids.

name: MATT
dialogue: The other book appears to have a section about alchemy. It's essentially almost a beginner's guide, but it's a very, very easy-to-follow introduction to a number of various low-level sorceries and the creation of low-level spell components preparing them for use with spell-casting, and there is a chapter on a little bit of alchemy.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay, how much are these, Sherri?

name: MATT
dialogue: "They haven't been priced, yet."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I mean, they're-- they're all right.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Good going, Keyleth! I like it!

name: MATT
dialogue: "25 gold, each."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: 25 gold, each? Oh, come on. I know some university student dropped these off and donated these. Don't kid me, Sherri. Am I doing it right? Do I sound like Vex?

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a persuasion roll.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Damn it!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I was about to say, make her do a persuasion roll, it'd be funny.

name: SAM
dialogue: Unforced error.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm sorry! (laughter)

name: LIAM
dialogue: I spoke too soon!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: So perfect! So perfect for you.

name: MATT
dialogue: She reaches out and takes the books and slides them back, and says, "Well, if that's how "you feel, perhaps these can be returned to those university students that perhaps left them by. I "should put these in the lost and found."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Sherri!

name: SAM
dialogue: Sherri. If I may. What Keyleth was trying to say was that she never got a chance to go to college, and that she wanted to get that university experience.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Good luck."

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, that didn't work. Hey, can you serve me, now?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (whispering) Scanlan. Scanlan! Will you buy those books for me, and I'll reimburse you?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I can hear you. I'm right here." (laughter)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Walk away!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes, I'm happy to help you."

name: SAM
dialogue: I was wondering if you had a small box of some sort that could carry a magical item, and perhaps shield it from detection.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That? Yes, we do have a couple of those. Hold on." She darts up the stairway in the other room and goes to the second floor. A few moments later, she comes back down with these two small chests-- they're about that big, each. One's a lighter wood color, the other is painted black all over. "We have both of these. They should shield something of this size from most low-level magical "detections. These will run you about 200 gold apiece."

name: SAM
dialogue: I just need one. You're a woman of the world, and I'm sure you have fine taste, judging by your appearance. It is quite fine, if I may say so myself. If I were a little taller, I would probably ask you out on a date.

name: MATT
dialogue: "If you were a little taller, yes."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Sherri is sassy today!

name: ORION
dialogue: She's full of sass!

name: SAM
dialogue: Which one is the fancier of the two?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, looking at these, this one--" She points to the one that looks like just a casual, wood chest. "This would be easier to hide in plain sight amongst the rest of your furniture. This "one, however, would be difficult to locate in a more shaded, or lightless, circumstance."

name: SAM
dialogue: Hm. I want ostentatiousness.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Then perhaps this one?"

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, please. That. Thanks. Thank you. 200 to you. Also, I know Gilmore is otherwise entertained. Can you try to identify something for me? Do you have that-- I mean, judging by the glint in your eye and beauty in your heart, I'm sure you have many skills I don't know about, but I'm wondering if you could identify this small, red vial with a floating something in it, that I procured quite some time ago! Do you remember that?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yes. This vial, if I recall, it has this small--

name: SAM
dialogue: Have I tried this, once before?

name: MATT
dialogue: No, this is the one that was found--

name: SAM
dialogue: Me and Pike found some stuff in somebody's house? I don't even remember, this was a year ago.

name: MATT
dialogue: Right. Yes, okay. There we go. And make a persuasion roll, actually, on this one.

name: SAM
dialogue: A lot.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, look: a real roll.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Shut up.

name: SAM
dialogue: Persuasion? It's 35. Wait, 31. 31.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Matt just visited his mind palace.

name: MATT
dialogue: She looks at you, and goes, "You have been good patrons, and you have been much kinder to me "than others. We'll put this one on the house. We'll call this on the house." And as she takes the vial, sets it down, and she pulls out another book that she shuffles through, puts it up, turns through a few pages, until, looking through, "This here would be a Potion of Fire Breath. When "imbibed, it should give you a temporary time period of the ability to breathe fire, much like a "relatively young dragon. This one in particular is fire. There are many different vials like this "that pertain to different colorations of dragon, but this one is specifically for the red."

name: SAM
dialogue: Thank you so much. Thank you. Well, thank you so much. Two more questions, then I'll leave you alone. One: where can I go get business cards printed up, in this town? It's a calling card? Never mind! Forget it.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Like a flyer?"

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Those can be printed. There is a-- actually, a pretty well-designed print facility "not that far up the road."

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, great! Thank you; I'll go investigate that. And one other thing: you know those books that my friend was asking about? Could we maybe make those happen for her? I know that you had quoted her a low, low price of 25. I'd be prepared to pay even more than that for them. And compose you a little song about yourself.

name: MATT
dialogue: At which point, for the first time since the entire time you've been in the shop of Gilmore's Glorious Goods, you see a slight grin creep across her lips. She goes, "How could a lady say no to a "song? 25 gold! The price stands."

name: SAM
dialogue: So I have to pay you and sing to you?

name: MATT
dialogue: "We run a business, here, yes."

name: SAM
dialogue: All right.

name: MATT
dialogue: She pulls the books out.

name: SAM
dialogue: I bring out my-- something. (laughter) (sings) Sherri baby, Sherri baby, Sherri, won't you come home tonight? Come home tonight? You better ask your mama. Tell her you're without a gnome! Why don't you come home to my keep!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Pay for the books!"

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay, here you go!

name: MATT
dialogue: You can see, her face is flushed and she, (clears throat).

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I Druidcraft a flower real quick and slip it to Scanlan to give to her.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh! Here you are.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Thank you."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (gasps) Did she blush?

name: MATT
dialogue: She's red in the face. At this point in time, the beaded curtains reopen. Have you finished the conversation, or do you want to keep going?

name: LIAM
dialogue: No. After ten minutes of finishing all that, of telling every tiny detail, if you mind me backtracking, I briefly place my hand on top of his, and say, it was terrible. I've never seen anything like it. Now we're back. We're in our home, and I'm hoping to learn how Uriel is doing, how the city is faring. Is there any news? Things are ill in Kraghammer; they still haven't seen the last of their troubles, but I'm also concerned for our new home here.

name: MATT
dialogue: "As far as I'm aware, this city has been doing rather well. Since Winter's Crest just this "previous year, trade has been booming, we're opening up pathways all across the continent, "we've improved relations with many other distant kingdoms, and I'm opening a second shop! I mean, "that's amazing! And who would've thought?"

name: LIAM
dialogue: And Westruun, how's it going?

name: MATT
dialogue: "So far, so good. We're going through the construction process, and I'm making sure that I "have a rather supple income of artifacts and oddities that I have to sell at both locations. I "have to widen my input of various items and--"

name: LIAM
dialogue: You're a busy man.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh, yes."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Have you any time for leisure?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Eventually." You can see, he's a little more worn than you've seen Gilmore before. He's still Gilmore, and he's excited, but after the tale you told him and opening the second shop has been a little rough on him, and his jovial self is a little more wearied. Though he still looks fabulous.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You seem a tad weary. Is there anything I can do to help you?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Just praise the brand. Praise the brand, young Vax."

name: LIAM
dialogue: That will happen. I did not even mean to discuss this, coming here, but I noticed, coming in, a sigil under your carpet. I had no intention of this, but we need to get back to Kraghammer in a bit of a hurry, and I certainly have no abilities, but do you remember my friend Tiberius? Dragonborn fellow?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes! Yes, I remember him."

name: LIAM
dialogue: He needs to run an errand back in Kraghammer. Is there any way you could hook us up with a favor?

name: MATT
dialogue: "What kind of favor?"

name: LIAM
dialogue: I just want to send the lizard to Dwarf Town. Do you think we could make that happen?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: "Send the lizard to Dwarf Town?" How many more slurs can you have in one sentence?

name: MATT
dialogue: "My sigil here is for returning personal use. Did you hear that? There was some strange "noise in the sky. This is for my return. As far as outgoing, most other sigils are-- well, they're up "here. Looking for that, you're going to have to go to the Lyceum, I'm afraid."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Understood. I don't want to push my luck.

name: MATT
dialogue: "However, if you're going to the Lyceum... I am owed a favor or two. Let me see what I can do, "here." And he goes, and he pulls out another piece of similar paper and he writes a quick little note on the side, sends it up in the air, and it vanishes. He goes, "I've just done you a favor. "Keep that in mind. You go to the Lyceum, you should have access to one of these sigils. Make "sure you choose properly. You only have one."

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm pretty magic-stupid.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Then don't be the one that does it. Talk to your friend, this Tiberius fellow. He'll know what "to do, I'm sure."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Correct. One last. It's small or it's boring, it's business. I need a dagger. I don't want one for free or anything; I want to purchase it, but we're a little low on funds. The reason Tiberius needs to go to Kraghammer is because we're owed a large sum of money.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Right, you mentioned this last time, when you almost opened a line of Gilmore's "Glorious Credit."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Mm-hm. I'm not there.

name: LIAM
dialogue: What would the credit entail?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Previously, we discussed 25,000 gold pieces, the amount of which you were going to "retrieve."

name: LIAM
dialogue: I was going to-- what was that?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Retrieve."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Retrieve? God, I've been in the Underdark so long. What was the deal?

name: MATT
dialogue: "The deal was since you did not have funds, and you had to retrieve this money from this "'Dwarf Town', as you so graciously put it, that you would borrow the money, at the time, and then "pay me back within a month. Within a month."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Understood.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Wait, is Gilmore trying to say we owe him money?

name: LIAM
dialogue: No. We almost did that. Correct, DM? That's what we almost did, but we didn't do it. You offered it.

name: MATT
dialogue: Correct. You backed out last minute when you realized there was, apparently, hidden platinum--

name: LIAM
dialogue: I would be interested-- Gilmore? I really just need a quick favor, and I mean to pay you back quickly. I need a dagger for something. Not your best dagger. Not your shittiest dagger, either. I just need something nice. How much would a fine dagger cost? Something that would be good in a fight. And could I pay you back in a couple of days, once Tiberius returns from Kraghammer?

name: MATT
dialogue: "If you want something functional, there are masterwork daggers out there. We do have "base-level enchantments that give you a fine, honed edge and a balance that cannot be beaten for "its price range. For that, I can easily give you one of our base-level enchanted items for no more "than, friend discount included, 400 gold pieces."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's a pretty good deal.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Can I please purchase three of those?

name: MATT
dialogue: "You may!"

name: LIAM
dialogue: Done.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right! I'll get these right now!" He stands up, and now that there's some sort of business involved, he's completely renovated and recharged. He comes through the beaded curtain again. You guys see Gilmore burst out, like, (laughs) "We're in business!" And he goes into the next room, and back up the stairs, and takes a few moments. He comes back down with an armful of these daggers, and sets them down on the counter. "Three for you! "That'll be 1,200 gold pieces, please."

name: LIAM
