dialogue: I reach out and I give his cheek a little bubby-squeeze, and I clap him on the cheek, and say, I'm good on my word, and you're a good friend. Thank you, Gilmore.

name: MATT
dialogue: "The least I could do. Pay me back. I'll find you."

name: LIAM
dialogue: I know you're good on your word.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Indeed."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Keyleth? Scanlan?

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, yes! How'd it go in there? You're walking straight, so it couldn't have gone too well.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Very good. Warm in here.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That dagger's so sharp, it could cut the sexual tension.

name: ORION
dialogue: Those are masterwork daggers?

name: MATT
dialogue: They are plus-one enchanted daggers, yes.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, let's get out of here and go. Did you find us any--?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm good. No, everything's good here. Just not everywhere else.

name: SAM
dialogue: Let's get out of here, go back to the keep.

name: MATT
dialogue: At this point, now, Tiberius, you have coasted over the air, and as you come careening in, you hear (swishing sounds) and look down. Two crossbow bolts whiz past you.

name: ORION
dialogue: It's me, you idiots!

name: MATT
dialogue: At which you hear immediately, "Oh, sorry!" "Sorry! We're not used to having you bolt in from "the skyline."

name: ORION

name: LAURA

name: LIAM
dialogue: You reanimated him? Oh then, never mind. I'm sorry, I'm sorry.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you pull your blade out, she commands and gives a hand motion, and the Broker hobbles towards her.

name: KIT
dialogue: My sisters, they sent you? They are still hunting me?

name: MATT

name: KIT
dialogue: Return to Palac Lusterka and present yourself to my sisters. Let them see what good it will do them to hunt me.

name: MATT
dialogue: Turns around and starts shambling off.

name: ORION
dialogue: Oh, wait a minute, hold on. And I as he's walking away, I'm going to loot that dude. Take shit off him. Come on. Hold on, let me take this.

name: MATT
dialogue: There is a mostly ruined set of studded leather armor that is enchanted, plus one. It's basic, but it's need of serious repair as it currently has a large gaping hole in the chest area. Eventually, this half-naked ruined body of this tiefling begins stepping off into the night.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What about the old lady? Do we get any loot off her?

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughs) The old lady has mostly a basic wand. It's a plus-one wand.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Here's a wand. I toss it back to them.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Scanlan? Tibs? Who wants a wand?

name: SAM
dialogue: I'll take it. All right.

name: MATT
dialogue: Plus-one Wand of the War Mage.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Plus-one Wand of the War Mage.

name: MATT
dialogue: A simple Ring of Protection.

name: LAURA
dialogue: There's a ring. I take it, put it on. For the time being.

name: MATT
dialogue: And about roughly 320 gold. Amongst the two of them. At this point in time, the other guy's exhausted himself now, just still in place. You see the Broker vanish into the shadows, heading southward.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Shall we throw him in the pen with the other guy?

name: ORION
dialogue: Hold on a second, why would we keep this one around to tell us now? What'd be the point? I will kill this man unless you give me a good reason not to.

name: KIT
dialogue: I look at him and I ask, this? My sisters, they are responsible for this?

name: MATT
dialogue: He gives you a look for a second. "I've been this my whole life. They gave me purpose. I follow "them, and you've hurt the Mistresses."

name: KIT
dialogue: That is true. I did do something similar to Bellenore's face. But they will not give you purpose. You are better out of their shadow. Trust me, I know. You should find better purpose for yourself. Go. Be free. I doubt that they will trouble you any more.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a persuasion roll.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Plus? Plus zero.

name: SAM
dialogue: You still have my inspiration.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Inspiration! Plus ten!

name: LIAM
dialogue: (singing) Scanlan make you feel good.

name: MATT
dialogue: 15. The tension in the muscles eventually relaxes, and the head hangs. "I know not for what "reason I live."

name: KIT
dialogue: You seem a capable fighter, yes? My cousin recently became member of the Slayer's Take in Vasselheim. Perhaps you would care to go find purpose in testing your skills there?

name: LAURA
dialogue: And if not there you can always fight in the Crucible.

name: MATT
dialogue: (grunts)

name: KIT
dialogue: They look for nothing but strength and honor.

name: MATT
dialogue: At which point there's a large cracking sound as the hardened foam breaks from one leg. (grunts) Breaks the other leg free and stands there now before you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Your purpose in life is only what you make of it.

name: SAM
dialogue: You can do anything. You could be President of the United States.

name: ORION
dialogue: While this is going on, I'm writing on a piece of scroll right now. Which I give to him.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I will walk, and I will think. Perhaps I will drown." And he turns and starts walking towards the shoreline on the other side to the west--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Lillith, does this mean you are free from those who are hunting you?

name: KIT
dialogue: I'm very much afraid not. This is but one of the attempts my sisters have made to find me. However, I have no intention of returning to my home.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And what was the name of your homeland again? It sounded very exotic.

name: KIT
dialogue: Palac Lusterka is the seat of my family. We go back very long way. But I would not recommend that you visit there. It's not the most cheerful place.

name: ORION
dialogue: Not tourist-friendly?

name: KIT
dialogue: Not particularly welcome, no.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I've heard some terrible things about-- what is it, your father, is it? Or is it your uncle? Your uncle.

name: KIT
dialogue: My family in general have interesting attitudes towards affection, shall we say. My sisters-- well, you see, I'm not particularly cut out for making a good first impression. However, my sisters did always tell me that what was inside was most important. They did tell me this as they were removing intestines to divine with them, so perhaps maybe not usual meaning of this phrase, but Zahra is perhaps the member of my family that I like best.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Understandably.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We all have those.

name: LIAM
dialogue: All we care about is deeds. You've proven yourself to great depth today.

name: KIT
dialogue: I believe in this circumstance I pale to my present company. I've heard many wonderful things about you from Zahra, and I'm honored to not only have met you, but also to have had your aid in this matter. I'm profoundly grateful. If there is ever any opportunity at which I can return the favor, I am not useful for much, but perhaps a little smoke and mirrors I can do.

name: ORION
dialogue: I would actually like to know how you keep your horns so shiny and clean.

name: MATT
dialogue: The cold wind picks up as the night air begins to darken, a distant storm blowing over the horizon to the northeast. The time draws late and cold.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Lillith, would you like to stay the night before you move on?

name: KIT
dialogue: If I would not put you at any--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Not even a little.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Please, have dinner with us.

name: KIT
dialogue: Then it would be my pleasure.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And we head back to the keep.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And I go in the back into the garden, and I take the glissfoil out of my pocket that I was given, and I revive it from its dried state that it was given to me in, and plant it in the ground.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And as the twins are walking I say, clearly, I'm eating shit here today. I guess I'm going to make a promise not to stray from your side.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Remember that promise.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I promise.

name: SAM
dialogue: I lick Tiberius. (laughter)

name: ORION
dialogue: That's what that feels like.

name: MATT
dialogue: That will be our freeze-frame credit high-five for the evening.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Nice job, Kit! (cheering)

name: MATT
dialogue: Thank you so much, Kit, for guesting with us this evening, and for coming out and visiting us.

name: KIT
dialogue: Thank you so much for having me. We've had an absolutely amazing week and-- oh, it's really nice to speak in my own accent again.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Your accent good. We enjoy.

name: KIT
dialogue: Thank you. No, it's been absolutely amazing. It really has been an honor and you will definitely be seeing me again in LA, because this was wonderful. Thank you so much.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah!

name: LAURA
dialogue: And everybody check her out on twitter.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What's your twitter?

name: KIT
dialogue: My twitter is AnemoneTea dot-- not even dot com, just AnemoneTea. It's that simple.

name: MATT
dialogue: Travis and Laura have to run to catch a plane flight. You guys go, rock it out, safe flight. You guys are off to...?

name: LAURA
dialogue: A wedding. And our anniversary is tomorrow. (cheering)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: But we got to go.

name: MATT
dialogue: Go. Travel safe. Bye, guys.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I love you guys.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Can I hold your mug? I want to see what it feels like. Wow! Look at the size of that.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's still got some booze in there, if you want to take a slurp.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes.

The Broker is actually their construction.

name: KIT
dialogue: That's amazing!

name: MATT
dialogue: The Broker was designed by one of our viewers, one of our Critters.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Thank you for the target practice.

name: KIT
dialogue: Thank you so much!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That is so cool.

name: KIT
dialogue: That's amazing.

dialogue: We're hoping to do stuff like that every now and then in the future to bring in some Critters to throw their creative mind in here and incorporate a character into our world. My heart's been going a mile a minute that entire game, because no DM wants to have to kill a player.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I was on the verge of bawling my eyes out.

name: LIAM
dialogue: If I ever died, I thought-- and I still think I'll probably be the first-- but if I ever died, I thought it would be more like a bus accident. I would just go (impact) and that'd be it. I didn't think the doctor would look at me and say, I'm sorry, you have one week to live. And the whole week I've been sweating.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, it's pretty harsh. The internet was very vocal.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, thanks guys, for putting the pressure on.

name: MATT
dialogue: Oh man. Well, that was awesome. [end of transcript]

name: MATT
dialogue: Hello everyone and welcome to Critical Role: an online show on Twitch where a bunch of us nerdy-ass voice actors roll dice and play Dungeons and Dragons. My name is Matthew Mercer. I'm the Dungeon Master. For returning fans, welcome, and for new folks, prepare. A couple of fun things to announce: first things first, unfortunately we are down a Percy this evening. Our buddy Taliesin picked up a con plague in Alaska this past weekend. He had a great time, but came back very ill and has been trying to get better, and is unable to make the game tonight. Which makes the current storyline a little interesting, but we'll work it out. It's fine. No Mercy Percy is going to have some business he's attending to. Thank the Critters for that. That's an awesome hashtag! So Taliesin, I hope you feel better. We miss you. Next week we continue that arc. Let's see, first and foremost, still every 100 subs we get on the channel we have a giveaway to someone who's active in the chatroom. The winner of that giveaway gets a signed picture of the cast of Critical Role, as well as a signed poster by our amazing artist Kit Buss, who was with us for our last session. Those are both given away to whoever wins that, so keep those subs going. Also, there is currently going around a hashtag: No Shave 'Til 10k. A number of people on the stream are a part of that. All sexes can compete and be a part of this, too. No Shave 'Til 10k. If you want to be a part of that, go ahead and tweet that out. Get that hashtag going and I'll see if I can convince Marisha to let me do that. We'll see. At the very least, for my Halloween costume. All right, so other cool things to talk about: all of tonight's donations are going towards the Extra Life charity. The Extra Life charity is a drive that's part of the Children's Miracle Network Hospitals. A lot of great people in the community have been supporting this and we're supporting that tonight. So any donations tonight will go to Extra Life. Also over the next two days, we will also be streaming here at Geek and Sundry doing a lot of other charity events for the Extra Life charity drive, including a small DND game-- some of us-- on Saturday evening with the Vox Moronica crew. So that should be fun. Come check that out! Oh, Dungeons and Dragons, the official Wizards of the Coast folks are also doing their Extra Life stream over the next 48 hours. They're just going to be doing live DND streams as well. So starting tomorrow at noon through Sunday at noon, just constant DND on the Wizards of the Coast stream as well. And all of that is going to be raising money for Extra Life. So you'll have a lot of things to keep you busy this weekend essentially. So there's that. Also, we have New York Comic Con coming up in just a couple of weeks. Excited about that, for all you guys. We have panels on Saturday. Do we have times for those yet?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Between 1:00 and 4:00 is when we're doing stuff.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, between 1:00 and 4:00. We have about an hour panel in there somewhere and then probably two hours of signings at the event on Saturday. So 1:00 and 4:00! Leave that period of time open. Hang out.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We'll have prints!

name: MATT
dialogue: Exactly! And then on Sunday, outside of the convention, because we know a lot of the badges were snatched up before this announcement even happened and a lot of the Critters aren't able to make it to the actual con. On Sunday, we're looking around midday. We don't have a time or location determined yet, but that will be up on Twitter soon. It's going to happen. We're going to have an offsite Critter meetup. Where we're going to all be able to be there, hang out with you guys and catch up, sign stuff, say hi, and have a good time. So watch Twitter. If you don't follow us on Twitter, do it, because we'll have those announcements coming up very soon. So excited about that. Liam, you wanted to announce--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes! This is the final chance for y'all to jump on Joe Madureira's Kickstarter, Battle Chasers: Nightwar. They have absolutely killed their Kickstarter. They hit their goal, their initial goal about two or three days in, and they have been hitting every single stretch goal they've had. They've got one last mystery stretch goal left to hit. So it's a good time to get in and just get them to the very tippy, tippy top of their campaign, which is about to end. If you guys don't know, really quick, because I've been talking about it for two weeks: Joe Madureira, amazing comic book legend, has drawn everything. It looks like nobody else's and has a good history in game dev as well. Created Darksiders with his company, Vigil Games, that he helped found. And now he has founded Airship Syndicate, and they're making an RPG in the style of JRPGs that you've loved in your lives. But also with Joe's ridonkulous art style. So go get on it.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah! Thank you, Liam. Orion, you wanted to say something real fast as well.

name: ORION
dialogue: Yes. Greetings and salutations, everyone! Last week when Kit was here-- Hi Kit, we miss you! We went to It's a Wrap over in Burbank, California. Me and Liam and Laura and Marisha and Kit and her hubby. We were there and saw this robe, and I think Marisha and Laura were like, try it on, and I was like, okay. And I tried it on and was like, oh my god, it was made for me.

name: MATT
dialogue: The Tiberius robe you always knew-- or didn't know you wanted.

name: ORION
dialogue: Yeah, totally, I was like, oh my god, and Liam tweeted a picture about it, and then I was streaming on my stream on Twitch and somebody mentioned the robe. And Michael Bauman-- thank you again, I'm going to thank you on Critical Role for-- he donated $400, which was the cost of the robe, and then he just wrote in the chat, this is for the robe, so I'm wearing the robe.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's awesome!

name: ORION
dialogue: Thank you very much. Thank you so much you guys and all you guys who pitched in and stuff. Thank you.

name: MATT
dialogue: We'll find many cool excuses to have that robe be displayed and utilized in many ways. I'm pretty sure he hasn't taken it off since he got it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, it smells really bad, you guys.

name: MATT
dialogue: Awesome! Anybody else have any other announcements before we get this party started?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I like cheese.

name: MATT
dialogue: Travis likes cheese, ladies and gentlemen.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's a good announcement.

name: MATT
dialogue: I think so. It was very informative. Thank you, Travis. All right, then. Without further ado, let's go ahead and cut to the intro and then we'll jump right into the next episode of Critical Role. [dramatic music] Welcome back! So picking up after the events of last week, to give you guys a little bit of a refresher. After the party had returned from their journey into Vasselheim for quite a few weeks, they discovered upon returning that the illustrious Briarwoods, current owners of Castle Whitestone and overseers of the entire city of Whitestone and sticking point in Percy's background, were coming to Emon to meet for essentially a political banquet with Sovereign Uriel Tal'Dorei to discuss construction of a bridge. It was a very political endeavor. And the council of Tal'Dorei was invited, including Vox Machina. There was a week of preparation in going into this event to see exactly what the Briarwoods were about. Information was gathered at this banquet. Vax went on his own little adventure into the Briarwoods' room, in which they nearly killed him. (chuckles)

name: LIAM
dialogue: Hey, everybody!

name: MATT
dialogue: I didn't notice the shirt until now. So yeah, the party rushed out to his aid. Much violence ensued. The Briarwoods eventually escaped through some sort of magical means that was not uncovered. However, they are no longer in the picture. The party was left with a destroyed carriage, a young carriage driver who had his hand shot off by Percy, and was then told to the guards to haul off and bring to their keep to throw into their cell for further questioning. Uriel was eventually drawn out and confused by the sudden chaos and vehemently requested that Vox Machina return the next morning to go over what has transpired. After which, the party during this event had encountered a tiefling by the name of Lillith, who was masquerading as one of the servants within the palace of Tal'Dorei. Aided them in the battle and revealed that she was being hunted by her sisters in a distant land and revealing herself here essentially opened up her physical presence to be pinpointed and then immediately sought and hunted by whoever was after her. The party then brought her back to the keep. They were on the way back before they were encountered by this bounty hunter and a small team of individuals that were coming with him to seek down, capture Lillith, and bring her back to her sisters. The party then defended her in this circumstance, brutally murdering one of them. Sorry, brutally murdering two of them. One of which was then raised and sent off as a present to the sisters by Lillith. One was salvaged, not given an honorable death, and sent to find his way somewhere northwest of Emon. Possibly towards Vasselheim or wherever else he may find his adventure. They then gave Lillith the opportunity to come stay the night to rest in the keep and they all made their way back to Greyskull Keep for the evening. And that was where we left off. So as the evening progresses you all manage to get your rest and gather your thoughts over the rather stressful experience you had the previous evening within the palace. The next morning comes around. You all come to consciousness. Breakfast is prepared by the servants of the keep. As you all wake up, start getting your meals and gathering what you want to do for the day, two individuals have not come down for their meal. Lillith and Percy.

name: ORION
dialogue: Good morning, everyone!

name: SAM
dialogue: Not everyone. We're missing two. A male and a female.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh. No.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You don't think?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Percy was upset.

name: SAM
dialogue: Maybe he needed some comforting.

name: ORION
dialogue: Oh, I see. Are you saying they're having relations?

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm not saying that.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Perhaps we should check on them?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We should totally check on them!

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay, but if there's a sock or a gun on the doorknob, don't go in.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Or a ribbon. She wore a ribbon.

name: ORION
dialogue: Well, I was thinking last night, Grog, that we're probably going to be here for a little bit before going anywhere. Do we go anywhere?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We have to go see Uriel.

name: ORION
dialogue: Who? Oh. Right! Yes! Also, I really want to see Allura. For no particular-- actually for very specific reasons. Yes.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I think he's lying.

name: ORION
dialogue: One of them is: I want to pick up one of the Earrings of Telecommunication. It has been finished for quite some time. We just have to go to where she resides to pick it up. Then one of us could have another one.

name: LIAM
dialogue: That robe just takes it to a whole new level!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, it really does.

name: ORION
dialogue: I feel so good.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm somewhat entranced.

name: ORION
dialogue: I'm telling you, it's helping, too.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Do I feel a little tingle from my belt? And can I roll for a beard check?

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, beard check?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Six. Two.

name: MATT
dialogue: You wake up, realizing that the morning has transpired. You reach up and grab. name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You know the remedy for it, you just turn your face in the looking glass.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, from this angle you look amazing Grog.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: My god, I'm so handsome. Right? And then just horror. Sheer horror.

name: ORION
dialogue: (poof) A little dust and fix that for him.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, so it looks normal again? I like it! Yeah. Beautiful. Don't touch it.

name: MATT
dialogue: The color's a little off, but it looks better than not having it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: In my head you're like those Mr. Wooly magnetic toys when you're a kid.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I would shave it and get it even, but let's be honest, given history, it's going to take care of itself soon enough. These things don't live very long.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm going to go upstairs and see if our guest, Lillith, is all right. I don't want to disturb Percy just yet.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. You head to the guest room. You have one guest room upstairs that was among the rest of the rooms that you guys had constructed.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (singing) They're going to be getting it on!

name: MATT
dialogue: You knock on the door. A moment passes. No response.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Lillith? Are you with Percy? Lillith?

name: MATT
dialogue: You knock a second time and the door (creaks) opens a little bit. It has not really been locked or closed.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I peek my head in.

name: MATT
dialogue: You peek in and look.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Did you check for traps?

name: MATT
dialogue: Roll a-- no, I'm kidding. (laughter)

name: LAURA
dialogue: Damn it!

name: MATT
dialogue: Already off! No. As you peek into the room, the lights are dimmed. What little bit of candles are in there are already down. Glancing in, the sheets are clean and set, the bed's been made, and there is a small piece of parchment that is folded on the edge of the bed.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Go and read it.

name: MATT
dialogue: Read it? It reads, "Vox Machina, thank you all for your hospitality and protection through "this past evening. I would stay, but the longer I remain, the more danger I am in, and as such, put "all of you in as well. I shall travel across the Ozmit Sea to seek the guidance of my cousin Zahra, "in hopes of finally getting out from under my sisters' baneful gaze. name: LAURA
dialogue: She's so cute.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I liked her bow. It was cute.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I tell everyone that she's gone. Gone.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, she's in Percy's room! Scanlan, let's go see if he's banging!

name: SAM
dialogue: All right, let's go! (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: You run up and Percy's room is-- the door is already partially ajar.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (boom)

name: MATT
dialogue: It bursts open. (wham) Slams on the side of the door, looking in the room. He's not there, is the first thing you notice. However, what you do see are a series of different books of sketches and designs and half-concocted blueprints for different things are crumpled and torn across the room. The bedsheets are thrown off the bed. It looks like the room has been continuously tossed through some sort of frenzied action, either seeking something or just out of emotional frustration. This room is left in far more disarray than you're used to seeing true to Percy's character.

name: SAM
dialogue: My god, Grog. Percy's a hoarder.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Right.

name: SAM
dialogue: Or he's in serious distress.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I think it's the previous.

name: SAM
dialogue: The hoarder?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah. Probably.

name: SAM
dialogue: We must find him, don't you think? Our friend's in trouble. I proceed down to his tinkering lab. Doesn't he have some sort of lab downstairs?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: My room's like shit, and I'm not in trouble.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, that goes with your character.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. You head down to the basement area, and to the right is the cell, to the left is the workshop. The workshop door is currently closed. There is a small slider eye vent where you can peek through.

name: SAM
dialogue: Can I reach the eye vent?

name: MATT
dialogue: You can if you leap hard enough and catch it on the edge.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I boost him up.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Looking inside, you can see, the forge is aglow. You hear the tangs of metal being hammered against the anvil, and you can see the form of Percy framed against the backlighting of the forge. He's feverishly working away on some sort of project.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Is he naked?

name: SAM
dialogue: No, he's working too hard. Maybe we should just leave him be. Seems focused, driven, like a madman.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh. I get it. Like a madman?

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't think you do.

name: MATT
dialogue: At which point a voice rings out from across the room: Percy unmoving, still continuing his work, shouts over his shoulder, "Please, leave me be. I have a lot to think about right now."

name: SAM
dialogue: Would you like a meal brought down?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Hi.

From what he described, a giant bird, larger than anything he's "ever seen or heard of." Ben then takes over the conversation, "Wings at least ten carts long, tip to tip. name: MARISHA
dialogue: Mr. Simms?

name: MATT
dialogue: "That was the bull." Riley says, "Kyle said he saw it fly northwest."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Northwest? Can I do a nature check to see if I can recognize the creature he's describing?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Are we certain he's not describing a dragon?

name: MATT
dialogue: 26. You've seen some big birds in your time. This is, from what they're describing, a lot bigger than any birds you've encountered in your experience. You've heard whispers of larger birds in the wild, but you've never seen anything like that. You haven't had any personal experience hearing or seeing anything of this size.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But it is a bird?

name: MATT
dialogue: That's what they described it as. At night.

name: LAURA
dialogue: When did these birds start showing up?

name: MATT
dialogue: "About two weeks ago when the whole thing started to happen." And then Ben kicks in and says, "Should this keep up, most of us will lose everything before the "year is out. And he brings up a couple of coin purses and she goes, "512 gold pieces, 37 silver, and 103 copper. "That's all we can spare."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Keep your money.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes, keep your money.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We can't possibly--"

name: LIAM
dialogue: What about this? What if you supplied us with a small stream of produce for our servants here at the keep? For cooking, for feeding them, for feeding us when we're here? It'll be a sight less than 500; it wouldn't be nothing. You could still give us something.

dialogue: "Yes! We could, we'd be more than happy to!"

name: MATT
dialogue: "I mean, there's no deadline, but the longer that goes by, the more and more we lose by the "night. Two weeks in and we've lost half of our livestock. If the creature is this big, I imagine "it eats quite a bit."

name: LAURA
dialogue: And how long of a ride is it? Is it walking distance?

name: MATT
dialogue: "To... where?"

name: LAURA, LIAM, SAM
dialogue: To your farm.

name: MATT
dialogue: "North side of Emon."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, so real close!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes."

name: MATT
dialogue: They look at each other and nod and he taps her hand and says, "Yes. By all means-- If you "could, please help us stop this beast from ruining our livelihood."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And can you please tell us how to get to your place. Do you normally stay there? Are you normally home?

name: MATT
dialogue: "We wander about the community, but we do have a homestead. If you look, it's the large red "wood and partially brick-based homestead closest to the city walls, on the north farm. Right "outside of Emon. It's hard to miss, if you're headed that direction."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Quickly. Presently, we will find you. Guys, we were told to sit and spin basically. I mean, what's wrong with earning some brownie points in the eyes of Uriel?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Mr. and Mrs. Kraut, as friends of the elderly--

name: MATT
dialogue: "Klaus."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Right, Kraut. Do they normally come at night, or have they ever abducted any of your sweet bulls during the day?

name: MATT
dialogue: "We've not seen it during the day. It'd be easier for us to identify if we had. Seems to only "hunt at night."

name: SAM
dialogue: And have they ever messed with a human?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Not that we've heard of. Not yet." He gives you this sudden look of realization and fear. And pats and comforts his wife who suddenly realizes, oh my. Are they going to take us now?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We'll probably be by like tonight or tomorrow morning.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes. Tomorrow morning at the latest. We have a little bit of business. Yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So we're in the middle of doing something. We'll get to it.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right. Well, thank you."

name: LIAM
dialogue: I take him by the hand and say, we will see you presently.

name: SAM
dialogue: Here. My business card.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And you can take that to the bank.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You can't actually; it's worth nothing.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, thank you for listening to us ramble on, and we look forward to hearing from you in the "next day."

name: LAURA
dialogue: You will.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right." He pats her on the arm.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Travel safe, Mr. Kraut!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Hide your bull; hide your wife.

name: MATT
dialogue: They both wander off.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We are in danger of being ostracized. We should really be nice to everybody right now.

name: SAM
dialogue: We were just having a conversation about how we should try to be nice from now on. But we do have very pressing matters.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, let's get fucking in there and talk to that little--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's funny how that type of thing can come back to bite you in the ass.

name: SAM
dialogue: I call up to Cordell. Oi, Cordell!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yeah!"

name: SAM
dialogue: Remember when I told you not to let anyone linger outside the keep?

name: MATT
dialogue: "To be fair, the Klauses are well-known in the community."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: The Krauts?

name: LAURA
dialogue: The Klauses.

name: MATT
dialogue: "They came here for business. I figured it was probably something you'd want to hear. I "apologize."

name: SAM
dialogue: By all means, use your judgment over the orders of your master. That's fine.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Scanlan!

name: MATT
dialogue: Cordell bows his head sheepishly. "I apologize. I'm sorry."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Ignore him!

name: LAURA
dialogue: We are here to help people! We're here to help.

name: MATT
dialogue: He does his finger like this and the gates open in towards the inside of the keep wall.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And what is wrong with you all today?!

name: SAM
dialogue: We had a really bad dinner last night. That's all.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I head straight to the jail.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I follow.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you guys are doing that, Tiberius, what's the first thing you're trying to do?

name: ORION
dialogue: Stop by and pick up the decanter from the temple.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. He said it required two days. It's been less than a day since you dropped it off, just so you're aware.

name: ORION
dialogue: Then the only thing I do is visit the keep with the sigils library or whatever.

name: MATT
dialogue: Oh, the Lyceum? Okay.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm not going. I'm just going to go hang out up on the wall outside the keep.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. As you head to the Lyceum, the clerk lets you in. What are you specifically looking to find or research?

name: ORION
dialogue: The sigil that's closest to the Feywild.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. In researching what they have at their disposal, you understand that the Feywild itself, because it is a separate plane, the magics to traverse it are a little more difficult to do. If you notice-- and I'll confirm here just to be sure that we're on the same page-- before I go full on this here. Pardon me, just a moment while I scan through the book. The mighty book. The book of might. Yes. Sigils of teleportation require the same plane of existence, meaning you can teleport anywhere within the Prime Material Plane that you exist in. To traverse into the Feywild, you have to actually find a door into the Feywild, and then you would be able to use a sigil from the Feywild.

name: ORION
dialogue: Then I only pick up my decanter.

name: MATT
dialogue: Which is not ready yet.

name: ORION
dialogue: I don't do that! Damn, I forgot! My short-term memory is just jacked!

name: MATT
dialogue: It's all good. It's all good.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You know, somebody's been to the Feywild.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. The Feywild. What you do find is that the Feywild-- the boundaries between this realm and the Feywild tend to grow weaker at full moons. It's tied to the moon cycle. And at certain places where nature is set to run wild. A lot of druidic tribes tend to mark these locations, and in some cases actually guard them.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We know where a hole in one is. Grog went through it.

name: MATT
dialogue: And if you recall-- good memory-- in the Frostweald, the partially frozen forest where you had that conversation with the nymph-- that portal that she existed through was specifically a door into the Feywild, which you recognized.

name: ORION
dialogue: What city was that near?

name: MATT
dialogue: That was south of Westruun.

name: ORION
dialogue: Then I'll go to the thing and I'll find the Westruun sigil.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Through your research, you do find a sigil to Westruun. This is allowing you to go into this portion for this sigil because you've already used the favor that you had to get the sigil of Kraghammer.

name: ORION
dialogue: No, I didn't. I used the amulet and we got permission to come there. I saved that favor for this.

name: MATT
dialogue: Right, the favor for Gilmore. All I'm saying is, you've used one of two favors to get that sigil. You have to invoke Gilmore's favor to get this one. Okay. And since you're a part of the circumstance, you acquire the secondary sigil. You now know, in your memory permanently, a sigil to Westruun. You don't know where in Westruun, but you are connected there. If you choose to teleport there, you know how to. That favor has now been used by Gilmore, so you can mark that. We'll see you guys and continue this tense adventure.

name: MATT
dialogue: [break] Welcome back. We've had our break; we've returned to the table. A quick note, we are 50 subscribers away from our next giveaway.

dialogue: 50? Come on!

name: MATT
dialogue: If we can get there, that'd be awesome! We'll have our giveaway-- the signed cast Critical Role photo and the cast signed art poster by Kit Buss.

name: SAM
dialogue: Kit Buss, ladies and gentlemen!

dialogue: Yeah! So you have all returned to the keep. You have found yourselves down to the basement area. You hear the distant pinging of metal, an occasional squeaking metallic noise. Like something is being altered, turned, or quenched in a water trough. Like the process of blacksmithing.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I go to the edge of the door and knock.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you knock on the metal door, it's like a (boom). The pinging stops. Just hangs for a second.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Percy? It's Keyleth.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Not right now. Please. I'm sorry. I just need to clear my head."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay. We'll be here.

name: MATT
dialogue: A moment later, you see Percy's eyes appear at the edge of the door.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Hi!

name: MATT
dialogue: Just looking at them, you can see they look a little sunken, a little weary.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Did you sleep?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Not as much as I'd like."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do you need anything?

name: MATT
dialogue: His eyes look away for a second, looks back at you. "I'm all right. Thank you."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We went and saw Uriel. Everyone in the city hates us. They think we're all criminals.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Great. I have to get back to my work."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay, yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: The slit shuts.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, we'll see you later, then.

dialogue: You guys, however, walk down to the other side of the cell. The cell door's been closed. The keys are hanging on the nail by it. You have not used the cell until this point. name: LAURA
dialogue: He's hanging?!

name: SAM
dialogue: We're the worst.

name: MATT
dialogue: He was put in as a prisoner.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I go and get the keys, and I take him down from the manacles.

name: MATT
dialogue: As she rushes into the cell, begins unlocking the manacles. He's unconscious at this time. Dirt streaked on his face and spatters of dried blood from the blast of the gun.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I go ahead and I administer Cure Wounds.

name: MATT
dialogue: The wound at this point has been cauterized. You cast Cure Wounds as he starts to come to consciousness, in a heap on the ground. (coughs) It appears he may be healed of any damage he may still be sustaining from that, but the fingers are gone. This is beyond the magic you're capable of. He comes to consciousness on the ground, dirtied, sore. Essentially broken before you.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Does he look like he's been bitten at all?

name: MATT
dialogue: You want to inspect?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can I look at his neck?

name: MATT
dialogue: Go ahead and make an investigation check.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. You don't have a whole lot of medicinal experience, but you take a moment and inspect both sides of his neck, tilting his head side-to-side, as he's groaning and coming to. "What's going on?" Looking at the sides of his neck, there does not appear to be any sign of any puncture wounds, anything that would be reminiscent of what your brother currently is healing from.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can I do an insight check to see if he is also under a mind-control spell?

name: MATT
dialogue: At the moment, no. He is barely coming to consciousness. There isn't enough of a presence at the moment to really read past.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Hey, there. Welcome back.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Where am I?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: You are being held, at the moment, for your own safety.

name: MATT
dialogue: "For my own safety?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: "How?" He looks at his hand.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, you were captured. We're pretty sure the Briarwoods are going to be pissed as hell that you let the carriage get hit. We're just trying to protect you, really.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Really?

name: SAM
dialogue: I mean, his friends all died, so.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do we not feel like terrible people enough already?

name: SAM
dialogue: Let's not have this conversation in front of the prisoner. What's your name, boy!

dialogue: "My name is Desmond. Desmond Otham. I am the son of a messenger, a courier of the de Rolo "family."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He's the son of a messenger! That's even more ironic!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Keyleth, do you need to step outside?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No, I'm good. Continue. Son of a messenger.

dialogue: Right now, everyone is at risk. The Briarwoods are bad people, you can attest to this, yes?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes. Can you tell us everything you know about them?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's not going to matter. They're going to find me. No one's supposed to get away."

name: LAURA
dialogue: You did!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: There's always a first time.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't even know where to begin." He adjusts himself, sliding back, putting his back against the wall of the cell.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I reach into the Bag of Holding. I pull out the little goblet, and I pour some ale into a cup, and I hand him a little bit of ale. No, it's fine. I take a little sip.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Please don't take offense if I don't trust a drink from strangers who've, well, to be honest, "put me in this position."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: All right. I put it beside him.

name: MATT
dialogue: "What do you want to know?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: We want to know if the Briarwoods--

name: SAM
dialogue: Are vampires.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Pretty much. They're vampires, right? I mean, they're vampires.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All I know from the stories I've heard. Mothers would tell their kids not to wander out at "night because dark things crawl in the shadows. From what I know of vampires, they're not supposed "to go out during the day, right? But I'm sure I've seen Lady Briarwood walk in the sun many a time."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Only Lady Briarwood?

name: MATT
dialogue: "As I recall, yes. Lord Briarwood doesn't make too many public appearances."

name: SAM
dialogue: Have there been any strange goings-on in their residence? Sounds you've heard? People disappearing? Boxes coming in or out?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I cast Cure Wounds on him. I know Cure Wounds, bitches! Level up!

dialogue: Have I reached the keep yet?

You get to him just as he can react, briefly.

name: LAURA
dialogue: 11. Do I add anything to that?

dialogue: I believe you add your Wisdom modifier to that.

name: MATT
dialogue: He goes, "Look, my father worked for the de Rolo family before the Briarwoods came. My father "vanished the night of their fall. My mother was taken in madness and lost to the night this past "year. I was left alone. However, I knew the roads well between here and Whitestone and places "between, growing up, traveling with my father. So I was made to be a coachman for the new nobles. I "was paid, albeit little, and I was left alone. "Now, when I say the new nobles, there were nobles that lived in Whitestone and worked along with the "de Rolos, and they helped oversee parts of the town, the business, and the people. They had been "there for many generations of their respective families, all under the de Rolos' guidance. But "the night the castle fell, those nobles were dragged out. "It's strange. I mean, after the brutality of that first night, it took days before the people of "Whitestone knew what had happened. We saw the fires, we heard the battles, but no word of the victors "until three days had passed. We were too scared to approach. By then, the Briarwoods called a town "meeting. They explained their new rule over the town. A number objected, which is expected. Many "strong-willed folk in Whitestone, those days. They were subsequently shot down at arrow-point. The "rest were quiet. "They then dragged out the noble families and executed them, gifting their property and titles to the "various cut-throats and mercenaries they had hired, brought across the channel to help them "take the town. They're not just two people; they've used a lot of money and influence from wherever "they came from and brought a whole slew of very dastardly folk, who have since been given the "titles once held by the other nobles of Whitestone, living in their homes, taking their "tithes and most of the profits made from the businesses they've forced us to continue to run from within "the city. A number of families fled into the woods the night after the executions, using the shadows "of a moonless evening to keep safe. They were all found hanging from the Sun Tree the next morning. "They kept things going as they were, mostly: farming, logging, manning the white marble mines. "Business went as usual, all filling the pockets of the new nobles and the Briarwoods. We were given "food, kept our immediate property. As long as we didn't attempt to leave, we were promised safety. "That lasted for a few years, until the nobles grew bored. Twitchy. They began to abuse the "people of Whitestone: scare us for fun, brand, cut, steal the children, leave them back, "destroyed. They treat us like animals. Folks went missing. I was beaten so bad by my employer, Count "Tylieri. But Lord Briarwood noticed, one night he was passing through the city. He saw wounds on my "back when he was meeting with Count Tylieri. When he asked me in private how I got them, I couldn't "lie. Couldn't resist him. He has a way of drawing the truth out of you. Now, he told me this "unrefined violence was boorish to him and his wife. That was the last I ever saw of Lord "Tylieri. "Lord and Lady Briarwood took me in as their own driver and showed me Tylieri hanging from that "same Sun Tree the next morning. I was thankful, then. In a strange way, life had been so terrible "for so long, it was the first time I saw someone reach out and save me. They took me in as their "driver after that. It was a better thing to be away from the anger and the fists of the thugs. "But the more I got to know the Briarwoods, the more nightmarish I realized they were. "Behind the walls of that castle was no longer a grand fortress that we heard it was. Seeing it, "keeping watch and guard over our people. No, that was a domain of perverse magics and sacrilege, it was. The "green fog drifting out from the ground where it stood. The same servants still run the halls, but "they aren't living. They're walking vessels of undeath, their flesh slowly tearing away. The "garden in back lies shriveled, a foul green mist forever pouring out. They're excavating something "in the dungeon, plundering pieces. A lot of their attention seems to be down there; I don't know "why. I dare not wander too far down. They bring up old things. Ancient things. Relics, books, bones. "You live in that world long enough, you believe there is no way out. Death would be easy, though "I've seen that death is no real end there. It's just the beginning of a whole new terrible "existence. A far worse fate."

name: LAURA
dialogue: If we keep you here, protected, would you be willing to tell your story to someone else?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Who would you want me to tell it to?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: The emperor. The guards here. An army that could go and fight the Briarwoods.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Maybe."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: This could be an option to save Whitestone, and you would have your freedom.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't know. You don't know what it's like. You don't know what they've done. They're "going to find me."

name: SAM
dialogue: We can protect you. We are safe here in this keep, and you're surrounded by very powerful allies now.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We've stood before them, and we did not fall.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's true.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'll think about it."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Would you like to stay in the guest room upstairs? You'd be more comfortable. You could get a good night's rest.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Far more comfortable. A little less safe. I'm going to put it out there.

name: MATT
dialogue: That resonates with him immediately, and his eyes flash open. "I mean no disrespect, but if "this is safe, then I'd rather stay here."

name: LAURA
dialogue: I think it is. And we will bring a bed down to you, make sure you're comfortable. I don't want you sleeping on the floor. That's terrible.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You're all being very accommodating."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You'll get every consideration for protection. We value your info very much.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You're also the key to our own freedom, so it's important.

name: SAM
dialogue: You also caught us on a day where we're trying to be nicer to people. (laughter) Lucky for you.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Just be glad you're not an old woman.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'll stay here for now."

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I need to think on it. I've been promised such protection before."

name: SAM
dialogue: From the Briarwoods?

name: MATT
dialogue: "From a few. And they're dead. An enemy of an enemy doesn't necessarily make them a friend, "I've discovered."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No, but it can make them allies if they have mutual enemies. Of their enemies. It's a little complicated.

name: MATT
dialogue: This whole conversation, the emotional recalling of everything, you can see has been very taxing on him and his still mostly conscious state. He looks exhausted, scared, and still trying to suss out all the information coming at him right now.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Grog, why don't you carry the bed down from upstairs?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Not a problem. Keep the goblet nearby. It is very nice ale.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Would you like something to eat?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes, please."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We'll have our staff bring down some food.

name: MATT
dialogue: He takes the goblet. He looks at it, smells it, but still holds it at bay as you walk off. You eventually go-- easy enough for you-- take the bed. You have to turn it to the side to take it out, which causes all of the cushions to fall out.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Aw, shit. (laughter) I grab a little pillow with my toes, and I hobble down.

name: MATT
dialogue: It takes about 20 minutes and three trips, but you manage to get the bed down there from the guest room.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Not a problem.

name: MATT
dialogue: When you fit it in the cell-- and it's not a large cell; it's maybe ten by ten feet maximum. You place it there. As you guys walk back, you notice as you see Grog walking back down the stairway-- right around the corner as you go down the steps, the hallway goes to the cell, and it turns to the right and to the left to the workshop. You see around the corner a shoulder, listening in. There's a person. And you recognize that it is Percy. Percy has stepped out of the workshop and apparently has been hearing everything this entire time.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Are you all right?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm fine." And Percy immediately steps away and you hear the door close with a slam.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Give him time.

name: SAM
dialogue: So moody!

name: LAURA

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Somebody talk to him before I kill this fucking bird.

name: ORION
dialogue: I am talking to him.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I land beside Tiberius and come out of eagle form. Tiberius, would you please Dispel this cow form from me. Please? Thank you.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. And with that, you cast Dispel Magic and Keyleth's form reverts that to Keyleth. Normal Keyleth. Non-cow Keyleth. The gnome character now has the staff at the back and has a hand in front and is like, (panting).

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Are you a druid? I'm also a druid. I think our goals might be aligned.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Really?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's okay. What's her name?

name: MATT
dialogue: "This creature has no name to it yet. I, myself, am a protector of the wild, as you claim "to be, as well. I have no tribe but the trees around me. I hear the whisper of the wind, and it "calls for justice."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I can relate to that.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Then why do you follow? Why do you insist on harming this creature?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Because we were seeking justice for other people.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Why? For the civilized folk of the city? You should know more than most. They sit there, "taking beautiful creatures of nature, making them fat and formless and worth nothing. To "slaughter them without life and purpose to their existence."

name: ORION
dialogue: The life and purpose of their existence is to keep those other people alive.

name: MATT
dialogue: "And why is it not the same with this creature? If they cannot guard their livestock, "why is it not food for this thing, as well? It is the natural life cycle that they've removed "themselves from."

name: ORION
dialogue: When one has an establishment, when one grows its own crop, and one steals something, it is considered a crime.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, when one is not part of that civilization, but the civilization of the world as "a whole, which requires hunting for what keeps you alive, perhaps that does not sink or hang on my "conscience."

name: ORION
dialogue: Fair point.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Let's not let this escalate. Okay? What is your name?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I was once called Byron."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Vyron?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Byron."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Byron.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I have not heard my name nor spoken words for many years."

name: ORION
dialogue: Would you not like to be called Byron, or would you like something else, like B-roy or B-man? My name's Tiberius Stormwind from Draconia. And this is my friend Keyleth, who is also a druid. And we also have a friend who is a gnome who sings songs and whatnot.

name: MATT
dialogue: The bird, now looking of much better health than it was when it arrived, now flutters its wings out in a stretching motion. And as it does, its head glides down and looks right towards you. This giant beak that looks like it could snap you in two with a single bite.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I reach up to it and reach out to pet its beak.

name: MATT
dialogue: I'm going to ask you to make an animal handling check on this. Just to see where this goes.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay.

name: SAM
dialogue: I gently start swooping down to check on my friends.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. The large bird-type creature retracts from your attempted touch and begins to rear back into the nest in a defensive position. Doesn't bite your hand off.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I kneel down a bit. Produce a few Goodberries. Reach out.

name: SAM
dialogue: Bye, Keyleth. This is how we lose one of our members. Feeding a bird.

name: MATT
dialogue: The creature leans forward and the giant bird, you can see its dark, black eyes staring at you. Each eye probably about the size of your torso. As the giant beak comes down, you can see the moonlight gliding off the smooth exterior of the dark black beak. It smells. And you take 27 points of piercing damage as the animal takes the Goodberries and almost your entire hand with it, as well. At that size, it's hard to be gentle.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's okay. It's all right.

name: MATT
dialogue: So you retract your hand, which is now essentially in many ways, bones are broken, feels like. There's blood streaming down the side of your hand, and (dripping).

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's a good girl.

name: SAM
dialogue: Is it?

name: MATT
dialogue: Swallows.

name: SAM
dialogue: Is it a good girl?

name: ORION
dialogue: I'm feeding a tiny snack to Lockheed.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I turn back to Byron--

name: SAM
dialogue: And say, ow.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, and go, that hurt. Now. Please listen to me. Please, please listen to me. We did come here to kill the giant creature.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I had assumed."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But upon seeing the situation, upon approach, realized the situation and decided amongst all of us that we did not want to bring such a great creature to its death.

name: MATT
dialogue: Scanlan, you've landed by now. A pterodactyl. A cow-looking pterodactyl.

name: ORION
dialogue: As he swoops, I've never seen anything quite like it.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a persuasion check.

name: ORION
dialogue: I'm going to aid her, too.

name: SAM
dialogue: All I've seen so far is Keyleth's bloody hand.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: 20 total.

name: MATT
dialogue: You have advantage on this because Tiberius is aiding you on this conversation.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'll take that 20 total.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. He looks at you. "Well, shall you leave us, then?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Under one condition.

name: MATT
dialogue: "There's always a condition. You call yourself a druid, yet you speak like the civilized "folk. I get the feeling that perhaps your connection to nature has not been tended to for "some time."

name: ORION
dialogue: No, she really knows her stuff. I mean, we just fought this fire guy--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Just because one can appreciate nature, does not mean that one cannot also appreciate humanity.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, this beautiful creature is the only surviving young of a clutch, bred by a majestic "roc high in the Cliffkeep Mountains. Its mother now lies dead, slain by the brutal giants that "wander those peaks. This young'un is all that remains of that clutch and the memory of that "blessed entity."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's a young'un?

name: MATT
dialogue: This is a young one. "This new home serves us well. Abundance of feed. Lack of large, "predatory creatures. I believe this is where we'll stay."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Question. If this is a young, adolescent creature, what do you think of the destruction it could cause once it reaches full adulthood? Are you okay with having that on your conscience? This creature could result in the lives of many. If you relocate out of town, just a few miles. Say like 50 or 100 or so because this thing's really damn big. So I'm sure it's got a pretty big-- you know what I mean.

name: ORION
dialogue: Or just the other way.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I will help you. I will personally come with you and tend to their safety. And make sure that their location is proper and safe, and handled with respect. Then you will be out of the harms of poachers. You can live off the land, and you can be free and alone.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Do you think we came straight to this mountain range? Do you think this is the first "nest we've constructed? Me and this lone survivor have scoured the length of this side of Tal'Dorei. "This, as far as I can see, is the safest. It's the most ignored by nearby civilization."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Listen--

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm going to drop Seeming and also drop my form of pterodactyl.

name: MATT
dialogue: All of you now, your forms change. As this happens mid-sentence, it's noticed immediately by the gnome druid, who's like (gasps).

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes! That is correct. Listen. We are being nice. Don't think that we will be the first. You will have more people come and hunt you and kill this, as this beast continues. How long do you think you can survive waves of mercenaries coming to try and kill this? We are the nice ones. I suggest you heed our warning, take our help, and save the life of you and your creature in the long run.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You have yet to provide a suitable alternative."

name: ORION
dialogue: Oh! I might have an idea.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: There is an alternative. Tiberius can tell you of that alternative.

name: ORION
dialogue: Yes! See, your creature is rather large and powerful, yes? You have a rather strong bond with him, which is quite unique with such a unique looking creature.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I was setting you up for an awesome one-liner, man! You were supposed to be like, the other option is death.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Ask him if he's considered Whitestone?

name: ORION
dialogue: Whitestone? Yeah! Well, I guess there's a couple of options, really. There's this town Whitestone that's pretty great and has a lot of livestock that this creature can consume.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, I don't know about that.

name: MATT
dialogue: Go ahead and make a deception check.

name: ORION
dialogue: That is a 24.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Whitestone. How far is this Whitestone?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Wait! No! Hang on! No! This is getting out of control already. I will not let you all do this! No! Not today. You guys have caused enough problems. We are not going to push this creature on other people. I'm trying, all right? I'm working on it. I don't want to push this problem off on a town that's already being held hostage by vampires. That fucking sucks! That's double shitting on them.

name: ORION
dialogue: Well, the other option was, like I was saying, perhaps you can form an agreement with Emon. I'm sure it would pay in livestock rather well for the protection of you, such a powerful druid, over at least a section of the land. In exchange for free food for your friend.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You, dragon man, are adorably naive of the ways of men and those that lie and deceive. I have "yet to have met any civilized people who have kept their word when it came to creatures like this."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can I come forward? All right. What about Vasselheim? Not in the city, but outside of it. There's plentiful forests, tons of giant creatures it could feed on.

name: ORION
dialogue: That's right! That's true!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That actually is fairly true.

name: LAURA
dialogue: There's so many monsters out there, they don't hunt them all because there's too many.

name: ORION
dialogue: That's a wonderful idea, Vex. Yes!

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a persuasion check.

name: ORION
dialogue: I'll aid her, as well.

name: MATT
dialogue: I'll say you've aided one person recently. This'll just be her check on this. He really doesn't trust you, given the current circumstances.

name: MATT
dialogue: Natural 20.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Then as a natural 20, you know that's good for you. That's the best place you can go. You can see the wisdom in my persuasion.

name: ORION
dialogue: It is true, though. I mean, it's just feed walking all around for it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Please, please listen to us. We're only trying to help.

name: SAM
dialogue: Is there a young creature around here besides the--

name: MATT
dialogue: No, looking about you, no.

name: SAM
dialogue: There's no babies there?

name: MATT
dialogue: No. This is the young. This bird is like the adolescent.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Please believe me. I let this thing almost take my hand off, and I'm still standing here fairly cogently talking to you, so please take that as a sign of honesty.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I go and put my hand on her back and cast Cure Wounds, because I got that spell now, yo!

name: SAM
dialogue: Where are we telling them to go?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: To Vasselheim.

name: SAM
dialogue: Vasselheim?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Listen. She's right. We have friends in Vasselheim. We can contact the Slayer's Take. We're a part of their guild. We can tell them that you're coming. They'll not bother you. We can tell them they are not allowed to take out a contract on your creature. You will not be harmed.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Don't bring up contracts, Keyleth. Maybe just don't even bring it up.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Because they don't have mercenaries out there. It has to be approved! So it's really good.

name: MATT
dialogue: "And what's to stop them from hunting down a majestic creature as rare as this one?"

name: ORION
dialogue: Us!

name: MATT
dialogue: "You, who live here in Emon?"

name: ORION
dialogue: Yes. No, us who are members of the guild.

name: MATT
dialogue: "So you also are monster slayers, who come here under the guise to slay this monster?"

name: ORION
dialogue: No! Not here. Other places that we're forced to do it. But still we're members.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's too much talk."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Can we kill this thing now? You guys are doing awesome.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I feel like I've done pretty damn good! Come on, man!

name: SAM
dialogue: I start speaking in Gnome to him. Listen. Earlier, you said that this place was perfect. It was safe. There were no large predators. Well, you're looking at six large predators. We'll keep hunting you down and hunting your beast down until you get out of here. This is your one and only warning. You must leave, and you must leave now. We're giving you a good choice, a safe choice. We can help you get there and be safe there. But if you don't listen to us, we'll start killing.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a persuasion roll.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: How many fucking persuasion rolls does this asshole need?

name: SAM
dialogue: Persuasion?

name: MATT
dialogue: This is essentially a conversational skill challenge. So every success and failure leads towards where the conversation's going to end.

name: MATT
dialogue: He gives you a look. Very intense, looking into your very essence-type stare. His little beady gnomish eyes meeting yours. (sighs) "If we're going to make this journey to where you say "this Vasselheim is, how far is it?"

name: SAM
dialogue: Several days' journey.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's just across the water. You could fly no problem over it.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Across the sea?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It's across the sea.

name: SAM
dialogue: We can draw you a map. We can give you provisions. We'll even make sure the farmers provide you with a few pieces of livestock to chow down on before the journey. A parting gift to fuel up before the big ride. We can give you papers to hand to the Slayer's Take that will ensure that you'll be treated fairly.

name: ORION
dialogue: I'll take out my Scroll of Telescription and start writing a note.

name: MATT
dialogue: He looks back towards Keyleth, looks back at Scanlan, looks back at Keyleth, looks up at the bird.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Please. We really don't need another death on our conscience today.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Then looks like we don't have much of a choice, do we? If you can assure us enough food to "get across on this journey, we'll make our way towards this Vasselheim. I pray on the solidarity "between our kin, and our kin, that you speak the truth that resonates this moment. Because if it "does not, may the fall of this entity and myself weigh on your conscience."

name: ORION
dialogue: I flip over the note that I'm writing to him and then I trigger it (flying noise) as he's reading it.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. It (poof) vanishes. "As the sun rises, two sizable pieces of livestock to be "placed at the boundaries of the usual hunting site. If those are there, and it is taken without "any sort of aggression, we'll take that as a sign that you are being honest, and we shan't bother "you or your people any further."

name: SAM
dialogue: I bow deeply and when I do, it goes (cowbell ringing).

name: MATT
dialogue: For a moment, you think you hear a slight, uncontrollable chuckle from the gnome.

name: ORION
dialogue: As that's going on, because we're going to head back right now to seal this up, right? Then I'll do my Teleportation Circle. Which is closer to the northeast: the Lyceum or the Keep?

name: MATT
dialogue: To the north side of it? That would be the Lyceum.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We could fly back pretty fast. Couldn't we?

name: MATT
dialogue: If he has another Fly spell, you could take it right back.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, we can just fly back.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Before he leaves. Well, wait! We've got to go to the farm.

name: SAM
dialogue: We've got to go to the farmers. We've got to buy some cows off them.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And I tell him, if you're up that way, there's a druidic tribe, a little village called Pyrah. They're Fire Ashari. You can find their headmaster Cerkonos. He's a friend. You might find your people there. Who knows? Maybe friends will do you good.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Ashari, you say? My dealings with them have been mixed. Perhaps I'll keep my distance."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can I see if there's any feathers dropped from the giant bird creature?

name: MATT
dialogue: There are ample around.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can I grab a few of them?

name: MATT
dialogue: As you go and reach up, slaps you across the knuckles.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can I have a feather that he dropped?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Why?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Because they're beautiful. You have to admit they're beautiful.

name: MATT
dialogue: (sighs) "Elves. All right."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Thank you.

name: MATT
dialogue: You take three roc feathers.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: They're huge, right?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. They're almost boat size.

name: ORION
dialogue: I put one in my Bag of Holding, too.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys manage to get one for you and three for you guys before he's like, "Now go! Now! My "patience wears thin. I'm through with talking words." (sighs)

name: SAM
dialogue: Sorry.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I walk out from behind him and just walk past.

name: MATT
dialogue: (yelps)

name: SAM
dialogue: (laughs) Sorry about that.

name: ORION
dialogue: All right. I'll burn another 5th-level and then fly us all out.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. You guys coast back to the north side of Emon. You go to the door where the Klaus family is, and you speak with them for a while. You manage to convince them of the situation and what seems to be a mutually positive circumstance. They agree it's better to lose two cows than continue this.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I pay them for their two cows. Being nice, man!

name: MATT
dialogue: How much do you give them?

name: LAURA
dialogue: How much are cows usually worth?

name: MATT
dialogue: You've never purchased a cow, so you don't know.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes I have! I purchased Dork the ox.

name: MATT
dialogue: An ox is not a cow.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Shit! How much do your cows normally cost, darling?

name: MATT
dialogue: This is a good question. Let me look in the book. I've not had to look up the cost of a cow before. I would put it at about maybe 40 gold each.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's way more than I expected.

name: MATT
dialogue: Because they can be used for meat, they can be used for milk.

name: LAURA
dialogue: 40 gold each to make up for the loss of your cows.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Thank you so much. I greatly appreciate you helping with this. And you promise, this will--"

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, just put them out in the open field.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We'll take them.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, we'll take them?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We'll put them out there. Stake them.

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay, we'll take care of it.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys take two of the cows. You bring them to the outskirts. With rope tied around their neck, you essentially hitching-post them to the outside of this open area, about 20 to 30 feet from the actual holding pen. A few hours go by, and the sun slowly begins to rise.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Along with some other food, right?

name: MATT
dialogue: Place some of their feed and things around there. Eventually, the sun begins to rise across the eastern sky. As it crests, you can see some of the farmers come out, anxiously watching from their homes. You see different families gathering. The wings beating in the air, and it swoops down (swoosh) and grabs two of them. You can see some of the families gasp and rush inside, and some are amazed to see this even happen. It takes the two, carries them up, and heads out over the Ozmit Sea, passing to the northwest side, and over the next 30 or so minutes, slowly disappears over the horizon until it's no longer visible.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: The sun rose, right? Can I make a beard check? (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: You may.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Two, zero.

name: MATT
dialogue: With that, (creak) the beginnings of the other side of your beard slowly begins to set in.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What happens to the existing side?

name: MATT
dialogue: The existing side has rounded itself off to a nice beard. It's pretty much where it's going to be on that side. The other side is now starting to finally catch up. And that's where we'll end: on a successful beard check.

name: SAM
dialogue: Wow. That was a crazy night.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Perspiration was happening.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, it was.

name: SAM
dialogue: I gave you my hand.

name: MATT
dialogue: More battle maps that will never get used.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Look at us not fighting things. That's really beautiful.

name: MATT
dialogue: That would have been really bad, too.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm glad we didn't fight it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Bad for us?

name: MATT
dialogue: Well, just imagine a giant bird that grabs you and then drops you off the side of a mountain. Would have been an interesting fight. Cool. That concludes a unique Percy-less bottle episode of Critical Role.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Squadron of cows.

name: MATT
dialogue: Squadron of flying midnight cows. That is probably the weirdest thing that's ever-- no, there's been weirder. That's in the top five of weird things that's happened in DND for me.

name: SAM
dialogue: Fighting "formootion." (groaning) [end of transcript]

dialogue: It's a weird word, the Winga Stage?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I love it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: They are pretty sexy.

dialogue: We're going to be on the Wikia stage.

dialogue: The Wikia stage on Saturday, near hall 1A, the Wikia stage at noon to 2:00 PM. Come find us on Saturday, we're going to be there. dialogue: They look so cool.

dialogue: Pretty rad. I'm really excited. They're metal and awesome. They're of our logo and if you feel like being as nerdy as we are and want to adorn your key chains with them, they are there available for your purchase.

dialogue: They're custom order, so they make them when you order them. It takes a few weeks to get them once you order them, but it's worth it.

dialogue: Mithril's hard to sculpt properly. Takes a while. Couple of other things, LARP: the Series, one of the live action series here in Geek and Sundry. Season two just premiered today. dialogue: I drew that shirt, by the way. I had to look at his face for 12 hours.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You're welcome.

dialogue: We've already hit 9,100. Protocol95, you are the first winner of the night!

[dramatic music] So to get you guys caught up on what happened recently, the group, having heard that the Briarwoods, a couple who had taken power in the town of Whitestone far to the northeast, apparently responsible for the destruction of Percy's entire family and his escape into the wilds of Tal'Dorei, were going to be coming to Emon to bridge a political handshake with Sovereign Uriel and all of Tal'Dorei proper to build a bridge across the channel that separates this continent from Wildemount across the sea. Upon hearing this, the party was planning to gather information, and in doing so Vax got himself caught by sneaking into their bedroom and was nearly killed in the process. The group managed to aid him, pull him out from the jaws of death, and the Briarwoods escaped through arcane means, leaving a shattered carriage, a mostly beaten driver of their carriage. Through the scuffle, a number of guards were hurt or killed, and the party, upon meeting an individual named Lilith, a tiefling, leading her back to the Keep, they were attacked, or seemingly attacked, by a series of bounty hunters that were after her. There was some intense violence displayed against a few of them, and this all got back to the Council. The Council called Vox Machina to the central palace and began a trial to see if they were responsible for attacking guests of the Council, ruining what could've been a very lucrative union between the two towns and possibly murdering an old woman. They had their membership revoked, and during this sequence, apparently the charmed Seeker Asum was restored, seemingly to little effect. The group then left, realizing that perhaps the moral ramifications of their actions are having a bigger impact due to their visibility and their heroic status in the kingdom at large. When they returned to the keep, they found two representatives of the northern farmers of Emon that required aid; their livestock had been stolen over the past few weeks and was putting them in dire straits when it came to the necessary amount of meat they had to raise. The group, trying to turn their morality on its head, decided to aid, waited out in the center of the cow pasture at night, masquerading, through illusionary magic, as cows themselves. The giant roc, a gargantuan bird, swooped down and grabbed Cow-leth, Keyleth, here. Swept her away. The rest of the party, Tiberius enabled to fly through arcane means, and thus we had a squadron of evening cows chasing after the roc, which then got turned into a cow, to crash into a mountain. They chased it back to its perch up in the Cliffside Mountains to the northwest of Emon.
