Your father Frederick, a blade jutting from his chest, slick with crimson. Your mother, Johanna, burned with irons, screaming. Cassandra, running towards you, calling your name into the night, begging you to help. One, two, three arrows. She falls. Darkness once more. Darkness and red. Red of blood. Red of burning fire. The sky is fire. The world burns with flame and iron. The smoke rises from the cinders, coalescing into a face, black as soot with eyes as burning coals, and a wicked grin. It speaks with a raspy, rumbling bass, like a slow-moving landslide. "You hold your vengeance, Percival. You made it. You only need to take it for yourself. "Make the world right. My gift is yours, and your gift shall bring justice. Our bargain stands eager "to close." You suddenly come to consciousness, gasping loudly against the air. You feel the warmth of the forge across the side of the workshop crawling across your face. You are sitting at your workbench, having fallen asleep amidst a pile of contraptions in mid-construction. dialogue: I don't think we're here in this city to become lords and ladies serving Uriel, as good a man he is. I think Percival's our ally, and this is a grievous wrong done to him, and we can kill two birds with one stone.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think we are in the situation we're in because we now know how much we don't know. How much I don't know. I'm not prepared. If we face them now, I'm going to get you all killed.

name: ORION
dialogue: I agree. We need proper preparation. Percy, I'm pretty sure you have a good background on vampires and what-have-you, as do I, as I've researched them in the last couple of days. There's other things that we should research, as well, and probably arm ourselves for that kind of conflict, if it comes to it. Quite frankly, I have a feeling if it's the whole town we're dealing with, we need to find out how many innocents there are to save, and if the number is low enough, we can fly in with an army ourselves, which would take some time. The Draconian Knights. I am an ambassador to Draconia, officially, after all the assistance I've sent, in giving them the Wheel of Mending, and proving my point.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You gave them the Wheel?

name: ORION
dialogue: No, I showed it to them, proving that my quest was true, which they gave me full ambassadorship, which means that, if harm comes to a Stormwind, harm comes to all of Draconia. And a town full of vampires and liches--

name: LAURA
dialogue: I didn't know we had a whole army at our disposal. That's wonderful to hear.

name: ORION
dialogue: If worse comes to worst.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Started on the bottom, now we're here.

name: SAM
dialogue: Diplomatic immunity.

name: ORION
dialogue: Even then, our relations must be strong with Emon. We need their allyship, as well. Draconia will not go into things alone. We need a union.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I agree. While we're not serving Uriel, that's not our purpose, I also don't want to leave an enemy of the state. That's not good for me, for what I want.

name: ORION
dialogue: I go up to Jarett. Eight days. What do you think of eight days?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And what, go with Jarett? Not Jarett, Asum.

name: SAM
dialogue: He's not even going where we would be going. We would be going to Whitestone, right? That's where the Briarwoods are.

name: LIAM
dialogue: But Keyleth, Uriel is the law, and the law is now corrupt.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Then why don't we save his mind before we go?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Here's the thing. He's going to find out stuff about the Briarwoods. What's the fucking point of him going if we're just going to go attack the Briarwoods before we know what he knows? We need to let him go, find out his shit, take care of Uriel, wait until he gets back, go take out the Briarwoods--

name: ORION
dialogue: As Vex is saying this, Tiberius is getting a half-chub.

name: TRAVIS, LAURA
dialogue: A what?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, that's just weird.

name: ORION
dialogue: You can't see it because it's inside.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes, but you said it out loud.

name: MATT
dialogue: Anyway.

name: ORION
dialogue: I'm just saying.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's a strategy boner?

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's a strategy chub, all right.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm still weirded out.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You've got to give context to those things, man.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's an odd choice of words, but now 30 seconds later, I see what you mean

name: ORION
dialogue: Sorry. Her brain. That's what I'm talking about.

name: MATT
dialogue: Asum says, "My getting to Wildemount is not easy, nor is it safe. I cannot linger for long. "Maybe a few days."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: How soon will you return?

name: MATT
dialogue: "That depends on if I even return. Every spy I've sent to seek information on the Briarwoods or "to Whitestone has not come back."

name: ORION
dialogue: (ripping noises) I'll give him two strips of Scroll of Telescription. If any harm falls upon you, write on this. I explain what it does.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. How many of those do you have left, by the way?

name: ORION
dialogue: I have 30 tickets left, so 28 now.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I have another idea. Uriel said that-- he was resistant, but he said that he would bring me in to have his people check me out. Check out my story. What if Keyleth and Scanlan rode in my pockets--

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm not that small.

name: LAURA
dialogue: As roaches.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You're pretty small. Just as mice.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Or bugs. Roly-polies!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Magic user's choice. Can you cast magic when you're transformed?

name: SAM
dialogue: No.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So they'd have to pop out. Can you shrink yourself and still do magic teeny-tiny?

name: SAM
dialogue: Are you asking me?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Either of you.

name: SAM
dialogue: No, but I can shit on things. Yes?

name: ORION
dialogue: Can you give the Seeker an inspiration before he goes on an adventure?

name: SAM
dialogue: It could last him 20 minutes, yes. Get him to the docks, maybe.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Seeker, what do you think? What was your goal of coming here?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, do you want us to come with you or what?

name: MATT
dialogue: "My journey requires the utmost of silence, speed, stealth, and I mean no offense to your "entourage, but I think I can do this alone, and should. However, this journey may take me two "weeks, a month, many months-- I do not know. I'm doing this just in case whatever you're choosing "to do fails. At least, if Vox Machina falls in this, I can come back with proof enough to try, and "once the army has been gathered, perhaps we can rally all of Emon against Whitestone."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: If you die, can you write a letter and sign your name saying that we were right, you were wrong, you were full of shit, the Briarwoods are assholes--

name: ORION
dialogue: But a lot more eloquently than that.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Or not.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I can try my best."

name: LAURA
dialogue: That would be lovely.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I go up to his arm, and I Druidcraft a wooden armband. Make it look cool. And put that on him.

name: SAM
dialogue: Onto Tiberius?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No, onto Asum. Now I can scry through that. That way I can at least check in on you every once in a while. If you're okay with that?

name: SAM
dialogue: I could've shat on him and had the same effect.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a persuasion roll.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What about being invisible? Can you cast spells while you're invisible?

name: ORION
dialogue: Only with Greater Invisibility, you can.

name: SAM
dialogue: We've always sought out the path of the most glory, and I think that that is the Briarwoods. Going into a giant, vampire-lich-ridden castle and killing two evil bastards amid their army of protectors is the coolest thing we could ever do.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's super-duper cool. Here's the thing: it's not going to be just two, I don't think. It's going to be an entire town of people that they've controlled.

name: SAM
dialogue: You think we can get into Sovereign Uriel without anyone detecting magic on us? He's got clerics all round him--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, but Seeker Asum knows all the ins and outs of the palace.

name: LIAM
dialogue: He's leaving town tomorrow.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We'd have to do it stat, but he knows how to get in.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He did say it was an inspired idea. His words.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Regardless, you have to make a choice soon. I cannot dilly-dally. I'll take your band, yes." He takes the wooden band and puts it around his arm and says, "If this will put you at ease, I'll "take it."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Don't worry. I won't abuse it, I promise. Could you potentially help us with sneaking in the castle?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I could get you in the door, but I could not escort you to that room. That would put myself "in extreme danger and the entirety of our mission."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Could you distract people?

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughs) "I can do that quite well, yes."

name: SAM
dialogue: We can get there, but something tells me we're still going to be fighting a big fight in a palace. I'd rather fight that big fight in the Briarwoods'.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Scanlan and I are in agreement, and here's the problem. If things go south in Uriel's palace, we are then forced to fight against people who are good and true, or give up and go to jail, which sucks.

name: SAM
dialogue: But in the Briarwoods', we can kill every motherfucker in that place.

name: ORION
dialogue: There are a number of innocents that we need to figure out, still.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What if we talk to Allura?

name: SAM
dialogue: You killed an old lady!

name: ORION
dialogue: She attacked us! And I will not back down from that decision.

name: SAM
dialogue: She did have an old lady smell.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: All right. Can we just vote on something, please? Since Percy's being oh-so-quiet about all this.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Percy is being very quiet about this.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are you sure you have nothing to say?

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's fucking your family. It's the people that attacked your family. Do you have no contribution to this?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I still feel I owe everybody an apology. I still feel terrible about dragging you all into this and putting you in danger.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We're choosing to do it.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Vengeance." A voice whispers in your ear, Percy. No one hears this. "Vengeance."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: If you're with me, we can be prepared for them this time. We know enough to prepare ourselves, we can have ourselves ready this time.

name: ORION
dialogue: How many days do we have? I would like eight days to prepare.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can I see if he looks like shaken or fucked up at all?

name: MATT
dialogue: I mean, he looks shaken and fucked up, yeah. He's obviously had a horrible few days.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think a week to prepare is reasonable.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And then leave.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And then we leave. We leave quietly.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Wait, we're leaving to Whitestone?

name: TRAVIS, LAURA
dialogue: Yes.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I've been avoiding it for too long, and now I know too much.

name: LIAM
dialogue: The law of this land is compromised. Percival, I agree with you. I think this is the right choice.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: All in favor, say aye. ALL (except Orion): Aye. All opposed, say nay. Nice.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Then it is settled. I'll be on my way."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Wait! Before you go, could I talk to you?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Certainly."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Were you going to say anything else? Because I'll talk to you in private.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Three days and I'll be off on my side of the mission. Very well."

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'll follow you out.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yes, and he walks out, walks with you.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Hold on, I'm going to hold you before you go. I just wanted to say, I'm so sorry and thank you. And thank you for doing this for me. I fear my temper before this weight is lifted from my heart. I do not wish to lose myself like that again, and I am so sorry for everything I've done.

name: ORION
dialogue: Tiberius puts his hand on Percy's shoulder, and go, I'm sorry for the tragedy which is your family, and what these Briarwoods have befallen to them, and I will promise you, I will do my best to have you give that final blow from that barrel to the names assigned to them. But now it is a far dangerous situation, as you very well know.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I will do my best to maintain myself. I apologize.

name: MATT
dialogue: And as you all scatter, Percy, as you walk out, the same voice creeps into your ear, "Yes." Now, as you step out with Seeker Asum, who now has a bit of haste to his step, arms crossed, looking around. "So you wish to speak with me?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes, I do. You're a ranger.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I am."

name: LAURA
dialogue: You're very sneaky.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I can be."

name: LAURA
dialogue: I've only ever seen people like thieves, like my brother, do things like you've done. Can you teach me anything that you know to help me maybe be a little more stealthy, as well?

name: MATT
dialogue: (sighs) "We'll go over what you know, and perhaps there are a few tricks that I can teach you "in the three days I have. I can't guarantee that it'll be extremely changing, as that's a very "short time to train over what I've learned over a lifetime, but I can certainly attempt."

name: LAURA
dialogue: I appreciate it.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I require your concentration for those days, though, before I leave."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Utmost.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right. Meet me at the morrow, crack of dawn. I'll be at the front of your keep."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Very well." And he heads off, outside of the keep. The rest of you, what are you doing?

name: ORION
dialogue: I go to my laboratory.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What time is it?

name: MATT
dialogue: About 3:00, 4:00 in the afternoon now.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That temple of Sarenrae is in the city.

name: MATT
dialogue: It's part of the keep, yeah. Oh, you mean the actual temple you went to? That is inside the city, yes. You can go into the city; you just can't get to the Cloudtop District.

name: ORION
dialogue: Use the earring real quick. I'm going to write a quick letter. If anybody goes shopping, let me know.

name: MATT
dialogue: Tiberius loves shopping.

name: LAURA
dialogue: He really, really does.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right, we'll go ahead and take a quick break. We'll be back in five minutes. Keep it a stringent break, guys.

name: LIAM
dialogue: So errands will happen after that break? Because I have some errands that I want to do.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yes. We'll try to keep the errands pretty concise so we can keep on schedule, yeah, so it's like, use this break to conjecture exactly what you want to do. All right, guys, we'll see you back here in five minutes. [break] Welcome back. So to try and expedite this, over the next period of time you guys want to take to prepare, what are you going to do? Percy.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm going to finish up those things that we talked about earlier, spend some time making some ammunition, and I'm going to attempt to build what we were talking about earlier.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Go ahead and make a tinkering check for your ammunition.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What we were talking about? Can I help him with that? Can I assist him?

name: MATT
dialogue: I would say the tinkering, the mechanisms involved, would be so far beyond your understanding as a druid. Even just metalwork in general. You can cheer him on, but would not be able to assist him with it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Go Percy, go! That's pretty good.

name: MATT
dialogue: 24? Okay. You manage to produce 25 rounds for your Pepperbox and ten rounds for the Bad News.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Ooh, that's good.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You still have inspiration from Scanlan?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, I used that.

name: MATT
dialogue: Used that to repair his Pepperbox. Roll for the secondary construction. Smoke bombs.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Okay. 11.

name: MATT
dialogue: 11. You take a better part of two days attempting to get these to work, and most of your materials are ruined, unfortunately. You manage to come out with it with, and I want you to write this down, "smoke bomb, question mark." It may function. We will see upon use. But you have one at your disposal that is questionable. However, for the cost of the ammunition and the cost of the smoke bomb's construction, already that comes to about, I'd say 75 gold pieces, so mark that off. And you're attempting to make, you're attempting to make, based on what you told me, an Archimedes death ray.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They're not hard. I say that as, like, knowing my actual skill level, I could make one.

name: MATT
dialogue: You could. To be functional with the materials that are at your disposal, it's going to be very large and hard to move.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We were talking about making it collapsible.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I could make a collapsible one, where it's basically a one-third dodecahedron, like an observatory.

name: MATT
dialogue: You spend the remainder of this week of preparation. Go ahead and roll your tinkering check. This is going to cost you in materials.

name: ORION
dialogue: Wait, hold on, can I pause real quick? You don't need to do this if you want to make more ammo and other stuff. I can do this without you making this and spending the rest of the time, if you want to make other stuff. Option.

name: MATT
dialogue: What do you want to do?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Story-wise it's more amusing.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, go for it. All right, so. The actual materials for this--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's copper.

name: MATT
dialogue: I know, it's copper, but the actual dodecahedron that's involved, the mirrors, the lenses, the whole thing? In order to be of the scale and quality to even make it even remotely functional, all of it for the extremely high quality and some of it custom-made within the first couple days within this, with a rush order. I'd say the total cost is going to come to about 1,200 gold pieces.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'll pitch in for that. How much do you have?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: At this point I have less than 100 gold.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You have less than 100 gold? I'll pay for it in full.

name: ORION
dialogue: What is the diameter of this?

name: MATT
dialogue: The actual focal lens is about this big. The whole construct can be carried by two people.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: But it will fold.

name: ORION
dialogue: I was just going to say, what's the radius of the actual thing's lens?

name: MATT
dialogue: Of the lens itself? This is the radius of the lens. I mean, even when it's collapsed, it can be carried by one person, but it's still a heavy mechanism.

name: ORION
dialogue: So it's only one foot? Two feet? Three feet?

name: MATT
dialogue: I'd say it's about two and a half feet in diameter.

name: ORION
dialogue: Are you sure you want to do that?

name: MATT
dialogue: He's already agreed. Go ahead and roll.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Why? It's fine. This is what we were talking about.

name: MATT
dialogue: 22. Through the materials and the construct of it, you get partway through the final stages of it, and as you're tightening one of the sections, all of a sudden there's a (cracking) sound. Your whole body freezes as you glance over. the lens itself has a giant crack through it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There shouldn't be a glass piece-- aw, man.

name: MATT
dialogue: For the construct for this one, there was a focusing lens that is part of what the initial blast, otherwise there wouldn't be a point of actually projecting a ray from.

name: ORION
dialogue: I thought they were all mirrors.

name: MATT
dialogue: There's all different sorts of construction based on. This one's the one we're going on here, or if you can say the center of it is a gem, but regardless, the tinkering roll was not high enough to construct the device. Sorry.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: The whole thing's wasted? Can we try and repair the crack?

name: MATT
dialogue: It's not something you can repair. The entire piece is constructed from a solid piece.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: What, could we put it on the Mending Wheel?

name: MATT
dialogue: You could attempt to.

name: ORION
dialogue: (grunting) Let's see. Okay. (clicking noise)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I want to go to the store. I would like to get a shovel and a pickaxe.

name: ORION
dialogue: You going to Gilmore's? We're going to Gilmore's, too. We could go together if you're doing that.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I don't give a fuck where we go. Just a shovel and a pickaxe.

name: MATT
dialogue: Pickaxe... comes to four gold pieces for the two of those. You got them. Make a secondary tinkering check.

name: MATT
dialogue: 22. This time you go back and as you're tightening it, the actual metal housing of the device ends up bending in a way that both cracks the gem and causes the frame itself to be dented to the point where the beam will be imperfect. This is a very hard thing that you've come up with in your mind that has not been constructed before, and the level of difficulty to create this is very difficult. It does not cost you additional money, thanks to the Mending Wheel, but right now the entire device looks like to continue, it's going to take more time and money to construct it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (sighs) I can always use this for spare parts for other things.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You're already 1,200 in? How much more would you have to put in?

name: MATT
dialogue: I'd say about half the cost. An additional 600.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And how many more days?

name: MATT
dialogue: Two more days.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: How many more days do we have?

name: MATT
dialogue: You agreed upon eight, so we'd be pushing about seven, then.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I've already built a smoke bomb and some rounds of bullets. All right, I'll put a little more time in this. Can I get some inspiration for this, too, if that would be possible?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Music, you mean?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: There's nothing I can do to help him?

name: MATT
dialogue: Unfortunately-- what's your intellect?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: My intellect? I've got plus three.

name: SAM
dialogue: (singing) Here comes the sun--

name: ALL
dialogue: (singing) It's all right. (vocalizing)

name: LIAM
dialogue: (singing) Kill the vampire.

name: MARISHA, TALIESIN
dialogue: Come on, come on.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Percy roll. Come on.

name: MATT
dialogue: Working on the device a third time, you get it right to the point where you think it could work and you go to set it up, and as you do, you find that the light focuses in a way that actually slowly melts the copper on the outside of the housing of the device, and it begins to melt onto itself, and you have to pull it out of the light. This design is beyond your grasp right now. You're inventing something that takes quite a lot of time to eventually perfect.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Okay. I'm going to put these away for a later time, and if I have one more day, I would like to work on--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Maybe a version of it that is not collapsible that we can at least mount?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We've got it taken care of.

name: MATT
dialogue: That's been your guys' week.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's my week, okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. You bought your pickaxe and your shovel. Cool. Vex, what are you doing?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm training.

name: MATT
dialogue: You're training, okay.

name: LIAM
dialogue: All right. I want to be brief. I have four things I want to do, but I'll be very brief. I promise. Okay, so first thing I want to do is I think at some point, I heard Tiberius talking about wooden stakes and vampires. So I want to go buy about ten wooden stakes.

name: ORION
dialogue: I give him extra. Get me 20.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm going shopping.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes, get me some holy arrows.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Can I get a loaner on that? I've got about 230 gold.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I thought you said you were going to be brief. (laughs)

name: LIAM
dialogue: On my own.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I thought we got a bit of an allowance.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's a week, so I get some gold from these people and I go and I don't even know what they said. I'm getting ten wooden stakes for myself.

name: MATT
dialogue: 20, technically, because Tiberius requested ten. Those will cost you a total of two gold.

name: LIAM
dialogue: That's what I thought. And what did you want?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I wanted some holy arrows.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make an investigation check.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Or holy water. Try to get some holy water. Holy oil.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'll get to that. Investigation, you say? That is a 13.

name: MATT
dialogue: 13. Asking around the town: holy arrows, that is an enchantment. They're pricey and they don't appear to be anywhere in the major shops, even shops like Gilmore's, that they specialize in. It's usually a special order-type thing. Holy water flasks can be purchased at 20 gold apiece.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'll get to that. All right, so we got wood. That was two gold, you said. All right, minus two. The next thing I want to do is go to the temple of Sarenrae and get my sister's holy oil for her. How much is that?

name: MATT
dialogue: Holy oil? As opposed to the holy water?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'll take both, if you've got it.

name: MATT
dialogue: Well, holy oil is a more expensive version. Holy water is a one-use. Holy oil can be applied to a weapon.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Holy oil.

name: ORION
dialogue: How much do the stakes weigh? Like each stake?

name: MATT
dialogue: A cluster of ten, if that's what you wanted, would weigh about five pounds. But they're relatively light.

name: ORION
dialogue: Tell him that he bought me 20 more.

name: SAM
dialogue: Tell him that he bought you?

name: LIAM
dialogue: 40 stakes, four gold. Totally happened. Then I went to the temple of Sarenrae and I got two vials of holy oil. One for my sister, one for me.

name: MATT
dialogue: Those are 100 gold apiece.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Okay. Got it. I can't. Oh, you gave me gold. I'll get four vials of that.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, I gave him gold to do it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We'll work that out, I promise. I ask if the cleric who helped bring Pike back to life is here.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, Tristan is here.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Jesus, how do you do that?

name: MATT
dialogue: Because I have to.

name: LIAM
dialogue: When I find him I say, you remember my friend Pike? You remember me?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes, I inspected you. Is that healing well, by the way?" He inspects the wounds on the side of your neck.

name: LIAM

dialogue: For both persuasion and deception.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Persuasion and deception? Persuasion, six. Deception, two.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. He seems very earnest, very broken. Confused, but driven, and there isn't any part of his voice that seems to conceal or attempt to hold back any information.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are you afraid you're going to hurt us?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No. I'm afraid I'm going to disappoint you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: How would you disappoint us?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I trust that you are all here in the service of justice and maybe friendship. But I'm not. I'm here for revenge. And as much as I would like to believe otherwise, I know that's not true. And I think I need people here who are not here for revenge. I don't know how to stop this.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Just because you started on this path for revenge doesn't mean you can't find other motivations along the way. Do you believe you're not doing this with your friends or for your friends? Not even a little bit; it's only a hundred percent revenge?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No one does anything purely for one reason. And I could justify it, but I'd be lying. I want to hurt them. I want them to know it's me. I want them to feel remorse for what they have done. I want them to pay, and if this thing is real, if this is really what is happening now, I hope that wherever they go, they suffer forever and beyond.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I think that sounds fair.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And I'm so grateful there is justice to be found in it, but it is not justice that I am motivated by. And I couldn't pretend it would be. I am so grateful there is justice in this. But even if there wasn't, I would still be here.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I want to talk about a plan, because our desires are in lockstep up to a point. Once we have gotten rid of the last of them, I want to know what happens then, Percival.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I've never had to think of this before. I think if we get out of this, either I'm going to need you to save me or finish me.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, we won't do that.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: If it comes to it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Damn it, where is Pike?! She would know about this.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: She would.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I miss Pike.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, I do want to save this city.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can we do any kind of religion check to see if we know anything about this kind of entity?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, go ahead and make a religion check.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Three.

name: MATT
dialogue: Suiting.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (laughs) Suiting.

name: MATT
dialogue: I mean, there are all sorts of extraplanar entities throughout the realms that have their own individual descriptions.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Whenever he starts a description with "I mean," it's not good.

name: MATT
dialogue: You don't have a whole lot of experience outside of the realm of mortals. You've had a few interactions with things that skew beyond that realm. While you get that he's saying it may just be a dream, you know that there are multitudes of creatures that thrive on these types of bargains. You do know that many of these bargains in the long run do not end up being wholly in the person's favor who struck it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well, look. It's going to help him on his quest, get revenge and kill all the people that killed his family, right? So can we do that, and then if it gets out of control, we bop him on the head and take him to a temple?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I think that's the best plan we have, actually.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I mean, you were really awesome in that last fight.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You did look pretty amazing, I'm not going to lie.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: A little bit of pee came out. It was that good.

name: LAURA
dialogue: But I don't like how dark it went, Percy. It went really dark.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And here's the thing. There's a thing. There it is, right there. Here's the thing.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh god, I hadn't even noticed. So sorry.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Your chances of succeeding here alone are pretty fucking slim. And if you want us all to work with you, you can't go from door to door, bringing wrath and ruin the way you just did, or you won't have our assistance. Not all of us.

name: SAM
dialogue: Now now, Vax, what are you talking about? We all knew what we were doing when we-- pay attention to me! I'm trying to be serious here. Don't you turn your eyes away from me. Look at me when I'm talking to you. We all knew what we were doing when we went into the house. It was an assassination mission. I don't understand why everyone's harping on how dark it got. We knew we were there to kill everyone in the whole place.

name: LIAM
dialogue: This is a city oppressed. These people did not invite it upon themselves.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That guy deserved it, but we did rip his tongue out, which I think was a bit harsh.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: He said take his tongue.

name: LIAM
dialogue: These people don't want to exchange one warlord for another. We need to maybe dial it back a tick or two.

name: SAM
dialogue: No, I disagree.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I do, too, Pedostache.

name: SAM
dialogue: We have to make a strong appearance. This is shock and awe. We're not going to win over the people by half measures and hey, let's hold an election, or something. We have to kill everyone in as dramatic a fashion as possible.

name: LAURA
dialogue: This is beheading a pony all over again.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You think we're going to win them over by showing them how disgusting we are?

name: SAM
dialogue: No, how disgusting they are, and how disgusting they die.

name: LIAM
dialogue: No. I mean the civilians here.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We're not going to kill civilians!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Of course, but we're trying to win them over, and if we're showing that we're ripping out their tongues and pulling their ears off and flaying their balls, they're going to be just as scared of us as they are of the Briarwoods.

name: LAURA
dialogue: They'll probably be pretty happy that the people that have been hurting them are being punished.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes, they've been oppressed, but we've also seen there's plenty of cases of people being charmed by them. We might have an army of people who will die for the Briarwoods at any cost and not even realizing they're being charmed that way.

name: SAM
dialogue: I wouldn't mind a few people being scared of us, too.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I will say it did get out of hand. And if I had known then what I know now, I would hope that you would restrain me in those moments where I seem to be going further than I should.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Done.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are you saying for your final bullet, you want us to stop you?

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, he's saying that if he goes dark, if he goes against his person that we know--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Knock me out and take me to a temple.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You don't want to scratch the name off the barrel?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I didn't know it was going to disappear, to be fair. I thought that maybe I could stop what was happening to me. I panicked.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Percy, do you realize we tried to talk to you for a good 15 minutes after all that last night, and you were unreachable? Do you remember that? So us saying if you start getting out of control, and you think that we're going to be able to be like, yo Percy, calm it down a bit--

name: LAURA
dialogue: We're not going to do that. We're going to knock him the fuck out!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Don't worry, Percy. We've got you.

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't think I would knock him out.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'll knock you out if you really want me to.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: If I start to turn against you. If you think for a moment that I am out of control. Please, please, do what is necessary. The moment that I turn on any of you, the moment that I even threaten any of you is a moment I am not in control. No matter what is happening.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah. Okay.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I walk up and I kiss him on the cheek. and I say: Don't you worry, we've got you.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Especially with the cough, thank you.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I don't believe you're really sick, darling.

name: SAM
dialogue: Vex, I've heard a cough like that, and it's probably syphilis.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Lovely. Thank you, Scanlan.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I barely sl-- I don't, I--

name: SAM
dialogue: Personal experience, that's all I'm saying.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Shall we rest and then we go find another house?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, maybe we should, now that we have the knock-Percy-out-in-case-of-emergency plan, should we have a revolution plan? Because we seem to be divided on that.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There's still two more lords in the city. And there is the castle. They know we're here now.

name: SAM
dialogue: It might behoove us to spend a day or two finding another shelter, and also seeing what our actions have resulted in, and seeing if we can't sway some opinion in our favor, because we're strong, but we're also pretty weak these days, and I wouldn't want to go against the big guns yet until we have the people behind us. Or at least possibly turn one of those giants to our side or something. We need some help.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We have a map of the city, yes? I think it best to stay off the streets. Is it possible, Keyleth, to tunnel through the city, underneath it?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Good idea.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I can, actually. Yeah.

name: SAM
dialogue: Can't really talk to people that way.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, but they know we're here. It's not safe. We can come up in secret, leave symbols to rally the people, and hide again.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You want to get a beat on the vibe of what people are saying out there?

name: SAM
dialogue: Hey, hep cat, yes. I'm wanting to get a beat on the vibe. Yes, I think we need to hear what people are saying. In the privacy of their homes, maybe. Do some snooping.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, there's a few people in our party who are good at that.

name: SAM
dialogue: And we need to find another potential safehouse.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay, that's plan number one, then. I think it's not a bad idea that we spread this de Rolo family crest around.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Have we been to the Alcove yet?

name: MATT
dialogue: You went to the Alcove-- no, you have not been to the Alcove.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We haven't been to the Alcove or the barracks yet. The barracks are right against the castle, though.

name: MATT
dialogue: Correct. You went to the Lady's Chamber and you spoke briefly with Keeper Yennen.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yeah, with Keeper Yennen.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, let's go to the barracks.

name: MATT
dialogue: And you went to Beyond the Horizon, which was abandoned and partially collapsed.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The barracks will be our last stop, I believe. Just because it's outside the city proper and it's up the hill. We might be able to stay at the Alcove, which is a magic shop that used to be in town. I know the proprietor, or I did, if he's still alive.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, let's go there.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Magic shop? Okay.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It was a magic shop, right?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, it's an arcane boutique, yes.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: An arcane boutique.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Are we tunneling there?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Are we going there now? Are we resting?

name: SAM
dialogue: We should rest.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's nighttime!

name: MATT
dialogue: Right now, I would say, based on preparation, the illusion-casting, conversation, you're looking at about 9:00, 9:30 in the evening.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We could get an early start once the light hits.

name: SAM
dialogue: If you fall asleep, is that illusion going to vanish?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No, I think Hallucinatory Terrain lasts for--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can I sense anything near us? Can I sense vampires above us?

name: MATT
dialogue: So you're looking for undead?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Undead.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. You feel a surrounding presence scattered throughout the city, some large, some small. You can gather over a period of time of concentration, you can feel the slow movement of the zombie giants moving through the city, the sentinels slowly tromping through, and a number of other undead entities there.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Does it feel like there's more in motion than there were before we set off the blaze?

name: MATT
dialogue: I would say yes, there appears to be a little more haste and movement to what entities you can-- and you can't pinpoint specifics, but you do sense that there is a heightened state of movement, to what you've previously sensed.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes I've a thought that at night, obviously, these streets are full of dead things. Tomorrow, the Briarwoods and the people that work for them are going to start pulling people out of their houses and telling them to look for us or anyone who's not from this city, so I don't think that the beggar routine is going to work for much longer.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's why we stay under the city. That's what I said.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Of course, but if you want to talk to people, I think we could probably get away with poking about first thing in the morning and that's it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay.

name: LIAM
dialogue: So we should probably get up early.

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right.

name: SAM
dialogue: And in addition to your excellent illusion spell--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Which lasts for 24 hours.

name: SAM
dialogue: That's wonderful to hear. Is there any other means of protection we have? I mean, if they are magic wielders, they might be able to sense our presence or something. Is there any way to obscure that? I guess I'm asking this, but I'm one of the only two magic wielders here, so I should know the answer.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I was going to say, it would be probably a me and you thing. In terms of making us not as noticeable, Seeming is probably going to be our closest thing. I don't have anything--

name: SAM
dialogue: It's just a visual, though.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Nothing like a bubble of protection or anything?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I've got my Antilife Shell.

name: LAURA
dialogue: But they're undead. Lovely. Well, first watch. Who's taking it?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We can all get a good night's sleep, I think, if I tunnel us in and we've got Hallucinatory Terrain.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I still think we should keep watch.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Percy's got it, yeah. I'll take second.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: All right.

name: MATT
dialogue: So you're all down at the bottom of the tunnel by the roots of the Sun Tree? And you have Hallucinatory Terrained the cellar?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I hate that he's asking for clarification.

name: MATT
dialogue: What?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Don't 'what?' me.

name: MATT
dialogue: What's the DC of your spell?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Of Hallucinatory Terrain?

name: MATT
dialogue: Of all your spellcasting, what's the DC?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's 17. No, 18. But I know they have to make an intelligence save to see through Hallucinatory Terrain.

name: MATT
dialogue: Correct. If something were interested in doing so.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Exactly, hypothetically.

name: MATT
dialogue: So who's taking first watch?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Percy.

name: SAM
dialogue: I will watch with him.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, Percy can't watch alone.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, that's fine.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'll watch with him.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I mean, I raised my hand before, but that's all right. I'll get some sleep.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. It's tight quarters. And you know, other than either a magical light or torch someone wants to put up, there is no light source. It is pitch black down here. What are you guys using as a light source, or are you leaving it pitch dark?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, you can light your little flaming warhammer.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Fine. I take the Flaming Warhammer, and I whisper the magic word, bacon. And it turns on fire.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm pretty sure he just said bagel.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Bagel?

name: MATT
dialogue: All righty. So, you guys take first watch, rest is till about 11PM or midnight or so. You guys finish. Who's taking second watch? All right, we've got Grog and Vax. All right so, you guys--

name: LIAM
dialogue: While Percival is sleeping, I pull Grog over and we look at him for a while, and I say, where do you think the smoke comes out of?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh, that's a good question.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Do you think it's the nostrils?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, it looked like it was coming from the bottom up, and there's only two holes down there, so it's either--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, that's right.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Either the dirt button--

name: LIAM
dialogue: It could just be his pores. You're right, it's probably--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It's probably the periscope. You're right.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you guys are having this conversation, the air down here, it's damp earth. It's chilled in the night, anyway, but it's a little warmer because you're under the ground, and it's absorbed some of the heat of the day. But it is getting noticeably colder.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's getting colder?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, just as the evening progresses. The temperature at night here--

name: SAM
dialogue: Colder than it did last night? Because it also got pretty cold last night.

name: MATT
dialogue: Comparable, yeah. There's a low mist begins to form within the tunnel from the temperature.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I wake up my sister.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What, what do you want?

name: LIAM
dialogue: There's fog or something. What's going on?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It's just cold.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can we see if it's magic?

name: MATT
dialogue: Make an insight check.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Do that thing again. You can tell when stuff's around.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh good, I rolled a one.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Can I do a nature check to show them it's just fucking fog?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, go ahead and roll.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. You step forward and take a good long look at the fog that is slowly beginning to form at the base of the tunnel you guys are in. As you lean forward and take it in, the fog begins to form into a physical humanoid essence and reach out for you. For the three that are conscious, roll initiative.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh god!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Shit. It's a teeny tiny tunnel.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's another damn ghost wraith thing ghosting in.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right.

name: SAM
dialogue: So what if the Sun Tree is like--

name: LAURA
dialogue: The source of the bad?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's possible it is.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's kind of funny. (laughter)

name: LAURA
dialogue: What if the Briarwoods are right under the Sun Tree, and we're right above them?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What if they didn't hang the bodies, the tree just grabbed people?

name: MATT
dialogue: So Grog back in the fog, Vex is waking up the back, Trinket asleep next to her. Percy, Scanlan.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Actually, can you move the Wyrmwood box, because all I'm--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes, Wyrmwood Gaming, check them out. Beautiful boxes.

name: MATT
dialogue: Indeed, all right. This will go there for now.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You look really good, Matt.

name: MATT
dialogue: I can't move in this. Great. All right, so. Get some initiatives on this. For Grog?

name: MATT
dialogue: 17, all righty. Okay, Laura?

name: MATT
dialogue: 22, all right, and?

name: MATT
dialogue: 18. Good to know.

name: SAM
dialogue: Are we spooning?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We're sporking.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, we are?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You guys might be sporking.

name: MATT
dialogue: So Vex, Grog, then you rolled a what?

name: MATT
dialogue: Oh, sorry, Vax. Vex, you rolled a--

name: MATT
dialogue: 22, right, Grog you were a--

name: MATT
dialogue: 17, okay. So Grog, this is technically a surprise round on you, then we'll get back to you guys on top of the initiative. You can see now, the mist has formed into a pale humanoid, with two more now that have rolled in. These pale-looking, intensely feral human beings with elongated fangs emerge from this mist and immediately lunge out towards you.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Are they vampires?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can they do that?

name: LAURA
dialogue: They can. They're fucking vampires.

name: SAM
dialogue: No, they can only become bats. I read about this.

name: LIAM
dialogue: (sings) Let's do this.

name: MATT
dialogue: So, first and foremost, the one that lunges out at Grog is going to shift to the side there. Is going to make a claw attack against you. That is a 20 to hit?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That hits.

name: MATT
dialogue: That hits. All right, you take eight points of slashing damage-- or no, you do not, actually. Instead, it is going to attempt to grapple you. Not attempt, it grapples you. So it reaches out and grasps on to some of the hide armor you have tied around your shoulder, pulls you in, and is going to attempt to sink its teeth into your actual body.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Don't forget that we all have our amazing metal around our neck that Scanlan got us.

name: MATT
dialogue: That's true. (laughter)

name: LIAM
dialogue: You're so intimidating in that costume.

name: MATT
dialogue: Good. That is a 17 versus armor class.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That misses.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, so it attempts to bite into you, you move out of the way just in time, and that little bit of chain mail, that practically useless piece of chainmail wrapped around your giant thick neck does manage to catch its fangs and deflect the attack initially.

name: LIAM, LAURA
dialogue: Hey!

name: SAM
dialogue: What, that piece of metal thing? Hey, I made that. I call it a Scanlan. I call everything a Scanlan.

name: MATT
dialogue: This one is going to swoop in as you are now currently grappled by the other one. It's going to attempt to grab you on the other side. That is a 21 to hit, so it's going to grapple you. And this one is also going to now reach up with its claws to pull down the chain mail, grasps you there. Since it's a surprise round, natural 20. All right, so you take five points of piercing damage, and--

name: SAM
dialogue: And you're a vampire.

name: MATT
dialogue: And 11 points of necrotic, and your maximum hit points are reduced by 11.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Okay, really?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh no, we haven't had another feast yet.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, and the feast is gone too, isn't it?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: So this third one over here is going to attempt to come after you, Vax, closest to it. That is a 24 to hit.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, that hits, but I'm going to use Uncanny Dodge.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, to reduce the damage?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, by half.

name: MATT
dialogue: That's 2d4 slashing against you. Ten points of slashing damage.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Is the half?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yes, it's going to try to claw you again. That's a 12.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Nope.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, so the first one slashes across the side of your shoulder, but you manage to pull out of the way just in time to lessen the impact. This, however, sets you up for the easily dodged second blow. You swoop out of the way just barely in time, feeling the wind (whoosh) above your head. That ends their turn. Now we're at the top of the initiative order: surprise round. This would not have been enough noise to wake you guys yet, so you're going to hold on until somebody can get your attention. Top of the round will be Vex.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm going to say: Wake the fuck up! And I am going to-- can I hide? Is that what I do as my bonus?

name: MATT
dialogue: You have nowhere to hide in this room, unfortunately.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Even if it's super-duper dark?

name: MATT
dialogue: You get the idea that these creatures probably aren't largely affected by the dark.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That makes perfect sense. I'm going to Hunter's Mark the one that looks the strongest.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. The one that's most visible to you would probably be this one going after your brother. You mark that one.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I am now going to attack him with my blazing bow.

name: MATT
dialogue: All righty, go for it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right. Natural 20!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Nice! Wyrmwood Box.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Breaking in the new box.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's right.

name: LIAM
dialogue: (sings) It's my dice in a box.

name: MARISHA, TALIESIN
dialogue: Dice in a box, yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I add all of my dice together and then I double it, and then I add the modifier? Okay. And I Hunter's Marked him, yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yes, you did.

name: MATT
dialogue: 31 definitely hits.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's 31 damage.

name: MATT
dialogue: Oh, 31 damage. (laughs) Okay. All righty.

name: LAURA
dialogue: The second one was a three. It was a 14 to hit.

name: MATT
dialogue: No, unfortunately it dodges out of the way. Its reflexes are very quick.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Be honest, the karma will come back to you.

name: MATT
dialogue: Right, so as you pull back, you release, and with a flash of burning energy, your arrow ignites mid-transit. It blasts and bursts into the vampiric creature, who hisses at you (snarls) through the dark.
