dialogue: Deception, 15. Wait, or 29. It's a lot.

name: MATT
dialogue: What's your bonus?!

name: SAM
dialogue: No, it's 16 plus 13.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, so 29.

name: SAM
dialogue: That's 29. Sorry. It's a lot.

name: MATT
dialogue: I was like, (explosion sounds). All right. Gives you a stern look. "Huh. Well, it'd be nice, for a change, that there'd be someone up to fucking fight for this shithole of a place."

name: LIAM
dialogue: I start fake-weeping into my cup.

name: MATT
dialogue: He goes, "Oh no. No need for that. Going to make me lose my appetite. Hate the sound of a "grown man crying. Chin up!" And he takes and flicks a coin at your face.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Ow, fuck!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Look, if what he's saying's true, and we've got some sort of savior making their way into "town, well. Let's hope they're at least a little more prepared than the last ones."

name: SAM
dialogue: The last ones?

name: MATT
dialogue: "The uprising three years ago. Are you new to this fucking town?"

name: SAM
dialogue: Three years ago, Papa wouldn't let me out of the closet, so I didn't hear much of what was going on.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Okay, first and foremost, you've got to treat your boy better. Going to raise someone no "better than the motherfuckers running Whitestone right now if you keep this up."

name: LIAM
dialogue: (retches)

name: LAURA
dialogue: Did you really puke, or did you fake puke?

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm sorry about my papa. He's had such a hard time these last few years. Our crops are not performing well, and he's under a lot of pressure. And I think Mama doesn't love him anymore. I'm sorry. We can go.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I think you should. But one thing: if he ever does anything else to hurt you again, you "come tell someone. Two: if you hear anything else about this savior coming into town, go ahead and "talk to Trevor over there, at the edge of the bar." And you see over there, there's the guy who's behind the bar with his book. He doesn't even notice all this happening. Guy in his mid-thirties, glasses at the end of his nose, his hair's slicked back and pulled into a taut ponytail, and he's sitting there reading. And he says, "Go ahead and tell Trevor, because the rest "of us would like to go out in a blaze of glory than live in this bullshit."

name: SAM
dialogue: What was your name, sir?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Not important to much, but you can call me Patrick."

name: SAM
dialogue: Thank you, Patrick. I don't know if my papa has enough money for these drinks.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm going to insight check Patrick.

name: SAM
dialogue: From the floor?

name: MATT
dialogue: He's listening in. Go for it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: All right, that's not that great. That's a 17.

name: MATT
dialogue: He seems honest. Seems he's got not much to lose and his interest is piqued, but he's not wholly invested in this whole idea. But it's definitely caught his attention. "Well, let's get "him up." Stands up, reaches over and grabs you by the arm, lifts you up onto the stool on the side of the table and says, "Up, you." Pats you on the back. "You need to sober up, drink the water you "got for your boy, there, and get your ass out of here."

name: SAM
dialogue: Come on, Papa. Let's go. I turn around and I take the rest of his drink. (laughter)

name: LIAM
dialogue: And as he pulls me away, and I slovenly turn after him. I turn back for a second, and I completely sober up. Pelor has returned. Walked out.

name: MATT
dialogue: He gives you a keen glance and nods slowly as you walk away. Looks over at the bartender for a second, and, "Psst! Trevor!" And then you exit the building. All right, you guys all convene at the Lady's Chamber. The other day, there were a few folks walking through the courtyard. Today, there's a group of about 25 people, all different dress, from what would be considered a Whitestone middle class, the few there are, to a number of other peasantry, farmhands, and other folk that look destitute by nature of existence here. All gathered in the amphitheater, and what appears to be a relatively hushed sermon or discussion currently going on by Keeper Yennen.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Let's not make ourselves known. I want to see this. I want to hear what's up.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Sit in the back.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, sit in the back. He begins talking for a while about a long tangent, speaking of, "This "land, once cherished, is a burning light and a beacon of good existence, of kinship, of honesty "and loyalty, dragged down to the muck by the imposition of darkness, the return of the evil "that once scourged this land. Now given new faces, they push us down, and as hope crumbles, the light "peeks through once again, for whispers have come to my ears, friends, that this unrest now has a "name. I'm sure you've seen it, the fire atop that building this morning, watched as one of your "oppressors was cut from his high throne. One of his close advisors scarred, tortured, shown the "strength of this hidden ally of us, the oppressed peoples of Whitestone." And he looks up over the group a little bit and past the streets, carefully. "I have come to believe that perhaps this is the "time for us to band together and show our support. Now, the information is still vague, but just keep "your eyes open. Be careful, be quiet. As things progress, word will find you." Bows his head and says a prayer that-- none of you speak Celestial?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I do.

name: SAM
dialogue: You do?!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I speak Celestial.

name: MATT
dialogue: All righty. The essence of the prayer is: By the guidance of the Lady, may civilization flourish and those that keep progression at bay be squashed beneath our feet. At which point the sermon breaks, and people begin to walk away and scatter.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I want to watch people as they walk away and try to read their lips as they're walking away to see if everybody seems loyal to what he said, or if anybody seems a little--

name: MATT
dialogue: Everyone is silent. Everyone is quiet, and everyone is looking warily and making their own separate paced exits, so as not to draw attention.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can we try to memorize their faces? Of everybody that was here?

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. You keep as best a mental image of everyone who's passing by. Not too many notable folk. They look like, especially where you're from, the peasantry doesn't really interest you visually, but you do manage to gather details of certain scars here and there, and people, hair color, age, stuff like that.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Did we recognize the guy that was talking?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, that was Keeper.

name: MATT
dialogue: Keeper Yennen.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah. Any familiar faces in the audience?

name: MATT
dialogue: Actually, Scanlan, you and Keyleth both recognize some of the farmers. You guys have all gathered.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, we gathered again. Okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: You recognize two of the individuals at this were the farmers you initially saw on the outskirts of Whitestone when you did your little scouting mission earlier.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, nice. When we flew in?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah.

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: So from all the people you've encountered, those are the only two that you specifically recognize so far, but it does appear to be made up of--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Working hands, farmers.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, the foundation of this city that have been so long oppressed.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I elbow Percy, and I go, do we talk to him?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think we do. Maybe he talks to us. I try and catch his attention.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. You can see as he begins putting out some of the incense, he looks over and sees, "Ah, "yes. You've returned. Please, follow me." And he steps outside of the amphitheater and around the back of it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We follow.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Around the back of the amphitheater, you see there is constructed, attached to the very far end of this round half-dome, a square brick building. Very simple. And as he ushers you all inside, it's essentially a tea room. There's a table, there's a tea set up there, there is a small stove in the far end with a little fire-burning stove, and shelves and shelves and shelves arranged with all different manner of small sculptures, metalwork, holy symbols of Erathis that have all been put on display. Each one has a name carved beneath it. And you recognize this, Percy. This is the legacy of all the Keepers of the Lady's Chamber over time, their symbols. This is basically a Hall of Previous Keepers. "Please, sit. Have tea if you like, if "you're so interested. We have much to discuss. So. I am to believe that these allies you spoke of "previously were responsible for this dastardly attack on Sir Kerrion?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That could be inferred.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, I have spoken privately with a number of the remaining community leaders of our town, "and they are unconvinced. Understand, this isn't the first time an insurrection has been attempted, "and much sorrow was endured after previous failures. We keep hope best we can, but without a "solid plan, we are sending the rest of our able-bodied into the abyss."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: What happened last time?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, in a similar fashion, we had a number of fed-up individuals decide to finally raise some "sort of aggressive act against the castle and attempt to storm it by force. We figured we had "the numbers. There are many dangers in that castle that go beyond what we were prepared for. As such, "the few that survived, well. They met the fate most do at the Sun Tree these days. So we've been "remiss to put ourselves in a similar position for many years now. To make matters worse, our "informant within the castle has gone silent these past few weeks. We have no idea of the progression "of the Briarwoods' plot."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Was your informant by chance named Simon?

name: MATT
dialogue: "No. Simon has been missing for some time, actually."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Who was your informant?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't know the name. The information comes through-- actually, he should be arriving "here in just a moment."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: What did they find underneath Whitestone?

name: MATT
dialogue: "All that we know is they've been rebuilding or repurposing something old and terrible beneath "the city. I've only heard whispers of it referred to as the ziggurat."

name: LAURA, TRAVIS, MARISHA
dialogue: The ziggurat.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Now, to go into the deep history of this city, as you are outsiders, legend speaks of a "seed, that the Sun Tree was placed by Pelor himself to seal a wound in the light. Whitestone "rose around it. The fable has long been told, but ever since those fiends took the city, their "interest beneath the city has kept me thinking on this fable. Leaves me very unsettled. And as the "Sun Tree slowly died, so did our confidence. Further--" At which point, the door across the room opens. (creak) And another enters the room. A very elderly man steps in, his ragged robes draped on his very thin, frail form.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I wink at him.

name: MATT
dialogue: His weathered skin is dark and leathery. He's nearly hairless on his head and has liver spots all over his scalp. One of his eyes is clouded over and white. He shimmies in very slowly. "I ask you strangers, what makes you so sure you can change the tide of this battle?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (whispers) Drop Seeming. Drop it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Do I recognize this person?

name: MATT
dialogue: As old as he may be, there is a subtle power and resonance and confidence to his voice. There's a force of personality and conviction that immediately leads you to believe that this man is or once was a man of great power and respect.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are there windows in the room?

name: MATT
dialogue: There are two windows. They are currently shut with curtains.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You should show him.

name: MATT
dialogue: You, Percy, recognize this man. He was once the chancellor to your father, and a long-respected philosopher in Whitestone known as Archibald Desnae.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Archibald Desnitt?

name: MATT
dialogue: Desnae. He was very well-respected. Very stern, and crotchety at times, but very much aided your family in holding the city together in times of strife.

name: SAM
dialogue: I pull out Sir Kerrion's notebook and I hand it to them and I say, this should be some proof that we mean what we say.

name: MATT
dialogue: Reaches out, and his long, spindly fingers wrap around the tome, pull it towards him. "So you "bring a trinket. That is helpful. But to kill one mortal man is no feat compared to the darkness "that lies in that castle. You need more than that."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I remove my hat.

name: SAM
dialogue: Can I drop it on one of us, or do I have to drop it on all of us?

name: MATT
dialogue: I'd say you can drop it on an individual, if you prefer.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right. I will drop Percy's Seeming.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. There's a slamming sound as the tome he's holding hits the floor.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Hello, Archie.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Percival? Sweet Percival."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Not so sweet these days. I did not think you would have lived.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I thought you had perished in the subjugation. Percival, you have no idea the joy "this brings to my heart." And he reaches out and touches the edge of your face like he's still in disbelief. "Your hair. It seems age has caught up to you, as well."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It was difficult, leaving.

name: MATT
dialogue: You see a smile creep across his very tense old-man face, and he looks about the room with a renewed energy that wasn't there before.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: My friends are strong.

name: MATT
dialogue: "With you here, Percival, we've two de Rolos spearheading the rebellion. We have the guiding "light the people need."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Who else survived?

name: MATT
dialogue: "We must succeed, Percival. If this fails, there won't be anyone else left to rise up. They "are nearing their goal, according to your sister Cassandra. We haven't much time. "Your sister lives, Percival."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh shit!

name: MATT
dialogue: "She survived the attack and was taken as the personal assistant and slave of the Briarwoods "and used as an example, a symbol of their dominance. She has been feeding us information for "years, whenever she could. She was the helping guide, the last two attempts we've made. We have "not received a letter from her in weeks now, but know you are not the only surviving member of your "family. I will talk to your people. I will talk to mine. We'll have your militia. Guide us, Percival "Fredrickstein von Mussel Klossowski de Rolo III. Guide us, Vox Machina."

name: SAM
dialogue: Wait. You know who we are? How does he know?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Some of us have information all over these lands. We've had a few friends come from Emon over "the past couple years. They met some dire ends. Don't think that we haven't heard of your "exploits. Help us bring a dawn back to this land."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I may have a plan. How fares Professor Anders?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Professor Anders has been lost to us since before the insurrection. He is a man taken by what "promises the Briarwoods have given him. What little he has shown his face in this town, he is "not the man he once was, or at least the man we thought he was was never "who he truly claimed to be."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: He lives in the house in the east? House in the north?

name: MATT
dialogue: "He lives in the castle with the Briarwoods, as well."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Lady Ripley lives in one of those mansions.

name: MATT
dialogue: "She did. There have been reports in recent days that she's been quick to pack. We know not "where she resides now."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Who lives in the third house?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Here." And he takes a moment to think of which house you're referring to.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We burned one of them.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes, you did. The house is Kerrion's house, and then there are two other homesteads of the new "nobles, one of which is currently held by the Duke," he says with disdain. "Goran Vedmeyer."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Goran Quagmire?

name: LAURA, SAM
dialogue: Vedmeyer.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Vedmeyer. He has supposedly been put in watch at the temple of Pelor, but he's left that "to ruin. The other home houses Count Tylieri, a rather sadistic man who oversees the timber "production of Whitestone."

name: LAURA
dialogue: The what production?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Timber."

name: SAM
dialogue: Is that the house that the Countess was briefly residing in?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Briefly."

name: SAM
dialogue: Count Tygieri?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Tylieri."

name: SAM
dialogue: Tylieri. How are these men, the duke and the count? What do the people think of them?

name: MATT
dialogue: "The Briarwoods, when they took Whitestone, did not take it alone. They came to this land with "a small army of cutthroats, mercenaries, sell-swords they brought over from whichever "forsaken land they came from. Each one of those men that then proved to be of utmost use to them "in that rebellion, they were given titles and nobility and homesteads. They were given "responsibilities over the land, the people beneath them. I can only assume that was part of their "payment for their service."

name: SAM
dialogue: But they're just thugs who were particularly successful.

name: MATT
dialogue: "As far as I know, yes."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Are they supernatural? Are they undead?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Not to my knowledge."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: If we were to continue working our way up this totem pole, which of the two is less powerful?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Which of the two is reviled most?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes, what would start an uprising?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Count Tylieri is known for being quite the sadistic individual. Beating, torturing his "servants, sometimes publicly to show his hand to those who would cross him. He would definitely be "a message to send, if there were one."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I have a plan.

name: SAM
dialogue: I've got one, too. Kill him.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, that's part of the plan.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I would warn, the longer we wait making these messages, the stronger we build this part of "the city, but also the more warning and preparation time we give to those in the castle. "So the choice is yours."

name: LIAM
dialogue: We act now.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Act now?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Against the Briarwoods?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Count Tylieri.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Here's my plan.

name: MATT
dialogue: The name Tylieri catches your ear's memory. If you recall, your captive back at Greyskull Keep was previously the owner of the driver of the Briarwoods, Desmond. The one that beat him senseless until eventually Lord Briarwood saw this and then took him as his own driver.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm just a small boy, but we've seen mists at night, strange things that come out when the sun goes down. Are those focused around a central area of town, or are those everywhere?

name: MATT
dialogue: "The mists are a means of intimidation. It's merely a magical precursor to the undead minions "of the Briarwoods. They slink through those mists, use them as cover. If you see it, run."

name: SAM
dialogue: Thank you.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We heard about green fog here. Is that something?

name: MATT
dialogue: "In the castle, yes. There are vents in what was once the garden. I know not the nature of "these vents or what is being utilized to produce this foul, noxious odor, but it has put a scent on "the city for many years."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Do we know what killed the tree?

name: MATT
dialogue: "We know not."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: And in your time, do you know anything about Lady Delilah? What she is?

name: MATT
dialogue: "The few times she's walked the city, it's been procession and power. She seems to enjoy the "attention. She's a vain one, that one."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Who's this?

name: LAURA, TRAVIS
dialogue: Lady Delilah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Does she come out during the day?

name: MATT
dialogue: "She hasn't in almost a year, but she has before, yes. "She walks in the sun, unlike her husband."

name: SAM
dialogue: Unlike her husband?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes."

name: LAURA
dialogue: I don't think she's a vampire.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: She may not be a vampire.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I think she's a bitch.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: What do you think of a distraction?

name: LAURA
dialogue: What kind of distraction?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: What if there was a way to start a ruckus at the Vedmeyer estate? Start a fire, maybe. Start a ruckus of some kind.

name: SAM
dialogue: The Vedmeyer estate?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The third house.

name: SAM
dialogue: The duke's. Okay, yes?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They're going to be waiting and expecting us, so if they think we're attacking one of the houses and then instead we attack the other while everyone's rushing to deal with what they think is the next attack, we attack the second home, and then when they prepare for us to attack the third home, that's when we attack the castle.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I like it.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Wait, you want to go bam-bam-bam?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Today, it's just one. We've already dropped one.

name: LAURA
dialogue: The next attack will be on the Briarwoods.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, he's saying create a distraction.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We make a big stink in the house we're not going into.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That I'm cool with. Percy, how much do you want people to see the de Rolo family crest? How much do you want people to know of your presence here? Do you want a big proclamation? Because I might have that.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Will it put my sister in danger?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's hard to say."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They don't know that I know she's alive. Perhaps keep her, just to surprise me.

name: SAM
dialogue: That symbol is not the de Rolo family seal, is it? It's modified.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's a part of it. Definitely. I want them to know. They need to know.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's a tough decision. The symbol does carry the weight of the people and does carry a "beacon of hope. But it, as you said, may put your sister in danger. It's hard to say. The choice is "yours in how you wish to use it."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes. Because I learned a trick back in the day from my father and the Air Ashari people. We used to do it as kids for fun, but it might be perfect in this circumstance.

name: SAM
dialogue: I did it a little in college. It's fun.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Dual-wielding. I can Skywrite for you.

name: LIAM
dialogue: How do you mean?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Like a giant sparkler.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Like a what?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: In the future, they came up with these awesome things called--

name: SAM, MATT, TRAVIS
dialogue: Nope!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Skywrite with clouds?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, skywriting with clouds.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You control the clouds?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Can you actually write letters in them?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: SAM
dialogue: That's crazy talk.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can you clear out clouds? Then if you can do that, can you make these gray clouds go away?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do we want the gray clouds to go away?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, sunlight would be nice as opposed to this misty fog.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's a good point.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Maybe temporarily.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, controlling weather on that scope is a little beyond your grasp. You can alter elements of it and you could darken elements of the cloud to form a message or a symbol if you would like, but actually removing the clouds, that would be--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can you poke a hole in them?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Temporarily, yeah.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We'll remember that. Let's go pick a fight with a house!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: From a distance. We pick a fight with a house from a distance so we can get to the other house and pick a fight there.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Is there just one of us who can make a big stink in the decoy house?

name: SAM
dialogue: I can probably make a big stink.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You could definitely make a big stink.

name: LIAM
dialogue: But you can catch up through one of those little doorways.

name: SAM
dialogue: Please, it's big for me.

name: LAURA
dialogue: How about this? I use one of my exploding arrows you gave me.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, those are so cool. Save those for a person.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It's a good ranged stink.

name: SAM
dialogue: I've got Magic Missiles. I've got all sorts of shit. I can do Stinking Clouds, I can make them see things, I can blow open their doors. I can do it. You guys go have fun.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: But you can also do this from a distance so we can get you far away. You could do both.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'll start on the distraction.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And I'm going to give you a second arrow as well.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Of what?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The arrow?

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's a question-mark arrow.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's an arrow?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. Write down arrow with a question mark. It looks heavily tinkered. It's a little front-loaded with the weight.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You know what it will do to the roof if it works?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Okay, cool.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's a kill-Trinket arrow.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh man, you know what? I forgot I-- okay, cool.

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughs) Yes. What?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Just don't. I have thoughts.

name: MATT
dialogue: Cool, have thoughts. Keep them going.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Arrow?

name: MATT
dialogue: Arrow?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: All right, can we do something now, please?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: All right. Let's do it.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'll head over to the other house. Show me on the map where it is so I know where I'm going.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What time is it?

name: MATT
dialogue: By this point in the day, it's probably around three in the afternoon.

name: TALIESIN

dialogue: I've never fought a zombie giant before.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, but everybody else is doing it. Those peasants are doing it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: That's what I'm saying. Let's see what we're up against. Let's take a breather and let's go pick one off.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Jordana, do you have any books here on zombie giants?

name: MATT
dialogue: "For the most part, necromancy is not studied in this town. At least, we never had to "deal with it until recently, and we haven't had the opportunity to really study since."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, I mean, zombie combined with giants. We've fought zombies and we've fought giants, so I'm assuming it with a vague--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We keep our distance.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: How long does it take to recharge Hex, by the way?

name: MATT
dialogue: You need a long rest.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: How many Sunbeam hadoukens do you have left, Keyleth?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: How many hadoukens? As in Sunbeams? I'm done on Sunbeams.

name: SAM
dialogue: We need to rest.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: If we get a short rest, how many do you get?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm done. None.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We need a long rest to get spells.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: However, if I short rest, I actually haven't burnt any of my animal forms here recently and I can water elemental up, which would also permanently kill them. So I have other defenses that could still take down vampires if we encounter another one. I'm more concerned about these giants right now.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's what I'm talking about. They're vampires.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No, they're zombies. They're undead.

name: LAURA
dialogue: They're zombies.

name: LIAM
dialogue: They're undead.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Those are two different things, huh?

name: MATT
dialogue: They are two very different things.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Grog learns. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. So what's the plan?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We short rest and get back out.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We take a short rest and then exterminate.

name: SAM
dialogue: Wait, join the rebellion or ride around town telling everyone, "quell?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We're taking down these damn giants. These giants are killing people left and right; we watched them crush people on our way here.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We tell them that they take cover during the night.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'm going to roll four hit dice.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, you guys go ahead, use your hit dice to heal up while you're taking your short rest for those who've taken damage.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, Trinket. Can you heal Trinket?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I can.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Heal him so much. Does Trinket get... oh, he does get hit dice.

name: MATT
dialogue: Trinket technically does not. Trinket requires--

name: LAURA
dialogue: It says he does. It's written down.

name: MATT
dialogue: Hit dice?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Also, another strange question: what creates initiative? Initiative is your dexterity modifier?

name: MATT
dialogue: Correct.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: So with me, it's my dexterity modifier. Plus two.

name: MATT
dialogue: Correct.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm also currently wearing a Headband of Initiative, which I'd forgotten about.

name: MATT
dialogue: Which...?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Gives me plus two to my initiative.

name: MATT
dialogue: Correct.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, dear god almighty. Okay. Thank you.

name: MATT
dialogue: Percy, Percy, Percy.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't mean to be doing this.

name: MATT
dialogue: No, it's great. Just glad you didn't take the Alertness feat. Then things would have gotten stupid.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Are you healing Trinket?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: How much more does he need?

name: LAURA
dialogue: He's at 36. He needs 24 more.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Actually, I'm going to be using the Hat of Disguise just because it's probably safe. Does anybody want a Headband of Initiative?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah. Do you not need it?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I can't wear two things on my head.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I don't have anything on my head.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: So you've got plus two to your initiative, and I'm losing plus two to my initiative. It's called a Headband of Initiative.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You already have an eight to your initiative.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's very mystical.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: How much time do we have before the sun that is being blocked by the rainclouds goes down?

name: MATT
dialogue: Well, you guys are taking a short rest, about 30 minutes to an hour, so you have about two and a half, three hours before it goes down entirely.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That should give us enough time to do a quick tour. We already know their walking route, and I'm sure that the people are putting up a fight.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm going to give him a level two Cure Wounds.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So do 2d8 plus ten.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Me?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Sure. Me or you. Whoever feels more comfortable.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'll do it. It was good.

name: MATT
dialogue: During this rest, if you wanted to spend some time with that cape--

name: LIAM
dialogue: I do. I'm going to sniff it and shake it out.

name: MATT
dialogue: For the most part, it doesn't appear to be enchanted.

name: SAM
dialogue: No, I can sing a Song of Rest for all of us.

name: MARISHA, LAURA
dialogue: Oh, yeah. Do that.

name: SAM
dialogue: It gives us all 1d6. That's pretty weak.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No, but that's...

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, it's fine. He's got extra hit points; don't worry about it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, Song of Rest just happens, right? Do you get that for free? You might as well, if you don't burn anything.

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay. (sings) Health! We need some now. Health! Not just anybody. Health! You know you need someone.

name: ALL
dialogue: (sings) Health!

name: MATT
dialogue: That's not trademarked at all. I love it. All right, so you guys have rested up. Through the rest, you occasionally hear voices run by, yelling. As you guys get toward the end of your rest, you hear the (stomping) large heavy footfalls heading nearby. (groaning, crash) A loud, heavy impact, and you hear some short cheers outside.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yes!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yay!

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, he died. That's two down. Splash two.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Right out front, we hear it?

name: MATT
dialogue: Out front, a little ways off. Not immediately.

name: SAM
dialogue: Do we have horses? We don't have any horses, do we?

name: LAURA
dialogue: No.

name: LIAM
dialogue: They died.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, they got eaten by harpies.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Should we go outside and see how they're doing?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yeah, let's check it out.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We go out front.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Time to kill some giant undead.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Jordana lets you guys out, locks behind her.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do we want to split up?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, let's keep together.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Actually, before we go, I ask, do you have any holy symbols at all in here?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm sorry, no."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Nothing?

name: MATT
dialogue: "No. All those were kept in either of the two temples here."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Do you have anything magic that could help me?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I already gave you everything of magic that I had here."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, right. I forgot we took it.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Sorry."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Shit. All right, thank you.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Once we're outside, how far away is that giant that was felled?

name: MATT
dialogue: As you step outside and look, it's about 60 feet off, near one of the big crossroads near this area. And a zombie giant has been completely felled down, and there are three people now that are currently in the process of hacking its head off just to make sure. It's a group of about seven people that live here. They're all looking pretty messed up, but they're all eager and adrenaline-driven, they're all hacking away, then stopping and taking a breath (breathes heavily). You hear in the distance, (thunder crack) bolt of lightning coming down from the storm, and as it echoes, everyone shakes for a second, look at each other, (cheers) give a cheer of victory. They all hop off the body of the zombie giant and begin darting further in towards the center of the city.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I look up. Is my de Rolo symbol still in the sky?

name: MATT
dialogue: It's there. It's dissipating slowly, but it's still there. It's moved a little bit off-axis with the storm.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: So that's it for the big houses, right? Just the castle.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Just the castle.

name: SAM
dialogue: Except we haven't killed the members of one of the houses. By the way, my Song of Rest is a d8.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Awesome.

name: SAM
dialogue: But we haven't killed the last one. Now, the one that you guys killed. What's his name again, Tylieri?

name: MATT
dialogue: Tylieri.

name: SAM
dialogue: He was a vampire.

name: ALL
dialogue: Yes.

name: SAM
dialogue: Because Sylas killed him. Right?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes.

name: SAM
dialogue: And then made him a vampire.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: One would assume.

name: SAM
dialogue: Didn't he hang him on the Sun Tree?

name: LAURA
dialogue: What? No. What? What are you talking about?

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't know. Didn't that guy that we meet...

name: MATT
dialogue: You do recall, actually, when you were interrogating the driver of the Briarwoods. Tylieri was the master of the driver Desmond, who beat him and subjugated him to various forms of torture and abuse before Lord Briarwood took Desmond and, to try and show extension of faith, revealed to Desmond Tylieri hanging from the Sun Tree. That was true.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Wow.

name: SAM
dialogue: And then he became a vampire. Is that where they're spawning?

name: LAURA
dialogue: No. Maybe he was already a vampire and he hung him from the tree just to show--

name: SAM
dialogue: That doesn't seem right.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Let's head to the Sun Tree, why don't we?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Let's head that direction.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Let's go.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Something to us about how when people die in this town. The guy you talked to at the bar?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, we talked to a guy at the bar. What about him?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He said when people die here they don't die.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, yes, we know that, yes.

name: LAURA
dialogue: They come back.

name: LIAM
dialogue: They could be-- yes, that could apply, too.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I think this whole damn town-- I think the whole land is cursed. Is what I think.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I think that's--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Probably pretty fair.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Should we go to the tree?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Sure.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Why?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Just to see--

name: LAURA
dialogue: We'll make our way through the town and look for giants as we make our way to the tree.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Let's look for giants. Let's go giant-hunting.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. All right, so from the Alcove, you guys head in a southwestern motion, keeping off the main paths best you can. The main chaos seems to have died down a little bit in this area of the town. You come across another body of a zombie giant, surrounded by what looks like eight bodies of civilians of the town.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Are they all dead, or are they injured?

name: MATT
dialogue: No, they are all very dead. Two of which are torn in half and just tossed to different sides, one appears to be half-eaten, and the rest are just smashed. But whatever troop was with them managed to take the zombie giant down. Eventually, you make your way to the center of the town square where the Sun Tree is and there is, across the way on the opposite side, what appears to be, in mid-struggle, one zombie giant that has a series of spears or javelins sticking out of its torso. It's currently swatting at a group of individuals that have torches in the rain, still trying to get up towards it and push it backward. The Sun Tree, at a glance-- roll a perception check.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: All of us?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yes.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: One. There's a tree!

name: SAM
dialogue: Four.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I rolled a 19, so 29?

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

name: LAURA
dialogue: If my passive perception's higher than my roll--

name: MATT
dialogue: Active perception and passive perception-- passive is more something to keep track when you're not actively perceiving. So. Grog?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Seven.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Keyleth, you pick this out in the rain, and it's hard to see, but from this angle, you see what looks to be eight ropes, currently, just dangling free from the Sun Tree.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Damn it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Shit.

name: SAM
dialogue: The tree is the spawning spot.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Really?

name: SAM
dialogue: Or maybe one of them.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Or maybe they cut them down.

name: SAM
dialogue: We've got to cut down this tree.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Does it look like the ropes have been cut?

name: MATT
dialogue: You can go closer to inspect it if you want.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: You're hearing in the distance the (roars) the battle's still raging about 65, 70 feet from you. You get up behind the tree and you take the ropes and inspect it. All the ropes are very finely cut.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh. They were cut. They cut them down.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: They cut their dead down.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay, so the nooses are gone.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. And you do see, there are a number. This close, you can see there are loops of rope all over the tree: some very old and weathered and aged, some of them are torn, some of them are cut, but the fresh ones that are the longest currently and that are placed closest to where the bodies were originally there are all very cleanly cut.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can we spin around and look and see if there's anything around that looks like-- or look at tracking and see if it looks like somebody cut them down or if they fell on their own?

name: MATT
dialogue: You glance around real fast and you can see to the south there is still the battle raging between the zombie giant and the crew of individuals, but you look back where you guys were from, and you see a large series of shapes stepping through the rain, coming from the direction you guys were.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I think they cut them down just like Tylieri. I think that this is where they hang them to ripen, and then when they're ready they pluck them off the tree and set them on their way.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you're having this conversation, you, keeping your eyes forward as he's saying this in your ear, you can see, as the light of the town is slowly beginning to vanish into a sunset--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Is it still raining?

name: MATT
dialogue: It is still raining. You see ahead of you, coming from the central roadway into the square of the town, what you can only surmise to be anywhere from 30 to 50 armored skeletal entities that are pouring from the north.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay. I climb the Sun Tree.

name: SAM
dialogue: Wait, what? We've got to get out of here!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm climbing the Sun Tree.

name: MATT
dialogue: Climbing the Sun Tree. All right. You guys see Keyleth scurry up the Sun Tree.

name: SAM
dialogue: I blow my Horn of Fog to create a smokescreen. I don't know what the fuck she's doing.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. (foghorn sound) The slow horn-blow comes out, and this fog begins to fill the area between this marching skeletal army and the Sun Tree where you guys currently are. Looking over your shoulder, you can see the zombie giant finishes smashing the last individual in that crew, picks it up and jams it into its jagged giant teeth.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So there's a big army coming down, filtering down a street.

name: MATT
dialogue: Down the street towards you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: How far away?

name: MATT
dialogue: You can't tell now. There's just fog along the way.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I can't tell how far away they are right now?

name: MATT
dialogue: No, you can't see them.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I can't see them?

name: MATT
dialogue: No, because Scanlan just created a whole bunch of fog between the two of you. The moment you saw, they may be about a hundred or so feet from you.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Keyleth, tell us what you're thinking, because the rest of us are taking this time to go.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You engage, they'll follow, we go, we fight another day, we sleep in the rafters and wait until daybreak.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Who are you?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I might be able to do something.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What is it? Say it!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I can do a big ice storm or do something to take all these fuckers out at once.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: All 30 to 50 of them? Kill them all?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's a big range.

name: LIAM
dialogue: No. Keyleth, we've got to go.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I say we let her hit them, and we run.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Scanlan, can you drop the fog just a bit?

name: SAM
dialogue: Nope, not by magic.

name: MATT
dialogue: He can't control it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's on the ground. You can probably see above it. Fog is low.

name: MATT
dialogue: Well, the fog this creates is a magical fog that obscures an entire area. If you climbed to the very top of the tree, you might be able to get a little bit of a visual.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: All right, I'm going to climb as high as I can.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, make an athletics check.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm going to climb up after her.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh my god.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: 11. Acrobatics or athletics?

name: MATT
dialogue: Athletics.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, that's better. 15.

name: MATT
dialogue: 15. Okay. You make your way up to the very precarious top of the branches. You can feel the brittleness of it as the tree itself, its life force is withered over time and some of it cracks and some of the actual bark of the tree twists off in your grip as you get to the very top. You can look just over the bank of fog that Scanlan has created and you can see beyond that. The number of undead from this angle, what was initially like 30 probably pushes closer to about a hundred.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay. And they're like a hundred feet away?

name: MATT
dialogue: Starting about a hundred feet away, slowly marching towards you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Right where they are, I'm going to start a little ahead of where they originate, I'm going to start making an ice storm. I'm pushing all the way back to where-- just right down these fuckers.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm also just trying to stay underneath her as best I can.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Stop looking up her skirt, brother.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Is she in a skirt?

name: SAM
dialogue: She's been wearing a dress this whole time?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I thought she was covered in leaves.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Stop looking up her fig leaf.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. What's the damage on that? Is it 2d8 bludgeoning and 2d8--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: They take 2d8 bludgeoning damage and 4d6 cold damage.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, go ahead and roll for both. And it's a save for half, right?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Inspiration?

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh. Well. I didn't do it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: 2d8 bludgeoning, that's seven bludgeoning... 4d6. Not great at all. Four, five, six, seven, eight.

name: MATT
dialogue: Total of eight. Eight plus... what was the other one?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Seven.

name: MATT
dialogue: Seven, okay.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And it's difficult terrain.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. So the first area. Suddenly you see some of the clouds above you begin to funnel downward, and a few bolts of electricity (crackle) through it. As the funnel hits, it grows dark, and then all of a sudden this cold wind begins to swirl around it. And with that, the cloud almost seems to tear open within itself and a sheet of jagged ice and sleet begins to pour downward into the center of this undead horde. As it does, you can see probably a good 25, 30 of these are just blown apart, bone shards scattered around and you can see bits of rusted metal weapons and armor thrown left and right. The ice then coalesces over the floor of this area and some of the skeletons just slip, but they keep marching forward. It definitely took a chunk, but as it continues pushing forward--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Now we can run.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Good job. I grab the back of her shirt and yank her towards me.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys make your way down the tree. As you get to the bottom of the tree, the zombie giant has taken notice of the sudden flashing of light and the movement in the tree and is bounding towards the tree after you guys.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Are we running?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are we going to the Alcove or going to the treeline?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I say we go to the treeline, and I say that you take a couple shots as we're heading--

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm definitely doing that, yes. I'm going to shoot at the giant as we're running. Hunter's Mark him.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, you Hunter's Mark, turning around, looking at the giant.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: As she says that, I'm going to go ahead and start casting my Call Lightning spell.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. So you land and you cast Call Lightning. The fog that you created, Scanlan?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: Has formed up. You start seeing shapes; these terrifying skeletal faces begin to appear through the fog as the rest of the army begins to push through. The clouds coalescing above Keyleth as you get your Call Lightning ready, you marking the zombie giant, you guys begin bolting out of the way. Trinket comes running up behind you, Vex, and picks you up onto his back, and you guys begin rushing off toward the treeline-- to the west or the east?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can I shoot him?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, as I turn around, I Call Lightning on the giant.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Go ahead and roll damage on that.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And it's cloudy, so I get how much more?

name: MATT
dialogue: I don't know, how much do you get more on that? Call Lightning would be...

name: SAM
dialogue: While you decide, which way are we going, Percy? West or east?

name: MATT
dialogue: 3d10. It does an additional d10. It does 4d10.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And I'm going to shoot him through my Longbow of the Sky Sentinel as we're going away, too.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: So the passage to the castle I'm aware of is to the west, and then the one that Stonefell mentioned is to the east?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Do we go to the treeline by the castle?

name: MATT
dialogue: No, the one Stonefell mentioned was the same.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Was the same?

name: MATT
dialogue: It wasn't Stonefell, it was Vouk.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yeah, thank you.

name: MATT
dialogue: But yeah. He was referring to the same one.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Treeline to the west so that we can attack first thing.

name: LAURA
dialogue: 22. Twice.

name: MATT
dialogue: 22 hits.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And then three on the last one.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, it's technically 14 on the last one.

name: MATT
dialogue: For him? Still hits.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, sweet!

name: MATT
dialogue: It's a big target. Big target, lot of hit points.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And as she's brewing up her bow, I'm behind her and just bring down the bolt for 32 damage.

name: MATT
dialogue: Damn. (lightning sound) You can see the bolt strikes the front of the zombie giant right as it starts swinging after you guys. The bolt hits its shoulder and blasts a chunk of its shoulder blade off. You see bone shards fire behind, and there's a giant piece of its torso now missing where the bolt hit. (groans) Stumbles back onto its back foot and catches itself, almost toppling over.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Just start backing up. "Vex?"

name: MATT
dialogue: It starts lumbering forward again as Vex releases her arrow, which splits into three.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Vex?

name: LAURA
dialogue: 54 points of damage.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Kill it!

name: MATT
dialogue: Nice! (impact sounds) All the arrows blasting into its body, you can see they sink in and burst on the inside. There's a little, a dull glow as this burst of electrical energy hits from underneath its sickly zombified flesh. At which point, there's a slight delay before it (explosion sound) bubbles forth and a bit of its internal liquid just spews out like a boil. You can see it's definitely taking damage, and it keeps pushing forward. Yeah, it's still moving towards you guys.

name: LIAM
dialogue: How far away is it?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: For gods' sakes!

name: MATT

dialogue: "Thank you. Thank you for coming and helping. That got a little hairy there, for a "minute. We didn't lose any of our men, thankfully, and that's thanks to you." He reaches up for a second and wipes this black blood stuck to his chin from the fight. "So. What's next?"

dialogue: "All right. What time?"

dialogue: Dawn.

dialogue: Right now? It's hard to tell.

dialogue: It's about two hours past sunset.

dialogue: Oh, good. We've got time! That's good.

dialogue: (laugh)

dialogue: It could be cursed.

dialogue: I'm not even here.

dialogue: Oh, that's right!

dialogue: That ornamental dagger?

dialogue: From what you can see from up there, it just looks like a fairly nice dagger, it has a little like gold sheen to it, and looks like there's gems encrusted in it from this distance.

dialogue: I want to make an arcana check.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's ornamental.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I just want to make an arcana check.

name: MATT
dialogue: Go for it, go for it.

dialogue: It's a 20.

dialogue: Okay. Take a look at it, there doesn't appear to be enough of a rune structure even on this dagger to give it like a formal enchantment. It looks ritualistic and ornamental. It's probably worth a pretty penny, but it is not a--

dialogue: I put it down and I pat it and I--

dialogue: Climb back up out of the grave.

dialogue: He doesn't know!

dialogue: Tourist, I'm a tourist.

dialogue: Yep.

dialogue: Their teeth are good for 1d8s, though.

dialogue: (laughs) This is true. All right, so what's the plan?

dialogue: We should head west.

dialogue: Head west, meet up.

dialogue: All right. So you guys--

dialogue: I take the little bit of Dust of Tracelessness that we had taken from Grog and I try to sprinkle it on our tracks as we go and cover up our tracks.

dialogue: Okay. As you pull the dust out of your pouch, you look at it, and it's turned to just sand. It seems that the Dust of Tracelessness is effective when only pulled and used directly out of its pouch--

name: TRAVIS

dialogue: If taken out remotely and left on its own for a while, it becomes magically inert.

dialogue: Well then, I use my ranger skills to try to make it look like our tracks are hidden.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I know the city well enough to take us through a relatively--

dialogue: Yes. This is one of those few circumstances where Percy's almost more helpful than you are as far as making your way through. The two of you together? Very helpful. name: LIAM
dialogue: Taking your pee break now.

dialogue: We need to hide.

dialogue: Totally did.

dialogue: Pike, we've missed you so much.

dialogue: Just how I remember you! Warm gelatin.

dialogue: And there is this hot wind that wraps around her and her hair is drifting a little bit. There's something, her physical form is very strange here.

dialogue: Us, too.

dialogue: Can I start taking a look around and see if I see anything?

dialogue: We should be very careful. These two are good at using their brain muscles. Could be an ambush.

dialogue: 26 on perception.

dialogue: This is new. These haven't been here long. I'm not very strong; do you want to start hucking rocks?

dialogue: I am extremely fast and nimble and could totally fuck you up, but I can't lift that much, including door jambs. Could you help me move these rocks?

dialogue: You look very handsome in that beard.

dialogue: Okay. Make an athletics check.

dialogue: (laughs) Oh shit.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Never forget. 18.

dialogue: Does this look familiar to me?

dialogue: This would be similar to the placement of where the bushes were that originally obscured the crawlspace that led into this tunnel.

dialogue: I think this might be it.

dialogue: Well, what happened here?

dialogue: Did they blow it?

dialogue: Does it look like a cave-in, like somebody did it on purpose?

dialogue: "Man-done."

dialogue: I think that's a 21.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, 21.

dialogue: Inspecting this, the pattern in which it fell was very localized, which leads you to believe--

dialogue: I think this was blasted down.

dialogue: Yeah, this was blasted or was intentionally done to demolish this exit as opposed to a natural fall. At this point in time, you've pulled through a few of the larger rocks, and you roll them over and you do reveal a small tunnel.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Hey, look! I found a hole.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Good work, Grog.

dialogue: About 15 minutes of pushing this stuff out of the way before you eventually find it, and it's probably a good ten feet inward.

dialogue: It's tight, but you can start moving in there.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Scanlan, squish in there.

dialogue: Well, we have two gnomes with us.

dialogue: She'll light up the hole.

dialogue: I hope so. (laughter) I will shimmy in, just to see what's down there.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I lean down and say, does it look like somewhere that we can rest for the night?

name: SAM
dialogue: Oi! I can't see anything. (laughter) You got a torch up there, or something?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I flip my Flametongue dagger over backwards and hand it to him through this little hole.

dialogue: Okay. You take the dagger.

dialogue: This feels so cool. It's like a shortsword for me! (laughter)

dialogue: With the flickering light along the blade, it lights up the area. name: SAM
dialogue: No one down here, but I don't know how far this thing goes, and I don't know how well it's guarded.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are there trees around us?

dialogue: Yeah. No more than maybe five feet off this mountain line, the forest grows immediately dense.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: If they've blasted in the entrance, I have a feeling--

dialogue: I don't think they're expecting anyone from here.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: They're not expecting people.

name: LIAM
dialogue: This was taken care of, in their minds. I say we squeeze Grog and Trinket in here.

dialogue: Tell us and we'll release you.

dialogue: That might happen if you're not careful.

dialogue: Anna?

dialogue: "Yes?"

dialogue: Roll an intimidation check.

dialogue: She leans forward and stands up and steps into the light, and you have a better look of her now, and her face is a little weathered from travel. dialogue: Tell us about the experiments beneath the castle.

dialogue: (chuckles) "You'll have to ask Sylas or Delilah for that. I don't have all the details or "the reasons behind it, other than the process I was brought in to construct."

dialogue: Can I see if she's lying?

name: MATT
dialogue: You can. Make an insight check.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Not great.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's a number.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It is a number. 16.

dialogue: 16? Okay. You get the sense that she's telling the truth. "I wasn't interested in their zealotry or the whispered "dealings, just the challenge behind the construction. I enjoy challenge. Challenge that "pays, well, (chuckles) I enjoy that even more."

name: TALIESIN

dialogue: "I'm down here because my work is done and I wish not to linger with an impending battle. I "don't choose sides; I merely let them fight while I live another day far, far away. name: LAURA
dialogue: How did you lose the hand?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Based on the way they've treated me here and their possible intent to not even keep up "their end of the bargain now that I'm free to walk away? Perhaps."

name: MATT

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That may be what your life is worth.

name: MATT
dialogue: "So. What else do you wish to know? What else do you need, even, to get me out from behind "these bars? Because I'm growing very uncomfortable and cold here in this cellar."

dialogue: I pull forward, I look her very deeply in the eye, and I say, you should know who your friends are here. Do you know that we're friends? And I'm going to become friends. I'm casting Friends.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

dialogue: What?

dialogue: "I've no reason to lie. Worst comes to worst, you kill me where I stand or leave me here "to rot. What do I have to gain by lying at this point? Besides, you've already proven you can see "through quite a few ruses. Apparently."

dialogue: So you'd be happy to help us find Cassandra de Rolo, wouldn't you?

name: MATT
dialogue: "If it gets me out of here and gets me free to do my own business, then yes. dialogue: You say you're a scientist.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Do you use magic?

dialogue: "I've no interest in paltry magics. I'm more of one who embraces the sciences as a means of "understanding mystery. My whole purpose here was one giant chemical experiment."

dialogue: I'll let you leave the castle.

dialogue: Perception is passive as hell right now. I am keeping very sharp eye on--

dialogue: Feels like a trap.

dialogue: You're inside the castle right now. You could go and if you want to try and enter one of the rooms to the right or left, you can see if there's a window.

dialogue: Perception?

dialogue: You asking?

dialogue: Can't we look at what she's built after we fight them?

dialogue: It could be useful.

dialogue: As we're walking, I just want to very gently take my gun--

dialogue: And shoot her with it. (laughter)

dialogue: And just put it gently at her back, going, nothing personal. I'm just feeling a bit nervous.

dialogue: "Understood." She straightens up a little more and continues walking ever so carefully. Not quite leaning her head or making too many large movements, but definitely still keeping a seemingly nervous eye on how quiet the atmosphere is.

name: LAURA

dialogue: You hear some slight, muffled, dull thud noise, but you can't really tell how close it is. It's very, very faint.

dialogue: Can I see if the door handle is--

dialogue: (click) It's open.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And?

dialogue: Sure.

dialogue: Okay. You two coast up to the glass and look out, and another cloud-covered, slightly drizzly morning has taken the caldera between the mountains that houses Whitestone in this forest. dialogue: Go ahead and roll perception check, while you're glancing out.

dialogue: So close.

dialogue: That could've been so bad. 20.

dialogue: Okay.

dialogue: It was like whee-- oh.

dialogue: (laughing) Love those little (gasps) moments. Taking a moment, you pull your brother in to point out where you're looking. It looks like the gates to the castle are wide open. name: LAURA
dialogue: Nice. I would loot, but it's Percival's home. Do we see anything that looks like it could be a doorway leading down, or anything?

name: SAM
dialogue: We've gone up, right?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We're on the main level.

dialogue: We're going to try to get my sister first.

dialogue: Do you know, Percival, how to go under?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes. Unless there's something new, then yes. I was born here.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Before my sister leaves, I grab her by the arm and say, "Listen to me--" (creaking) What is that? Pizza. Forget I said that. Listen to me, I do not have a good feeling about this. dialogue: I will wear it. Thank you.

dialogue: I walk out ahead of her.

dialogue: Pull the hood up. So you get advantage on stealth checks. As you guys step into the hallway and move forward, Pike's physical form is drifting along you guys as she takes each step. dialogue: Oh no!

dialogue: Damn.

dialogue: As you feel this warmth on your hand, Vax, and the symbol of Sarenrae that you have embedded in your glove. dialogue: Ooh! (laughter)

dialogue: Oh. Let this be a lesson to all the people out there who think clerics are lame and nobody loves them.

name: MATT

dialogue: (yelps) Shit, she's awake!

name: SAM, LAURA
dialogue: Punch her in the face!

dialogue: No wait, don't. You'll kill her.

dialogue: Up to you. What do you want to do?

dialogue: Blindfold her!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I slap her.

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughing) Roll a strength check.

name: SAM
dialogue: Shit! (laughter) He's going to kill her with a slap.

name: LAURA
dialogue: She'll be knocked unconscious and she'll have to save three times again.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh that's good!

name: MATT
dialogue: (whack) Right across her face. You hear a resounding crack sound as it appears some part of her cheek bone probably is going to be fairly bruised tomorrow. But she is straight to unconsciousness again. (cheering)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: If you're curious, she's still alive.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I can tell.

name: LAURA
dialogue: She almost killed me.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Is she just unconscious?

name: MATT
dialogue: She's still breathing.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm going to try and wake up Cassandra.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I did bandages on her real good.

dialogue: As you're standing in the tunnel, they're off to one side. You go over to where Cassandra is. You briefly set her down to have this conversation. dialogue: "I don't... what? What's going on?"

dialogue: The spinning orb of death.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm going to slap her in the face.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. (slap) Go ahead and roll a strength check.

name: SAM
dialogue: That's your sister, Percy!

name: LAURA
dialogue: She might be unconscious too!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Not with my strength!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (jokingly) Natural 20. (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: 16. Well, actually my strength is still thin because I still have a--

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh! Negative two strength, right.

name: MATT
dialogue: 15, yeah okay. You smack her to get her attention in this circumstance. She stops for a second and gathers herself. Her breathing slows and she stares off into space for a moment.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I need my sister back. Are you awake? Are you a terrible person? Do I want to strangle you right now?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Probably."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Good. Then we can work with this. They were building something down here. The Briarwoods are no longer a problem. They were building something-- what do you know about it? It maybe started, it seems to be affecting magic. I think.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't know. They wouldn't let me near it."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Don't lie to us anymore!

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm not lying! Do I have a reason to lie right now?" And she looks over at you with an intensity to her gaze that catches you not as desperation, but as passionate self-loathing.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You seem to really believe your words, but you know your word is worth fuck all right now. Fuck all.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I know. I know." She leans her head down on the side of this cavern wall and stares off into space. "All that I know about this is that they've been building it under the guidance of some other "person or entity. They referred to him many times as the Whispered One. They're very secretive about "it. The only reason I knew was because I overheard a few conversations and questioned them about it. To "which there was punishment. dialogue: Can I check my history memory banks to see if I know anything about the Whispered One or if that jogs any memory?

dialogue: Roll a religion check, Mr. Bard.

name: SAM
dialogue: Religion check? Well, that's not good. 20.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What?! Natural 20?

name: SAM
dialogue: No.

dialogue: Damn it! I had a really strong reaction to that.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh.

dialogue: Yes, the whispers!

dialogue: He's whispering about the Whispered One!

name: SAM
dialogue: He's gone! Where is he?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: This is the pre-show days!

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's not new, it's just been a while.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It's been a long time.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, but he's on this side of the table.

dialogue: None of us have rolled this well in so long.

dialogue: We used to play-- don't over-listen to it!

dialogue: (starts singing In the Hall of the Mountain King)

name: LIAM
dialogue: He is licking the inside of Sam's ear.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Look at his eyes!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Matthew is the Whispered One.

name: LAURA
dialogue: He is the Whispered One! This is normally the time when Sam would--

dialogue: It was all tongue in my ear the whole time! (laughter) It was so dirty. The Whispered One! I have a memory! I don't know where I learned of this knowledge-- I am very old-- but I did, at some point in my travels, I remember reading about something. A lich king?

name: MATT
dialogue: A lich entity, yeah.

name: SAM
dialogue: Who wanted to be a god. And his name was Vecna, and they called him the Whispered One. That's all I remember, he tried to achieve great power, and I don't know if he was successful or not.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh boy.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Cassandra, does any of that sound familiar?

name: MATT
dialogue: Cassandra shakes her head and says, "Honestly, I didn't know anything beyond the name. "I just knew they were very close with this individual."

name: LAURA
dialogue: When you betrayed us, you said you were serving a higher purpose. Did they plan to sacrifice you to him?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I know there was a blood ritual involved. I did not know more than that. There was to be a "gift of power should I give an element of my life to this ritual." I look back on so "many decisions I've made, and all the people that I've--" The tears just start flowing again.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Insight check. (rolls) I'll take that. 14.

name: MATT
dialogue: 14. Best that you can read off her is there is a deep look of regret and sorrow in her face. And you do notice that, through most of this conversation, as much as she's been able to talk to all of you, she has been unable to make eye contact with Percy.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm going to walk over and plop down in front of her and say, you've backed a losing team. And that's not surprising, you having been through what you've been through. That's all gone now. Sylas is gone, Delilah is on death's door. Whitestone needs to be tended to and protected. Do you know anything that can help us save your birthright here and now?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I mean, you've already done half the job." Her eyes look over at the unconscious Delilah in the hallway.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Cassandra, is there any reason why they'd want to sacrifice you in particular?

name: MATT
dialogue: She thinks hard for a second, her eyes squinting. "I don't. They spoke very little-- "intentionally, I think-- of what they wanted to do. To be honest, I think there was an element "that even they didn't know quite what they were doing. I was a tool. I was to be used. I had my "purposes. I did my best to fulfill them."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I've got a question. Do you care if I smash the shit out of Lady Briarwood's head now?

name: MATT
dialogue: She glances over at her, and with a stern look on her face she goes, "Someone needs to "avenge my family." And for the first time she looks over and makes eye contact with you. You feel a pulse in your hand, like a heartbeat. (thoom) The gun itself seems warmer and warmer, and you guys all notice as a bit of smoke begins to billow out the sides of Percy's sleeves. You hear a familiar voice creep up in the back of your head. "Percival."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I walk up to Lady Briarwood.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Here at your mercy."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I put my gun to Lady Briarwood's head.

name: SAM
dialogue: Wait, Percy, you're going to shoot an unarmed woman?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Hush!

name: SAM
dialogue: Don't shoot an unarmed woman.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Unarmed? She tried to kill us.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You changed the deal. Take her name off the gun.

name: MATT
dialogue: "The deal was never changed."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Who's he talking to?

name: MATT
dialogue: "The deal was made."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I pull the gun away. Things have changed. We need to talk.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: All right?

name: SAM
dialogue: Who's he talking to?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I hold up my hand and shush the group with my hand.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You made a great sacrifice for my gifts, Percival. Do not let it be in vain."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (sighs) Did I even want revenge before I talked to you? Did I? I don't remember anymore. What does she die for? What do I even need? I want my country. I want my sister! name: MATT
dialogue: "Pull the trigger."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I take out my hammer...

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Pull it back, put it to her, put it back. "Maybe I will."

name: MATT
dialogue: You're placing the gun against your own head?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And back to hers.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Percival, don't!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Percy, no!" "Percival, don't do this. We made a deal."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I put the gun to the side-- no, I'm holding the gun on Briarwood. That deal was a soft deal. It was a dream. It was a vision.

name: MATT
dialogue: "What are visions if not a window into the future? You understand so little, Percival. Do not "make me regret sharing this with you."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I need more from you if you want anything from me. I don't trust you anymore. Besides. I put the gun to the hand of Lady Briarwood and pull the trigger. The gun's broken anyway. I drop it. I'm not satisfied. I want my money back.

name: MATT
dialogue: (chuckles) The smoke still billows out from you at this point.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's actually also still around her, it occurs to me.

name: MATT
dialogue: Go ahead and make a wisdom saving throw.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yep.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (mumbles) You have advantage.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I have advantage! Thank you!

name: MATT
dialogue: You do.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm not doing anything, but I'm holding a dagger and just watching Percy, and aiming at Percy.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yay! 20.

name: MATT

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Which does work.

name: MATT
dialogue: And then you (grunts) rip control of your hand once again.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Delilah. You are going to die tonight. Whether or not it is a merciful, quick death or a slow and agonizing one, controlled by something darker than I know, is entirely up to you. How do we stop that thing?!

name: MATT
dialogue: Delilah, whose eyes are still rolling after all the shouting that's been going on as she comes into consciousness with a gag around her mouth and goes (breathes heavily, struggling) And her eyes dart around in fear. name: SAM
dialogue: I will Mage Hand to remove the gag from her.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh god! I pull an arrow and aim it right at her head.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, I prep my fire hands.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I know the pain you're feeling right now. I know the rage. I know every moment of it, and I guarantee I can make it worse. I can make it so much worse. Fix this. And join your beloved.

name: MATT
dialogue: As this is happening, the gag falls away from her mouth from the magic hand. She's glancing at you and the smoke is now billowing up stronger to the point where you can barely see Percy's torso. You can see his head now, and what little bit of a view you have, his eyes have gone completely dark. There is just pitch black, completely encasing the entirety of his visible eye. You can see his feet still dangling beneath the smoke, and his feet are digging and tensed into the ground.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Delilah, don't make me hurt you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I reach over and I grab Vex's hand. And I look at her and I say, what do we do?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Grog, be ready to restrain me.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'm ready!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Percival Frederickstein von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III, you will fight this monster inside of you!

name: MATT
dialogue: Delilah is looking at you right now and the anger and fury in her eyes clarified, she just looks up and, "You've already taken everything from me."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I really haven't. You still have your sanity and your life. I will take your life tonight, but I can leave you your sanity.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Interesting. You seem to be struggling, Percy."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Okay, I'm going to be an asshole. Fine. Fine. Casting Minor Illusion.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm changing my form into the screaming, writhing, slowly-melting visage of Lord Briarwood.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh shit!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And I'm just going to scream in holy high hell and pain.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Suck it, girl!

name: MATT
dialogue: So Minor Illusion, as a limitation, it wouldn't be a full-body illusion, but you can take elements of your features.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm in smoke. I'm just taking--

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. Where once Percy's face existed, it twists into this shimmering apparition of Sylas Briarwood looking down at her as his face contorts into horrible, screaming pain. name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That pain you're feeling, I've felt for years. Don't think I've imagined every way to hurt you! I could spend years hurting you before you die, in ways you cannot imagine. Now, how do we stop it?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't know. I don't even know if it worked. We've been preparing for this ritual "for... five godforsaken years. All to repay a debt. And that's all. You forced us. "It was too soon."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Why? Why was it too soon? What were you waiting for?

name: MATT
dialogue: "We were waiting for a particular date. There is a time each year in which the barriers "between realms grow and grow very weak. name: LAURA
dialogue: What did he give you?

name: MATT
dialogue: At which point, her eyes well up with tears, and she looks over. "He gave me my Sylas back. And "you took him from me again. So do what you must do. name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, I really won't. Knock her out again.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh. Fine! (punching sound)

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a strength check.

name: MATT
dialogue: 19? (impact noise) You hear (clinking) across some of the lower rocks as two of her teeth go scattering out the side of her mouth.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Collect them.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: They're not pointy, right?

name: MATT
dialogue: No.

dialogue: Check her person for anything.

dialogue: Oh, I will gladly do that for you.

dialogue: Hold on a second. Are you sure you don't want to smoke this bitch?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I check her person for anything valuable.

dialogue: I think we're just going to throw her into the acid pits. No, I don't feel...

dialogue: What's the plan here, Percy?

dialogue: Shit!

dialogue: Plus two! Plus two.

dialogue: Fine.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Natural one.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Nope. That's a 16.

name: MATT
dialogue: So you watch as Scanlan looks around, grabs it. Picks it up and (clink) the full barrel comes off of the gun.

name: SAM
dialogue: I back away from it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You guys, he's got smoke billowing out of him right now.

name: SAM
dialogue: Kick it off away to the corner.
