dialogue: Scanlan. Give me the other gun.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, it's on the floor right there.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The other gun.

name: SAM
dialogue: You were talking to something out there. What was it? I was very scared. I'm a little man!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Just change the subject.

name: SAM
dialogue: Who were you talking to?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I need another gun.

name: SAM
dialogue: Are you going to kill me with it? (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Maybe?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I walk between them and say, Percy, what are we doing here? That woman deserves everything that is brought upon her, but what are we doing for Whitestone? What are we doing?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: More importantly, what was that just now?! Who were you talking to?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't know.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What?!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Things have gotten a bit weird.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Percy, you cannot honestly tell us you don't know anymore! We just watched you have a full-fledged conversation with yourself!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Did they not hear any of the voice?

dialogue: Yeah, was he talking out loud?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh shit, I came off like a crazy person just then!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You did! Yes, you did.

name: SAM
dialogue: Here's what I know.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We were trying to answer you for a little bit.

name: SAM
dialogue: Here's what I know. Vecna is possibly, maybe on the loose, maybe coming back. We know that this ritual has been started, and we don't know whether killing her is going to end it or not. So I propose that we start leaving right away.

dialogue: Pike, do you know anything about Vecna?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Anything further?

dialogue: Pike, you go ahead and make a religion check.

name: SAM
dialogue: Matt, fly to New York to whisper in her ear. (laughter)

dialogue: It's tempting.

dialogue: Yeah, just text her!

dialogue: 17, okay. Not a whole lot more information than what Scanlan was able to ascertain from this. name: MARISHA
dialogue: I wonder what Erevan has to do with this.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And he created a vampire? He made Sylas a vampire?

name: MATT
dialogue: You do know that-- sorry.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Go ahead.

name: MATT
dialogue: You do know, and Pike relays this too. In particular, Vecna is known as, for lack of a better term, the patron saint-- or lesser god to those who worship-- as the deity of secrets. name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Jeez.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Things are complex, and I don't trust myself to take her life. I'm in over my head.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Do you need someone else to do it for you?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't know if that will help.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: She almost killed Vex, she didn't kill Vax, we've got to do fucking something with her.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: This thing wants her dead, and the only thing I can think to do is to say no.

name: LIAM
dialogue: This thing? What thing?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: This thing in my head--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Your thing?!

name: LIAM
dialogue: What thing is that, Percival?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't know!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, start fucking talking, Percival, because we've all watched you talk to yourself for five straight minutes, and we're not going to deal with it for much longer!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Sorry, Percy. I'm with Vax, here.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I had a dream, and that was all.

dialogue: You mentioned just now that you wanted your money back. Was this a dream? Did you pay somebody? And with what?

dialogue: It was a dream where I was offered a means to revenge. It was a dream!

dialogue: Well, clearly it wasn't!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, I know that now.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Percival.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: This is as new to me as anyone.

dialogue: It feels like you are lying to us.

dialogue: Can I do an insight check on him?

dialogue: Please.

dialogue: (laughs) "Let me know if I'm lying, because--"

dialogue: Fucking fuck!

dialogue: Why do you all keep rolling so poorly against me?

dialogue: Persuasion six, deception two.

dialogue: 23! Ooh! Two in one!

dialogue: You got a whisper?!

dialogue: Whispers!

dialogue: I think we've already had an episode called "Whispers."

dialogue: "Ear-tonguing."

dialogue: For the record, I like the shadow stuff.

dialogue: You don't seem very satisfied.

dialogue: Yeah, walk away, you beardless bastard.

name: MATT
dialogue: As everyone gathers in now, you can now see more discussions and people are starting to really place bets down now on the outcome of this circumstance. The barmaid comes up again. "You, "champion Grog, sit down. And you, champion Trisha, sit down. As the final round of this show of "majestic might happens now. Hands clasped, please."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: If I may, thank you for your service to this city. That last round was a true pleasure to watch.

name: MATT
dialogue: Her face goes from hardened to soft for a minute as she reaches out and clasps you, not hand in hand, but forearm to forearm, and gives you a solid shake. "I've done so little. You've done far "more. But we all must do our part to keep the city safe."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Aye.

name: MATT
dialogue: "But right now, I'm going to have to destroy you."

name: LAURA
dialogue: I kind of love Trish the Dish.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I know, I like her, too.

name: MATT
dialogue: Her clasp on your forearm slides back, keeping your hand. Both of you tense muscles, we're talking Predator vs. Schwarzenegger.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (Schwarzenegger accent) Yah, what's the matter, Dylan? You guys ate too many pretzels?

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughs) Just like that. As the crowd begins to shout different names, you can see people going, "Trish, Trish, Trish, Grog, Grog, Grog." The voices are starting to grow and grow as both of you are standing there focusing on each other. You can see her tightly bunned dark brunette hair, you can see these green eyes piercing through, looking straight into yours with a bit of sly smirk on the side of her face. You can see a little bit of a scar on the outside of her face that's longtime healed and you can see she's definitely seen her share of battle, just from the complexion and the intensity in her face.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: She's one of us.

name: MATT
dialogue: "For the final round, let this show of might begin!" Strength check.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Eight.

name: MATT
dialogue: As the moment of tension hits, you can sense there's definitely a balance, both of you are keeping at bay. She cocks her head curiously and forces you down to the three-quarter back position. Go ahead and make another strength check.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Come on, Grog! Oh my god.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Six.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's that sword's influence.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, it's laughing in the Bag of Holding.

name: MATT
dialogue: She brings you right down to the edge of the table and you can see in her face, there's this genuine look of surprise, like she probably could have finished you, but she feels like there's a trick or there's something to it that she can't be beating you this easy.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'm so surprised by what's happening. I use Intimidating Presence on her.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh shit.

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughs) Okay. Go ahead and make an intimidation check.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Fuck.

name: MATT
dialogue: Does this have to be during a rage?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: 12. I'll go into a rage for it.

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughing) It may have to be. Let's see.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (laughing) Why weren't you raging the whole time?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I was hoping I wouldn't need it!

name: MATT
dialogue: No, you don't have to be in a rage for it, but you can choose to, if you want.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: it doesn't add anything to my strength roll, right?

name: MATT
dialogue: A 12 for intimidation? Well, what do you want to do to try and intimidate her? She's about to finish you off on this table.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'm like, oh! (grunts) and I bite down on my tongue and blood just starts to pour out of the corner of my mouth.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, gross!

name: MATT
dialogue: She sees this, and her eyes go wide for a second. She pulls back and for a brief moment, you feel her grip loosen ever so slightly. Go ahead and make the next strength check with advantage.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Fuck. (laughing) It's unreal. 11.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: The other one was a one.

name: MATT
dialogue: Well, I'm glad you had advantage on that; she rolled a five. So you do manage to (groans) force her back up. You're still in a bad place, but you manage to pull out of that circle and you can see now her intensity hits and she realizes she's not going to go soft on you at all going forward. But as the blood pools down your chin, you can feel the iron-y taste swishing around in your mouth and you can see there's a little bit of a quiver to her. She's still spooked by this whole circumstance, but she's trying her best. Go ahead and make another strength check.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: She's battle-worn. 19.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's good!

name: MATT
dialogue: That's good. She has disadvantage on these because of the fright. I'm giving her that, but even still, she still rolls a 17. What did you roll, total?

name: MATT
dialogue: 19. You guys keep it-- she's still holding you there, you're not able to gain any ground. You're really impressed by this display she's giving you. Roll again.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Do I have advantage? No.

name: MATT
dialogue: No.

name: MATT
dialogue: 12? Okay. She forces you back down--

name: SAM
dialogue: I step forward and I sing a song of inspiration.

name: MATT
dialogue: What are you singing?

name: SAM
dialogue: I sing, (sings) let's go raging now, everybody's learning how, come on on a rampage with me!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Come on on a rampage with me!

name: MATT
dialogue: All right, take a d10 inspiration, as you hear the song break through the intensity and you know that Scanlan's presence alone in itself and his fine ditties means that you can do this.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Fine ditties!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Show us your ditties!

name: LAURA
dialogue: With the ten inspiration.

name: MATT
dialogue: With the ten? Okay. It's good you did that. You force her back up, she starts like, really pushing into it and you can see now the sweat's dripping off of her brow, her eyes are quivering. Make another check. How long does that last?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Seven.

name: MATT
dialogue: Seven. Hold on.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You should switch.

name: SAM
dialogue: Grog, what are you doing?!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (laughing) I don't know! They're so low! It was all those free rolls during the two weeks when I rolled 20--

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh my god, do you really have hand herpes? (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: What did you roll?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Seven.

name: MATT
dialogue: Seven. Yeah, she still beats you. So, at this point, you're pushed down. She gives you this look--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: This is unreal.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. Of intense anger-- and her face softens and she gives you a nod of respect. (thud) Releases her grip and pulls away, holds her arms up, crowd goes wild. The drink is slammed in front of her, the ale swishing and spilling over the side. She takes it in one hand and slides it forward and hands it to you.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Aw, she's a good lady.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You are a true warrior and I hope you'll continue to protect this city with that strength.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I intend to." She gives you a nod, walks around, accepts her coin purse and steps back into the rest of the celebration.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I walk away (coughs), coughing (coughs), trying not to cry. (coughs) I take my tankard and splash it on my face. Oh, it's just ale. It's just ale. (sobs)

name: SAM
dialogue: It's okay, Grog. Let's go get you drunk.

name: MATT
dialogue: As this is happening, a courier comes up dressed in colors that are reminiscent of the courier service that travels through Emon, through Westruun. There's a certain type of overcoat they wear that gives you the inclination that they've traveled from nearby civilization. Steps up with a rolled up sequence of letters and a small box that is wrapped up.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh look, the young boy you ordered, Scanlan.

name: MATT
dialogue: He's in his mid-20s. (laughter) He's asking around. "Looking for a Percival and a Vox Machina. Percival?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm Percival.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You're Percival?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm to deliver this to you." He hands you the small box. "I have here two small letters." And hands them over both to you. There's a small, thin one that is actually written to Percival, and there's one addressed to Vox Machina.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I was going to sit here and watch you roll them.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Presentation's lost.

name: MATT
dialogue: That's fine.

name: SAM
dialogue: I just noticed Taliesin's outfit, by the way.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We were supposed to wear pajamas.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I wore my pajamas. My muppet pajamas.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, the week got busy and we forgot.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You don't want me in my pajamas because they're--

name: MATT
dialogue: That one's to you and the other one's to Vox Machina.

name: SAM
dialogue: (sings) Letters, we've got letters.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, this is quite interesting. "Vox Machina, a little bird tells me you have been "playing the heroes again. Keep this up, and the whole world will end up indebted to you. Please "accept this small gift in the spirit of Winter's Crest, as a token of my enduring gratitude. "Perhaps it will prove useful in a difficult moment. In the meantime, I look forward to a "fuller account of your deeds reaching us in Vasselheim. A joyous Crest to you all. It seems "you have earned it. Lillith."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: "P.S., Zahra sends her greetings."

name: SAM
dialogue: (dreamily) Zahra.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: The tieflings!

name: SAM
dialogue: We had quite a night together. Just braiding each other's hair.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I tuck the private note away and put it in my pocket.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, there's another one, right?

name: MATT
dialogue: There is a box, yes.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, is it big enough to hold a giant carpet?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Perhaps a small ice egg.

name: MATT
dialogue: It's about that big in your hands.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We open the box.

name: MATT
dialogue: You open the gift. Inside, there are two--

name: SAM
dialogue: Check it for traps!

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughs) Make a reflex save-- no. As you open it, you see inside there are two crystalline stones that both identically look like that.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's been a while since we had a visual aid.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, it's nice when you have a really good artist, apparently. But two stones like this. They are called Gate Stones.

name: SAM
dialogue: Gate Stones?

name: MATT
dialogue: The two stones are essentially linked. One is placed wherever you like and the other is kept with you. A single individual, just an individual, not a group, can take a minute to concentrate on one stone and be instantly transported to where the other stone is, with the stone.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Badass.

name: LIAM
dialogue: One-way ticket.

name: MATT
dialogue: Essentially, yeah.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You take it with you and you can zoom back to wherever you left it.

name: SAM
dialogue: There are two stones in this box?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. They are the two that are linked.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: A person or linked?

name: MATT
dialogue: No, there is a single set.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So this is a get out of jail free card.

name: SAM
dialogue: Or a bamf-in-Pike card.

name: MATT
dialogue: There's multiple situational uses for it, depending. But apparently this has been painstakingly either enchanted, constructed, and sent by Lillith for you.

name: LIAM
dialogue: They're all from Lillith?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, the letters and those two stones.

name: SAM
dialogue: From Lillith and Zahra?

name: MATT
dialogue: And Zahra, both of them, essentially.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, Lillith doesn't have the other stone?

name: LIAM
dialogue: For a little arcane booty call?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't know what you're talking about.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Please?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I don't think I've ever seen Percy giggle before.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are you blushing?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No. It's cold. Very cold.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It's a new demon, isn't it? The blushing demon!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: She was great, wasn't she?

name: SAM
dialogue: Lillith is a true friend. Zahra, as well.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Zahra is great, as well.

name: MATT
dialogue: You hear murmurs now, people mentioning the pie-eating contest starting soon.

name: SAM
dialogue: Vex and Vax!

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right, we'll give it a go.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you guys make your way over there, we're going to go ahead and go to our break. We're at the middle point here, yeah. So it's going to be a longer break guys, because we've got a little present for you. I know for a while we've been talking about this work we've been doing on a pre-stream story of Vox Machina's adventures that you guys hadn't had a chance to really experience. So, through all of us doing our individual narration, as well as the wonderful Wendy Sullivan doing incredible work on 50 pieces of art for this, and using music from actually some of our Critters that sent us some great musical tracks, we have been able to present to you over the next 20 minutes, the story of Vox Machina, the beginning. So, enjoy guys, we'll see you here in a moment.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah!

name: MATT
dialogue: The grandest of adventures often stem from humble beginnings. The story of Vox Machina is one such a tale. They begin as a ragtag group of mercenaries in the swamp town of Stillben, eking out a living, when a job board posting brings them to Fendril Vas, the wealthy head of a small merchant empire. Hired to investigate new competition in town called The Myriad, the path eventually leads them into a chamber housing a planar rift, pulling the group into the plane of the stillborn god Crysa-Thul. It is revealed that the contract was a ruse to feed the party to the undead, fetal deity. Upon destroying the abomination, the party returns to repay Fendril's deceit with a blade to the throat.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Weeks pass, and Grog the barbarian hasn't been seen since suddenly leaving for the city of Westruun. Heading there in search of him, the party meets his childhood friend, and their new companion: the gnome cleric, Pike. Grog apparently hasn't been acting normally, and had marched off on his own through the Bramblewood towards the ominous mountain, Gatshadow. The party followed, dispensing with a troop of roadside thieves along the way, and wound their way toward the mountain. Deep within, they encountered an abandoned subterranean city and eventually a crypt housing a mind-controlled Grog, the reanimated corpse of his father Strongjaw, and a dying mage attempting a ritual to Lichdom. Our heroes slayed the mage, but not before he could complete the ritual and embed his phylactery into Grog's chest. Returning to town in search of aid, they find there are few of enough knowledge or power to ascertain the nature of Grog's wound. Also, rumors of missing children begin to reach the party's ears. While contemplating all this at a local inn, the party is approached by a mysterious elf named Drez Vina who wishes to pay handsomely for the party to infiltrate an archmage's tower, and retrieve a particular brass box within. Pushing forward in the hopes of speaking with this archmage, the party accepts, and passes through arcane trap after trap to reach the top of the tower, deciding not to steal from the archmage but instead parley with him for his aid. The tower's keeper, Realmseer Eskil Ryndarien, agrees to help and sends the party to collect two items he requires for the ritual: the skull of a nightmare and the heart of a nymph. The caveat: their defeated foe is indeed a lich now, and in merely two weeks, he will be reborn within Grog! They travel north to the Umbra Hills, wrestle with a small cult to slay their infernal messenger and his nightmare steed, and find a fresh companion in Percy, newly freed from imprisonment. From there, the party rushes south to the Frostweald, a forest shrouded in eternal winter. Battling past basilisks, the party finds a single, unfrozen pool where they coax a nymph from her dimensional sanctuary. Talking their way out of battle, Grog enters the sanctuary with the nymph, and returns holding a jewel gifted by the beautiful creature: the "heart" of the nymph.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Traveling back to the archmage, the ritual is completed and the phylactery destroyed in time, but not without some lingering necromancy branded within Grog. They are suddenly approached by the mysterious elf again, saying his master is unhappy with the broken contract, and he demands that either the debt be paid, or the party complete a more difficult contract in its place. The party accepts, and heads into the Shade Barrow, an ancient druid burial chamber that was purchased and renovated by an eccentric lord who made it his own tomb. Fighting the denizens of the barrow, they locate the tomb and the iron golem guarding it. Successfully defeating the golem, they tear the Arcane Cortex from its chest and return it to Drez to square their debt. After a bit of R and R, a clean-shaven dwarf named Grimthorne propositions the group to enter a nearby, underground fighting ring, even offering to represent them. The party agrees and, not surprisingly, manages to pull off a victory. With the holiday of Winter's Crest arriving, the town bustles with preparation for a festival, during which a strange blue crystal is delivered in the name of Archmage Eskil. This crystal suddenly detonates, freezing the entire populace of Westruun in ice-- though the party is protected by a sudden ally in the streets. In a last-ditch arcane effort, a mystic merchant named Noja manages to shield the group from harm. And where the crystal previously rested now stood a pale, nude woman of white hair and frail physique. She opens a portal and leaps through, the party giving chase into what seems like an icy, frozen world, chaotic and elemental in nature. They catch up to the woman, who then reveals her true self: a great white dragon. Weakened by her premature "rebirth", the party manages to defeat her, and upon returning to Westruun, discover its people released from their icy prison. With the archmage Eskil Ryndarien now on trial for the attack on Westruun, the party intercedes and proves his innocence. In thanks, Eskil uses his talents to investigate the source of the blue crystal, revealing the powerful society of thieves, known as the Clasp, responsible for its delivery. Vax, having previously been a member of the Clasp, knows the main headquarters lies within the capital city of Emon, and Vox Machina sets out for the west.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Upon arriving in the sprawling metropolis of Emon, the party continues to hear of children disappearing, and reports of a black-haired, golden-eyed boy befriending them before they vanish. While investigating, they do a few odd jobs, one of which unexpectedly leads them to the home of Syldor, Vex and Vax's father, and his new wife and child. Awkwardness aside, Syldor is here as ambassador to Syngorn, the elven city of their origin, to seek aid from the Sovereign Uriel Tal'Dorei. However, the political climate of Emon is tense with a recent, failed attempt on the royal family's life making Uriel unreachable at the moment. Syldor's connection within the Council has now gone missing, and his mission stands at a complete standstill. He hires the party to look in on this missing ally, Sir Gregory Fince, and get his ear back to Syngornian business. Vox Machina finds Sir Gregory's home dark and still, pushing them to infiltrate and investigate. Within, they discover a dark presence in the home, leading them into a battle with demons in the basement. The battle won, Sir Gregory's tortured corpse is found, as are his notes about the attempted assassination on Uriel and his family. It seems that since the attempt, the royal family has grown strange and withdrawn, keeping Uriel from the council most hours, and his wife now demanding she attend all meetings, whispering in the Sovereign's ear and scoffing at the others who defy their decree. A General Krieg thwarted the attempt, and is mentioned often. The party decides to inquire with him. On their way out of the basement, half of the party falls into a trap, tumbling into a cistern and are flushed deep below into a subterranean river system. The trapped party members-- Vex, Keyleth, Grog, Tiberius, and Percy-- come to rest on a small island in the vast Crystalfen Lake, home to a terrible aboleth! Barely escaping, they eventually discover the base remnants of an ancient town, long toppled, and a small hut that contains a clever hag named Trysta. Tiberius finds one of his prized artifacts and makes a dangerous deal to acquire it. The party barters for information on how to escape, which Trysta will give... in exchange for their aid in slaying a newly nested denizen that threatens her work. The party agrees, climbing to the very top of the Crystalfen Cavern to do battle with an umber-hulk. The fight goes south when Grog is tossed from the cavern ceiling, nearly dying upon impact with the island, but victory is eventually theirs. Returning, Trysta shows them a hidden staircase that exits into the Graveyard District of Emon.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: The other members-- Vax, Pike, and Scanlan-- set out to find where the cistern could have drained to. Scanlan leaves to seek out a map of the sewers, while Vax and Pike notice they are being followed through the town. Leading the pursuers into an alley, the shadowed figures attack, eventually knocking them both out. Vax and Pike awaken within the Clasp's headquarters, meeting with one of their leaders, or Spirelings, named Modeth. The Clasp had Sir Gregory's home under surveillance, as bad political stuff can be difficult for the way the Clasp does business, and when our heroes were spotted leaving, they had to be interrogated. Vax reveals his membership to the Clasp sect in Westruun, and Modeth calls for a test of their skills and intent. Pike and Vax are then forced to do battle with a chained chimera in the Clasp's arena. Their might rings true, and the beast falls beneath their weapons, but Modeth is not convinced. While the two are held overnight, they manage to escape from the Clasp's lair, exiting into the night and managing to locate the rest of the party in the Graveyard district. Knowing their next step is to speak with General Krieg, Vax forges a letter of summons using Sir Gregory's handwriting, and the party is allowed entry into the carefully guarded Cloudtop District, the innermost area of the city and home to the Citrine Garrison, as well as Emon's Palace. Approaching the garrison, they have an audience with General Krieg, who seems nice and keenly interested upon learning of the Clasp's involvement. He also mentions the difficulty in talking with Uriel since the attack, and is sad about the death of Sir Gregory, but warns to leave the investigation to the officials. Vox Machina then heads to the palace to try their hand at speaking with Uriel, but entry is barred. They find another is being prevented from entering, a golden-haired woman in fancy blue robes who angrily stomps away from the palace doors. They engage her in conversation, and she reveals herself to be Allura Vysoren, a powerful arcanist and member of the Tal'Dorei Council. They discuss the state of things within the palace, how Uriel is a good and trusted man, but his actions (and those of the Empress Salda) are recently suspect. After seven days of being kept from the council chambers, she's about to give up and leave. The party tells her of their findings, and Allura leads them to her tower within the district to further discuss the matter in private.

name: SAM
dialogue: Within, Allura and the party make an alliance, and Keyleth aids her in performing a scrying ritual on the palace. The vision reveals that the family of Uriel-- his wife, two daughters, and son-- are all under the influence of some demonic force, and have addled the mind of their father, using him as a mouthpiece for their plot. The party decides to pay a visit to the Clasp, using Vax and Pike's knowledge of an entrance, and end up in a confrontation with Spireling Modeth within his chambers. The battle ends with Modeth's head on the floor and four strange, glowing crystals he had been keeping now stolen by the party. They attempt to leave, but are met by a host of Clasp members and another, dangerous-looking Spireling. Through Scanlan's deft lies and coercion, the party is allowed to leave unharmed before their deeds are discovered. They return to Allura's tower only to find the front door ajar and the interior tossed by some previous scuffle. As they reach the top of the tower, they investigate, finding signs of a struggle with a demonic entity, and Allura's escape seemingly successful. Unfortunately, a magical defense of the tower is triggered, and it begins to cave and crumble around them. Through some ingenuity-- and the discovery of a magic carpet-- the party manages to escape being crushed within, Allura's ivory monolith now compacted into a single, magical pearl. Our heroes then locate and enter the home of General Krieg, finding a brainwashed servant and a hidden passage that leads to a teleportation circle. Using the device, they are transported to a distant cavern, high in a range of frost-covered mountains, and an incredible hoard of gold, jewels, and fine trinkets. Across the room are four obsidian orbs placed within the rock. As one is touched, a giant eye appears from within the black crystal and a voice erupts, calling for a Brimscythe, and noticing the unfamiliar folk, mentions, "Intruders... I know your face now. He "is a fool, and so are you, insect." The orbs all crack simultaneously, becoming inert. Grog dives right in, rage-looting the gold, but the arrival of the party seems to call the attention of General Krieg, who appears at the teleportation circle. He angrily denounces the party and reveals his true form, that of a frightening blue dragon!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: The battle is difficult, with many an ally nearly devoured, but eventually Vax strikes a mortal blow. Krieg, or Brimscythe, defiantly smashes against the support pillars of the cavern in his death throes, causing the chamber to collapse, the party barely escaping via the teleportation circle. Leaving Krieg's home, Allura finds the party and warns that the evil that feeds on the throne is growing more bold. She herself was attacked shortly after the scrying was complete, and barely escaped. As dark clouds fill the sky above Emon, the party decides the time to strike has come. Allura aids the party in infiltrating the palace, and they storm the throne room. Uriel sits upon his throne, surrounded by his creepily mannered, possessed family. Vox Machina attacks, managing to banish the shadows from within their bodies, but the throne itself cracks in half as the dais below glows a deep red, summoning the entity behind the entire scheme: a devil prince called Juurezel, who tells the party of a great war between devils and demons spilling over into this plane, threatening all creation. He justifies his actions, and notes all the demonic forces throughout the city, and tells them of the horrible devastation that will ensue if the party stops him. They read him as honest, and Juurezel asks for their aid in destroying the demonic threat, offering a single Wish should they make a pact. The party deliberates and agrees to the contract. Thinking over what they had just agreed to, the party returns to the throne room, asking for their Wish to be provided to aid them in their demon hunting. Upon its casting, the party wishes to cancel their contract with the creature, and attack! The devil prince angrily reveals his true form, a hideous treachery demon, a glabrezu. A long, deadly, and epic confrontation ensues, one that suddenly claims the life of the gnomish cleric, Pike. Her death fresh in their minds, Vox Machina deals the killing blow, sending the demon to its unmaking. They gather up the cold body of their fallen friend and rush her to a nearby temple of Sarenrae, where a resurrection ritual is attempted... and succeeds.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The clouds disperse, the immediate danger over, but the royal family lies on the throne room floor, catatonic. Upon inspection, their souls are missing and their bodies failing. The party recalls the four glowing orbs they recovered from the Clasp headquarters behind Modeth, now identified as soul jars, and through a rigorous and tense evening, all souls are successfully restored to the family. A few days pass, and Sovereign Uriel Tal'Dorei calls the party for audience. He thanks them all for their bravery, heroism, and for saving him, his family, and quite possibly all of Emon. As thanks, he offers them a place on the Tal'Dorei Council and informs them of his intent to throw another Winter's Crest festival to make up for the ones ruined in Westruun, and here via assassination attempt, where they will be celebrated as heroes! He has also commissioned the construction of a keep for them on the outskirts of Emon as a sign of his very deep gratitude. A week later, the festival begins! The populace is out in full force to meet and celebrate Vox Machina, but during the festivities, the party notices Uriel's son Gren speaking to another child-- one with black hair and golden eyes. They immediately spring to apprehend the child, but he escapes with Uriel's son. They give chase, following him into an alley, and through a portal of some kind. The party finds themselves atop a large island drifting through the Astral Plane, surrounded by a perilous bramble forest. They fight their way through, eventually coming upon a gothic mansion towards the center of the landmass. Within, the party makes their way to the inner library, where numerous kidnapped children are working all about the place, cleaning nervously. The Dread Emperor, as he calls himself, stands from his chair, the child illusion fading into a golden-armored man with long, black hair, four children chained at the neck to his breastplate. He attacks the party with fierce magic, mind-controlling all of his child servants to attack as well. With the first blow dealt, they realize that damaging him also hurts the chained children, one boy accidentally falling in battle to Keyleth's magic. Eventually, they succeeded in destroying the Dread Emperor and return to Emon with a host of lost children, happily now found. Six months of peace follow as their new keep is constructed, and the party scatters to their separate business until its completion. Upon their return, they assess their new abode with delight, naming it Greyskull Keep. They then send out job inquiries, seeking guards for hire, and servants. After an impromptu try-out, they settle upon their new hires.

I did my digging in Wildemount, specifically Wynandir and "Port Damali, near the southwest coast of the Shearing Channel. dialogue: "By a mob. All official documentation in Wildemount on the Briarwoods was set in this day, "and that we the end of their line. Upon doing more "digging, in Port Damali, months later, it seemed that individuals matching their appearance "appeared briefly within the Port, where they bought a ship and hired a crew. Now there was no "political knowledge in Wildemount, or any approval of a bridge being built, either. This announcement "from the Briarwoods, whom had previously been silent, came about the time that I'd sent two of "my gatherers to look around, and never returned. I theorized that this entire presentation to Emon, "and these political handshakes, were a means to avoid suspicion. "It's also been brought to my attention that the attack within my walls was "indeed instigated by the Briarwoods themselves, and that Sylas is vampiric in nature. This is the "influence that clouded me. This is twice now that I have found myself, in spite of all of my "protections and intents to defend this city, that I have fallen prey to the wills and whims of some "infernal intent. dialogue: I would right now, but I don't have any on me, how crazy is that?

dialogue: I tell some guards on the way out just to block off that house and not let anybody in it. Don't go inside, on your life.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Noted. The order just came through. Don't worry. We're gathering a troop specifically for "this. Don't worry."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Not a lot of troops. Just a couple of dudes is good.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Very well."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you're leaving, you can see there are a few armed individuals, four, approximately, that are moving towards the house to stand guard and inspect the exterior, at the very least. You return to Greyskull Keep. You guys get there, as well. Grog, you return on your own, essentially, at this point, unless you're walking with them with the skull. Vax is nowhere to be found. You do find that Dr. Dranzel, that whole team is gone, except for Zed.

name: SAM
dialogue: The drummer?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yes. Zed is currently having a little bit of ale in the dining room area, along with Jarett, who was assigned to watch over while they're at the keep. As you step inside, they all notice. Jarett, still with his crossbow loaded in his lap, though he's happy and jovial and conversational with Zed. "Ah, you've returned. Good to see all of you in good health. The rest have left into the city."

name: SAM
dialogue: Did they say why? For a performance?

name: MATT
dialogue: Zed leans forward and goes, "Actually, it appears that Kaylie got in some sort of a serious "bar tussle last night and is currently being held in the stocks. The stockade. I get those words "confused. Stockade." He takes a sip of his ale. "The rest of the troupe's going to see if they can "get her out."

name: SAM
dialogue: All right, good to know. Thanks, Zed.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Jarett?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Any issues while we were gone?

name: MATT
dialogue: "No issues, actually. They were good conversationalists. They were very aware of my "disposition, and I kept a very close eye on any movement, preventing them from leaving the room "unless they were as a group, except for their exit, in which Zed escorted me. There have been no "problems."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Good man. I pat him on the shoulder.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: She's in the stockade. Only problem is getting caught. I like her style. Should we get her out?

name: SAM
dialogue: I'd like to, very much, but I don't know how. We can't just barge in there and break someone out of jail. We're known people.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Don't you have your sheriff badge?

name: LIAM
dialogue: (laughs) Well-remembered.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, can't we post a bond or something?

name: SAM
dialogue: It's customs, not sheriff.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Call the council.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, it sounds like they've already-- they're sending other people to get her out. What's the big deal?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, but they could make the problem worse.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Those guys? They'll make it worse.

name: SAM
dialogue: She's quite special to me. I think we should-- I think I should go and try to get her out.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, she's 'quite special' to you, yeah?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: There's one place I haven't done it, and it's in a prison.

name: SAM
dialogue: Not, not in that way. (laughter) That's creepy. No, not in that way.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Why is that creepy?

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm not interested in her in that way.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But you were courting her two days ago.

name: SAM
dialogue: Things have changed.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I thought she spent the night in your room.

name: SAM
dialogue: She's a good person and she deserves much better than the likes of me--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's never stopped you before.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Don't say that, Scanlan. You've got a cube!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's true.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's a rather large cube, but, listen, all right, she's-- she's-- we're related. We're related.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What?

name: SAM
dialogue: And I don't just mean--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Wait, what?

name: SAM
dialogue: She's a Shorthalt.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Like a cousin?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Like a sister?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Like an aunt?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Like a mother?

name: SAM
dialogue: Like a baby. Like a baby Shorthalt.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Whose baby?

name: SAM
dialogue: (high-pitched 'hee' sound)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: 'He'? (laughter)

name: SAM
dialogue: Listen, don't spread the word around. I don't want my cred to be ruined, but... she's my little girl.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You dog!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You're a baby daddy?

name: SAM
dialogue: I didn't know this, this is new information. I'm still just adjusting to it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Holy shit!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You tried to sleep with your baby daddy?

name: SAM
dialogue: No I didn't.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Did you lock that up that night?

name: SAM
dialogue: No, I did not! I did not try and sleep with her. I think deep down inside, some part of me knew, which is why I gave her all that gold. I think.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You paid her for it?

name: SAM
dialogue: No! Oh, Grog, please! (laughter) I may deserve that but no, no. It's not like that at all.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Then you didn't know. There's no part of you that knew you had any children.

name: SAM
dialogue: I mean, I always knew that was a possibility, in the trade I deal in.

name: MATT
dialogue: At this point Zed breaks in and goes, (chuckles) "Indeed!"

name: SAM
dialogue: All right. Easy. Listen, drummer--

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's Zed."

name: SAM
dialogue: You can be replaced easily. When I played with them, we had seven drummers in two years. And I killed two of them. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: He sets his drink down and pushes it away. "Should I go?"

name: SAM
dialogue: No, just stay and shut up.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'll take that, though. I take his drink.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, wow. Well, that's--

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, I don't quite know how to act or behave now. And I'm going through a crisis of conscience and identity. I'm sorry; I'm off my game right now. But she's related to me.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Just make sure that she knows that you love her. And make sure that she knows that you're there for her.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Why do you keep saying she's 'related to' you? Why don't you just call her exactly what she is? Which is your daughter.

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't know. Okay, all right.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's weird to be like, 'my child is related to me.'

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm not good with this stuff. I haven't done this before, all right? I haven't really had family for much of my life. And this is a new thing and it's going to take me some time to adjust and figure out what this means for me. All right? I've defined most of my life by the people I've slept with and now, this a new part of me that I have to figure out.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, technically, it's still defined by--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I was just thinking that. It's a redefinition.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You could make a really good move of it by helping her get out of the stockade.

name: SAM
dialogue: I would like to. But I'll need some help, probably. I don't know if we can all go barge in there.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Trinket.

name: MATT
dialogue: (bear grunts)

name: LAURA
dialogue: Scanlan needs help

name: MATT
dialogue: Trinket lumbers over to you and (slurp). Licks the side of your face. (bear groan) Leans into you. Nearly pushing you off your feet from the sheer mass.

name: SAM
dialogue: (laughs) Thanks, Vex. Trinket, I'm okay for right now. But maybe you can help best by staying here and looking after the drummer here and making sure.

name: MATT
dialogue: (growls) Just growls at Zed, who stands up. "I'm just here to make sure that we continue our "deal when they return. I'm not-- I don't-- I just play the drums."

name: LAURA
dialogue: You do a good job of it. Keep drinking that ale.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I give it back.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I--" Takes the empty and goes and refills it from a nearby cask.

name: SAM
dialogue: I know it's late in the day, but I wouldn't mind going right away. Does anyone want to join me?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Do you want all of us? Or a smaller party?

name: SAM
dialogue: Probably just a smaller party. Don't we have business to attend to here? Gold to count and--

name: LAURA
dialogue: I can stay and count.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I can stay with her.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Who do you want to take? You pick your dodgeball team.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Ooh, I like it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well to get out of a stockade, we'll need some cunning. And cunning-- And cunning.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Go ahead and ask.

name: SAM
dialogue: I wish Vax were here.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Don't we have earrings?

name: SAM
dialogue: You know what, we are but they have a range.

name: LAURA
dialogue: They do have a range.

name: SAM
dialogue: Come in, Vax. Earth to Vax. Tune in Tokyo.

name: MATT
dialogue: Approximately where are you right now?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So many secrets!

name: MATT
dialogue: I love the whispers!

name: SAM
dialogue: He's gone to Whitestone!

name: MATT
dialogue: All right, there is no response. He really is out of range.

name: SAM
dialogue: Percy, I need you for your words, and Keyleth for your magic. Let's go.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: All right.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We're useless.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can I heal myself up first?

name: SAM
dialogue: Sure, if you've got a little left for me. Wait, I can give us--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh wait, Pike! Will you hook us up?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yeah," And she goes over and--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm going to try and do a quick repair to my gun, also.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, go for it. She throws down a couple of Cure Light Wounds. She's going to do 3rd level to each of you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Dope.

name: MATT
dialogue: Of Cure Wounds. This'll be 3d8 plus five to each of you. So 23 to you, and 21 to you, Scanlan. She'll do a third one to you, Keyleth. Because you're looking pretty rough, right Keyleth?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Huh?

name: MATT
dialogue: You're looking pretty rough?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm at 65 now, with that. So I'm still 30 under.

name: MATT
dialogue: So on top of that you get another 13. Pike's going to stay with you guys.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right, so. While you guys count the gold and what you managed to gather, you find in the--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Out of sight of Zed! Just so you know.

name: MATT
dialogue: Not a worry. You manage to pull from the hoard entirely, out of gold, silver, copper, platinum, the equivalent of 4,150 gold pieces.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Wow.

name: LIAM
dialogue: There was another 20 or 30g there.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I know, right?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Probably.

name: SAM
dialogue: We can go back.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: How much? 4,000?

name: MATT
dialogue: 4,150 gold.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You don't want to go back in there.

name: MATT
dialogue: About 1,050 gold worth of gems.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yep, in gems. Mark that. And about 750 gold approximately of art items, knick knacks, things that you would have to find a specific seller to really get the money for them.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (singing) Knick knacks.

name: SAM
dialogue: Tchotchkes.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, like small jade statues, bits of jewelry...

name: LAURA
dialogue: And how much in platinum?

name: MATT
dialogue: Well, the gold equivalent of platinum is what it would be. The total amount is 4,000. But nice try. All right, so. You guys make your way-- After asking around a bit, you figure the closest stockade is the Promenade stockade.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, there's multiple stockades.

name: MATT
dialogue: There are. But that's the one that's closest to the keep and the first place you should start. So you make your way towards the Promenade stockade. It's a fairly grim-looking grey stone building on the outskirts of Abdar's Promenade, which is a very, very, bombastic, colorful gathering of tents and buildings and various shopkeeps. As you walk to the outside of it, approaching, you can see immediately, there on the steps, is most of Dr. Dranzel's troupe, just sitting on the outside steps with two guards at the door. And they're all talking amongst themselves, waiting outside. Dr. Dranzel is not amongst them. As you begin to step closer--

name: SAM
dialogue: He got nabbed, too, didn't he?

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughs) As you step closer, you can see they wave you down, and they recognize you and approach you with an excited look on their face as if they now have some sort of backup.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm going to whisper to Scanlan. I'm going to say, I'm going to stay back. You go ahead.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right, thanks.

name: MATT
dialogue: So Kent Plucker approaches you as you approach and goes like, "Scanlan. Good thing "you're here. I think we may need your silvered tongue to go ahead and help us out in this "endeavor. Dr. Dranzel's inside; he's been arguing with the warden for quite some time. We're trying "to get Kaylie out."

name: SAM
dialogue: What happened? Why is she in jail?

name: MATT
dialogue: "She got in a bit of a bar fight last night, it seems. Messed up quite a few gentlemen and all "of them are arrested and being held inside. They're wanting a bit of change to do the damages "and pay for the fine of whatever else she's done. And, well, we're not keen on really paying fines, "so we're trying to see how much we can get out of this with our--"

name: SAM
dialogue: What's the fine?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't know. We didn't go in as a full group. The guards wouldn't let us."

name: SAM
dialogue: Was she injured in any way?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I haven't seen her. You'll have to go inside to find out."

name: SAM
dialogue: All right. Thank you. You won't be needed here anymore. You guys can leave.

name: MATT
dialogue: They all look at each other. "If it's fine by you, we're going to wait for Dr. Dranzel."

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh yes, all right. Percy.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes?

name: SAM
dialogue: What do you think our play is here?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well--

name: SAM
dialogue: Should we go in and pay? Should we do a bit of a ruse? You still have your Hat of Disguise, right?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes, but I think I'm more useful as myself, rather than anybody else.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, you could be a guard taking me in there.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think on a certain level, you're possibly making this more complicated than it needs to be.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, but it's fun, though? No, no, you're right, we should just go in and talk.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You forget you have clout. Part of the point of clout is that you spend it. You spend your clout.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, all right.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I know you're not used to actually having the means by which to just simply get what you want by asking for it. But you could just... ask for it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That was the most privileged thing you've ever said.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's the most privileged thing I've ever said that you've heard. (laughter)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Touch<U+FFFD>.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Marisha has a high clout score.

name: SAM
dialogue: So you think just walk on in there. No subterfuge, no sneaky-sneaky, no breaking down doors?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, a little subterfuge. Let me--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I've got Polymorph. I can always be a tiny thing in your pocket.

name: SAM
dialogue: Who said that?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Sorry, I'm back here. I figured Percy and I were waiting back here.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, okay, hi.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Let me attempt to see if I can defuse this relatively easily. I will need some gold.

name: SAM
dialogue: Are you lying to me to get me to pay you for a new gun?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, but that's a very good point. So later I will be asking for some gold to help me fix my new gun.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right, I'll give you what you need.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: All right.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do you have gold, Scanlan?

name: SAM
dialogue: I do.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Okay, we may have to have a discussion. At the very least I'm going to need 20 gold, at the very least.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: 20 gold, at the very least.

name: SAM
dialogue: You don't have 20 gold?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, I do. Just not for your daughter.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, Jesus. (laughter) Take 50.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That will do.

name: MATT
dialogue: So you guys approach?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No trips to Coldstone with Percy. You are not the Godfather.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I will take you to White Castle, though.

name: MATT
dialogue: You come to the front steps of the stockade, there are two guards there, with tower shields and what looks like halberds to each of them. One of them steps forward, putting his shield out. Not in an aggressive way, but definitely in an attention-gathering way. "Do you have business here "in the stockade?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I do; I wish to speak to the warden.

name: MATT
dialogue: "The warden is indisposed in conversation at the moment."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, he will agree to be indisposed in conversation with me. I'm Percival Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III. And I'm here on the business of Whitestone.

name: SAM
dialogue: He's an ambassador.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a persuasion roll. I'll say with advantage due to the very, very, intense, believable stare of Scanlan backing you up.

name: MATT
dialogue: He gives a nod. "All right, but good luck." The two guards open the doors, and as they do you can already hear raised voices shouting back and forth. Can't really make out the words, but as you step into the inside you can see there is a clerk's desk. With a clerk sitting there, keeping one ear closed as he's trying to write in a book. To the immediate right of them, there is Dr. Dranzel in an argument with a gentleman with a well-kept mustache, thick over the top lip, slicked black hair that curls up in the back in a small poof. He's wearing a breastplate and is standing with an appearance of self-importance. At which point, as you approach, Dr. Dranzel turns and goes, "Oh good. Someone with actual--"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Shush! Who is this person?

name: MATT
dialogue: Everyone gets quiet and the individual standing there goes, "Well apparently, he's the "man who's bothering me. Hm?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: What do you do, sir?

name: SAM
dialogue: I just throw Dranzel a quick little wink.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: What do you do, sir?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm a performer." (slight chuckle)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Excellent, he's a performer. You may leave, we have no need of you.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (whispered) Oh, shit.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Hmph." He adjusts his hat and--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Guard, escort the commoner out of the room.

name: MATT
dialogue: The guards instinctively step up and take his arms and they lead him out. Dr. Dranzel, taken aback and the whole time he's looking at Scanlan with this look of like--

name: SAM
dialogue: You heard the ambassador; please leave. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: (boom) The doors close behind. The individual steps forward.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Now that that's been taken care of, who is an authority that I may speak to?

name: MATT
dialogue: "That, I'm afraid, would be me. (sly chuckle) Pleasure to meet you. I'm Warden Cyrus "Hume. What is your name?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Cyrus Hume. I'm Percival Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III of Whitestone.

name: MATT
dialogue: "This does me no service."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It will.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Hmph."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I am, of course, the newly appointed ambassador from Whitestone, and I have been brought down here because apparently you are holding one of my performers. A performer who is meant to be heading towards Whitestone in the next three weeks to perform for my sister.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Describe your performer, sir."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, small, plain, female. (dismissive sigh)

name: MATT
dialogue: (sighs heavily) "I know of the one you speak. The same one we're arguing-- I assume this other "individual that just left is one of your performers as well."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes, he is. He is one of the official performers-- they're supposed to be performing at the new coronation of a brand new temple in Whitestone. Much has been arranged, much has been paid for, and I don't want to explain any of this to the royal court.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a deception check.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Casting-- no, not yet. 13.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. He goes--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: If you were to be agreeable to helping us move this along, I would remember the favor. Whitestone would remember the favor.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Good. Well, listen. There are fines for damages, or she sits until tried. Now."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Damages?

name: MATT
dialogue: "The damages to the Nervous Brook pub are estimated to be upwards of 450 gold pieces, and "the fine for drunken battery and disturbing the peace amounts to 250 gold pieces. 700 total and I "would gladly let you take that rabid dug-grubber off of my hands."

name: SAM
dialogue: You'll watch what you say about her.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh, will I?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Shush, performer. Well, sir, I appreciate your candor, I appreciate the cut of your jib, and I appreciate that you are a man of honor and of your station. It is very, very rare to find someone who respects such things. Obviously the damages must be paid--

name: MATT
dialogue: "If you wish to discuss it with the three in question--" He points to one of the cells on the other side of the room and you can see that there is a set of bars, and you can vaguely see what looks like the shape of a person who's just slumped in the cell. Mostly cast in shadow.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Who are they?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Bar patrons. And they're all worse for wear."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Do we know what happened?

name: MATT
dialogue: "The dog has teeth. Three against one, if the stories say true. The bar patrons and the "owner of the establishment all verified that she indeed started and finished it."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't care who started or finished it. Obviously, we will pay for the damages out of your troupe's pocket.

name: SAM
dialogue: Your majesty, are you sure you don't want to write a check from the treasury?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Quite.

name: SAM
dialogue: I've got the checkbook with me. We could just write a check.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We will write a check for our friend's pocket, but for the damages, I feel that some responsibility must be taken.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm not familiar with this check you speak of. I deal in gold, as does Emon. What good does "this do me in my station if I am to show up with a simple piece of paper?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: He has a very fair point.

name: SAM
dialogue: (whispers) Your brand of subterfuge is not what I had in mind. (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: What good is subterfuge when there's such an opportunity to create a ballad? Some sort of ballad about a cautionary tale.

name: SAM
dialogue: I could have picked anyone to be with me here. Not this. You're rubbing my face in it because I threw your gun in the lava.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You chose so poorly. You chose so poorly. It is truly impressive how poorly you chose.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Stop wasting my time, if you're going to retrieve this invalid, do so quickly."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You may come pick up your gold from Castle Greyskull in the morning. It will be waiting for you, of course, sir. In the meantime, here is 20 gold for your trouble. On top of the gold you will be expecting for all fines imposed.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a persuasion check.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (high-pitched) One.

name: MATT
dialogue: He rolled a natural 20.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: All right, bring it. Bring it.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, I appreciate your attempt to maneuver around my station of which you hold so clear. "You seemingly attempt to bribe a warden of the stockade in an attempt to retrieve what appears to "be a relatively... How do I put it? Immoral, destitute and feral creature."

name: SAM
dialogue: Warden. This is just like this bastard. He always goes around trying to boss people around and throw his money around. And I turn and I punch Percy in the face.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay! Roll for an attack.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, shit. Going for another one. A nine. Probably not.

name: MATT
dialogue: Plus your strength modifier.

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't have any strength. One, so that's ten.

name: MATT
dialogue: Ten. Percy, do you take it?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes, I take it.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Whack! A solid hit across the face. You have to lean into it and make it look more impactful than it really is.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (overly dramatic) Oh!
