dialogue: At this point, as you guys are having this conversation, and you guys are darting out, Vex, you stop, as coming down the stairs from the main floor is Erwen. Frazzled, but still put together as well as he can.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I tuck it behind my back.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm sorry, Lady Vex'ahlia, it appears you have a few guests, suddenly."

name: LAURA
dialogue: What? What kind of guests?

name: MATT
dialogue: "She's been here before. I don't recognize the other; in the dining area."

name: LAURA
dialogue: What does she look like?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Blonde hair."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Allura.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Dwarven individual."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh my god, it's Allura and Kima.

name: LIAM
dialogue: This is a little like Clue: the Movie.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It kind of is. Yes-- Erwen. Bring them down here. It's an emergency

name: MATT
dialogue: "Very well, I'll--"

name: LAURA
dialogue: As quickly as possible.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes, yes." And he turns around and hustles up the stairs.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can we all please go back in Percy's workshop?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Not yet, darling.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Why not?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Keyleth, let's just wait until Allura gets here. I feel like she might have a calming effect on this situation, an outside eye.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We are standing in the damn hall, all I am asking is that we move into a quiet room.

name: MATT
dialogue: At this point now, at the top of the stairway, two individuals come walking down. First and foremost, you see a dwarven male with short black hair and a beard, trimmed fairly fine, red leathers, carrying some sort of crooked wand on the side. Behind him you see, hair tossed back as she rushes down after him, Arcanist Allura Vysoren.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I sheath my daggers.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. She looks about curiously and the dwarf goes, "Okay, what have we stepped into here?" And Allura puts her hand on his shoulder and goes, "Don't worry. I apologize for my "intrusion. I had a-- is everything all right?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: We could use your help at this moment.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Certainly. Sorry, this is a long-time friend of mine, Elementalist Drake Thunderbrand. "If you don't mind him accompanying us as well?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Is he good?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh, he's one of the finest."

name: LAURA
dialogue: A good person?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I've put my life in his hands a number of times, yes."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Things are a lot more complicated than you can even imagine. Please come in, we need you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes, yes." And as you guys are having this standoff, you watch as this black-haired, red-leathered dwarf walks in, looking around and inspecting intently. You don't recognize him, you've never seen him before

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What's he wielding?

name: MATT
dialogue: No weapons on him. You see him clutching this gnarled, curved wand that almost spirals, like a piece of well-treated but messed up wood.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: A stick.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's a weapon.

name: MATT
dialogue: Maybe. And Allura rushes in, muttering under her breath, "I was just in Whitestone and I had a "terrible feeling come over me and all my teleportation sigils within the city were suddenly "severed. Both my tower and the Lyceum. I had to manually teleport us here as it was the only place "I really had enough familiarity with far enough away from the city in case something bad had "happened, I hope you don't mind."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Not at all. We're grateful for your help.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Could you do us a favor? We had a small accident with Percival.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Not yet, not yet.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Does she know about the-- D--?

name: LIAM
dialogue: No. So... Emon is in ruins. It's been destroyed by dragons.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Four. Ancient. Dragons.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: They call themselves the Chroma Conclave.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And your tower is--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Fucked!

name: LAURA
dialogue: We're sorry.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'll go ahead and drop the Hold Person on Percy.

name: MATT
dialogue: And her face goes white, the blood runs from her entire complexion, and you can see the dwarf that initially was huffed up and intense in his energy, while not fully understanding what's going on, looks over to Allura and softens and walks up and puts his hand on her shoulder. "You okay, lass?"

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm sorry, my lady. Did you know that Uriel planned to step down?

name: MATT
dialogue: "He threatened it--"

name: LIAM
dialogue: He did it.

name: MATT
dialogue: "-- for weeks-- what?"

name: LIAM
dialogue: He did it, and moments later four old dragons descended upon the city.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: The Cloudtop District has been demolished.

name: MATT
dialogue: "This cannot be."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We don't know who all is alive or dead. We can only expect the worst.

name: MATT
dialogue: "This cannot be."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Unfortunately, Allura, all of that is the reason for our current impasse. We seem to have discovered something that could potentially reverse the situation. But there's a great price to pay. It could be a small price to pay, we don't know. If you wouldn't mind taking a look at this relic that we discovered.

name: MATT
dialogue: And you see, she is still lost in thought and there's something in her mind that's distracting her immensely, but she eventually clarifies and her eyes focus on you once more and she goes, "Of course, please."

name: LAURA
dialogue: I don't give it to her, but I pull the tapestry off of the skull and show it to her.

name: MATT
dialogue: She looks at it and leans forward and begins muttering something beneath her breath, and she goes into technical mode, like she distracts herself with work at this moment. And as her brow furrows, she mutters under her breath and completes some sort of flash of arcane energy, and you can see the flash of energy attaches around the skull for a second and glints back at her, and she goes, "Right, all right, that's-- That skull is not human, that skull is Githyanki. That is a "species that exists primarily on the Astral Plane. They're rowdy, evil, pirating, marauding "individuals, and that's one sense. The gem within that skull appears to be a soul gem and contains "the soul of, from what I can gather, a Githyanki individual. Very old. I can say at least from my "knowledge and learned opinion that no good can come from such an artifact."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay. He can grant a wish, he says? Lying, truth? What do you think?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's hard to say. It would take a very powerful individual to do so, however, I would say "that wishes granted by entities that do not correspond with your moral outlook for the most "part rarely end up in your favor, even when carefully worded."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Right. No, but I remember this, we dealt with this with the demon that killed Pike.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes, but we used our wish to wish ourselves out of that contract.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And it had to be so carefully worded.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We can destroy more, if we're not careful.

name: MATT
dialogue: "There have been powerful individuals, who upon obtaining the ability to make such a wish, "even as careful as they were, they reached beyond the means of its magic, and doing so, undid "themselves. It's a very, very powerful, very dangerous magic, and if this entity is indeed "even capable of doing so, who's to say the chances that it wouldn't wreak more havoc than you "intended?"

name: LIAM
dialogue: We are in a precarious position. The city is in ruins, already, in a matter of hours.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes, yes."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What do we do?

name: MATT
dialogue: And at this point, she looks around for a chair. You can see her hands are shaking, and she goes and grabs a chair and pulls it up and sits down for a second, puts her hands on her knees, and quietly, "Describe to me these dragons."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: There was one of each color.

name: LAURA
dialogue: A green, a black, a white.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: And a big red piece of shit.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: All colors except for blue of the chromatic spectrum. I got a few of their names.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you go through each color, she nods, but when you say the big red, her body freezes.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Does this sound familiar to you?

name: MATT
dialogue: "The names, you said?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: There's a white dragon that called himself Vorugal. A green dragon, Raishan. Black dragon, Umbrasyl, and the red dragon, we haven't heard his name yet. He seems to be the leader.

name: MATT
dialogue: At this point she nods and goes, "I know not the middle two, but Vorugal has been known to "wander the wastes north in Othanzia. Some of the offspring have wandered further, in fact I believe "the Skysunder that you destroyed naught but two years ago that was sealed in the Frostweald was one "of its brethren. Its children. But Vorugal has not been seen wandering this far out. Chromatics do "not work together, they are selfish and greedy and territorial."

name: LAURA
dialogue: They're definitely working together.

name: MATT
dialogue: "This red you say is the leader?"

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes, most definitely.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He had a message that he belted over the entire city. He said that we who live, he's showing mercy and that we can either fight or flee, and then--

name: LAURA
dialogue: He said if we fight or flee, we'll be denied the mercy.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay, something along those lines. And then he said that it was the guardians of this city that brought this upon Emon, and that he has control. He called it like a new order.

name: LAURA
dialogue: He said our new purpose is to serve him.

name: MATT
dialogue: Now for the first time, you have known Allura for quite some time, she's been a very stoic, strong, confident, and powerful person. At this moment, she has withered. She looks genuinely like she's hit a level of fear you have never seen in an individual like this, and it shakes you to see this upon her face, and she puts her hand up and says, "This is not your fault. This burden is mine." And looks over to the dwarf and says, "It is ours." And the dwarf, you can now see, he's nodding in understanding. "This dragon... it's been called many names, but the one that it's "taken is Thordak, The Cinder King."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Thordak?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Thordak. This terrible beast lorded over half of Marquet for centuries, taking the scalding "sands as its domain and its denizens as cattle, and just as the city of Ank'harel was becoming the "jewel of the desert, Thordak struck. A battle, however, that it was unable to win. Sent away, "mortally wounded, it was thought that the dragon had died soon after, having not been seen for many "centuries since. That is, until about 15 years ago. The rumors of a powerful drake, storming the "beaches and seas, had been whispered for a long time, while ships would be lost at sea. It had "survived and secretly ruled the island of Viscan in the south of the Lucidian Ocean. I suppose "after generations, the dragon, now self-crowned as the Cinder King, grew greedier with the island's "limited resources and began razing the Mournset countryside south of the Verdant Expanse and the "Stormcrest Mountains." And her eyes get even more distant as she is recalling all this. "Reports of "a dragon more massive than the records can compare hit Tal'Dorei. At the time, I wasn't part of the "council. I traveled with a group of adventurers much like yourselves: Kima, Drake here, and a "handful of other brave souls who are no longer with us. We traveled to investigate, but arrived "to find this creature destroying everything surrounding the Glade Pools. Port Udall, gone, "Byroden a smoldering ruin, and we gathered a small army of mercenaries and hunted it back to its new "den in the Stormcrest, where a large number of lizardfolk had formed around him. But we were "overpowered by the sheer might of the dragon. Many lives were lost. Knowing that we could not kill "it, we turned to other means. I called upon the Arcana Pansophical, a circle of friends, arcane "practitioners that agreed to work together across the land to keep them safe. They devised a trap, "one that could, we believed, permanently seal Thordak within the elemental plane of fire, "preventing him from ever returning to our world. At the sacrifice of many, including our "companions Sirus, Dohla, Ghenn, we succeeded." And as the tears begin to roll down her face, she looks around. "For naught now, it seems, and somehow he has broken our invocation. We bound his "essence to the fountains of creation and thought he would stay there forever." And she goes quiet and looks around for a second. "I'm sorry."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: This couldn't be because of our journey to the elemental plane, could it?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm so sorry."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We saw him there.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We did, but it sounds like he has been....

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We didn't set him free, you don't think?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, it was Keyleth's Ashari thing.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: My people-- Our job is to guard these realms.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Is there any way of contacting the Fire Ashari?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, yeah, oh god. Oh god, what if they're-- what if they're dead?

name: MATT
dialogue: "To bind him, we created an artifact called a soul anchor. It was crafted from the salvaged "heart crystal of a primordial fire titan. The anchor could not be removed from the plane, and "the Cinder King could not leave without it. I don't know how he's managed to escaped the binding "of this."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh my god, this is all my fault.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No. No. This was a land mine waiting to be stepped on.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But wait. We fought-- We fought my elders, we fought the Headmaster.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It couldn't have been.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That would have no bearing on this. The heart crystal is immense. 15, 20 feet in diameter, "it's a gem of pure crystallized ruby and elemental power and energy. Lest you managed to find this "and destroy it, which, I mean no offence, is far beyond your capability."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: My people, would they be okay?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Depends on where he made his way through. The timing is rather conspicuous, seeing as how "Winter's Crest recently passed, in which time the planes are the thinnest barricades."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Whatever it is, I fear that our ruse will not work twice, especially if Thordak has had all "this time to obsess over his failure. I do not know our next course of action."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What do you know of General Krieg?

name: MATT
dialogue: "He's been gone for some time."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You were on the council with him, do you know anything further?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I think it was discussed that he had been killed during the demonic intrusion in the city, "or deserted."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Would a dragon seek vengeance against one of their brethren killed?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Chromatics are selfish beings, they do not care for each other, and the power of one is "enough, but a conclave of dragons is both extraordinary and horrifying, but there is no-- "There is no sense of vengeance for their kin unless it is against the greater plan. Now, if "what you say is true and these other dragons are bound together in the service of Thordak, I "imagine they would be the ones who had the power and the resources to find some way to bring him through."

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right.

name: MATT
dialogue: At which point, the dwarf steps up and still has his hand rubbing Allura's shoulder and says, "We knew not what we were doing, other than trying to save it, don't blame yourself."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Allura.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Would you consider us guardians of this city?

name: MATT
dialogue: "One of many. I believe the guardians--"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Is this because of us?

name: MATT
dialogue: Allura looks at you dead-on and says, "The only guardians that Thordak would know of would be "the ones that sent him away to that plane 15 years ago. This is my fault."

name: LIAM
dialogue: That's not true. If we are to solve this situation we cannot hide the truth. I killed Krieg. We killed Krieg. I finished Krieg.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Krieg was a dragon, Allura.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: A blue dragon.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We stumbled upon his lair, reached through his home in Emon, through magical means. We found his lair.

name: LAURA
dialogue: He attacked us.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And we-- I--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I reach out and I grab Vax's hand.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We survived.

name: LIAM
dialogue: When it happened, he had four stones, four orbs in his lair. They saw us.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: They spoke out to us.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They threatened us.

name: MATT
dialogue: "When was this? Was this--"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Many years ago.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Maybe two years ago.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Not all that long ago.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It was right after we got to Emon.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's been over a year at least. Well, if it's taken them that long at least to free Thordak, it "means that this was probably in the works for quite some time. If we do share this responsibility, I "assure you it weighs heavier on me than it does you. But right now we need all the allies we can "gather. Now, you say Thordak is where right now?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Sitting on Emon.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Within the city?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Vex, you would know.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, I can sense them. Right.

name: MATT
dialogue: It's for a six-mile radius, was it?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: On the edge of your senses, you close your eyes and focus and extend your ability to feel the landscape around you. Indeed, The Cinder King still sits in the center of the city.

name: LAURA
dialogue: He's here.

name: MATT
dialogue: "What of the others?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Do I sense any others?

name: MATT
dialogue: Nope.

name: LAURA
dialogue: They're gone for the time being.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It's weird, they do what he says.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Barely.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And on top of all that, we have this fucking skull.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I need to check in with my people. I need to check in with the Air Ashari.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Where's the rest? Where's the council? Who do we know survived?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: We don't know anything. Everyone was dying around us, we made it to the keep.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It happened very quickly.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We don't know what happened to Uriel, we didn't see.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We need to take stock of who we can consider friends that are still around. We need "all allies right now. That should be our first order of business, if anything." And her face drops again. "I just lost my connection with Westruun."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh fuck. The whole world.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, this is an annihilation.

name: MATT
dialogue: "This isn't an annihilation, if this was an extermination there wouldn't be any survivors, you "wouldn't be here. The fact that they've only taken what they can of the city-- what use is a city "to a dragon if it doesn't have worshippers? They're vain beings."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Think, Allura, what do all these cities have in common? And what would be the benefits of taking over these cities?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Resources, their gold, their people."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do you think they just want domination over people? Over us? They called us ants!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes."

name: LAURA
dialogue: They want to be gods.

name: MATT
dialogue: "What good is a creature that sees itself as superior if there aren't those around it to tell "them as such and confirm the belief, and if anyone refuses to bend to their will through fear and "power. That is the nature of the chromatic dragons."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: There has to be something more that they want.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Perhaps, but for now, the fact that he's even shouted mercy at this time as opposed to "completely destroying everything in his wake, means that vanity can be used to our advantage. I "don't know how soon, but that's something. Now--"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Allies. Vasselheim has warriors, armories.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Whitestone as well.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We can bring them here.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I need to reach out to the Ashari and see if they're-- I leave, I want to go-- Well, actually; Allura, will you help me in a scrying spell?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes, yes, the best I can, yes."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I want to scry and first check in on the Fire Ashari.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. All right, at this point she pulls out her crystal ball from a little tiny satchel, which is in itself a smaller Bag of Holding. Pulls out a small mirror, takes some water and pours it on the mirror, places the sphere above it, and it floats for a second. And there's a makeshift scrying ritual site here before you. You guys take about ten minutes to concentrate, and if you guys want to do anything in that ten-minute period, you're welcome to, or if you just want to watch and wait, you can.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm going to just sit, it's been a long, long day.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. The spell completes.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Can I roll hit dice?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, you guys can begin to take a short rest, if you want to heal up.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I go over to my sister in that time. I want-- I want to kill that dragon. Or I want to die trying.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We will.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do I see Cerkonos?

name: MATT
dialogue: So you take Allura's hand and you put your focus into the crystal sphere, your vision lifts out of the keep with extreme speed. You find your visual surroundings thrust across the Ozmit Sea. You find yourself swooping across the shores of Othanzia, over the forests, eventually coming upon the blackened clouds that perpetually hang above the charred mountain range that contains the home of the Fire Ashari and the entrance to the elemental plane of fire. Your vision crests the mountain and steps into the valley of broken, blackened shale to the ever-burning forest. As you come upon it, you recall where the Fire Ashari village was and where you were greeted before and given your trials. Where there is now nothing but sundered, broken wood, tents, destroyed bodies burned and charred and curled up in horrible ever-gasping pain. The forest itself is flattened from the inside out, like a blast from the center of it just exploded outward, the trees all bent and snapped at the base, and in the center, where there once was that small pool of molten lava that you created the portal through and stepped into the elemental plane, there is a large, ominous, flickering gash between the planes that is roughly 30 to 40 feet in width and height that is pulsing as fire and magma pours out of it. You can see wandering imps and elementals and various entities slowly peeking out and escaping and wandering throughout the mountain tops. From what you can see, there are no signs of any survivors.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It destroyed everything. They killed everyone.

name: MATT
dialogue: Allura at this point, who pulls out of the ritual, reaches out and grabs you by the shoulders.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We failed.

name: MATT
dialogue: And she looks you in the eyes, and for a moment you feel like her normally warm and embracing face has gone cold and intense and her voice seems to echo with an undercurrent of arcane focus and volume. She goes--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: My people failed, we failed our cause.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Keyleth, you failed no one, this is not your doing. This burden is ours as a people to "hold, do not let this wash over you or he wins. This is their making, this is not yours. These "creatures are evil incarnate, and it is our job, our true calling to end what they have done. Do "not let this crush you, you are stronger than that. Pull yourself together. Your people, those "that remain, they stand behind you."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm not as strong as you, Allura.

name: MATT
dialogue: "But you can be and you will be. Do you trust me? Do you trust me?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Good." Her grasp releases.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's my people.

name: MATT
dialogue: "And mine, and all of ours. There are many secrets in these lands. I'm a firm believer that "there's always a way to victory, if we are smart about it and if we're quick about it. Now, I think "we should look for survivors. Gather those we know that can rally to our cause, in Emon and beyond. "What say you?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Aye.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Aye.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We are to stand now or we might as well be dead.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So we're definitely not going to wish on this skull then, yeah?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I would recommend against it."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, I stand.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Very well, let us prepare for the fall of the Chroma Conclave. Together." And that's where we'll end our session for tonight.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Fucking A!

name: MATT
dialogue: Hey guys, D&D's fun! (laughter)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: D&D will never be fun again; everything's ruined.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Hey, we're all cows! (laughter)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Back when things were so much simpler.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Be sure to buy a t-shirt over on geekandsundry.com.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Wow.

name: LIAM
dialogue: In Sam's honor.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What in the hell.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Brought to you by Wyrmwood Gaming. Specifically designed to absorb tears. (laughter)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Ah yes, thank you. It's so porous.

name: MATT
dialogue: So yeah.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Can we play longer?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Can we play longer?

name: MATT
dialogue: Aww.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What time is it? It's ten o'clock, and we ended on time and--

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's the first time we've ever ended on time.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Wow, that game felt like 20 hours.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah. Originally this was supposed to be a three-hour show, but it never quite made it that way.

name: MATT
dialogue: I know we tried, we try and mostly fail, but occasionally we get it right. So, I mean, I'd say I'm sorry for the emotional rollercoaster, but no.

name: TRAVIS

name: TALIESIN

dialogue: Well. Welcome to the new story arc.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh jeez. (cheering) Everything changed.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. Oh man.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Everything.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: When do I level up?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm going to find a corner to rock back and forth in.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We would have been working in a lich's sugar mine if you'd done that.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Nah, we all would have been kings and queens, we would be drinking iced mochas.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I was more afraid of us wishing ourselves out of existence. I wish there were no more dragons... and no more people and no more--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It was such a bad deal, I said no. Like, can you imagine how bad of a deal that must have been?

name: LIAM
dialogue: That's a good point.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I was really looking for a reason to say yes.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And it turns out that it was just a fucking lame-ass pirate. Fuck that, we don't want to be indebted to some shithead pirate.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Nothing good happens when you let Mxyzptlk out of the goddamn skull.

name: MATT
dialogue: It was fun. I set a time for myself when she's gonna arrive, and I was like, "Oh man, "what's going to happen before she gets there?" I was like, as you guys kept delaying it, they might actually-- she might actually catch them in time.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: She would have walked in and we're beating the shit out of each other.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It all would have gone to hell if--

name: MATT
dialogue: You don't know what would happen. You don't know.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I would have saved the world, that's what would have happened. Fucking one.

name: MATT
dialogue: None of you have heard of a githyanki in your travels.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I would have been King Grog, I would have gotten a cave, I would had a bunch of harem people taking care of me, giving me sponge baths with their tongues.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I was going to carve my name in your nuts.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I would object to that.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I was going to gender swap, I wanted-- Percy was going to become Percina. (laughter)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I wish I was a woman. We still have the dragon problem, but now have the dragon and a pirate.

name: MATT
dialogue: There you go-- the de Rolo sisters-- Glad you could make it, Ashley. (cheering) You should make it every week.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Does this mean I'm the last druid to make the Aramente?

name: MATT
dialogue: You don't know.

dialogue: There might have been one after you.

name: LAURA
dialogue: There's got to be other ones.

dialogue: From what you saw, the Fire Ashari were decimated, you saw a number of bodies, you don't know if any escaped, you don't if any were hidden, you don't know what happened. At that location, it is desolation, and you get the sense from that, that is precisely the place where Thordak came through the plane.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm wondering about the other locations, though, too.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I want to know about Whitestone. We have a lot a phone calls to make.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We have a lot of phone calls. Like I--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: They're all dead, everybody's dead.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Theoretically wiped my people off the face of the planet.

name: MATT
dialogue: Such an optimist.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: If they all busted through--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Does decimate mean that 1/10 survived? Or that only 10% died? I can never remember which one decimated is. I know it's one of the two.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, that term has been largely misused in the current-day vernacular.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I know. 10% died, that's what it is.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I love misusing vernacular.

name: MATT
dialogue: It's fun. You guys--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Great fucking story Matt, holy shit. Holy shit, you had trees and stuff.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Why do you got to be a dick, man?

dialogue: As we're discovering the white battlemats don't pick up as well on the camera as the colors, I'm trying to use other options whenever possible.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It works. The green was amazing.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It was really cool with green.

name: MATT
dialogue: So I'm going to try and push more on that. A little more work on my end, but it'll be fine.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Tell me more, sadist.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Thanks for joining us, you guys.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys, thank you for watching, and hope you have a wonderful night, and we'll see you guys next Thursday. Good night!

dialogue: I need a cigarette, and I don't smoke.

name: MATT
dialogue: Hello, and good evening, everyone! Welcome to Critical Role, where a bunch of us nerdy-ass voice actors play Dungeons & Dragons! Or yell curse words at me as we intro. So yes! Welcome to the show tonight! Sam Riegel is on his way, our Scanlan will be here shortly. Such is the nature of these things. But, anyway, welcome to our show, friends new and old. Tonight, we're continuing a rather intense beginning of the next arc of Critical Role, as Laura prepares her dice via bulk-rolling. I like the juju aspect of it. It's nice. It gets the energy going. Just burn all those twenties out first.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, I've already rolled two.

name: MATT
dialogue: See? There you go.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Those are two you cannot use.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I know!

name: MATT
dialogue: So, yeah! So, tonight we have a special guest that will be coming into the show a little later on, as part of the story arc, and after tonight, we will be having Critmas for this month. It won't be all of us, some folks have a really early morning tomorrow and unfortunately have to run off due to needing to exist tomorrow professionally, but we will be doing that this evening. Let's see, as far as announcements go--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We're winging it today. Sorry.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. It's all good. So, I guess first and foremost, reminder for those of us who are interested in going to Portland for Wizard World Portland in a few weeks, we'll be there for that. I know, except for Liam.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: February 19th to the 21st. Come say hi! Yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's so hard to get all of us in one place at the same time.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: If you're even in a neighboring state, come see us, because we might not make it all that way again.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And bring your dice, and we'll all roll together!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, we'll bless them. Or he will.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'll bless them, Laura will curse them, it'll be great!

name: MATT
dialogue: Also, me and Marisha will be at Colorado Anime Fest, the weekend before that-- actually next weekend.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Valentine's-- next weekend!

name: MATT
dialogue: Next weekend! We'll be in Denver for that convention.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Come spend Valentine's Day with us.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And I will be at Amazing Arizona Comic Con that weekend. The Amazing Arizona Comic Con, Saturday and Sunday.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Sam's here-- can someone let Sam in?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We have a gnome!

name: MATT
dialogue: Let Sam in!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (yelling) I got him!

name: MATT
dialogue: Travis has this. I like this very much. Let's see, other announcements. Oh, the next episode of the GM/DM Tips goes up tomorrow on the Geek & Sundry website. Check that out. Not sure what topic it is. I don't know what order they're putting them out on, so it'll be a surprise for both of us! But hopefully you guys will find it helpful. I hope the previous ones have as well. If these turn out well, and people like them, and go click on them and share them around, they'll be more apt to do more, in which case I can do more in-depth, advanced videos. So, let's hope that works out well.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Even if you're not a DM, you should go look at them. So you can keep making more!

name: MATT
dialogue: Exactly. Yes!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Be a kind clicker. (Last of Us clicker noises)

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, that's a whole different clicker. And then, first weekend of March, me and Marisha will be in Cork, in Ireland, for Kaizoku Con. So, that'll be a lot of fun, you guys can come out there. And yes, I know that Ireland is not in the UK, that was meant to be a joke, but the internet did not take it as such, and felt the need to correct me for a week. And you know what, I deserve that--

name: LIAM
dialogue: There are no jokes here!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's crazy, the internet has the best sense of humor about everything!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: The internet always understands sarcasm!

name: MATT
dialogue: But as a person of some Irish lineage, I may have accidentally also offended my ancestors, so I apologize to everyone!

name: ALL
dialogue: Hey!

name: MATT
dialogue: We have a gnome!

dialogue: Hey scarf man!

dialogue: I got to go get ice!

dialogue: Go get ice? He'll be back!

dialogue: Is he cosplaying as Matthew Mercer? What's going on?

dialogue: Thanks to the Critter who sent us bacon jerky.

dialogue: Travis will be smelling like bacon jerky for the rest of his life.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Prepare yourself! That smells extra like dog farts!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh! It really does!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Just have a piece! One little piece!

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm sure it's delicious!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'll give you the ear.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Thank you!

name: MATT
dialogue: Aww, that's-- whoever sent those, thank you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That was amazing!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's very aerodynamic jerky.

name: MATT
dialogue: Let's see, other announcements. Liam, do you want to mention that one thing?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, we'll do our weekly shout-out to Wyrmwood gaming. I dunno, look at the rules, I don't want to mess it up. But your dork dollars will go farther if you go over there this week. Happy Valentine's Day!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Dork dollars, that's like bitcoin, right?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, kind of! Let's see, other things-- for those who didn't see it, Lootcrate put up a cool video about their most recent package that's going out this month, themed "Dead," in which they shot a ten-minute short film in the zombie apocalypse, starring me!

name: LAURA
dialogue: I saw!

name: MATT
dialogue: Did you see it? It was fun. I got really dirty. And Marisha has a cameo in it as my deceased girlfriend. Sorry.

name: LIAM
dialogue: So sad.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You didn't save her?

name: MATT
dialogue: Look! You think I can save anyone in the apocalypse?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I would hope so.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Honestly, it's impressive that you were the one that lived.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Would you straight-up run, or would you throw people in front of you so that they would be trampled?

name: MATT
dialogue: Neither! I'd try and work things out, and then get sniped in the head. We've had this conversation.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, are you kidding me? He'd be the first one that would be like, "Oh, rivalling--"

name: LAURA
dialogue: "Let's save everyone!"

name: SAM
dialogue: Phone's ringing, sorry.

name: MATT
dialogue: Oh. You need to get that.

name: SAM
dialogue: You know what, I'll send it to voicemail.

name: MATT
dialogue: Oh, thank you, Sam! So conscientious. (laughs) All righty, anything else anyone needs to mention? Or announce?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Bacon jerky's fucking good!

name: LAURA
dialogue: It actually is really good. Yeah, once you've tasted it, you don't smell the stank.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's like garlic. As long as everybody's had the garlic, everything's cool.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You wanna try it?

dialogue: No, I can smell it on you now!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Right? It's disgusting!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You want some? You want to join the fold?

name: LIAM
dialogue: No!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It is adding to, like, the tavern-ish feel of this place.

dialogue: All righty! Announcements are over-- let's go ahead and get into the game proper.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh no!

name: MATT
dialogue: So, to get us up to speed. Vox Machina, the intrepid band of adventurers, who have been enjoying being honorary members of the council of Tal'Dorei, returning from a harsh adventure in Whitestone, having the Winter's Crest festival, and then going in and re-inspecting the death place of a blue dragon they once fought over a year ago, returned just in time for a series of chromatic dragons, white, black, red, and green, all attacking Emon at once. This union of extremely powerful dragons tore through the city, with the red staying behind, named Thordak, the Cinder King, basically housing himself in Emon and claiming himself essentially ruler of that area. The party fled to their keep, attempted to help a bunch of refugees inside and then were immediately attacked by Vorugal, the white dragon. A heavy battle commenced that was ill in favor of your victory until Thordak himself knocked Vorugal out of the sky, claiming that there were better things to be done. So three of the four of this Chroma Conclave have now gone east, while Thordak sits in the middle of his new nesting place. You guys decided to try and help those who were in the keep at the time, those who survived that encounter on the outside of Greyskull. However, Percy and Grog had a conversation about this magical skull artifact they had acquired: this whispering in exchange for a wish if it got freed. This led to a rather intense bit of conflict--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Negotiation?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yes. (laughs) Which, thanks to the luck of the die, seemed to avoid a unique circumstance, whatever that might have been.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Bullshit.

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughs) However, the party in this tense scenario were then visited by a dwarven elementalist named Drake, along with your old-time friend and guide Allura Vysoren, who had sensed the connection to her teleportation circles here in Emon severed immediately. There was discussion about how this came about, who's to blame, and it appears that this dragon has a history, 15 years before, of having conflict with Allura and her then-party of adventurers, many of whom lost their life in the final battle. When they realized they were unable to actually defeat Thordak, hatched a plan to seal him within the elemental plane of fire, and had managed to keep him there for 15 years until recently. We left off with Allura suddenly sensing her connection to the Westruun sigil severed as well.

name: LAURA
dialogue: God, I forgot about that!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Nothing like genocide to put you in the mood!

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah! That is where we'll pick up. So, at this point, after Allura senses this, her eyes go wide for a moment and she-- you, being there in front of her still, Keyleth, after your guys' scrying ritual, grabs your shoulder, and looks around the room. "Who is left? Where is the "council? Which allies can we draw to us, in hopes of planning our next move?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We don't know.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We are scattered.

name: LAURA
dialogue: For all we know, the council is lost.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We could be all that's left.

name: MATT
dialogue: (sighs) "Well, we have to try and gather what information we can about who remains. If "anyone out there survives, any of our allies, we need to make sure that they're brought away from "the center of this chaos. And hopefully we can reconvene and figure out a path of hoping to free "our city, our entire land, of this scourge."

name: LAURA
dialogue: How do we even make contact with them? Thordak is in the center of town.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Perhaps skirting the center and hoping others have found their way towards the outskirts "of it. I don't know. This is as far as I've gotten to the city, is your guys' keep. You have the "better position on this. Where would anyone in the town go? Are there places to hide, are there--"

name: LIAM
dialogue: I think that they would leave the center of the city, at least to the edges, if not try to get out, though that might be foolish.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Check the harbor, maybe?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We know that Riskel made secret passageways in different places.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Security tunnels!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah. Did we ever find out if he put one in ours? Did we have one? That leads into the town?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We don't know.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, didn't we have a tunnel made that goes under the wall?

name: MATT
dialogue: You did, actually.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But does it lead out into the city?

name: MATT
dialogue: You haven't actually utilized it yet.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We've never used it, but they described it to us when they brought us here the first day.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Maybe we can sneak in!

name: SAM
dialogue: To the city.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, yeah!

name: LIAM
dialogue: We need to see if Uriel is still alive.

name: SAM
dialogue: By the way, hi guys.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Hi, how's it going?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Wait, who was with Gilmore?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Gilmore disappeared. I didn't see where he went.

name: LIAM
dialogue: He was alone before it all happened.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, that's another place to check.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What, where? Gilmore's?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm thinking of where I would go if I didn't know what to do--

name: LIAM
dialogue: That's smart.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What places are left that have a teleportation circle?

name: SAM
dialogue: What about the thieves' guild tunnels? Would anyone go there?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It depends on who knows! It's a way out of the city once again.

name: LAURA
dialogue: The smuggler's coves, all of them.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's not a bad idea, either.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That was all through the--

name: SAM
dialogue: That bar.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Through the bar, in the--

name: SAM
dialogue: Place. With the thing.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That one!

name: MATT
dialogue: "The connections I had to this town were within my tower, your keep, and the Lyceum, the "Alabaster Lyceum. The Lyceum has also been severed, and though I know not of what may remain "there, that is also a place of great power, hence why it was probably a very operative target for "their attack."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Allura.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: How far does your arcane connection reach? Can you feel when you lose connection to other cities?

name: MATT
dialogue: "If I have a connection to the sigil, yes. I don't have much beyond the boundaries of "Tal'Dorei. Vasselheim does not allow sigils for transportation, it's against their philosophy "against embedded arcane intrusion. If Westruun is under attack as well, I will make my way there in "hopes of salvaging any lives that I can."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You're leaving?

name: LAURA
dialogue: If Westruun is under attack, now, and we know Thordak is here, does that mean--?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: His forces are divided.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: This is a takeover. For some reason Thordak doesn't want to leave this city. Why?

name: SAM
dialogue: This is the seat of power, right?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We could potentially attack one of his subordinates, though. One of the other dragons in Westruun, by themselves!

name: SAM
dialogue: But then he could just come and kill us!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, then we teleport right back out.

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Bad idea? Bad idea?

name: SAM
dialogue: How fast is he?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, they just made it to Westruun, several hundred miles away, in all of 40 minutes?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There's a lot of assumptions here.

name: MATT
dialogue: "They move rather fast, and to be honest, I hate to inform you, but my single teleportation "ability has been utilized for the day in getting here."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm tapped out, too.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Me too.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Lady Allura, what do you know of Marquet?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Marquet."

name: LIAM
dialogue: You said that they successfully repulsed him.

name: MATT
dialogue: "400 years ago, yes, when he was younger. He was a much smaller dragon then."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Oh.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: 400 years ago?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, he is ancient, Grog! He is ancient!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, slightly.

name: MATT
dialogue: "The only thing I can think of: there are two bastions of knowledge that hold inklings as to "what could be the undoing of dragonkind, of powerful entities. There were battles of many such "powerful entities, long, long ago, back before the Penance, before the historical wiping of "civilization. Some of these books remain in Vasselheim, being the only city to have survived "those times. A few have found their way in the Cobalt Reserve, the library of Westruun. If I "could go and hope that this library still stands, stay out of sight, help who I can along the way, "and gather what bits of research I can and bring them back here, perhaps we could reconvene as long "as you go and find who you can of our allies that survive within Emon."

name: LAURA
dialogue: We can do that!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Within Emon.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes.

name: SAM
dialogue: Going to let you go on your own?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, she has Drake with her.

name: MATT
dialogue: Which Drake next to her says, "Damn right, she does! And I don't mean any offence, but the "two of us is about the same as you lot!"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Say what?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Trust me," and he gives you this dwarven grin as both of his eyes spark for a second with electricity.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (quietly) Well, fuck.

name: MATT
dialogue: She pushes him aside and goes, "It's all right, Drake. For our mission, it's going to "require more-- success is guided on being subtle. Some of you excel at that, maybe not all. And "speed. I believe we can handle this. You're better suited in combing large bits of territory and "seeking the allies that may survive."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Will you be leaving in the morning, then? Can you go tonight?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I should leave now."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You're going to go on foot?

name: MATT
dialogue: "We have other means of transportation."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Allura, if you're going to Westruun, and what you say is true, that we have two potential options for finding out how to defeat these dragons, should we be heading to Vasselheim? Maybe that's best where we're needed right now.

name: MATT
dialogue: "If Vasselheim still stands, I-- knowing its history, that is one of the most fortified cities, "the most fortified city in our civilization. It's endured two great wars, and has been the starting "point of each cycle. I doubt even with the might that these dragons hold, they would have the gall, "the foolish intent, to attack such a place. Especially the center of an entity such as "Bahamut, who stands against such creatures. I think Vasselheim is going to definitely claim a "key role in this attempt to save ourselves."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Bahamut is a good guy?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, for the most-- yeah, yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Cool.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's the city that was closest to Pyrah.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: My people, my tribe. We could pull double duty, we could go and I can--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Heh. Doody.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Grog! Now is not the time!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: What of Whitestone? Was there any mention, any--?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I have no connection to Whitestone. I did not have time arriving there to install a sigil."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Did you learn anything of the anomaly beneath the castle that might be useful?

name: MATT
dialogue: She shakes herself in her current mindset and goes, "Well, me and Drake here, we spent the "better part of two days studying the structure underneath the city. It itself appears to be at "least 600 years old, predating Whitestone's construction. Unfortunately, both of our magics "are thwarted in the proximity of this structure and any rituals that we attempted, or would have "been able to attempt, to discern its nature, in the classic means, would not be functional due to "its anti-magical properties. However, we've taken a few things of note, and we're taking our "observations to reach for two research facilities around the world, one of which I intended to be "the Cobalt Reserve before this happened."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Interesting, thank you.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So there was no-- you didn't move it, you didn't do anything with it, it's still just sitting there.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's a hazard zone right now?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Essentially. We have locked it off and it's under intense guard. We spent a little bit of "time experimenting with its properties, and any object of firm matter that was introduced to this "object was then torn from our grasp, sundered into many pieces, and then vanished."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Maybe we can get Thordak near the little orb!

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, yeah! Yeah!

name: LAURA
dialogue: I like it.

dialogue: "Hmm."

name: LIAM
dialogue: And we want to know what's left behind.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, we're seeing to our own. We're going to see how many of our allies still lie within the "city. Going to reach out to our friends across Tal'Dorei and see how much of a network we still "stand to keep. Then we call in a few debts, reach out to some friends and, ah, we see if we can find "some way to supplant this red thing."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Can I insight check?

name: MATT
dialogue: Go for it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Not good. No. Nine.

name: SAM
dialogue: Nine, you said?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Nine. The plan now is to lay low and hide?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, for now, I have a number of operatives topside who are currently trying to get "as much information on the red one as possible. The piles of wealth are growing, and it looks like "the beast is building a damn home out of the district."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The city's going to need a black market.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh, I am aware, and we are preparing for that. However, it's still fairly fresh, and "individuals aren't willing to release any coin when all of it goes to the pouches of the thing "that sits on us. Word has gotten back that Westruun was also hit rather hard in the night. "And these creatures have continued eastward ever since-- no further word on their whereabouts. So "we're put in a reactionary position, which I loathe. We're used to being ahead of the rest of "the curve."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, here's where we could help each other.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It would appear that could be a possibility."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We need this city to stay alive. We need the citizenry to be fed, and we need people to know where they're going to get their medicine and when they're going to get their food. We understand it's going to be tricky. We need information, we need spies, we need to know what's happening in the city, and you need people like us to stay out of your way.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That seems like a fairly top-heavy trade in our direction, if you ask me. There are many ways "to get people out of our way."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There are ways that we can benefit each other.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I would love to hear it."

name: SAM
dialogue: (whispers) I would, too.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We have safe haven-- and please, by the way, stop me if you feel I'm being too broad.

name: SAM
dialogue: No, go for it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We have our keep that is untouched by the dragon's attack-- we have a safe haven.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Hmm. How is this keep accessed?"

name: LIAM
dialogue: We can get to that.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There are-- options.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We also have strong connections to Whitestone.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And Vasselheim.

name: SAM
dialogue: And to The Slayer's Take-- that's what they're called, right? Yes? There could be a formidable force that could come to protect the city or drive out the dragons.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We're proposing a short-term solution-- you want to get back to a position where you can grease the wheels and make money. That's not going to happen anytime soon. But you can't take care of these beasts on your own. And neither can Whitestone, neither can we.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: But it is very likely that we will be the thing that is dropped upon it from a great height, and the most cooperation we can get, getting into a position of power over this beast, the happier we'll all be.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Hmm. Let's say we do this, let's say we go forward with this alliance. You get out of our "way, you promise resources from Whitestone, perhaps? They have quite a few unique "contributions they could make. The Slayer's Take-- I have not had many dealings across the Ozmit Sea, "but are you referring to, ah, Vasselheim?"

name: SAM
dialogue: Indeed. They are a mighty force.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Now, that is a tough nut to crack, that city. If you're connected in Vasselheim, perhaps "we can talk."

name: LAURA
dialogue: There's no guarantees you'll be able to get in anywhere.

name: MATT
dialogue: "There's no guarantees we'll be able to provide food or medicine-- it's dangerous times, "my dear."

name: LAURA
dialogue: It is. But the sooner these dragons are defeated, the sooner business can get back to usual.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Of course."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Ow. I mean-- (fake coughs) eh.

name: SAM
dialogue: I know I'm getting a bit ahead of ourselves, but once the dragons are gone and the city's returned to normalcy, what is your ultimate goal? To hold power or to remain in the underbelly?

name: MATT
dialogue: "All the real power lies in the underbelly, my friend. I have a proposition for you, then. We "will do this. We have many channels and secret tunnels throughout the city, and we could very "easily deliver food, medicine, shelter, even, to the wired and poor and downtrodden folk of this "town, be the subterranean heroes of Emon. Out of the goodness of our hearts, of course. However, "once this creature is toppled, and the city is brought toward, I gather you would have the ear "of whoever comes to power in this city."

name: SAM
dialogue: We may very well be the person that comes to power in this city.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That is helpful. And I imagine you also have some presumably powerful connections in "Vasselheim. We would be interested in beginning a sect of our fair trade in that distant, all-too-- "how do I put it? Xenophobic cityscape?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What?

name: MATT
dialogue: "If you agree to be our seed in that stubborn garden of a town, you have our aid."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can you give us a moment? (softly) Please?

name: MATT
dialogue: "My patience grows thin."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (whispering) Can we talk about this for a second, guys?

name: MATT
dialogue: He adjusts the monocle on his eye.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do we really need them? Are they really providing us with enough to make this worth our while, to where we essentially want to open up the Pandora's Box of crime in Vasselheim? Do we want to be responsible for that?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well, I'm all about Pandora and her box, but I don't think we really need this. It's not worth all of that. Especially if we're going to Vasselheim.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I feel like we just took one pretty top-heavy deal and traded it for an even more top-heavy deal not in our favor.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh no, I'm not-- I feel the urge to further discuss this. Also, to be fair, we're not representatives of the Clasp; we couldn't, technically speaking, open-- All we can do is-- I think, the most fair thing to do-- to offer in exchange for this is perhaps some trade with the materials that are available in Whitestone and maybe a promise of keeping a blind eye towards their business until the finished reconstruction of the city. Let them reestablish themselves until the city is properly completed.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Don't say that.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You need an underbelly. Underbellies are function. Underbellies function for this very need: the fact that we can actually get food and medical supplies into the city right now if we need to. Less than 72 hours after such a devastating attack, there's no other system--

name: LIAM
dialogue: If the Clasp were to vanish, something else would take its place.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They're inevitable.

name: LAURA
dialogue: But I don't want to introduce them to Vasselheim, no.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: At the cost of people starving or not starving.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We're already here, Keyleth.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm down for joining them and letting them join our cause, and using their infrastructure, but beyond that--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Can I use perception to make sure that we're really private right now?

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a perception check.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can I join in?

name: LIAM
dialogue: 22-- Oh, 22, plus can I use my inspiration on this?

name: MATT
dialogue: When'd you get that inspiration die?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I got it in the wyvern fight.

name: MATT
dialogue: It would've faded by now, unfortunately.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Okay, so 22.

name: MATT
dialogue: 33? You're far away from the crowd. However, Spireling Shenn has been very concentrated in shifting his attention from each person that is currently speaking in this conversation.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He's reading our lips.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I turn my back to him and I say, he can read our lips as well as I can.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Of course he can, which is why I'm not saying anything that I wouldn't want him to hear anyway. I just don't want to promise anything we can't deliver. I don't think we could deliver Vasselheim; we're going to be busy! We have too much on our plate as it is.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I don't think they'd listen to us anyway, honestly.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm going to offer what we can give, and see if that's enough.

name: SAM
dialogue: We have to have something to sweeten the pot.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes.

name: SAM
dialogue: What are you offering, money?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Offering to sweeten the pot-- we're defeating a fucking dragon! Let them get back to normal.

name: SAM
dialogue: We can't promise that! The dragon could very easily kill us!

name: LAURA
dialogue: We could say-- They certainly can't do it without us. And we can't do it without them. But we'll be bringing in other armies with us.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I agree-- it's joined forces at this point, that's all we can offer them. A place to fight at our side.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You're still assuming he's going to keep his word, too.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Let me go back to him. (deep sigh) Shenn.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes, hmm."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I propose a counter-offer. I just don't feel comfortable offering Vasselheim; I don't think that we could necessarily deliver, and we, honestly, have a lot to do.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All I'm asking is an introduction to a handful of key figures in the city, no more than that."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, I will not promise that now. What I can promise right now is some access to materials from Whitestone, which-- and I show him my gun hilt, which is embedded with the gems. I can see what's still lying around, and we can make a deal. I can also promise that for the reconstruction, once this has been dealt with, which is in everybody's best interest, until such time as there's a functioning government in this city, you will be treated with the respect appropriate of a group of people who are helping keeping the city functional.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You act like that hasn't been our treatment for the entirety of this city's existence. You "think your council didn't have dealings with the Clasp for many years before this happened?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Of course they have.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We helped make this city function. All we're offering is this service to other places "that maybe don't have the right guidance to achieve their true greatness. All I ask is an "introduction. Beyond these other. Far after the fact; don't even need to worry about it now. Who's "to say what changes from now to then?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Who would we even introduce you to?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We don't even know anyone.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, we do. We know some high-ranking clerics. We know the Slayer's Take. We met a bunch of people up there.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: In a zealot city? You want to go to a cleric and be like, "Hey. Thought you might want "to meet the underground mob boss."

name: MATT
dialogue: "We don't have to worry about that now. Just a simple handshake, and it's all done."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'll put something forward to the group. If they prove themselves honorable, if they prove themselves faithful and capable of keeping this city afloat, then we will speak to whomever they wish us to speak to precisely of what they did. No more, no less.

name: MATT
dialogue: "If this is an issue of morality, I would like to remind you that, one, we've let you escape "after murdering one of our leaders, only upon learning that he himself was an immoral "individual."

name: LIAM
dialogue: You're welcome.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Also, we went against our word as an organization by letting you take a war criminal "that had already paid his way out of the city."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And for that, we are grateful.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And we gave you something very powerful in exchange.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And you got to keep that man's money.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That was business.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It was business, but business that was persuaded by the actions of good people, and "bringing justice. We want society to thrive."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm willing to kick this ball down the field.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What?

name: MATT
dialogue: "So. Not wasting any more time, shall we make this a fine, healthy city once again?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: This feels a fair deal to me, and it means that we can leave knowing that the city will, in fact, still have a populace while we're gone.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You seem used to selling your soul, Percy.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It is the job of ruling.

name: SAM
dialogue: If we come back and learn that you have made a deal with the dragons, you'll be the first to die, not them.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh. I would only hope that would be the case. I wouldn't be caught dead dealing with such "a selfish entity."

name: SAM
dialogue: All right, then let's do this. Keyleth, shake the man's hand.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You don't have to.

name: SAM
dialogue: You've got nice soft hands.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Vax?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It should be Vax.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: This is not the worst deal I've ever heard.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You just don't know that yet.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I have things to do."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I have met the devil. That's not him.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Don't do it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Percy, you make me so nervous.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Thank you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I haven't all day. My arm grows weary with impatience."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Vax?

name: SAM
dialogue: Would you like me to sing to give you some extra strength for that arm?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Vax, I will make the deal if you're not up to it, but I want your blessing.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You know what? Keep your deal.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah! Attaboy.

name: SAM
dialogue: We're going to leave the city abandoned?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yes.

name: SAM
dialogue: With no one to protect it?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We are not abandoning it. We already discussed it. There's more than one way to cut through this knot.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I don't think you're going to let this city fall, anyway. If this city dies, you've nothing.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I agree.

name: LIAM
dialogue: If the parasite hasn't a host to feed on, the parasite dies. No, thank you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Percy? I'm sorry, but I think our methods of being rulers might differ. I don't think I need to sell myself for the greater good.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Very well. Unfortunate as it is. Step forward."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Is this a whisper?

name: MATT
dialogue: No, this is him asking you to step forward. He steps really close to you, and he takes you by the shoulders and turns you around to face away from him. Do you resist?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm going to roll out of his hands forward to my friends.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Make an acrobatics check.

name: MATT
dialogue: 28. You tumble away from his grasp, and he (grunts). "Very well. I know your face now, at "least. And the rest of the Clasp will know you are a false member, now. You are not welcome in these "tunnels ever again, and if we see your face amongst our kind, it will be our word that you are "to be taken on sight. It's a shame you've marked yourselves our enemy this day. I wish it wasn't "this way. But to step up and confront us with such disrespect for all the patience we've shown you in "previous years is just-- it irks me. Stinks of a lack of civilization. So please be on your way. "We'll do as we do. You do as you. Now be gone." And he turns around, flicks his cloak, and steps back into the group. The rest of them keep their hands on their belts and wait for you to leave.

name: SAM
dialogue: I look at Garthok and say, "Even you?"

name: MATT
dialogue: Garthok actually gives you a very stern look and pulls his blade an inch from the side of his scabbard.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I wouldn't do that.

name: MATT
dialogue: At which point, you can see 25 more Clasp members step out. Even wounded ones as they are, all stepping up and gathering. There are now 35 to 40 of them starting to form out of the shadows, forming a semicircle around you entirely.

name: SAM
dialogue: Don't do it, Grog.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Absolutely not.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Let's go. Come on.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: A fellow can't smile every once in a while?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We'll just back up.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I take a bow, and I turn my back to them and walk out.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I do not turn my back. I walk backwards the entire way out, with an arrow notched.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I stay next to Vax.

name: SAM
dialogue: I say, party on, Garthok. And then we leave.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Keyleth? Darling? Could you maybe make a wall of stone and close off this tunnel?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Unfortunately, no.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Save a thought for the people of Emon, if you've any room left in your narrow minds. And I back out.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I end with, hopefully, you will realize there is a far greater enemy at hand than the personal squabbles between us small people. And I also step away.

name: MATT
dialogue: The Spireling's not even in view at this point. He's disappeared amongst the rest of them.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm sure he can hear me.

name: MATT
dialogue: Possibly. As you guys exit and find your way back up to the surface, as the last of you makes it outside of the entranceway, you immediately start hearing this slamming and breaking of stone from underneath you, and you gather pretty rapidly that this entrance is being entirely removed for possible entry.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I would like to point out, since you had such noble intentions towards my position on things, this is your ego at work here. I may be many things, and I may be a deal-maker, but I never forget that when I rule, I rule these people, as well. I'm not better than them. And you may think you're better than them, but this is what it creates. It creates enemies.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No, Percy. The difference is, I don't think I'm better than them.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They certainly think you do, and they are not pleased.

name: LAURA
dialogue: This mark. Is it magic? Can they trace you through this mark?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I don't answer. I walk over to Keyleth. Can you still do the thing with your hands?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (fire noise) That thing?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I rip my shirt down. I want you to burn it away. Now.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Vex, do you have an arrow?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Of course.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I hand it to him. Put this in between your teeth. (sizzling noise)

name: MATT
dialogue: (sizzling noise) Searing white pain through the back of your eyes, Vax, as Keyleth presses her palm into the center of your shoulder blades. You can hear the sizzling and cracking of skin, and smell the burning of Vax's flesh in the air in this cellar. Make a constitution check.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Seven.

name: MATT
dialogue: Seven. You break through the arrow with your grip, and actually give out a very loud, painful scream out of reaction.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Like you do.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Similar to when you hit me in my arm.

name: MATT
dialogue: Kind of. A moment passes. Keyleth, you pull your hand back, and where the Clasp symbol once was, there is a hand mark burned into the back of the shoulders.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Vecna. (laughter)

name: LIAM
dialogue: It was you.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Kill her now!

name: MATT
dialogue: What would you guys like to do?

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, that was a bust.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That could have gone so much better.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Vax, I think you made the right call, and I don't think very often.

name: SAM
dialogue: Or very well.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Thank you, Grog.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think we could have gotten out of there with at least the hintings of an alliance, as opposed to just--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Straight up--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Bitter enemies. This was a disaster.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Sometimes you have to walk away from a bad deal to find a good one.

name: SAM
dialogue: That's not a thing.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's not a thing. Where did-- you didn't read that--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I got what you were saying, Grog.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: When it rains, the sun is shining.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's deep, Grog. I like it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Stew on that.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I cast Cure Wounds on--

name: LIAM
dialogue: No!

name: LAURA
dialogue: I already did it. Too late! I fucking touched you, fucker.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Does that take the scar?

name: LAURA
dialogue: It just takes the pain away.

name: MATT
dialogue: Cure Wounds? What it does is prevents infection. It does heal you for the hit points you would have lost for that. I'll say it nullifies the damage you would have taken from the burn mark. It does not alleviate you from the scarring. It's not as graphic as it would have been, had it been left to heal on its own, but it does muddle the Clasp symbol somewhat.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Okay. Thank you.

name: SAM
dialogue: Shall we go back to our keep?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We could just kill them all now.

name: LIAM
dialogue: There's hundreds of them, Grog.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (splutters) No, we can't.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I saw, like, 40 or 50.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, there were another 160 in the rafters.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It would do no good. Who would be bringing food into the city in the first place?

name: LIAM
dialogue: They're going to go on doing the same thing they would have done with us or without us.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They're doing it without us, though.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But Percy, do you honestly think that after all of this was done-- do you want to be beholden to those people?

name: LIAM
dialogue: And I don't believe they are going to bend the knee to Thordak. I don't believe it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They're not going to, no. Of course not.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And that was all I, personally, was worried about.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I wanted people on the inside keeping us informed, and we just lost a very powerful spy network.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I think the only people on the inside right now have scales.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Everybody needs something.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can we go back to the keep?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We are not going to bother. We're going to go and we're going to find a way of killing these things, and we're going to hope for the best in this city. That's what we're going to do.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you guys are heading back, I need stealth checks from everybody.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Stealth check. Pass Without a Trace.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Fuck! Natural one.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh my god, really?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Natural one.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Then what's the point of anybody rolling?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We have a plus ten? 33.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. You guys push southward through the city, finding your way. At this point, the sun has set. Night has come in, and occasionally you hear the flapping of leathery wings overhead as a number of sentry groups of wyvern riders go tearing through the city. At one point, you hear a similar (raspy cry) sound, and you hear other ones begin rising up off the rooftops, heading in your direction, Keyleth. What do you guys do?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The minute we see that, I'm going to push her against the wall, and I'm going to Minor Illusion a shadow right over her.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Make a new stealth check with disadvantage.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Add ten.

name: MATT
dialogue: (chuckles) It's a natural one on their end.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, good.

name: MATT
dialogue: As long as you didn't roll a natural one.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No, I didn't, I rolled an eight, plus a seven, plus ten.

name: MATT
dialogue: So, at that point, they (whoosh), one swoops down and lands on the edge of the roof, and you see it curling down. And takes off again, and they continue on, out of the way. You wait a few moments before silence takes the night once more, and you press on heading southward. (laughter)

name: LAURA
dialogue: Nice.

name: SAM
dialogue: Good job, Percy.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Thank you, Percy.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: One day you're going to stop being afraid of me, by the way, and I hope that day comes soon.

name: SAM
dialogue: Before we go to the keep, do you want to swing by the place?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The place?

name: SAM
dialogue: The place with the airships.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There's no "swinging by," that's a caper. That's an entire thing, that if we're going to do--

name: SAM
dialogue: Just to go there and look?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: The showroom is fucked. It's broken.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: This is one of those things that we're going to have to get everybody on board before we even start talking about it, so probably a good night's sleep.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We need to sleep. We need to get up in the morning--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And then we'll talk about an airship. I'm really on board with the airship.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I think we need to go to Vasselheim or Whitestone.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Vasselheim.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We don't need an airship to do that.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, we don't. But we also need to find out what's happening with Allura in Whiterun. Westruun. All those cities.

name: SAM
