name: LAURA
dialogue: That's wonderful.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I should probably stay with him for a bit. Make sure he's okay."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Is he unconscious still, or just sleeping?

name: MATT
dialogue: He is asleep, currently, yeah. "He's been conscious throughout the day while you were gone, "but he's got to rest a bit more. He's still had a rough few days."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It's dead on.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Just needs headphones.

name: MATT
dialogue: I just need headphones, and to brush against the mic occasionally. Especially during really really impactful story moments.

name: LIAM
dialogue: "What? What?"

dialogue: You going to sleep, Grog?

dialogue: Yeah.

dialogue: Yeah, you got to sleep.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I got to sleep.

name: MATT
dialogue: If you don't sleep you're going to start getting levels of exhaustion for the next day.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh. Okay.

dialogue: All right. So you lose the strength bonus. Everyone, you can get half of your hit dice back.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's a lot of--

dialogue: As the sun goes down? It's been down and everyone's going to their rooms? I go to Keyleth's door and knock on it.

name: MATT
dialogue: Keyleth.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I open the door. Hi.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Hi. I don't want to be alone tonight. Do you?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I haven't been wanting to be alone most nights. And I let him in.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. So, we--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Bow-chicka-wow-wow!

name: MATT
dialogue: Jump forward to the next morning--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That wasn't the kind of ship I was hoping to get. (laughter) I don't think we can all fit on that ship.

name: MATT
dialogue: So, next morning, you all wake up; full hit points, get back half of your max hit dice that you spent. All your spells back.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I give Scanlan the Hat of Disguise back.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

name: SAM
dialogue: You sure you don't need it?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, fuck 'em.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right. Keep up those rhymes. Not bad for a first timer. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: All right, so. What's the plan?

name: SAM
dialogue: You know, Vex, I don't want to be alone right now. (laughter)

name: LAURA
dialogue: I take his face and I push him down on the ground.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. What's the plan?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I don't know.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Do we have a plan?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I suppose our plan is the Slayer's Take next?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, Vasselheim.

name: SAM
dialogue: How do we get there? Wait, we have to get rid of all the 'fugees.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah. We need to go to Whitestone, then.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, here's the question is do we want to head towards Vasselheim from Whitestone?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, let's do that.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: So we'll all go. We'll take the last of the-- I can't believe I'm going to say this-- the last of the 'fugees.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes. Ooh, la la la.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Wait. All of our guards, and our servants, as well. I don't want to leave everyone here.

name: SAM
dialogue: We're abandoning the keep?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I don't know what else to do. If dragons attack, our five guards aren't going to be able to do anything.

name: LIAM
dialogue: One dragon crashed in the roof of the building.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Accidentally smushed.

name: LIAM
dialogue: What are the cook and the maid going to do?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Make it breakfast.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Jarett's pretty badass, but I don't think he can handle that.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Dragons get hungry.

name: SAM
dialogue: When we come back, our keep will be gone.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And we'll be able to build it back up.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It'll match the rest of the city, Scanlan.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Percival's the lord of Whitestone. He's got a castle!

name: LAURA
dialogue: We find a new keep.

name: SAM
dialogue: But my room is just the way I want it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm sure that some lucky dragon's going to come and shit in your bed. It'll be fine.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right, if we're going to leave the keep, I'll need a moment in my room.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You'll find another room bathed in self-loathing. (laughter) It doesn't need to be here.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It takes a good month to bathe a room in that much self-loathing.

name: SAM
dialogue: You look like you're glowing this morning.

name: LIAM
dialogue: That's ridiculous.

name: SAM
dialogue: I've never seen you quite so chipper.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Let's gather what we need, make sure that Gilmore is ready to move, as well. We'll bring everybody through to Whitestone.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I guess we should go tell the guards that they probably will have to leave, if they want.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And that they can come work in Whitestone.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, I don't want to force them to, but of course they're welcome to.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Why don't you go ask the guards? I'll go talk to the kitchen staff.

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I know who she's going to talk to.

name: LAURA
dialogue: He's the captain of the guards, anyway.

name: MATT
dialogue: We'll say for the sake of brevity, you speak with the rest of the keep's staff, including the guards as well. Jarett for the most part is like, "As long as I'm still getting paid, we're more "than happy to go where you need us to be. If it's further away from dragons, I am okay with that."

name: SAM
dialogue: Don't you need your tools?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I can pack up my kit, and I've also technically got a reasonable workshop back in Whitestone.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, so you gather your materials, you prepare at the tree in the center of the keep, you say your goodbyes--

name: SAM
dialogue: Before we go out there, I go to my room, I take a dump on my bed--

name: MATT
dialogue: You've used it at the temple of Sarenrae--

name: SAM
dialogue: No, it's not a potion. Just a straight-up poo.

name: MATT
dialogue: Just a straight-up poo? Okay. Marking your territory. I respect that.

name: SAM
dialogue: I hang a note on the gate of the keep.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Shitting on your own bed?

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't want anyone else to use it. And with a butter knife, I put a note on the gate to the keep that says, "If Kaylie comes, go to Whitestone. P.S. If my painting is delivered, "please forward to Scanlan Shorthalt, care of Whitestone."

name: MATT
dialogue: All righty.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: "Mind the poo."

name: LAURA
dialogue: I leave a note for Allura, and tell her we've headed to Whitestone, as well.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I don't say Whitestone. I say, "the place where we sent you originally," so she knows where it is.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Notes are placed. Spell is prepared?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I've packed everything that could possibly be used to make anything dangerous.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. You have your supplies at the ready. You all gather in the center of the temple of Sarenrae. Keyleth?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Not yet, Keyleth!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We'll be back.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What's wrong? Are you ready, Vex?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I mean, it's the first time we've had a home in forever, and we're leaving it.

name: SAM
dialogue: Can you make it disappear, or something?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We can go. It's nothing.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I can put Hallucinatory Terrain over it, that'll last a bit, but not long enough to make it worthwhile.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's just stone.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We've done it once before. We can do it again.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It will be built back better than before. That's what we do.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Let's go.

name: MATT
dialogue: The portal opens outside of the tree, and all of the refugees start rushing through. You guys give chase, following over to the opposite side, where Whitestone waits. You all emerge from the Sun Tree in the center of the familiar town.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Fucking cold!

name: MATT
dialogue: It is chilly. Not as snow-dappled as it was when you first arrived. A little has melted, and the clouds are a little bit more open; you can see some of the blue sky above you. It's actually a beautiful day, if a bit chilly. As you emerge, you can see there's a few individuals in the center of the town, including a couple of the original refugees that seem to be waiting for the rest to come through. They greet you as soon as you arrive, and rush up and grab a couple of people that they had met at your keep. Some come forward and say, "Thank you. I'm so glad you made it!" They shake your hands. You've arrived back in Whitestone. So, do you guys want to wait here for the day, and then make your way to Vasselheim?

name: SAM
dialogue: Do we need to talk to anybody here?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Just to set up to make sure that the queen and her children are taken in at the castle.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I imagine you'll fill your sister in.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I will. I'll fill my sister in on how they're to be taken care of. Make sure that Gilmore is taken care of.

name: SAM
dialogue: We may want to stock up on potions and stuff before we leave.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, buy as much as we can.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There's a shop.

name: MATT
dialogue: There is, but you guys have cleaned it out.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Buy stuff in Vasselheim.

name: MATT
dialogue: They have not had an opportunity to restock. Their main providers have been killed.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Do you think that with the time that's passed, Cassandra has found any of the belongings of the Briarwoods? They were pretty snazzy.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We can ask about that.

name: MATT
dialogue: You approach Cassandra, who is happy to greet you once you return. "Did you have a question?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Vax?

name: LIAM
dialogue: We need to kill some dragons, and we are out of everything. You've been here a while. Have you found anything of the Briarwoods? Any store of treasure or potion or anything of use?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, the personal effects you all retrieved when they were defeated. What remnants "of income or gold which they'd kept was put in with the rest of the Whitestone treasury when they "took over."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Not so much interested in gold as in means of protection or healing.

name: MATT
dialogue: "They weren't really specialized in healing, I'm afraid, and what bits of protection they had, "you've already taken. But if gold is what you need, we can probably spare you some."

name: LAURA
dialogue: I mean, I'm not going to say no to the gold.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Obviously, we'll sieve the coffer a little bit because we're going to need it for the mission.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So very generous of you.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Also, let's re-employ our castle guards as the Emon royal guards in the meantime, and they can serve the queen and her children.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I like it.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That can be very easily presented. Oh, here we are!" There's a small chest with a lid that she hands it over to you. Actually, puts it out and your hands are already out. "All right. 2,000 gold "from our coffers. It's not much, but we have to keep the city running."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Of course.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And a small amount of the green gem, if that would be possible, that's left over from the mining operation.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Of the glass?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Of the glass. If possible.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes, certainly."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Thank you. I'm working on something.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Very well." It takes a few minutes for that to be retrieved from down south of the tomb in the mausoleum, but nevertheless, you get four half-dollar-sized pieces of residuum glass.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Perfect.

name: MATT
dialogue: Four shards of residuum glass. "I hope that's of aid to you. Apology for the confusion. "We have quite a bit of individuals to find homes for, and get them running."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Gilmore will be of great help.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes, as you've told me."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (laughs) I'm sorry to drop this all on you, and I'm thankful.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm thankful that we even have an opportunity to offer aid to somebody. That's "thanks to you, so it's nothing on us."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It will not be the end of it, sadly.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That's all right. Whatever we can do. Anyway, good luck."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'll be off in the morning.

name: SAM
dialogue: How are we getting to Vasselheim?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We can teleport.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, teleport, right?

name: SAM
dialogue: Is that true?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Just pop on over, yeah. We sleep for the night, and then we go over to Vasselheim the next day.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Let's have dinner.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Hang out in Whitestone for the day.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm going to work on that little project.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Whitestone and chill.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The thing I was trying to attach to my gun but wasn't working, I'm going to try to attach it to my boot instead.

name: MATT
dialogue: Interesting.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I can draw you a sketch.

dialogue: All right. While the rest of you guys are attempting to rest, I need you to make a tinker tools check.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Tinker tools. This goes in here.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's better. 22.

name: MATT
dialogue: 22. You've affixed it to your boot. We'll see if it works.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And I've got one working piece? I know each individual build, I have to build the--

name: SAM
dialogue: The nubbin.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The actual device itself has to be built for individual usage; it's not auto. I'm going to try and build one and see how it goes.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. So total cost for the materials on that will put you at about 300 gold.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What?

name: SAM
dialogue: 300 gold.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm working on something.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Thank you.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I mean, it's your city.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Are you borrowing 300 of your gold from the money you loaned to Vex?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Since the day I've met her, I've given her every bloody dime I've made. So, yes. I no longer even think about it anymore.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And I love you for it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: She's practically the royal treasurer. She's just happier that way.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (laughing) "She's just happier that way."

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. You find an evening's rest. The next morning comes uneventfully. You find yourselves refreshed. I'd say at this point, you're all at full hit dice after two nights of rest; you're fine. So, on to Whitestone, Keyleth?

name: LAURA, TRAVIS
dialogue: Vasselheim?

name: MATT
dialogue: Sorry. You're in Whitestone.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We were just here!

name: MATT
dialogue: You recall you've seen a number of trees. The largest you've seen in Vasselheim would probably have been on the outskirts of--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Where we fought the hydra, maybe.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We camped out in a few trees outside of Vasselheim.

name: MATT
dialogue: Do you want to stop outside the city or within the city, is the question.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Whatever's closest.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No. No magic in the city.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No magic in the city, remember?

name: MATT
dialogue: No arcane magic. Divine magic is a different thing. There's plenty of divine magic within the city.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, is there a teleportation circle? Do we have one in Whitestone?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: There wasn't a teleportation circle to Vasselheim.

name: MATT
dialogue: There are no sigils to Vasselheim. Part of their defense process is preventing any secret intrusion in that regard.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We'll teleport to the outside of the city and perhaps sleep at the temple of Sarenrae.

name: MATT
dialogue: There's the Abundant Terrace.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We always have rooms at Slayer's Take, remember.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We do always have rooms at Slayer's Take.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What's the Abundant Terrace?

name: MATT
dialogue: That's the section that Melora looks over. That is where primarily most of the farming, food--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, let's go there.

name: MATT
dialogue: That's where you know there are a number of orchards and things that are kept in that vicinity. If you wanted to.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's right outside the city?

name: MATT
dialogue: It's within the city. It's one of the five quarters. I won't say quarters. It's one of the five areas.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Sure.

name: MATT
dialogue: Quarters.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Is Gilmore staying here in Whitestone? Yes?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, unless you want to try and bring him with you.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, it makes sense to leave him here, right? Where do you want to stay, Gilmore?

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughs) You're approaching Gilmore. He goes, "To be perfectly honest, I'm not quite "feeling 100%, and let's just say I'm not a huge fan of the zealot type."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Understandable.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Vasselheim doesn't really jangle my dingles."

name: LAURA
dialogue: You've got a whole bookstore devoted to you here.

name: MATT
dialogue: "This is true."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I would appreciate your help in restarting the economy of Whitestone, to be fair.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well. (sighs) Guess it's not too late to open a new branch of Gilmore's Glorious Goods, "since my other, possibly, two no longer exist. (sighs) I was so close to opening. I started from "nothing! I can do it again. (coughs) Good luck, you all."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You as well.

name: SAM
dialogue: So we're going to a tree outside of the city?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yep.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, it's in the farming district in the city.

name: MATT
dialogue: It's in the actual city.

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right, cool.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. Using this once again off the Sun Tree, you guys step through. As you emerge out the other side, you are in the thick of a heavy orchard in the Abundant Terrace. There is heavy snowfall that has fallen recently here, and where it was cold in Whitestone, it's cold here in Vasselheim. You can see built-up ice and sleet that has recently been pushed off to the sides of the orchard. Even amongst this very cold weather, all of the plant life in this area is vibrant and springtime green. As you all emerge in the center of this orchard, you can see one of the nearby workers who's tilling the land looks over. "Hey! What are you doing here? You're not supposed to be in the "middle of the orchard!"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Slayer's Take business. We'll keep moving.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We were just leaving.

name: MATT
dialogue: (groans) "Fucking Slayer's Take. Do whatever the fuck they want." He drinks out of his canteen. "Fine! Just get out."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Glad that manticore's not in your orchard. That's all I can say.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Manticore?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's just cruel.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Don't worry. We took care of it.

name: MATT
dialogue: (weakly) "Thanks." He starts looking nervously over his shoulders as he goes back to his work. Eventually, you guys step outside of the Terrace, finding your way to the Quadroads, which is the central network that the four main portions of Vasselheim attach to. This is the Erathis-based center of the town. You have before you, to remind you, at the very northern part of the town is the extremely tall, pointed mountain known as Heaven's Stair. Attached to that mountain on one side is the Silver Talon's Reach. That is the main temple to Bahamut. To the left of it, against the mountain, not actually into it, is the Braving Grounds. This is the area that is geared towards Kord, the deity of war, where you had previously had a conversation with the Dawn Master, the Earthbreaker Groon. There's the Platinum Sanctuary in the Silver Talon's Reach, which is where the Highbearer Vord, the Silver-Touched, the high priest of Bahamut is. You also just left the Abundant Terrace, and there is the Quadroads, which is where the Slayer's Take currently is. And there is the Duskmeadow, which is the Raven Queen's domain. Where do you guys want to go?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Remind me, what was the Duskmeadow, again? Was that where we chased the rakshasa?

name: MATT
dialogue: That is where the Amaranthine Oubliette resides, which is the prison of the city.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What was the name of the section of the city that has the Slayer's Take?

name: MATT
dialogue: That's the Quadroads, the Erathis, deity of civilization.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: So, like, I really want to go talk to the Kung Fu Panda master. I don't think we're going to get a lot of fights in. The guy, I think he was the teacher of Kern. The guy I beat in the crucible.

name: LIAM
dialogue: That ripped, chiseled old man?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: SAM
dialogue: The guy who beat you twice?

name: LIAM, LAURA, TRAVIS
dialogue: No.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: And nobody beat me twice. He got lucky once, get it straight. I want to go talk to him because maybe we need some more fighters and strong folks and I think he might know where they might be.

name: SAM
dialogue: We should talk to the Slayer's Take, as well.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We should get our rooms.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, let's go post up.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We have things to put down.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And also only about a day's travel from Pyrah.

name: SAM
dialogue: What's that? Pyrah?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Her home.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: What's left of it. That will be a trip that will be necessary soon, but not yet.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys hit the Slayer's Take first, or where are you heading?

name: LAURA, TRAVIS
dialogue: Slayer's Take.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Just to let them know we're here and we need some rooms.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. You make your way to the outside of the main Slayer's Take guildhall. The dark wood exterior greets you happily. You can see they still have a gathering of various antlers of creatures that are tangled into each other that form this rustic-looking entrance. And there on the front doors, you see emblazoned the Slayer's Take-- for lack of a better term, their symbol with the words of their actual guild spread across it, as you saw before. Opening the front door, you can see within the main foyer area, there is the dark iron chandeliers that run across the entire length of the moot hall, if you will. Across the front area, you find the clerk desk. Sitting behind it, a familiar red-haired, tousled, chin-bearded, scarred-up tiny man with his feet up on the desk, falling asleep in his chair.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (laughs) Oi!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Ta-da!

name: MATT
dialogue: "What is this craziness? (laughs) Ah! It's been some time."

name: LAURA
dialogue: It has.

name: MATT
dialogue: "So. Hello."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Hi.

name: MATT
dialogue: "What's your business? What are you looking for?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Dragons? Have you heard about anything?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Other than the fact that you killed one. That is the most recent, but nothing beyond that, "really, no."

name: LAURA
dialogue: We're going to need rooms.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And we're probably going to need to speak to your lady lord.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Your wife.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, your wife, but I'm talking about the boss, here.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's his wife.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Higher still: the sphinx.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Vanessa, she's currently out on a hunt. Should be back in the next day or so."

name: LIAM

You can see a few stars glistening, and a little of the moon peeks through. Catches your attention, specifically, as the moon is the essence of your patron. Through your vision, you can see a handful of small-- I say small. Small from this distance, but relatively large, Trinket-sized furry entities that cluster up to the edge of the lake on the opposite side.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Trinket-sized furry entities? I can't see if they're actually bears.

name: MATT
dialogue: Not at this distance, no.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I cast Pass Without a Trace on everyone around me, and I stealth. We're already stealthed.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What's the circumference of the lake?

name: MATT
dialogue: The full distance around it? I'd say 250 to 300 feet. It's not a huge lake.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It's a giant pond.

name: WILL
dialogue: So they're not that far away, then?

name: MATT
dialogue: They're about 50, 60 feet from you guys right now.

name: MARY
dialogue: I have darkvision. Can I see them?

name: MATT
dialogue: Darkvision up to a certain distance.

name: MARY
dialogue: 60 feet.

name: MATT
dialogue: I'd say, best you can look at it, you've encountered these in the past, and this appears to be a small group of evening-wandering owlbears that are passing through the vicinity.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Owlbears!

name: MARY
dialogue: I can talk to them.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Big, angry bastards.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, well why didn't you just say so?

name: MATT
dialogue: They do not appear to notice your presence, and are just passing through.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Let's just watch them.

name: MARY
dialogue: What are they?

name: SAM
dialogue: Throw things at them!

name: LAURA
dialogue: We just sit and enjoy this magical moment of seeing the rare owlbear in person.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (whispering) So majestic.

name: SAM
dialogue: Quick! Start eating a Tootsie Pop.

name: MARY
dialogue: One.

name: LAURA, MARY
dialogue: Two.

name: ALL
dialogue: Three! (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: Mr. Owl's bad, but Mr. Turtle was a real dick because he's the one who sent the kid to it, knowing full well the owl was going to eat that treat. The true villain's Mr. Turtle.

name: WILL
dialogue: What about the education of the kid, where he's got to go to animals to learn things-- oh, forget it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Half the audience is going, "yeah." And half the audience is going, "what the fuck are they talking about?"

name: MATT
dialogue: You get slightly nervous as the owlbears make their way closer to your edge of the lake, going to where the initial breaking of the ice was set by Grog. They all drink of the ice-cold water, and then eventually make their way scare on the opposite side of the forest.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Did they leave any feathers behind?

name: MATT
dialogue: A couple, maybe?

name: LAURA
dialogue: After they get away, I want to climb down and gather the feathers that they left behind.

name: MATT
dialogue: You find two owlbear feathers.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay!

name: MARY
dialogue: We can put them in our hair.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I want to fletch an arrow. Owlbear arrows.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. What kits do you have with you?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, shit. Really? You know. Those ones I have.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a dexterity check. Just a straight dexterity check.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Where did you get those thieves' tools?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I have thieves' tools because I'm a thief now.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Where did you get them? Did you buy them?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I stole them, dude.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Stole them from where? When? I don't remember that. Did that happen in-game, or did you make that up?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Matt told me I have thieves' tools! Dick. 27. 27 dexterity.

name: MATT
dialogue: He is asleep. Talking in his sleep.

name: MARY
dialogue: Voice in my head. Brother. Twin.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Shut up!

name: MATT
dialogue: You finish out the rest of your watch. Using the moonlight at your disposal, you manage to make a couple of owlbear arrows with the feathers you found.

name: LAURA
dialogue: These are special.

name: MATT
dialogue: They're functional. They'll do.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Cool.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: They're fucking feathers.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Shut up. I'm writing, "two owlbear arrows."

name: MATT
dialogue: Next watch?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Hello.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. You guys go to sleep. The two of you stay up. All right. You watch and the next four hours go by, unhindered.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, I warn them there's owlbears in the area before I go to sleep.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Where? What the--

name: WILL
dialogue: About three hours into their shift, can I come and relieve him?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Wait! I wanted to talk to him. You've got to wait. (laughter)

name: WILL
dialogue: I'll wait. I'll wait.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Percival.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes?

name: LIAM
dialogue: De Rolo. How are you doing? A lot's going on. A lot. But it hasn't been that long.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, I'm pleased for the distraction, honestly. I feel-- (sighs)

name: LIAM
dialogue: Has Orthax fully left the building?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't hear anything anymore, if that's what you're asking.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It is.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think-- I think all I'm manifesting at this point is scars. Honestly, I feel a little lost now. I'm really not entirely sure what I'm doing with myself.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Can I tell you, I believe you are a good man.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Thank you.

name: LIAM
dialogue: If you listen to your better angels, and they're within your friends. Listen to them. I don't want to be pushy. I'm sorry. But you have a family, if you want it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I know. I've been thinking, a lot, about why we're together and what we're doing.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I think we all are, yeah.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And the conclusion that I've been coming to so far (sighs) and Pike being the exception to this rule, as she's the exception to so many things, is I think we're very broken people, but I think together, we are far greater than the sum of our parts. I like who we are together, and I think that's important.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I agree with that.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And I like the influence that everyone has on each other, and this includes, perhaps, you taking some strides with yourself. (sighs)

name: LIAM
dialogue: How do you mean?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's good to want things. It's very, very good to want things. It's also very, very good to have things. It's good to-- it's good to find the things that are important to you and move towards them. I'm in a place where I'm realizing that I have to make decisions about what's important, and I'm a little envious that you seem to be ahead of the curve on that.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I wish I felt that way.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I know.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well. I started talking to you. I just-- I'm sorry if I've done anything to offend you.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Never.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We're a bit of an awkward family, but we are trying.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And I apologize for any of the mistakes I've made, and honestly any of the mistakes I'm likely to make, but I am starting to imagine a better version of myself. I'm not quite sure who that is yet, but there is a destiny, I think, for us all together.

name: LIAM
dialogue: This is all a lot bigger than us individually now.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We've been given mighty deeds to accomplish. We will rise. Or if we fail, no one will ever know. (chuckles)

name: LIAM
dialogue: (laughs) There's comfort in that. All right. I've said my piece.

name: MATT
dialogue: At which point, you hear a voice say, "Good. I'm trying to sleep." (laughter) The clinking of armor as Kima rolls over on one of the branches and is face-palming at the conversation.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You are really fucking cool. You know that, don't you?

name: MATT
dialogue: At this point, you hear a distant screech that echoes across the night sky. All of you wake up. While not extremely loud, it is very noticeable and cuts through the silence, as there is a very still wind tonight.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Even if my sister's waking up, I kick her hard in the ass.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Ah! Fuck you!

name: MATT
dialogue: You two, make a perception check.

name: SAM
dialogue: Have we achieved our long rest yet?

name: MATT
dialogue: Not yet, no.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I have Pass Without a Trace cast on us--

name: MATT
dialogue: As you went to sleep, you didn't.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Shitballs... (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: As you guys are coming back to consciousness, you see a shape that's just-- can't make out the actual details of it, but it coasts across the distant sky, across the clouds, and a little bit of moonlight framing the image.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I pull out Bad News and I'm just going to try and use the scope to trail.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. You pick it up and what you see in the distance is a very, very large bird, cresting across the distance. It doesn't appear to be coming in your direction, but it just slowly makes its way just over the opening in the canopy.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I am of course reminded of the giant roc. Is it the same shape?

name: MATT
dialogue: It's pretty damn close. It disappears over the opposite side--

name: SAM
dialogue: Wait, is it our guy?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He lived!

name: LIAM
dialogue: After I've kicked her, I grab Keyleth by the shoulder and I start waking her up. Roc. Roc. Roc!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Does it look like the same one?

name: MATT
dialogue: It does. You catch it just before it disappears over the distant horizon. It arcs away and then vanishes past.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (whispering) He made it!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's very pretty, I don't understand what--

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's the cow-roc. When we were cows! When we saved a roc.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Was I? I don't think I was there.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Percy was having-- you were having an episode. And locked yourself in the basement.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh shit, Percy.

name: MARY
dialogue: Kash, it's the big bird.

name: WILL
dialogue: I remember that.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You've seen it?

name: MARY, WILL
dialogue: Of course, of course.

name: WILL
dialogue: When were you cows?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, it's a long story.

name: WILL
dialogue: Okay, fair enough.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We saved him, though, and we told him to come here!

name: WILL
dialogue: We see him all the time. A fixture in the night sky.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It was just a bird? I go back to sleep.

name: MATT
dialogue: The rest of you go back to sleep. You guys are finishing up your watch. Did you want to--?

name: WILL
dialogue: I'll take a watch.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: All right, I'm out.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. So is it just Kash taking this next one?

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, I'll-- nope. (laughs) Do I need my sleep still?

name: MATT
dialogue: No, you've had a full eight hours' rest.

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay, I'll stay with you.

name: WILL
dialogue: Good. We'll nap it up.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I elbow him. You're snoring a-fucking-gain--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Shut the fuck up.

name: SAM
dialogue: So. I've seen you checking out some of the members of our little group, here.

name: WILL
dialogue: This is a very interesting group you have here, that's for sure.

name: SAM
dialogue: Listen, Vax doesn't fly that way, I don't think. I know you've been eyeing him pretty good.

name: WILL
dialogue: Huh?

name: SAM
dialogue: Vax. I'm just looking out for you, brother. He's not available for you.

name: WILL
dialogue: What else do your keen eyes perceive?

name: SAM
dialogue: I see the way you've been flirting with him. It's adorable.

name: WILL
dialogue: That's funny. I didn't think anyone was going to pick up on it.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, I'm a romantic, so I notice these things.

name: WILL
dialogue: You are that. You are that. He has a way about him, you have to admit.

name: SAM
dialogue: He does. He has a flair-- it's not my thing, obviously. I go for the lady hookers.

name: WILL
dialogue: Well. To each his own, am I right?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, yes, but no, you have good taste in men.

name: WILL
dialogue: Yeah. Thank you.

name: SAM
dialogue: He's a dashing young rogue.

name: WILL
dialogue: He is. And this crew is lucky to have you.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes. Yes. They are. They really are. That's your keen eye at work!

name: WILL
dialogue: Well. We all see what we see, don't we? Incredible. Just-- incredible.

name: SAM
dialogue: Can I give you a bit of advice?

name: WILL
dialogue: Please. Please do.

name: SAM
dialogue: You know, you have to follow your heart, so if you do have feelings for the lad, you at least have to tell him. Even if he won't return them to you.

name: WILL
dialogue: It's funny, I've been wanting to have a conversation with him for quite a while now. We have a lot to discuss.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh yes, what about?

name: WILL
dialogue: Oh, you know, this and that. Feelings, as you would call them. Romance, as you would say.

name: SAM
dialogue: You are so in touch with those.

name: WILL
dialogue: I know. (laughter) I do my best. When you've lived the sheltered and wonderful life I have--

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, yes?

name: WILL
dialogue: It's not often you meet a man like that. So you run towards him. Some would say, with your spear out. (laughter)

name: SAM
dialogue: TMI, my friend. TMI--

name: WILL
dialogue: That. Is funny. Well, you're right, we do have quite a bit to talk about.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, we have another two and a half hours on this watch.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I wake up. Can you guys talk a little quieter? Some of us are sleeping.

name: WILL
dialogue: Are you going to be able to get her on board with my little plan for her brother?

name: SAM
dialogue: I think she just wants her brother to be happy, you know.

name: WILL
dialogue: And that's wonderful. How do you come up with your songs, by the way?

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, well, you know. I think of like, a word, and then I try to think of a rhyme for it. Like, 'Kashaw', like, what could that be? That could be 'pshaw'! You know, something like that, I don't know, I'm working on that, I'm working on it.

name: WILL
dialogue: That's amazing. It's a skill that I've never had before. But I guess as you said, when you really take in the world and can see people and how they feel, you can really write a powerful ballad.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm a man of the world, I'm well-traveled, I'm cultured--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (snorts awake) Rickshaw, rickshaw-- (snores)

name: SAM
dialogue: Rickshaw's a good one! Let me tell you, secret weapon. I sleep near Percy a lot and he rhymes in his sleep. It's the strangest thing. Here, I'll show you, I'll show you. I haven't a fear in the world!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (mutters incomprehensibly) (laughter)

name: SAM
dialogue: Sometimes it takes a while.

name: WILL
dialogue: I don't. I don't understand.

name: SAM
dialogue: It takes a while.

name: WILL
dialogue: Okay.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (mumbles) Something rhymes with world.

name: SAM
dialogue: See? It's amazing. Every time. Every time.

name: WILL
dialogue: Absolutely incredible.

name: MATT
dialogue: As the hours pass-- (laughter) Through intense conversation and learning about one another, the sky comes to a glow with the rising sun.

name: WILL
dialogue: For the love of god, let something attack us.

name: MATT
dialogue: The rest of the group finds themselves to consciousness. The cold morning air and frozen bits of early-morning dew across the grass and growth in the forest.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Hm, my ears feel really hot this morning, I don't know why that is.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I've been breathing on them.

name: LIAM
dialogue: What?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What about the little hole in the lake that we smashed? Is it still there, or did it freeze over?

name: MATT
dialogue: The hole's still there, but there is a very thin layer of what appears to be forming ice that could be easily cracked.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I got it, I'll do that. And I go and take my morning wee right on the little hole where it's starting to freeze back over.

name: MATT
dialogue: There you go. Grog has now effectively peed in the Marrowglade Loch.

name: WILL
dialogue: Kash walks over to also pee and looks down at Grog and goes, "Holy god." And just turns and walks. (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And that's canon, folks.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's the sound of 20,000 pens hitting paper.

name: WILL
dialogue: For the love of god.

name: MATT
dialogue: Two weeks, folks. We've been storing this up. All right. So what's the plan, guys?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I guess we should breathe underwater and head down, right?

name: WILL
dialogue: Can we handle the cold, is the question I want to know.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That is true. How cold is that lake?

name: MATT
dialogue: It's-- the surface is near-freezing by the just general temperature of the morning air. You're liable to get hypothermia if you spend any extended period of time in the water.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Extended period.

name: WILL
dialogue: Can we send somebody down to try to find the entrance and get in before the rest of us go down there and flounder around?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I can, well. I have really good perception, so. I can go down and see if I can find an opening that you guys didn't see yesterday.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm going to take a walk around the whole thing and see if I can see anything on the edges.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: How big-- you said the lake was like 350 feet--

name: MATT
dialogue: It's about 350 feet circumference around. It's not a very, very large--

name: WILL
dialogue: I can destroy water, but I don't know.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I can control water.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Could you, like, make a, you know, parting of the Red Sea sort of thing?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I might be able to, actually, yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Try that.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Did a 22 perception check around the edge of the loch find anything?

name: MATT
dialogue: Nothing beyond the edge of the lake. There isn't, I mean, you find bits and pieces of broken stone, but nothing that seems to be indicative of a change in topography.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I would actually say breathe underwater would be the safer bet in case something happens. If we have to escape, we don't want to necessarily rely on your consciousness.

name: SAM
dialogue: I can make us all look like fish.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, that's good. Useful. That could be useful if something was attacking and they wouldn't attack fish.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes, they're like, oh look, fish, I'm not going to eat that. I'm so bored of it.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'll workshop that one.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, it's good that you have it, but just hold onto it for a rainy day.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I can focus to part the waters for about ten minutes.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Ten minutes? That's more than enough time.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'll run in, search around.

name: SAM
dialogue: You? We'll all run in!

name: LAURA
dialogue: We'll all run in, search around like maniacs for ten minutes.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Grog, are you ready to dig?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And then if we don't find anything, then I can still cast Breathe Water on us.

name: SAM
dialogue: How much water can you displace?

name: MATT
dialogue: A cube of up to 100 feet on a side, so you could pretty much part the entire lake.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Let's do it and run down and search.

name: MARY
dialogue: In doing so, could she get all the water out of the lake so that it would be gone forever, or is it just a temporary parting?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I feel like that's killing a lot of wildlife.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Are there a lot of fish in here?

name: MATT
dialogue: You've been around. There are some fish that live in here.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Let's just get in there. Let's not destroy the loch.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, I probably can't even get all of it out, but let me-- Let me see what I can do.

name: MATT
dialogue: So you cast Control Water?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I guess I cast Control Water.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Keyleth, I have total faith in you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Thank you.

name: SAM
dialogue: Go, Keyleth. Go.

name: MATT
dialogue: As Keyleth completes the spell in a rapid series of hand motions, concentrating, her eyes illuminate with the power of her druidic, divine energies. She extends her hands and the water itself in the center of the lake, the ice cracks up, almost like a fissure is building in the center. It's almost like tin foil being folded back from the inside out. The ice is actually breaking and being pulled to the sides, and as the ice is pulled back, the water is pulled back with it, like someone has torn into the surface of the earth and peeled the ice back like a sheet. It forms this long tunnel that leads directly down into the center of the lake. The water is being held aloft over the surface, not actually being cast to the sides out into the river. You could empty the lake, for the most part, if you wanted to do it now, but right now you're just holding it aloft as these two water pillars.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Could you build an ice tunnel, perhaps? Take some of the ice and actually structure a--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I was going to say, actually, I think as Control Water, I can also change if it freezes and if it's solid? Can I freeze the edges of this? Make an awesome--

name: MATT
dialogue: You cannot refreeze water with this spell, unfortunately. You can just control its shape. The temperature is a whole different ballgame.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: But there is frozen-- we could take the existing ice and create--

name: LAURA
dialogue: You know what? I'm running in. And Keyleth, just be ready to throw it away.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm just going to focus and keep pushing it out.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I run in and start looking for anything.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Go! Move fast, you have ten minutes!

name: MARY
dialogue: I go to the entrance that was blocked and I investigate to see whether or not there's any way we can climb our way through. Focus on the non-vegetative spots and get in.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm going to that and seeing if there's something there.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. The stonework-- you can start pulling the stones that block the area that lead into that one collapsed entrance, and yeah. You start moving things out of the way and they tumble down to the bottom and stick into the mud. The bottom of the pond is a very interesting sight when it's drained. All the plant life is just sucked together and you're all sloshing through. You're up to your knees with each step as you just sink into the mud.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's a super muddy "ahnus."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I am going to go ahead and start pushing some of the water outwards, out of the lake as I'm keeping it pushed.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I go to the hole, to the "ahnus," and start looking.

name: MATT
dialogue: Looking in there, as you begin to step into the mud, it is a thicker portion and your feet begin to sink into it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You can control water. Can you control the water in the mud?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I've got a lot on my mind right now, Percy!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Okay. Okay, I was just throwing it out there.

name: MATT
dialogue: To a certain extent, you can control elements of it, but because the earth itself is not part of it, it does resist the spell effect, so it would be very minimal effects. As you step into it, you begin to sink.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, I just stepped right in, because I'm really smart, you guys. Hold onto me.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I start pulling.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a strength check.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Oh, thank god I'm so strong. That is-- I'm going to use Luck, and that's shit.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm going. I'm sinking. Grog?

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. The two twins are now, (sucking sound) being pulled in into this small mire.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What happened to you two?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Grog, help. Seriously, quick.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Remember how happy you were that I was alive? That's not going to last much longer.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Come on, come on. Grog, help!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: How deep are they?

name: MATT
dialogue: She's about up to her waist now.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Nah, you're good. Just swim.

name: MATT
dialogue: Up to upper torso. Vax is now getting to right around upper thigh.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh, look. I mean, you're not even twinsies about it. You're at different lengths. You've got to even out a bit.

name: WILL
dialogue: Don't struggle, or you'll sink faster.

name: MATT
dialogue: Trinket's all, (concerned grunts).

name: LAURA
dialogue: I take out my Rope of Infinite Twine and throw it to Trinket's mouth from far away.

name: MATT
dialogue: (chomp, grunt)

name: LAURA

dialogue: Not a whole lot left to harvest. Like, it is destroyed. There's a few eyestalks that you could probably pull.

dialogue: Can we perception check the tomb and see if it's safe to grab shit out of it?

dialogue: Sure, go ahead and make an investigation check

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Hey, Vax, you got that rope yet?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Thank you!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm going to-- Very gently, I'm removing the leather armor from the body.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, I need Vex, I need Percy, and I need Trinket to all make dexterity saving throws.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Evil shit.

name: LAURA
dialogue: One.

name: SAM
dialogue: Dead. Instant death.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Why are you rolling twice?

name: LAURA
dialogue: For Trinket!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm going to use one of my re-reroll a saving throw.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Six for Trinket! It's a good night, you guys.

dialogue: Did I find any loot in the bodies of the losers? The little guys?

dialogue: You find a bunch of shitty spears, crappy leather, and through all them all, about 12 gold pieces.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That can almost buy a book. 21.

name: MATT
dialogue: You manage, as you reach out and grab for the armor, as your fingers touch it, there's this vibration and it seems like the shadows, the nearby shadows in the corners, seem to reach up towards your hands. You pull back in time, but you and Trinket notice a little too late as there's a burst of death. A burst of death energy that just bursts out for a ten-foot radius around the entire sarcophagus. You avoid it. Both you and Trinket suffer 56 points of necrotic damage.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm unconscious. Trinket--

name: MATT
dialogue: Does that bring you below zero?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: Vex's body falls and hits the stonework, and you look over as you see her eyes stare up, the last bit of air escaping from her lungs as the life drips out of her form.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh shit.

name: MARY
dialogue: What?

name: LIAM
dialogue: What's going on?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Running over.

name: MARY
dialogue: What? Running over, pouring a healing potion in her mouth, instantly, as quickly as possible.

name: WILL
dialogue: I can revive her too.

name: MARY
dialogue: Kash, do something.

name: MATT
dialogue: The healing potion has no effect, and as you go to her, you can already feel the clutch to her skin. Her body is instantly cold from the necrotic blast.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Kashaw!

name: MATT
dialogue: You glance over at the sudden intense energy of the room and see your sister lying cold and lifeless on the ground, being cradled by Zahra.

name: LIAM
dialogue: The fuck happened?

name: MARY
dialogue: Kash, Kash, Kash.

name: WILL
dialogue: I can raise the dead.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I run over.

name: WILL
dialogue: I can revivify or I can raise the dead.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Revivify, revivify.

name: WILL
dialogue: Let's do it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm already running over. I'm picking her up. What happened? I was only down there for 30 seconds.

name: MATT
dialogue: Do you have it prepared?

name: WILL
dialogue: What do you mean?

name: MATT
dialogue: Do you have it prepared as one of your prepared spells?

name: WILL
dialogue: I believe so, yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: Check your list to see if it has a little dot next to it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm pouring a healing potion in her mouth. I'm pouring a greater potion in her mouth.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. No effect.

name: LIAM
dialogue: The fuck is going on?

name: WILL
dialogue: Yes, I do.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Do it. Do it.

name: WILL
dialogue: I do. I have it prepared.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's true. It's written down. It's true.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Do it.

name: WILL
dialogue: And I have third levels left.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Do it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh my God, I'm shaking.

name: WILL
dialogue: I can bring her back.

name: MATT
dialogue: You rush over. You reach in your pouch and pull out a bit of clustered diamonds in your hand that you keep just in case for such a circumstance, and as you place them out, you sprinkle them across her chest, pushing Vax a little bit away, knowing that you need the concentration on this, at which point you pull up the symbol, and this type of magic, life and death magic, draws a little closer than you feel comfortable with Vesh, and you realize at this moment that you're going to have to make the choice to possibly call her attention forth.

name: SAM
dialogue: Call whose attention forth?

name: LIAM
dialogue: What are you hesitating for? Do it. Whatever the fuck you're going to do, do it.

name: WILL
dialogue: She could destroy everything.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Do it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What do you mean, she could destroy? What do you mean?

name: SAM
dialogue: Who's she?

name: WILL
dialogue: I mean the dragons are going to be the least of your fears if she comes back. That's what I mean.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Kashaw, you're running out of time.

name: SAM
dialogue: Who's she?

name: WILL
dialogue: I'm going to bring her back.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. So, we're going to do a quick ritual skill challenge as part of this revivify enchantment. So as you grasp the symbol, and as you do, you can see all of the scars across your forearm begin to light with a deep red crimson energy, just (hissing sound), and you close your eyes, and as you look up, you can see Kash's eyes just go straight black, and this dark energy begins to swirl off, and as it reaches out, it touches the diamonds, which then shatter upon impact, and the dark energy seeps into your sister's corpse. The back arches, though she does not register on the face or any of her movement. Her body lifts slightly in place, her arms just draped, dangling and scraping against the stone beneath her as she's elevated there. How do you guys want to help with this ritual?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I take out three of my shards of residuum, and I place them in where the crystals are as an extra offering.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, so you place the residuum across where the diamond dust was shattered and use that as almost a focus for the energy from the spell. All right, I need you to go ahead and roll an intelligence check. Just roll a d20 and add your intelligence modifier.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm going to throw up. Oh no.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I can use my rerolls as well, correct? I can't use my--

name: MATT
dialogue: That's for saving throws, not for ability checks. What did you roll?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Six.

name: MATT
dialogue: Six. The energy itself vibrates within the glass shards, which then shatter, seemingly not able to focus the energy of the spell.

name: MARY
dialogue: I take my enchanted moonstone from my staff and place it next to her.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, so as you take the moonstone, and-- are you speaking to your patron to aid with this?

name: MARY
dialogue: I am.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right, so as you take the moonstone and hold it aloft, you place it near the focus of Kashaw's ritual. The dull white glow begins to intermingle with the dark, shattered energy of Vesh's grant, and as they impact, it creates this strange grey swirl. I need you to go ahead and roll an arcana check. Roll a d20 and add your arcana skill to it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Depending on what she does, I'd like to do something next.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (whispered) That's good. That's good.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. The grey balances, and where the two meet now, there is just grey energy seeping into her body. You, focusing, look up at the altar where the body was, and you see the very faint drifting image of a dark female form looking on. Who wants to make the third and final attempt to aid?

name: SAM
dialogue: I will--

name: LIAM
dialogue: I do.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, sure, I will let you do that.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I pull my sister in close, and I say, take me instead, you raven bitch.

name: MATT
dialogue: Go ahead and make a persuasion check. With advantage.

name: MATT
dialogue: 11. Okay. At this point, the dark female form that drifts from the altar, you glancing up intently, feeling the sudden intense, fearful gaze of Vesh upon you. As it gets closer and closer, the presence is different. What you feared was Vesh is not Vesh, actually. It is an image, a specter of the Raven Queen herself. The face is formless at this proximity. You can't make any details. It's just this perpetually blurred female form of a face. The hair just tumbles down past, and as it steps forward, no expression, no words. The hand reaches out towards you, Vax. There's a nod. The magic strengthens, focusing through your moon crystal into Vax's body. I'll take a picture of this so that no one questions this. A moment passes. A second moment passes. The vision of the Raven Queen nods the head to you, steps backward, and the specter vanishes. (gasping) Breath fills Vex's lungs as she begins to cough, her form drifting back to the stonework. Your vision clears, and you find yourself looking up at the partially broken stone ceiling of the dark altar into the face of your brother, tears streaming down his face, the rest of your friends gathered around.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What happened?

name: MARY
dialogue: Hello, darling.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I feel so cold.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You were knocked out.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Knocked out?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (sighs) Well, that was a close one. (laughs) Did we find anything?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I reach out, and I touch Vax on his back. Do I feel or sense anything different?

name: MATT
dialogue: No.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (exaggerated sobbing) God.

name: MARY
dialogue: I take my stone and put it back in my staff.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Why are you crying?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm not crying, stupid.

name: WILL
dialogue: I'm all right. You people suck.

name: SAM
dialogue: I just hand Vex 30 gold and say, sorry about before.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What happened?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You fucking died.

name: MARY
dialogue: Grog.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah. We turned around. I pull your brother out of the pit, and you're laying there lifeless on the floor.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What?

name: MATT
dialogue: At which point, you immediately have this perpetual slapping of wet bear tongue across your face as Trinket is just (bear noises) nuzzling up against you and, like, pressing all his weight against your body to an almost intense degree.

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right, all right. Your breath is lovely. Okay. How did I--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: How do you feel?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I feel-- I feel cold?

name: MARY
dialogue: Here, take my cape.

name: LAURA
dialogue: How am I not dead, then, if I died--?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's a good question. Vax, how are you feeling?

name: LAURA
dialogue: (softly) Vax--

name: LIAM
dialogue: I walk out of the chamber.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Wait, Percy, did you set off a trap? Is that how I died?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (laughing nervously) Well-- who brought me back?

name: SAM
dialogue: Kash.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And your brother.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: And Zahra.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh.

dialogue: I grab Kash by the hand and, just to him: What does this mean?

name: WILL
dialogue: To be honest, I have no idea.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: How do you feel? WILL:I feel okay. I hope the barrier that was sealed has remained sealed, or this is the start of very bad things. Why did you do that?

dialogue: 'Cause I knew you wanted me to.

dialogue: Hey, Vex, do you want any, like-- ale or anything? You-- I got some, like, firewater?

dialogue: Yeah.

dialogue: We need to get those-- those leathers, those vestiges or whatever, and get the-- out of here.

dialogue: Right.

dialogue: Well, let's keep you away from it for now, darling. Have a sip of firewater, just to warm you up.

dialogue: Here, here's a big flask of firewater.

name: WILL
dialogue: Can we read any of the runes that are on the--

name: MATT
dialogue: As you walk back up to the altar and look on the inside, the corpse is dust. The blast, whatever it was, while it didn't damage anything, seemingly, the remains are dust. The only thing that sticks out to you is what looks to be a black crystal that comes to a point on one end. It has a loop on it like it was part of a medallion or a necklace or some sort of a loop to carry on a chain. Those are the only two things you see within.

name: MARY
dialogue: So the leather is gone?

dialogue: No, the leather is there. The corpse is gone.

dialogue: Yes. All right. Is there any way to pick this up without touching it? I mean, is there any way to-- can I use Mage Hand to lift it?

dialogue: I can hold up to ten pounds.

dialogue: Yeah. It's full leather armor. You can just-- I'd say--

dialogue: I can assist, I've got Mage Hand as well.

dialogue: Well, what if I lifted it up and put it onto your sword, and then you could carry it out that way?

dialogue: Well, all the runes are inscribed there; you can make an arcana check. Or religion check, one of the two, probably would.

name: MARY
dialogue: I glance at it, I can read. I have Eyes of the Runekeeper.

name: MATT
dialogue: The language is a forgotten language. It has been dead for-- probably since before the Divergence. But your eyes clarify on it in the arcane nature of your sight. It is the history of her penance for ascending and taking the throne of another entity that was supplanted. It's just seemingly a history tale that is woven in with a very, very strong enchantment, and you see within each one of these little runic sections, there are mentions of elements: fire, ice, lightning, you know, it runs through all these various elemental arcane properties that are bound into this enchantment. name: MARY
dialogue: Well, do you want to put it into the Bag of Holding and then deal with it later, when you're up against these things?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: SAM
dialogue: Matt, I just did an arcana check and got a 23; does that help us know anything at all?

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay. Let's take it!

name: MARY
dialogue: All right, what about the jewelry and the black crystal?

name: MATT
dialogue: You can take the black crystal as well.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It was the runic things in the sarcophagus that set off that blast, not the leather itself?

name: MATT
dialogue: You don't know. But there were two runic circles within the inside of the sarcophagus that were not visible when you first looked into it, that are both now visible and expended of energy.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: All right, yeah, let's put it in the Bag of Holding. You want to Mage Hand onto my swordy, and then we shish-kabob it into the bag?

name: MARY
dialogue: Yes, I'll take the crystal as well. Is that the only thing-- the rest are all tarnished and green, yes?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MARY
dialogue: All right. So here's the black-- can I do an investigation check on the crystal at all, or--?

name: MATT
dialogue: You'd probably have to take some time with it, like a short rest, to go ahead and ascertain the nature of it.

name: MARY
dialogue: All right. Well, maybe on the way back. I don't know. Get some insight-- so here. Mage Hand it up. There we are.

name: MATT
dialogue: So you gather your findings, your first retrieval of one of the Vestiges of Divergence a success, barring difficult circumstances. You make your way back out through the tomb.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I walk up to Vex. And I just say: you know, he loves you very, very much. So very much.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Thank you, dear.

name: MARY
dialogue: I'm so sorry, but we still have to deal with the water and getting out of here. A stone-- don't we have a stone wall there? We still have to get out.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I still have one more Control Water spell I can do.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. Well, it wouldn't be an issue. We'll say for the sake of story brevity, you guys make your way up through the temple in relative silence, just taking in the moments that have transpired. Through the aid of Keyleth and the rest of the party, you manage to make your way back out the way you came, parting the remnants of the Marrowglade Loch, and start making your way back, in the darkened evening hours, towards Vasselheim.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We need rest!

name: MATT
dialogue: Do you want to rest on the outside of the loch here?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I feel like we should maybe camp and sleep and rest up and get-- I don't know, it's up to you guys.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, no, I think a little treeline rest would be a good idea. Before we go anywhere else.

name: MARY
dialogue: I pull Vex aside and say, walk with me for a moment.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And I go with Kashaw.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

name: MARY
dialogue: I'm not sure what just happened, but I need you to know that you're very dear to me. I've only known you for a short period of time-- At any rate, while you were gone, and I'm not sure how much time I'll be spending with you from now-- I have something for you. After our fight with Rimefang, I forged something for you as well. And it is one Arrow of Dragon-Slaying. And I want you to have this, if for some reason I'm not here, or I can't help you. I want you to use this to do whatever you can to get rid of these things.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (whispers) Thank you, Zahra.

name: MARY
dialogue: You're welcome.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Want to kill it.

name: MARY
dialogue: Yeah. I want you to kill it. And I want you to write me and tell me how you did it. Details. Lots and lots of details.

name: MATT
dialogue: Now it's Keyleth and Kashaw--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You know, Kashaw, for a cleric, I was concerned maybe you didn't believe in much at all. And I was very unsure of how you got all of your radiant powers, considering I didn't know what you believed in. But you must believe in something. So what is it?

name: WILL
dialogue: I believe in life. That's all I was raised to believe in, was life. When you're married to death, it's pretty much all you have. And I didn't believe in any actual person until I met Zahra. She saved my life. She didn't have to, but she did. And she started to teach me what it meant to have family. I didn't really know what that was like until I first saw you guys together. I figured there was no way that was going to happen, and then there she was, and suddenly I had a sister. Once again I realized that, at the end, life conquers all.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, you did our family a great service today, and you didn't have to do that.

name: WILL
dialogue: Yeah. Vax would've killed me. And like I said, I believe in life-- mine, above all others. He's a good guy, you know. And a hell of a warrior. A little creepy, the way he's always staring at you, but I can't really blame him.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You know, you're a good guy too, even though you try really hard to pretend not to be.

name: WILL
dialogue: Don't let that get out, I got a reputation.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Thank you. For everything.

name: WILL
dialogue: There is something you have to do for me, though. You got to go and kill these fuckers.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You actually think we can do it?

name: WILL
dialogue: I don't really know, but I know that no one else will be able to. I hope you can. That Grog guy's fuckin' huge.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, he is.

name: WILL
dialogue: Stay near him. Behind him, maybe.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay, yeah.

name: WILL
dialogue: Or just stay near Vax. He'll look out for you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And thanks for looking out for me.

name: WILL
dialogue: Yeah, you don't suck.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: By the way, y'know, you didn't need to apologize for stealing that kiss before, it was fine.

name: WILL
dialogue: Well, that's good to know. It was only my second one!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What? Really? It was my first!

name: WILL
dialogue: Really?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah!

name: WILL
dialogue: Well, between us we've had three kisses now, I think we did pretty well.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Aww, yeah! High five!

name: WILL
dialogue: Oh, right!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Question. Who was your first kiss?

name: WILL
dialogue: That would be my wife.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, sure, yeah.

name: WILL
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, no, that makes sense.

name: WILL
dialogue: (deadpan) Well, this has been pleasant.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Cool, yeah, no, it has been-- (laughter)

name: WILL
dialogue: Very, very nice talking to you again. I'm glad that it's not awkward at all.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I-- Yeah.

name: WILL
dialogue: Okay. All right.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, I c-- we should probably--

name: WILL
dialogue: I'm going to camp across the way from you tonight, if that's all right. Just 'cause it's a little weird, so.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's fine. Okay.

name: WILL
dialogue: All right. Cool.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you guys head back, the rest of you have gathered at the same camp set-up you had the night before. Kima-- while you guys were doing this, Kima's fixed a little bit of a meal at the base and set up her own Bahamut arc of protection on the tree below where you guys are set up. As everyone gathers around, she kinda gets your attention for a moment and goes: "All right, so "best that I can understand, we have most of our allies and many of the survivors at your place, "right, in Whitestone?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: "While you're seeking most of these things, that's where the bulk of our hope resides. This is "also, you say, where Allie is, and where the rest of the survivors of the Council are."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes, everyone. Everyone that we could save.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Okay. Well, for the time being, I'm probably going to head there and make sure that we "have defense in case any of these dragons manage to get some sort of wind that this is where their "possible usurpers are. They're going to hit it, and they're going to hit it hard. Want to make "sure that we have at least a decent chance of defending these people. So I figure, all strength "that we can spare, beyond those that are searching for these artifacts, go and stay there at the "moment. Besides, it'd be good to catch up with a few friends, myself."

name: MARY
dialogue: Lovely meeting you, Lady Kima. Come and find me when you return to Vasselheim.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You're welcome to join us in Whitestone. We could use the help over there."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Both of you?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I can guarantee you, probably, seeing what you guys can do today, we can definitely make use "of that better over there than killing things for cash here in Vasselheim. But to each their own. "Just a noble cause. Helping your friends, whatever."

name: MARY
dialogue: I'd have to put it to the group of Vox Machina. Is that all right with you?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes! We'll meet you in Whitestone!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Whitestone would be honored.

name: MARY
