dialogue: Oh. My. God. This is the best day of my entire life.

name: SAM
dialogue: You look great up there.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Thank you. Thank you.

name: SAM
dialogue: But you should not have stolen that!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, I know, I know, it's terrible!

name: SAM
dialogue: He was our friend! He helped us!

name: LAURA
dialogue: How bad of a person am I? I'm a horrible person!

name: SAM
dialogue: We should do something to repay the debt!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, I tried. I was going to give him a lot of dragon scales, and he wandered away!

name: SAM
dialogue: We can't possibly find him now.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, how do I help him? Because I feel terrible.

name: SAM
dialogue: If we can't help him, you're going to have to help someone else to make up for the lost karma.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I will help as many people as I can while I'm flying through the air.

name: SAM
dialogue: Perhaps I will pick someone for you to help someday. To repay us both.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I think that's a deal, Scanlan.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right. I will mark that down.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What are you, like, a hag now? I sit on it, and I open the door, and I fly through the doorway.

name: MATT
dialogue: She drifts out of the room. The door (slam) shuts behind her.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You're going to be one of those Segway assholes now!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yes, totally!

name: MATT
dialogue: You lean back in your bed, on your fine, black silken sheets, with Flight of the Bumblebees still blaring by the fireplace.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right, guys, it didn't work, you can go.

name: MATT
dialogue: They all get up. The music stops. And they all slowly drift out of the room, one by one. Fireplace still crackling.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's nice in here.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm sitting wherever there's a lounge of any kind. I'm working in the sketchbook. Working on things.

name: MATT
dialogue: Not a worry.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'll be reading my alchemy book, because I have had so little time to catch up on my reading.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We never talk anymore, do we?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We never do.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Mmm.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm so happy! It's the best!

name: MATT
dialogue: So good!

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm going to try to sleep. It's going to be really, really hard because I'm so excited, but I really need to get some rest!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Did you feed the dog?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Today? I don't know.

name: MATT
dialogue: So, anyone want to do anything else? You going to go rest for the evening?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I rest.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm good.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. You all eventually find your ways to your rooms, happy and comfortable in the fact that no one has to take watch for this night. As you all get to bed, a few hours into the evening, Keyleth, you are just starting to doze off when you hear a knock at the door.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (gasps awake) Scanlan?

name: MATT
dialogue: You open the door?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: On my door?

name: MATT
dialogue: On your door.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Who is it?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Keyleth, it is Cerkonos. Please open up. I wish to speak with you."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I open the door.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Cerkonos comes in. The first thing you notice-- previously, you had seen what was his burned-off arm at the shoulder. You can now see the flesh is extended and is currently very slowly in the process of regenerating his lost arm. And it catches you off-guard for a moment, and he puts his hand up and says, "Sorry, it is not very presentable." And he still keeps his hand over it, slightly embarrassed by the mid-regenerative state of it. "I'm sorry to have disturbed you, I come as "unease has taken my mind." And he enters the room and closes the door behind him. "May we sit?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Of course, please, Cerkonos.

name: MATT
dialogue: He goes over and takes one of the nearby chairs and sets it down, places one across from him for you to sit, gestures with his one arm. Sits down. "I would not speak with those I do not "trust. And I have seen your purity of soul, Keyleth. So I come to you with these concerns." His eyes trail off for a moment in the distance, and he gathers his thoughts and his words. "Four "years ago, a young woman came to Pyrah for redemption. A lost girl, cast out and wishing for "acceptance. We, as we do with outcasts, took her in, taught her. And in time, called her one of our "own, one of the Pyrah. In recent months, she began to grow distant, taking to staying in the "Cindergrove unattended for days at a time. One afternoon, the mountain moved, angry with shifting "fires. We felt a disturbance in the Gate, and when we went to investigate, there she was, commanding "powers we did not know she had."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What kind of powers? Beyond those of druidic nature?

name: MATT
dialogue: "These were the magics taken by man who defied the gods. These were the purest of ancient arcane "threads. We watched as she reached out and tore open the Gate. She laughed as we called out to "stop. But something terrible emerged from that wounded sky."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Thordak?

name: MATT
dialogue: "This dragon you speak of, yes. I defended all that I could, but the power was too great, and "unconsciousness took me. I awoke to my people in tatters, the fires untethered, and this terrible "girl gone. It is both embarrassing and greatly alarming that we could be infiltrated by such an "entity. That blame falls on me, as the headmaster, for not seeing this earlier."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You acted within the good nature of our people, there's nothing wrong with that. How old was this girl when she came to you? And how old is she now?

name: MATT
dialogue: "When she came to us she couldn't be more than 15."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So she's 19, 20?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Perhaps. She did not seem to blossom into womanhood as many do. We considered her more of a "runt of her litter, if you will."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And what was her race?

name: MATT
dialogue: "She seemed human."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: She seemed human? What do you mean?

name: MATT
dialogue: "We take many forms as druids. If she was indeed human, at that age, to command such power... "I do not know her true nature."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What was her name?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Her name was Raishan. Anyway. I wish to tell you this because my heart is heavy with "guilt, and I want you to know that even in places of comfort, family, be careful, keep those you "know you can trust close. Be mindful of those that promise aid when they have not proven themselves. "If you have an instinct, follow it."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Are you referring to something in particular, Cerkonos?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I just do not wish you to make the same mistake I did. Anyway, I thank you for your "companions and you coming to our aid. It shall not be forgotten."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I shall keep an ear open for the name Raishan. If I hear anything about her, I'll send word.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Should you need the aid of the Pyrah, though we are not much at now, come find me. I "look forward for to you bringing Zephrah together. You will make a fine leader."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Thank you, Cerkonos. And I'm glad that you're still with us.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Kaitiaki, Keyleth."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Kaitiaki, Cerkonos.

name: MATT
dialogue: Cerkonos leaves.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And I start poring through my notes for the name Raishan, because Keyleth believes she has heard that name before as one of the dragons, correct? One of the white--

name: LAURA
dialogue: (whispering) It's the green one.

name: MATT
dialogue: That is true.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do I have any other reference, would I know anything else about that?

name: MATT
dialogue: That's all you know, is the name Raishan was used when the Conclave attacked Emon. And it seemed the name belonged to the green dragon that initiated the assault where you guys were.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Fucking bitch.

name: MATT
dialogue: So, these thoughts echoing through your mind--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Streets will run green with revenge!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes, they will!

name: MATT
dialogue: You sleep, but uneasily, as all of these realizations swirl in your head. Eventually sleep takes you, but it is not an easy sleep. Just enough to function. Barely. Vax. As you yourself have attempted to stave off sleep for many days, pushing yourself to your limits, it finally takes its toll, and you drift off into a deep, deep slumber. In that slumber, you find yourself in darkness. Echoes of a distant voice, muffled, as if underwater. Crash. The darkness is shattered into a thousand black feathers, and you find yourself falling, falling. Falling towards what seems to be a tangled net of glowing threads. You're afraid you might impact at such a speed, but before you do, you slow and come to a stop before this extremely prominent glowing weave, this infinite tapestry in all directions. You are uncertain of the meaning of this moment when a large cold hand reaches past your shoulder and grasps a thread right before your face, this singular glowing thread, pulsing with light like a heartbeat. You follow the arm over your shoulder, and glance up directly into the massive form of the Raven Queen: porcelain face like a mask, long jet-black hair, her body encasing you like a physical cage. Your eyes follow the arm back to the thread that she carries between her massive fingers. She tugs it, ever so gently, and it causes waves to ripple through the tapestry into infinity. Her voice fills your mind, both calm but cold. "This is you, my champion. You are fate-touched. The choice is yours. Rebirth or "ruin. Maker or martyr. Conqueror, tyrant, or nothing." She plucks the thread from the weave, snapping it. You plummet into the hole left behind it, falling faster and faster into the dark. Losing control, you turn around and see the Raven Queen, disappearing into the distance, growing smaller and smaller, until suddenly, nothing. Grog. You fall into a deep snore, heavy, heavy snore, after drinking the wine, climbing up walls, you've had an exhausting day of--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Sleeping in the sand pit.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, you are face down.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Like a beach, just (snore).

name: MATT
dialogue: It's great. You've drooled into the sand, and it's clustered around your beard. It's horrifying. But in the middle of snoring, this restful sleep also comes into your mind, and you find yourself walking alone. A long hallway, into blinding light. You have to cover your face, it's so bright, but you push forward because you know there's only one way to go. You cannot see, but you can hear around you and sense the hallway's ended, and there's now space around you. You cannot see, but you sense an arena, gladiatorial in nature. You can hear the distant whisper and hum of crowds cheering.

name: SAM
dialogue: Phillip! Phillip!

name: MATT
dialogue: You sense others around you, closing in suddenly. A voice, ever-whispering in your ear, says, "Release me." Still blinded, eyes closed, on instinct, you pull the cold, dark blade from your back and swing wide, over and over again, feeling the shuddering shock of each impact, your strength matched by the razor-like edge of your weapon, cleaving down any who would approach. The high of adrenaline is incredible, and you laugh aloud at the sheer thrill of your own power.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (laughs triumphantly)

name: MATT
dialogue: The light subsides and your vision returns. You look to see hundreds of people dead at your feet. Farmers, children. You see Pike, motionless, cast among the carnage. You want to scream, but instead you laugh, against your own judgment and intent, like you're locked within yourself and have no control. And as you look up from the pile of corpses at your feet, you see a towering figure before you, cast in furs and bone, standing even a head and a half's height above you, is Kevdak, looking down at you with pride. The entire herd steps up beside him, staring at you atop your throne of corpses, and the herd kneels. Kevdak bows, looking up at you, smiling. "You. You have "finally made me proud, Grog." You wake up (gasp), spittle and sand and grit mashed against your face. Who knows how long it's been, but it's been a while since you've had a dream, let alone one like that. Now, as you all eventually come to in the morning, having your evening's rest, you've recovered your hit points, your spells, all of the usual good stuff, in a fantastic mansion. Maybe not the most fantastic rest for some of you, but a fantastic mansion. You all eventually find your way to the breakfast nook, which is as extravagant as you would imagine a Scanlan-based breakfast nook would be.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Green marble, silver tiling. Sorry, carry on.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Crystal chandelier.

name: SAM
dialogue: Waffle presses.

name: MATT
dialogue: There's a fantastic breakfast feast already prepared, rows of servants along the walls waiting eagerly to attend to you guys as you sit down, pouring fresh juices. It smells fantastic, and most of you look rested, except for a handful.

name: SAM
dialogue: Eat! Drink!

name: LAURA
dialogue: I come skipping into the room, for sure.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Good morning.

name: SAM
dialogue: You're looking delighted and delightful.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What a beautiful day it is!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do you have wine and ale at the breakfast buffet?

name: SAM
dialogue: Sure, sure. There's mimosas, there's--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'll have a mimosa.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You've never heard of breakfast beer?

name: SAM
dialogue: Breakfast beer? Sure. There's milk from a cow with a broken nose.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, that is so sad. Can you heal it? Can it be healed?

name: SAM
dialogue: It'll be fine. When we leave this place, all these people die, anyway.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You're supposed to churn the milk after it leaves the cow.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Wait, Scanlan, can we store things here, or does it all disappear as soon as we leave?

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't know.

name: MATT
dialogue: You haven't tried it before.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We should leave something inconsequential.

name: SAM
dialogue: We'll leave Trinket, and then we'll try it again, and if Trinket's still here, we'll know.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Schrodinger's Trinket.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's just-- no?

name: LAURA
dialogue: No.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right. We'll leave the broom and see if it's still here.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, no, no, let's not.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: What broom?

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, Vex, is there something you'd like to admit to the rest of the group? They'll see you use it sooner or later.

name: MATT
dialogue: You hear a voice go (grunt). Trinket's over there, face covered in breakfast food, trying to sit at one of the edges of the table like a person, the actual bowing of the wooden bench that Trinket's on, you hear the creaking as he moves around in it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Thank you, Scanlan, for making me feel... So, guess what! I can fly! A-plus!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: How did that happen?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I had a really weird night, too. What happened in your... because, I mean, flight?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Did you have a weird night? Do you want to tell us about it?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No, I want to hear about your night.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think you go first.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I want to learn how you fly.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay. So I sort of kind of tricked Gern, I'm a terrible person.

name: SAM
dialogue: Gern, our friend.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You swallowed that last part. What did you say?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I sort of kind of, this is the worst... took something that wasn't mine? In a way. I mean, I was holding on to it, and then I slipped, and it fell into the Bag of Holding.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Why is that bad?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You stole from a candlemaker?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I stole from a necromancer.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Slash candlemaker.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes. No, he was a nice guy.

name: SAM
dialogue: I think we should hear Vax's opinion of this.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Vax, I think you were a bad influence.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I can't judge. I've done my share in the past. I thought you were a little overly nice to him.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I mean, to be fair, we did steal a carpet once.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We did.

name: SAM
dialogue: Did we steal that? I thought it was just a--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We used that in an emergency.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We commandeered it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We took it, Scanlan, and we didn't tell Allura.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And then never gave it back.

name: SAM
dialogue: That's true.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We're terrible.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I don't think any of us can judge you, Vex'ahlia, but it does strike me as a little bit odd, if nothing else.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I know. I know, I'm afraid these rogue tendencies I've been learning from you, brother, maybe rubbed off a little bit. No, I just, I know I shouldn't have.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I don't care.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I wanted to return it right away, and then he wandered off. That's a lie, I didn't want to return it. But I did want to pay him!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I don't think you wanted to do that either.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, I did! I did, I wanted to pay him! But he wandered away, and then I didn't pay him, and now I have this broom that I stole, and there's really no way to return it. Well, I probably could find him, but I don't want to because now I can fly, you guys.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are you going to re-gift it?

name: LAURA
dialogue: No. I'm going to keep it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What do you say, Percy? I think it's kind of funny.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Are you honestly asking my opinion? You said what?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Actually, Percy, do you know-- I know you can build things and make things wonderful.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Can you show me? What is this thing, what did you steal? What is this thing?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I pull out the broom and I lift up in the air.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys watch as Vex all of a sudden (whoosh) takes off above the breakfast room.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Sweet!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: All right, that is pretty cool, Vex. That's pretty badass.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't know if I approve of the metaphor, but that's--

name: LIAM
dialogue: What happens when you shoot a couple arrows from up there?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, shoot me with an arrow!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, shoot some arrows!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Okay, you're not holding onto the broom anymore.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, I've been practicing! I've been practicing!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I reach on the table and I grab what I'm sure is a whole chicken sitting there.

name: SAM
dialogue: Sure.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And I hold it up and I go--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Has it not occurred to you that you're not going to be able to fly?

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, no, no, look! I'm not holding on, Percy! Look at me, not holding on!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay, Vex, ready? Ready, Vex? Vex?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, dear.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Trust.

name: SAM
dialogue: Watch your eyes. Watch your eyes.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Trust Vex!

name: MATT
dialogue: All right, Laura, I want you to go ahead and, first, roll a dexterity check.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay. Shut up! 13.

name: MATT
dialogue: 13, okay. You almost slip off the broom in the process of drawing the arrow from the quiver. You catch yourself and just barely manage to pull back and fire. I want you to go ahead and roll an attack with disadvantage.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, man, disadvantage. Okay.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Please, god, may your aim be true today, Vex.

name: MATT
dialogue: 16. (impact) The arrow does get relatively close to your hand, but it does stick into the turkey.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: She did it! I hand the chicken to Scanlan.

name: SAM
dialogue: I start eating.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I pull the arrow out of the chicken.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Do it again! And I throw the chicken closest to me into the air.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, shit.

name: SAM
dialogue: A moving target!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, god, okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, make another dexterity check.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay.

name: SAM
dialogue: There's lots of chickens, by the way.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Shit balls. 13.

name: MATT
dialogue: 13. Okay, this time, you start falling off and you catch yourself entirely. The arrow just goes wide, you don't even get a chance to nock it in the bow.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Mother bitch, I really need to work on this! Okay.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It'll take some practice.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't think this is-- this may be an engineering issue.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes, Percy, this is the thing. Can you build a seat on this?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I pull out my notepad and start sketching.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What if you could build a seat, and then I can sit on it instead of trying to sit on this tiny little stick?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Let me--

name: SAM
dialogue: Tinker?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Tinker.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You know, beyond it being an engineering issue, it might be a greed issue first.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Really?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Look--

name: LAURA
dialogue: How's that mimosa treating you?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's phenomenal. It's been a long few weeks. I don't care. I don't care. We're never going to see Gern again. I have so many other things to care about.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, no, she's day drunk again.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, no, are you already drunk, Keyleth?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No! I'm just, it's been a long few-- Look.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh, Jesus!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I don't care anymore.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: How many was that? Just one, right? We've been here for five minutes.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I float down.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No! I just don't want you to die.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I float down eye-level, but I'm still floating.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I don't want you to die. I don't want you to die because of your greed. I don't care that you have-- You look amazing. Doesn't she look amazing?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Like a real hoverboard, is there a chance this one might set on fire as well?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Why are you trying to be an asshole?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Sorry.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Here's the thing, Keyleth. I'm not afraid to die anymore. I came to this realization. I've seen the other side. I've come to terms with it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, that's phenomenal that you've come to terms with it! I don't know about the rest of us in the room that all watched you die, though.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I feel too guilty to say no to her. I'm perfectly content to let this go.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It is pretty sweet, flying around like that.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's pretty wonderful.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's really cool.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: She's an adult. Deep levels of arrested development, but an adult nonetheless.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I don't care about the broom.

name: SAM
dialogue: Keyleth, Vex swore to me that she would only use it for good.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's right. I'm not going to steal anything while I'm riding on it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Where would you put it, anyway? You can't let go.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Just don't get into trouble, I guess.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'll practice as much as I can, and Percy's going to help me.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So I can be stable on this thing.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I may need some money, but we'll put something together.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I will give you all the money you want.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Are you going to carry that on your back?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Maybe.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You'll look like a Byroden chimney sweep.

name: LAURA
dialogue: But I feel so good.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You got out, you came out on top this time. It might not happen next time.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I start eating while sitting on the broom.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: All right. I think she's listening to me.

name: SAM
dialogue: I think you broke through.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I think I did.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think you're learning to let people be people.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I don't care anymore.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, look, look! Another round of chickens has just arrived for us to eat.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, chicken!

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't know what breakfast is, so I just keep commanding them to make chickens.

name: MATT
dialogue: So much chicken, guys.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Where should we head to?

name: SAM
dialogue: What is our next-- Shoot, I kept a to-do list for us, but I didn't bring it tonight.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (burps)

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh. I thought you were going to say something. That was a belch?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Did you want to head back to-- Actually, Keyleth, you said something weird happened last night for you as well.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah. Cerkonos stopped by.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah? I look at my brother. All right, cool. Keep going.

dialogue: Yeah, no I want back in, for sure. That's what I've come here for: to come back in. But here's the thing. It's a bit of a surprise, right? Other people haven't seen me. You like a good surprise, right, Horace?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yeah?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah. I thought you might. Here's my question: have you seen my cousin Zanror? Is he in the city?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Probably, aye."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Right. And what about Kevdak?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Kevdak stays in the city, as well. Up at the old Margrave's place, actually. Turned it into "his palace. Want me to take you?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Before we go any further, what do I roll if I want to find out if Horace really does like surprises? I'm not kidding.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make an insight check. All of you guys are still hidden, by the way, unless you want to do something.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, I'm just watching.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And we gained another plus ten, so now we have plus 20 to all of our stealth, by the way, from that Hide in Plain Sight.

name: SAM
dialogue: Wait, what?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We have Pass Without a Trace, which adds plus ten, Hide in Plain Sight adds plus ten. That's what I camouflaged us fucking for.

name: SAM
dialogue: How do you have all these things?

name: MATT
dialogue: All of you guys make another stealth check with plus 20.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Natural 20, so 40. Actually, I have a stealth of seven.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys have never been seen. Retroactively, no one's ever seen you in your entire lives.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I could fire my gun, at this point, and they'd be like, oh, rain's coming.

name: MATT
dialogue: If it was Bad News, it would still probably break stealth.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, if it was Bad News, yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, unless you rolled a one. Yeah, no. (laughs) Horace hasn't seen anyone. "I could take you in."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Right, listen. I was going to pounce on this poor farmer over here, but I saw you were obviously keeping your eye on him. Why are you doing that?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Which one are you talking about? Reggie?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah. Old Broken Foot over here.

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughs) "He's a little bitch, that one is. No, but you know what? I caught him sniffing "around. I think he's keeping some gold hidden."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Really? Gold? This poor farmer?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Twisted his arm a couple of times."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Have you?

name: MATT
dialogue: "We could do this for old times' sake. Each take an arm, pull until he tells us."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh, like wishbone?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yeah."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, that does sound like a good idea. Here's my thing. Why are you guys in this city? It's not really our thing to be in civilized places.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Here's the thing. Let me get loose here for a minute. I'm feeling a bit uncomfortable."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, I don't think I will, Horace.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Okay. We were heading up north. We took out a small caravan just south of the road cuts, near "the Silvercut Way, and all of a sudden out of the sky, we saw these streaking dragons come through. "Largest I've ever seen. Dangerous as the day's long. So we fled. We watched them come here and "tear into this city. Rend it, destroy it, smoke and flames and ice and all sorts of craziness. And "they kept going. We figured, dragons come, didn't take the spoils, there's plenty of spoils for us. "More than we could ever dream of. Most of it's pretty well-guarded, but there couldn't be much "left over there. So we gathered up who we had, and mind you, the herd's swelled a bit since you left, "my friend. We conquered another wandering tribe last year. Zanror took the head of their leader "and commanded them to join. We're about a hundred strong these days."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Jesus.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Fuck.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Pecking order. Still us goliaths at the top. We got all sorts of other piddly men."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Really?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Half-men, half-orcs. A few brutalized elves here and there. They make cooking easy. Anyway, we "took that moment and we rushed into the town. Took it before the day was over. Killed all who didn't "bow before Kevdak himself. Days of revelry ensued, my friend. Oh, you missed out. Wine, women, gold. "We took what we wanted until one of them dragons came back. Black one. Scary. Killed a lot of us. "We weren't so much a hundred strong then, but by the end of that we had 50 or 60 to our name before "the anger finally stopped. Kevdak bent a knee and made an offering to this dragon."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Kevdak did?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I know. But trust me, you see a beast this size... it was survival through a mutual discussion, if you "will. Promised our might to its worship, gathered our spoils, deliver it every now and then. We got "to have the leftovers. We rule the city in its stead. Not a bad deal. Doesn't watch. We leave it "what we find-- most of it, at least, we keep a little on the side-- and we live like kings here. "Westruun is now property of the herd."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well, it sounds really good.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You've missed out, and there's quite a few openings now, since we've lost a few of the less "than strong folk. You look strapping. I'm sure Kevdak would be more than happy to have you back."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I do. I've actually brought a few gifts.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (whispering) I notch an arrow.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I unsheathe Craven Edge.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That's a good blade."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Isn't it. And I ask out loud, are you hungry?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's been probably half a day since breakfast. Aye. Why?" His expression begins to shift as realization begins to dawn on his face.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I pull it back. I stick the point in between his ribcage, and I drive it up through him. (shocked noises)

name: MATT
dialogue: Before he can say a word-- he tries to speak through the pain, but it's met with the gurgle as various bodily fluids fill the inside of his lungs and throat.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh, more?

name: MATT
dialogue: The blade, now, you can see (choking noise) peeks through the back of the mouth as his eyes go ever so dull, the rest of the blood flow pouring out the sides of his mouth.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Pity that, acid reflux.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Grog! Oh shit. Good job, there.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Vex?

name: MATT
dialogue: As this is happening, the blood that has filled the mouth begins to seep back into the mouth. The trails are still there, but what was once filled to the brim has been slowly recessed, swallowed. Not by the unmoving body of Horace, but the dark blade itself now drawing from the inside.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What the fuck is that sword, Grog?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What?

name: LAURA
dialogue: What is your sword doing?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Nothing. It takes in the strength of who it slays.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It takes in the blood?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Did it do that?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Grog.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What?

name: SAM
dialogue: You killed him. Was he related to you in some way?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I don't know. I remember him. He was always a little shit.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Grog, do you remember killing him five seconds ago?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Who?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh no. You guys.

name: LAURA
dialogue: The little dude. Your little friend?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Horace?

name: LAURA
dialogue: You killed him. On purpose?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Sure.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You wanted to?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, he was going to go tell about us.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You were conscious of that?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Is it me?

name: SAM
dialogue: You're using too-big words.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: So listen, right? Either we stay and do some recon, or we take out the other guy that's walking back to the city. Really shouldn't be a problem. But if they're all in there, 50 strong, I don't think we're quite ready for that. The sneaky fucks in our group could go take a look, if you're feeling randy.

name: SAM
dialogue: What would be our mission?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Info only.

name: SAM
dialogue: You killed this one quite easily.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Very easily.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, but that's because we did it as a group.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Did we?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Could we wait until nightfall?

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm going to check out his body. See if there's any booty on his body.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, as soon as we move, we won't be camouflaged in this crop anymore. We'll lose that.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, we won't look like crops.

name: MATT
dialogue: As the stalks unwind, leaving his defiled body and you draw the blade free, Scanlan, you find, across the body, there is a simple, slightly chipped-but-still-functional greatsword that was sheathed in the back, wrapped in a haphazard hide that functioned as a scabbard. Mostly just leather pants, a few furs, looks to be a bone necklace and a bone bracelet around the wrist which looks to be teeth, human teeth. About 27 gold pieces in total change.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: How far are we from the city here?

name: MATT
dialogue: About a five-minute walk.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Five-minute walk. That's not far.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Keyleth, can you use your powers to suck him into the ground so that nobody sees him?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I honestly don't think they're going to find him, anyway.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I use my abilities and try to camouflage the body so that nobody finds him.

name: MATT
dialogue: You pull him up into one of the walls of the plant stalks and set him in there, mounding up whatever bits of fallen leaves and dirt you can. He's pretty well-hidden.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I use my Druidcraft to grow some flowers on top of the dirt.

name: MATT
dialogue: Some flowers come up there. Some of the local leaves from the stalks bend down and help cover him up.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Leave a couple of his human teeth that he's collected--

name: SAM
dialogue: I'll leave all his human teeth, I'm not gonna take that shit.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Great, so very successful trip. Stopping down.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Reggie?

name: LIAM
dialogue: His partner's still long-gone.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That guard?

name: LAURA
dialogue: The other guard, yeah?

name: MATT
dialogue: The guard's gone. Reggie's still sitting there, watched this whole thing happen. Looking at you and goes, "You did good. You did good."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I know I did. Just imagine what we'll do to the rest of them.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Thank you. Thank you."

name: SAM
dialogue: Are we going to do anything to the rest of them?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Right now?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think we're going to go take a look.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I don't mind you taking a look, but be careful.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We can also still turn into mist.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We can.

name: LAURA
dialogue: They can't hurt us when we're mist.

name: SAM
dialogue: We can all mist and go into the city and check it out.

name: LAURA
dialogue: See what we see.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Be fast and stealthy.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can we stealth while we're misting?

name: SAM
dialogue: It doesn't matter if they see us, they can't do anything to us.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, it would be being conscious of the cloud patterns in the sky, moving with the wind in a way where you become less noticeable as something strange. So it's possible.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Let's try that, so we can spy on the city! Get closer in.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It feels kind of cheap.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Why?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I don't know.

name: LAURA
dialogue: At least if we go in, Grog, we can see what we're up against.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, but can't we use our eyes? Just as they are. Do we have to turn to smoke this time?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Why would we not?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It feels a little cowardly.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's not cowardly, Grog, it's safe.

name: SAM
dialogue: You can stay behind.

name: LIAM
dialogue: What if Vex and I went as mist, just the two of us, quickly? Just the two of us.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, that's fine.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I may join you two for this as well.

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And what are the rest of us going to do? Just wait? Me, Scanlan, and Grog?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You can turn into a cloud, and float in there, and see what you want to see, but I'm not turning into mist when my herd is inside that city. If I go in, I'm going in.

name: SAM
dialogue: As Grog.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So why don't we just not go in right now?

name: SAM
dialogue: Why don't you all go in, I'll stay back with Grog.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Thank you.

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Not crazy-ish.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right, the four of you convert into mist form, crest up over the edge and start drifting your way over the top of Westruun, leaving Scanlan, Grog, and Reginald amongst the crops.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Reginald, you want some ale?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Do you have some?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, I do, yeah, hold on. Get the cask out, pour him a cup.

name: MATT
dialogue: He drinks thirstily, both because he seems genuinely thirsty, and second, it seems like he could use a long, hard drink.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Pace yourself, son, there's a lot that's here.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I've been drinking longer than you've been alive, friend." Just (guzzles).

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Wow. Another?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yeah."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'll keep them coming.

name: MATT
dialogue: And, for that, we'll take a quick break, come back here. See you guys here in a few minutes, and we'll continue this story. See you in a minute! [break]

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Cock goblin.

name: MATT
dialogue: Welcome back! Ha ha, they got it on stream! Sorry, Liam, we're not as good as you are at it. So, guys, quick note before we get back into the game. Apparently, the shirt link wasn't working earlier, it is working now. They got it functional, so go ahead and hop on now while you can. Returning from the break, as Grog and Scanlan sit, waiting to hear back from the rest of the team, traversing over towards Westruun, seeking information in their mist forms. The two of you remain behind. The four of you guys who are in mist form, where are you going?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can we stealthily head towards a pocket of people? Do we see a crowd of people being held?

name: MATT
dialogue: This is your mist form?

name: LAURA
dialogue: This is my mist form.

name: MATT
dialogue: Ocean. I like it. I'd like you guys to make stealth checks.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Stealth checks!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do we still have Pass Without a Trace?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes! 39.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys make your way across the rest of the fields. You head over Cole, you can see walking his way to the outside of the western side of the city. You come towards the bottom of the gate. You can see the rigid, small fence structure you noticed when you were far away from the city becomes more clearly visible. It is a series of spears and pikes that are set up as a barrier or a barricade to the outside world to Westruun. You do see adorned atop a number of them a few heads, varying sizes, various people, various ages.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Does this appear to be goliath-built?

name: MATT
dialogue: It's hard to say. It looks built.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And the spikes are facing inward towards the city, or outward?

name: MATT
dialogue: Outwards. There are breaks in it, but essentially it's partially a pseudo-defense mechanism, it's more as a warning, it's a point of intimidation.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So does it look pretty jerry-rigged?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. It's not anything too classically designed.

name: LIAM
dialogue: No flying buttresses?

name: MATT
dialogue: Not quite, no.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Doric columns, oh my god! Awful! Tacky!

name: MATT
dialogue: You coast over the outside wall and glance down within. You can see there are people wandering the town, townsfolk that are out in the streets. Many of them are in pairs or groups, two to four people, appear to be traveling from one place to another. Most of them are accompanied by one or two armed individuals. Some of the people have chains around their neck. You do see a number of these buildings are in ruins, patchwork places. Some are just crushed. Some appear to have been melted down, like the wood or stonework itself has been dissolved into a pile of matter. You see places where fires have broken out and some places have burned into a giant cluster of ash and broken wood. A quick memory glance at this height, you start looking for specific areas that you recall from memory. One: you glance over and see where you first came to meet Pike, where she and Wilhand lived. That area is the area of town that was, apparently, salvaged from the battle. It still stands, there appears to be very minimal impact. As you give yourself enough closeness to check in, the red brick homestead of Wilhand does appear to be standing.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can we see Wilhand anywhere?

name: MATT
dialogue: At this distance, no. You also note, towards the shopping district of Westruun, there is the shop of Abjurist Noja, one of your first enchanter friends who protected you during your first Winter's Crest.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah! He cast the protection spell on us!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: This is making me feel very old.

name: MATT
dialogue: His structure is still standing as well. A few buildings around did not fare so well, but his shop and a number of other ones adjacent to it seem to still be standing. You can't really tell if they're functional, or how busy they are, or if anyone's doing anything with them, but that's still there. You do notice, though, at numerous parts of the street, there are just piles and piles of burnt wood and ash, like they're large burn piles that were set at different periods of time and have long since burned. Little bits of white, post-burning plumes that still smolder over the past few days. You're not quite sure what these piles contained at the time they were set ablaze. There is still the worship district here. You have the various temples. Best you can glance, a few of them have been partially toppled. There is damage to some of the buildings. Still too far away to make out any specific details beyond that, some of the structures having taken a hit in previous conflicts. You're not sure from which source.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What about the mayor's house where we heard Horace--?

name: MATT
dialogue: The Margrave's. Towards the southern central portion of Westruun, south of the main town square where the bulk of your first Winter's Crest festival here in Westruun took place. The Margrave's house is at the very southernmost portion of that. That entire square is lined with row after row of sharpened wood sticks and various other weapons, tridents, broken swords that have been, with ropes, strapped together to form a military barricade. If anything were to attempt to attack from the ground, it would be difficult to do so if this area was filled with prepared soldiers, using these as protective guard. The actual Margrave's home is intact, although at this glance, you can see a lot of it has been defiled, elements of the outside walls are strewn with dark burgundy paint slapped over. You can see what looks to be some sort of strings adorning edges of it, like decoration. You see, walking through this area, what looks to be 12 or 13 or so armed individuals of varying heights. Probably a good six or seven goliaths among them. Others appear to be human, half-orc, it's hard to make out the full details from this distance. They're all on the outskirts surrounding what was previously the Margrave's home. Now the homestead of Kevdak, seemingly.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can we see Kevdak anywhere?

name: MATT
dialogue: You have no idea what Kevdak looks like.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I look for a bigger goliath than the rest, or one that looks older and bigger.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a perception check.

name: MATT
dialogue: 16. At this distance, it's hard to make out any specific details. You can barely make out the fact that they're goliath. It's only because you've traveled with Grog so long you can pick out the details, the hairless form, the tattoos, the general tone of skin. They're male and female, it's a smattering of all different types of goliaths. Some of different thickness, some that are a little more barrel-chested and wide, some that are a little shorter. There are other similarly dressed individuals that are not goliaths as well, but they seem to be more of a subservient role within the herd than the goliaths that would be the ruling class within this self-contained society. But no one stands out to you as matching the descriptions of Kevdak that Grog gave you.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The mansion seems to be where they've based their operations, though.

name: MATT
dialogue: Seemingly.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We don't see a cluster of prisoners anywhere out in the open?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Where's the prison I was being held in?

name: MATT
dialogue: The prison you were being held in was in the Umbra Hills. That's far north of Westruun.

name: LIAM
dialogue: That's when we fought the Nightmare.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (laughs) (imitates Laura) Yeah!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Do we see a cluster?

name: MATT
dialogue: Do you see a what?

name: LAURA
dialogue: A cluster of prisoners out in the open at all, or is it just out around--?

name: MATT
dialogue: It's hard to tell because most everyone who lives here is, in some, way, shape, or form a prisoner. You do see at the various gates of the city as you went through, there's about three, four individuals average stationed there. Nobody seems to be entering or exiting. And the pace of those that are not of the herd that you see walking through the city has a feel of hopelessness, or at least their presence outdoors is more of function. They do what they're told, and if they're not, you've already seen what happens to them.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Now what?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Maybe stealth isn't-- maybe Grog's right-- we can't talk, can we?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No, we're fucking clouds.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can we say go back to the--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, I'm gesturing to go. Get out.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, let's go back.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a stealth check, guys, on the way out.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Scanlan and I have been alone.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay! You guys make your way westward. Is there anything you guys wanted to accomplish while they were gone?

name: SAM
dialogue: Just massage each other.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Right, so I turn to Scanlan. And I say: you and I are mates, right?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, the best of mates.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Right. Could I confide something in you?

name: SAM
dialogue: I wasn't aware that you knew what that word meant.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (clears throat) Right. Well, I'm full of surprises. One of which is-- so, I had this horrible dream recently, and in the dream, I was killing all these people with this amazing sword that I have.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: But there were a lot of people, and some of the people that got killed I knew. And I feel it has something to do with this sword that I have. And the secret is: I can hear the sword talking to me.

name: SAM
dialogue: Like, talking-talking, or you just--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, look, so I'm telling you because you and I have such a history, right? And I feel like you won't judge me, but, like, I'm afraid the rest of the group won't quite understand. I don't know if I'm crazy or if this sword is talking to me.

name: SAM
dialogue: Do you see a mouth on it or anything?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, I just hear a voice and I was wondering if maybe I take it out--

name: SAM
dialogue: All the time?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, only when I'm holding it. So, like, I could take it out now and we could see maybe if you hear it.

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: So I take out Craven Edge.

name: MATT
dialogue: You take out Craven Edge, you hold it out in front of you.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Craven Edge. How did you enjoy your snack?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It was a good snack. A snack it was. If there's more where that came from, "I would be so thankful."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are you getting that?!

name: SAM
dialogue: No, Grog, I'm not.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You're not hearing anything? No, like, super sexy (low-pitched growl) voice? Nothing?

name: SAM
dialogue: Try one more time.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, it's not worth it. Look, do you want to hold the sword?

name: SAM
dialogue: Sure! That's a good idea, actually! Can I hold the sword? How big is it?

name: MATT
dialogue: It's a greatsword. It's almost twice the length of your whole body and probably weighs close to as much as you do.

name: SAM
dialogue: Can you hold the top part and I'll just hold it by the handle, the hilty-part?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I hold the blade, and I hand the hilt towards Scanlan.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you hand the hilt over towards him, there's hesitation in the voice, "Only you are worthy of "holding me. You will hand me to no one."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (grunts) See, now, now, now, Craven, I'm starting to feel like I'm doubting myself. I'm seeing things-- he's talking to me.

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'm going to take it right back, I just want him to experience your glory.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a charisma check.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Shit. Fuck. That's bad.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (gulp) Seven.

name: MATT
dialogue: Seven? Okay. You can't give the sword up. It means too much, and the voice in your head says, "Only those proven worthy to feed me can carry me. And you, Grog--"

name: SAM
dialogue: Grog, hand me the sword.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (pained) No. On second thought, don't worry about it. It's clearly-- and I take it back-- it's not, it's just-- maybe I just need to see someone or talk to somebody. Clearly, I mean, you don't-- it's talking, you don't hear it, right?

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't hear it, but maybe if you handed it to me, I could.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, it's really heavy, too. And I sheathe it.

name: SAM
dialogue: Do I believe him?

name: MATT
dialogue: Make an insight check.

name: SAM
dialogue: Not good.

name: MATT
dialogue: Grog, make a deception check.

name: SAM
dialogue: Not good! Seven!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Three! (laughing)

name: MATT
dialogue: Grog's not the most able liar, you glean. You're pretty good at seeing past the deceit of others. This definitely falls under the line of deceit, as adorable as it is to see him try.

name: SAM
dialogue: Grog, you want to give me the sword. And I will cast Suggestion on him.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Ooh!

name: MATT
dialogue: Is it a wisdom saving throw?

name: SAM
dialogue: I haven't used it in a while, and I don't have my thing.

name: MATT
dialogue: I'll pull it up real fast, just to make sure. I'm pretty sure it is.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think it is.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yep, make a wisdom saving throw.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Giant modifier on this one. 16. With a modifier of zero.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, 18, if I'm not using my thing.

name: MATT
dialogue: Not using the cone, so no, it still fails. So you feel compelled now to give this sword. You're like, no, that's a great idea.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You know what? That's a great idea! I feel like you should hold this sword. And I hold on to the blade, but I still hand the hilt to him.

name: MATT
dialogue: As he holds up the sword towards you, you grasp the handle. As his hand touches it, the voice goes, "No! Only you can wield me!" Go ahead and make a wisdom saving throw again.

name: MATT
dialogue: I'm sorry, that's a charisma saving throw.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, plus one.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. You feel the influence of the blade begin into creep into your mind, but the bond you have with Scanlan and the time you've traveled together, you manage to shrug it off. Fighting that impulse, you still hand the blade over. You take the handle. You let go of the weapon. You hold it in your hand now. It's a (heavy thud).

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You ruin everything good! You take everything good away from all of us!

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, it's heavy.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Throw it into acid, why don't you?!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Ask it a question!

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh! I talk to it?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah! And it'll talk right back, it's like that!

name: SAM
dialogue: Oi, Craven Edge. Have you been talking to my friend Grog?

name: MATT
dialogue: There's a long beat of silence. And then a barely audible (annoyed sigh).

name: LIAM
dialogue: Sing to it!

name: MATT
dialogue: All of a sudden, you hear this tiny voice creep up in the back of your head: "If you truly "wish to hold me in your grasp, I require you to prove to me your worthiness."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Is it saying something?

name: SAM
dialogue: No.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No?! It's not saying anything?!

name: SAM
dialogue: Craven Edge? How do I prove I'm worthy?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What? (laughing)

name: MATT
dialogue: The blade, all of a sudden, it almost seems to have a slight shift of its own, like a divining rod, and it moves. And the blade shifts away from the direction of you and Grog and gently shifts down the way to an older gentleman who's now returned to picking a few crops and it points in his direction and says, "Prove to me."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Is it Reggie?

name: MATT
dialogue: Pointing to Reginald.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Not Reggie!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Why are you pointing it at Reggie?

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't think I can. I don't think I want to. So I think I'll try to give the sword back to Grog.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a charisma check.

name: SAM
dialogue: Is this magic?

name: MATT
dialogue: It's not a spell. Let me double-check, if you're referring to the gnomish racial capability. Let me go ahead and check the rules here, because this could make a difference here.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, it's fine.

name: MATT
dialogue: Against magic? I'll say yes, because it's technically a magical entity.

name: SAM
dialogue: Natural 20.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Witchcraft!

name: MATT
dialogue: The sheer force of personality that begins to exude from this weapon, you sense that it is old, it has seen many a hand, and has probably taken far many more a life. But it's not met a gnome like you before, Scanlan Shorthalt.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (singing) Never known a gnome like you before!

name: SAM
dialogue: Take this back, will you?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah! I take it back. It talked to you, then, yeah?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, it did.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Right, it's creepy as shit.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's very compelling. I don't know if you should have this, Grog.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (confused sputtering) Now, hold on! I just wanted to make sure that I wasn't fucking, you know, batshit crazy, which I'm not! And I'm really glad that we're sharing in this now. But hey! Hey! Don't tell anyone. Promise me.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right. I won't tell anyone. But I might have to ask some questions about this.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, that's why I brought you in! You're all smart, right? And I always want to ask questions like, what's the first thing it remembers, what was it doing with Lord Briarwood--?

name: SAM
dialogue: Does it tell you to kill things?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No!

name: SAM
dialogue: A lot? I know it does, it just told me to kill something.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You must be a dark wizard.

name: SAM
dialogue: Does it tell you to kill things?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No! It just says it's hungry.

name: MATT
dialogue: At which point, you both hear a voice simultaneously go, "Always hungry."

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You heard it that time! Holy shit! I feel like Kevin Costner in Field of Dreams and you're James Earl Jones! I've got a friend in this now! (laughing)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh boy.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Right, so, look, you know.

name: SAM
dialogue: We should not tell the others about this. This is very strange.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah!

name: SAM
dialogue: They might freak out.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Right!

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm going to ask about this. When next we see Pike, I'll ask her about it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: SAM
dialogue: Find out if it's good or bad or neutral. Because I don't know anything about this. Right, I don't know anything about this?

name: MATT
dialogue: Make an arcana check.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It could be good; there's nothing wrong with being hungry.

name: MATT
dialogue: 12. It seems magical.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, I don't know. Don't know anything about this.

name: MATT
dialogue: As a bard, you understand that there are certain artifacts, weapons that either upon their creation, upon their development, had the essence of a creature or soul put into it. Or, conversely, the weapon came into being as its own personality. You're not sure of the nature of this, and you're unable to ascertain which side of the spectrum it lies on as far as morality goes.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'll do some investigating. In the meantime, try not to kill anyone in our party. If it tells you to.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I would never!

name: SAM
dialogue: Well.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Never!

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, yeah there's never even, like--

name: SAM
dialogue: Let's just keep this between us.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, totes.

name: SAM
dialogue: Just like that time in Emon when we--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yep!

name: SAM
dialogue: --double-teamed--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: The Eiffel Tower!

name: SAM
dialogue: Yep!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yep! All right!

name: SAM
dialogue: It was a--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, that went up my nose!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Ugh!

name: MATT
dialogue: At which point, a few clusters of wind come landing out of the sky.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What? Green lights?

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's us.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys, you're the mist!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (panicked yelling) Oh! It's just me!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You're literally just scared of your hands.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (relieved) Oh!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What did--

name: SAM
dialogue: Nothing happened here. How was your trip?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, boring here.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Totally boring?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yep. No action.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You know, not a lot to see there. There's a lot of goliaths and a lot of other bad guys walking around, oppressing very nice-looking people.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: A lot of goliaths?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: They've made really poky fences everywhere.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's what I'd do.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It looks like if we barged in, straight in, they'd probably have very good fortifications.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Right.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I also think they're trying to be scary.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Trying to be scary?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Not that you're not scary all the time, Grog. I just think they're like, ooh.

name: LAURA
dialogue: They really want to look scary.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: They really want to look tough, yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So, here's the thing. Do we barge in, totally risk our lives? Or try to find a way around this situation?

name: SAM
dialogue: There's a central stronghold of some sort?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes.

name: SAM
dialogue: Is it a fortress?

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's where the mayor lived before.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's a house?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, it's like a big house.

name: TALIESIN, MARISHA
dialogue: It's a nice house.

name: SAM
dialogue: And if we were to make our way into it, somehow, what would our mission be?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, let's put on the table what we're doing here. Right? Kevdak has the Knuckles. We don't know where he is. He's probably pretty formidable on his own. And in a day or two, a dragon is going to be swinging by, so it's not one problem, it's a very large problem and a massive problem.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Agreed.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I wonder if Kevdak goes to the sacrificial area where they leave the hoard for the dragon.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I wouldn't.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Or if he does rounds to check in on people.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'll also say I think it's more than likely that, in the end, I doubt the dragons would care who is filling the sacrificial plate.

name: LAURA
dialogue: As long as someone is.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: As long as the plate's full.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: As far as this city goes, correct me if I'm wrong, but we have two options. Either we stealth in with the stealthy people, not me included, and we try and pickpocket Kevdak for the Knuckles. Or I challenge Kevdak for the Knuckles.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Is Kevdak known to ever wander off by himself? Does he take interest in his subjects to where we could corner him alone?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Or is it a walk in and try to challenge him?

name: SAM
dialogue: We could take out that guard, what was his name, Cole or something?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, Cole was heading back to the city, though.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, we could find one of your goliath friends, hold them hostage, and draw out Kevdak that way.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: They won't care about a hostage.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: There also could be the issue of are they going to go looking for Horace?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Maybe. Not that hard, though.

name: SAM
dialogue: We could do some sort of a diversion, set a fire or something that would draw them out. Or set a fire to the house they live in.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's not a bad idea. What would bring Kevdak out?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Grog. Grog would bring Kevdak out.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Grog?

name: SAM
dialogue: Do you want to march in there, solo, while we stealth--

name: LAURA
dialogue: No!

name: SAM
dialogue: No, no, while we all stealth around in the rooftops watching, ready to act.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Grog, I'm curious how tied you feel to the ways of your people now, or if you do. Do you feel the need, yourself, to face him on your own, or would you be amenable, would you be friendly to the idea of my sister and I softening him up for a moment, and then letting you have at it? What do you want to do here?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: So my fear is this: that if it's anyone but me and him, everyone gets involved. Not just us, but all 60 of them in that stronghold. I don't think we walk out of that very well. I'm not opposed to facing him head-on and seeing what fate has in store for me while you free any prisoners that might be around, or ransacking his house for any fun bits, but I think he's going to have the Knuckles on him.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Question. Is your herd and Kevdak the type where, if you start getting the upper hand in this fight, will the herd move to protect Kevdak?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So they'll honor a one-on-one fight? They'll honor that? They won't pull a fast one and swarm in when he's on his last leg?

name: SAM
dialogue: Tell us this. If we walk in with you into town, is that not good? Should you walk into town alone and we lurk in the shadows?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do you want to be on a hilltop, like standing on a hilltop? Because we could arrange that.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I would need to think about it. Regardless, I think now is not the time. Perhaps we go look for Osysa's mate.

name: SAM
dialogue: You don't want to do this now? It seems like now or never!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We know where Kevdak is, he doesn't seem to be going anywhere.

name: SAM
dialogue: We may not know where he is after this.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: He seems pretty fortified. And we don't have Pike. And this is her hometown.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Judging by the-- no, I didn't hear any of that.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I want to throw something in here as well. And I don't know what to do in this situation, I'm looking to you all for guidance. But I do know two things. One is that I don't want you to fall, Grog. We need you. And I do not want you to fall to Kevdak. And second: if you do fall, I'm not willing to walk away without those Knuckles, not for me to use, but for us to use. We need those Knuckles. So if you are to fall at his hand, which I do not want, I don't know that I can honorably walk away.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well, yeah, speaking from a selfish position, if I fall, you can really do whatever the fuck you want. I think honor is bupkis at that point. So I don't mind what you do after that.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You're not going to fall, Grog.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, no, no.

name: LIAM
dialogue: My first point, Grog, I need you, we all do.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's very sweet. Uh. Emotion. I would like it if Pike was here.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We know.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We wait.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Look, could we hear Horace when he was interrogating him?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Judging by the way Horace was speaking, it sounds like they're pretty settled in for right now.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: They're not nomadic any more.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Sitting pretty.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, they ain't going anywhere.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So we know where he is now. It'll give us a little bit more time to formulate our plan? This is your fight, Grog, we'll follow you in this one.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You want to go in there with Pike?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Let's wait for Pike.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We wait for Pike. We wait until Gilmore's up and standing and we bring Pike here with us.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Pike might even be an emotional trigger.

name: LAURA
dialogue: For what?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: The herd if they see her, maybe.

name: LAURA
dialogue: They never met her.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's true. They probably don't give any shits.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Let's just do this. Let's go after Osysa's mate. If we don't learn or find anything incredibly valuable, we're at the same place we are now.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Good point.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: And then we can kick the tires.

name: SAM
dialogue: Do we still have mist possibilities?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We do, we can float on.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Is Reginald still around?

name: MATT
dialogue: You notice that Reginald's sitting there, clutching his full stachel.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Hi, Reggie!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Hi!"

name: LAURA
dialogue: So we're going to help you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Right."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We're going to go get some reinforcements.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You might have to wait a little while.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That's okay, but you're coming back, right?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: We most definitely are. Spread the word that hope is alive. We will find a way to beat this.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right. I'll be careful. You be careful, too. Come back as soon as you think you can, when "you're ready."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Don't tell anyone what you saw here, though, right?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Good luck."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: If anyone asks where Horace is, what happened to Horace?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I haven't seen him for days."

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's a good answer.

name: MATT
dialogue: Spits on the pile where his corpse is. "All right. Hope to see you soon, then." He turns around and begins walking back.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Reginald.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys all take a moment, collect yourselves, revert back to your mist form, coast out of the farmland, heading southward in the direction of the Frostweald. And there, we're going to finish our campaign for the evening.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Ooh, shit!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Man, Grog!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Grog!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Feeling the pressure now? Feel it?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Grog showing restraint and caution!

name: LAURA
dialogue: I like it! I want Pike here, too.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, so do I.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It's too big for Grog.

name: SAM
dialogue: Could have taken them.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You could totally have taken them.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Could have. But it's where Pike and her family raised Grog.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Seems appropriate.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Her schedule's so busy, but if we can get her next week...

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, next week we do the sphinx, and then the week after.

name: MATT
dialogue: We'll figure it out. We'll get her back sometime soon, right?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We do.

name: LIAM
dialogue: If it takes 17 episodes, we will.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You're in New York. Can you stuff her in your suitcase while you're there, bring her back?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Good call!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Just commandeer her, she's tiny!

name: LAURA
dialogue: She's little!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: She might be a little loud.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Skype is rough, guys, it makes me feel bad for Pike.

name: MATT
dialogue: We'll have you back soon, buddy.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm fine.

name: MATT
dialogue: No, you're not! You need to be here!

name: LIAM
dialogue: (fake crying)

name: MATT
dialogue: I know. Hopefully we'll be having Ashley back when Blindspot releases her between seasons, we'll have her back for a few months.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Season break!

name: MATT
dialogue: Whenever that happens soon. We'll see you guys back here next week for the next length of the journey of Vox Machina. Until then, is it Thursday yet? See you guys soon.

name: MATT
dialogue: Hello everybody! Welcome to tonight's episode of Critical Role, where a bunch of us nerdy-ass voice actors sit around and roll dice and play Dungeons & Dragons.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, we do.

name: MATT
dialogue: My name is Matthew Mercer. I am the Dungeon Master of the show. Before we get started, let's go ahead and run through our announcements for the evening. name: LAURA
dialogue: It is!

name: MATT
dialogue: Strongjaw Ale and Dagger Dagger Dagger shirts.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Also ale.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I need them!

name: MATT
dialogue: You do need them.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You do. Actually, Ashley, I think I got shirts for you.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, we've got some shirts held for you.

name: SAM
dialogue: Extra large!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: But if you're not Ashley, you'd better get yourself a shirt.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yep. So you have until tomorrow to get those, so go to the Geek and Sundry store to preorder if you're interested. Yay! name: MARISHA
dialogue: And I went to college there, so I'm going to be finding my old homies and getting drunk.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Do you have a college sweater that just says "college"? You could really use one.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I went to the performing arts school, and we did make football t-shirts, because we thought it was funny, as our performing arts shirts.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That sounds like a performing arts joke.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: SAM
dialogue: Fascinating.

name: MATT
dialogue: Indeed.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Cool story, bro.

name: MATT
dialogue: Next up, I get to announce, coming up as part of a celebration for International Tabletop Day and a sponsorship by Pathfinder and Syrinscape, who have been fantastic in getting this program for me in this game as well, we're going to be doing an event called "Critical Role One Shot" on April 18th, Monday, at 7 to 10 PM. name: ALL
dialogue: What?

name: MATT
dialogue: I know! What, what? (gunshot) Mind blown. Destroyed. Ivan will be playing. name: SAM
dialogue: Wait, what? I didn't know that.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah! So it's going to be a fun night playing Pathfinder.

name: LAURA
dialogue: When is that, again?

name: MATT
dialogue: That is April 18th, Monday at 7 PM, Pacific Time.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Aren't taxes due that day?

name: MATT
dialogue: When you're done with your taxes, this is a great way to celebrate.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: A great way to celebrate. I'll be filing an extension, like everybody else.

name: MATT
dialogue: It'll be a fun event, we've got some cool surprises set up for the story, and I'm excited about it, so come and join us 7 PM Pacific, Monday, April 18th for Critical Role One Shot. name: SAM
dialogue: Oh? What is it?

name: MATT
dialogue: They'll have to see.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, a tiny poop. I'm in.

name: LAURA
dialogue: A teeny-tiny poop, just from Sam.

name: MATT
dialogue: But yeah, those of you out there who want to check it out, we have a fun little insert there in the box. You get to see if you grab one, so check it out and see if it's to your liking. Liam, did you want to talk about--?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Oh, yeah, hey! You know my love for Wyrmwood Gaming and their boxes. We have these beautiful ones. Lift up a Wyrmwood box.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh! Oh my goodness.

name: LIAM
