dialogue: Plus 14? Okay. Okay, so, as you guys begin strolling up, immediately you see torches (fire sounds).

name: LIAM
dialogue: Hands up. No weapons.

name: MATT
dialogue: You see guards come forward, two of them with nocked crossbows. "Who goes there?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Hey, you guys!

name: MATT
dialogue: And they don't really recognize-- they're all looking at this source of singing. Crossbows--

name: SAM
dialogue: (singing) It's a magic carpet ride. Except we burned our magic carpet so we can't-- (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: The guards slowly drop their crossbows. "What's your business?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Hey, hey, that's not necessary. We're friends.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We've already got enough mouths to feed. Move along."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, we're not looking for food. We're here to provide aid if we can, if it's in need, if people need our help.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a persuasion check.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh, shit.

name: SAM
dialogue: Persuasion? You?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Grog--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Ten.

name: MATT
dialogue: While their crossbows are notched, they haven't lowered them completely, they're still on guard and still nervous of your approach.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We also think there's a woman with you named Elowen. She knows us. We'd like to speak to her. We'll wait here.

name: MATT
dialogue: One of them glances over at the other one. One of the guards who was paying attention walks away and they all raise their crossbows again and just train them on you guys for the next few minutes.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I mean, it's really not necessary. Even if you were to loose those, it would just be a tickle. I mean, trust me, we come from Westruun, all right?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Don't you remember us? In Westruun?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah. Winter's Crest festival?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Vox Machina?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Grog? Pike? Wilhelm?

name: MATT
dialogue: One of the guards takes a moment and gives you an eye and just goes-- "I remember seeing you around town. You were-- Oh man, jeez, it's good to see you."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Right? I'm as psyched about all this--

name: MATT
dialogue: "Sorry if I gave you any trouble back in the day. I was young and stupid."

name: SAM
dialogue: Why don't you all lower your crossbows, for a second?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I mean no offense, but we're very guarded with your kind at the moment."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (inhales) Right. Yeah, yeah, understandable. Right. We just actually came from Westruun. It seems to be a bit occupied at the moment.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And he's with us. So-- He's not with them. LAURA. He's different than the other guys, see? He's got a beard.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, I, listen. It came about my own. I just got the genetics for it. (stage-whispers) Would you shut up?

name: MATT
dialogue: At which point the guard that had left comes back with Elowen. She walks up with her tightly braided reddish hair with a little bit of grey on the sides, that probably has come since the last time you've seen her and the experience of having her child gone so long. It's taken a physical toll on her. But there is a smile on her face. Now she looks over and focuses her eyes--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Elowen!

name: MATT
dialogue: "That's them! That's them! Let them in, let them in." And she runs forward immediately and gives a big hug to you, Vex.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh.

name: MATT
dialogue: And starts moving through, and, you know, just this big smile and surprise. And you can see her little boy Simon come up to the side.

name: ALL
dialogue: Oh! Simon!

name: MATT
dialogue: Simon, who last time you saw, you were retrieving him from the pocket dimension that the Dread Emperor had called his domain. At which point, there's a few quick pleasantries, as she says hello again. She says: "Please, please come in. Please. It's fine. They're trustworthy." And the guards nod. And they follow behind, not in an aggressive way but just in a being-careful kind of way. So you have two people, two armed individuals flanking you the entire walk that you guys are doing, but it's at ease.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Keyleth goes up to Simon.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Hi!"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: How old are you now?

name: MATT
dialogue: "This many-- " He puts up nine fingers.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You've grown up so well.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Thank you."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And I just give him a big hug.

name: MATT
dialogue: He freezes up. He's gotten a little shy at the interaction.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I kneel down next to him and I say: do you want to see something cool? Look at this. And I take off the serpent belt. And-- (snake hisses)

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, Jesus.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And I put him around my neck. I named him after you. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: "Really?"

name: LIAM
dialogue: He's my pet. Do you want to, he's gentle as a lamb. Do you want to tickle his neck?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes." (laughter)

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah. Here, you hold him. I set it down around his neck. Don't worry. Nothing's going to happen. It's fine.

name: MATT
dialogue: He locks up again. Snakes and women have the same reaction to this poor little boy.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Simon, fart in his ear. Go ahead and fart in his ear.

name: MATT
dialogue: He gives you a stern look. And the snake just wraps around him for a second.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Keyleth does a little wind gust and goes (poof).

name: MATT
dialogue: He goes (giggles) and starts laughing. Reaches up and rubs his ear from the tickle.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's good to see you again, kiddo. Come here, Simon Jr. I'll put him back, now.

name: MATT
dialogue: He has a big smile on his face now. "That's so cool."

name: LAURA
dialogue: While that was happening, I pulled aside his mother. Is this everyone that made it out of Westruun?

name: MATT
dialogue: (sighs) "Well, we're one group. Many went to Kymal, but they're at capacity now, and based on "many of the farming fields that were destroyed or burned by the dragon ransacking, there's only so "much food to go around, so they had to turn us away. But there were some small farming "communities along the river that were kind enough to take us in and we're... we're getting by."

name: LAURA
dialogue: But you're searching for a home?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Hoping to find out if anything takes care of the problems in Westruun. You should probably "talk to Cornelius. I don't know the details of everything happening."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Cornelius. Is he the man I saw in the finer robes?

name: MATT
dialogue: "No, no. Cornelius is rather-- he's not very well-dressed. He--" And she scratches her head. "He used to be the bookbinder in Westruun but when everything fell apart, he rose up and took the "lead in keeping everyone safe and so, I mean, he won't say it, but we kind of look to him as a "leader for now."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Did he work in the Cobalt Reserve?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I think he did business with them, but I don't think he worked directly with."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Here. Let me take you."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, wonderful.

name: MATT
dialogue: She walks over and, as you guys are talking to Simon, she scoops Simon up and pulls him to her side and gives you guys a smile of acknowledgement. "Come," and leads you guys--

name: LAURA
dialogue: We're meeting Cornelius.

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (softly) Who's Cornelius?

name: LAURA
dialogue: He's a bookbinder.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Never heard of him.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys are led through. Most of the folks stop what they're doing and pay attention. Some look wary and guarded. Others, you see their faces brighten up as they begin to connect the dots between the whispers they've heard of Vox Machina throughout the landscape and the individuals walking through. Most everyone seems to have a somewhat visceral emotional reaction once Grog passes by. It does catch you. You know, as a person who has always stuck out against the society as it was, and you've worked hard to a degree to get some respect, especially in that city. Having so many eyes on you, and you can feel the, while unearned from your standpoint, the heaps of hatred that are thrust upon you by how you look right now is uncomfortable. Eventually, the guards and Elowen bring you guys up to a central tent around what looks like a larger bonfire in the center where a lot of people are starting to bring their big nets of fish over and starting to divvy it out and set up small cooking arrangements so that people for the evening can have their dinner. She walks up to the edge of tent, speaks to one of the guards, mentions you guys and your wanting to talk to Cornelius. The guard leans in, shouts off to the side, "Cornelius, you've got some visitors. Is "that okay?" A voice muffles through, "That's fine. Go ahead and let them in." The guard pulls open the tent, and at this point Elowen says, "I'm going to go get my son some food. If you need "anything, just ask around."

name: LIAM
dialogue: We'll see you again.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Thank you guys, again." She rubs Simon's head and walks off. And as she walks off with him, he keeps looking over his shoulder at you the whole time, with a big smile on his face. You guys walk into the tent, and it smells like a tent that's been lived in for a couple weeks. The interior's not fancy by any means. It's blankets and burlap, and whatever functions to guard against the relatively muddy shores of the river. And you get a sense that most places here, just because of the landscape and how close it is to the river, mud is tracked everywhere. So it's mostly caked ground. There is a small cot on the far edge and there is a table set up and some elements of dried fish that are just being pulled from a sack on the side. And there are two guards, and you can see what appears to be Cornelius coming to greet you, as you enter. A man in his mid-40's, blondish hair with a scruffy, unkempt beard. You get the sense that he's a working man. His hands look calloused. He's got a layer of just dirt and grime across his brow that tells you he's definitely one who gets in the thick of it when it's needed. And you can see why in this circumstance people put trust into a person that can rise up amongst all the chaos from simple means and prove themselves to want to help everybody. And in the moment he smiles, you immediately see also why people follow him. He's got this bright, toothy, white smile, and he puts his hand out immediately to each of you. "Pleasure "to meet you. I'm Cornelius."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Vex'ahlia.

name: MATT
dialogue: "So, I'm told that you all are here to talk to me? What's this about?"

name: SAM
dialogue: We know that you've been driven out of your homes by an attack of dragon or dragons. How many have menaced your city?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, counts all say that we have upwards of three dragons that came through here and tore "into this city and-- They were gone for a while, and we'd hoped they weren't going to return, but "that's when--" He kinda looks over to you, Grog. "That's when the savages came in and took what was "left. And I mean no offense to that. I recognize you; I've seen you around the town before. You "seem like you're not like your ilk."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No. No, I'm sorry, I don't know who you are.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That's okay. No one really knows who I am and I want to keep it that way, when all this "blows over."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Understandable.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Don't like all the attention."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: How long have you been nomadic for?

name: MATT
dialogue: "We're going into our second week now, I think. We sent a few of our most able-bodied up "north in hopes of trying to figure out if the city was safe to return to, and, well, only a few made "it back, and those that did said it was a bloodbath."

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's quite dangerous there right now.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yeah."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: How many do you have here, in your encampment with you?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Let's see." He kind of takes a moment to think and does couple marks on the dirt in front of him to do a count. You can see he's not a very numbers-guided person.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I like him. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'd say we got probably about close to 60, 70 people left. We used to have more. Then we lost "the scouting parties up north and, well, these past four days we've had a few of these orcish "fuckers been raiding the outskirts of our camp every night and taking goods, people--"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What's your current destination?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Hah, we got none. We're just staying here and staying alive."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And what made you camp out here?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Fish, mainly. I mean, all the farming grounds are destroyed or they're being guarded "currently, and there's no space for us in Kymal. We can keep going east, but--"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: If I could be selfish for a moment. Have you seen Wilhand? Pike, Pike Trickfoot. Her grandfather.

name: LAURA
dialogue: A small, older gnome?

name: MATT
dialogue: "We got a few older gnomes from the city. I don't think we have any among us though, no."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Fine. Thought I'd ask.

name: LIAM
dialogue: If we could help you relocate quite a ways away, would you be open to that?

name: MATT
dialogue: "How do you mean?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: There's a city. A lot of the refugees from other cities that have been destroyed by the dragons are finding their way there and--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Percy actually has family who's in charge there.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We could give you safe passage.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Possibly find you someplace to work.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Very quick, safe passage.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can they account for 70 extra people in Whitestone?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We lost a lot during the attack with the Briarwoods.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Right.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There's room, but there's only-- We can maybe make room for a few more.

name: LAURA
dialogue: There's farmland, there are some empty buildings.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I appreciate the offer, and--"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It hasn't been touched by dragons yet.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Hah. 'Yet.'"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yet.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I tell you what. We greatly appreciate the offer, and we're liable to take you up on that at "some point in the near future. But right now, we have too many of our people that are unaccounted "for to the south. We got a couple scouting groups who're trying to find out where these orcs are, "where they've taken them. See if we can retrieve our own before we go ahead and find a new place to live."

name: SAM
dialogue: How many are missing right now?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, we lost 11 in the last few nights of exchange, to blade, and we've lost about nine to "the actual bands themselves, so. There's nine unaccounted for. We're hoping--"

name: SAM
dialogue: If we found them, would you be more likely to take your people to somewhere safe?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And what is necessarily stopping you from at least sending a handful of women and children ahead? Families that don't need to be nomadic.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Do you have the means to keep them safe for that kind of travel? That's a long way, up to "Whitestone. We don't have the guards to keep them up on that."

name: LAURA
dialogue: We have very safe means of travel.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: A shortcut, one would say.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: They'd be there in an instant.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't know anything about any of that weird magic stuff, but you seem like a reliable group."

name: LIAM
dialogue: You can tell we're a motley bunch of assholes. We've seen shit and we've done shit and we can do shit.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Ain't that the truth. Well--"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We'd also like to talk to you, perhaps, to see if you've seen some shit. We're actually looking for something out here.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Are we?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We are. Well, you've been travelling, we're looking for a creature who may have what we need to help defeat these dragons.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Possibly a bit deeper into the Frostweald.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Into the Frostweald?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That's where we're thinking our scouts are saying these orcs are holed up, anyway."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Really?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's useful.

name: MATT
dialogue: "At least, that's where we've been sending our folk. And follow them out there. Only one "group went in after them and they never came back, so--"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No one's returned who's come back?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh, we've gotten one group that came back. That's how we know they're there. But they were "just a scouting party. They got to the outskirts and came back."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can we speak to them?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I think they're out right now, actually. Going to get more information. Sorry."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, that works out well, then. We can go up that direction, perhaps take care of this problem, possibly.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's on the way.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I wouldn't mind a good stretch.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Kill some orc.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I could use some breathing.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do you know your way around the Frostweald at all?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Can't say I do. But I do have some stake in this personally, if you don't mind me asking. We "don't have much to offer you, at all, really, other than my gratitude. Tell of a few friends of "ours that've found their way wherever these savage creatures are stationed. One of the individuals "that was taken in a raid two nights ago was my brother, Cyrus. Don't know if he's still amongst "the living, but if you are indeed planning on taking a look at where these orcs are and bring "folks back safe, if you could just keep an eye out for him?"

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, I'll tell you, in times like these, it will feel good to be able to do a bit of good.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Hear, hear.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What does your brother look like?

name: MATT
dialogue: "He's about 15 years younger than me. Shaggy brown hair, bit of a puffy goatee. He looks like a "lazy man. He is a lazy man, but I love him. If you're looking for someone who's hiding in the "corner, shaking in their boots, it's probably him."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Understood.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Check the corners.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's his defense mechanism."

name: LAURA
dialogue: (laughs) A very safe one.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I hope." His eyes go a little colder at that moment. "I hope."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, we've been to the Frostweald before. I'm not afraid to go in there again.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I say we take the evening to rest, and first thing in the morning, head out.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Would there be any injured members of your camp that would want to head out in the morning to Whitestone? Somebody that needs any medical attention?

name: MATT
dialogue: "We've got plenty of folks who aren't feeling too well. Illness and disease, "unfortunately, tend to go hand-in-hand with these type of nomadic lifestyles. We can probably-- "about seven or eight people that could use some relatively immediate attention. Couple survivors "of the recent raids. If you can indeed do this, you might be saving some lives, here."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Are we camping the rest of the night?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes.

name: LIAM
dialogue: That's wise.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, we promise you no one will bother you tonight.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Question. Question. Can I do my Transport via Plants as a ritual cast to not burn a slot level?

name: MATT
dialogue: Nope.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's what I thought.

name: MATT
dialogue: It would say it next to the spell. Ritual.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's what I thought. Okay. Keyleth spends the rest of the evening burning up my remainder spell slots to do curing on those who need it.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. You guys are given a relatively ramshackle tent in which you can sleep for the evening, cooked fish-- that's about all they have to offer-- with a few leftover potatoes that appear to have been recently either located amongst their remaining crates, you have no idea, but a passable meal is presented if you'd like, and a place that has cloth over your head.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, I don't need to sleep tonight. I'll be on the watch.

name: SAM
dialogue: Boy. (laughter)

name: LAURA
dialogue: Should we scour the camp for her grandfather?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm sleeping tonight. I don't know what's wrong with him.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I know he said there were no gnomes, but--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: There's only 60 people. I feel like he'd know with 60.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's like this many, like--

name: LIAM
dialogue: And it's not a lot of gnomes. I'm assuming it's a handful of gnomes.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Right. I just, I don't know. I wish Pike were here.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, me too.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Always wish Pike was here.

name: MATT
dialogue: You do recall, last time you were in Whitestone, you left the other half of your gatestone with Pike.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'll write a letter.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We'll write a letter.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'll write a letter that will travel with them to Whitestone and--

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Ooh, that's a good idea.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's wonderful, and she can pop over.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Mm-hm. Take about a minute.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Really?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: SAM
dialogue: Wait, we'd have to send them tonight, though.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, in the morning.

name: LAURA
dialogue: They could go in the morning and just go find her immediately.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, could task someone to find her immediately and then, as soon as she gets the message, she'll beam to us.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I've still got the other one. Right here.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Great. We take the night, then.

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I write a letter to my sister, letting her know that I do apologize that we're sending more people, but it's necessary, and I write her a letter insisting that Pike be sent here by stone immediately.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

name: LIAM
dialogue: (singing) D-E-A-R C-A-S-S, how are you? I'm fine.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What the fuck are you singing?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (singing) Everybody else is too!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Wow! You know what I'm doing!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Holy shit, what the fuck just happened?

name: LAURA
dialogue: What was that?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You are a nerd!

name: LIAM
dialogue: A theatre nerd, yeah.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yeah, you are a theatre nerd.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Wow.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Secret Garden, ladies and gentlemen.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Secret Garden: The Musical. It's magical.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Can we have the break so Taliesin and I can go make out in the other room?

name: MATT
dialogue: Don't go on break for that! Just move your seating arrangement.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And suddenly the YouTube hits just go through the roof. (laughter)

name: SAM
dialogue: What injured people are going back? Have we met these people yet? Can we meet them?

name: MATT
dialogue: You haven't met them, no.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Let's go find the injured.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys are led with Keyleth as well. There are two armed guards that are hobbling their way through their patrols tonight as they've been wounded in the previous orc raid that happened the couple nights beforehand. There are a number of just relatively sick people. Couple of children. Whether it be having to eat whatever was around to stay alive but some of the food had spoiled in travel, or just catching disease as when you have clusters of people in cold environments, especially cold, wet environments like this tonight. It does tend to happen. Nothing seriously life-threatening, but, you know, definitely worrisome.

name: SAM
dialogue: I try to find the one who's the most able-bodied. Right? We're going to need someone to go find Pike or deliver a message, right?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's going to be whoever's organizing it.

name: SAM
dialogue: Is someone going who's not injured to transport these people?

name: MATT
dialogue: Possibly. And you can organize whoever you'd like. Someone you know, you could bring along.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, I start attending to the children first.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. So you tend to the children, helping them feel comfortable, deal with any wounds, scrapes, relative inconveniences, and it's easy enough for you to take a moment to cure disease if need be.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can we find any families with children and maybe see if there's able bodies in there that we could send through?

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Yeah, you manage to-- and with Elowen and her son Simon as well--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes. Maybe Elowen could go?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Elowen would be perfect.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, remember, we were able to get about 25 or so people through last time with the spell.

name: LAURA
dialogue: How many sick people are there?

name: MATT
dialogue: You see about seven or eight people that could use it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Perfect.

name: MATT
dialogue: So you can get a bunch of other folks through as well.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I talk to Elowen and ask if she can go find Pike in the morning, if she wants to go through, and all that kind of stuff.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'd be happy to, I--"

name: SAM
dialogue: You remember what Pike looks like?

name: MATT

dialogue: This is not a bad plan.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We have the means to bail us out very quickly if things go wrong.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: And if I may, in case any of your consciences are in conflict, the Herd is full of murderers and pillagers and rapists and child killers. The worst of the lot. And only when I was younger did I not know the difference between right and wrong. Still working on that definition. But I can tell you, this group ain't the best lot in the world, and they mean nothing to me compared to the people in this room.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Conversely, you were a part of that lot once. And you came out of it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Once. But are we trying to save a herd? Or are we trying to save a town?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I think we're trying to save the world at this point.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's bigger than a town, right?

name: LIAM
dialogue: By a bit.

name: LAURA
dialogue: A little.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Today we can save a town.

name: SAM
dialogue: You know, we're all gathered here together, so I'd like to take this opportunity with Wilhand's blessing to propose marriage to you, Pike Trickfoot. Will you make me the happiest gnome ever? I'm sorry, I couldn't contain myself any longer.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: That was so sudden!

name: SAM
dialogue: I know, I'm sorry, I've been thinking about it all night tonight, I went looking for Kaylie, she wasn't there, and then-- I'm sorry, I blurted it out, it's just, we're all together, we're never all together like this, so.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Can I roll stealth and hide right now? (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: Go ahead.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Can I roll stealth and hide right now?

name: MATT
dialogue: You can try to if you want to.

name: LIAM
dialogue: 28, I'm gone.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Scanlan, at least this could wait until after the danger's over.

name: SAM
dialogue: I know, I know, but we may die later tonight when we go see Zanror.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Only if we follow your example.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That was the most impressive segue I've ever encountered.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I was trying really hard here.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: That was a segue if I've ever heard one.

name: SAM
dialogue: You know what, don't answer now, don't answer now. I know that you want to say yes, but please, don't answer yet. Just think about it and we'll talk about it some other time.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I will definitely have to think about it. Because that's a lot--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We can work on some sort of concoction if you need help sleeping after that information, at this point. That would keep me up for hours. That's-- yeah.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Do we have any alore root? (laughter)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You ever want a vision quest, just let me know.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: You know what, I will think on it, and I will give you an answer after some dragons are killed and-- let me think on it, Scanlan. Let me think on it.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (whispers) I think that went well.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Do you mean, like, permanent marriage?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I think I was really start-- yeah.

name: SAM
dialogue: No no no, I'm sorry, that didn't, I didn't do that the way I had planned it in my head, I'm sorry.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: It's okay.

name: SAM
dialogue: I was overcome with a lot of stress, you know? We're fighting dragons and bonding with goliaths here and you're in my house, and it's a very very stressful night for me, I'm sorry.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That was the weirdest coping mechanism I've ever heard of.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, yeah. I'm sorry.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: It's okay, maybe you just feel that way because we could all die, so.

name: SAM
dialogue: For sure.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: You feel like you maybe-- I don't know.

name: SAM
dialogue: You know what, we'll table it. We'll table it.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: We'll table it.

name: SAM
dialogue: We'll table it.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Okay. Where is Wilhand?

name: SAM
dialogue: I think he's in the kitchen.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: He's probably made a delicious meal.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We should eat and then sleep.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys make your way to the kitchen?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, let's finish this conversation over food.

name: MATT
dialogue: There is a-- what did you have in mind?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm going back to my room, I'm not eating. Yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Wait, we need to finish this conversation.

name: MATT
dialogue: He's already gone, you don't know where he is. Vax disappeared in the confusion. You head back to the main dining area. There is a full meal prepared of very creative uses of chicken. (laughter)

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: It's all-- if he had more stuff, he could really do well.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't-- I don't think you're supposed to eat-- that's creative.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Every chicken dish ever.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'll have the soup.

name: MATT
dialogue: Wilhand is slumped in the corner on a stool with a bottle of wine that is mostly empty.

name: LIAM
dialogue: (old-man voice) Try the chicken sorbet!

name: MATT
dialogue: A bit of drool dribbling down his neck.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I take the bottle. He pulled it back! I let him have it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I go and whisper to Scanlan, are you all right?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, I'm fine. She didn't say no?

name: LAURA
dialogue: She didn't. I sort of meant about Kaylie as well, though.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, yes. I just don't know where she is, so it's a bit stressful. That's all. She's safe though, right? Just say yes.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes. Of course she is.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, I thought so.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I go and grab a shitload of chicken and start shoving it in my mouth.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Is Wilhand here?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: He's passed out.

name: MATT
dialogue: He's passed out in a corner with a bottle of white wine that's half-empty.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I go get a blanket and cover him.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I walk over and I slide the bottle of ale out of his hand.

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughs) Death grip on the bottle.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: All right. I leave the bottle of ale and I take the statue of Sarenrae and I put it in his other hand, tuck him up.

name: MATT
dialogue: Cuddles it up with the blanket around it, he's like this little bundle of old gnomish sleeping joy right now.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Oh, buddy.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Is Vax here?

name: MATT
dialogue: No.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Shit. I wanted to put like shaving cream in his hand and tickle his nose with a feather.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Although I feel like we still need to finish this conversation. Shouldn't we all be present?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What's left to finish?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Other than take a rest.

name: SAM
dialogue: We're going to try to convince them to delay. If they won't delay, then we say, all right, let's go fight, and we send them into battle.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And then we don't really fight.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Huh?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, we see how they do, and we try to rescue people.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Maybe it's time to split up. Maybe some of us help fight the dragons while others help evacuate.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No. I'm not separating from you when we go fight a giant fucking dragon.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I may run to try and quietly by myself grab a few things from the library that we may need for the next Vestiges.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You're going tonight?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Ah. Possibly in the morning.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'll go with you.

name: MATT
dialogue: You do recall based on your previous scrying spell--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It was ruined and most of it had been picked clean.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, all right then.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I mean, it doesn't mean that there's not something still potentially there, but I'm sure Allura got most of the good stuff. She's not stupid.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, that's fair.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We can still check it out.

name: MATT
dialogue: So what's the plan?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We go to sleep--

name: LIAM
dialogue: I don't have a plan, but while they're all dicking about, after about an hour of staring at the wall, I start talking to the air, and say: you know, I've never put much stock in faith. And for the life of me, I question so much why my sister took that broom and I can't figure out another reason for her to have done it, other than fate, for I would not be standing here, nor would anyone else in my family. So. You weren't my first choice, but I'm over that. And I'm ready. I will come to you as soon as I am able. I don't know how any of this works. I'm coming. Whatever we need to do. I don't know what I believe, but I made a promise and I'm sticking to it and I'm coming to you. So just hang on.

name: MATT
dialogue: Minutes of silence pass. No response. Nothing.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I go to bed.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. As you get to your bed, you look down and a single black feather is currently set on the pillow before you.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I tuck it behind my ear.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. The rest of you going to sleep for the evening?

name: ALL
dialogue: Yes.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: As we're walking to sleep, I grab Scanlan real quick. I grabbed Scanlan real quick once everybody's--

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: So, I have to tell you something.

name: SAM
dialogue: You don't have to answer now.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: It's not an answer for that.

name: SAM
dialogue: No, it's fine, I was, it was, I was impetuous and silly and I don't know sometimes, I get hamhanded around you-- I'm very smooth with everybody else, I don't know what it is.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: It's just that-- it's fine. It's okay. I have to confess something to you. When you gave me that letter--

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: When you told me not to read it until you died--

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I read it immediately after you left. Because curiosity gets the best of me sometimes, I can't-- it's not--

name: SAM
dialogue: But you can't, you're like a priest or something, you can't lie!

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I know, but that-- what does that even mean?

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't know, I--

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I go back and forth with it.

name: SAM
dialogue: There was personal stuff in there!

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I know, but what-- I know, it was very personal, and I just wanted to tell you that everything you said in that letter, I promise to you.

name: SAM
dialogue: You do?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: That I give you my word that everything you said in that letter I promise to you I will do.

name: SAM
dialogue: Really.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: If you die. (laughter) Which I am hoping that you never do.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, we've almost died a few times very recently.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I know, and we've had so many close calls and I feel like I just needed to tell you so you had some comfort in your person, in your body, that you knew that if--

name: SAM
dialogue: My body? What are you t-- you sound like me, you're stammering and babbling like I was!

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I know, you do make me a little nervous and I'm not really sure why, and I need to reconcile these feelings.

name: SAM
dialogue: We should just marry then!

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Well, I don't know!

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't know either! It's a very strange relationship.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I'm so confused. Maybe we should just sleep together and see what happens.

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay, fine. No, you said it! You said it!

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I'm just kidding, I'm just kidding, it was just a joke.

name: SAM
dialogue: You can't joke about that stuff with me!

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I know. I'm being careless, I think that drink that Wilhand gave me is settling, and it's-- moving about. Making me say things.

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't even know what's going on right now!

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I'm just kidding. I don't actually think we should sleep together. I just need to tell you that I--

name: SAM
dialogue: Thank you for clarifying?! (laughter)

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Anyway, Scanlan, I love you.

name: SAM
dialogue: This is not how I thought tonight was going to go! I feel betrayed, I feel let down, I feel so horny right now!

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Well, you've grown those forearms for a reason, so just go take care of business.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, come on, Pike!

name: LIAM
dialogue: That's some reincorporation right here.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Callback!

name: SAM
dialogue: Listen. Everything I said in that letter I meant. And regardless of whether or not you totally betrayed me by reading it, I'm glad that you at least understood the sentiment, I hope?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I did.

name: SAM
dialogue: And appreciated my honesty and the fact that you are taking that vow? If I die.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Yes, I am taking that vow.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, I understand. Well then, that's fine. That's all I need.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Okay. And I was trying to be funny and I didn't mean to be careless with your feelings.

name: SAM
dialogue: No, I know, I didn't know why I proposed, that's stupid.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I do love you so much.

name: SAM
dialogue: I love you!

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: And a part of my heart does-- I do love somebody else very much.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm sorry?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: But my feelings are growing for you a little bit in a weird way and I'm not sure what it is, but we'll figure it out. I'm confused.

name: SAM
dialogue: I think we both are? Anyway. Thank you for telling me the truth after you sort of lied to me, so--

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: But I never told you I did not read it!

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Which is-- what's your picture?

name: SAM
dialogue: It's just a mirror. (laughter) But, listen. I do love you, I will always love you, even in death, and thank you for telling me that and-- I hope it doesn't come to that, but if it does, that makes me feel a little bit better about things.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Okay. Well, I love you.

name: SAM
dialogue: Sleep tight.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I give him a hug and a kiss on his cheek.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

name: SAM
dialogue: I kick the dirt a little bit and then I walk away and I click my heels. Little jump-and-click.

name: MATT
dialogue: And-- anything else, before the evening's rest comes? All right. Sleep finds you all, some easier than others, until a measured period of time, I believe?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: Grog sprung awake, gathered the folks in the pre-dawn hour of the following morning. You gather your stuff, exit the mansion, and start making your way towards the Margrave's house.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Is there anyone on the street?

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a perception check.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: 19. Plus zero.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys exit Wilhand's place and there is a cross-street that Wilhand's home is nearby, that's like a building sandwiching it on each side, and the one just south of it is on the corner of that cross street. Across the way as you guys exit the room, or exit the front of the building, you see two figures stand up, arms crossed. The same individuals you saw earlier.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Of Wilhand's place?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Same people I saw outside of the house earlier. All right, fuck this shit. I turn and I walk towards those two people.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. You approach, you recognize them. They're the same two people that were watching you while you guys were resting directly after the battle with Kevdak in the center of the square, the two that were assigned to keep an eye on you.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Hello. What're your two names?

name: MATT
dialogue: They look at each other. "Veskin. Mortar. What do you want?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Funny, I feel like I've seen you about in the last few hours, watching us.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Keeping an eye out."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Huh. Why?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Because you killed our leader. Takes a while to see what strength is a man who's killed "your leader. If he's a murderer. If he's an honor-bound man. Or if he's a piece of shit that "you should wipe off your heels."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Hm.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Takes a bit of watching to get that. Jury's still out."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Don't you have a new leader now?

name: MATT
dialogue: They look at each other. "Maybe."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Would you like to walk with us? We're going for a little morning stroll.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Nothing else to do." And they wipe a little bit of sleep from one of the corner of the eye. "Lead on."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: And we head to the Margrave's house.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I put my old-school circlet back on, by the way, but I have the other circlet with me.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. So you've re-attuned to the original circlet. You guys, walking through the town as you do, there is a bit of business, there are, some of the street lanterns have been lit, where previously at this hour they would be greatly diminished, there is movement, you see some of the Herd that are now wandering forth, armoring up, gathering weapons, you know this. This is the morning before a siege. This is the pre-dawn meditation before the Herd takes its next-- yeah. Warpaint being applied, breakfasts being enjoyed, people preparing themselves for the frenzy of battle, this is the pre-war ritual of the Herd of Storms. As you make your way southward, across the once-battlefield, returned-town-square outside the Margrave's home, to the front doors, the door is open and you see there are two individuals sitting at the front. One of which is a goliath keeping watch, to the right of him on the other side is a gruff-looking female human, humanoid, sitting there, arms crossed, watching as you guys approach.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I make eye contact with both of them. I seek an audience with Zanror.

name: MATT
dialogue: "He's expecting you, get in."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We go in.

name: MATT
dialogue: So you guys walk into the house, you see the interior of the Margrave's abode. Across the way there is a haphazard throne that's been built from lumber and carts and things that were pulled from resources within the town. You can see this is probably where Kevdak sat once they had taken the home, the estate.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I grab my earpiece and very lightly say, Vax, keep your eyes about you.

name: MATT
dialogue: Are you all entering with Grog?

name: ALL
dialogue: Yeah, sure.

name: SAM
dialogue: Should we leave a couple outside or anything or no?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Nope, stay together.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. You guys all enter into the foyer area. The throne is across the way, there's a long hallway that leads to the back of the estate, and at the very back you can see the throne. There are some low sconces in the walls that give the flicker of light, in the center there is a round table which is currently set. There are some weapons and daggers, a few javelins tossed onto it, looks like some fruit that's partially eaten, and there on the table you see Zanror, already armored up, arms splayed across the side, looking down at the table, looking down at the weapons before him. Behind him, you see his wife, the lady, the other pregnant goliath that is currently behind rubbing his shoulders and talking to him into his ear. They both look up and see as you approach, at which point Zanror whispers to her for a second.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What does he say?

name: MATT
dialogue: He says, "We have company." They both sit back as he goes upright as you approach. "Glad to "see you had the sense to take my summons. So. Now's the day where we prepare."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Aye, wouldn't miss it for the world.

name: MATT
dialogue: (sighs) "First and foremost, Grog, take that shit off. It's really freaking out most of our people."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It is pretty sweet, though, isn't it?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's confusing, to say the least, aye?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We all have our preparations to make before battle. Don't worry about mine.

name: MATT
dialogue: "To each their own, I suppose. Heh. You've fallen in some strange paths since we last met."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You have no idea.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Rest of you, can we expect your attendance in this glorious fight?"

name: LIAM
dialogue: Wherever Grog goes, we go as well.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Good. Good."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I suppose we could ask the same of your Herd, Leader Zanror.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We're prepared now. And we've met around with the remaining Herd, we've spread the tale of "Kevdak's fall. Demanded solidarity under my arms and yours. And our plan to show our strength and "independence from his reign by cutting down the black dragon of Gatshadow. Many are easily swayed "by words of bloodshed and glory. Others, the hesitation in their eyes worries me. Now "Greenbeard had set us down a path of ruin, coming here. We conquer and move as a people. This "life without roaming, lording over a broken city, living under the thumb of a drake? This is not our "life. Since Greenbeard's age and selfishness had caught up to him, Kevdak's lust for the fear of "others swayed his judgment into more self-indulgent territory. And while we all quelled "rebellion, gathered gold and goods, while I parlayed with that beast, my uncle stayed in "here." Points back at the throne behind him. "Taking his drink and his women, breaking those "who could not defend themselves out of idle boredom. I could see it. Regret. He'd listened to "the old man and led us into ruin, but the only thing stronger than Kevdak's might was his pride. "So we stayed. He could not admit he was wrong. He abandoned reason and foresight. And I questioned "him, our actions here in the city. Our future. He beat me and threw me into chains. So learning from "the mistakes, here. When this dragon is done, we leave. We have no place in this city."

name: LAURA
dialogue: You speak of pride, of listening to reason. Might be smart to listen to reason in this instance as well. That dragon is ancient and very large. It's quite possible he'll wipe out all of us, the town included. It might be smart to swallow our pride for the day and prepare. Come back when we have preparations made and we can take the dragon down.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Please understand, the dragon has claimed quite the tithe from our people. We've provided "what we can, what we could scavenge, but even then the coffers of this town that we could acquire are "growing thin. The reason that we were preparing for this attack even before you arrived is because "we were at the end of our rope. Many of the people made away from this town with their goods before "we came, and many still have escaped our grasp when we took over. So the paltry sums that we "could gather in the time that we did hold reign over Westruun-- the dragon is not going to be "happy that each package dwindles with each passing couple of days. Either we take this element of "surprise and fight it on our own terms, or we wait for it to come to us angry, on its. And if we "leave now, the Herd may survive. But I haven't heard of a dragon that when crossed lets that "vengeance fly. And I'll be honest with you, we leave a trail behind us, as you know."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That I do. It is a wide wake, my friend.

name: MATT
dialogue: At this point, the door slams open behind you guys. You see a muscular man walks in, skin sun-scarred and calloused, his long, black hair clustered in wild, unkempt clumps. A wild elf, Tress, who accompanied you to the square naught but earlier the day before walks in behind him. "Ivon, your timing is good. We speak on." At which point this man steps forward to the table, pushing you guys aside and looking directly at Zanror. "We do not recognize you, Zanror. Kevdak was the "Thunderlord who conquered the River Maw, and now he's dead. You take his title unearned and intend "to lead us into suicide against a dragon that even Kevdak feared. We will not stand for this. The "River Maw are picking up and leaving. Now. We return to our fens, to lead our people. You can "all die for your own reasons." Zanror leans forward, very serious, a grave look on his face. "Are you saying you're abandoning the Herd?" At which point you can see there's tension in his muscles, and you can see Tress currently reaching back for a weapon and Ivon, not breaking a sweat, leans into his face, square chiseled jaw going, "Yeah. I guess that's what I'm saying. Herd of "Storms is no more if you're going to lead us into death. We'd rather live on. Back to the lives we "had before you came in and mucked it up." "Close the doors!" Zanror says, and the door shuts behind.

name: SAM
dialogue: Shit.

name: MATT
dialogue: Zanror looks to you. "What do you say, Grog Strongjaw, slayer of Kevdak, he who raises might "against the dragon?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Thunderlord, we back your play.

name: MATT
dialogue: "The rest of you, those who travel this world afar, outside of our people, where does your "allegiance lie?"

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, certainly not with the cowards who're abandoning you in the face of a tough fight.

name: MATT
dialogue: Ivon turns to you now, eyes red with fury. "Who're you calling a coward, little man?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Watch where you turn your gaze. It may be the last movement your head makes attached to your body.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make an intimidation check.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh, that's not good. Ten.

name: MATT
dialogue: Ten.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm dead.

name: MATT
dialogue: He's still staring at Scanlan. (spits) Spits right in your face.

name: SAM
dialogue: That's not very nice.

name: MATT
dialogue: "No. It's not. Neither is calling me a coward."

name: SAM
