dialogue: Three hours ago, back when we were still together, I pulled Scanlan aside. Listen, I want to talk to you. I have an idea.

name: SAM
dialogue: Is this about Kaylie? Because I'm still worried about her. But I don't think that we should discuss her right now. We have other things! Why are you harping on this? She's my daughter. (laughter) Just give it a rest.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You're right, I should have never dragged you down into the sewers, and I apologize. It won't happen again. But listen to me. I have an idea. It's a dangerous idea, and I don't want to lead with it. I don't want to fight this dragon, to be honest, but I think the group is going that direction. If we do-- Percival's run off to try something, maybe we're just going to run out. I have an idea that only you can do.

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We have a rod.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Not the cube. A rod that cannot be moved.

name: SAM
dialogue: We could use it in some way.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You can teleport, and I'm almost too afraid to even suggest it, but if shit goes south, how would you feel about teleporting inside of Umbrasyl's stomach? With that rod.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, what has he eaten? Because it could be nasty in there!

name: LIAM
dialogue: I assume it will. I don't know anatomy. I haven't talked to my sister about this. She might be able to give us input, and I don't want to lead with this. I don't want you to do it because I feel like you could melt in there.

name: SAM
dialogue: Of course I could melt in there! I'm a little man and he's got acid on him!

name: LIAM
dialogue: I know. I'm looking for a way through this fucking clusterfuck and if there's nothing else to do, you could go in there and click that rod and give him the worst suppository ever invented!

name: SAM
dialogue: Listen. If there's a man invented who can go to where shit is made and make some really good shit, that's me. So let's pursue this. As a plan B.

name: LIAM
dialogue: As a plan B. And I take him by the shoulders. You remember that little talk we had about a week ago, when you told--

name: SAM
dialogue: Is this about Kaylie again?

name: LIAM
dialogue: No, we can talk about Kaylie in a couple of days, all right?

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay.

name: LIAM
dialogue: When you told me how things were better now? Okay, you remember that?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes.

name: LIAM
dialogue: That was fucking insane. They are not better. Everything is terrible! Our lives are terrible. They are way worse than they were six months ago, way worse. I was with all of you assholes a year ago, and two years ago, they're way worse.

name: SAM
dialogue: You're saying that, a sullen loner who is confiding in one of his closest friends while holding him on the shoulders. This you never had before.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I slap him on the cheek a little bit and say: you are a fucking madman, but I am glad you're here.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm glad to be with you.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And I love you. And I give him a playful slap across the face.

name: SAM
dialogue: Six points of damage. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: Unexpected, sneak attack. 7d6 points of damage.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right, so I'm going to go talk to Vex. An expert in dragons I hope?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm an expert on dragons.

name: SAM
dialogue: And ask her how dragons work, how their bodies work.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What do you mean?

name: SAM
dialogue: Where they're vulnerable, where they make the acid, where they have lungs, where they have stomachs, how many stomachs? Are they like a cow with eight stomachs or something?

name: MATT
dialogue: Go ahead and make an intelligence check with advantage.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Cows have eight stomachs?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: They've got like two or three.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Shut up! 17.

name: MATT
dialogue: 17. Yeah, dragons have the pieces you imagine they would have in the right vicinity. Their stomach is quite acidic, as it has been known to dissolve some of the hardiest of creatures, let alone break down some basic minerals and materials. So it's not a happy place to be, but it's not like instantaneous dissolution. It will hurt. Also know that the breath weapon, the acid that a black dragon, which uses acid as a breath weapon in a stream in front of it, much like your lightning bolt, does not come from its stomach. That acid is much more toxic, concentrated, and comes from a separate part of its body, a gland, a breathing mechanism that projects it outward.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Where's the gland located? Would I know that, like, in his throat?

name: MATT
dialogue: It's somewhere in this vicinity, you're not entirely certain.

name: SAM
dialogue: So if I miss, end up in that gland, that would be not good.

name: MATT
dialogue: That would be really bad.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Don't roll a one!

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: But that would probably be really hard to just get right into that spot.

name: LIAM
dialogue: But you know, you wouldn't suffer.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It would be instantaneous, at least.

name: SAM
dialogue: Also. Vex. Vex'ahlia.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh. Getting fancy now, Scanlan Shorthalt.

name: SAM
dialogue: Thank you. Your brother tells me that you have some sort of acid-resistant something.

name: LAURA
dialogue: The armor? That I took from him?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes, my armor. She has it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well-- are you here? Are you next-- are you next to me now?

name: LIAM
dialogue: No, I'm about five feet behind you rolling my eyes and doing this the whole time you're talking about dragons.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's the armor that I won fair and square from him! Yes, I am wearing it right now.

name: SAM
dialogue: Is that your primary armor?

name: LAURA
dialogue: It is.

name: SAM
dialogue: How would you feel about me asking you to take it off? Doing a little unbuckling and giving it to me instead?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Scanlan, that's going to cost you a lot of money.

name: SAM
dialogue: We could swap armor.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You think your little armor will fit me.

name: SAM
dialogue: I have a pretty broad chest. These are pecs.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What kind of armor do you have?

name: SAM
dialogue: I have cold snap leather armor.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Which is cold resistant?

name: SAM
dialogue: Cold resistant. Maybe the dragon will throw snowballs at you.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I doubt that. What is it, is it plus two?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah.

name: SAM
dialogue: Plus two on top of the armor, so it's four.

name: MATT
dialogue: So it's armor plus two.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's better overall.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay. Well sweet, then yeah, sure, give it to me.

name: SAM
dialogue: Can we do that?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Strip on down there, Scanlan.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, ladies first!

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, you first, I want to see the cube and then I'll give you my armor.

name: SAM
dialogue: Shall we make it interesting and play a little poker?

name: LAURA
dialogue: There's no time for that.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right. I very slowly and sultrily unbuckle my armor, let one strap fall, let the other strap fall, just do a little shimmy and let it fall to the ground, sort of like The Crying Game. Just sort of, camera pans up a little bit and it's just, there's nothing underneath, it's just me and the cube. And I cry a little. (laughter)

name: LIAM
dialogue: During which I pick up Scanlan's shawm and start playing it terribly. No idea what I'm doing. Do you blow into this, are there strings? I don't know.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I try really hard not to start laughing.

name: SAM
dialogue: Go with what your body tells you to do. How are you going to take off your armor?

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's a good question. Do you want to walk away for this?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, I leave the room.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I completely ungracefully take it off and throw it at you. Give me that armor. How is this going to fit me? I'm just naked trying to squirm into these extra-skinny jeans.

name: MATT
dialogue: Actually, as you pull the armor pieces up, they shift and formfit to your size as part of their enchantment.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What color is it? Is it beautiful?

name: MATT
dialogue: The cold snap armor is I believe dark browns with traces of white and silver along the edges as a cold winter motif as part of the enchantment.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Does it match my storm bow?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, I guess you could say that.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You might not be getting this back, Scanlan.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, really? Well. What does mine look like?

name: MATT
dialogue: For a moment, it looks pretty haphazard and hanging off of you.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, these are like C-cups up here. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: As the armor slowly retracts and finds itself to your form.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh! They went down.

name: MATT
dialogue: In that moment, Scanlan learned a lot about himself.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right. I feel good about this. Now we'll continue our dragon lesson I suppose.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Wait, why did you need to change-- are you going to be up close and personal with him?

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, I think we all are, you know. He breathes acid.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well yes, but.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, so we could get hit! Now I'm more protected than you are!

name: LAURA
dialogue: This was a really stupid-- why did I give that up?

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm very charming.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Now you're not here?

name: LIAM
dialogue: You told me to leave! You took off your clothes. I'm Liam, I'm not Vax, what're you talking about?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Are you planning on doing something?

name: SAM
dialogue: We're all planning on doing something, and I don't think that my part of the plan is any stupider than yours will be. So. Good luck to you. I'll keep your armor safe. Hopefully we can trade back. And if not, you can peel it off my dead body.

name: LAURA
dialogue: As long as you're not melted from all the acid.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I'd like to attune to my frostbrand sword.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, so you'll be putting aside the mace of disruption and taking on the frostband instead. Okay. Cool.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Oh, shit, I go running after Percival. I'm going to go find Percival.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah. Well. Does that take an hour, or do I catch up with him pretty quick?

name: MATT
dialogue: You would know the direction he went, and thankfully in the awkward still-quiet that is the center of the town now that it's missing most of its populace, and those that are there are acknowledging the tension of what might be coming, and many of them are now packing up and leaving and getting out of the town, evacuating when they've been notified of the possible coming battle. The sound of metal clangs in the distance, and the gathering of materials from some of the rubble is not too difficult to discern over time. Takes you about half an hour or so to locate him.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Oh, there's that white hair. Percival!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes? Hello. Bit busy. What?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, I'm sorry, I don't want to take up a lot of your time. I reckon you're going to be busy with this all day, yeah?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh yes. This is quite a project.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Ah, and also tomorrow. You're probably going to be taking potshots at that thing, yeah?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Ah, that's my hope is to be, honestly, as far away from this as humanly possible.

name: LIAM
dialogue: That's probably not my plan. Can I have use of your blade?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh! The dragonslayer longsword, yes, of course, of course. I pull it off my belt and hand it off. Could help. I'm a little terrified that you're getting that close to it, but here it is.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's just in case.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's quite a piece.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Good luck today.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Thank you.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Good luck tomorrow.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I am down to my normal sword now.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can I be talking to Zanror?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'll join you in that. That was my next plan.

name: MATT
dialogue: The two of you eventually find Zanror. Zanror and Warra are in the process of piling weapons and armor with the rest of the Herd into the center of the town where the battle outside of the Margrave's house happened. Most of the warriors there are in the process of steeling themselves, some of them are gathering their materials, some are in the process of doing some minor ritualistic scarring in preparation for the battle. There is very little conversation happening. It seems like there is this quiet understanding that this, for many, might be their last day. They're making peace with the coming glory of battle. You'd expect this sense of tense fear, this very Battle of Helm's Deep-type acceptance of doom, but this is a different personality amongst the Herd here. There is almost a brimming excitement with the idea of possible glory or at least a glorious end. And it very much befits the story that you've heard of Grog's past history, and very easy to see where he once came from.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I bring Zanror a big tankard of ale and sit down in front of him. MATT "Oh, good to see you."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I stand behind Vex'ahlia.

name: MATT
dialogue: "This for me?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: Looks to Worra.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Don't worry, we wouldn't try to poison you the night before a dragon-fight.

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughs) "That would be rather stupid, wouldn't it?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It would.

name: MATT
dialogue: And he just downs it all in one big chug. "Thanks."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Zanror? Did I hear you correctly before, that you have been the one speaking with the beast in the past?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I have, aye."

name: LAURA
dialogue: So when it comes and gathers its treasure, it stops and talks, or does it just come and take it and leave?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It has at times. More at the beginning. If it had questions and seemed curious. That wore off "after the first few times. Now it just seems to come and take and find its way out."

name: LAURA
dialogue: So if the treasure looked different this time, it might stop and talk about it?

name: MATT
dialogue: He stops for a second. "Maybe."

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm curious because I know you said you are lacking in gold and treasure. What will entice the beast?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Hm. Beyond that, I don't really know. That's what is forcing our hand right now."

name: LAURA
dialogue: What if we had a way of providing some gold? And maybe you provide an offering of a different kind? What if you say that your father Kevdak had been plotting against the dragon and you found out about it. Would you be able to offer his body and the body of his allies as tribute to the dragon?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Huh."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Dragons are vain.

name: MATT
dialogue: And you do know specifically white dragons, or sorry, black dragons, they're very cruel by nature. They actually enjoy messing with creatures they see below them, especially intended prey, torturing for extended periods of time before killing. They aren't comparatively as vain as other dragons per se, but all chromatics fall in some way shape or form on that same scale of self-love to the point of being a near-disease to many of them. Zanror thinks to himself for a second and goes, "We can certainly try. I mean, I've got no more use for it, though it's going to "be hard to convince it without a head. I'm pretty sure Grog took that with him."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, we may be able to get that back. How are you planning on hiding your fellow warriors from the dragon so as not to attract its attention? Because we may have some ideas.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We'll have to share ideas. Ours was to go ahead and plod up Gatshadow. Usually it's about "noon when it comes down for the offering. We leave it what little we have left, possibly lose two "men in the process of delivering it, and then when it returned to its place we'd be there waiting to "ambush it once it returned, use that time when it was gone to go ahead and hole up inside its home."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That was our intent."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We might be able to do one better.

name: LAURA
dialogue: A dragon's lair is not--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Especially a black dragon's lair.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We wouldn't do much damage to it there, in fact, it's probably laid several traps against us already.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, there's not much we can really do when we're all fighting with our fucking axes and "swords, can we? In the lair at least it's stuck on the ground."

name: LAURA
dialogue: What if we could trap it onto the ground here?

name: MATT
dialogue: "How do you intend to do that?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: We have a wonderful tinkerer. Quite talented. And he's creating something to trap the dragon.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Really."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Plus we can provide several chains. Once it's on the ground, maybe your very strong goliaths could try to snare it, grappling-hook it, throw some chains up and over?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: This pile of weapons you have here, I see a decent amount of javelins. A rudimentary harpoon, in the hands of some of your strongest, could help wrangle him down.

name: MATT
dialogue: He stops for a second and goes, "I just want to be clear we don't underestimate the sheer size, "strength, and ferocity of this beast. With all 20 men, we might be able to hold it down, I don't "know how long. I hope that contraption your friend is making is strong enough to aid us that last "little bit, because I get the feeling that if our might is put to just keeping it on the ground-- "well, that's a lot less of our strengths that we could be tending to. A lot less blades we could "put into its hide."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, hopefully it would only be needed for a small amount of time before our magic users have their way with it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: About that time I light up my hands.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That's impressive. You know what else is impressive? Watching four of my friends melt in a "matter of seconds."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That is very impressive. You're not wrong.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I just want to instill with you an understanding not to be brash, not to go ahead and "run into this unless you're absolutely certain. Now. I've got chains, you've got chains. We've got "strong men. If we put ourselves intent on just holding this beast down, I have the feeling, even "with our weight behind it, it's going to be a difficult attempt. Do we have any other way of "anchoring it down, something else we can put the chains to?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: About that time I walk over to the-- is there a stone wall in here?

name: MATT
dialogue: I mean, there are pieces of stone building in the vicinity.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I put my hand against the stone and I cast Transmute Rock and I push my hand into the stone as it turns to mud.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And now turn it back, Keyleth.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I take a spear that's on the floor, stick it in, and then turn it back.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. Let me look this up real fast.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: See? Magic. (laughter) Put my hand underneath the spear. Put my hand over the spear.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Ah? Ah? No strings!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Where is it, where is it?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, mud to rock, yeah. Lasts for-- it's instantaneous. So when he looks at that, he goes, "So. What you're saying is if we can find a few places in which the rock is close to the surface, "you could lock these chains in?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I think I could lock the whole dragon in.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Once it's on the ground, if we can pull it down enough, she may be able to lock its legs into the stone.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Beyond that, if that fails-- And then I cast, for right now I'll just do Wall of Stone, I'm just burning through all my spells as a demonstration. And I bring up two pillows. Two pillows?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: And then we all lay down and go to sleep!

name: SAM
dialogue: Pillow fight! (laughter)

name: LIAM
dialogue: Billy Mays here for the Ashari Tribe!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Goose down. Unexpected tactic."

name: LAURA
dialogue: I like how we're walking through all of these ideas and none of it's going to work when we get there.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I blast up two pillars, right next to Kevdak.

name: MATT
dialogue: Not next to Kevdak. You mean Zanror?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Sorry, sorry. Sorry, the other big goliath leader.

name: SAM
dialogue: Whatever your name is.

name: MATT
dialogue: That one, ohmygod.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And trap him in.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, you (rumbles). Warra's pushed to the side as the stone shoots up.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (whispers) Sorry, Warra, sorry. So-- I know! Did not mean to lay a hand.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right, your point is made. We've got two others who can do similar magic as you, maybe "not the same level, but--"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Fantastic.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Want us to put them at your aid?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That would be wonderful. Beyond that, in prep, I can dig a trench, hidden underground around our trap, so that whenever we're ready, your army can bust out of the ground.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Surprise.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Without being seen.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Without being seen, what, are we going to bury my men?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Very lightly.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Pretty much. To be fair, I actually did it on a trap to kill like eight of your men on the way in and it worked phenomenally. So you should trust me.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It was pretty great.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It worked well.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I think we'll take our chances above ground, please."

name: LAURA
dialogue: The only thing I'm worried about, Zanror, is that if this ugly beast flies in and sees, oh, how many of your men do you have?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Currently we're sitting at 25 total, including myself."

name: LAURA
dialogue: 25 men standing around. Don't you think it's going to be a little curious as to why all of the sudden-- all of a sudden? There's a large number of people around, that's never been there before?

name: MATT
dialogue: "You're asking me this, our plan was to go inside while it was out. But if you want us there, "let's figure out a way to hide, then. I don't think my men are going to like to be "underground."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It'll be very spacious. It'll be a nice big tunnel, it's not going to feel like you're buried alive.

name: MATT
dialogue: "And what, they just leap out one by one through an opening?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: It'll be super shallow. Just enough that they can come on up and out.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It'll be awesome, it will look like they're coming out of the grave. They'll look like badasses!

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't think that's going to really get a dragon shaking in its claws, y'know?" (sighs)

name: LAURA
dialogue: Not a lot is going to get a dragon shaking in its claws.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Let me talk to my men. We'll see what we can do, we can muster as far as these chains go."

name: LAURA
dialogue: A surprise attack is going to be one of our best shots at grounding this thing.

name: MATT
dialogue: "So, am I to tell my men we're going to bury them in the ground?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Not bury them, that sounds so dramatic when you say it like that, I mean I'm going to make a tunnel, there'll be stairs, they'll be able to walk freely, they'll have air holes, it'll be just like when you moved through the sewers to not be seen.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'll talk to them. I certainly hope your magic stone-shaping is as strong as it is. At the "very first moment that dragon looks like it's going to go ahead and break free, we're weapons "out. You do understand that."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We would appreciate that, actually.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Okay."

name: LAURA
dialogue: We want it to land, then we strike. We just want it to hit the fucking ground.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Okay. And what's our bait? You say you have some gold to give?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Some gold to give.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Try for Kevdak's corpse-- I hope that's enough. I'll see what else we've got left in our "coffers." He turns around and him and Warra walk away, a couple of the men join them and they--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, I actually-- I go over to Warra real quick before she walks away? Just to her side, and say, you look well. Have the Seers told you if it's going to be a boy or a girl yet?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Not yet. But if we survive this, I have a feeling I'll know. The strength and glory of this "fight will confirm."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: If you survive this fight, I'm pretty sure you'll bear the strongest child anyone has ever known.

name: LAURA
dialogue: The stallion that mounts the world, for sure.

name: LIAM
dialogue: There it is, there it is. It's in all our heads.

name: MATT
dialogue: Nothing ever goes wrong when that title comes up. (laughter) What could possibly go wrong? She looks over her shoulder at Zanror as he's walking away and goes, "Could be." And she just turns and starts walking with him.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So we really need to dig a trench.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah. I'm going to start digging a trench.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Around the area that the treasure is going to be.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: How far is it?

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys scope it out, it's northwest of the town, you saw it on the way in, and it's very easy to make out at this point because there have been large claw-marks in the ground, there are broken pieces of wood, there's a shattered cart, there's some barrels that are partially destroyed to the side, there's a little bit of leftover ends and pieces that fell out of whatever it picked up as it took off as well as a smattering of copper, silver, and gold pieces that you rummaged through before when you first came to the town. But there's a definitive place that you recognize where this drop point is, it's out in the open in the field, there's going to be a couple of nearby rocks, a handful of trees, but they're all very sparse and spread apart. Other than that, it's just open field, so.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: How far away is the nearest tree cluster?

name: MATT
dialogue: To that, it's about-- tree cluster? I mean, most of the trees that are here are singular, there's two trees that are within ten feet of each other and that's maybe 80 feet away from it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay.

name: LAURA
dialogue: When you dig the trench, can I use my perception and my ranger ability to camouflage things and make sure that from above the ground, from the height that the dragon will be looking at it, that it's not seeable at all? I don't want this trap to be seen-- I guess I should wait until we find out if Percy finishes his trap and gets it in place to do all of this.

name: MATT
dialogue: You can do that if you'd like to. Yeah, as far as the camouflage ability--

name: LAURA
dialogue: I know Hide in Plain Sight is for myself, but I feel like as a ranger I'd be able to hide tracks and stuff.

name: MATT
dialogue: I'll say we can certainly give you--

name: LAURA
dialogue: We can use a little Dust of Tracelessness or something?

name: MATT
dialogue: We can make something function a little bit there, you know, illusion magic is also helpful. If you have anything illusion-based that could even just help tidy up before. You do know that dragons are very perceptive creatures and are very-- are not very trusting either. They're paranoid. That is part of their narcissism, so anything you can use, whether it be illusion, camouflage, anything to hide any sort of possible chance of it not trusting this scenario you're going to want to do, otherwise this thing might fly overhead and notice one thing and be like ah, peace! So. Be warned. Miss Dragon Specialist.

name: LIAM
dialogue: That was all knowledge in your head.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I know all of these things! All of a sudden!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Did he just say dragons have really high perception so don't fuck with anything and make it look weird?

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, he said if we're going to do it, make sure it is hidden.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Right. Make it look real good. Right.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Can I go up to some of the guards outside and say, oi. Where do you keep your prisoners, hostages, meat shields?

name: MATT
dialogue: I mean, there are no real guards of Westruun anymore, most of the guards that--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I meant like the goliath, the Herd guards.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, the Herd guards. They're a little sparse right now, there aren't any towards the outside of town, most of them are gathering towards the center as the rest of the folks are leaving the town, finding their way out south of Westruun to be away from the battle. But you do find in the Margrave center, similar area to where they were talking to Zanror, there are gathering warriors that are getting their weapons ready, some of them armoring up to just see how easily they can get it on, some of them might even sleep in their armaments, it's not a huge thing. But as you approach and ask this question, one of them turns to you and goes, "Well, there's-- the Iron "Stocks is where we generally keep our prisoners. The ones who were before and the few we did keep, "well, those we chained up or executed, but there were a few that were thrown in there."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are there any still in there? Or are they all clear?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh, there's plenty of prisoners still in there, we didn't touch the prison, mostly."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Hm. All right, thank you. (whispers) What was Reginald's daughter's name?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I don't know if I wrote it down.

name: SAM
dialogue: I wrote it down.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'd like to make my way over to the Iron Stocks.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. And you've been here before, you know the Iron Stocks, although you weren't sure if it was being used as still a prison. And seemed loosely, just throwing a handful of people in for use later on that never quite came to fruition.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I don't know her name either. We might not have known a name.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I thought we knew her name. Reginald's daughter's name?

name: MATT
dialogue: Do you remember her name?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are you asking me?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What Sam wrote, he just wrote down 'Reginald's daughter'.

name: SAM
dialogue: Maybe he never told us her name.

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughs) All right, you make your way to the Iron Stocks. And it is currently unguarded, there is nobody there, the Herd has lost interest in it, the door's partially ajar, and as you walk inside you can already smell the place just reeks of refuse and decay. It looks like everything left in the middle of a workday. There are still ledgers open on the front desk, you can see what looks to be a small group of-- a barracks-type scenario to the left of the entrance that is just completely abandoned and looks like some cases are left open, scattering various keepsakes and bottles that are shattered on the ground, a lot of people left either to go into battle to defend against the dragon, to lose their life in it, or just to get the hell out of Dodge.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Can I walk up to the ledger and pretend to read it?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. You pick it up and leaf through for a few pages, lotta great squiggles.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yep.

name: MATT
dialogue: Some pretty handwriting, you can tell--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Any squiggles that look familiar?

name: MATT
dialogue: Um, no. No, none that-- I mean, some look familiar, some are more rounded--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh, this poor bastard right here, yep, I remember him, good chap. Hello? Is anyone in here?

name: MATT
dialogue: There's a slight pause. Then you hear a voice echo from the right side of the room, down a hall just through the stone, you can barely make it out because the distance it's at, because you're hearing the echo protrude from quite a distance, but a voice just says, "Hey! Hey! In "here! Need food please!"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh, shit. So I go in that direction. Open the door and try and make my way that way.

name: MATT
dialogue: You charge down the hallway and there are a number of cells that are immediately here. Some of them are open and abandoned entirely, there are a few that you look off to the side, looks like a few individuals just passed away inside the cell. You come to a set of stairs that leads down into the next subterranean region and you hear the voice again, much closer, be like, "Hey! Hey! I "hear your footsteps!" And you see a hand reaching out from behind some of the bars.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Put your hand back inside.

name: MATT
dialogue: The hand retracts as you look over.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's a good lad. What's your name? Before I approach. Still far enough away.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Ah. Orn. Orn Finch at your service. Been in here far too long and very thirsty. I will be "happily at your service, fair muscled man, should you see fit to relinquish me from these binds." And you look at him, he looks like a lowly beggar, longish tattered hair, wearing just general tattered and soiled clothing, no shoes, feet look blistered and black.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Ugh. I'm going to call you Orn Blackfoot.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Blackfoot it is, Orn Blackfoot at your service, if you could just--"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: My name is Lord Grog.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Lord. It is my pleasure." And he reaches through and grasps your hand, his fingers are bony and thin, and he takes it and shakes it with what little strength he has.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Man, you are looking a little rispy-- Pour out a little ale into a goblet, and I give him a goblet of ale.

name: MATT
dialogue: He snatches it from you and slurps into it, extremely thirsty.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Ah-ah, not too fast, not too fast, don't want to get the bubbles. And I reach into the Bag of Holding and I have a dry food ration. I have three left. Now I have two. And I give him some dried food ration.

name: MATT
dialogue: He takes it and eagerly starts jamming it into his mouth. As he's eating, he's not even talking at you, this is just sheer hunger, the need to survive has taken over and he's just cramming it in there, choking a couple of times, keeping himself okay.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Pace yourself, lad. Tell me, why are you in here, Orn Blackfoot?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Ah, well, this is-- everyone just started yelling and they abandoned us all here. It's been "terrible hearing the moans and screams going silent. I thought they abandoned us all."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, they did, to be clear. They totally abandoned you. You are really the only person I know of that's in here. All the other mates around you, they're either sleeping or, you know.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I appreciate the food and drink, you've certainly done--" At which point a voice comes from about two cells over behind you that goes-- "Did I hear food and drink?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Fuck.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Food-- food and drink, please. Please."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Orn, did you kill all those dried food rations just now, did you just--

name: MATT
dialogue: You see him very discreetly pocket some in his robe. "Oh, everything you gave me is gone, I'm "sorry, friend."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Man, what an appetite. Do you mind regurgitating a little like a momma bird into my hand?

name: MATT
dialogue: "What?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Never mind. Orn, don't, heh, don't move. And I walk over to see where the other voice is coming from.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. As you turn around the way, there is the next set of bars, you see behind there a man in his forties, also extremely thin and gaunt, reddish long thin beard, long unkempt brownish red hair that is just crimped up around the base of it, like it's just gone almost into dreadlock territory from how long he's been in there and mistreated. You can see dried blood at the corner of his mouth. He looks up at you. "Sir, if you would be s-- Grog?" And the moment of recognition hits you, this is Abjurist Noja, whom you previously-- (yelling)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Abjurist is a very powerful-- he has knowledge of the arcane and stuff, right, he was--

name: LAURA
dialogue: He was the guy who saved us! He saved us when the white dragon came to Westruun.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I was frozen in ice. That guy!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I found us Boba Fett, sweet!

name: MATT
dialogue: He looks pretty wrecked right now.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh shit, give him food, Grog!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Abjurist Nosebleed, hold on real quick, look. And I take the other, the second to last dry food ration, I give him that, and I give him a thing of ale, I'm like, I'm sorry, it's really dry.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Thank you, friend, thank you very much."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh, yeah, you're very welcome! Hold on. Is there anybody else in this hallway before I give away my last bit of food?

name: MATT
dialogue: You hear two voices simultaneously down the end of the hallway come in, one of which is a very weak female voice, the other is a very loud kind of-- "Hey, bring me food this way, please!" The other one is like, "Please, I ask of you, I'm starving." And you see these two hands come out of the two cells in the distance.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Right, I'm going to pick a number between one and ten. Ready? Go.

name: MATT
dialogue: There's an awkward pause. "Three?" "Seven! Definitely seven!"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I lean over to Abjurist Noja, I say, I actually don't know any numbers, so. Y'know what, we're going to deliberate and we'll be with you in just a moment. (whispers) Abjurist, how old y--, why are you in here, who put you in here?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I've only been in here for about a week. Got in an altercation in my store when these "brutes started walking in. Threw me in here, didn't even let me take my spellbook."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh, that is a crime. I love b-- I can't even say it. Hold on, stay right there, I'll get you out-- And I walk back to Orn Blackfoot, I go, look, hey, so I gave you food, can you do anything, like, special?

name: MATT
dialogue: "What?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Like, can you make your hands turn to flame, can you disappear, are you really good with a bow and arrow?

name: MATT
dialogue: "No! No." And he reaches out and grabbing at your clothes though and starts pulling you--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Hey! Orn, chill!

name: MATT
dialogue: "But I have friends in many places, though. I can, I can get you things. I can make "connections--"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, but most of the people in here are dead, right, like they're probably not--

name: MATT
dialogue: "Not even here, Emon! I can get you anything you need from Emon. I can get you from Stillben. "And Lansway, just name it and get me out of here and I can--"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: How long has it been since you've been to Emon?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Few months?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You got any loved ones there?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Why?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I don't know, just asking, like, do you want me to take a note from you to them or something, you know.

name: MATT
dialogue: "No, if you can release me, I'd be more than happy to take it myself if you don't mind."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, no, I'm still deliberating, sorry. Enjoy the food that you snuck in your jacket pocket. And I go back towards the front desk area. And I try and find any-- is there a lever on the wall to release the cells or can I look for keys?

name: MATT
dialogue: You-- make an investigation check.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Fuck me.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yes.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Your fate is in excellent hands. Oh shit, you're not dead! (laughter) Minus two for a 17!

name: MATT
dialogue: Ah! All righty. So. After spending the good part of an hour or so clamoring through, just throwing bookshelves over and (crashing) taking the desk and actually throwing it onto its back and pulling drawers out, this is Grog's method of investigation here, you're just--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, just trying some splinters of wood in the locks just in case.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, yeah. You break off a few forks in some locks.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (laughs) Forks, yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: In practice, yeah, whatever looks small enough and should fit, though it doesn't, but you make it fit. And it doesn't help. You do eventually find in one of the cells, closed and locked as you look by, there is one person in guard armor, in Westruun guard armor, that is in the cell. Not moving.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Hey. Hey, you. I kick him in the back a bit.

name: MATT
dialogue: No movement.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I kick him harder.

name: MATT
dialogue: No movement.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I look down the hallway. I back up a few steps. And I really run up and kick him really hard.

name: MATT
dialogue: He just lurches over onto the side. Not moving.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, you're dead. Can I pat him down?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, you reach in and you can smell the decay starting to set in. And as you get close you can reach through the bars and see him, the actual area is closed and the door appears to be locked, and inspecting the body very quickly you can see that he was stabbed multiple times from behind and probably left in here to bleed out.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Low perception.

name: MATT
dialogue: But you do find on him what appears to be a ring of keys. Not directly on his body, but underneath the corpse, like he was-- you gather best you can, someone probably grabbed it, got their way out, used that moment to stab him and escape.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Nice! I take the keys and I jauntily run by Orn Blackfoot and I go to Abjurist-- Hey, do you know who those other two voices are at the end of the hallway? Like, did you have anyone with you when you got put in here?

name: MATT
dialogue: "No, no one with me. Although-- been plenty of angry discussion from that dwarven fellow down "the way."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, he's got a really rough accent.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I can hear you!"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Shit. My voice carries. Are you all right here for one minute? I have to go perform an interview real fast.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm all right." And he just finishes eating the little bit of the ration that you gave him, like dried meats and bread.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: All right, sit tight. All right, you two, put both your hands outside the cell where I can see them.

name: MATT
dialogue: They both put their hands out. The dwarven man you can see puts his hand out, the skin is very wrinkled and you can see the varicose veins on it, the arm hair that you see on the dwarven arm is white, like bright white. The female hand comes out is thin, but the skin looks a little softer and younger.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Female elven, or is this female--

name: LIAM
dialogue: The daughter.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Who said three?

name: MATT
dialogue: At this point, the dwarf voice goes, (incoherent semi-cursing).

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I know, look, it's always lucky number three, right? That's what they say. Who says that?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Racist little-- peh!" And the arms just withdraw, and the woman, "That's me, that's me."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh good. Hi. You look nice.

name: MATT
dialogue: Look down, you see a young woman, maybe in her late teens, early twenties, long brown hair, tangled, covering one half of her face. You can see the edges of her lips are cracked from just dryness and lack of moisture. She's wearing, both of them actually are wearing just these long, simple cloth drape-over robes that are just, y'know, for any prisoners in here that need to not be wearing their normal clothing.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I've got three other goblets left, can I both give them a goblet and some ale, just to wet their lips and get a drink in?

name: MATT
dialogue: They eagerly take it and begin scarfing it down, the dwarf's like, "Oh! That's nothing!" You can look at the dwarf now, he's elderly, crotchety, half-blind, one clouded eye, but for being a man who's been stuck in prison and slowly dying, he's got this wry grin on him at all times.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You're turning away good ale. Looks like you've seen many a moon.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You're telling me that. But no, seriously, that's like half full. Come on, don't be stingy!"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I like your gall. And I pour more ale in.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That's the ticket!" It's like spilling on the sides and getting stuck in his bright, bushy white beard, and each bit that dribbles down, he goes-- catches it and then pushes it back in, not wasting a single drop.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Beautiful. If you don't mind, ladies first, love, what is your name? Why are you in here?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's Amelia. I was taken because they were-- the beasts were dealing with an uprising "from some of us farm folk and, well, they took me as leverage in the argument. Stopped their-- "stopped their arguing."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You're-- you're farm folk?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yeah."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Do you have any family?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I do."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What are their names?

name: MATT
dialogue: "There's my father Reginald."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh no!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Sorry, I had a bit of split pea soup that's just disagreeing with me, it's all right. Yep.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Are they okay, have you seen them? Have you seen any of the people out there?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, I-- we should get you out of here, there's really bad stuff going on outside, we're trying to get everyone out of the town.

name: MATT
dialogue: And you hear a voice down the way say, "Everyone out of the town? That sounds like a "great plan." And the dwarf behind you is like, "Well then, get us out! I'm sick of this cell!"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, just a minute, hold on. And so like. Hold on. Can I try the keys on Amelia's cell?

name: MATT
dialogue: Mm-hmm. You go through the keyring, which probably has a good 40 or so different keys on it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Shit.

name: MATT
dialogue: And so you go through one, two, three, four, yeah.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Six, six, six.

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughs) And what would be the late teens, and for what to you seems like forever, one key does (squeaking) in the lock and it opens. She, who's been like sitting down the whole time, stands up weakly and grabs the bars and pulls herself up and waits for you to let her through if she does, just being patient.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Amelia, if you would, please stay with me. Funny, I believe I heard of a man named Reginald. Very brave. Not sure where he is, but we're going to get you out of the city, just stay put for a moment.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Okay."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: All right, you, you salty bastard, what's your name?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Old Davin. What's your name?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Lord Grog. Emphasis on the Lord.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Lord Grog."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Lord of?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: The Vales of Strongjaw.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'll take it, that's fine. Get me out, please?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Right. Oh, keys. Can I take the keyring and can I pry the metal keyring-- is it like one solid piece or is it the kind that I could maybe bend it open?

name: MATT
dialogue: I mean, it is one solid piece that has been looped twice, but it has been-- the iron itself has been bent around itself to make it nice and tight, form-fit on one end. Go ahead and make a strength check.

name: MATT
dialogue: Ping. (laughs) Like, you were preparing yourself for a full pull, and with but a minor twitch of your muscles it just bends open.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Can I take half the keys and give them to Amelia and say, love, would you go and let out the kind gentleman with the reddish beard and the little blood on his mouth named Abjurist, would you try these keys and see if his cell will open? Not yet for Mr. Blackfoot across the way.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Right. I will, I will." She rushes off and starts fumbling through the keys, and you hear in the distance her making her way through the keys as--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I take the other half and start trying to get Da-- what was his name?

name: MATT
dialogue: Old Davin.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Old, I like old.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Have we met Old Davin?

name: MATT
dialogue: You have not met Old Davin, no.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Okay. Davin, what did you get put in here for?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Right if I know! Got real drunk and woke up in here, everyone started screaming and running "away, and I'm like ahh, run away you pansies, and they did, ran away, they never came back. Some "packed fire, but not a problem now." And yes, the one snowblind eye doesn't move at all, the other one glances around, that one's completely stuck in a forward position.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Is that magic?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I mean, certainly gets the ladies."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, it does.

name: MATT
dialogue: "But no, it's a reminder to not, well, to not mess with your people."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh. Well, I'm sorry to hear that. But they do make you look very young.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Much worse, say I."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Now if we let you out of here, right, which we're actually in the process of doing, what is your weapon of choice?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh, oh." And he thinks to himself for a moment. "I would have to say my weapon of choice "would be Bloodvine ale. Aye."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Bloodvine ale?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Aye, if we're picking poison, that's my favorite."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, no, my-- He's a dwarf, right?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah. Obviously we are brothers of the beard. Like, to fight with, right?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh, that kills, eh?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, stab, poke, enchant, whatever.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Once upon a time I was quite a duelist, so if you got something pointy and prickling I can "spear 'em with the best of them."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I do have a Greatsword of Frenzy, but it's a two-handed weapon.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Ah, that's not my preference."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I do also have one regular, just a regular longsword. About the best I have.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yeah, that'll do, certainly, I'll take a longsword."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: All right, so. Have I got the door open yet?

name: MATT
dialogue: Not yet. But at this time there's an awkward pause and now you're like, don't have any more conversation. But you still have to finish the-- about a minute later, he's sitting there going, "Come on, come on, come on." Eventually-- tink!-- it opens up. "Yes!" And he pushes it open as you pull it open.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Before I give you this sword--

name: MATT
dialogue: "Aye?"

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Can I insight check him?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yes, you may.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: This is going to go really well. Eight! Nine!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Go Tarv, go Tarv.

name: MATT
dialogue: He seems a little--

name: SAM
dialogue: Scottish. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: He seems a little malnourished, and a little confused.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Right.

name: MATT
dialogue: But nothing sets you off as untrustworthy.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Look, your expression says a lot. What if I put an excellent meal in your belly, sharpened that sword some more, would you like to fight for some glory come the morrow?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Sure. Why not?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's what I thought. If you would go join Amelia, I have to get my good friend Abjurist Noja out of his cell and then we're going to go have a meeting, because there's going to be a big feast tonight, it's going to be delicious.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh, great, I'll be there for that, aye. Where's it happening?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You know, it's very secret, yep. Secret location, TBD.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Right, right. I'll wait for you." And he walks out, taking the keys from you as he runs off toward Amelia.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Now, has she gotten Abjurist out?

name: MATT
dialogue: At this point, yeah, Noja has stepped out of the cell and is putting an arm on her, you see he's actually having a hard time standing and she's helping support him, even though she's having a hard time standing. (Skype noise) There goes Taliesin.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Man, I know a lot of people that are going to be really, really happy to see you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Ah. Really? Well, I'm very happy to see these people, anybody really, that're not the "inside of this blasted prison." (coughs) (Skype rings)

name: LIAM
dialogue: Oh, get him, get him!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Quick, answer it!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Stupid tinkerer.

name: SAM

This group of intrepid adventurers, Vox Machina, found their way towards the city of Westruun, which had been partially destroyed by the attacks of the Chroma Conclave, a dangerous group of chromatic dragons, very powerful entities that tore through the countryside. In the wake of this destruction, the Herd of Storms, a roving barbaric tribe that Grog once belonged to, swept in and conquered the city of Westruun. They made an accord with the returning black dragon, Umbrasyl, that they would alleviate most of the spoils of their findings toward it and, as such, would not be in conflict with such a powerful and dangerous entity. Vox Machina swung into the town, cut down the rather brutal and ruthless leader, Kevdak, and aided his son, who seemed to be of more honorable mind, Zanror, and Grog himself, to temporarily take the herd in its current state and use this moment to surprise and hopefully take down this ancient black dragon known as Umbrasyl, the Hope Devourer. They set a trap. They sprung it, and kept the dragon close to the ground as long as they could, dealing vast amounts of damage but not enough to stop it as it began to tear through the herd, as well as Vox Machina itself. Vax and Scanlan had, through the use of magic and ingenuity, teleported themselves inside of the dragon. Didn't seem to go as well as they intended, as the dragon took off, leaving a dangling Grog with his axe and chain stuck in its side, flying off towards the high, darkened mountain of Gatshadow. The midair battle ensued as they tried to find ways to carve their way out of the beast. Vax, utilising the embedded arrow hole and loosening the tension of the muscles with the dragon blade at his disposal, Scanlan's technique a little more sensual.
