name: SAM
dialogue: Sploosh. That's an 11. (laughter) And when I hit the water I set off a level two Thunderwave. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: So Scanlan doesn't sprint but gingerly jogs up to the side of the pool, leaps in the air. It sends waves out from each side and drenches all of you waiting on the side again-- (laughter) As the water comes rushing back, slapping into you, Scanlan, after the fact but, nevertheless, a very impressive display.

name: SAM
dialogue: Why, thank you. Take a bow, take a bow.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Good job, good job.

name: SAM
dialogue: Thank you, thank you. Percy, are you back yet?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm ready.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I've got a kettle-- (laughter) And what is essentially a giant cheesecloth teabag of raw sodium in an oil holding base. You are aware of what will happen when I hit the water?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yep.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Okay, cool. I grab the kettle. I put it to my chest. I take a run, and I leap into--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Isn't this is detrimental to your health?!

name: PERCY
dialogue: Yes, this is a terrible idea. Do not do this. Do not do this. You will die. And I take a run and jump head into the--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (shouting) Percy, no!

name: MATT
dialogue: Make an athletics check.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Not acrobatics? Athletics. 23

name: MATT
dialogue: 23, okay. So, as you land and hit the water, there's a momentary pause, a little (sploosh, explosion sound). A secondary explosion that sounds dulled and covered until it hits the air in a loud cacophonous (explosion sound). Water and smoke and pieces of metal go flying as the kettle is destroyed. You, Percy, suffer--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Should have mostly directed down but I'm aware that some--

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. 23 points of bludgeoning and piercing damage from shrapnel and pieces of metal that have just scattered across your chest but nevertheless, a very impressive display.

name: LIAM
dialogue: For science!

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Total Party Kill cannonball!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I look down and pull out a small piece of the kettle out of my pectoral and toss it away. That was very impressive, all of you. I'm very impressed. It seems that--

name: SAM
dialogue: The twins!

name: MATT
dialogue: The twins haven't gone.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh, oh! I'm so sorry.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's all right, Grog.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, no. Get it. Go do it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right. I take my broom.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Here comes the bellyflop--

name: LAURA
dialogue: I know, right? I fly 20 feet up. As high as the ceiling. How high is the ceiling?

name: SAM
dialogue: Not that high.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I get to the top of the ceiling.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, it's about 15, 20 feet up from the water's surface.

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right. I stand up on the broom.

name: MATT
dialogue: Ceiling's right above you. You're having to hunch forward a little bit.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And right as I cannonball off of the broom, I release Trinket out of the necklace too so (shouting) double cannonball!

name: MATT
dialogue: As you leap off, make an athletics check.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make an athletics check for Trinket.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, man. I thought that was going to be good. Me and Trinket kind of suck. What is that, strength?

name: MATT
dialogue: Strength, yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: 16. As you hit the water, there's a (double splooshing sound) as a bear is suddenly placed magically into the water beneath you at the same velocity, causing the water itself to splash outward, in a large column, a spray that gently comes down around the sides of the initial splash. Impressive, a very impressive display.

name: SAM
dialogue: Impressive. And she didn't really use magic, so that's good. Bonus points there.

name: MATT
dialogue: Trinket eventually comes out of the water. (growl, shaking coat sound) Shakes off.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Is the judging of this up to artistic interpretation, like ice skating?

name: SAM
dialogue: That's up to Grog!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well done, all around. Really, I'm really quite impressed. However, there was only one--

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Hang on. He still has to go.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, he's not in the room.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: He's not in the room.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, wait. Is Vax going to do it? Is he coming down?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Is he stealthing right now and he's actually in the room?

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't think so.

name: LIAM
dialogue: (snoring)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, there was only one that managed to draw blood with their display. Therefore, Percy is the winner. (applause)

name: SAM
dialogue: Well met, well met. Five pounds of gems?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LIAM
dialogue: He needs it!

name: MATT
dialogue: He takes it and smiles as the blood slowly runs from one nostril-- (laughter)

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Oh man!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Now, if you'll excuse me, I need to sleep off this spa. (laughter)

name: LIAM
dialogue: Those gems are going to turn into lead, aren't they?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Got plans for one of them--

name: MATT
dialogue: He takes the gems in one hand, takes the towel, wraps it around as he steps out of the water with the other and makes his way outside of the spa.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Leaving a little trail of blood all the way down the corridor. (laughter)

name: SAM
dialogue: Good game, good game.

name: MATT
dialogue: All righty.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well, I'm going to bed.

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right, all right.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. You guys go, find your way to your respective rooms, rest for the remainder of the evening. Wake up to the smell of wonderfully cooked chicken wafting through the hallways of the mansion. The only person that has a unique evening's sleeping is Vex, who slides into her comfortable, silk sheet bed to a (sucking sound) to find some sort of now chilled but loosely room-temperature chicken paste--

name: LAURA
dialogue: That is just disgusting.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Don't you mean, that's fowl? (groaning)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh! Fowl!

name: LAURA
dialogue: I don't even care. Trinket loves it.

name: MATT
dialogue: And Trinket is all over that. Trinket is now just lapping it up from the inside of the bed--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah. I just go to sleep and I'll take a shower in the morning.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. All right. You all wake up. Breakfast is at your disposal. You begin to eat comfortably, you wash up, Vex--

name: LAURA
dialogue: A lot.

name: MATT
dialogue: Is there anything else you wish to achieve here or shall we continue with the rest of your journey?

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, we just have a few things to divvy up. I've learned about the book that we found from the dragon. It is filled with knowledge that can increase someone's abilities.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What abilities?

name: SAM
dialogue: The abilities that I happen to be very good at would be even better.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Hmm.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I don't want any part of that.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's not my sex abilities.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, oh. Okay.

name: SAM
dialogue: Actually, technically yes. Technically, yes. My sex ability--

name: LAURA
dialogue: What abilities? (laughs)

name: SAM
dialogue: Charismatic abilities.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Oh, it just gives you, you have all the charisma?

name: SAM
dialogue: Permanently better charisma.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, Keyleth, as you make that awkward-ass face, maybe you should improve your charisma.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You smell like chicken.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, somebody put chicken paste in my bed. I don't know who it could be.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, we've got to get out of this mansion.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah. Weird.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well, I also went to my room and I was like "Man, what I could really--" and I was holding the jug, at the time, and I was like, "I'm just going to break it, nobody'll know--"

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh shit!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It'll be great. And I was like, "I could really go for some beer right now," and all of a sudden, the jug was full of shitloads of beer.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What?!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: SAM
dialogue: Is it a never-ending beer jug?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh no, it's not never-ending. It stopped after a bit. But I got plenty fucking wasted.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Is it just beer?

name: SAM
dialogue: Is it just beer? Or is it any spirit? Or what?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, I said "mayonnaise" and it started to make mayonnaise and then it stopped so I think there's a finite amount of stuff it can make in a day. (disconcerted oohs)

name: LAURA
dialogue: Do you have a jug of mayonnaise now?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, I ate that too. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: In the wee hours of the morning--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There's chicken!

name: LIAM
dialogue: That was one of the best exchanges of our entire run!

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Oh my God.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Wow!

name: MATT
dialogue: So--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Gross!

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I can't stop laughing.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Oh my goodness.

name: MATT
dialogue: So, what else? (laughter)

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay, now you're going to get a bunch of mayonnaise shipped to our PO box. (laughter)

name: LAURA
dialogue: No mayonnaise!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Beer. Send beer, is fine.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, that one brought tears.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Please somebody draw him just sad in his room eating mayonnaise--

name: MATT
dialogue: Scooping mayonnaise out of a jar.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: A Grecian urn of mayonnaise.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Oh, my tears.

name: MATT
dialogue: Saddest Winnie the Pooh ever--

name: SAM
dialogue: I also found out that that one of the vials is a potion vial. It can temporarily give the drinker a spell of Etherealness. Which is like you temporarily turn into Casper the Friendly Ghost. You can pass through walls.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh cool!

name: SAM
dialogue: Anyone who drinks it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Vax?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, that would be good for you.

name: MATT
dialogue: Well, less drinking. More like applying.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, it's rubbing?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, it's an oil.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, don't drink it.

name: MATT
dialogue: I would not recommend drinking it.

name: SAM
dialogue: I can rub it on your back for you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, you have to rub it on you.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm all right with that. (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You'd need to use a stepping stool to do it, but you could.

name: LAURA
dialogue: The other one was a Potion of Climbing, which we decided--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Does Pike want it? Oh, you?

name: SAM
dialogue: No, it's Vex.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I suck at it, but anybody else can have it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Don't you have a broom? You ain't going to be climbing much.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's true! I don't need it. I have a broom!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Actually, I might take it. High ground is occasionally very useful for me.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I've got a broom that flies.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And I'm not that strong.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What was the name of that tome again, Scanlan?

name: SAM
dialogue: Tome of Leadership and Influence. I'm torn, Keyleth. You have some charisma issues, shall we say?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Uh-huh. No, keep telling me about myself, Scanlan, today.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, I'm just saying that I am quite self-confident, sure of myself. Some would say charming.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Some. Not most.

name: SAM
dialogue: And this book would make me unstoppably so--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Sure.

name: SAM
dialogue: So, I don't know, we could roshambo for it? What does the group think?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I think Keyleth should read it. She's trying to lead her people.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah. Roshambo for it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I don't want to-- what? I don't like wanting things. I don't care, you--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Who has-- This is-- who has charisma-based spells?

name: SAM
dialogue: Me?

name: MATT
dialogue: You.

name: LIAM
dialogue: That's a big fat pause, is what that is.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah.

name: SAM
dialogue: Why don't we think on it?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: All right, we'll think on it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: To be fair, it takes days.

name: SAM
dialogue: It takes six days of reading to take effect.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh shit. So if you read for two days and then pass it off to someone else, does it just restart?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's once a century it works.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh shit! Once a century?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I have a similar book, that I used--

name: LAURA
dialogue: What did you use it on?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, you live for many centuries, Keyleth. You can have it nexties! (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's actually a very fair point.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's kind of perfect.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I was about to say, would you like a Manual of Quickness? Here, for you-- (laughter)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, for the next century?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: So 99 years from now--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Sure, I'll hold onto it for that long.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: When we're all cold and dead!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I was holding onto it in the hopes of finding somebody long-lived to sell it to.

name: SAM
dialogue: Speaking of old, are some of us older than we used to be?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Are we still old? It would have worn off, right?

name: MATT
dialogue: I would say, for the purposes of the travel, because you guys had a few days' travel from the actual Sphinx's lair, towards Westruun when you were travellng back, you had the opportunity to use Greater Restoration to get rid of it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Between Pike and I--

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, in that time.

name: SAM
dialogue: What if we don't want to be any younger?

name: MATT
dialogue: Then you could have said no and kept it as you go. If you wanted to take in your nice salt and pepper--

name: LAURA
dialogue: How old are you now, Scanlan, if you keep it?

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't know.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: That salt and pepper hair?

name: SAM
dialogue: A girl never tells her age.

name: MATT
dialogue: Would you want to maintain your little creeping Reed Richards going on at the sides there?

name: SAM
dialogue: No, I'll get young again.

name: MATT
dialogue: Slightly.

name: SAM
dialogue: Slightly.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He said, begrudgingly.

name: MATT
dialogue: I know.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Set that dial back to 39.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right then. Anything else?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What were you going to say, Percy?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I was thinking, perhaps, you're not necessarily the person to magically augment your path.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's kind of my hesitance about it, I guess.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I had meditated upon the idea for a minute.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm honestly kind of afraid of what kind of leadership things and influence it could possibly tell me. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (laughs)

name: SAM
dialogue: I do!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You can read it, Scanlan.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes! (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: At the very least, it'll keep him busy for four or five days.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's true.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: That's true. That's true.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Because you have to read for 48 hours--

name: LAURA
dialogue: What if he gets even more charismatic and then he proposes again? And he charms you more?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Well, if he's so charming, I just wouldn't be able to help it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's possible.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I know, that's my-- actually, my only other regret is do we want to turn Scanlan into a charm nuclear weapon? Because that's what we'll be doing.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I kind of do want to do that. He is super good at talking to people.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He is.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And I think there's enough of us that we could all keep each other in check, from--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Between Grog and Scanlan, we can solve any problem, I think, so beef him up, so to speak.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Tell me what kind of leadership things-- who wrote that, Scanlan?

name: SAM
dialogue: Lao Tsu.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Tell me what kind of leadership skills Lao Tsu wants to bestow upon you. If there's any good ones, pass them along.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right, I'll give you some tips.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: All right.

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughs) All right. You guys finish your breakfast, make your way outside of the mansion, back into the dragon's den. Is there anything else you wish to do before you leave? As you can only take the amount of gold that you retrieved, and the items you could farm, the rest will have to be left behind, hopefully to be retrieved at some point down the line by either the remnants of Westruun or yourselves.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'll just say that I've attuned to all my old shit while everyone was swimming.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Cool.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, yeah. I carved a pretty little heart on the side of one of the boots just to make it extra girly.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a perception check.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I would just think that meant you love me.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Maybe I do.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Uh, that is a 39.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (laughs) What?!

name: LIAM
dialogue: 17 plus perception is-- did I get it wrong? Am I too tired? I've had a long day, people. Let's say 29.

name: MATT
dialogue: Did you take perception as one of your--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: Oh, then yeah. Okay. You take the boots and you put them on and immediately, there's a heart there. And you're like (pained) hmm. That probably means she loves me.

name: LIAM
dialogue: No, I like it. It's fine!

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. At first you're like, sh-- oh no, it's cool.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I don't know what you're thinking. It's beautiful.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right, you guys are back in the dragon's lair. Is there anything else you wish to do?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We're going to make sure we walk around the trap that is still active in the front--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Right.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make your way back through the tunnel that you had carved before--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Have to avoid that old magic.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Is there any lasting damage from the acid burns?

name: MATT
dialogue: Thankfully, through magic healing and other means there was no scarring. The tattoos and beard that were partially destroyed--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I was going to ask: beard?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, the beard's a little bit reduced from the sheer volume of acid that was thrown at your face but since healing magic was applied shortly thereafter, the little bit of the beard that began to singe, it stopped that process. So you still have some facial hair, just may have to grow back to its full majesty--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I may need a haircut in a day or two.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Ooh. Can you Stone Shape something for me? I would like to have Keyleth Stone Shape and use one dragon scale, if you would be so kind. Or, actually, one tooth if that would be all right.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Sure. Tooth me.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I would like to leave the "VM" seal on the side of the cavern.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (gasps)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And just written in-- what would a dragon understand?

name: MATT
dialogue: Draconic.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Draconic?

name: LIAM
dialogue: We have somebody who can do that--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: "One down" and let's embed the tooth into the rock.

name: SAM
dialogue: Ooh.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yes! I like it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We might as well.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I like it. I like it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So I do the Vox Machina crest.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And then "one down." Who speaks Draconic?

name: MATT
dialogue: All right, so you get with her. You scribble onto the ground what that phrase would look like. You go ahead and copy that and you embed it permanently and immediately into the side of the stone.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And I said, bitch!

name: MATT
dialogue: All righty. You guys make your way down Gatshadow, through the Bramblewood Forest to Westruun itself. As you hit the base of the mountain, start getting towards the edge of the forest, you see a pillar of smoke rising up from that direction--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: From Westruun?

name: MATT
dialogue: A relatively thick pillar of smoke, a few actually.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh no!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Wait. What?

name: SAM
dialogue: Uh-oh. They've already attacked.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, we go fast. We go.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. You guys rush through the remainder of the Bramblewood, come out into the field and are met by what looks like a series of fires that are out in the open field, north of Westruun, not within the actual city. You see these are pyres. The dead of the Umbrasyl battle have been set aflame, being given off the proper heroes' sending. It is a standard after-battle remembrance of those who fell for the herd. You see standing amongst them the twelve surviving members of the battle, many of them pretty badly scarred from the encounter but alive, nonetheless. Bandaged and kind of taking a moment of silence. You do see of that group, as well, Zanror and Worra are there. They haven't noticed you yet. And standing behind them all, one large aimless stone golem with a big chain hanging out of its chest, just standing there.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Fassbender!

name: SAM
dialogue: Who controls him?

name: LIAM
dialogue: No one at the moment.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yep.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, you took it off?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I took it off.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But you have the circlet still.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Of course I have the circlet, yeah, but--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'll take it if no one else does.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Sure.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Can I find my way to Zanror? Is his-- is she his wife? His woman--

name: MATT
dialogue: His mate, Worra. Yeah, they're both next to each other and as you get closer you notice most of them have gathered their belongings. They have travel packs. They have taken sacks and whatever they could to bring whatever belonged to them and it looks like they are getting ready to move. You see Shale a bit behind them, as well, who has also taken some small supplies with her one good arm and putting it over her shoulder and tying it to her armor before she grabs her staff again. So you walk over to Zanror and Worra. Zanror looks over to you as you approach, his arm still around Worra's shoulder. "It's good to see you survived, Grog."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah. Did more than that, actually. Found our way up to the cave where Umbrasyl was. Left him in pieces.

name: MATT
dialogue: "As Shale told us. 'The Bearded King,' she said."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (laughs) A word of advice. If, as you're finding your way out of town, you were to stop by a certain cave, there might be some things for you to pick up.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Gro--

name: LIAM
dialogue: I take my sister, put my hand over her mouth, and I drag her back about 30 feet.

name: MATT
dialogue: He gives you a look, and looks to Worra, looks to her belly--

name: LAURA
dialogue: (whispers) That's for the people of Westruun!

name: MATT
dialogue: --and goes, "Appreciate that. We'll take what we can."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Your little one. You take care of him. Her. It.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I will."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: All right.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Do you want to come with us? We know we cast you out once, but we're not like that "anymore. The herd's dead. We go to find prosperity with the Rivermaw. A people we wronged and we're "probably going to spend some time making it up to them, for my father's infractions. You're one of "us now, and we'd be honored to have you."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'm honored. Truly I am. But I lost a family, all those years ago. And while I will always think fondly of you, I have a new family now, and I must stay and guard them with my life.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I understand. Well. I'm not very good at these parting pleasantries." He puts his arm out.

name: MATT, TRAVIS
dialogue: (crashing sound)

name: SAM
dialogue: Stereo.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Come on, it blew your hair back when it happened.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, a little bit, little bit.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Magnavox, like (squeal sound)!

name: MATT
dialogue: "You be safe. You find your way, head north of the Silvercut. You're always welcome in our tents."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'll keep that in mind. Travel safely.

name: MATT
dialogue: He goes ahead and takes up his bags. Shale takes up her staff, comes up to you, and: "We'll "see each other again, Grog. Of this I'm sure."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah. Hm, totally sure, heh. You look out for that other eye now. Don't lose the other, because then you'll just be like (scared noise) in the dark.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you're doing that she smacks you on the nose with the staff. "I'll be fine." And she walks away with a smile on her weathered, crooked face. Zanror yells out, "Come! We move west." Everyone turns their heads and gather their things and they walk by. As all the soldiers walk by, those wounded and not, to each of you they bow their heads in respect. And you swear you hear a couple of murmured "thank you" as they all solemnly make their way out west, away from Westruun.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Is it just the remainder of the herd?

name: MATT
dialogue: Mm-hmm.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Herd leader! We trust you will leave something in that cave for the people of this town. Something to help them recover.

name: MATT
dialogue: Zanror turns to you, and says, "There's very little in our lifestyle that really has use of "this coin, just enough to make it from place to place if need be. Besides, occasionally we need "supplies, something to trade with. I'm not like my father. This I've learned in recent months."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Prosperity on your family.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Hm." Looks to Grog. "Your family as well." Turns around and continues to walk.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You're lucky he's nice, Grog.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What, what?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Offering all the gold to the herd instead of the people of Westruun.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I didn't offer all of it. I said there was something to pick up. He might have grabbed a bunch of mud, what are you so upset about?

name: LIAM
dialogue: He meant well.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you guys make your way-- uh, where are you heading?

name: SAM
dialogue: Into Westruun?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, yeah, yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Is the gold pile trap still there?

name: MATT
dialogue: It is, yes.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's sprung. We have to pick it up.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Is our gold still there?

name: MATT
dialogue: Your gold is not there. (groaning)

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's a good thing I only put a little bit in.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm going to go take like five minutes. I'm going to kneel down and sort of meditate in front of one of the pyres.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. (laughing) But what you do notice, ironically, while the gold is still there, it's scattered about. Because there's been an explosion where the gold was left behind.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (gasps) Oh shit.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Oops. (laughter) My bad. I made a bomb!

name: MATT
dialogue: Nearby, there is a groove in the dirt that is dragged on for about four, five hundred feet, before there appears to be a body at the edge.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Dead dwarf?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's a dwarf?

name: MATT
dialogue: No, it's not. It's the gentleman who disappeared as you let him out of prison. (shouting)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That son of a bitch! That thieving bastard?

name: LAURA
dialogue: He deserves it!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: The fucking asshole that peaced out!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Blackfoot-- what was his name?

name: MATT
dialogue: Oran Blackfoot.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I knew he was going to go for the gold. That's what he thought he was going to do.

name: MATT
dialogue: As soon as you guys left, he seized the opportunity. (laughter)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Good kill. Good kill.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: All right, all right, all right.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm taking a moment to pay my respects to the dead.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I do the same.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm attuning Fassbender. And working on getting the chain removed from him.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Keyleth takes a minute to Druidcraft some wildflowers around the pyre.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. As you guys are taking this break, Vex, you notice a small group of individuals walking from the town in your direction. Make a perception check.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I bent my paper. (high voice) 17!

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. You glance over and, best you can make out, some appear to be armored, some appear to be just carrying sacks and goods. There's a cart being dragged behind with two beasts of burden affixed to the front, a set of horses, and at the front of them you see a human male wearing chain mail with a heavy shield to one side, walking up and approaching. He's mid to late 40s, big black- and gray-streaked beard pulled into two points, wild crazy-looking dark hair, also gray streaked. Sun-dappled nose. He walks up with his hand in the air.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oi, friend.

name: MATT
dialogue: Can we go ahead and have our guest enter?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Ooh!

name: LIAM
dialogue: I know that guy! (cheers)

name: SAM
dialogue: Sorry for the wait.

name: MATT
dialogue: We had to have a hot spring episode.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Very important cannonball competition we had to get to.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: I'm sorry that I was laughing loud enough for the mics to pick it up. Some people on Twitter were saying that they heard me laugh.

name: MATT
dialogue: That's fine. Patrick Rothfuss, joining us today!

name: SAM
dialogue: Fabulous writer. Good person.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: That's not me.

name: MATT
dialogue: So, as you're walking up from the city of Westruun, carrying behind you the group of eager-to-leave refugees that have gathered around you, you notice the burning spires, and you see the remnants of the horde leaving westward behind the group of heroes that you all had feared had gone to the top of the mountain to meet their doom. They stand before you alive and resting, and as you approach to hail them, one of them, the half-elf female, hails you.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Sir, how fares-- (stuttering) How are you doing?

name: SAM
dialogue: Charisma!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Give me the book. Give me the book!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Amazing. Couldn't have done any better.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What's happening in the town? Are you leaving?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: How many people are left in town and how many have come with me?

name: MATT
dialogue: In town, there's probably a couple hundred that are scattered throughout. Most of them have left, the party has sent them out, but many individuals that they didn't get to have still been holed up in their homes. You have with you right now 20 people, and these are the folks that have congregated around you to figure out a plan of what to do.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Okay.

name: SAM
dialogue: What's with all the questions, narc? (laughter)

name: PATRICK
dialogue: I will admit I did not expect to see you folk again.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, we're here.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: What's happened?

name: LAURA
dialogue: You know that dragon?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: I noticed the dragon.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Gone. Killed. Destroyed. Vox Machina! (laughter) Give me the book.

name: SAM
dialogue: Nope.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: I don't know what to say. I was expecting to have to bury some more bodies.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Thankfully, that is not the case. And you are smart, with leaving town.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Well, the town itself hasn't decided exactly what to do, how much to rebuild, or whether or not it's even worth it. But now, at least we can make some plans.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Definitely.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oi, what's your name?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Oh. My name is Kerr.

name: SAM
dialogue: Kerr?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Like Care Bear?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Is that with a C or a K?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: (laughs) With a K.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay. Kerr. I like it.

name: SAM
dialogue: And tell us about yourself, if you don't mind.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: I have been here in this town for a while. I settled down after-- I had a bit of an adventurous youth.

name: SAM
dialogue: Ooh! I like!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, me too.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: How old do these guys look?

name: MATT
dialogue: They look younger than you. They look like a bunch of young upstarts, for the most part.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: They're puppies, right?

name: MATT
dialogue: They're puppies, but looking close up, you can see weathered experiences in their eyes.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: They came back from the dragon. But still, these are like kids, right?

name: MATT
dialogue: From your perspective? Yeah.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Yeah.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm an adult man!

name: MATT
dialogue: Who's just roughly past your knee.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: I welcome you back to what is left of the town, and I offer my thanks, and thanks on behalf of those of us that are left.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Are you responsible for these pyres?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: The town has been pulling together, and we have been doing what we can with what we have.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And what's your position been in Westruun?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Oh, I don't have a position in the city. I'm just the smith.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You're a blacksmith?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You make weapons?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Yes.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Armor?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Armor.

name: SAM
dialogue: Percy?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, I make things. They're not--

name: SAM
dialogue: Maybe you guys could collab on a joint project.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Smithing and gadgetry, while I can see how, to the layman, they look very similar, are in fact quite different.

name: SAM
dialogue: I actually might have a project for you, if we have a moment.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay, before we start hitting him up for work.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Is this everybody you could round up to get out of the city?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Well, this is everyone who was interested in coming out on this particular expedition.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh, yeah! What is your expedition?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Mostly exploratory. Like I said, we just didn't have any information at all. I didn't know if we were going to be burying more bodies, or dealing with an increasingly angry dragon.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, the dragon in the mountain is dead, but there are increasingly angered dragons in other cities that will probably be coming here to retaliate.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: That will be coming here?

name: SAM
dialogue: Possibly.

name: LAURA
dialogue: More than likely.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Probably.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Maybe.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We don't know.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No. No chance. (laughter)

name: SAM
dialogue: Actually, this raises an important question. What do the people of Westruun do at this point? Do they rebuild? Do they go underground? Do they leave and abandon the city?

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's a huge question, yes. What do you think, personally? What is this small group that you're leading? What's your plan?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: I offered to come along with them in case they needed a strong arm. I don't speak for the town. I just know most of the people involved, and I wanted to make sure they stayed safe. But the truth is, there's a lot of people who have nothing to rebuild, and nothing to rebuild it with. And if there might be dragons coming back, I don't know.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well, Kerr, Pike and I are both from Westruun. Yeah. Yep.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I've seen you before. Do you know Wilhand? My great-great-grandfather?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Great great?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Great-great. Yeah. Two greats, not just one.

name: MATT
dialogue: A tiny, hunched over gnomish gentleman, a little absent-minded but friendly enough, keeps to himself.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Likes to drink.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Ah!

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Yes. You probably have had some drinks with him before.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: A little bit. And I haven't met you, but I've heard of you.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh, yeah?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Yeah!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What have you heard?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: I heard that you were a good member of the community.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yep, that's me.

name: SAM
dialogue: Nope. You are incorrect.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Totally.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: He was, and is, but we're just never home.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Grog. Grog is my name.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Kerr, do you have a sense of how many people are left in the city, roughly?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Maybe as many as a couple hundred.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, that's it?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's not a lot.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: A lot of people have been leaving, but some people can't.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well, look, I would just like to put this forward. Westruun is their home. It's Pike's home, it's my home. And if you start running, you never really stop.

name: SAM
dialogue: But where are they going to stay? I've been down to the sewers, and there's crazy giant creatures down there.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well, you can treat it like a weather shelter. If the dragons come, we set up an early warning system. They go underground. But this is their home.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Here's an interesting thing to contemplate about this whole problem, is that we have three dragons still at large. Three dragons who have probably found cities of their own, so the chances that they're going to come back and take time away from their own city to go look at one that's, in theory, already taken over is very thin. And if they are traveling, then they're going to travel to cities that haven't been plundered yet.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's true, this one has been plundered.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: This is no less or more. There's a risk either way. It's just the risk of running or the risk of staying.

name: SAM
dialogue: Also the dragons know that the last dragon who came here died.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I think the dragons' motives have probably shifted by now, and where the dragons might not be interested in plundering anymore, instead might be interested in any city that we are in.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Which, I imagine we're leaving soon, anyway.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, they might not believe we'd be here, but they also might try to--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Kerr, are you an honest man?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: I've been called an honest man.

name: SAM
dialogue: I insight check him!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Can I insight check-- Oh yeah, you do that. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: You may both make insight checks.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (high voice) Four.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: If you whisper to Grog, it's going to make me really happy. Yes!

name: SAM
dialogue: He just said, you fart.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Mightily.

name: MATT
dialogue: Excuse me for just a minute.

name: SAM
dialogue: What was this about Loot Crate?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Three dollars off if you use lootcrate.com/criticalrole next week!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But that's no secret!

name: SAM
dialogue: I trust him with my life. I pledge my allegiance to you, sir.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You just dabbed to him.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Scanlan literally hasn't said that to me in the entire three years I've known him.

name: SAM
dialogue: What was your name again?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Scanlan just found out that Kerr has a daughter, is what he found out.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Wow, you pledge your life to him? Jeez.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Kerr. You said you were an adventurer several years ago.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Many years ago. Many years ago. I've lived here-- I've lived here a lifetime at this point.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Did you have a party that you traveled with as well?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: I did.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Would we happen to know any of them? Allura? Asum?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: No, that was a long time ago, and I'd be very surprised if you'd heard any of the stories from back then. I will say, though, from what I know about dragons, that perhaps vengeance might not be outside a reasonable expectation. There might not be anything here for them to plunder, but--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But no one likes having their ass handed to them.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: And these creatures are old and intelligent and powerful, and they stay that way by striking fear into people. And (sighs) as much as I hate to leave my own home, I don't know who will be able to help my people if any other things like this happen.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We can't be everywhere at once.

name: LIAM
dialogue: What about the sewers?

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, we were down there, and there was horrible, creepy things.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We could help with that.

name: SAM
dialogue: We could clear out the sewers.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But that's not indefinite.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, it's not.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: They'll be back.

name: LAURA
dialogue: The only other option is--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There's the traveling band, by the river.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Split the city up? Set them on different paths?

name: LIAM
dialogue: There's Whitestone.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Whitestone is rapidly becoming a very large target.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Very quickly becoming noticeable, I think.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Ever been to Vasselheim?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Refugees are often very unwelcome, too, and most of the people here did not have much left to lose before they lost it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We have claim to the gold that was stolen. It's up in the mountain. It's just hard to get down.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Someone honest is going to have to come and help divvy it up amongst the survivors.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: We can look for an honest person.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But if all of the survivors are evacuating the city--

name: PATRICK
dialogue: We could probably-- I know enough people to put together a group of carters to go up there and start fetching stuff down?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. And the people that have gathered around you are people that have been around you most of the time you've been in the city, or at least have known you long enough to the point where they themselves are also like-minded, so you can trust most of the folks that have walked with you out towards the pyres.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: I'll say, excuse me for just a minute, and I'll walk off and I'll chat with them a little bit, so you can see that I'm pointing up. I'll do a little talk off with them, so you can talk about me behind my-- Without me.

name: SAM
dialogue: I like this guy.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You do?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Why do you pledge yourself to him?

name: SAM
dialogue: I just feel like he's an honest man. He's a good guy. He's got a nice twinkle in his eye and I recognize that as a sign of honesty, because I have a similar feature.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You do? I've never noticed a twinkle in your eye.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, the light has to hit it just--

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, it's a crusty from the morning. You might just-- yeah.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: How do you get glitter in there?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That seems like such a shame. I mean, shouldn't we ask the people of Westruun if they want to stay or go?

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, there's only 200. We could have a huge meeting and put it to a vote.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: A town hall thing?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Why not?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But he said some people were incapable of leaving. There might be elderly and sick here that can't travel.

name: SAM
dialogue: Is there a way to hide the city with magic? We've seen that done before.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can we make it look like it's already been burned down?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It has already been burned down.

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughs)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That won't be hard at all.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can we hide?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Can't they have sentries and a shelter in the sewers? They could clear out part of it and have sentries every night, and any time a dragon comes, they just go underground and wait. Wait it out.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't think this is a terrible-- I think this is a pretty reasonable idea.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What do you think, Grog, Pike?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's what I said.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I feel like it's a good idea.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah. I don't--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Hang on, hold the phone. Hold the phone.

name: SAM
dialogue: We could spend a few days here and get them started before we go on to our next thing.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It's so hard to find shelter and protection that's not a city where you're unwelcome in the first place.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, this is an unwelcome world at the moment.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We could leave Fassbender here to help protect everyone.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, I guess if we gave him away. But we need him.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Do we need him?

name: LIAM
dialogue: He's going to slow us down.

name: LAURA
dialogue: How are we going to get Fassbender anywhere with us?

name: SAM
dialogue: Tell him to walk.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are we returning the band?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, Quall did want the circlet at some point. It's not necessarily ours to give away.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Quall's evil.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Is he?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Selfish, maybe.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We are under contract, technically.

name: LAURA
dialogue: This is true.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What were you going to say, Pike?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: We could just leave it with Wilhand.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We could leave it with Wilhand, actually.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: And then we could tell Quall--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Oh, Quall, we didn't know where you were, we couldn't find you, we left it with Wilhand.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: We wanted to leave it in one place, just in case we see you again.

name: SAM
dialogue: Is that your lying voice?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Sorry, buddy.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: What is the general atmosphere in town? Are people just done?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, right? I'm fucking over this shit!

name: MATT
dialogue: Best that you can ascertain, a lot of people are scared because they were separated from their families. A large bulk of people left south to Kymal, which is the nearest township to Westruun that feasibly could take in refugees. They left directly after the dragon attack, even before the herd was there. When the herd came in, the maybe ten percent, 15 percent of people that stayed behind were then captured, some of them were killed as they fought back, many were enslaved and brutalized, and a number of them did escape thanks to this group's efforts. So I'd say those that are left behind, they're eager to see their families. They're probably eager to leave for the time being. Some of them do want to stay just because they're stubborn, but the majority seems interested in not being in a place that could be a target for more dragon attacks, as rumors have come back that there is more than just the black dragon, and many of them recall the red, the green, and the white that came with the initial onslaught that tore through the city. Or it would've been the green and the white.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Okay, yeah. So I'll wander back, and I say, my friends here are willing to go on a retrieval mission. I'm assuming you folks could use some rest, and the hospitality of the town isn't what it used to be, but I'm sure a lot of people would be very glad to see you. Have you set up protections? Did you hide the treasure?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We did. We did. It's hidden in a cubby with a little mark on it.

name: SAM
dialogue: We'll give you instructions.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Sketch out something.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Including a little walk around.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, yeah, the walk around is important.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: But there are stuff out there in the woods. There are things.

name: SAM
dialogue: He's a strong man.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: And I've got, these are the more capable, these folks can go out on their own?

name: MATT
dialogue: A number of them can, yeah. Some of them were there for general visual support, carrying things forth and stewards that have taken up arms because they have to, but you're essentially the strongest of a group of relatively capable individuals.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'd hate to send you into anything that all of a sudden got a bit too nasty. I see you wearing chain mail. If I may, what is your weapon of choice?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: I'm partial-- I was partial to the warhammer.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Ooh. I reach out to shake his hand. I like your choice.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Kerr, do you know how to make armor be quiet? (laughter)

name: PATRICK
dialogue: That's probably the first laugh you get. I've been there. I lived there a long time. We could talk shop about that.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I love talking shop. Let's do it.

name: PATRICK

dialogue: Are there any--?

dialogue: (groans)

dialogue: Anybody with cantrippy message sending--?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: They beat feet long ago. Yeah.

name: MATT

name: PATRICK
dialogue: I think at this point, it's people that are stubborn and with really low intelligence scores are the only folks left, so the wizards went right away.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's appropriate on occasion to leave people to a modicum of risk. Life is risky. It's perfectly reasonable to send people on themselves.

name: LIAM

dialogue: Yes, we will tell you about the basilisks.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, never mind.

name: MATT
dialogue: As far as you know, they were nowhere near the Bramblewood, thankfully.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So what should we do here, clear out the sewers? Because that's what was said.

dialogue: Wait, there's three options for these people, and they have to decide for us. They can stay here and live in the sewers. They can go to, what's it called?

name: MATT

name: SAM
dialogue: Kymal, where they're still accepting refugees, or they can wander off into the desert.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, there's also that group of people wandering around. There's that group.

name: SAM
dialogue: That's what I'm saying.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Hey, guys, so remember the farmer? Outside, and then he turned into a scarecrow?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes, we remember.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I found his daughter.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, where is she?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Did you tell her?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, no, I didn't know what to do. She looked like a deer in the headlights.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Where is she?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: She was in the prison with Abjurist Noja and Blackfoot, who's now dead. What's her name again?

name: MATT
dialogue: Amelia.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Amelia, really sweet.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Did you send her towards refugees?

name: SAM
dialogue: Is she around?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I brought her out before we took the fight to the dragon, so I think she's still in the town, but I don't want to tell her.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We should tell her, Grog.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, I know, and maybe give her a little coin, but, Pike, do you think maybe you could--

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Tell her?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Yeah.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Okay.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Do I remember where he is?

name: MATT
dialogue: Where Reginald is? Yeah.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I head off that way.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. It's directly west of the town, so it's pretty much south of where you guys are currently standing, because the drop point was northwest of the city. He is still affixed.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I bring him back here.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Make him sound real brave, you know. Paint a good picture when you talk to her.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: He was real brave.

name: LAURA
dialogue: There's only about 200 people left. Do you know someone named Amelia?

name: MATT
dialogue: You know of Amelia, though you-- No, you did see her last night. You hadn't seen her in a while. She was one of the people that was still in the town. But you do know that she's safe and reachable.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Yeah, she's around.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Where is everyone staying within the town? Are they scattered about or are they staying in a central location?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: We've organized places for people to sleep if they don't have places for themselves. It's makeshift, but-- because it's been a couple of days, at this point?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, it's been almost two days since the initial encounter.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Right, so we've got triage camps set up. I will say, some people are going to stay no matter what, and they have the right to stay, and that's their choice. I imagine some people will come back and rebuild here, but most people, they are ready to go. They miss their families.

name: LAURA
dialogue: An entire city.

dialogue: We can build a dragon shelter. At the very least, that is something we can do.

name: MARISHA

The largest concentration of survivors that you've been keeping tabs on actually aren't that far from Wilhand's home, in the area where most of the temples are constructed, which is generally considered one of the oldest and most protected areas of Westruun. There are two inns that are basically now ramshackle homes for sleep. There's bedspreads across the entire floor, all the tables and chairs have been moved out, and it's now just a giant room where people who had their homes destroyed come and sleep, not because it's comfortable, but because there's comfort and safety in numbers. People have gathered what belongings they still had that are worth anything or they might need for a journey. Many of them are still gathering bits of dried food and fruit and whatever, preparing for whatever the next step of their travels may be. But you probably have the bulk of the people in the town, other than a few older, very stubborn folks that are like, "I'm going to stay in my home!" The folks that stayed at Mt. St. Helens, where you're like, come on, guys, seriously? (laughter)

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I look around for Wilhand.

name: MATT
dialogue: Wilhand is not amongst this group. Wilhand probably stayed safe within his home, which kept him safe up to this point, so far.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Do we see Amelia?

name: MATT
dialogue: Looking about, yes, you do see Amelia. She is asleep right now, though.

name: SAM
dialogue: Wake her up! Tell her her dad's dead!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Hey, hey. It's really important. I need to tell you right now.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: We see her?

name: MATT
dialogue: You see her. She's asleep. It's later in the day from the travel, you guys went down the mountain to even get here after you woke up in the morning. You spent most of the day getting back to Westruun, so you're getting pretty close to sunset. The group has been set off for the evening's travel toward the top of Gatshadow. She appears to have fallen asleep early.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: I'll start a few things, and I'll spread the word. Everybody could really use a bit of a party here. We don't have many resources, but I'm betting there's enough liquor for everybody to get good and drunk tonight.

name: MATT
dialogue: Oh yeah.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: That's the resource there's always an abundance of at this point. We'll kind of put the word out, and honestly, I don't need to organize it. I can just say, "Dragon's dead, and they did "it. We're going to throw them a party tonight." And I'm just going to let that happen.

name: MATT
dialogue: And with each chain of that word spreading, the energy immediately lifts up within the room, and the building adjacent, and folks that were either resting or in a state of perpetual anxiousness suddenly brighten up, even with the dirt-smeared faces, you can see smiles poking out as people begin coming into the room to see those who slew the dragon that threatened them. People start coming up and shaking your hands, individuals who haven't seen you guys for years, people that lived down the street and gave you a passing hello in the younger days of your youth, are now coming up to you with a look of absolute appreciation and thanks. Just as that energy picks up, the wine and the ale begin to go throughout the area as stores of them beneath the taverns that were not found by the herd, as there were only so many members of the herd and a larger number of actual inns and taverns throughout the town, people start grabbing cups. Even some of the kids start coming up with cups, and the parents are like, "Hmm, a little." It's New Year's, you can have a sip.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's medieval times, everybody drinks.

name: MATT
dialogue: Without much worry at that point, everyone's getting nice and liquored up, and happiness has ensued. Some folks pull out some meager instruments. (laughter)

dialogue: Yeah, not a worry. Go ahead and make a perception check.

The starry night sky now spreads infinitely above you, and for the first time in a long time, knowing that the immediate danger is no longer chasing you, you take a minute to appreciate the sheer beauty of the view that Westruun always had. This brief moment to allow yourself to exhale helps remind you what all this is worth, and the importance of moments like this. You can hear the laughter behind you within the inn. You can hear the music. You can hear the kids chuckling and telling jokes. People clinking glasses together. And in this tiny little microcosm of a moment here, you let yourself silently smile, and really know what all of this is worth.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm going to join--

dialogue: I really don't--

dialogue: Yes.

dialogue: No.

name: MARISHA

name: LAURA

dialogue: To Reggie.
