name: SAM
dialogue: It seems like a waste.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Give me water like the ocean!

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, no, no, no!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No!

name: MATT
dialogue: The jug is now filled with water to the top.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, look! Water.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Is it saltwater?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I dip my finger in and take a taste.

name: MATT
dialogue: It is saltwater.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (groans) Damn it, Grog.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Did I do it wrong?

name: SAM
dialogue: You did it wrong.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You should try that, though. See if you like it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Is there anybody else sleeping in the room?

name: MATT
dialogue: There are a few folks that are probably still sleeping off the drinking, but I'd say the majority of the folks have woken up in various states of grogginess.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (whispers) Hey, should we wake up the rest of the people with this?

name: SAM
dialogue: The people who've lost their city? You're going to prank them?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well, I'm feeling a bit salty this morning. (laughter) I go outside and I dump it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I cast a Create Water spell so we can all have some water.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We should probably call everyone in the town to talk.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, we should have a big meeting, let them decide what they want to do with the rest of their fucking lives.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: What did you have to drink last night?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Is there a bartender or somebody that's running the inn that everyone's staying at? Or is it kind of makeshift--

name: MATT
dialogue: It's just kind of makeshift. However, whoever who once ran this place is no longer here, probably left with the first or second wave of evacuees. Everyone here is just kind of doing their part to keep it going.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can I grab someone nearby that looks like they're up and about and actually accomplishing things?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. There's an older woman who did not drink but just was around last evening who's done most of the cleaning-- and even though there's no reason to clean, she's still just kind of going through the motions of wiping down the counters and putting things away properly.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Dear heart, um--

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Could you spread the word that there's going to be a town meeting?

name: MATT
dialogue: "A town meeting? What for?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: So we can talk about how to keep everyone safe, dear.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes. As soon as possible, can everyone meet here?

name: SAM
dialogue: No, the central--

name: LAURA
dialogue: In the center of town.

name: SAM
dialogue: Where we killed Kevdak.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Where the goliaths, where the barbarians-- sorry, Grog-- where all the mean people were.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right, I'll get the word out." And she puts away a couple of towels and grabs a couple of people near her, and the three of them saunter out into the main walkway.

name: SAM
dialogue: Also, I don't know if he remembers, but sometime in our revelry last night, I asked Kerr if he could-- I gave him a sheath, just a sheath of a sword-- and I asked him if he could make just a little-- there's some metal components to it-- I was asking him if he could just make a little secret compartment on it. Like a place that you could hide a little vial or a little powder or a little note or something, just in the side of the sheath.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: What are the odds that I would make a total hash of that? (laughter) I'm imagining I don't do that much delicate work.

name: MATT
dialogue: No. But also, how much did you drink last night?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Oh, right! Yeah, I can totally do that.

name: MATT
dialogue: So, how much-- how drunk were you?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: You know, I probably was pretty modest. I probably drank with her, to be social. And then I probably just kind of prowled and made sure nothing got out of hand and everyone was okay. Yeah, I probably-- I'll take a shot at it. How attached to this sheath are you?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (snickers)

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes. Extremely.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Extremely. (laughter) I'll see what I can do.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Just nail a sock on the side of it, it'll be great. (laughter)

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't make the best decisions.

name: MATT
dialogue: Especially while drinking. You find your way back to your forge, which is still functional. It was not one of the buildings that fell on the initial attack. You heat it up late into the evening. It doesn't require a lot because it's smaller work. Go ahead and make a blacksmithing check with your proficiency bonus. Plus, with this, it would be dexterity. Because it's very, very minute work.

name: SAM
dialogue: Could I have inspired him?

name: MATT
dialogue: You could. Yes! You can very much do that.

name: SAM
dialogue: I will give him a limerick to inspire him with.

name: MATT
dialogue: Drunken Scanlan limerick, here we go!

name: SAM
dialogue: Have you heard the legend of Shale? One eye, elderly, frail? To a black dragon, she told, "You "may be ancient, but I'm old!" And somehow lived to tell the tale. (cheering)

name: MATT
dialogue: Go and take your d10 inspiration dice, if you want to add that to the roll.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: All right. So, just proficiency bonus--

name: MATT
dialogue: Plus your dex bonus.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Yeah, my vast dex bonus. 16.

name: MATT
dialogue: 16. That's not bad. It's not the finest craftsmanship in the world, and what once was a very, very beautifully detailed sheath to a weapon now has a somewhat hammered, dented element to it that you probably want to hide with a silk or something. It's an imperfection in what was a previously a perfect element, but it is functional. It is a small compartment that actually has a tiny metal slot that can be moved closed or open with your thumb.

name: SAM
dialogue: Great!

name: MATT
dialogue: It's functional. It's not pretty, but it is functional.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: We focus on function here.

name: SAM
dialogue: I understand. Thank you for your nimble fingers. Next time, I'll ask Percy to do it. (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And it will explode.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I make a tonic out of the glissfoil that I had in my pouch from the garden back in Emon. Pass it out, a little hangover tonic.

name: MATT
dialogue: It does help, actually.

name: LAURA
dialogue: All of us?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Sweet!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Just a little crushed herbs and water, like a tea.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: A little hair of the dog, huh?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Thanks, Kiki!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are we day drinking?

name: SAM
dialogue: Also, before we go to the meeting, I haven't used it in a while but I would like to use my Scrying Potion to-- not potion! The scry that I left at our Greyskull Keep so long ago, to kind of see what's going on at Greyskull.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Your scry pie?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: Glancing at it this moment now, and it's about midday, you concentrate on what you left behind.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yep. We all know what it was.

name: MATT
dialogue: You have a brief view, a small windowed view of the kitchen before you. It seems to be currently empty.

name: SAM
dialogue: But still standing?

name: MATT
dialogue: But still standing. You do notice, in the sink there are some fresh dishes.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh! Okay.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Squatters.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's fucking squatters.

name: SAM
dialogue: Or maybe our staff.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Unpaid now, so now they're squatters.

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughs) It's an important distinction.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Can you talk through your poop?

name: SAM
dialogue: No, no. Poo doesn't work that way, Travis. It's a one-way street.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: The finer points are lost on me.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: You left it in the kitchen?

name: SAM
dialogue: I left it in a jar in the kitchen and I told the people not to open it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We only got a C on our general inspection rating. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: There's a parchment that's just nailed to the outside of the keep. At least it's good calligraphy. All right, so unless you have anything else to prepare in this time, most of the townsfolk are beginning to converge towards the square in the central-southern region of Westruun where you had the showdown battle with Kevdak outside of the Margrave's home. The now deceased Margrave. Everyone seems to have gathered together and there is an air of tension. As you approach, as folks are muttering to themselves, then it gets quiet as you all step into the central area. There is still-- it's been pulled over, it was partially damaged before, but there is a large elevated platform that was used for speeches or celebration elements that has been, for the time being, fixed to allow you guys to stand up if you wish to address the rest of the folks.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Who wants to talk? Scanlan? You're so charismatic.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: What are we going to say?

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm still reading my book. But, yes, we're just going to ask them a question.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I think we need to ask them where they want to go.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And if they ask what we think?

name: SAM
dialogue: We don't think anything. We'll support their decision, right?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think something.

name: SAM
dialogue: What do you think?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I guess I could talk to them?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I would like to build-- The death of a city is such a blasphemy. It is the murder of the dead. And I'm horrified.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Percy, a city is nothing without living people in it. A city is made up of the people that live inside of it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It is.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We have to protect them first.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Percival's suggesting letting them live here, building something for them underground--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Which we can facilitate?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Rather than running.

name: SAM
dialogue: We have a lot of other things to do-- let's talk to them.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: How about Pike talks to them?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Me?!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah! You were born here.

name: LAURA
dialogue: This is true! Pike? They know you.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: (sighs) Well, I'm not very charismatic.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'll be with you.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: But you're genuine.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Do you want to help me?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Exactly. You are genuine.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: So we're telling them-- asking them if they want to stay. And if they do stay, that we could built them shelter.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Help them take shelter in the sewers. If there's danger.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: The dragon's dead. We don't know if another one will come.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can we ask before we go up on the stage if Kerr, if you're willing to help, should they want that? Is that something you could help us with?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: I would be delighted to help facilitate things between you and the community. I know a lot of people that have left will return. I don't doubt that for a second. But right now, everyone is scattered and scared. And a lot of families have been separated. A lot of people who would love to return here and rebuild the city, they don't know where their loved ones are. And I know that is preying on their minds more than their own safety, in some cases. I know most people are looking to leave and come back eventually. And depending on the resources, like what you've generously offered from the caves-- that will keep them from being refugees. They can continue to be a community in this other town, and then return, well-organized and with resources to build it. (sighs) I don't feel they're ready to do it here and now, though. I don't feel they're excited about that. I know that so many of them have people from their lives they're just missing.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: And by the way, it's going to be a hot second before the carts come back from the cave, right?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Yeah. Probably--

name: MATT
dialogue: Another day or two before they arrive, yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can we even say that these people are in--

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: So are you thinking they won't want to stay, then?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: I know from speaking to a lot of people over the last couple of days, and even speaking to them last night, they're relieved that the dragon is gone. But they're worried about more in the future. But primarily, they're looking to be safe now, and reunite with their friends and family, and most of those people are in--?

name: MATT
dialogue: Kymal.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Kymal.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I think we give them a choice. But I think, Pike, I think it's a good idea. I think you present the idea of staying and getting word to the people in Kymal that some of their loved ones are still here, still living. The dragon is dead. Summon them back to rebuild.

name: LAURA
dialogue: How far away is Kymal?

name: SAM
dialogue: Two days' travel.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Wow. Fucking Shorthalt!

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: How do you know?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Was that in your book?

name: SAM
dialogue: My girl is there.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Your daughter's in Kymal?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes. I'll be going there anyway.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Haylie? Maylie?

name: SAM
dialogue: Kaylie.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And Kymal hasn't been hit yet?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Not yet.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Is Kymal bigger or smaller than Westruun?

name: MATT
dialogue: It's smaller than Westruun.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well--

name: LIAM
dialogue: They're better off in Westruun.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm afraid with each refugee we add to another city, we're only making it a larger target.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Which is why-- (sighs) There is no safe harbor right now.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And there's no point in rebuilding--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There is.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Why?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Because this is civilization. This is--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: There's no point in rebuilding right now when there's still three other dragons who will only come and go, 'Stomp, stomp, stomp! Dead!'

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: They might.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They might.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: They. Will.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, they might. We don't know they will.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: If you were a dragon, what would you do?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I would hit the city where all the refugees are going. Because it would hurt more. I would not hit the city that's going to take 200 years to be a shadow of its former self.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes, but you're also not a vain dragon who just had one of its allies taken out in this very city. These dragons are going to have a huge vendetta against Westruun now.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I may not have lost an ally, but I am a vain dragon.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Maybe they will, maybe they won't. How about for those who want to stay, we help build some fortifications. For those who want to leave, we'll protect them on their way there.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We're at wartime. The people can live underground. For now.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Building will give them something to do. And if the dragon comes back, they will be safe underground. And if the dragon doesn't, we have saved thousands of years of inspiration and life. It's-- you can't just abandon something like this! There's too much here.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Otherwise, what else are we fighting for?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Otherwise, it becomes our friend Pike from Nowhere.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That would be bad.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: That would be bad.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That would be terrible.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Scanlan, get their attention.

name: SAM
dialogue: Get their attention? All right.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And Pike, do you want to step up there?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Okay. I'll go, I'll go.

name: SAM
dialogue: I blow my horn to call the meeting to attention.

name: MATT
dialogue: (horn noise) Everyone gets really quiet. The two of you step up onto the platform--

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: (airhorn noises)

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughs) It gets quiet. Everyone gets quiet. You hear one voice in the back go, "That's my "Pike!" As you immediately look over, you see at the far end is Wilhand, leaping up, trying to get a view between the crowd. Everyone's quiet, looking at the two of you, now on top of this platform. Which puts you just over head height from the rest of the folks, by the way.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: (stuttering) Hello, everybody from the town.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm doing sign-language interpretation. (laughter)

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I know I'm not one usually to speak up, but because I know so many of you and some of you are family-- (blows kiss) Um, we-- I'm sure you guys have heard because of the party and festivities from last night, the dragon has been killed.

name: MATT
dialogue: There's a cheer (crowd cheers), clapping--

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: And we know that some of you have stayed because if anything else, this is your home.

name: MATT
dialogue: Some murmuring.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: And some of your family has left for Kymal?

name: SAM
dialogue: Kymal.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Kymal. But we wanted to give you all an option. And for those of you that do want to stay, we would like to provide you with an underground protection of sorts.

name: MATT
dialogue: (whispering and murmuring) Whispers through the crowds.

name: SAM
dialogue: As we speak, upwards of 40,000 gold are being delivered by your finest men. This, with our help, can help construct a sturdy underground layer that will shelter you if the dragon were to come back. It will take days, possibly weeks to construct this. But if you wanted to stay, this would be your best bet. However, we are not forcing you to do anything. If you would like to go with the fellow refugees to Kymal, or find your fellow citizens scattered about, roving in the lowlands, that would be fine too. We need to come to an agreement today, so that we can help you do what you want.

name: MATT
dialogue: One gentleman takes the stage next to you guys, man in his younger 20s, kind of soot smeared on his cheeks. Looks like he's a little weathered by the experience. Even though he looks young and thin, there is a general hardness to his face from recent experiences. He kind of raises up, looking at the both of you, below him: "I, for one, miss my family and have no home to go back to. And the the homes that are empty in this "town right now are empty because those who lived there are now dead. There are ghosts here I "wish not to see every morning when I wake up. If I'm going to live here, I want to return with "those that are important to me and build a new home, over the old. Now is not my time to stay. "Especially if more of those things are coming back. If anyone wishes to come with me to Kymal, please, "stand with me." And he steps off the stage and make his way to the right side of the stage. Everyone in the crowd looks to each other, and few folks begin filtering off and gathering around him. I'd say about a third to half of the crowd begins to shift over as another person steps up right next to you guys, actually. This is a woman in her late 40s or so. She's wearing relatively nice clothing that's been kind of torn apart through constant use and not really having an option to change into. She looks like she came from money, but has definitely been pulled down to the same level as the rest of the folks here; they're living in destitution out of necessity. Her hair's trying to be pulled up into a bun, but a lot of it is kind of falling around her face, and she's keeping this kind of poor facade of her previous life. And she stands up: "I myself, my family's history is here in this town and I would be remiss if I didn't express my "hesitation in leaving that behind, for the next roving horde of barbarians to rush in and take "from us while we're away. Especially if this gold is to be retrieved, how do we know how much of that "is to be distributed? How much was my family's versus yours? If we're to divide ourselves at this "point, we're leaving ourselves open to inner conflict, lest we have a very clear idea where "these funds are going. And I, for one, want to make sure I have a home when my family returns. So "I'm not leaving. I'm not going to come back here months down the line and find four layabouts "living in that home, made a complete mess of our things, and telling us it's now theirs. Those who "wish to stay, stand with me." (harrumphs) And she walks offstage, to the side--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm going to get up on stage.

name: SAM
dialogue: (whispers) You don't live here.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The terrible woman may have a point. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: "Thank you. What?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (sighs) Many of you are going to leave, and that's fair. And that's right, you're free to do so. I wish any of us could promise you safety once you leave this city. But there is no safety anywhere. The dragons fly freely. They may come back and wreak their vengeance upon the rest of Westruun once again. They may not. They may find new, fresh targets. We don't know. (long sigh) We will build an underground haven in case of attack, free of charge. We will make a place that is open to all. Since there seems to be some dispute about the finances, we will create a trust that will be used to help those who stay and help rebuild. It will be managed and it will be fair. And it will not go to titles. If you're properly titled, you'll have money elsewhere, and you'll figure it out. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: You hear, "Hmph!"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: New money. (laughter)

name: SAM
dialogue: Old magic!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Old magic, new money from ivory towers. I would urge you to stay. I would urge you to leave, collect your people and return. I would urge for one city not to be wiped from the map. And anything we can do to make this at least livable while it is rebuilt, we will do our best to help. (sighs) It is such a victory for them if Westruun falls. And I sit back down.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a persuasion check with advantage.

name: MATT
dialogue: There is a silence in the crowd and people have stopped shuffling from side to side. Some of the folks on the side of the gentleman began to shift back and people tend to stand up. And even the gentleman who was standing at the opposite side kind of ponders for a moment: "Well, regardless of what "happens, we have to get word out. We have to let our loved ones know what has happened, and that "it's safe to come back. If you indeed can help us set this about, I'm confident we can keep out "of sight. At least, hopefully."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I stand up on the podium. Um, sorry. While the terrible man and the terrible woman both absolutely have a point--

name: SAM
dialogue: (whispers) He's not that bad.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (whispers) I'm that bad.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I look at the man who's off to side. I agree with you that finding your loved ones is most important. I believe we can actually maybe do a little bit of both here and solve both problems. Me, alongside with the help of other magic users, can help quickly build an underground bunker. And I would be willing to help escort any party to Kymal in order to help find your people. Whereas I do agree, to an extent, with Percy that we should not let Westruun fall to this, this city is only as great as its people.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Woo! Good leadership! (laughter)

name: SAM
dialogue: That's definitely Vex.

name: MATT
dialogue: Some claps and a few folks kind of agree and nod their heads. The gentleman that you've been talking to kind of looks at you and he's very intently engaged and nodding in agreement.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Uh. To Westrunn! Huzzah!?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Huzzah!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The awkward woman makes a fine point!

name: MATT
dialogue: And the people eventually raise their arms, "To Westruun!" "To Westruun!" (laughter) The clapping comes together.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, football rules!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Pike, do you remember that spell you cast on Greyskull Keep when it got hit by the dragon? The thing you did--

name: LAURA
dialogue: That was Divine Intervention, I thought.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Was that Divine--?

name: MATT
dialogue: No, she summoned a Planar Ally. That one was--

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: To help rebuild?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That was expensive, wasn't it?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: No.

name: MATT
dialogue: That spell was expensive.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Yes!

name: LAURA
dialogue: It was, like, a thousand gold?

name: MATT
dialogue: That was Planar Ally--

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: What do you want to rebuild? I mean, underground--

name: MATT
dialogue: Depends on how long you want it to stay. So a task measured in hours requires a thousand gold per hour.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, no, no.

name: MATT
dialogue: A task measured in days requires 10,000 gold per day--

name: LAURA
dialogue: (in alarm) No, no, no!

name: MATT
dialogue: Mind you, these entities can do some crazy stuff.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah. And we have 40,000 more gold coming. That's four days of entities--

name: LAURA
dialogue: But I don't want to use up all the-- we can do that after things are--

name: SAM
dialogue: What else are we going to spend the money on?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I can try Divine Intervention again so--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We don't want to rebuild a city that's going to be stomped by dragons in another three months!

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: No, just the bunker, right?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Just the bunker--

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Not the city.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Keyleth can make the bunker.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's fine.

name: SAM
dialogue: For hundreds and hundreds of people?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Honestly, if we take a couple days, I can make a pretty extensive--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We're going to use a previously existing sewer system, and we're just going to reinforce it with pillars and then block off any of the sewage and re-route it, since it doesn't have to handle the load that it used to.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: We're going to build a vault?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We're going to build a vault.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: While they're chatting, I'll step forward and I'll say: we all have a lot to think about. Talk with your friends and neighbors and come to know your own minds. This is a decision that has to be made soon, but not on the spur of the moment. Thank you for coming.

name: MATT
dialogue: One man in the front, an old friend of yours, his name is Joseph, puts his hand up, "Kerrek! Of which mind are you? Are you staying or are you going? Are you going to escort, go along "as an escort with this woman, or are you staying to protect us? Where you walk, I walk."

name: PATRICK
dialogue: I am going to do what would be best for the town as a whole. I am not sure-- to a certain extent, I'll be led what is needed by the town. If--

name: MATT
dialogue: "What we need is a decision."

name: SAM
dialogue: If I may, If I may, I'm so sorry, I know everyone's talking here. A city is not just a collection of houses and streets. It is a person of itself. And we can't go dividing it right now. Everyone should stay here. Everyone should be a unit, a cohesive unit. And we: me, Keyleth, and one of your own, Pike, will definitely travel to Kymal to spread the word, if you give us a list of your ancestors, family members, friends, we can get word to all of them very quickly.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a persuasion check.

name: MATT
dialogue: Everyone in the crowd seems to nod, and the gentleman kind of nods his head to you, "All right." (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You're a monster.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Since you haven't been as present in the community for a while, if I am sure that things are adequately defended here, I might go myself to ensure the proper apportionment of funds and to talk to those of our townsfolk who have already left, and perhaps organize them a little more effectively so that they can return.

name: MATT
dialogue: There's a few nods of agreement that spread through the crowd, and actually, the folks on the left side, with the woman that seemed to building tension and arguing amongst themselves over the ideas of that, seem to quiet a bit at you taking up that position. You guys notice this, too; there's a general respect for Kerrek that other folks don't seem to carry in this community. Everyone nods in agreement. "Well, I have no objections!" "Neither do I." The woman on the other side. (huffs) "Well, have no other choice, do we?" Everyone nods, and they look up to the rest of you. Look to you. "Then let's begin building."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Bunker it is.

name: LIAM
dialogue: As all that starts to wind down, I ask my sister to point me towards Reginald's daughter.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Do you see her?

name: LIAM
dialogue: The one with the nice hair?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, that one. And the giant bag of gold.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I seek her out in the crowd.

name: MATT
dialogue: She's still looking up, kind of by herself in the crowd, clapping off to the side as you approach.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm going to hang near him.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Excuse me, young miss.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes? Hi."

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm sorry. We haven't spoken, but you spoke to my friends. You spoke to my sister. My sister looks very much--

name: MATT
dialogue: "I can see the similarity, yes."

name: LIAM
dialogue: I know the news they delivered to you. I am so sorry for your loss. Your father was very brave at the end. Impressively so, and I want you to know that. I've also recovered his body, and I thought to add him to the pyres that this city did outside the city, but I thought maybe you had a family plot or somewhere you'd prefer him to be laid to rest. I'll gladly take him there for you, or take him with you. Whatever you prefer.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'll come with you. I'd like to see him one last time. We have no family plot. We were meager "folk. But he spent most of his life working in that field. I think it's only fitting that's where "he spends the rest of his days. Show me." And as you guys begin the building process, she follows you out to the field where she is shown the body of Reginald, and she takes a moment of quiet with him, and cradles his body. But there's a smile on her face, and she says thank you for letting her say goodbye face to face. With your help, you both bring the body back to the farmhouse where you had first met, and you spend the rest of the day interring his body within the hillside that is buttressed against the actual farmland that he tilled.

name: LIAM
dialogue: To lose a parent before their time is no easy thing. I'm very sorry for you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's all right. He did good."

name: LIAM
dialogue: That he did.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Let's go ahead and make sure the rest of these folk have more to look forward to, shall we?" She looks at you for a second, and you can see she takes a general scope of your expression and your emotional state, and even for a young girl, she has a stronger insight than you expected, and she puts her arm out and touches your shoulder and says, "You carry too much "sadness with you. You've done a lot of good. Let yourself-- Let yourself understand and accept the "fact that you've done a lot of good." And she starts walking back towards the town.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I linger for a bit.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. Now. You guys begin the process of building this subterranean bunker. You take the first day, scanning through as a group, clearing out whatever creatures lurk beneath the city. Nothing of severe threat lies down there to your power level, and you know, what once was a threat to you guys long ago, within the period of a day, you've cleared out a very, very sizable portion of the sewer system. And because it's been empty for quite a while, it's also not in a very terrible state either. I mean, it still needs to be cleaned, but that's also the specialty of those who can control water and air, let alone reinforcing the stonework that keeps the walls themselves sturdy, strong, able to support any heavy weight on the surface. Within the next couple days, you guys continue the reinforcing process. People begin actually moving their supplies down underground and begin taking bits of furniture and elements that would at least make life down there more comfortable, or at least, a ghost image of some of the life they lived above. Because when you're down there, the comforts are what keep you going. But the people seem, as more and more of it comes together, folks genuinely begin to get a little excited at the idea of having a safe place to live for a while. And you feel like this is doing some good for these folks at the very least. Whenever you guys would like to take your journey--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I would like to do a couple things just to the room before we do anything other than this to our houses.

name: MATT
dialogue: Certainly.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I would like on one wall to carve the names of every survivor who stayed in the city. And on the other wall start--

name: SAM
dialogue: In Draconian.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: In Draconian. (laughter) Terrible person. And on the other wall, start carving in the story of--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Those we've lost? That's not what you were going to say.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: What we've done to save the city, and where the story, and where the city came from, and what has happened, and make a place where other people, they can start carving in also the history and everything they need to say about the city, just one of the giant walls, I just want to start filling in with stories of the city.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, and this catches your attention too, because as pragmatic an individual as Percy is, this is a strangely artistic endeavor of his point, at least the intent behind it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You disagree with my opinions.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I don't really agree with immortalizing ourselves in stone--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's not about us.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: --way before we're even dead--

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's not us, Keyleth. It's the history of the town. Perk up, you're driving me crazy. (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: How long do you live?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: If I complete my journey, it could be upward of a thousand years or more.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: How long do you think I live?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Less than a hundred? If you're lucky.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: How long?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (sighs) I am Percival Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No kidding.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: My ancestry dates back thousands of years and will continue for thousands more, unless Whitestone falls. I live as long as Whitestone lives. This place is the human soul. This is what we have built with our tiny moments. To lose a place like this, we don't feel it immediately, but it would ruin everyone in small ways.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Not all of us are lucky enough to have a lineage in a name.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Not all of us are lucky enough to have a lineage in a lifespan.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Not many of us are lucky enough to have a lineage at all.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Which is why we save everyone we can.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I guess that is one thing we can both agree on.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: This is good we're doing here. This is great good. And it's not about idolizing ourselves; it's about a very long story, which we are, even you, a tiny part of.

name: MATT
dialogue: At this moment, you look down and notice that, while you guys were having this talk, a small child has walked up to the wall and where Percy has stopped the carving, the child has picked up a piece of wayward chalk that was on the ground and has begun to draw little stick figures on the wall where you stopped. And in a little bit of the quiet, he stops and looks up over his shoulder at the two of you and smiles, and then just goes back to writing on the wall.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: He'll outlive you, right there.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, no, you're probably right. Look at him. I guess this little guy is like the moment encapsulated. Hey, bud.

name: LIAM
dialogue: (kid voice) That's a octopus!

name: LAURA
dialogue: (kid voice) That's a shark. This is a flower.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: (kid voice) This a bear!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I give Keyleth a little hug.

name: SAM
dialogue: Pikey-pants. Do you want to have gone to Kymal? Or do you want to have stayed and helped?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Didn't you volunteer me to help?

name: SAM
dialogue: I volunteered you to come with me to Kymal.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I'll go with you to Kymal.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'll come along to chaperone. No, I'm kidding.

name: SAM
dialogue: You can.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Oh, so these two things are happening simultaneously?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Are these two things happening simultaneously?

name: MATT
dialogue: This is up to you guys. The Kymal journey--

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's a couple days.

name: SAM
dialogue: A couple days and back.

name: MATT
dialogue: Well, not according to druidic spells.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh yeah. You could bamf us there.

name: MATT
dialogue: Which is what I assumed you were referring to about instantaneous travel.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: At some point we should put a teleport circle in this, down here.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That would probably be smart.

name: MATT
dialogue: Well, you would have to contact an arcane practitioner.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Somebody else is going to do this. We've got shit to do.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Let's bamf in.

name: SAM
dialogue: Let's go do it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So we're all going to go?

name: MATT
dialogue: If you would like to.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm going to stay and help build.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. So, Scanlan, Pike, and Keyleth, you're going with them?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I guess so. You guys are going to need me to get back.

name: SAM
dialogue: That's true.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Unless I can get you there, and then you can walk back. Fly there, walk back. Or you can--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Teleport.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Can you fly?

name: SAM
dialogue: I can fly.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I can mist form us, and then we can get there in how many hours?

name: MATT
dialogue: Mist form, you'd get there in under a day.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Teleporting is more fun.

name: MATT
dialogue: So what are you doing?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Teleport them there, and then they can get back on their own.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, we can get back on our own. It's two days.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: All right.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They just killed a dragon, they'll be fine. What's a bandit going to do?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Have fun, you gnomes! (magic crackle)

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. She finds one of the surface trees just outside of the sewage system. As she touches her hands to its bark, the bark cracks and splits open, revealing the doorway behind it, about five foot of internal wood tunnel leads to an opposing side that opens into what immediately is a tent city on the outside walls of Kymal. You guys quickly step through with the moments you have before the portal slams shut.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: High five! High five!

name: SAM
dialogue: Nope.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Asshole.

name: MATT
dialogue: You do get a little tag from Pike right before it shuts.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah! Scanlan, you suck! (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys are now standing on the outside of a small cluster of trees outside of Kymal. The mountain range behind it, you can see, there are hundreds and hundreds of people that are displaced in the outside of the city in tents.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Before-- because assuming it's been, it sounds like a couple of days, if there's walls and artistry happening, have the wagons gotten back?

name: MATT
dialogue: They have, actually, yes.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: And if there are those resources, and I know that this trip is happening, I've got to go across and make sure that my people aren't dying of dysentery.

name: SAM
dialogue: You're coming?

name: PATRICK
dialogue: Yeah.

name: SAM
dialogue: Great. (coughing) Third wheel. Trying to get some action here. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: There's a high five tag to Keyleth as Pike jumps through, and before it slams shut, Kerr goes, "Wait!" and jumps through after.

name: SAM
dialogue: No, this is great. It's great to have an old dude with us also.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I do think it's great!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Two old dudes.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: There's so much that I wanted to talk to you about, Kerr! I'm so glad that you came along!

name: SAM
dialogue: (grumbles) (laughter)

name: PATRICK
dialogue: There's important work to be done here.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: There is very important work to be done, and I feel like we all need to focus on that, and get down to the nitty-gritty of it, you know?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I think your nitty-gritty might be different from somebody else's nitty-gritty. (laughter)

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Let's go, let's walk!

name: SAM
dialogue: Let's go spread the good word about Westruun, and the great things happening in sewers there.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. You guys begin to make your way from tent to tent, finding individuals, many of which you recognize. Some have recognition of you, and there's a brief little discussion of what's happened, what's transpired, and you tell them of the fall of Umbrasyl, of the herd being sundered and sent westward, and making sure, as Scanlan would, that Vox Machina is responsible.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes. And that it rhymes.

name: MATT
dialogue: Indeed. There is no central guidance here. The Margrave Tumner Wann, who runs Kymal, does occasionally come out to check up on people. It's not like they're being kept out of the city forcefully. There's just no room for them. They've taken in as many refugees as they can, and then everyone else on the outside is being helped to the best of their ability, but they're very thin on resources. They've sent trade wagons out to Stillben, even southward, they sent some over into the Verdant Expanse to hopefully trade with Syngorn. There have been people that have been trying to help where they can. However, most of the people outside are still beginning to starve a little bit. A lot of the beasts of burden have been converted into food out of necessity, so there's a lot of empty carts and wagons around. People are in this holding pattern, waiting to hear any news. And the news that you bring does bring hope to the eyes of those that do speak with you.

name: SAM
dialogue: At some point in our journey I excuse myself for ten minutes, drink my last shit-scrying potion. Poop out a little loaf. (laughter) Take a tiny bit in it, wrap it in a little bit of parchment, stick it in the secret compartment of the hilt of the sword.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

name: SAM
dialogue: The scabbard, yeah.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You should name the sword Number Two. (laughter)

name: SAM
dialogue: I like it.

name: MATT
dialogue: The classiest of magic practitioners, Scanlan Shorthalt. You do so. Like spackling a wall, you fill the compartment affixed within the scabbard without issue.

name: SAM
dialogue: Thank you.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Shove that dingleberry in there.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Fresh blueberry sherbet.

name: MATT
dialogue: Anyway.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right, so we've spread the good word. Are people going to travel back, do you think?

name: MATT
dialogue: Many folks are now considering returning. Some folks speak of another group of people that are over by the Foramere Basin. They're going to go ahead and send people over there to give word. Some people are asking to see if their family members are okay, and you don't know everyone's name there, but you tell them there are survivors. Most of the people you talk to are intent on returning, because this living situation is only going to be so good for so long.

name: SAM
dialogue: I hope we're not sentencing them to death.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: To be fair, the town you're currently in could be gone next week.

name: SAM
dialogue: That's true.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Either way.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: I know what's needed back there. I've got access to money. They have wagons and labor. I know most of the people in town, so I'm not going to do it myself, but I know who-- honestly, anyone who runs a farm is a better organizer than any modern small business owner.

name: MATT
dialogue: This is very true.

name: PATRICK
dialogue: So I will talk to a few of these old, capable farmer types and say, okay, here's the money. You know how to bargain. Do your business, and we can get together and we'll head back all together. As soon as you can get everyone together and all that. Also, I'll put somebody in charge of making sure that we're bringing in food, and I'll do a scan around and make sure that people literally aren't dying of dysentery. That they have a clean well and all of that stuff.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. I mean, there is disease, as tends to happen when you have people who are displaced and clustered like that in sub-par living conditions, but no major pandemics that are kicking through the people there. The people who are sick are being tended to, and there are people who are medically practiced, or at least herbalists and such, that can help with that. You find a slight group of trustworthy individuals that you know would do well and understand the process, and with the mere inclusion of a few thousand gold, would be more than enough to be able to purchase from the interior of Kymal enough oxen, horses, and other beasts to bring most of the current carts back with you. That was the only real barrier, because Kymal was like, "We can't help you guys "for free." Now there's gold, people are like, "Oh! Well, let's talk." Charity only goes so far. But you do feel through this trip that you've definitely made an impact, and most of the people, at least over the next week or so, will be outfitted with the proper materials, food for the journey, and be able to make their way back towards Westruun.

name: SAM
dialogue: And I will also go to look for Dr. Dra and Kaylie at some point.

name: MATT
dialogue: Go ahead and make an investigation check.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I'll go with him.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. As you walk with him, within mere hours, almost like you picked up the scent on a hunt, you see a glimmer of short, dark hair, and you glance over, and sure enough, there is Kaylie, who is currently holding over her shoulder Dr. Dranzel, who is limping alongside her.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh God! Is he okay?

name: MATT
dialogue: You can go and ask.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'll go and ask!

name: MATT
dialogue: They're walking across the street. They haven't noticed you yet.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oi! Shorthalt!

name: MATT
dialogue: There's a stop, and Kaylie turns her head.

name: SAM
dialogue: Hi.

name: MATT
dialogue: She drops Dranzel's arm and rushes forward and gives you a hug. And then lets go after a second and pushes away. "Glad to see you survived. That's good."

name: SAM
dialogue: You, too. How's he?

name: MATT
dialogue: "He's got a foot infection, nothing too great to look about." You look down and his left foot is all swollen. He's like, "I've had worse!"

name: SAM
dialogue: Pike has healed feet before.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: May I?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Please. Be my guest." As the half-orc grins with his hat still floppy on his head, he presents his horrible foot that gives off a delightful smell of putrescence.

name: SAM
dialogue: While she works on him, I'm going to take Kaylie off to the side.

name: MATT
dialogue: It's easy enough for you to cleanse elements of disease with minor healing. We'll say for the purposes of this, through a couple of low-level spells you're able to pretty much take care of his foot entirely. He's like, "That's incredible! I mean, if you ever need a traveling troupe, we're "always looking for someone to keep us on the up and up! Can you cure hangovers?"

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I can.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, hang with me, young Pike!" While this is happening, you turn to Kaylie.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm so happy that you are alive and safe, and I came a great distance to do other things, but mainly to see you, and I just wanted to say a few things before I go off to complete my mission. You know, I know I'm not the father that you wanted, but I'm the father that you have, and I'm sorry. I just wanted to tell you that I've been doing a lot of thinking about you, and me, and where I fit in to the life of a family man. Most of my adult life, I've been longing for a gnome to care for, and I met a really good one, and she's here and her name is Pike. And she's beautiful and wonderful, and possibly my soulmate, but I've learned that she's not my family and never will be. You're the gnome that I'm to care for forever, and I'm doing something very stupid now with my friends. We're going to try to save the world. And I didn't know why, but now I know, and if we die doing it, it will be for a good thing, and if we don't, then, well, I'll find you, and I'll be whatever kind of father you need me to be. One who's close and helpful.

name: MATT
dialogue: She shushes you. Puts her finger up and shushes you, then steps up and looks at you. The hardness in her face softens, and there is a little bit of tears gathering at the edge of her eyes when she says, "Don't you die. You stay alive."

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't intend to. But you know, I was just inside a--

name: MATT
dialogue: "You're. Not. Going. To die. You're going to go do your stupid world-saving mission like you "told me, and you're going to come back, and we're going to have a lot to talk about."

name: SAM
dialogue: All right.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right. Can you do that for me?"

name: SAM
dialogue: I promise you. I promise you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'll hold you to that."

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, you do the same, all right? Stay safe. I got you a present. It's a ring. It's a beautiful ring because you're a beautiful girl, and I'd like you to keep it.

name: MATT
dialogue: She takes it and looks at it and goes, "Are you sure this wasn't for someone else?"

name: SAM
dialogue: No. Never.

name: MATT
dialogue: She puts it on.

name: SAM
dialogue: And you're also strong, and you'll need this sword. And I give her my Singing Dawn Blade, which has a unique little imperfection at the bottom of it, and I say, this sword has killed a king, which makes it almost worthy enough for you. I hope that it keeps you safe until I can see you again.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't know what to say. I'll start with thank you. Well, I feel pretty well protected."

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay. Get out of here. If you can, try to make your way to Vasselheim. There's three more dragons, and it'll be a while before I kill them all.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't know, you've done quite a bit of work in even these past few weeks. Vasselheim. "I'll talk it over with the doctor. See what he's interested in. You promised."

name: SAM
dialogue: Gnome's honor.

name: MATT
dialogue: She reaches up and grabs your shirt and gives you a kiss on the forehead. And then pushes you away and says, "Get out of my fucking face." Turns around and walks back towards Dr. Dranzel.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right, Pike, I'm done.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Okay!

name: MATT
dialogue: "But she's not done! You're sticking with us, right?"

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I don't think I can.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh, I know. I'm just-- I try."

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: But you guys are headed to-- Where are you headed to? Where are you going to go?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't know! I figure we can-- based on what we're hearing around here, folks are heading "back to Westruun. They probably need some cheering up on the road. From there, who knows? Actually, "I've never been to Marquet before, but I'm thinking--" At this point, Kaylie comes up and goes, "Let's have a talk. I'm feeling a bit of religion coming on. Perhaps we should look further "west. Northwest. Vasselheim. Not a lot of music in those parts. They'll be willing to pay for that, I "assume." He's like, "Vasselheim? It's cold there, isn't it? Let's get some furs." They both start walking away from you guys.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Before they go, I just reach out my hand and introduce myself to Kaylie. I've heard many lovely things about you.

name: MATT
dialogue: She looks at you guardedly and takes your hand. "As I've heard of you. He made a promise."

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I'll make sure that he keeps it.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Thank you." They keep walking. So, with the money dispersed, the group having a returning sense of hope, with materials, goods, food being redistributed amongst the refugees, it appears there is a direction for the future of Westruun that you've set into place. As you guys gather the rest of your things, Keyleth, you take an evening's rest with the troupe, and the next morning return back to Westruun.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Something I wanted to do last night. In all the hubbub that's going on in Westruun, I spend some time to find my sister, and I wanted to stealth up on her.

name: MATT
dialogue: Easy enough to do while they're out and about taking their rest with the group in Kymal, while you guys are still helping rebuilding. So yes, go ahead and make a stealth check.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm just reading these names on this wall!

name: MATT
dialogue: What's your passive perception?

name: SAM
