dialogue: Too good.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I feel like you<U+0092>re just on a higher level.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Right?

name: LAURA
dialogue: So much. I just thought you were going to make him not there so you didn't have to do it.

name: MATT
dialogue: No no no.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, yeah yeah. He's just not home. Sorry, guys.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Oh, I love him.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Victor's on vacation.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: So, I'm going to go see if there's-- if there's not a blacksmithing, if there's not somewhere I can do a bit of basic smithing work and technical work, then I'm going to go find that blacksmith from last time.

name: MATT
dialogue: There's basic materials to do essentially weapon repairs, armor repairs, minor armor construction within the Slayer's Take. If you want something that's going to be a little more to the level of what you're doing, you may have to actually rent out a facility.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, I'm going to go find that young chap from before.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Yeah, easy enough to do. If you want to rent the forge for the day to craft whatever it is you're looking to craft, he's charging you 50 gold for the day.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: 50 gold for the day? Can I use all of his tools and just my own materials?

name: MATT
dialogue: You have to supply your own material, but he'll let you rent.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm going to run and find Vax, get my stuff, and go to work.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. You guys. You four make your way over towards the Duskmeadow.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Trinket's out.

name: MATT
dialogue: Trinket's out? (whoosh) (bear moans)

name: LAURA
dialogue: Come on, Trinket.

name: MATT
dialogue: (grunts) He rolls his head against you, licks the side of your face, happy to be out of that stuffy little necklace. You make your way towards the Duskmeadow, which you've seen before. It's a very comparatively... glum-looking area of the town, hence the name that accompanies it, but this is the area of the city that contains the Raven's Crest, the Amaranthine Oubliette. It also contains the entire town's catacombs. This is where, since this town's existence, all of the dead are interred perpetually deeper and deeper and deeper beneath this part of the city. Also one of the oldest libraries of the city is kept here as well. As you approach the outskirts-- and you can see a very fine line between this area and the Birth Heart, which is the Melora section of the city. There is a very, very wide river divide between the two of them and it's like night and day, back and back. Very, very, very directly between the two of them. You can see on Melora's side there's just stalks and stalks of corn and other vegetation that's being grown for food. There's almost like a lush forest that curls around the outside of it that doesn't match the rest of the indigenous trees you've seen in this area of Othanzia. The entire Birth Heart area, where this temple to Melora is, is just this plucked-out-of-nowhere section placed into it. And then you move over to the Duskmeadow and it's just... like the color has left the vicinity. And there you see in the center of this part of the town, this large, looming, ominous obsidian and gold structure. It's like a giant black stone aerie. It has no intricacies from this distance that you can see. It's almost like a giant square building that is just devoid of light, with little glimmers of gold when the light catches it at moments. It's hard to miss and definitely stands as a centerpiece to this section of Vasselheim.

name: LIAM
dialogue: The whole walk over, I've been talking a lot, mostly to Trinket. You know, scratching him behind the ears, saying, "Buddy, you've been trapped in there a while. "It's good to see you out."

name: MATT
dialogue: "(moans, snuffles)"

name: LIAM
dialogue: Come hug your uncle. Come.

name: LAURA
dialogue: He doesn't mind it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm sure he doesn't. I'm just happy to see him.

name: MATT
dialogue: He presses his nose under yours and lifts your chin up and you bite your lip a little from the sudden impact from this very large bear, but it's all with love.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah. It's cold. You're sure you don't want to go back in? Nah, you don't want to go back in. I know.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (whispering) Hey, Pike.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Just nervous talking the whole way there.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (whispering) I think Vax is talking to himself.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: (whispering) He's very nervous right now. This is a big deal.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: This temple is very... it's lovely.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's gorgeous. It's very intimidating. Do you know anything about this? You've lived here for a while, Pike.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I've never been by.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Never been in?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I've never been in, no.

name: MATT
dialogue: You do know from your time here and what little you've heard that part of the purpose of this vicinity is not just to inter the dead within part of these catacombs. The library here is kind of a loose partnership between the people worshipers of her and those who follow Ioun. It is a center for knowledge and history kept within the city. But you'll see throughout the town and the landscaped outer wall that surrounds this entire portion of Vasselheim, there are repetitive glyphs that line this entire area. And from what you've heard, at the very least, most of these glyphs, which you see across the corners of roadways, and many of which surround the entrance to the catacombs, it is a perpetual enchantment that is to seal any sort of possible undeath. There once was a terrible scourge of undeath in this part of the landscape, long ago, that corresponded with a battle hundreds of years ago, and since then, the reinforcement has been put in place to prevent that from happening again. So the downside is that the power of these glyphs that prevent undeath also prevent any actual vegetation from existing in this area as well. So all the ground that you've come across: no grass, no natural vegetation. It's just dirt and ash and dust.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can we recognize the language in which the runes come from?

name: MATT
dialogue: The magic itself is divine in nature, but it's based in the same very, very base Draconic glyphs that a lot of arcane magic is based on. It's very-- it's old magic.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: (laughs) It's old.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. It's based in some sort of divine ritual.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What did you say the name was of the Raven Queen's temple, again?

name: MATT
dialogue: The temple itself is referred to as Raven's Crest.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Raven's Crest?

name: MATT
dialogue: Raven's Crest, yes.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: How are you feeling, Vax?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm all right. I'm just going to talk to my sister for a minute.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Okay.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You know, I know you want to-- I know you. I know you want to be here.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I know you don't want me to come.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I don't. I really don't.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I know. And I won't, if you're sure. I put you in this place and I feel terrible about it and I know you're extremely nervous. Trinket can sense it, too. He's very in tune with those emotions. And I just--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Listen to me. You did not put me in this place. No one put me in this place. And everything's going to be fine.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Everything will be fine!

name: LIAM
dialogue: And I tug her sleeves and make them a little more orderly and I move a bit of hair out of her face and I do a button that's not done.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (laughs)

name: LIAM
dialogue: Everything's going to be fine.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I wanted it unbuttoned, actually.

name: LIAM
dialogue: That's all right. Just wait here I'll be out in a bit, all right?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Everything's fine.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I know. Everything's fine.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You don't need to be nervous, either.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm not.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I will be here waiting for you when you come out.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I know. I'll see you--

name: LAURA
dialogue: I love you.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You know I love you, too.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm proud of you, you know. She's just going to love you so much. And who knows, you might have a new girlfriend when you come out. (laughs nervously, sighs) I've heard other people have dated gods before. I've heard it's done. That Cashew guy. Anyway.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You're going to wait here for me, right?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'll be right here.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And then I drop the smile as I walk off towards the other two.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Which, as you turn and look, when you originally approached the stairs that lead up to the entrance of this large structure, it was just empty, doors closed. There was no guard post on the outside. It was just these two looming, almost dark glass-type doors about 12 feet tall and about 8 feet wide on each side that are just locked shut. As soon as you turn to walk towards them, the doors open and you see a figure standing there at the door, just looking directly at you. Or at least you assume is looking right at you. It's hard to see. This individual, somewhat lithe in physicality, is wearing long, dark robes and their face is shrouded in opaque black cloth, like a death shroud that just blocks the entire face. You can see the hint of a jawline, a nose. It looks to be a person of some background in there, but they're just standing there, watching you. And as soon as you react to their appearance, the hand just beckons quietly.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Were you expecting me? All right. I've brought a couple of friends. Is that permissible here? They'll keep quiet.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I turn to Vex.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Keep him safe.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I swear to you. We're all coming out of here alive.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I know.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But if like an hour passes and we don't, maybe come in? But we're all coming out of here alive, so don't worry about it. It's fine.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: And I squeeze her hand. I'll make sure he gets out okay. I promise.

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Okay. Please be safe.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It'll be fine.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: It'll be fine. Yes.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'll just be right here. Waiting here with Trinket.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Okay.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Just calmly leaning against a wall. No big deal.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Okay.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We've faced way more terrifying things than a few albeit creepy men in robes.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I don't even think she's that bad. She's not going to be bad.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Guys.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Just go.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Okay. We'll go. We'll go in with you.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. As you step up to the stairs, the figure leads you all inside, and as you step into the main center of this initial walkway chamber, the figure doesn't enter with you. It just closes the door behind you. (echoing thud) You can feel the hint of vibration of impact as the doors close shut.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's dark?

name: MATT
dialogue: It's lowly-lit on the inside, and it's interesting. From the outside, it looks like a black, solid, impossible-to-see-through building. From the inside, you can actually look out and the entire building is made of this glass, this somewhat-warped, dark glass. And you can see almost the entirety of the outside from your position. The doors are held aloft into it. It's like a one-way type enchantment, or the construct, the material itself, is somewhat translucent from this side.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Like an interrogation room? Like one-way mirror type of thing?

name: MATT
dialogue: Kind of. Or like a very, very dark pair of sunglasses, but made of naturally-formed rock, almost.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Noticing that, I turn and just sort of look at my sister for 5 or 10 more seconds.

name: MATT
dialogue: She doesn't see you and she just stands there quietly, looking around, inspecting the vicinity. Pets Trinket a little.

name: LIAM
dialogue: (hesitantly) Let's do this.

name: SAM
dialogue: (chuckles)

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Do I feel anything, being in here?

name: MATT
dialogue: You just feel a natural tremble stepping into a place of powerful divine influence that is not the warm comfort of Sarenrae, which has protected you before. Now, you understand the way many deities work in these lands, and your place in it, and Sarenrae's place in it, and you know enough about the Raven Queen to know that this is not an unwelcome place, per se. Go ahead and roll a religion check.

name: MATT
dialogue: 23. You understand the Raven Queen has also not always been the one who holds sway over the domain of death, the domain of winter, the domain of fate. Once mortal, the Raven Queen ascended as, essentially, a follower and a partner to the previous god of death, which his name has been erased from the books. This mortal ascended many, many years ago, pre-Second Spark, and has since taken what was once a tyrannical position of death and afterlife and souls and took it instead as the natural transition that it is. However, due to a lack of respect, or at least, a lack of, for lack of a better term, belief or trust from the other gods, she only gained dominion over the actual moment of transition, not of the actual souls of the afterlife. That influence was given to others. But the Raven Queen represents one of the most feared elements of life, which is the end of it, but you also know that that is a natural thing. Your personal belief is up to you. The sense you get here is that... being an individual that worships life, that worships redemption, that worships second chances, you can't help but swallow a little hard at the idea of a god that's purpose is to make sure that if you're destined to have once chance, it stays one chance.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you begin to walk down this hall, ever so slow as it is, each footfall deafening in the clack. (clicking footsteps) The hallway leads on for another hundred feet or so before the glass, somewhat translucent material shifts into the next chamber, into an almost deep gray and ivory ice-like interior. The dark, coal-black exterior you've seen now transitions into what feels like a very finely-carved piece of architecture from ice and bone.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do I get the sense as a druid, as an Ashari, that we've switched into another plane?

name: MATT
dialogue: Go ahead and roll an arcana check, as this is not so much a nature-based thing, yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh! I rolled a 19. (laughs) 21.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Oh dear, oh my.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh gosh, oh jeez.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh goodness gracious.

name: MATT
dialogue: From your understanding of transitional magic between planes, there has been no actual shift between planes, it's just the material itself is different upon the interior of this building. As soon as you enter this place, you do see another figure walking towards you. Similar long, dark robes. However, the veil has been pulled back, and you see before you what looks to be an older elven woman with very, very bright silver hair that just kind of falls long, past her shoulders, down to her back about mid-waist, or down to the bottom of her waist. With a smile. You can see as she walks towards you, a very welcoming grin. As she approaches, she pays very little mind to you three, but directly to you, says,

name: LAURA
dialogue: (whispers) I'm not there.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You walk with Her sight on you. "You are ever welcome here."

name: LIAM
dialogue: I've come to understand my place in Her sight.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Then I think, perhaps, you are here for communion. "Come. Our most sacred chamber. The communion pool awaits. "Only you may have entry, unfortunately."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Right. I plant a kiss on the cheek of each of the women.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do you need anything before you go in? Any enhancement of any kind?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Just cross your fingers for me, okay?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay. I just kind of squeeze his hand.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Same. Be careful.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We're right out here on the other side of this door. If anything terrible happens, you have the earpiece. No one will stop Pike and I from getting through there if something terrible goes wrong. Rules be damned.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I made my bed. Now I gotta lie in it. I'll see you soon. I follow.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Come, champion. The Lady of Fates awaits." And she turns around and leads you 30 more feet to what looks to be an ascending staircase that just enters up and out of the sight of you two.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: We'll just hang out, yeah?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I guess we'll wait, yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: You ascend a few feet behind her, about 40 or so feet, until it comes to a single large doorway of deep, deep dark oak wood with what looks to be a dark iron ring in the center. As she steps up to it, she takes it and (thud) knocks on it twice. (deep creak) It just shifts open and leads into a central chamber now that looks about a hundred feet high, and it is a large steepled dome of what looks to be nothing but stained glass. It's awe-inspiring. It's beautiful: the colors, the light as it peeks through. The source of light, diffused as it is by the clouds, is sourceless in here. It seems like there are beams of light coming from all directions and all the colors are just strewn across the floor in what looks like this perpetually-shifting kaleidoscope of dots of reds and blues and purples and yellows and pinks and whites. You can see, across the room, there are three other figures that are all dressed in the same dark robes, the veils over their heads, of varying size. You can't make out what their racial background is, per se, but they are all stationed around the center of the room, in which lies, from what you can see, a very, very large round pool of some sort of deep crimson liquid.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I have come to pay a debt, and I do so gladly and without question. What would you have of me?

name: MATT
dialogue: "You came to speak with the Lady. "Well, the way is before you." She gestures to the pool.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I walk slow and straight in.

name: MATT
dialogue: You step into it. (squelch) It comes up to your ankles, to your knees. And what catches you first is that the liquid is very thick. It is viscous in a familiar way. This is most definitively a pool of blood. And it is cold. It is ice-cold. As you step in, you can feel that as it begins to seep into your boots and begins to find its way into the crevices of your outfit as you get down into your waist, it's just chilling. You can't help but to stand up straight as you step further in, not quite sure of how deep it gets. And it gets deeper. And deeper. Up past your chest, up past your shoulders, and you're not even halfway into the center of the pool before it's going past your nose.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I keep going.

name: MATT
dialogue: You take your last breath, hold it, and submerge yourself in the pool. Darkness around you, the cold sensation. Nothing... Nothing... Nothing...

name: LIAM
dialogue: I open my mouth and inhale.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you do, you feel the blood fill your lungs and immediately your lungs begin to seize with the lack of oxygen. You instinctually begin to reach up for the water and pull, but you can't rise. You can't get up. And at that point, the cold, piercing pain of the liquid in your lungs becomes warm. All the liquid around you becomes warm. And in the darkness, where you cannot see, you calm, as suddenly your breathing is no longer difficult. It's natural. It's like air. And it's reminiscent of being in the womb, of the moment of birth you'd forgotten so long ago, that you're just surrounded in darkness and comfort. And piercing the center of this darkness before you, you see a very faint bead of white light just begin to spark and grow, and grow, and as that light widens out, it becomes a face. A porcelain face. A nose, lips, a chin, empty dark sockets, long dark hair that goes to crimson and surrounds you. You see a small hand reach up behind and lift you from your legs. And for what you thought was only a few feet of liquid, you look around you and it is an endless space, a space you've been before, a space that you once visited in your sleep, in your dreams. You look down below and you can see the infinite skein of threads that you were once given inspection to. As you look down, you see the very palm of the Raven Queen holding you aloft in this space as the mask pulls in close to you with a smile. The lips don't move, but you hear a voice from all directions in your head. A comforting voice. A welcoming voice. "My champion. "Vax'ildan. You've come to me at last."

name: LIAM
dialogue: This was always supposed to happen, wasn't it?

name: MATT
dialogue: "There is destiny, "but you still guide your path where it must go. "Especially you, fate-touched. "You're one of the few that bends threads near and around you. "That's why you're so interesting to me."

name: LIAM
dialogue: (haltingly) I give myself willingly to you for the bargain that was struck, although I question if the bargain was just the surface reason for this to happen.

name: MATT
dialogue: "When one such as your... "unique essence walks these realms, "do not think I am the only one to take interest. "And do not think you are the only one, either. "But I was there to seize the opportunity when it arose, "and as such, you are now mine. "And I know that you hate me. I know that you fear me. "Most do. "But only because they are without understanding. "Without death, life has no meaning. "Finality drives change, "innovation, "greatness. "It is the end that I bring "that drives all of your gracious creations of this land "to make the world better than we did, than those before me did."

name: LIAM
dialogue: I would learn your ways. I will learn your purpose. And I will serve.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Then understand the wholeness of what it is you serve "and what you represent, champion. "Even after death, the soul is carried to another purpose, "but it is that transition where it is at its most vulnerable. "It is my charge, my gift-- your gift, now-- "to safeguard that beautiful moment. "There are those that find the immortal soul "one of the most pure and powerful means "of energy, of sourced power, in this world. "That is an abomination. "There are those that wish to halt the process "and live eternally in some form of undeath or the other. "That is an abomination. "There is also a difference "between bending your thread around destiny, fate-touched, "and perverting the thread entirely, "for death is sacred. "But not all deaths are destined, in that moment. "Some destinies require one to endure beyond the moment. "To meet that moment many times before the final death is to come. "We must guide these moments across this web." And as she sweeps her hand out. Where she holds you in one palm, another hand reaches out, and the entire web of threads just glows below you in this curling wave out into infinity, into the horizons, endless, to each side of you and beyond. "So, to bend destiny, to bend these fates, "is within our sphere of influence. "It's those that find a way to cheat this destiny, "halt the progression, "corrupt their thread to the point it sickens those around them. "Undeath, wayward necromancy. "Perversion of the sanctity of the cycle, "of our very domain, is an atrocity "and must be stopped and stamped out. "That is our cause. "Your cause, now. "Do you still accept this gift?"

name: LIAM
dialogue: (whispering) I do.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You, Vax'ildan. I've had my eye on you for some time." And the smile curls into this much wider smile. To the point it seems somewhat perturbing. "Your dual nature: rushing prematurely towards your end, "wantonly throwing your life before the flames, "only to pull away in those last moments. "Instinct. "You test your path constantly, without knowing "you've been preparing for this mantle your entire life. "My beautiful champion." The smile subsides. The face goes stone. Lack of expression. Blank. The hand pulls back and you now can see the full immensity of her size. Her body infinitely long, looking down before it disappears into darkness. And as you look up, suddenly the mask is there before you, but normal, human-sized. You're no longer in her hand. You're standing on a floor, a floor of the same white, ice-bone type substance that the interior of Raven's Crest seems to be built from. And for a brief moment, you see before you the woman before the god, the ascended mortal, no larger than you. From the hair that topples down the sides, the hand reaches up and grabs the mask and pulls it away. Beneath the mask you see a very beautiful, very sad-looking woman. But her eyes are cold and red in the iris. Her skin flawless and smooth. White, pale, sunless. Her brows thinned and furrowed. She steps forward and touches the side of your face. "There are those who will be frightened of you. "But know what we do "is one of the most important gifts of all." And she grabs your head, pulls you down, and kisses you on the forehead. At which point, suddenly your lungs fill once again with searing white pain. You find yourself scrambling about, instinctually spilling out liquid all around you, and you finally (coughs) come out on top of the communion pool. Your eyes open and you can see just red crimson pouring in your vision. You rub it out and you're in the chamber alone. Eyes wide, swimming around, you can see the figures on the side come to the edges. They all bow. The figure that led you in stands at the mouth of this pool where you entered. She's smiling. She has her hand extended.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I take it.

name: MATT
dialogue: She lifts you out of the pool. One of the other figures runs up and takes one of the dark robes that they have and pulls it off around them, revealing just a simple dark blue and black outfit beneath. Still wearing the veil, but wraps the dark robe around you as the liquid is now back to its freezing cold sensation. Your teeth are chattering. They lead you back to the door you entered, down the stairs, and into the central chamber where both Keyleth and Pike await. You guys turn and see, descending the stairs, being flanked, essentially, by two of the members of the Raven's Crest, both of the shoulders with the dark robe wrapped around a very cold and somewhat freaked-out looking Vax'ildan, who has smeared red across his face. His hair is thick with viscous crimson liquid.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I run over. You okay?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I stand at the bottom of the stairs and I watch.

name: LIAM
dialogue: (hoarsely) I got answers in there, but they led to more questions. What am I to do with those questions?

name: MATT
dialogue: The woman who had led you in there smiles and says, "That is the nature of death. "We can't have all the answers, my friend. "It is the pursuit of those answers that drives us. "Do you trust Her?"

name: LIAM
dialogue: I do.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Then perhaps you'll find those answers one day."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Thank you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Thank you." They pull the robe off and they all head back up into the chamber, leaving you all there in the room alone.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I walk over.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: (whispering) I'm just going to stay where he is.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm shell-shocked.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You look well.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's going to be good.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What did she say to you? Did she speak to you at all?

name: LIAM
dialogue: (whispering) Yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (shocked laugh)

name: LIAM
dialogue: Do you speak?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Yes?

name: LIAM
dialogue: To her?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Sometimes.

name: LIAM

dialogue: "It doesn't sound very fun, no."

dialogue: "The Shademirk Bog."

dialogue: Ugh, it sounds awful.

"If they are brought beyond the plane themselves, "they generally shatter, "and the few that can be brought across temporarily, "the magics that contain them do weaken, "and those that attempted to harness their power "leave it to ruin, destroying all around them "before it whirls itself into a frenzy "of uncontrollable arcane mass and destroys everything nearby. "These were many of the fools "who ushered in the beginning of the Second War. "So. Essentially, we convinced Thordak "to find one of these in the plane "and convinced him that he had the power to contain it. "Once there, all of our forces gathered "and we attacked him, pressed him down, "and the gem that we had convinced him-- "the heart-stone that we had convinced him "to take into himself, "well, we found a way to seal it, "to banish it permanently to that plane so that he could not escape."

dialogue: (whispering) Fuck.

dialogue: "There's a few things in that there dreary elvish city that I haven't the skills to procure, "but if you wouldn't mind maybe borrowing them for me in my stead, well, we've a done deal."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Borrowing them indefinitely.

name: LIAM
dialogue: What are we discussing, exactly?

name: SAM
dialogue: Quid pro quo?

name: MATT
dialogue: "If you will."

name: LAURA
dialogue: I've got no problem stealing from any of those people.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes, but the devil's in the details. What are we after? Tell me a little bit more.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We make the agreement first."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Say again?

name: MATT
dialogue: "We make the agreement first. Consider it a bit of trust!"

name: LIAM
dialogue: Balls is what that is.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Let us add an addendum, then. If we are going to steal things from you, you will not only take us to the bog--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But you'll take us to our final destination.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Nope, no. No Shademirk. I'm out. Sorry."

name: SAM
dialogue: Or we could kill you here.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Are we killing people?

name: SAM
dialogue: We could kill him.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Do I get to grab him again?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Remember, you have to be nice to things in the Feywild. This is what we've learned.

name: SAM
dialogue: We have a powerful position in negotiation. I'm a master negotiator.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What is he doing?

name: SAM
dialogue: Who's getting whispered to? Percy? Percy goes blind again. Every five minutes.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: This is interesting. 17.

name: SAM
dialogue: A roll and a re-whisper.

name: LAURA
dialogue: The Feywild. Slippery. Sneaky.

name: SAM
dialogue: This is crazy.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Interesting.

name: SAM
dialogue: He just said the C-word, the F-word, the G-word!

name: MATT
dialogue: "If it's that important to you to go to this dark place, then keep the book, all right? I can "draw more."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I've got an idea. We broke your ocarina, correct?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Why don't I try and fix the ocarina? We give him his book back, we take a couple things from those people and get on our way? We could just get on our way.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Not have him at all?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, let's make the deal and get this moving. This is a place where deals happen. Let's do it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: But you're usually so picky about details. What if he asks us to steal somebody?

name: LIAM
dialogue: We're talking about a pantsless cartoonist in the middle of fairy land.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We agree to the deal, we present it, and then we're there.

name: LAURA
dialogue: If we can't steal the things, then the deal is off.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's that simple. We both go our separate ways, and good luck finding the Shademirk on your own."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's kismet, in my opinion.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, I trust you, Percy, if you think it's smart.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Can I insight check Percy? Because he's acting a little strange.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Same.

name: MATT
dialogue: You can make an insight check, but he's not acting too far out of his normal place here.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, but I've done insight checks before because he's Percy.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Did you do it?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Yeah, but I didn't get anything.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I got a 15. Balls.

name: MATT
dialogue: It's an interestingly tense conversation. It's hard to ride one way or the other, but it's a valid point. If worse comes to worst, and what he's asking for is beyond your grasp or something that you wish not to do, then the deal is off and you go your separate ways.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We're in the Feywild. We're going to make a deal with something. This is what the Feywild is.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: All right. Fine.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I turn to Vex. You like this idea? You want to do this?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I have no love for that city. I don't care.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I want to go there, too.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: The people we're stealing from better be meanies, though, and they better have deserved it at some point.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Ultimately, I would love to ask them to help us in our fight. They're cowardly and stupid for hiding, but we could use their help if they're making an army.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Possibly better equipped and better educated, sorry, than this one here.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, Garmelie also said they were strengthening up an army. Did they ever have a standing army before?

name: MATT
dialogue: They did.

name: LAURA
dialogue: They did? Of course they did. They're a city.

name: MATT
dialogue: It wasn't a huge army, per se, but they had trained forces, and they had a means of defending their city.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We had a fight instructor when we were growing up.

name: LIAM
dialogue: They're elves. They're very civilized. They've all got sticks up their asses. They're fucking elves.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I can't wait.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I like this one."

name: SAM
dialogue: Are you going to fix his what-is-it-called?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Give me your ocarina. Let me see if I can get to work on it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I can help Percy.

name: SAM
dialogue: I will inspire Percy by singing. (singing) Go ahead, Percy, and fix his ocarina! Take your tinkering tools and fix his ocarina! You go, Percival, you can fix his ocarina!

name: ALL
dialogue: Hey, ocarina!

name: MATT
dialogue: Take your d10.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can I help with a Mending spell?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You can help with a Mending spell.

name: MATT
dialogue: Mending spell? Do you have the cantrip? Mending is a cantrip.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I thought she used it once before on something.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I thought I used it as a ritual spell before.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You fixed that little Sarenrae doll.

name: MATT
dialogue: Right. So you have the spell, correct?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I thought I learned it. I don't know.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Oh jeez, here comes the internet.

name: MATT
dialogue: Cantrips you have at all times.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can I use it as a 1st-level spell?

name: MATT
dialogue: What cantrips do you know?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Guidance, Druidcraft. I used Druidcraft before, for the wooden thing. Can I use Druidcraft to help this?

name: MATT
dialogue: How would you use Druidcraft?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What's it made out of? Is it made out of wood?

name: MATT
dialogue: Actually, it's made out of clay, yeah.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: So I'm going to attempt to glue it together, and then I'm going to need something to hold the whole thing together while the glue sets.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Using what materials are within the workshop that you had before, there is a very mild adhesive paste that you construct. Go ahead and make a tinkering roll. This will be with your intelligence modifier.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That was a natural 20.

name: MATT
dialogue: Very rapidly, with the things that are given at your disposal, not even needing the materials here, but what you have on you as part of your traveling tinkering kit, you piece together a nearly unnoticeable binding agent for clay and dirt and earth-based materials. You manage to fix the ocarina rather quickly, in a period of maybe 20 minutes, and with the help of Keyleth's Druidcraft, dry it and manage to get it fixed.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Your instrument, sir.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Thank you. That's one good deed you've done me today. I appreciate that."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Don't forget about all them ales, yeah?

name: MATT
dialogue: (whistles) It's awful. He doesn't really know how to play, and it's like (off-key singing).

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's quite nice.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: At least you can always draw.

name: MATT
dialogue: "If I can find my quill."

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm sorry. I said I'm sorry. I looked for 20 fucking minutes. I looked, all right?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I'm sure we could find you a quill.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I've got one right fucking here. I pull the black feather out from behind my ear and hold it up. This is a very fine feather to sweeten the deal. Don't fuck us over. And I slide it into the book.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Don't give him that, Vax. It's too nice!

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, it is really nice! I know you're acting like he's lying, but he's telling the fucking truth.

name: SAM
dialogue: Good lie, Grog.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We've really been burned. I am really going to punch you in the back of the head if you fuck us over. Do you understand me? I don't like you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I like you! Well. Are we at an agreement?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Sure, why not. Me?

name: SAM
dialogue: Who's he shaking?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Whoever your leader is! Shake my hand."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Here, give me your fucking hand, you dirty bastard.

name: MATT
dialogue: Before you got your hand there, Vax, Vex put her hand in, and both of you guys clasp both sides of his hand at the same time. A trio handshake.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm pretty sure he was talking to me.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm pretty sure he was talking to me, actually.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right, so you guys shake hands with him. You feel this shiver on your back as you shake hands, and he smiles. "Very well. Now, we've properly gotten acquainted. My sharper "introductions are in order." He stands up and wobbles for a second, a little drunk on the ale. "My name is Garmelie. I am a simple joy finder of the ever-shifting grasses, and I am happy to be your guide for the remainder of this journey to the outskirts of the Shademirk, and no further. "Three things you wish you avoid as you progress further. As we are traveling through the "Moonbrush, alongside the Green Sea-- we could take one or the other, your choice. Eventually finding "our way to the Gilded Run, and from there on to the Shademirk itself. I'll be leaving you at the "outskirts of the Gilded Run, but it should suffice for the journey you wish to have ahead. "Things you wish to avoid. One, the Hut of Wodenna. She's a terrible woman. You see a hut, don't go. You may smell enticing things."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Odenna?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Wodenna. Delightful smells, sounds of soft music, a gentle light across the shade and sea. "Two words at once. I'm drunk. But do not go near the hut. Avoid the hut. No hut! "Two. Avoid the Last Campsite of Sorudun the Happy."

name: SAM
dialogue: Sounds nice.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, that sounds fun.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Avoid it. Trust me, avoid it. If there's a campsite that's empty, looks happy? Avoid it. And "three, avoid the theater."

name: SAM
dialogue: I love the theater!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Oh, that's good advice, actually.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Avoid the theater."

name: SAM
dialogue: Just in general, the theater?

name: MATT
dialogue: "In general. I hate all theater. Let's avoid the theater, please!"

name: SAM
dialogue: I do an insight check.

name: MATT
dialogue: Do it.

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't know what I have. Terrible. 13.

name: MATT
dialogue: He seems pretty perturbed by the idea of theater.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm changing my mind on this guy.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Why should we avoid the hut? What does Wodenna do?

name: MATT
dialogue: "She's been around a while."

name: LAURA
dialogue: She's a hag? Is she a hag?

name: MATT
dialogue: "That's a name. Best to avoid. Trust me."

name: SAM
dialogue: We do nothing but trust you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Great. Wondrous. And who are you, by the way?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We're Vox Machina.

name: SAM
dialogue: The Slayer's Take.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Vox Machina Slayer's Take. Very well. Pleasure to meet you all, Vox Machina Slayer's "Take." He holds his drink out for you to fill again.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: How many fingers am I holding up?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't care. Thank you. Now, the deal is made, drink's been had, introductions have been "properly given. I think it's time for bed." He takes two steps forward, (thud) face-first in the center of the main area, and starts snoring loudly.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Maybe we should move him to a safe location that we can lock.

name: LIAM
dialogue: With those 20 guards, right, Scanlan?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Can I take his ocarina? Just for the night?

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a sleight of hand check.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: He's asleep, so do I get advantage or something?

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a sleight of hand check.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Natural 20.

name: MATT
dialogue: You sneak forward, and in a move that would've made Vax proud, you pull the ocarina from his grasp, show it to the rest of the party, and tuck it away.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I look over at Vax and give him a wink. And Vex!

name: LIAM
dialogue: That was primo, baby.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Thanks.

name: SAM
dialogue: Hey, Keyleth.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah?

name: SAM
dialogue: You've got magic. I don't entirely trust this thing. We were told specifically not to trust anything. Do you have any spell that can do true-seeing, or that can restore him if he's putting on this form, or that can dispel some charm that he has around him or some aura?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Maybe some sort of magical thing that he put on me, because I'm pretty sure he cast something on me and my brother.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Really? What happened? What did you feel?

name: LAURA
dialogue: A shiver. When we shook his hand.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay. Yeah.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: He never told us what he wanted you to get, what he wanted to steal.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, he hasn't.

name: SAM
dialogue: Pikey, do you have something that can reveal some truth or dispel magic from him?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I actually have Dispel Magic right now.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can we try it? On me and my brother, see if it cancels out whatever he just did?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'll touch Vex and cast Dispel Magic and see if anything happens. Wait, take off all magical items first.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Everything I'm wearing is magic.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, take it off.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, take it off!

name: LAURA
dialogue: What is it about this dimension that makes us get naked all the time?

name: SAM
dialogue: The hat is not magic. You can leave that on.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Thank you. So I take off everything except for the hat.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I don't want to risk dispelling anything.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm taking a short walk, all right.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Every time I've seen anything attractive and naked, it's gone very poorly today. I'm walking away.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's like wearing metal in a really hot sauna. You just don't do it. Come on.

name: MATT
dialogue: Roll a d20 and add your wisdom modifier.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: All right. I'll do the big guy. Come on, big guy. Oh, that's okay. My wisdom, just my modifier? 22.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. You cast the spell.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Do you feel different?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That was a very high wisdom roll. Do you feel anything?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Do I feel anything?

name: MATT
dialogue: You didn't feel anything in particular.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Give it a minute. It might take a while to take effect. Maybe do some jumping jacks.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm definitely putting my clothes back on.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I can also try a Regeneration spell.

name: SAM
dialogue: Wait. I think I can do something. I can sing a song. That's mostly what I do, if you haven't noticed by now. I have a power that I never ever use. It's called Countercharm. I can counter charms.

name: MATT
dialogue: As they're being cast. So you still can't use it. (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm going to start gathering the servants to pick the boy up and put him in his room.

name: MATT
dialogue: And the 20 guards lift his form and carry him off.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Don't let him steal any of our shit.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Everything would disappear, anyway.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, I mean our personal shit.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Lock the door.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, but what if he can do Scanlan's thing where he goes through the door?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I have a feeling if he shook your hand and did something, like Scanlan said, it's probably a Pike thing, like a Remove Curse. It's got to be something more like that. Mine is all nature-based. I can try to Regenerate you, but I don't think this would fall under that.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: She's fine. It was a draft. She needs to wear more clothes. It's all right.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Do you feel different?

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, not anymore.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I have a feeling it's like if you stray from a contract or something, you might feel it. I don't know. That's what I would think.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'll go to bed. And I sleep on all of my weapons and stuff. They're under me, on top of the mattress.

name: MATT
dialogue: Perfect. Everyone else go to bed?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I put a blanket over the satyr, and I pet him, now that he's asleep. Is his fur coarse, or is it soft?

name: MATT
dialogue: It's pretty coarse.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That is really creepy.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Creepy, unconsented petting farm.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay, good night.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I make sure everything's fine. I will leave him his book, lock the door, and head up to my room and lock the door behind me, as well.

name: SAM
dialogue: I stayed up all night reading.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Are you going to take a point of exhaustion for that?

name: SAM
dialogue: I have to.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I get very little sleep. I'm having trouble sleeping.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You are?

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. So this is your second level of exhaustion.

name: SAM
dialogue: No, I slept last time.

name: MATT
dialogue: Oh, that's right! You did sleep. Correct. So you do take another point of exhaustion now, so you're back to one point of exhaustion. So all your ability checks are at disadvantage.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: How long does that take?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: A week.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: It takes a week? To memorize it?

name: SAM
dialogue: I think it was 48 hours of reading over a period of six days.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh jeez.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: How close?

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm on day four, I believe. And I'm up to 36 hours now, if this counts as ten, 12 hours.

name: ASHLEY, LAURA
dialogue: Wow.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So you're close. Yeah, you're doing good.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. Anyone else doing anything?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I sleep, and I dream of fireflies and the Feywild because it's so magical.

name: MATT
dialogue: There you go.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I'm going to get up early, but yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm going to get up early and try to fix my hair and make it as pristine as I can and try to clean off my clothes and everything before we go.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I sleep like a baby in my armor.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. Percy, as you're getting ready to go to bed, you feel this strange tickle at the back of your head that dissipates.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Is it what I think it is?

name: MATT
dialogue: It is the fading of a Charm Person spell.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Okay. Goddamn it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Son of a fuck.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And as I'm going to bed? Or as I wake up?

name: MATT
dialogue: As you're going to bed.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Okay. Fuck.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Did you fuck us?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Percy was charmed.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, you don't know anything yet. I'm not quite going to go to sleep yet. I'm going to go see who else is still awake.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Scanlan is reading in his room with the door slightly ajar.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The little fucker charmed me.

name: SAM
dialogue: I knew it! I suspected it! That's why I tried to use Countercharm, but I don't know how to use it. (laughter) Apparently, it's some sort of preemptive thing. I have to read about it. Oh shit, I'm already reading this! Goddamn it! (laughter) Anyway. What do you think we should do?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't know what we can do.

name: SAM
dialogue: Wait. When were you charmed? What did it affect? What decisions did you make today that were key?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We made a bloody deal with him.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, we can always back out on the deal.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, no, we can't, really.

name: SAM
dialogue: What, is there some sort of blood pact that we made?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (sputtering) I don't know exactly how it works. It's just in any book you read about the Feywild, you make a deal and it's a deal and you have to deal with it.

name: SAM
dialogue: What does mean? You and I could go down to his room right now and kill him and be done with it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't think that would work.

name: SAM
dialogue: Would we be cursed?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Maybe?

name: SAM
dialogue: Haunted forever?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Probably.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh man. That sucks. I don't want to be haunted. That's for you and Vax! (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You would look lovely in eyeliner.

name: SAM
dialogue: No baggage, man, no baggage. What do we do? We made a deal with a devil of some sort.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It was inevitable.

name: SAM
dialogue: Is there a way to trick the trickster into releasing us from the deal?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Could be.

name: SAM
dialogue: Because, you know, I'm a sly talker.

name: LIAM
dialogue: When did this show turn into Rosencrantz and Guildenstern Are Dead? (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: Right now.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Right now. I'm going to have to tell the others in the morning. I'm going to go see if anybody else is awake. Oh god. Sleep well. Oh, you're reading. Never mind. Don't sleep.

name: SAM
dialogue: Now I've got to read about the fucking fey, too.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No. Finish your bloody book.

name: MATT
dialogue: Keyleth is at rest, Grog is at rest, Vax is at rest. Vex is still up, cleaning your garments, you said, right? And Pike, you went to bed but are waking up early, correct? So essentially, it's just Vex who's awake.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Vex.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Little shit put a charm on me. I felt it wear off about 45 minutes ago.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Before we made the deal with him?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Fuck, Percy! I made the deal because you said it was fine!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, I--

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's fine. You didn't know. Well.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, at least we know that he definitely can't be trusted.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's our own stupid fault. We knew we weren't supposed to trust anything here.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I know. We've got to make sure that Pike doesn't give him back his whistle, just yet.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Why did you want to fix his whistle? You just liked him.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: He was so nice! He was just so nice.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Damn it. I thought you knew something we didn't know. I really thought you did.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I did. It's sadly what I knew was he's a little shit. I just didn't know until about half an hour ago. I hate magic!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Percy. Change of subject. Would you say I look put together? Well off? With this armor.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: In what sense?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, you come from money, right?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Right, so do I look like I come from money?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Does she look like she comes from money?

name: MATT
dialogue: That's entirely up to your opinion. You know the attire she wears; you've traveled with her. It's based on what you want to base that judgment on, whether it be pure looks, the person inside. It's whatever Percival thinks she would be in his eyes.

name: SAM
dialogue: (quietly) She's naked in a hat.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (laughs) Honestly, dear, you're too happy to look like you come from money.

name: LAURA

dialogue: You currently have no way of seeing it right now unless you move far enough in that direction. You may.

dialogue: "Bad news, we've reached the Gilded Run."

dialogue: Let's sleep in the mansion tonight.

dialogue: But you can't?

dialogue: That's the coolest thing that's ever happened to me.

dialogue: You hear the phantom chanting in the back of your head. How do you want to do this?

dialogue: Percy is still in its mouth, yes.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay, I'm going to say: Stop putting foreign objects in your mouth!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It takes hold? Okay. How about this? You know the petrified forests in Arizona? Can I petrify him?

dialogue: All right, so as the Blight spell spirals across his body like a spider web, crackling, it begins to (snarl). (laughter) You hear the scraping and cracking of bark and dried plant matter, its entire form slightly squeaking as it becomes a solid, petrified piece of plant matter, the life force now drained from it. name: MARISHA
dialogue: Hey, Percy! How's the weather up there?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Ow!

name: LAURA
dialogue: I would be cheering for you if I wasn't drowning at this very moment.

name: MATT
dialogue: On that note, too, I need you to make a strength check.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh. Well, that's a 15 there. Actually, that's a straight check. That's not a saving throw?

name: MATT
dialogue: Right, just a check.

name: MATT
dialogue: (chuckles) You and Vax and Garmelie still hold your ground, but unfortunately, not a whole lot of physical strength in this daisy chain right now.

dialogue: Can I ask Trinket to come up and help?

dialogue: You can, yes. And Trinket rushes over. (moans) Comes up behind Vax and bites the back of his cloak and begins tugging on him as he's now being slightly strangled by the bear. Pulled back toward Trinket, adding his strength to that. What's Trinket's strength bonus?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah. Four! He's stronger than me.

name: MATT
dialogue: With a roll of a 17, that brings it to a 21. name: LAURA
dialogue: Thanks, buddy.

name: MATT
dialogue: (moans)

name: LAURA
dialogue: I get up and hug Garmelie. What! You saved me. You're wonderful.

name: MATT
dialogue: "What was I supposed to do, watch you drown? No! We're almost to the end of our agreement."

name: LAURA
dialogue: I tousle his hair. Good job, Keyleth!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Thanks.

name: LAURA
dialogue: How you doing, Percy?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Grog, could you help with this?

dialogue: Do I get to chop down a tree, finally? (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I really wanted alligator boots, but I suppose that will do. Please help.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Do I get to chop him? I start chopping down the petrified alligator tree!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Trinket, catch him when he falls.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: What?

dialogue: Trinket rushes up and looks up at you underneath with open jaws.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, ow!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I stand up and kick one of them.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Keyleth wants to get down on the grass that she hurt, and I want to cast Druidcraft and heal it, and talk to the grass, and be like: It wasn't personal. I hope you know you were not the intended target, you just happened to be caught in the fray. It's okay. Don't be mad.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you extend your fingers about you, you see small strands of green go (popping) and you hear a hundred soft voices go, "Eh."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I like your enthusiasm, grass.

dialogue: All right. How are you doing over there, gnomesies?

dialogue: Come on, you should get over here! No rush, but.

dialogue: All right, there's a river.

dialogue: Don't forget to loot the body?

dialogue: I'm going to stick my head in and see if there's anything in there.

dialogue: Just for fun, Grog, smash this.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Okay! (whack)

dialogue: How was that?

dialogue: Anything exciting come out?

dialogue: I'm going to pick one up and bring it to Keyleth. For you. Well done. (applause)

dialogue: I get a souvenir from the Feywild! That's all I wanted.

dialogue: No, he's going to leave. I mean, he can. I guess you got us all the way here, didn't you?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Once he's across, our accord is complete."

dialogue: Oh yeah. No, totally. Come here, bitch.

dialogue: "No!" Roll an attack. Well, technically, this is a grapple, so it's an athletics check.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: A 20. Total.

name: MATT
dialogue: You reach out and his eyes go wide and he darts around, and your fingers barely catch the edge of his fur, and you get enough of a hold to lift him off the ground. name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh, no, yeah, I totally hear what you're saying. We're going for a ride, bitch. And I back up.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make an athletics check.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: 20 again. 12 plus eight.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Keep moving.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What kinds of things?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't know. It's time for me to go. Thank you guys so much. I appreciate this. "It's been something."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Wait, before he goes, I want to give him a kiss on his head.

name: MATT
dialogue: A little kiss on the head, and he goes, "Well, at least it's been a pleasure travelling "with you, my lady." He takes your hand and does a little bow and (kiss) on the edge.

name: LAURA
dialogue: As I was kissing him, can I give him a little pat down to make sure he didn't steal anything? (laughter and applause)

name: MATT
dialogue: Make an investigation check.

dialogue: 23? As you feel down, you feel this slight little bump inside of his fur, and you're afraid to touch it for fear of it being-- on the outside of his body! name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, now I feel wrong saying I reach for it and try to see what it is.

name: MATT
dialogue: Do you reach for it?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah!

name: MATT
dialogue: All right.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You're committed now.

name: MATT
dialogue: Grasping onto it, you tug, and pull forth the small onyx mastiff that you had found earlier in the campground.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I take it back.

name: MATT
dialogue: He goes, "Oh, that's right. I was holding this for you."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Thank you so much. You're so kind.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: The little black dog statue? Oh, I like that thing.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Fantastic. Well, wish you all the best of luck. Stay alive."

dialogue: Wait a minute. How do you plan on getting back across the rivers?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I have my ways." And he turns invisible. You see little sludgy footprints go off down the shore and around the bend.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Bye!

dialogue: What do you want to do?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can I cast Hunter's Mark on him?

name: MATT
dialogue: You cannot currently see him now. He's already vanished.

dialogue: Sorry. I should've done it when I was kissing him, but I was distracted by feeling him up.

dialogue: It happens. All right, so what are you guys going to do?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Awesome. So we're across the rivers. Everything gets worse now, and we can't stop moving.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We should move until it's time to camp, and when we camp, we should camp in your palacious...

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, in the mansion.

name: SAM
dialogue: I've got the mansion.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Thank god.

dialogue: Are we in the bog now?

dialogue: This would be the tangleward tip of it, the southern tip of the bog, yes.

dialogue: I want to test and see if we sink when we step on the bog.

dialogue: Okay. You step onto it, and your foot descends about three inches before it comes to a stop. (squelch)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It comes to a stop.

name: MATT
dialogue: But as you go to remove your foot, (sucking sound). It's very sticky. Effectively, you guys are at half movement moving through the bog.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I cast Pass Without Trace on us so that we can be stealthy. She doesn't have mist form, not until we rest.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I could rest and learn mist, and we can mist across. That was what I was going to say.

dialogue: Is it a treeline? Are we into trees?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It's dripping from the trees?

dialogue: It's seemingly seeping from everything.

dialogue: I have Land's Stride. Does that mean that this doesn't affect me? Or am I still slowed down?

dialogue: Read out Land's Stride to me.

dialogue: Land's Stride isn't on any of my pieces of paper. Oh, wait. Here it is. Moving through non-magical difficult terrain costs you no movement.

dialogue: Technically, yes, you can move at your normal pace. The rest of the party still has to stay slowed.

dialogue: Then I'll tell you what I'm going to do. I'm going to pull out my broom and I'm going to let the gnomes ride on it, since you guys will sink down a little bit more than the rest of us. Do you want to ride on the broom?

name: SAM
dialogue: How do we do that?

dialogue: You sit on it, and then you fly.

name: SAM
dialogue: Do we have to say a magical word?

dialogue: I'll say it for you.

dialogue: I don't think it works that way. I think you have to tell them, and then they have to say it.

dialogue: Oh, really?

dialogue: You can try. It's up to you.

dialogue: Sit on it.

dialogue: Do you want front or back?

dialogue: Yeah, sit on it! Front or back?

dialogue: Okay.

dialogue: That's sweet. (hacking spit)

dialogue: Okay. As you guys get up onto the broom, you release it from your grasp, and it goes (splat) onto the ground. Both of you guys sink about three or four inches into the ground.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Say (hacking spit).

name: ASHLEY, SAM
dialogue: (hacking spit).

name: MATT
dialogue: It lifts up and pulls you guys slowly out of the sludge, (squelch) finally freeing yourself, and you're now hovering a very short distance above the ground.

dialogue: So at least you guys and me aren't slowed down, so that's good.

name: SAM
dialogue: Bye, guys!

dialogue: By the way, now that we're out of all this shit, can we look around and see if Ukurat has been peeping us this entire time?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can we see him?

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a perception check.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We're not in the forest anymore? This is bog?

dialogue: Right now, technically it's swamp, yeah. Not considered forest.

name: SAM
dialogue: 16 here.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh my god! It's a 31.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you guys take a moment to look out in the distance, you're unable to really make any idea of a form or movement. dialogue: So he's checking us out.

dialogue: He's following you.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So he's going to be able to get across all these rivers?

dialogue: Apparently, he's fine.

dialogue: He's pretty cool. He can jump really far.

name: MATT
dialogue: He shrinks sideways against the tree and is now barely visible, other than his furry chest that's now peeking out one side of the width of the tree.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I give him a--

name: MATT
dialogue: No reaction. Vax at this point is like, "So are we going to move on, then?"

dialogue: Yes, but stealthily.

dialogue: "Let's do it." Make a stealth check, guys.

dialogue: I cast Pass Without Trace on us, so we all got plus ten.

dialogue: Oh!

dialogue: Did you get something good?

dialogue: I did.

dialogue: Percy.

dialogue: Keyleth.

dialogue: All right, Vex.

name: MATT
dialogue: 32! Pike.

dialogue: I rolled a 14.

dialogue: You guys begin trudging forward into the Shademirk. Everyone's being kind of... and he's lumbering through it like a mammoth.

dialogue: You all shush him, and you find ways to cushion his footfalls.
