name: MATT
dialogue: Correct. However, it was Vorugal, it was the white dragon, which from what Gilmore is saying has been roosting over at the top of the ruins of Draconia.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Which is to the east.

name: SAM
dialogue: So this was not the group that had set off from Emon.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: To the west.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No it's-- Draconia is to the southeast. Why do I know that?

name: SAM
dialogue: Here, here's the map. We're up here. This is the group that was coming from Emon. These guys came from somewhere over here? Where's Draconia?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can I cast Primeval Awareness and see if it's within six miles of us right now, still? Or if it's farther away from that.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I thought that Draconia's on a whole another continent.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yeah, it is. It's over here.

name: MATT
dialogue: It's over on Wildemount.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I want to see if they're just camping out around us or if they're going away.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Are they going back?

name: MATT
dialogue: Using for dragons, I assume, right?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes. It's my favored enemy.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. I would say as part of your Primeval Awareness--

name: SAM
dialogue: If this is the United States, we're in Maine. Emon is LA.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. Sensing at this point, with the day of travel and everything, you have no sense of dragons in that direction or anything.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay. They're further than six miles away.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, there are minor essences in the northern area, but nothing beyond what you've already sensed in the Alabaster Sierras. Nothing on the level of strength that the draw of an ancient dragon would bring on your radar.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: To answer your previous question, there are four Vestiges left.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That we know of.

name: LIAM
dialogue: There's a dagger, there's a cloak. Armor. There's a staff.

name: SAM
dialogue: Wait, there's other objects that we haven't--

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Four left. Because we have Whisper, right?

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, no, we don't have Whisper.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So there's five.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Do we have any other allies, friends, people who are sworn to aid us and--?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Ooh! Yeah, yeah! Your parents.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's right.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Technically, the elves of Syngorn are building an army. However, who knows if they'll actually come through.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The werewolves could be called upon.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I think they would understand it would do them well to help what is a threat to all of us."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You would think.

name: SAM
dialogue: One werewolf has vowed allegiance to us.

name: LAURA
dialogue: In the Feywild.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: In another plane of existence, which I don't know if that's a problem.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Not going to count on that one."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's not as ridiculous as you think.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes. Your former pals.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Whatever remnants of Draconia perhaps?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Wait. So the last time we saw the main portion, the bulk of Emon's army from Fort Daxio was "sent to Syngorn before this attack happened?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Do we have any knowledge on their whereabouts?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: A lot are there.

name: MATT
dialogue: "They're there?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: A lot of-- at least all of our guards from Emon are in Syngorn, right?

name: LAURA
dialogue: No. Our guards aren't in Syngorn.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Not our personal guards, but Emon's guards.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No.

name: MATT
dialogue: You did see quite a few soldiers from Emon there.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh we did?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I was distracted.

name: MATT
dialogue: That's okay. You did have a lot to think about with your dad.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They would not answer our call but if someone has relations with the Clasp, they are always an option for manpower.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, I have been dealing with them and definitely-- they're not much of an army, but "they're definitely good at acquiring information and I currently have a few of them trying to find "out as much as they can about Thordak."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: There's also the Ashari druids, who will definitely want to help our cause.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: This is very true.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That is good to know. Well, any more that come your way or any possibilities you have to "bring more to our cause, please, do so."

name: SAM
dialogue: There's a candle-maker who might help out. I would put him in the strong maybe category as well.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Don't mention that Vex flies.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Good, well keep tabs on those you've found and any possibilities of others, especially those "who have... I don't know, more of these Vestiges that you speak of, or armies at their disposal. "Big weapons, anything. I'll take anything at this point really."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There are options but we need to discuss what happened today. This changes some things.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, we need more offence, less defense. I don't know if that will work a second time.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You're mad. We need defense. This is not a site of a victory, this is a site of our end. We need bunkers.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah. We need to move everybody underground the same way we did in Emon.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I can spend more time fleshing out and reinforcing the bunkers to make them--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'll discuss a warning system to get people underground.

name: SAM
dialogue: But when the dragon came here just now, they saw nothing, correct?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We hope.

name: SAM
dialogue: Is there a way that we can spread false rumors that the city of Whitestone has been magically moved to another plane or something?

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's wonderful. That's smart.

name: SAM
dialogue: Some way of getting that word to Draconia or I don't--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Putting the word out that we're other places than we are. Putting the sound--

name: MATT
dialogue: Asum thinks to himself and goes--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Can't we drop it into the Clasp's pipeline?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I can do that. Definitely. We can find a way to get that information. There are a number "who have sworn allegiance to Thordak and, you know. Some folks who don't see honor but the necessity "to stay alive override any sort of previous friendships."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Best not to mention our name. I don't think we're cool with the Clasp after our last meeting.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, they don't like us.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Good to know. I'll look about planting that information. I'll do the best I can in that "regard. I've been told that you've already felled another of the Conclave, is that correct?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yes.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's true. Umbrasyl. Dead and gone.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That will certainly stir some attention from them."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, and if not that, then the message left in there.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They know we did it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Strange that he had all those wyverns with him, though. Umbrasyl had none. He was by himself.

name: LIAM
dialogue: They don't like each other, though, this is some sort of loose partnership.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, but didn't they say the white one was more savage. More emotional?

name: LAURA
dialogue: The white one was more vain.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, the black one, Umbrasyl is the one that's--

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh you're right, the white one is a hunter, it's primal. Hates others. You're right.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Maybe the army's going to head to-- no, we could be so lucky if it was on its way to attack it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Black ones like torture, right?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, they like to make people suffer.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I feel like there should be trading cards.

name: SAM
dialogue: So the white one's like Predator?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Shut up! There's notes somewhere in here!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Just be warned: fell one dragon, that might make them nervous. Fell another and that's almost "certain to bring retaliation."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We were hoping to distract them.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, the next wyrm you decide to fell will probably be the start of this war."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Can we ask, why would it bring retaliation? How would they know it was us?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We did sign the card.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We left our names.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Maybe the next one we can sign as somebody else.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What if we don't sign it?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Even if we don't, they probably are going to get much more vindictive overall.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And just as much as we can scry on them, they can scry on us. I'm sure they've been watching us.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't think they know where we are. I think they know when we travel, I just don't think they know where we are.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Have any of the living ones seen you?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Have any what?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Have any of the living ones seen you and know you for who you are?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: When we killed the first one, there were a bunch of jewels in the wall and we saw a bunch of eyeballs.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: He did not know our name, but he has seen us.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Raishan saw us, the white one saw us, all of them saw us.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Then it is very possible."

name: SAM
dialogue: Wait a second, you just said no one knew we were here, none of them knew we were here.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Here.

name: SAM
dialogue: They just attacked here. And we just got back here.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Gilmore was scrying on them. It took three days for him to get here. That's how he knew.

name: SAM
dialogue: Because Gilmore was scrying on them. Got it. Not because we have a leak.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We probably do. We should assume we have a leak.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm going to blame Shaun.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Is he Shaun now?

name: MATT
dialogue: "You're more than welcome to."

name: SAM
dialogue: Sorry! (chuckles)

name: MATT
dialogue: He's sitting down, wiping his brow with this really fine scarf.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Judging based on what happened in Emon, we know that they have an insider, we just don't know who yet.

name: SAM
dialogue: They do? We know this?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I would assume that there's nothing we say that they don't know at this point.

name: LAURA
dialogue: They struck during a political--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: During a council meeting.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Somebody has to be telling them things.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Someone probably very high up.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It could be Raishan taking the form of a human again, for all we know.

name: SAM
dialogue: Who was there and lived? Besides us?

name: MATT
dialogue: Jarett catches up, by the way. (panting) "Is everyone all right?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes. How are the citizens? Did you get everyone in there?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Everyone seems to be safe and accounted for. There was a lot of fear, of course, but "elation, whatever you did." And he looks at you and looks at Shaun. "Whatever you did, keep doing "it, please."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I insight check Jarett.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make an insight check.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Seven.

name: MATT
dialogue: It's hard to read that fella. Slippery.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Can I do an insight check on Asum?

name: MATT
dialogue: You may.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What are you doing?

name: SAM
dialogue: Ooh, that was a Luck.

name: LIAM
dialogue: First one was good anyway.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, you're just hoping? First one was really good.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Damn. I can choose whichever one I want. 21.

name: LAURA
dialogue: About Jarett?! You're insighting Jarett?

name: SAM
dialogue: Seeker Asum.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Perhaps we should not have... assumed.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Hey, Travis! How is it you're on this side of the table?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well I was looking for a Loot Crate. Have you guys seen any Loot Crates?

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh! Well I've got some of the great swag that you can get in a Loot Crate. Why this shirt came in one last week.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's incredible! How do I get one of those?

name: SAM
dialogue: You go to LootCrate.com/CriticalRole to see your selection and then if you sign up, you get three dollars off the first month, which is a really good deal!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Ironically when we played the game at home this is exactly what we'd do.

name: MATT
dialogue: Totally.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Sam who are you talking to? You're facing a potted plant.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm talking to Seeker Asum! He's a big fanboy.

name: MATT
dialogue: Gilmore stands up and catches the edge of Vax's shoulder.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Hey.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right, so, what's your plan? What's the next order of business?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Get you a drink, I think.

name: MATT
dialogue: "A drink would be great."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think we talk and drink.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes. We need to talk about barricading underground. Making it more secure.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Come. I can definitely use that right now." You guys are led into the nearest open-- it looks to be an unused tavern, but there are drinks, ale and things that are at the ready. There isn't much commerce currently happening in the city, since right now everything's in survival mode, so there's no exchange of money, you guys are presented with drinks. The lanterns are lit on the inside from other villagers that are just happy to help. And the central table is set where you all sit around and quietly have a few sips.

name: LIAM
dialogue: While everyone's sitting, can I just pull him over to a corner for a second?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LIAM
dialogue: How are you doing, personally?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Me?"

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Wondrous! I'm doing great! (chuckles) I'm exhausted."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Shaun, I--

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'll be fine."

name: LIAM
dialogue: You sure?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes, I'm fine."

name: LIAM
dialogue: All right.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's been a long time since I put my energy and talents towards anything beyond making shiny "things. Feels nice to be helping others."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, I feel we're seeing your true talents.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm at my wits' end with these. Do you want to see true talents? You should ask Allura to show "you what she's capable of when she gets back."

name: LIAM
dialogue: She is pretty nifty.

name: MATT
dialogue: (sighs heavily)

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, come on, come and have a drink.

name: MATT
dialogue: And he like leans on you a bit and you both make it back to the table. The rest of you--

name: SAM
dialogue: This booze is okay, but Grog, I could really use the finest wine I've ever had.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh shit, hold on.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We've got some fancy-ass bottles.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I reach into the bag of holding and I grab five expensive-ass bottles of wine.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Holla!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Scanlan and I will share one.

name: SAM
dialogue: Good idea.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Just one bottle between the two of you?

name: SAM
dialogue: We don't weigh very much.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm involved in this. This is exciting.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys scatter the wine amongst your glasses. Drinks are had as you begin to discuss the plan.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Pour one for the landlord as well. He's letting us drink our wine in his room.

name: MATT
dialogue: Asum leans in. "All right. So. Vestiges. Defenses. Allies, what's the next plan? "What's the next--"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well, I've a question. If I were to call somewhere a City of Brass, where would you think that would be?

name: MATT
dialogue: Asum goes, "There are cities that use brass in parts of construction in Wildemount, that's as far--" Gilmore leans forward and goes, "No, that's in the Elemental Plane of Fire. That's a "dangerous, terrible place that you should never go."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We were already there once, actually.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Terrible dangerous places you should never go are practically our middle name.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We saw Thordak there, actually.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh! Even more of a reason not to go!"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, he's here now, so Fire Plane's probably safer!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: She's got a very fair point.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Why do you ask, Grog?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well, look, the Plate of the Dawnmartyr is in a City of Brass, but I don't know where that is.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I bet that sounds something Pike would like.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Draconia is in Wildemount?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Draconia is in Wildemount, yes."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Right. And so is the big white fuck, right?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes. Are any of the Vestiges in Wildemount?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: The City of Brass?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Whereabouts are the Vestiges?"

name: LIAM
dialogue: One at the bottom of the sea.

name: LAURA
dialogue: One is in Marquet?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: The City of Brass is in the Plane of Fire. We've covered that.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's not in Draconia? It's in the Plane of Fire?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: The city is in the Plane of Fire.

name: SAM
dialogue: Correct. Where's Ank'Harel?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Ank'Harel is on the continent of-- what's it's called?

name: MATT
dialogue: Gilmore chuckles to himself, "Ank'Harel. It's been awhile." And looks at--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What's the continent? I suddenly blanked on it. You just said it.

name: MATT
dialogue: Marquet.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Marquet. It's on the continent of Marquet.

name: MATT
dialogue: Ank'Harel is also where Jarett is from, which is where you first heard. Gilmore smiles. "It's where I grew up, or nearabouts, at least."

name: SAM
dialogue: Where you grew up, Gilmore?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, not in the city, a little ways out a bit."

name: SAM
dialogue: You're Marquatian?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Originally, yes, but I've been living here most of my life. Soon as I had the opportunity to "leave-- It's a free plane here in Tal'Dorei and all the shops I can muster... until they all got "destroyed."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Good times.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's fine. I'd made the bottom floors too small anyway. More space. Next time."

name: LIAM
dialogue: You ever want to revisit home?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Maybe. Nah. I need to stay here and maintain this."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes you do. If you don't mind.

name: SAM
dialogue: What about the endless maze of the Abyss? That's another place that we're supposed to go.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Also another plane of existence.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't know much about the Abyss, but I know that it's probably the worst place ever."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Abyssal. That's where demons come from.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Worse than the Fire Plane?

name: MATT
dialogue: "That's correct."

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's the thing that killed Pike.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Wait, isn't that where the rakshasa's going to be?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's in the Nine Hells.

name: LIAM
dialogue: He's a devil.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Ironically is somewhere else entirely.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And I think we can table Meowmix for a little bit. Somebody told us it takes a while.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Months and months.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Months but we also don't want to wait until--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Not forever.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Who's got a map?

name: SAM
dialogue: I've got a map.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Where's the Ozmit Sea?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Before we even think of this, we should see what we're-- I don't think we're going to collect all of the Vestiges. We should see what other Vestiges we think are going to be helpful.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's like the Pacific Ocean.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Which direction is it? Towards Draconia?

name: SAM
dialogue: No. Draconia's across the Atlantic Ocean in France.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But the Ozmit Sea is where the Water Ashari reside. And I have to go there anyway. It's also where Pike is very familiar. I'm pretty sure that's the sea that she sailed?

name: LIAM
dialogue: And the Vestige there is the staff?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Whisper, right?

name: SAM
dialogue: Whisper, the blade.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Whisper, the blade.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well, look, hey, so I have an idea, right. Someone mentioned that the white dragon is very vain and very savage. He's got like all those wyverns around him. That's a little bit of a bitch for us. We're usually good one dragon on all of us. You got a whole gang, worse for us. So what about if we played to his vanity, and maybe sent him knocking on one of his Conclave brother's doors. Maybe start a little beef that maybe's not there.

name: SAM
dialogue: How do we do that?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I don't know, the idea just popped up. I'm looking for your help and shit.

name: LIAM
dialogue: He's a big picture man. Here's the detail fellow.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You know how tired I am right now?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We're so tired.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think that we've been thinking about this the wrong way. I think that we've been treating this as a battle. And we have to start treating this like a war, which is a very different creature.

name: SAM
dialogue: Are we guerrillas?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We are absolutely not.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Beret.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Wolverines!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We need to reinforce this city not as a final stand, but as a place where there might be survivors. Because if they come here, there's no battle to be fought. It's just a loss.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We need to take it--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Elsewhere.

name: MATT
dialogue: At this point Jarett steps out from back of the room and says, "The more time that goes by, "the more chance there is that the battle, the war, will be fought here. On our turf. The faster we "move, the better chance we have of bringing it to theirs, so let us not dilly-dally."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You mentioned about having our own mole at one point. Our own inside man.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah. Scanlan.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm not going to volunteer myself as a slave to the dragon.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Keep thinking about it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You are a sexy dinosaur.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm considering it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You'll be the Hercules Mulligan of Vox Machina.

name: ALL
dialogue: Hercules Mulligan!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I would like to talk to some of the magic users about installing some sort of-- or perhaps helping me install a non-magical dragon raid signal so that the population knows to be quiet, and knows to quietly go underground. In the event of the next fly-by.

name: MATT
dialogue: They all look at each other and Gilmore nods. "That's actually, I wouldn't say "rudimentary, but it's definitely within my skill set."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Would triggering it possibly alert them to our existence? Does it make holding up the shield--

name: MATT
dialogue: "Not if I can maintain it underneath the barrier."

name: SAM
dialogue: Does the barrier block sound and visuals?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It should."

name: SAM
dialogue: And is there any way that we can help you make this barrier more permanent and stronger?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't know. This was crafted for this reason. This isn't a long standing existing "incantation. This was crafted through the minds of Drake Thunderbrand and Allura and myself and "Pike's aid. This is a new magic, it's experimental, and to be perfectly honest, I'm very "glad it succeeded because I was--"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Just guessing?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Essentially."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Also, Gilmore, as a sidebar, what about that black ball beneath the city? Has anything been learned of it?

name: MATT
dialogue: "We've been a bit distracted."

name: LIAM
dialogue: That's what I thought.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I would like to put it to use.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Wait, what?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We're at war.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We can't move it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We teleport to the black dragon's lair, we sleep overnight, teleport in, teleport out. And then sleep overnight, teleport either to Whitestone or to Marquet.

name: SAM
dialogue: Can you teleport today? Or are you done?

name: MATT
dialogue: You can only use that once per day, though, right?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I used Plane Shift. I didn't use Transport Via Plants. Yes. Wait. No. I Moved Earth. I can't do it today. It has to be tomorrow. And if that's the case, it's tomorrow, then we lose that two-day grace period. Unless we go right now and sleep overnight in Draconia and start first thing in the morning.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And risk a very reasonable reason that they would know where we are.

name: MATT
dialogue: As far as I know, Plane Shift can't teleport you on the same plane. It brings you specifically to another plane of existence.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah. I'm saying I cast Plane Shift from the Feywild to here. That's all I'm saying. But I used that, and that's a seventh level spell.

name: SAM
dialogue: So if we go to Draconia tonight, if we want to sleep in the mansion, we can't, because I changed his memory.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh fuck.

name: SAM
dialogue: So we would have to sleep out in the open as lizard people.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Nope.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Too many negatives now.

name: LAURA
dialogue: This is danger zone.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We're getting a lot of cons. There's not so many pros.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We need to sleep anyway, because we're exhausted.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh man. I can find all sorts of problems with a situation if I look hard enough.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That is so astute. It's 12:00. My god, he had a thought.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Opportunity. Honestly. There's a dragon's perch, and he is vacated, and it will probably never happen again as far as we know.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I disagree. I think the next time they come to attack and kill us, it will be vacated.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Cool. While they're killing Whitestone because we didn't take advantage of this moment, then we'll go to Draconia.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I agree. I legitimately agree.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We can sleep and wake up in the morning and teleport there.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We do have to sleep, regardless. There's no getting around sleep.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We can't fucking go there when we haven't slept, Grog. We'll all die.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We can't actually get there right now.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: There's also no guarantee that they're going straight back there. Maybe they're heading somewhere else. They were heading with an army to somewhere. It's probably not a city they've already conquered.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They were heading southeast.

name: MATT
dialogue: Southeast is what you saw, yes.

name: SAM
dialogue: That's where they live.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: So they're probably heading back home.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Balls. Then where did they come from? What were they doing?

name: LIAM
dialogue: They were fishing.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They thought that we might be here, and they took a quick look around, which is why I don't want to make any more noise around here.

name: SAM
dialogue: Let's sleep.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm going to go to the barkeep.

name: MATT
dialogue: There is no barkeep here. This tavern has been opened just for you guys to be served. There is no current owner here. Most everyone who helped you open this are yourselves and a couple of civilians that were just there.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Is there a civilian waitress?

name: MATT
dialogue: There is no waitress. There are a couple civilians outside, but as soon as you guys started talking, all the civilians left the room.

name: LAURA
dialogue: They're so nice.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There's no barmaid at all?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Your nobility is showing, Percival.

name: SAM
dialogue: I need a young boy. (laughter)

name: LIAM
dialogue: These white gloves are sullied. I need a new set of white gloves, please.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They're shooting mittens, and you're so uncouth.

name: SAM
dialogue: I have an Unseen Servant. Do you need a servant? I make an Unseen Servant for him.

name: MATT
dialogue: There's a wisp of air.

name: SAM
dialogue: Command him as you see fit.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Never mind. This is what I get for trying to be nice to anybody. I've learned my lesson.

name: SAM
dialogue: I tip the Unseen Servant.

name: MATT
dialogue: You toss the coin and it (clinks) to the ground.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I pounce on it.

name: MATT
dialogue: You (soft impact) into this weird cluster of air. It's pushing your beard hair back, and your mouth is full of all that air pushing into it as you reach into the Unseen Servant, grab the coin, and pull it out.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: Well done. You got a gold.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We'll sleep for now. We'll wake up in the morning, and we'll either go in one direction or the other.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Good plan, guys. Good plan.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We came up with nothing.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's so not true. We came up with a lot. We just have to sleep and then make a decision based on what the world looks like in the morning.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Dream about a cloak, Percival. Maybe we can get you a cloak.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That cloak sounds useful.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: All right, let's sleep. Let's go to the castle.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys find your way to the castle.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: As a side, I want to grab Vex for a quick walk on the way to the castle. I want to go by the cemetery. Has it been worked on, by the way? I suppose I'll find out.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You did say Vex, right?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Vax.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You said Vex.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Vax. I've been drinking. I've not even been drinking, I've been pretend drinking.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. You grab him.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I have something to show you.

name: LIAM
dialogue: What is it?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You'll like it. Well, I don't know if you'll like it. I don't know what you like. I'm going to take him to the cemetery, to the crypt. The title I gave your sister doesn't come with much, but it does come with one, at the moment, tiny plot of land, on which a crypt sits. This was the resting place of the father and grandfather and assorted family members of the man you killed the first night we came here.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You want my sister to live in a mausoleum?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No. I want something else to live in a mausoleum. This is actually for you. Open it. I go and I light the two little torches on the side. This is very traditional, and it should open. Do you trust me?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Uh...

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Good answer. I'll go in first.

name: MATT
dialogue: Percy enters the building.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I follow.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. As you enter the mausoleum, the gentle flickering of torchlight that was lit by Percy shows the interior, though it is low-lit partially, and your darkvision does catch you. What was once a relatively decent mausoleum seems to have been gutted, retrofit, and now you see standing before you, is a mostly constructed shrine to the Raven Queen.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I figured it would be a good idea. I've had my fill of gods, but I'm not so foolish to think that we do not need them still. This is here when you need it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I am having trouble.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Me, too. I do not want to die who I am. I would like to live long enough to be someone else. I think you understand that.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I've been really angry at you.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I've been encouraging it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I don't know if it's entirely fair, but I can't shake it. I don't know that I'm willing to let go of it yet.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Good. I certainly do not deserve it yet. I don't know if I ever will. But I can't think of anything else to do with my time on earth right now, other than... this. I am finished with gods. They will not help me. Maybe you will.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Percy.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I've always liked you. From the beginning, I've always liked you.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I've always liked you, too.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You are intelligent and charming.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Thank you.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And good in a tight spot.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's the open spaces where I suffer. The tight spots, I feel very good about. It's the open spaces. This is a very tight spot.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I would like to be friends with you again. I just have a condition.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes?

name: LIAM
dialogue: My penchant for forgiveness with my sister's welfare is razor thin.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I know.

name: LIAM
dialogue: If you can respect that, then we don't have a problem.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Do you know why I titled your sister?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I have some idea.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: She thought she was missing something that-- and I use this term loosely-- ordinary people... We have a magic we use, to convince people that we deserve the things we get, those of us who were born this way. It was treating her unfairly and limiting her ability to see her world for what it was worth, and it was a simple and easy fix. She is going to wake up one morning-- not yet, but soon-- and realize that money will not make her happy, and that trying to please that awful father will not make her happy. The first step in that is realizing that he's weak, and there's no better way to do that than being better titled than your parents.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I don't agree with that line of thinking.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I know. But you are not her. And I'm not saying it's the truth, but it is what I believe is in her heart. I think perhaps that might lift. I will never hurt her. I will never hurt anybody intentionally, especially not you, any more than I already have. In return, I ask: never take your eyes off me. Never trust me. And that is the best friend that you can be.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I will recommit to that same promise I made.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You can like me. I would love that. And in fact, I hope that I can earn your like.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I do like you.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I just never want to earn your trust.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, then it's your lucky day.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: A gentle title will suit your sister well. I'm leaving.

name: MATT
dialogue: Percy walks out. You're left alone in the silence and darkness, looking at the small shrine before you.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm on board. You have me. Whatever you will. I have something I need to take care of, which you know, and I hope you will help me with it. But I do not take your gift lightly. You have me. I close the door again and head back to town.

name: MATT
dialogue: Back into town. You guys quietly keep your distance in your walk, find your way back to the castle to your respective rooms, and an evening's rest takes you all.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do I hear Vax go to his room?

name: MATT
dialogue: Are you waiting to hear Vax go to his room?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm waiting to hear Vax go to his room.

name: MATT
dialogue: Actually, knowing Vax, you wouldn't hear anything. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: You wait for a long time, and no sound comes to your ears.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I go to sleep.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. And with that, as you guys rest for the night, we're going to take a quick bathroom break. We'll be back here in a few minutes. We had a friend come and deliver a gift to Laura, which you can see presented on the table now. It is a replica that someone, Kiki Day, made this awesome prop replica of Fenthras.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I wish you guys could see it up close. Obviously, we're going to send a picture on Twitter so you guys can see it, but it lights up different colors!

name: MATT
dialogue: Design based on David Rodriguez's concept art for Fenthras.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's got Elvish for "protector" and "growth."

name: MATT
dialogue: That's so badass.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Did I say it right? Protector, not protection? Protector is right!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Protector and growth.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Say what?!

name: MATT
dialogue: That is awesome.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Thank you so much!

name: MATT
dialogue: Thank you, Kiki!

name: LAURA
dialogue: You're unbelievable.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Should we put it down?

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. There we go.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Lean it up against the table.

name: MATT
dialogue: So. As you guys come to consciousness the next morning, the storm has come in now--

name: LAURA
dialogue: By the way, I got terrible sleep. I replayed everything Saundor said in my head a hundred times.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a general wisdom saving throw.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You're paralyzed from fear.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I am terrible! Wisdom saving throw? 12.

name: MATT
dialogue: 12? Okay. Your evening is hard-pressed. You do manage to get a full night's sleep; you do not suffer any exhaustion. You do manage to get rest, though the nightmares do come in memory of your last encounter at the Feywild, and Saundor's words still swimming around in your head, finding cracks in your sense of self. But you still are stalwart against the choice you made and the friends that were at your back. And as you all come to consciousness, the sound of rain outside of the castle against the exterior stone greets you with the morning. You can smell the fresh rain in the air, and eventually come down to find breakfast prepared, a meal earned.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Not chicken.

name: MATT
dialogue: Not chicken, no. This is eggs, fruits. A classic Whitestone breakfast. Chicken is available, but strangely untouched.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Baked beans. Tell me there's baked beans!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The thick, single-slab bacon.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Blood pudding.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Basically an Irish breakfast.

name: MATT
dialogue: There are a few farms here, most are in the surrounding fields south of the city. It's good. It's fresh.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The rain is good. It will mean that they'll have an easier time figuring out the water level while they're digging out beneath the Sun Tree and making sure that it's secure. I love this weather.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well? To Marquet or to Draconia? What's it going to be? Should we vote?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: An attempt at an object of power or an attempt at friends in power?

name: SAM
dialogue: Which is which?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Draconia has friends in power.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Speaking of friends, we should probably check up on ours.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (long sigh) That is true. We haven't heard anything, but that is true.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We haven't heard anything about him.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's terrifying.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I know.

name: SAM
dialogue: He's probably okay.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Who are we talking about? (laughter)

name: SAM
dialogue: Jarett.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh.

name: SAM
dialogue: Our only friend in Draconia.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I personally would assume that Tiberius would either be on his way to one of the two cities, if he were so inclined. And if he had survived. And if he wasn't working in the city itself to keep it functioning.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He's hard-headed enough. So all of those things are very true.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And again, we're at war. This is not a battle. We do not win by going to Draconia. We do not win by going to Marquet. We win months from now.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You're starting to make less and less sense, Percy.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No! I'm making perfect sense.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Part of the traditional Whitestone breakfast is--

name: LAURA
dialogue: A rambling de Rolo.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Breakfast needs things to live. (laughter)

name: LIAM
dialogue: I think you got that backwards?

name: SAM
dialogue: Whitestone continental breakfast. Two eggs, rambling tirade. (laughter)

name: LAURA
dialogue: Vote, then?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Vote.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm all right with a vote.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right, all in favor of going to Marquet to find a Vestige that will maybe give us some more power that we need to kill a dragon, say aye!

name: TALIESIN, LIAM
dialogue: Aye.

name: SAM
dialogue: All in favor of going to Draconia, where we don't really have a great plan but I think we're going to go try to fuck up a dragon's lair and maybe rescue five people and probably die as lizard people, say aye.

name: LAURA, TRAVIS, SAM
dialogue: Aye.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Aye.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I've changed my mind. I want to go to Marquet now.

name: SAM
dialogue: Three to three.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Sorry. Oh shit! I didn't mean to fuck that up. Trinket, what's your vote?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Hold on, let's see if Ashley texts in the next ten minutes.

name: MATT
dialogue: Three versus three. Are you going leave it up to the dice, being a game of DND?

name: SAM
dialogue: Let's do it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Where's that coin we have?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I have it. I have it right here. Yeah.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You could also do one to ten and 11 to 20.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: One or 20. Ready?

name: SAM
dialogue: Wait, we're just doing one flip?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah!

name: SAM
dialogue: No. What?!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes. It's flipped!

name: LAURA
dialogue: What is what?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay! 20 is Marquet and a one is Draconia.

name: SAM
dialogue: What about all the other numbers?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There's only two! It's a coin!

name: MATT
dialogue: 20, Marquet. One is Draconia.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And any other number, we stay home.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What is it?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We're going to Draconia, and we're going to see if we could find Tiberius.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh god!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Let it be known, I don't think we should go as lizard people anymore.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Why?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I think we should go as ravaged Draconians.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think we should go as Draconians.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We can make ourselves look like dragonborn with Seeming?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think that's a better plan.

name: LAURA
dialogue: At least that way, they'll trust us.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We don't have to teleport to the middle of nowhere. Well, we do need to get farther away from here. Is there any way to get farther away from where we are right now before we--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Can we get back to Umbrasyl's lair? I thought that was a good idea.

name: SAM
dialogue: We could go there and there and back.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, as long as we commit to 24 hours in Draconia no matter what.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We can go to Umbrasyl's lair, but it'll take an extra day, because I can only teleport us so many times.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think 72 hours is a perfectly reasonable amount of time to dedicate to this prospect.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Pop in, scry, pop into Draconia, look around and next day, pop out. Can we do that?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yep.

name: LIAM
dialogue: If we stop at Umbrasyl's lair, is there anything we can do to run Grog out like a labrador? I'm worried about him not getting enough playtime in.

name: SAM
dialogue: In Draconia?

name: LIAM
dialogue: No, in the mansion. Can you bamf up anything for him in the mansion?

name: SAM
dialogue: You're talking about tonight?

name: LIAM
dialogue: No. We're going to go camp somewhere for a day, right?

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, we're going to Draconia.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Right now?

name: SAM
dialogue: Go to the black dragon lair, then go to Draconia, then spend a night there.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I've been travelling with these fuckers for years, and I still don't understand magic.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Hold on a second. We have two choices if we're going to Draconia: we can either go to Umbrasyl's lair to scry from there, then teleport there, which means we will be staying the night in Draconia.

name: SAM
dialogue: In Draconia?

name: TALIESIN, MARISHA
dialogue: In Draconia.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Or we go to Draconia right now, blindly, and then I'd still have a spell to get us out.

name: SAM
dialogue: But they could track us back here.

name: LAURA
dialogue: How can we go there blindly if you don't know where a tree is?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, I'd scry.

name: SAM
dialogue: And then they'd know where we are.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: They could theoretically, if we get caught.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We would only scry on a tree. We wouldn't scry on a dragon.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I have a compromise.

name: SAM
dialogue: Actually, can I just throw this out? The only thing that would detect us scrying is currently flying over the ocean. We can scry right now.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Let's scry from the giant's cave outside the city.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It'll still take a couple of hours to get there, though?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Couple of hours to get there. It's fine. It's nine. It's seven--

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's 5:00 in the morning!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's 3am! Why are we awake?

name: MATT
dialogue: You're still drunk somehow.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We get far enough outside of the city so at the very least--

name: SAM
dialogue: To the giant's lair! To scry!

name: MATT
dialogue: North of the city, up into the beginning stages of the Alabaster Sierras, you find the abandoned fortress that is there, embedded on the side of the mountain wall. Keyleth, you are attempting a scrying spell? What are you scrying on?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay. I have the map of Draconia, let me just see if I can scry--

name: SAM
dialogue: You know what you know in Draconia? Do you know what you know in Draconia? You know Tiberius and you know his armor, and you know his objects and personal effects?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No, we don't know if he's in Draconia.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We may end up somewhere random.

name: SAM
dialogue: That's true. but what do you know what is in Draconia?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I know of the things that Tiberius has told us.

name: SAM
dialogue: Do you know any of his friends or his family? Have we met his family?

name: MATT
dialogue: You have not met his family. You've never been there.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I don't need to have a known location, right? I can just scry in a general area, yeah?

name: MATT
dialogue: You need generally a creature of some kind.

name: SAM
dialogue: What about his little pet?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Are you not scrying on a tree?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Lockheed.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Lockheed has a higher chance of being dead than Tiberius.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think that's underestimating, or overestimating-- I don't know.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's a coin flip.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's a coin flip, really. He's small.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, this could answer our question. If I can't find anybody, then we might be going to Marquet.

name: SAM
dialogue: That's true.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Go for it, then. See what happens.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I guess it's Tiberius, then? He's all I got. It's got to be someone that I know? It can't be something I've heard about?

name: MATT
dialogue: It can be something you've heard about. A person or a creature.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: A person or a creature, not a place?

name: MATT
dialogue: Not necessarily, no.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Can it be a magic object?

name: MATT
dialogue: It would be a creature of some kind.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We know about Tiberius. We know about Kruvanis Stormwind.

name: SAM
dialogue: We know of Lockheed.

name: LIAM
dialogue: The Mending Wheel. A creature only? Oh shit. Fucking magic!

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's what he just said!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Are we gambling on Tiberius being there?

name: SAM
dialogue: You're going to gamble on Tiberius?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I am gambling on whoever we scry to, because they could all be dead.

name: SAM
dialogue: How many times can you scry?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Theoretically, four times.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I've also got a Scrying Stone.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Start with the stone.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's right, you've got that goddamn thing. Give me the stone.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Here.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Thank you!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think we should call it rock. The Rock.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It doesn't go away, right?

name: LAURA
dialogue: No. it's a Scrying Eye. You can use it once a day.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah. Let's do this!

As you guys begin to walk, a nearby pile of rock and rubble, there was that one cluster of four, five of these moving lizard-like entities. Suddenly, one of them looks at your group, looks back at the rest, and they all stand up and look over in your direction.

name: SAM
dialogue: You're our leader, friend. Do we continue?

name: MATT
dialogue: They're just watching you. They're not doing anything.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Let's injuredly keep walking.

name: MATT
dialogue: They go back to rummaging through. You guys continue to walk. The ravine curves to the right, or at least begins to open up further to the right and you're met with the next large structure of rubble. What you saw was the edge of an extremely large, once-floating island, now crushed and sundered across the ground. There are sheets of ice across parts of it. You can see the better part of a large palace or library that is now caved in partially. You can see frozen books scattered across portions of the stone and rock on the ground before you. You can see a series of huts have been constructed on top of this rubble, and there are some small fires lit, little plumes of smoke and probably two dozen dragonborn figures that are currently combing through the rubble.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Do we see any books that seem interesting as we're walking through them?

name: MATT
dialogue: They're underneath ice. You can try and chisel some out, if you like.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Don't have time!

name: MATT
dialogue: A lot of it's covered in snow. There's some bits you can peek through and see sheets of ice and frozen books--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are there any frozen bodies?

name: MATT
dialogue: As you begin to have a closer book as you walk by, there are many frozen bodies. You see many people, all dragonborn, some atop the rubble, some partially crushed, some partially locked in ice, some destroyed by some sort of an acidic substance. Some of them are covered in boils, and their face is locked in some sort of horrible coughing fit. This was a very terrifying battle scene that has transpired here.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That means Raishan was here.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That means Thordak was here.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Umbrasyl was here. Acid.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: They attacked the cities as a horde.

name: MATT
dialogue: There are no signs of anyone burned.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I thought you said ash.

name: LAURA
dialogue: The people that are scouring through the rubble, are those dragonborn or just the lizard people?

name: MATT
dialogue: Best that you can tell right now, it appears to be dragonborn.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can we look at their behavior and see what it looks like they're doing?

name: MATT
dialogue: Make an insight check.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I would like to join that insight check.

name: SAM
dialogue: I would not like to.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Nine.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Nine.

name: SAM
dialogue: I will join that insight check.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'll join in, too.

name: MATT
dialogue: You've already said no.

name: LAURA
dialogue: 13. This isn't having to do with dragons? So it's 13.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I don't do insight checks too often, I'm sorry. 22.

name: MATT
dialogue: Did you roll or not?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh, I rolled a ten.

name: MATT
dialogue: Best you can tell, they're surviving. They're scouring through the ruins, trying to find anything of worth. Some of it's finding wood and throwing it onto these little flame pyres that are scattered around the ruins. You begin to look and see that actually the sides of the ravine, there are hundreds of small caverns are carved into the rock. Not quite like a dense honeycomb style, but it looks like there is an entire cave city that lives within this ravine.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And they're not frozen over?

name: MATT
dialogue: Some of them are covered in snow.

name: LIAM
dialogue: But snow, not blasted with ice?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They look like they're in use?

name: MATT
dialogue: Some of these dragonborn, they're coming out of their huts. Some of them are still looking up at the sky nervously. They look over and see you guys approaching and a voice calls out, "Who goes there?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Friends. Friends of Stormwinds.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Friends of Stormwind, you say? We have friends of Stormwind. Approach."

name: LAURA
dialogue: I walk up injuredly.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm hobbling up behind.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm cowering.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys cower and approach. Keyleth, Vax, and Vex, you notice as you approach that a number of the people that have all stopped and are paying attention are beginning to move around and encircle you.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Pardon my friends, their tongues have been cut out by our captors. I'm all that's left.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you walk forward you can see the figure that's talking to you, a very tall, burly, bronze-scaled dragonborn, long horns that protrude down the back in a slow curvature. No tail. In fact, you now notice that every single one of the dragonborn you've noticed here have no tail.

name: SAM
dialogue: We had a 50-50 chance!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Friends of Stormwind. That would make you Sky-walkers. I see your tails. You survive the "onslaught and step into the den of those you persecuted. Well, what are your last words?"

name: SAM
dialogue: This was a great plan.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Drop it.

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't know what's going on.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Is this all being said in Draconic?

name: SAM
dialogue: It's Draconian! I don't know what's happening.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You know what, I don't know what to tell you. Everyone with a tail's an asshole. We got what was coming to us.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a persuasion check.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Wow!

name: MATT
dialogue: He turns his head to the side a bit. (spits) "What skills do you have?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: I can shoot.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Is that all?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: He makes boots.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That's a skill."

name: LAURA
dialogue: She's really good at stonecraft.

name: MATT
dialogue: All the other dragonborn that come behind you are now holding spears, some of them rudimentary-looking pikes that are just held up and pointed in your direction. You guys are now enclosed by about two dozen dragonborn. "Here are your choices: You die here like the scum you are--"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Choice B.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Then slavery it is." (laughter) "You will join the rest of your ilk, and you will seek food for us. You will know what it's "like to be bent beneath the knee of those who do not deserve it. Put them in chains!"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, they're going to know, as soon as we're in chains.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, we're going to have a fight here.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, shall we drop Seeming? Perhaps we should drop Seeming?

name: SAM
dialogue: What? Is it going well?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Wait.

name: MATT
dialogue: They approach, and stop for a second. A few of the folks who came over and went to grab for chains have stopped and are holding them in their hand.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I have to tell you something. We're not actually Draconian.

name: MATT
dialogue: He leans in and gives you this very keen look now, and takes a few steps closer. He's about five feet from you now. "From where I stand, you look pretty fucking Draconian to me."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, we have some really good magic users with us. Look, forgive us for making tails. We don't know anything about your culture. We're idiots! We came here because we know you're under attack, and we're trying to help.

name: MATT
dialogue: "And you just wander into the caves of the Ravenites, dressed in the face of those that broke "our backs?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yep, because we're stupid!

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a persuasion check with disadvantage.

name: SAM
dialogue: Disadvantage. Not good.

name: MATT
dialogue: 14? "Bring the chains. You have ten seconds to prove--"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Drop Seeming, just drop it.

name: SAM
dialogue: Really? It's one of my better spells.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I know, I'm sorry!

name: SAM
dialogue: All right, poof. We're back to normal.

name: MATT
dialogue: All of your images fade. Everyone takes a step back. The spears come up even further, and there's a little pause.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: My tail's gone! Bummer.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, believe me, you don't want the tail.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But I enjoyed it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Does this make things better or worse for us?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I repeat him.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, the reactions you get from them, you gather most of these don't speak Common and none of them seem to understand what you're saying.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Here's the thing. You're being attacked by a white dragon.

name: MATT
dialogue: "The white dragon came, and he tore down the Sky-walkers."

name: LAURA
dialogue: So you're happy with it?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, it's put us in a better position."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Right. But now that the Sky-walkers have already been torn down, do you want to keep the dragon in charge?

name: MATT
dialogue: "We owe the dragon for the freedom that he gave us."

name: LAURA
dialogue: So you serve one.

name: MATT
dialogue: "For the time."

name: LAURA
dialogue: And he doesn't punish you at all? He's a good master?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Those who deserve punishment get it. But we hunt with it. It brings us power. It promises "expansion of the Ravenites, and we will no longer live under the boot of those in this countryside "and this continent."

name: LIAM
dialogue: How's it going?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Really bad.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We have children to feed. We have families of our own."

name: LAURA
dialogue: How can we help?

name: MATT
dialogue: "How can you help?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's what we're here for.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Bring us food, bring us warmth, chop some firewood. Bring some trees. Work."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Gladly. But not in chains. We do this freely.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Give us your weapons, and you can walk freely."

name: SAM
dialogue: Let's kill them all.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm sorry, that's not happening.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Then leave."

name: LAURA
dialogue: That we will.

name: MATT
dialogue: "What is your business here, she who wanders in the faces of others?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's a cool title.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, add that to the list. Our entire landscape is under attack. Now, Vorugal has helped you, but they've made many others suffer, not just Draconians. Entire cities brought down, for nothing. We're here to right the wrong and help in any way we can.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You should talk to Tooma."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Tooma.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Tooma. It is not a tumor.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We knew that was going to happen.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Took about 1.5 seconds to fuck with Matt's name.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think he assumed.

name: MATT
dialogue: All you're doing is putting fuel on the fire. (groaning)

name: SAM
dialogue: Is it Tooma?

name: MATT
dialogue: Tooma. T-O-O-M-A.

name: LIAM
dialogue: That's totally different.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Who is Tooma?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Tooma is our chieftain. I'm not to make this decision. Come. No chains, for now." They all stay with their spears still out in front, but they nudge you forward.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I explain everything that's happening in Common as we walk. Is everyone still cool with this? We're going to the chieftain.

name: SAM
dialogue: Just tell us when it's time to kill everybody.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We improvise. It's what we do.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think this is actually going far better than I had hoped.

name: SAM
dialogue: Just remember Vex, ticking time bomb here. We've got to get in, get out. We've got one day here.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are there any trees that we can see as we're walking?

name: LAURA
dialogue: They actually said they wanted us to chop firewood, so if we can get sent on that mission, we're set.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a perception check.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Hey, 19!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Are we in the mountains? No. Are we?

name: MATT
dialogue: You're in a ravine. Perception check was just for Grog, as he's the only one that asked to look for trees. But you rolled a 19?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I did!

name: MATT
dialogue: Looking around, occasionally poking out of the rubble, you'll see a tree. Most of them seem to have not fared so well with the cold weather and have been snapped or broken in the process of the falling rubble. You do make out, towards the edge on the other side of the ravine, beyond this giant one, you can see this one island, one larger island of the cluster that made up Draconia, fell in the center here and is broken apart. On the far end, you can see there's a small cluster of trees, the hint of green still to them, some of them varying thickness.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I could work with that.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Might be a long way, though.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We've been here, what, ten minutes?

name: MATT
dialogue: I'd say about 20.

name: SAM
dialogue: So we're going to go see Tooma, or we're going to chop down some fucking trees?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We have to go. They're walking us to the chieftain. Can't just walk away now.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys are prodded along, over the rubble, and as you come around you can start to see, where the outside of the island is broken rock, the center of it is broken structures. Buildings, homes, giant great marble halls, everything is mostly fallen in. You still see some structures standing, but at odd angles. There are sections of buildings that still show the outer outline of what once stood, but it is all a complete ruin. You do see every now and then a few large spikes of ice that are jutting out of portions, and you see bodies that are jabbed onto the spikes and left to freeze.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Do they have tails?

name: MATT
dialogue: They do. You move over the bulk of this giant pile of rubble and begin to descend the other side, and you can see now there is an active village here that is half-frozen entirely. Half of it seems to be abandoned; the other half of it is completely coated in solid ice. The crowd leads you past that abandoned village to a series of tunnels against the wall, maybe 300 or 400 feet past that cluster of trees that you saw. Leads you into this tunnel, and on the inside, there are small glow stones set in portions of the stone. Not naturally forming, but essentially small natural bits of torchlight just pressed into the stonework to give some sort of a light source. You're led in for about five or so minutes. and you see other offshoot tunnels. It's like a giant anthill weaved throughout this, and you can see rudimentary furniture made of wood and stone, with limestone rock, whatever's available within the actual ravine here.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can I get a sense on when this was carved? If this was carved recently or if this has been here a while?

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a nature check.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Ooh, 27.

name: MATT
dialogue: Best you can tell from looking at the rock and knowing the amount of erosion versus the curvature of it, these tunnels have been here for a very long time. This portion opens up and you can see now there is a much more refined, village-type structure inside, maybe 30-plus small homes carved from rock and stone. Built much better than the makeshift huts that you saw outside. You also see a giant pile of broken chains to the left side of the entryway. Many of them are manacles and neck vices that are just thrown and discarded in this large pile.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Tiberius never mentioned this side of Draconia.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you are brought into the center of this larger chamber you see two dozen Draconians that are out and about just currently gathering materials, talking and walking, and stop and see as you enter and just watch as you pass by. Colors range from metallic to chromatic, all spectrum; it's a mish-mash of all walks and sizes.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And the chromatic-- the red, the blue, the green-- are we seeing tails on them?

name: MATT
dialogue: Nope.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No tails.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Nobody has tails down here.

name: SAM
dialogue: I could make us all Draconian again without tails.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That would probably work at this point, right?

name: MATT
dialogue: You're led past a couple of these stone structures and there is a central, open circular plot between a lot of these. There's a fountain that seems to spring a very clean source of water within the center of this chamber. Beyond that, there is a larger temple-like square structure that has a slight trapezoidal appearance to it. The entranceway is an open arch, and you can see a large fire burning on the inside of it. You are led around the fountain and led to the inside. There, sitting on a large stone seat made of haphazard bits of rock and stone, it looks relatively uncomfortable, a large stone throne, there is a female dragonborn. She wears long, drab, gray robes, tattered at the edges, a hood loosely pulled back and a large scarf or wrap around her neck and shoulders. She just sits there with her hands over the side, draped, and as you walk in and your eyes adjust you can see that she looks very old. As you're brought in, the rest of your crew still pushes you in with the spears. She leans forward. "Are these prisoners of ours?" The dragonborn who brought you in goes, "They are, for the time being. They say they come here "because the Frigid Doom and other dragons who came are killing their people, as well. They have come "to fight the dragon, or so they claim. They walked in under guise of our enemy. It is your wisdom to "make these choices." And the larger dragonborn bows his head and steps away, the spears pull back and they step, blocking the exits that you walked through; the entire archway now is shoulder to shoulder dragonborn with spears at the ready.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Tooma. We apologize for coming in the guise of your enemies. Unfortunately, we don't know much about your culture, and no one ever informed us of what you have suffered, and we apologize.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a persuasion check.

name: MATT
dialogue: You're saying this in Draconic, I assume? She leans in a bit, and the firelight crackles under her chin, and you can see the teeth on one side pull out beyond the lip, and it gives her this lopsided look. The tongue wipes across the front, and she leans in toward you. "You come here "to fight the Frigid Doom, you say?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I would be lying if I said it did not bring a chance for freedom to all of us Ravenites."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Much deserved.

name: MATT
dialogue: "But as time progresses, I fear we shake one bond to step into another. The dragon presented "itself as our savior, but has since required an ever-growing fealty."

name: LAURA
dialogue: They do that.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Without the Draconians, without the Sky-walkers, and without the Doom, we would be "free. Rebuild our culture."

name: LAURA
dialogue: I want nothing more for you than that. Let us help you.

name: MATT
dialogue: Now, the rest of you hear this: "Do your friends speak Common?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, that's lovely.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Hi!

name: SAM
dialogue: Hi, yes.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Much relieved. Yes, they do.

name: SAM
dialogue: Grog doesn't, but we do.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (moans) (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: "If we are to let you go, do you promise to slay this creature?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: We will do everything in our power to watch it die.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It is our only purpose.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It has been gone for days."

name: LAURA
dialogue: It should be back very soon.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Took most of its army with it."

name: SAM
dialogue: Grog was right! He's always right!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That was our hope, that we would be able to come here when it was at its weakest and get a sense of it.

name: SAM
dialogue: Do you know where its lair is?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I do."

name: SAM
dialogue: Is it far?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It is not far, but one hour walk."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can I roll an insight check on her?

name: MATT
dialogue: You may.

name: SAM
dialogue: (gasps) Oh boy.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Do you know what I like as much as whispers? Loot Crate.

name: SAM
dialogue: What? Taliesin. You've got to do better than that. Try something like this: You know, Matt's an asshole, but you know who's not? The good people at Loot Crate.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Loot Crate doesn't decide to just tell one person about what's going on. They let everyone know, not just Vex.

name: SAM
dialogue: Hey, you never told us what he whispered to you before.

name: MATT
dialogue: No, he didn't.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We're good.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh boy.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm a vampire. Just deal with it.

name: MATT
dialogue: "If you come here to kill this dragon, I assume you have the means and a plan."

name: SAM
dialogue: We definitely have plans.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Totally have a plan.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Then let us set an ambush."

name: SAM
dialogue: Ambush? Sorry?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Come again?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, we tried to do that one other time. While it did pay off, and its brother is dead, a lot of people died in the process. A lot. Very large, strong people.

name: MATT
dialogue: "So what do you insist? We not have an ambush, we just wait for it to land and attack head-on?"

name: SAM
dialogue: We were going to use this opportunity to find our way into its lair and find its weaknesses, and plan.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Sabotage, from the inside.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There's more than one dragon, and they are supporting each other.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We kill this one, it'll set off a chain reaction that we might not be able to recover from if we're not fully prepared.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We want to make the means to make sure that when the time comes, we can destroy them all in one fell swoop.

name: LAURA
dialogue: The risk here is that by destroying Vorugal--

name: SAM
dialogue: The Frigid Doom.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We'll bring the wrath of the others upon you.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: He is not the strongest.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Thordak is much larger, and I don't think he's been here.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You speak with accents I do not understand. Where do you come from?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Everywhere.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We're a motley crew.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Lots of different places.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Do not answer that question.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We can answer the continent.

name: LAURA
dialogue: As you can see, we're half-elves.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We are to walk to the den. We are to learn your information. Then what?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Set up a situation where we can monitor you and possibly contact you when it's time, and even let you know if we think the dragon's about to leave, so that you can prepare.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I have lived to see this day by not being deceived or tricked. You speak words that are not "direct. They wind. They spin. They circle. What guarantee do I have that you will not just flee?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: To be fair, what guarantee do we have that you won't kill us, and the ambush was meant for us? I believe there is untrust on both sides.

name: MATT
dialogue: At which point, she steps off of the throne, steps on both of her feet, and when she's off the throne, her imposing form becomes far less imposing. You can see now there's a very heavy hunch to her back, and as she scuffles forward, she's an almost pitiful-looking sight, physically. As she pulls forward to walk straight to you, Keyleth, you see the somewhat clouded, cataract-ridden eyes of the dragonborn female Tooma. She comes up to you and goes, "We are a "proud people, even when pressed into the dirt for as many years as we have been. We reclaim our "honor. We reclaim our place in this world. We wish to do this as peacefully as possible, but we have "been forced to scrounge and survive through this freedom. We wish you no folly. We wish you no ill "will. But we also have learned that trust needs to be earned; it cannot be spoken and given so "freely. Both ways. You are right to mistrust, as are we of you. But that is the impasse. One must "have faith, in one way or another, if there is to be a compromise."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I think faith and trust are not mutually exclusive. I can not trust you and still have faith, and you should not feel lack of pride for living in the dirt, or surviving. There's nothing wrong with that. But I understand your urge to want to rebuild, become the great culture that I know you all are. So you should at least trust that we have similar interests in the end.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a persuasion check.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Ooh! 19!

name: SAM
dialogue: Was that opal?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes, it was.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Opal's back! 25.

name: MATT
dialogue: 25. She reaches forward and extends a finger that gently scrapes the bottom of the chin, not too much to hurt, but to go across the skin and pull your chin upward into the light of the fire a little bit. "There is much wisdom in there for so young a face. All right. There are not many "options we have, either. Come. We will walk. And at the very least, if you decide to flee, never return."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We can give you that word.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Tooma. Are the Frigid Doom's armies around? Will they see us?

name: MATT
dialogue: "There are a handful of dregs that stayed behind, but you tell me you wear many faces."

name: LAURA
dialogue: We certainly don't want them to see ours.

name: SAM
dialogue: What should we disguise ourselves as?

name: MATT
dialogue: She points past, over your head, and goes, "Tiny gnome, the faces of those that lead you here."

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay, tiny is uncalled for, but I understand. The faces of your tribe, of your clan. All right.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Be glad you walk with one as wise."

name: MARISHA
