dialogue: But you can't address it. You just have to let it be. I'm not going to encourage it. I'm not interested in him.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I see it every time. He does. He smolders.

name: MATT
dialogue: As he walks with you down the pathway, having this conversation. It's that awkward, quiet about three, four minutes of walking before he goes. (sniffs) "Ugh. So when all this is over--"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, come on, man. Why are you doing this to me? (laughter)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Hold on, it's going to happen. Let it happen.

name: MATT
dialogue: "If we survive all this dragon business--"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Fuck you, I hate you so much right now. (laughs) Uh-huh?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Do you want to get a drink?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I love drinks.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Good."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So much.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Great."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What kind of a drink?

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys begin to approach the edge of the tree. He goes: "I think you answered your own question."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Is that a yes?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well...

name: MATT
dialogue: "Open the damn tree."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Look. You know. It's really complicated right now, and I'm trying this whole "allowing myself to feel things" thing.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yeah. It doesn't work out for anybody. Trust me."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh man. I don't know how to respond to that. I'll see you on the other side. We'll put a pin on this one. Bye, Kash. And I cast it through the tree and I push him in.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right, then. We'll just-- hey!" And you push him through the tree. Shuts behind him. You're left there alone, standing in the cold Whitestone air outside of the Sun Tree. Around mid-morning.

name: SAM
dialogue: Did Kash leave already?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, he's gone.

name: SAM
dialogue: Aw, Vax, you didn't get a chance to say anything to him. I've talked to him about this. He has his eyes out on you.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I've got enough complications around me as it is.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm a really good reader of people.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's true.

name: SAM
dialogue: The dark eyeliner--

name: LAURA
dialogue: So now that that's handled, are we leaving today?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, we're leaving today.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, one of us doesn't have any luck left, so maybe we should spend the night.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I've got a little bit of luck. I'm a lucky guy.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We'll get our luck back tomorrow.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We've got a limited amount of time on this.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. You guys make your way towards the building that has recently been essentially given to and is acting as the abode for Shaun Gilmore while he's here in Whitestone. As you come to the front door, the door's closed. You knock. (knocking) No response.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Shaun? Shaun! It's us. Are you home?

name: MATT
dialogue: You hear a muffled voice in the distance within the building go, "Yeah, hold on."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Did it sound like anyone we knew?

name: MATT
dialogue: It sounded like Gilmore. He's under some sort of duress.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Sounded like he was under duress?

name: MATT
dialogue: Slightly.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Is everything okay?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes. Hold on, please." And you watch as the barrier flickers for a second and restores itself, almost like a wave of energy brought what was a slowly dwindling bit of the blue energy, now restored to its full strength.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: He's got to use the privy at some point.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, he's probably squeezing one out. It's okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: A moment passes before the door opens again and you see Gilmore there, beads of sweat down the front of his face. He's got his fuzzy purple-blue robe wrapped around him. "My sincerest apologies, "I had to take care of the now morning ritual."

name: LAURA
dialogue: How are you holding up, Gilmore?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm fine. This is child's play compared to what you're having to deal with on a daily basis, "I'm sure."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can I do an insight check?

name: MATT
dialogue: Go for it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh! You got a whisper on a 15.

name: SAM
dialogue: This is an early whisper. A first-hour whisper is rare.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It came at such a high speed. I wish it came so quickly.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I wish I knew more about Loot Crate right now.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, it's not just Loot Crate, Liam. It's Loot Wear. Those come in a separate bag.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Different than Loot Crate?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, it's different. You can find out all about it at lootcrate.com/criticalrole.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Actually, the shirt you're wearing, Sam, is from Loot Wear.

name: SAM
dialogue: What? It is? Oh my god! And I'm so handsome.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Anyway, back to the game.

name: MATT
dialogue: "What can I do for you?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, we plan to go to Marquet. Things have progressed much quicker than we expected it to, and unfortunately we are on a two-week time crunch before all hell breaks loose.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, at the very least, that gives us a series of days to make the best of the time we "have. So Marquet it is. All right. Come in." He closes his robe a little bit and walks in, and you enter. You can see there's a half-drunken tea set, and he begins to walk past. "Tea, anyone?"

name: SAM
dialogue: I'd like a loose-leaf oolong, please.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'll do what I can."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: How many cups are currently sitting with the teapot?

name: MATT
dialogue: Currently, there is one cup, but as he walks by, he does this with his fingers and you watch as multiple cups drift off the shelf and find their way (cups landing) on the table.

name: LAURA
dialogue: How does his house look? Does it look together like it would normally be, or does it look disheveled at all?

name: MATT
dialogue: It looks a little disheveled, but also it hasn't been too long since the assassination attempt on him and he threw his attacker into the far wall, but it looks like the furniture has been placed up. There are still some bits and pieces of broken things here and there, but for the most part it doesn't look like he's had lot of time to clean up other than just making it functional. It seems livable; it's not too bad. He goes into the kitchen. He comes back out a moment later with a fresh pot of hot tea and sets it down. "All right. So this isn't going to send you to where you're going--"

name: SAM
dialogue: We literally know nothing about Marquet.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's hot. It's dry. Bring some water if you can."

name: LIAM
dialogue: You're not able to leave, are you?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I should not. Got to keep this going until Allura comes back."

name: SAM
dialogue: Is there anyone that we can say maybe vouches for us or someone who we are against so that we can win favor with the locals? Something like a no-tail, long-tail binary.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We walked into a sort of political snafu because we didn't know the lay of the land, so is there anything we should know in advance?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Best I can tell you, because I haven't been there since I was very young, one: this going to "send you not to Ank'Harel itself, it's going to send you to Shandal, which is a small oasis "village a little ways south of Ank'Harel. It's where I grew up."

name: LIAM
dialogue: What was that name again?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Shandal."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Shandal.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I will say that it has been about 15 years, so I don't quite know what to expect there. I "apologize in advance for any ensuing chaos, but it's a nice town. It's small, it's sleepy. It's "not my speed. Hence why I came here. However, in Marquet, it's mostly music, culture, fun people, "good food. Don't break the laws. Don't drink the water freely from the various channels you may "stumble across. Water there is a commodity. It is controlled and sold throughout the city."

name: LIAM
dialogue: We got a jug.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We got loads.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Those are the main things I can think of. I don't know what else you're really looking for there."

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, I can tell you.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Cabal's Ruin.

name: SAM
dialogue: Thank you.

name: TALIESIN, MARISHA
dialogue: The Den of Druja.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Druyah. Drujah?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Druhah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Jaja.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Thanks.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't know anything about that, unfortunately, but most folks that have "information are eager to give what they know with a little coin to grease the palm."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Or a little water.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Depends on who you're talking to. Anything else?"

name: LIAM
dialogue: No, go ahead.

name: MATT
dialogue: He pours tea for everyone else who asked for it. And for each person that asked for a different flavor of tea, he begins to snap his fingers and the tea color changes.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We are looking for a merchant warrior. Outside of you, do you know of any very powerful merchants?

name: MATT
dialogue: "There are many."

name: LAURA
dialogue: One with a missing eye?

name: MATT
dialogue: "That would definitely probably narrow it down, but none that I can remember off the top of my head."

name: SAM
dialogue: Why don't we bring Jarett with us? Is that a thing?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We should talk to him.

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay. Shaun, you do so much for us. We do nothing for you. Is there anything we can bring back for you or messages to give to someone there?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Is there anyone you haven't seen in all these years?

name: MATT
dialogue: "When you meet them, and you'll know who they are, tell them I say hello. And actually--" He thinks to himself for a second. Rushes off. Comes back with a small backpack made of leather and thick, light tan wool. He opens it up and reaches inside. Pulls out a small silver locket and takes it and puts it in your hand, Vex. He goes, "Just give that to them."

name: LAURA
dialogue: To them?

name: MATT
dialogue: He closes the bag and places it back in the other room.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Shaun, are you doing okay? You look a little worn out.

name: MATT
dialogue: (sighs) "We do what we must."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I could only imagine a barrier of this size of a construct can be quite taxing on one's physical energy.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes. I guess if I had one request of all of you, this goes universally, can we end this dragon "business soon? Please? I really just want to set up shop again."

name: LIAM
dialogue: We would like nothing more. I think we're on the same page.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Great."

name: LAURA
dialogue: We're very interested to start paying you for your service again, Gilmore, and stop expecting it for free.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Good. Because I've been keeping a tally. I don't know about you guys, but the tab is running "very deep."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, believe me. I have, as well. This locket will take a nice little chunk off of that tally.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Fantastic. I love it."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Birds of a feather, you two.

name: SAM
dialogue: Should we go talk to Jarett and then come back?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Let's go talk to Jarett. We'll have appropriate clothing set up and prepare ourselves for the trip.

name: SAM
dialogue: Robes and things?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'll be here if you need me."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Thank you.

name: SAM
dialogue: We'll be back in an hour.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right. You don't want the rest of your tea?"

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh. I'll drink it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Do you have any to-go cups? (laughs) Just kidding.

name: MATT
dialogue: "These didn't belong to me, so please, take them if you want." (laughter) He transitions the tea over into a couple of cups and hands them off to you guys who haven't finished. You head out. As you're leaving, you see Sherri coming up. Her hair's a bit tattered. She's usually more put together when she runs the shop. Now she's in casual Sherri mode. Her hair is frazzled and pulled back. Her glasses are pushed to the end of her nose, and she's carrying a bundle of groceries, various bits of produce and such. "Oh, hello, everyone. I'm bringing Gilmore "his breakfast."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Sherri. We asked him, but he's modest. How's he doing?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Not that he'd tell me anything, but he doesn't have a very lengthy period of keeping this "up without him probably collapsing like he did back in the city. Just please, try to do your best to "get this over with. I'm worried. At the very least, until Allura comes back. At least they can "share the load. All right." She knocks on the door and opens it. "Gilmore? Gilmore, breakfast." The door closes behind her.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Hey, I have an idea.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh boy.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I know, it's thrilling. We need eight gallon wine skins or bottles or jugs. Because the Alchemy Jug can make out eight gallons of fresh water. We pour it all out and then at the end of the day it starts over, so we have eight gallons sitting in the bag.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: In theory, we all have water skins, don't we?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We should have a spread of our survival kits.

name: LIAM
dialogue: But all the same, that is a very good idea, Grog.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm surprised you even know how many eight gallons is, Grog.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, eight gallons.

name: SAM
dialogue: But if we had an extra skin or something, we could trade it. We could give it away, so we should go get one, yeah?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, we could give it away, give it away, give it away now.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Wow. I walk off and look for Jarett.

name: LIAM
dialogue: A rift just opened in the universe.

name: MATT
dialogue: It doesn't take you long. He is still stationed as one of the central figures guarding the actual castle of Whitestone itself. Similar to the place you saw him last time you guys had a conversation walking up to the castle. He stands there with his crossbow at the ready, giving a long view over the surrounding valley before he watches you approach. "Friends, you have returned. "I hope all is well on your end. Can I be of service?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: You can tell us all about where you're from, actually. Did you leave Marquet a long time ago?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It was maybe ten, nine years ago, "and it was not under the best terms. Probably would be in jail had I not got away."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, really?

name: MATT
dialogue: "They are not very forgiving of broken laws there, and based on certain judgments... let's "just say a slap on the wrist usually takes the wrist with it."

name: LAURA
dialogue: What did you do?

name: MATT
dialogue: (sighs) "Whatever was needed for survival."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, we're going there, so I'm hoping either you can give us a lot of tips so we don't run into problems, or I don't know if anyone can take your place right now. Do you want to go on a field trip?

name: MATT
dialogue: "To Ank'Harel?"

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: "No!" (laughter) "I'm sorry, I respect this. I think my strength and skill set is much better used here "than in the Scarlet Prison beneath the Cerulean Palace. I do not want to even conjecture spending "the rest of my life there, or in pieces. Also possible."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Forget it. We need all the knowledge in your head, in ours.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, what was that Scarlet Prison you just mentioned, under the what now?

name: MATT
dialogue: "The Cerulean Palace. The Cerulean Palace is where the Hand of Ord generally keeps most "justice, where most of the courts are kept. It is also where the Tower of J'mon Sa Ord is maintained "for watching over the entire city, and most of that eastern side of Marquet. The Scarlet Prison "is where people go to disappear. It is also referred to as the Scarlet Oubliette. People are "placed there to go away; people are placed there to be tortured; people are placed there, rumors "say, to be part of various experiments. Regardless, I would highly recommend--" He looks to you. "Don't steal anything unless you are damn sure nobody knows of it."

name: LIAM
dialogue: I haven't stolen anything in years.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (coughing) Bullshit.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Me neither. (laughs nervously)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I've never stolen anything!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Have you heard about the Den of Drujah. Drujah.

name: MATT
dialogue: He closes his eyes a second. "That was... a very, very--"

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's unscrupulous.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It would have been in a tale of a one-eyed merchant.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Not any merchant I know, but this Den you speak of, they were a rather serious gang running "rather violent activities in the city maybe 70, 80 years ago."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Would they have been in the walls? Is it possible to be in the walls of Ank'Harel?

name: MATT
dialogue: "In the outer walls? The outer walls are solid. They are thick; they are meant for defense "only. I did not run with them. I do not know anything. It was before my time, but they have not "been around for at the very least 50 years."

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right.

name: SAM
dialogue: Do you know who rules Ank'Harel now?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It is J'mon Sa Ord."

name: LIAM
dialogue: What can you tell us about him? Or her, or it?

name: MATT
dialogue: "J'mon? I have not seen J'mon, though I have heard the stories. J'mon brought the city together "400 years before. When it began to grow, expand, when it became this great oasis, long ago, it went "into chaos, and there were many who wished to utilize those who lived within the center desert "to be abused, to be swindled, to be enslaved. "J'mon started the Hand of Ord, which was the peacekeepers, and really brought the town of "Ank'Harel into the grand city it is today. Not known to appear in public very often; there are many "rumors that circulate. Some say that perhaps J'mon is some godling, an entity that has existed long "before Ank'Harel and will exist long after. "There is also-- and this is my personal belief-- I think J'mon Sa Ord is many people. I think J'mon "is more of an office, a station, a title that's passed on from person to person, because I've "heard referenced as a girl, I've heard referenced as a boy."

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's like the Man in Black.

name: LIAM
dialogue: What story is that?

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's this famous tale of the Princess Bride. Don't worry about it.

name: SAM
dialogue: Does the Hand of Ord carry any symbol? Do you know of any way of identifying them?

name: MATT
dialogue: "They carry ornate armor of a deep blue sapphire color, and brass."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Brass.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Like the dragon.

name: SAM
dialogue: And this other city, Shumble. Humbal.

name: LAURA, MARISHA
dialogue: Shandal.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Shandal! Yes. (laughs) It's more of a podunk."

name: LAURA
dialogue: A very small town.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Comparatively, yes. Ank'Harel is immense. Shandal is usually a small stop in case camels or "other horses have died in transit, as well as a small water stop on the way to the city."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Is it a long trek from there to the city?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'd say maybe a day's travel."

name: SAM
dialogue: In which direction?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It is to the south-southwest of Ank'Harel."

name: LIAM
dialogue: On par with Emon, the city? Bigger? Smaller?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh, Emon? Comparable. A bit bigger."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Wow. Shit.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We'll make waves.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah. Maybe we shouldn't.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well. We're going to have to get someone's attention.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's a city that has no water. We shouldn't make waves.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Do you remember, in all your time there, did you ever deal with-- this is completely ridiculous-- a merchant who only had one eye?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't recall. I've met people missing many limbs and parts of their body. Kind of "happens; it' a dangerous place, the deserts in Marquet. But there are also many people that live there."

name: LIAM
dialogue: And you're sure we can't talk you into going? Percy's giving out titles.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I am absolutely not!

name: MATT
dialogue: "I have no interest in titles. I just wish to stay alive. I'm sorry. I am much more of use to "you here, I assure you. I would be a perpetually nervous paranoid wreck if I were to come with you."

name: LAURA
dialogue: I can't even imagine you like that.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Good. We'll keep it that way."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Jarett, was there still a control of water going on while you were there?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes, for many long years, yes. The oasis is built around."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Is there anything we should know about that?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, most of it's controlled in the River District. A number of canals begin in the River "District. This is where there is the spring, the perpetual oasis that fuels the city, and many of "the caravans that travel to and from."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Perpetual oasis.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Source of power. (laughter)

name: SAM
dialogue: Good note-taking, Grog. How do people greet each other there in Ank'Harel? Is there a "Kord's "strength be with you" thing?

name: MATT
dialogue: "There is 'be pleased,' with a small bow, preferably with the hand down towards the stomach, "with the hand out. Be pleased."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Be pleased.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Beep-bleep.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Bleep-bleep, yes. No stealing. Got it.

name: SAM
dialogue: Water is valuable.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Don't drink the water.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Is there anything that's offensive? We don't want to offend anyone by accident.

name: MATT
dialogue: "To be honest, anything you do will offend somebody in the right place, right time, but "people are pretty laid back in Ank'Harel, as long as you follow the rules. It's a beautiful city. "I'm actually excited for you to see it. I'm very proud of it, had I not made some mistakes."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Can we bring you anything back?

name: MATT
dialogue: "You know what? If you can, there is a special spice that is harvested not far from the "city. If you could find me some fusaka spice? Bring me a small-- not a lot, just a bit."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Is it for food?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's for food, yes."

name: LIAM
dialogue: I would love to do that. We'll keep an eye out.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's a bit pricey. I can give you some--"

name: ALL
dialogue: No!

name: LIAM
dialogue: No, you've done way too much for us.

name: TALIESIN, LIAM
dialogue: Fair trade.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right. Well, I appreciate it."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Be pleased.

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughs)

name: LAURA
dialogue: We'll work on it.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Work on it for a bit, maybe watch some folks. You'll pick it up right quick, just pay "attention."

name: SAM
dialogue: All right, well, shall we--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Let's go change, and then let's be off.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right, be safe, friends. Look forward to your return."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Keep everyone safe?

name: MATT
dialogue: "That is my purpose."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And Jarett, will you keep an eye on Gilmore for us?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Is he all right?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I think he's just working himself a bit much.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Stretched a little thin.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I may have noticed it myself. I will do this for you. Promise."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Thank you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "My pleasure."

name: SAM
dialogue: To Marquet?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: To market!

name: SAM
dialogue: To buy a fine pig.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: To market!

name: SAM
dialogue: Home again, home again.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I didn't realize Marquet was like Emon. This might be a bit difficult, to find a one-eyed merchant in a city bigger than Emon.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think that once we arrive, he'll find us. Or she.

name: LAURA
dialogue: This is true.

name: SAM
dialogue: We get there, we start poking people in the eye until someone doesn't flinch, then we'll know we found them.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Can I point out that now we have to learn an entirely new lore? We've worked so hard, and now spices? Rivers, canals, fusaka! Oh god, I'd gotten everything together, and now.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We've only got two weeks. Fuck.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It takes a day to do Disneyland.

name: SAM
dialogue: Does anyone speak Marquetian, or do they speak Common there?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We'll run into a lot of Common. Common is common for a reason.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right, let's go.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right, you guys head back to Gilmore's place?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, but are we going to get some water jugs and shit like that before we leave?

name: SAM
dialogue: Sure, we get some water jugs.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, more water's good.

name: MATT

You step up to the very top of the stairs to find yourself already breathless at the sight of the immense purple-blue-colored palace. A dozen towers reach for the clouds, the daylight peeking through their slightly translucent material, like glassy waters ever-frozen in a fall. The central tower, the one that caught your eye, that ends in a large cup-like position, rises above all of them with a slight spiral-type texture to the outside of the palace that is incredibly tall amongst the rest of the cityscape. As you get closer, you can see the main palace structure presents hundreds of arches pointed at their apex in its structure, smaller and smaller as it recesses further into the palace. Its very architectural build is a marvel, and seems to both have consistency and a chaotic feel to the placement of some of these arches too, in size. It's a very strange but fascinating structure. You can also see turquoise detailing and trim against many of the pillars and carvings and statues that adorn the exterior of the grounds of this palace. As you approach what appear to be the front gates that ascend, with a very bright blue turquoise exterior, close to 50 Hands of Ord patrol various elements of the grounds around it. It looks like there are actual pockets of grass and gardens that exist around the Cerulean Palace in here. The topography changes almost to feel like it belongs entirely anywhere but the middle of the desert. The guards do eye you suspiciously as you approach, and you watch as one armored woman, her dark hair hidden mostly beneath an ornate helmet of brass and blue, approaches you guys. "Welcome to the Cerulean Palace. I must ask "your business here."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Forgive us for our intrusion. We come seeking an audience of J'mon Sa Ord.

name: MATT

name: MATT
dialogue: 24. "Let me inquire with the Grand Maven." She turns around, her armor clinking, and walks back to the palace, leaving you guys there amongst these courtyard grounds. A few moments pass before she returns, the doors opening. As she descends, next to her you see an older woman with these long, ceremonial robes that drag behind her, spilling across the stairs as she descends, seemingly dozens of gemmed bracelets that jingle as she walks with each step. She wears a tall headdress with what looks like brass quills that press behind her head and down her back. As she approaches you all, the woman earlier that you spoke to, the Hand that approached you, stays behind quietly and watches, weapon at the ready. The woman steps forward with a smile, and unlike the abrasive appearance that most of the Hand have given, she seems to be more welcoming, and gives, for the first time since you've been here, a very formal welcoming bow with her hand before her, the other hand out. Says, "Be pleased, everyone."

dialogue: "I must apologize. We were not aware of your arrival here. I am the Grand Maven Gameshega. "Please, enter and follow me."

From the interior, massive pointed archways that lead down ornately decorated halls that echo with each footfall that hits across what looks like endless white and black bespeckled marble. She leads you through a series of hallways, more Hands walking past, as well as a number of other robed individuals. What appears to be a central chamber that has a number of steps and seats, where it looks like various philosophers are in mid-heated discussion in once again, this same language that you have not heard on your ears before. You are eventually brought to a very intricate and decorated waiting room, with some finely upholstered silk chairs, couches. The Grand Maven stops. "If you would not mind, please have a seat."

No other exit. You all enter and the door closes behind you, the Maven still relaxing, her arms to her side, her headdress still giving her this ominous presence. Looks up, and there's a (impact) shuddering sound. Suddenly, the bland, uncharacteristic walls, compared to the rest of the palace, begin to slide past the chains, now making this rattling sound as the floor itself seems to be lurching. You feel a bit of pressure in the room that wasn't there before. You're all being lifted, and the walls, now no longer walled in by the rest of the palace, you can now see this occasional traveling-down line as the spiral on the outside of the tower you once saw now surrounds you. The walls are much thinner than the rest of the palace, as you can see through this somewhat-translucent glass exterior the entirety of Emon surrounding you from upon high as it goes lower and lower as you're lifted higher and higher into this tower.

The Maven says, "I request you do not touch the walls, please."

dialogue: The view reveals the entirety of the city around you, and beyond that, the distant dunes and the desert that seems to have no end. You view a far-off mountainscape a little bit in the northern direction that just begins to peek past your view, then (boom) the floor ceases again. You all seem to lurch for a moment, yourself, an inch before you catch yourself on your feet. The Maven catches herself, very used to this transition. You now see behind her, where it has stopped, there is another set of doors, similar to the ones you entered from in the bottom portion of this tower. The door opens, (creak) and you can see the next room is a set of staircases of the same color that slowly curl off and disappear upward above you. "Please, follow me." She walks in, her robe dragging behind her. You guys give enough berth for it to follow. As you're led up the stairway, choosing right or left, they both lead to the upper platform in what is the top of the central tower of the Cerulean Palace. As you enter this room, you see close to a hundred dangling silk tapestries from 50 or 60 feet up of multitudes of different colors; rainbowscapes of beautiful translucent cloths and silks, gently flowing with breezes and mingling and mixing into each other around the outside of the wall. High arched windows on each side, and behind, what looks to be a large opening reveals passing clouds surrounding this height and obfuscating certain portions as they meet with the height of this tower's apex. You see a large balcony from the opposite side of the room that is opened from its own similar-sized arch that extends outward. It has a railing about four feet up that is an opening that overlooks in open air all above the city to see. In the center of the chamber, you see a series of step-like platforms, circular, that rise up upon each other, and in the center, you see what seems to be a tall throne of bronze and sapphire that probably sits ten feet up from the base. Thin, but extremely long and widens towards the top. You can see hundreds of sapphires put into and set into this shiny, ruddy metallic material that frames the entirety of the throne. And there sitting atop this throne, you see a slender, human-like entity wearing no jewelry, no ceremonial adornments, no crown, just a simple brown cotton shirt over simple, elegant pants. Bare feet, no shoes. Androgynous and beautiful; you're unable to make out the sex of this creature. It's not a man, nor elf. Not fey, but something somewhat alien, almost. The skin a deep-set reddish brown, smooth and impeccable. The features are extremely fine and delicate. The eyes are what catch you: black like night, but the pupils, burning points of molten metal. The entity smiles and stands off the throne. Now, at this height, seeing it standing almost as tall as Grog, by comparison. The limbs are elongated. dialogue: The dragon leans forward, the head coming down straight to you. Their maw right across from your size, one of their front teeth is about up to your waist by comparison. (heavy breathing) (chuckles) "You are sly, gnome." Turns around and reaches into the same box that carried the flute, pulls out a chain that dangles, fluttering in the wind, and hands it to you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's a four-day Comic-Con badge.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh! Professional!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Only one day."

name: SAM
dialogue: Sunday? Motherfucker! (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: The chain, as you grasp it-- it's dropped into your hand and you look at it. There appears to be a brass emblem with a single circular sapphire set into it. "This is a symbol of my "crest. Few should argue should they be under my sway."

name: SAM
dialogue: Thank you so much. And I drop six inches, which is to my knee, and bow my head in supplication.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Scanlan! Beep-beep. Beep-beep!

name: LAURA
dialogue: He means "be pleased."

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh! Be pleased.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Before we depart, my lord, I would ask perhaps some local knowledge. We have magical items that we require wisdom as to their origin and their function. Who would you trust in this city? Would you know who to trust in this city?

name: MATT
dialogue: Thinks for a second.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Flips through his notes.

name: MATT
dialogue: (chuckles) Yeah.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: A little Rolodex.

name: LAURA
dialogue: His Trapper Keeper. I like that everyone has a Trapper Keeper.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Large brass Trapper Keeper.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You hear the Velcro.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The iPad is rebooting.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Neon pinks and purples.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Updating? Goddamn it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: (as Devo'ssa) "I love Night Rider."

name: SAM
dialogue: How am I supposed to remember "beep-beep" from two weeks ago?

name: MATT
dialogue: "There are many who I would call friends, or trustworthy. The list would be long."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: For ancient objects, such as we have. For Vestiges. For things that are old.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You would seek Headmaster James Kryon."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: James Kryon?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Krylon?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Head of the Crystal Chateau's program for arcane arts and training."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I will not tell him of anything other than our gentle acquaintance.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Crystal Chateau-- what was that last bit?

name: MATT
dialogue: "The Crystal Chateau."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Got it. Sure. Crystal Chateau.

name: LIAM, MARISHA
dialogue: Old magic.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's a two year professional degree.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I don't know how to spell chateau. I really don't know how to spell it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Percy, what's the proper way to leave a royal chamber?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The way that you leave a royal chamber is you thank them for their patience and their time and for their wisdom, you keep your head beneath theirs, and you never turn your back. And you leave, facing them in reverence.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Thank you for having patience, put your head, and--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Be pleased. Don't say the words, just do the things. I didn't tell you what to say, I told you what to do.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Thank you for your patience. And I turn around and walk out. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: You hear a hearty, deep-throated chuckle as you turn around. As you make your way to the door of the exit, it opens once more as you hear the platform coming to rest once again. As it opens, there standing in the space is the cobalt golem, eyes flickering with white flame. (footsteps) It comes rushing forward past you, shouldering you out of the way. Grabs its blade. You can see there are dents in its armor, but it's still standing. Apparently didn't seem to take that much damage from the impact of the fall. It takes the blade and drags it behind it as it moves around J'mon, who steps back as the golem goes back under the balcony and then begins to climb back up outside to whatever strange device or platform it was affixed to before it dropped.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Sick.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Marvelous piece of engineering.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We have many throughout the palace."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Your technology is impressive, your craftsmanship beyond anything I have ever seen, and there is nothing more pleasing than a monarch with a sense of humor. Bless you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "My patience for your honeyed words grows thin." (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, that felt good.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That was so good, too!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Now, be on your way. I suspect when the time comes to call me you'd best be ready. Now." Turns around and with a whirl, the wind picks up again and the form shrinks down leaving, once again, in the space as the shadow shrinks, the lithe form of J'mon Sa Ord. They walk back to the throne as the throne seems to magically lift up and cover the box that was there beneath it before. Sits back on the throne, crosses their knees onto the throne, leans on one side of the armrest.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Should we ask how to tell if someone else is a dragon? Is there a tell?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They won't tell you.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Because I think that's their secret.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Right.

name: LAURA, LIAM
dialogue: Thank you.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I begin walking out.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, we all walk out.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Backwards. I'm going to keep holding my slashed--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That should actually give you excellent posture for a slight bow.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Right, yeah.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm going to cast Lay on Hands through my arm around her shoulder and give her a big five hit points.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, thank you. I'm in the thirties now.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's like the life force of two kittens.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Two kittens worth.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys step back into the platform. The door closes. The chains shudder and begin to unfurl as the platform lowers down once more, giving you the view over the vast expanse of Ank'Harel and the deserts beyond.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, in the see-through elevator?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yep.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Just us, no Grand Maven?

name: MATT
dialogue: No Grand Maven. It finally reaches the bottom floor. The door opens once again, and there you see the Grand Maven surrounded by twelve different servants that are now picking up pieces of shattered rooftop, broken furniture, and a large crater that is now jammed in the center of what was once the waiting room where you guys were previously set. Furniture scattered and totally ruined, and there seems to be an air of haste in making sure that it doesn't stay like this for long.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So sorry about that.

name: SAM
dialogue: Did anyone die?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Thankfully, no. There was no death. You are lucky this time."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Just a heart attack and a metaphor for our entire existence, that's fine.

name: SAM
dialogue: Did you see a javelin? No? Maybe? Okay.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can we look around for it?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We're going to have to take a walk around the tower for a javelin. You threw it?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: How high is the top of the tower?

name: MATT
dialogue: It's hard to tell. A few hundred feet.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: A few hundred feet up, I chucked the shit out of it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It could be around.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You know the needle in the desert metaphor?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Is there a needle in the desert-- is that a thing?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well, I've heard it before.

name: MATT
dialogue: There is now.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Many a wise and learned creature--

name: MATT
dialogue: You wish to take some time to go ahead and try and figure out a trajectory and where it may have gone?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm going to sit down and do a little math and see if I can get a vague sense.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm going to ask the Grand Maven: Flying, is that sort of weird here, or is that totally okay? On a broom, maybe? I don't want to do anything that's wrong here. I feel like I might be able to see it.

name: MATT
dialogue: "As far as I understand, there is no issue with flying within Ank'Harel."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Not old math.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: New math. He's finding fractals and shit over here.

name: MATT
dialogue: Did you roll a natural 20?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Weirdly enough, I've figured out--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He just created the Mandelbrots.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Percy, point me in the direction. I'll fly and get it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Natural 20.

name: MATT
dialogue: You became the animated gif of the cat that gets the flower on its head and sees through space and time. You guys watch as Percy zones out for five minutes, the hand moving at a rapid pace across the paper.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I found a window and I'm doing the Beautiful Mind.

name: MATT
dialogue: What that enables you, as you get some ideas as to the trajectory, the speed, the strength of Grog in the non-grown form versus the grown form. This does allow you, whoever wants to lead this expedition, one investigation check to possibly even recover anything.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can I fly? I feel like I could fly down and get it.

dialogue: I'll fly with her and use the math to--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Point me in the direction.

dialogue: So the two of you are using the broom. It only has space on it for one.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm going to hang.

dialogue: Okay, so Percy's hanging from underneath as you fly up a few hundred feet.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Hold tight, Percy!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I've locked my gauntlet.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm holding onto one of his wrists as I'm flying.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm watching in case I need to catch.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys watch them vanish in a darker and darker spot as they get higher into the sky. Percy. Go ahead and make a wisdom saving throw. name: LAURA
dialogue: No, Percy, you're totally fine.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, I'm not. Oh, I can reroll a saving throw, can't I? Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: You can, as a fighter, yeah.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I can reroll a saving throw, because I'm going to pretend that number didn't happen.

name: MATT
dialogue: Indomitable Will, this is a perfect use for it, actually.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm going to do it again. I have one more, so I'm going to blow them all.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, I'll let you do that.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Better!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Fight that vertigo, fight it!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'll tell you what, because I had to blow all of those, we can say I threw up a little. Let's go there. That's a wisdom, that's 19.

dialogue: 19. You feel quivering of the broom as Percy's hands are beginning to shake and you see the fingers constantly flutter. As you look down, about to ask if he's okay, you watch as (vomit noise) this spray of--

dialogue: I throw up, too, because anytime I--

dialogue: This was a very poor decision!

dialogue: Vax, you watch as you see a gentle rain.

dialogue: Have we gone forward, or have we just gone straight up?

dialogue: So we're not going to hit them.

dialogue: Excuse me, but this is poetic justice if I have ever seen it. That is beautiful.

dialogue: This has been the metaphor game. This is a metaphor for our entire existence.

dialogue: Yeah, I do a Gust cantrip overtop of us to keep from getting splattered.

dialogue: I'm not going to look down. I'm going to look ahead. I'm good.

dialogue: Yeah!

dialogue: Nope!

dialogue: Shut up!

dialogue: This is a one. I'm going to blame it on Matt Abernathy. Thanks for that opal dice.

dialogue: Yeah!

dialogue: What the fuck?!

dialogue: He got opal dice and it-- okay. That's okay.

dialogue: We love you, Abernathy, don't listen to her.

name: LAURA
dialogue: 13 perception.

dialogue: But you rolled a natural one.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Automatic failure. Sorry, Charlie.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Damn it.

dialogue: As he begins telling you about the wind trajectory, and the direction of its travel and the hypotenuse, and he goes in this long series of various--

name: LAURA
dialogue: I zone in and I notice that I accidentally puked a little bit on Percy's head. And that completely distracts me.

name: MATT
dialogue: Just focusing on the one bit of his hair. The little clump right there.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's got a tiny bit of puke on the top of his head, and I feel so bad I can't focus on what you're saying.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Because of that, we've done about 350. Have we done 350? Where are we now, 80, 90 feet ahead?

name: LAURA
dialogue: And I throw up again because it's so gross to see.

name: MATT
dialogue: This time, thankfully, you have the mind to pull out of the way a little bit. However, after about ten minutes of conversation, and you unable to focus again: it's lost. You have no idea where that javelin is.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I would like to think you could feel my grinning from way down below.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You were so smart with your math and I--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, sometimes math is not enough.

name: SAM
dialogue: 20 and a one.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Let's go fly down.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Someone is going to find a really expensive weapon.

name: MATT
dialogue: Someone's going to find some pauper impaled on a wall somewhere.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh no! No, I hope not! And the mystery, it will just be unsolved mysteries, they'll never know.

name: MATT
dialogue: Three month investigation, no answers.

name: LAURA
dialogue: They're going have a documentary on Making a Murderer.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It'll be one dude impaled against the wall and some poor bastard that grabbed it and then got fucking electrocuted. There's two corpses.

dialogue: As you guys fly back down, gather the rest of your party, the javelin lost.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Sorry, Percy, I'm so sorry.

dialogue: It's all right. It wasn't my javelin.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, but it was your hair that I threw up on.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You threw up on my hair?!

name: LAURA
dialogue: I mean! And I take some--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh god.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You know, if you hadn't thrown up to begin with, this would have never happened.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I wasn't aware that was going to be a thing that could happen. My hair is very absorbent, that's going to take some time.

dialogue: So as you guys take a moment to gather your next stage in your endeavor for the day, we're going to take a quick bathroom break. Back here in a few minutes guys; hold tight. We'll continue this adventure here in just a moment.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Man, I rolled a one! [break]

name: MATT
dialogue: Hello guys, welcome back! So, finished our break, Vox Machina have exited the Cerulean Palace. Apparently revealed to J'mon Sa Ord that they were capable, and in doing so, J'mon Sa Ord revealed that so is the leader of the city. So one javelin down, unfortunately. You are now getting to the later evening of your time here in Ank'Harel.

dialogue: What time is it?

name: MATT
dialogue: What is your plan?

name: SAM
dialogue: Is it sundown yet?

name: MATT
dialogue: It's pretty close. The sun's about 30 minutes from dusk.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Is it spice o'clock?

dialogue: I'm going to use another spell and heal myself some more.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh yeah. Can we take a short rest somewhere? And hit dice it up or something?

dialogue: Yeah, totally. Go ahead and take a short rest out there on the steps of the Cerulean Palace.

name: SAM
dialogue: Take a knee.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: A little therapeutic massages all the way around.

dialogue: Is Grit recovery a short rest or a long rest? I can't remember.

name: MATT
dialogue: What do you mean?

dialogue: Grit recovery.

dialogue: It's a short rest.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Thank you.

dialogue: And don't forget, Scanlan, you have an ability that helps everyone who's using hit dice gets a bonus.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You do?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Really?

name: SAM
dialogue: It's not very much but yes! Yes, I do.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's even less if you don't do it.

name: SAM
dialogue: I've never used it because it's so weak. But yeah, sure.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: He doesn't like us.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah. I do. I'm trying to find where--

name: MATT
dialogue: Song of Rest.

name: SAM
dialogue: Song of Rest. It's only a d10? What is it?

dialogue: Yeah. 1d10.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's still. That's potentially ten extra hit points.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Between all of us.

name: MATT
dialogue: Every person, as soon as you finish your short rest to heal. You heal an additional 1d10 hit points at the end of it.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right. I will sing us a Song of Rest.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, I rolled a ten! Oh wait, do I roll or you roll?

name: MATT
dialogue: You roll.

dialogue: We roll? Cool!

name: SAM
dialogue: I'll sing. (singing) I believe you can kill. I believe that you really will. Think about it every night and day. Sharpen your blades because it's time to play. I believe! Okay, it's time to go get some spice! (laughter)

dialogue: You finish your short rest. As the night takes the sky, the streets of Ank'Harel do not grow any calmer. The bazaar lights begin to glow in the distance as you see the lanterns and various magical light sources of the city spark to life and the lamps light themselves. name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There's a casino if I recall.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, that's where we're going.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Do you gamble?

dialogue: I don't know. I mean, I do, but I never gamble for fun.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I don't mean with lives.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, I do not gamble.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I enjoy the gambling game. That's fun!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's right! We did play cards with you. That went really well.

name: SAM
dialogue: Guys. If we're going to this casino, I have a deal to make. I value your friendship. I value the backup you will provide, but I need you to stay far away. Be inconspicuous. And by the gods, do not help me in any way! Unless I say some sort of a codeword.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What's the codeword?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Help me. Help me. Oh God, help me?

name: SAM
dialogue: That's a good one. Let's make it that! Help me. Help me. Oh God, help me!

name: LAURA
dialogue: I have a question.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Do you really think this is a smart move, considering that a brass dragon just gave us our aid and asked us not to fuck anything up?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Also, what exactly are you doing?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (loudly) Your drug deal?

name: SAM
dialogue: Keep it down, dude! Chill! Just chill!

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right. We're cool, Scanlan. We're cool.

name: SAM
dialogue: We are not cool.

dialogue: We're so cool.

name: TALIESIN, TRAVIS
dialogue: So cool.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm cool enough to know that, perhaps, you should hand off that necklace that he gave you.

name: SAM
dialogue: Not at all.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They're going to think you're a narc.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, they are! What if they find it on you?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You're wearing a police badge basically.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Give it to us. If anyone comes and tries to take you away, we'll present it and say that we're higher rank.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's true.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are you supposed to do anything to set up for this deal?

name: SAM
dialogue: Set up? I have to change into my red shirt.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And also, are you sure you really don't want us nearby? My sister and I can be unseen.

name: SAM
dialogue: Nearby is fine. Nearby is fine but keep your distance and do not do anything including if it looks like I'm in trouble.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I mean I'm ready for the show, man. It's fine.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We've seen you turn into a triceratops and fuck things up. We trust you, Scanlan.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Oh, we didn't see that.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, we know it happened.

name: SAM
dialogue: I had it commissioned as art.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Seen the tale throughout the mansion.

dialogue: Can I ask for one other codeword if you don't want us to step in? What if you want us to create a distraction?

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay, okay. What would that codeword be?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Kill everything.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, we are being honest on this trip, right? "Kill everything," means make a distraction, right? But "Help, help, oh god, help," means I need help.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: How about "tomato paste" to create a distraction?

name: SAM
dialogue: Tomato paste?

dialogue: Yeah, because I'll cover the walls in tomato paste. But from people.

dialogue: I feel like we need something that he could use in a sentence very easily.

name: LIAM
dialogue: What about "Love-a the spice?"

dialogue: "Love-a the spice," huh?

dialogue: Let's stick with tomato paste. I feel like that's easier to work into a sentence than "Love-a the spice."

dialogue: I don't doubt you could fit it in, Scanlan. Let's be real, please.

dialogue: Really nervous, guys. I've never done a drug deal-- (whispers) a drug deal before.

dialogue: Are you sure this is even a drug?

dialogue: Yes, of course! I said, "Spice. Spice. Spice," And shady people came around. That means it's a drug, right?

dialogue: Did you say what the spice was?

dialogue: Oregano.

name: SAM
dialogue: I told them. They seemed illicit about it. I'm very excited!

dialogue: All right. You'll do a wonderful job. You're so cool.

dialogue: The north end?

dialogue: It's where the Ravenites are. Nope! That's a different page.

dialogue: We'll find out.

dialogue: All right. I'm heading to the casino. Would you all like to join me? And you can entertain yourselves with some games while I--

dialogue: I cannot wait.

dialogue: I am very excited by this!

dialogue: I really enjoy the gambling!

dialogue: I enjoy watching her gamble.

dialogue: Yes!
