dialogue: Her hands are on the orb, eyes darting around. She's trying to think her way out of this. You see her face flash in a couple of ways, and she looks cunningly at all of you and smiles.

name: SAM
dialogue: Percy's killing you right now, not us. I drop it, and we all attack.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Stab.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Obliviate.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. Go ahead and roll, Grog. Roll your three attacks.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Reckless, great, everything.

name: MATT
dialogue: Vex, roll your two attacks. Vax, roll your attacks. Scanlan.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Goddamn it, Gil, you better not fuck me. Not bad, Gil. (laughs)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Are we doing melee attacks, or spell attacks, or what?

name: MATT
dialogue: Spell attacks is fine. She doesn't have a whole lot of energy left in her engine, and we don't even need to roll damage, because: How do you, Vox Machina, want to do this?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I want to sink my dagger into her arm, sever all around her shoulder, and rip her fake arm off of her body.

name: MATT
dialogue: (grunts) The arm plummets to the ground, the shadow still coalescing where the wound is. The shadow of Orthax shoots up into where the exposed wound is. With that moment, who does what next?

name: SAM
dialogue: I'd like to carve the de Rolo crest into her forehead.

name: MATT
dialogue: As she's clutching this, you reach forward and grab her by the throat, her eyes wide, and slash across. Right now, she has no strength to resist.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'm going to take the axe and go straight across her navel.

name: MATT
dialogue: Keyleth?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm going to take a Grasping Vine and choke her around her throat.

name: MATT
dialogue: The vines wrap around and hold her in place. Vex?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I want an arrow straight through her heart, and one in her mouth as she screams.

name: MATT
dialogue: The scream is cut short as the arrow finds its place in the back of the skull. The other one straight to the chest. Grog, your blade cuts through the midsection as the grasping vine pulls the lower half down. Ripley is entirely torn asunder in a final silent scream. The shadow of Orthax dissipates, sputters, and vanishes. The battlefield grows silent. You all turn and look back over your shoulder and see the still body of Percy against the tree trunks over there.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (tearfully) I'm still going to try and cast Cure Wounds on him.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (tearfully) I do the same.

name: MATT
dialogue: And that's where we'll pick up next episode.

name: SAM
dialogue: No. Shit.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What? Why would you do that to us?

name: MATT
dialogue: It's what they would have done.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm okay with this.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I have nothing left.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What just happened?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Wait, is that it? We need to know, because if that's it, then we've got to go get drinks. (laughs) That was our promise.

name: MATT
dialogue: There are certain people that have magical, divine abilities that have been known to restore life. It's happened before to other members of your party.

name: LAURA
dialogue: How do we get there, though? We're so far away. You could bamf us through a tree? There's no trees.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Not today!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: She's depleted.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm totally depleted until we sleep.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Maybe I could put him in the--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: In the bag of colding?

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, not in the bag of colding.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think Percy would like that. I think that's very appropriate.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I could put him in the necklace and maybe stabilize him? I don't know.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You can't stabilize him.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You're going to make us deal with this for a fucking week?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: As the person who is sitting here, I think that we will see you next week. It is time.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I've grown a lot of emotional attachment to this.

name: MATT
dialogue: We can keep going for a bit--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, I need to process.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What?!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Pick this up later.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Ashley just texted. She doesn't work next Thursday.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: She doesn't work. She is desperately wanting to get in.

name: MATT
dialogue: Pike would be an individual to talk to about this.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well, that went sideways.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yeah. Let's stop this conversation for now. We'll have more of this conversation later. I will not have this conversation online, either, guys. Sorry.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Nothing left under a 3rd-level spell. I have nothing left.

name: SAM
dialogue: Next week, with new Vox Machina member Wil Wheaton. Thank you for your service, Taliesin.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Shut up, Sam!

name: SAM
dialogue: Wheaton will be joining us every week.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: He'll be getting a mohawk. Thank you. We'll have this talk later.

name: MATT
dialogue: The story will continue next week. Have hope. Have faith. We'll see what transpires.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What? We don't have faith at this table!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Some of us do.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's okay, honey.

name: MATT
dialogue: It's fun to be the DM.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Thank you, Matt.

name: MATT
dialogue: Good game, good fight. Hard fight. A very clever foe felled. We'll pick this up next week. Have a good night guys. Is it Thursday yet? [music]

name: MATT
dialogue: Hello, everyone, and welcome to tonight's episode of Critical Role, where a bunch of us nerdy-ass voice actors play Dungeons and Dragons and occasionally leave sobbing messes. Tonight's going to be a very interesting episode. Before we get into that, let's go ahead and coast through our announcements so we can get to the actual game at hand. First and foremost, we want to thank our sponsor for many weeks still going, Loot Crate!

name: ALL
dialogue: Loot Crate!

name: MATT
dialogue: Thank you so much. Sam, did you have something prepared?

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't really have anything prepared this week, guys. Instead, I thought I'd tell you a little story about something that happened to a friend of mine. Her name is Jessie. We grew up together in a small town. When she went away to college, she didn't want to go because she was a homebody. Her parents said, just go, have fun, you'll love it. She got to college. A couple of weeks into it, she and her roommate went out at night. She came home. She fell asleep. They were a little tipsy. She woke up in the middle of the night to this scratching sound and she couldn't figure out what it was. She just went back to sleep. Got up again, heard another scratching sound. What was it? She couldn't figure it out. She went back to sleep. The next morning, she woke up. Her roommate, the skin had been ripped off of her body, and the cat that they shared had also been turned essentially inside out. And on the wall in the blood of her roommate was written: Use code criticalrole for $3 off.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's a lot of blood.

name: SAM
dialogue: That's a lot of blood, and it's a lot of savings for the new Loot Crate, whose theme is horror. Channel your best Final Girl with items from The Walking Dead, Nightmare on Elm Street, Friday the 13th, Texas Chainsaw Massacre, Halloween, and the story I just told. Hey, should we open them up, guys?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah! Now, I think this is September's theme.

name: SAM
dialogue: This is definitely horror. Let's open them and see what horror items we have?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Whoa, look at this scary car!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Whoa! Look at this scary keychain of Batman!

name: MATT
dialogue: Scary Stark Industries.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Stark Motor Racing.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The scariest Stark Industries.

name: SAM
dialogue: Look, it's Dark Knight.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, it's Gone in Sixty Seconds.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Nicolas Cage was scary in Gone in Sixty Seconds, just throwing it out there.

name: MATT
dialogue: I forgot he was in that movie.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Ashley, do you want this?

name: SAM
dialogue: What's the pin? The pin says Loot Year. Oh, it's like Goodyear.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Is this really a hood ornament?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's pretty sick.

name: SAM
dialogue: But in all seriousness, Loot Crate is a big supporter of the show, so we want to support them. Go online, go to lootcrate.com/criticalrole. Sign up, get subscriptions for all of your friends and all of your dead friends who died tragically in a horror.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (laughter) In a horror.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I used to break those off of the front of people's cars when I was a kid because I was an asshole.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, you were. (laughs) Great! Thank you, Sam. Next up on the list, I will actually be down in San Diego tomorrow for the first day of TwitchCon. I have a panel in room FrankerZ. It's at 6:30 to 7:30pm about GMing roleplaying games on Twitch. It's going to be me, Adam Koebel, Chris Perkins, a bunch of great people that run a lot of great RPG programming on Twitch. We're going to be talking about our experiences running it, answering questions, all that fun stuff, so if you're already down there or you're in the San Diego area, come tomorrow and say hi at the panel at 6:30. It'll be awesome.

name: MATT
dialogue: Oh, totally. No, never. 6:30pm in FrankerZ, I think is the room, unless I'm reading the emails wrong. That's the only room information I was given. FrankerZ is the guy who's sending me the emails.

name: SAM
dialogue: (stage whispering) They're our fucking sponsors! Leave the box on the goddamn table!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I got it!

name: MATT
dialogue: Anyway, speaking of fun news, Laura, you wanted to mention something about some things up on the store?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes, this is exciting!

name: SAM
dialogue: Is it about your friend who went to college?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Her face was ripped off, but when her body was discovered, she was wearing one of these How Do You Want to Do This? hoodies. These sweatshirts that have been available before and then we took them away. But guess what, guys? They're back!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We made more!

name: LAURA
dialogue: For two weeks of preorder, you can get these comfy, cozy hoodies.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What is that voice you're doing? (laughter)

name: LAURA
dialogue: There's other things in the store too, like our beautiful mug that I don't have on the table today that Ashley used in Blindspot!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes. And Christmas is right around the corner, you guys!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, it's getting cold, so make sure you bundle up nice and warm.

name: MATT
dialogue: It is, no joke, the most comfortable hoodie I've ever owned.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You'll be wearing it all the time.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Soft as hell.

name: MATT
dialogue: I was a little worried when we started doing actual wearable merch, I was like, it's going to end up being that chintzy stuff that we don't want to hawk, but I'm actually really happy that it came out pretty high-quality.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I miss school relay races.

name: MATT
dialogue: What?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Sorry, go ahead. Nothing. Don't worry about it. Keep going.

name: MATT
dialogue: Anyway, anything else you want to talk about? Nope, then let's go ahead and get into tonight's episode of Critical Role! [dramatic music] Welcome back. Before we begin, real fast, I have been notified that Twitch is having some audio sync issues. Recommendation has been said to try and switch between the Flash player or the HTML5 player on Twitch. That seems to be fixing the issues for a lot of people out there. So if you're having issues with that, reloading or trying that switchover should fix the audio sync issues if you're having any. Without further ado, last we picked up, Vox Machina, who had been traveling to collect the Vestiges of Divergence, artifacts from an old ancient time to gain enough power to combat the Chroma Conclave, a group of chromatic dragons that assailed-- (burps) pardon-- Tal'Dorei, led by Thordak the Cinder King. When you get nervous, you get the burps. I feel like Robert Durst.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Robert Kraft, the owner of the Patriots.

name: MATT
dialogue: Different guy. You, in searching these artifacts, found that one in the city of Ank'Harel had been taken out from under your nose by a long-forgotten NPC named Ripley.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, she wasn't forgotten.

name: MATT
dialogue: You know what I mean. You gave chase down to the Glintshore Island of the Hespet Archipelago, and upon storming the beaches, destroying her ship, you walked into the jungle, where an ambush turned into folly. You charged into what appeared to be a couple of illusions. As the floor detonated beneath you, setting you across the ground and starting an encounter with snipers in position, at half-health and below for most of you. You gave a very good fight and still managed to push through. Unfortunately, Dr. Ripley, with the reveal that she has now bound herself to Orthax, the shadow demon that once plagued Percy's inspiration and nightmares, bent on vengeance, managed to take him, slay him, and leave him cold on the ground. As a group, you did manage to dissect Dr. Ripley very aggressively and get vengeance back for your friend. But where we left off, you'd just let the adrenaline and the shock of the moment hit you as Ripley's breath expends and a tiny tree begins to try and break and grow from her corpse on this parched land. So. What do you want to do?

name: SAM
dialogue: (chuckles) We have no idea.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh no.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Wait, did she originally take Percy's gun? Was that what she was using?

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't think so. She took his designs.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He threw Percy's gun into the pool of acid.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Should we collect her gun now?

name: SAM
dialogue: We're all extremely emotional, but we need to move quickly if we're going to do anything. We need to collect all the guns.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We should collect her guns. We need her other hand, and we need the Vestiges off of her fucking body.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well, let's collect those. Quickly.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Grog?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yes?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Will you do the honors of taking her other hand?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I would love to use my teeth for that. No, I'll use the axe.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. With a heavy thud sound, her hand is jettisoned from the wrist, her left hand, as it scatters across the broken glass floor of the center of the jungle here in Glintshore.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: This one, right?

name: SAM
dialogue: There's only one, so yes, that's the one.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Bag of Colding.

name: MATT
dialogue: Fair enough. Kynan is still standing there, the adrenaline wearing off of him. And he's at a good 15, 20-foot distance from all of you just standing.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I forgot, are we killing him?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Hold on a second. I walk over. Do you have the blade?

name: MATT
dialogue: (stammers) He looks down and he seems to have dropped it after everything that transpired. And he picks it up and holds it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I've come a long way for that.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Take it." He throws it to your feet and it spins and scatters and comes to a halt at the tip of your boot

name: LIAM
dialogue: Wait here a moment, please. I bend down, I take the knife, and I walk it over to Keyleth and put it in her hands. And I walk back to him. How?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I didn't mean for any of this to happen."

name: LIAM
dialogue: How? There are people behind me who want you dead, and I cannot blame them. How?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I wouldn't blame them, either. Look, after we met, I was hurt. I was angry. I knew I could be "someone, despite what you told me, and I could prove it, prove that I was worth your attention. "And I left Emon and my home to seek that destiny and I'm sure many of you did the same."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Do you know what shape Emon is in right now? And this is what you choose to do with your time?

name: MATT
dialogue: "You don't know what I've been through!"

name: LIAM
dialogue: What has that man done to you? What has she done to you? What have any of them, except for me, done to you? And what have I done except be an asshole?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Look, when she picked me up in Kymal, she taught me a lot. I learned a lot. She also told me "that you weren't who I thought you were. When everything went down in Emon, with the dragons. "She said you did that!"

name: LIAM
dialogue: Summoned the dragons?

name: MATT
dialogue: "You were responsible for it. She had me listen in to a conversation where you admitted "that it was your fault."

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'd like to make an insight check.

name: MATT
dialogue: Go for it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: (sighs) No.

name: MATT
dialogue: He seems emotionally on the brim of a complete nervous breakdown, but he's holding his ground. His hands are shaking in place as he stands staring at you with the look of a man on the precipice.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Kynan, what am I to do with you?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We'll deal with him later.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I ought to cut the heart from your ribs. I ought to cut out my own! Is there anyone else here, now? Is that it?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, we went back to the cavern to set up, but you got here too quickly--"

name: LIAM
dialogue: How long have you been here?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Only a few hours."

name: LIAM
dialogue: A few hours was all it took for that? Are there more of you?

name: MATT
dialogue: "We have a few people on the ship."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Not anymore.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Listen to me. I don't know what's going to happen in the next 24 hours for you, but the best thing you can do right now is help us. When anyone asks you to do something, you do it.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, I would ask for a chance to redeem myself, but I am also beginning to understand what "I've done. And I accept whatever judgment you see fit. Just know that-- just know that "I've been very confused."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Look at me. Kynan, look at me. You help right now. Put all that out of your mind. Right now, you help. Can you do that?

name: MATT
dialogue: (whispering) "How can I help?"

name: LIAM
dialogue: Just do whatever we ask.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Whatever you want me to tell you. I know a little bit. Anything, just let me know."

name: LIAM
dialogue: We're going to table this. Just be Johnny-on-the-spot right now, all right?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Okay."

name: LAURA
dialogue: (tearfully) Grog? Can you pick him up? Percy?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah. Where am I taking him?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I have nothing left. I have no way to get us out of here quickly right now.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Can I ask, is Orthax still here? That's who that was, right?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Orthax could have his soul, for all we know.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Do we sense him? Is Orthax around? Can you sense evil?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, I could, yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, so you sense as part of your paladin ability. Divine Sense, I believe it was?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah. 60 feet: demons, celestials, devils.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, as you guys are going through Ripley's things, you do sense there is a pulse of fiendish energy emanating from somewhere near Ripley's body.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Near Ripley's body?

name: LAURA
dialogue: How do we destroy him?

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't think we can. He's just a shadow, isn't he?

name: LIAM
dialogue: We have to go to him.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh, I was going to ask the question of could he help us with Percy.

name: SAM
dialogue: Orthax?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Honestly, right now I think-- it sounds crazy that I'm saying this, but we have mutual interests with him. It might not be the worst idea.

name: MATT
dialogue: Who's inspecting Ripley's body?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I will, I guess.

name: MATT
dialogue: A few things you find as you rummage through. You find about 1,051 gold pieces. Two weeks of rations, some of which appear to have been dampened and will probably be gone soon. You do find the cloak. The dagger that Kynan used still lays to the ground. No, it was handed to you, so you have it right now. There is what appears to be a small polished grey stone with a couple of runic symbols carved into it. You also find what appears to be a small leather case, a long thin case about that long, that is latched shut. And her gun. Which is similar to Percy's Pepperbox, but thinner, longer, more refined. It's a deep gunmetal gray color with brass sections and what appear to be portions of whitestone built into it. As she pulls the gun out, you immediately know that that's the direct source of the fiendish energy.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Put that down. Please. Put it on the ground.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's in the gun?

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's in the gun.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Just like last time.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So we drop it in acid again?

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, that didn't kill it, did it? Just got it out of the gun.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And what if he has Percy?

name: LAURA
dialogue: No!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well, let's try and get him back first before we get upset about it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: How do we get him to Whitestone?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah. How do we move?

name: SAM
dialogue: We have an airship.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That'll be too slow.

name: SAM
dialogue: Maybe it can take us somewhere with trees.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Somewhere with a tree.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I need to rest.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: How long?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I need to sleep.

name: LIAM
dialogue: This tree is stunted that's coming out of Ripley's body?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. It's a slow-growing tree. It's only about six feet tall. It wouldn't be large enough to use her spell through it. This is the remnants of a Fenthras death. There are a few large jungle trees, like I mentioned before, that have managed to find root and grow in this jungle. It'd be like one healthy tree for every 50 that are burnt, charred, and petrified. There are trees available in this jungle that in theory could be used for that spell, if you had it available to you.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I don't remember, do we have a way to call Pike?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We have the stone.

name: SAM
dialogue: Wait, does that send one of us back to her?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Potentially.

name: SAM
dialogue: One living soul holding a dead soul?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Or can we bring her to us?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I could try and scry her. Let me see, actually.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I could try putting Percy in the necklace and--

name: SAM
dialogue: Going through? Yes.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But what if you can't get him back out? Living and willing, right?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We don't want him to get stuck.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Is that correct?

name: SAM
dialogue: No disrespect, he's an object right now. So if one of used the stone, holding him, it'd be carrying him like a sword. He'd go through.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make an intelligence check. With plus two because of your Jack of All Trades. Add your intelligence modifier plus two.

name: MATT
dialogue: 18? That might not work for most spells. (laughter)

name: SAM
dialogue: Shame, intelligence check.

name: MATT
dialogue: He's still considered a creature. It's just a dead creature.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So we rest and then we go to Whitestone in the morning.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Can you do the mansion, Scanlan? Are you tapped out?

name: SAM
dialogue: I could, but--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I can't believe that there's nothing we can do right now.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We could stay here.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I still bring Trinket out of the necklace, and I cast Cure Wounds on him.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, yeah. As Trinket emerges from the necklace, his unconscious form hits the ground, laying on the side. As you walk up and place your hand, still breathing, and your warm touch presses across his fur and the breathing inflates into one deep breath and then (bear noises) the head leans up and begins licking your hand as you finish the casting of the spell. Go ahead and roll hit points for Trinket.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm also going to give him a butt scratch and do Lay on Hands and give him another five hit points.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Nine whole points. Plus five.

name: MATT
dialogue: You also do notice, Vex, on the gun, it has across the handle, the bottom of the handle, the name of the weapon, which is named Animus.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Animus?

name: MATT
dialogue: And across the barrels you now see there are three empty barrels and three that still have names.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can I read the names?

name: MATT
dialogue: The names are: Rictor Wells, Oz Grud, and King Bertrand Dwendal.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh my god.

name: MATT
dialogue: Rictor Wells, Oz Grud, and King Bertrand Dwendal. Apparently all people that Ripley in some way, shape, or form felt vengeful towards.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm going to walk over and pick up the false arm that I hacked off. Will you put this in the bag?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Which one? Oh, regular bag.

name: LIAM
dialogue: This big, old arm here.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Can I see the little stone with the runes on it?

name: SAM
dialogue: Why don't we ask Kynan what it is? Maybe he's seen her use it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Kynan, what is this?

name: MATT
dialogue: "That's what she used to listen in on you guys."

name: MARISHA

dialogue: (offscreen) Keyleth, I write to let you and your companions know that the repair of Westruun is proceeding well. I will not bore you with the details. Suffice to say that our children are well-fed and safe, our elderly and infirm are cared for and comfortable. Without the help of you and yours, this would not be the case. The folk in charge argue constantly, but that is to be expected, and it is no bad thing. They all want the same good things in different ways. I listen, mostly, and do what I can to make sure that they listen to each other. Without listening, nothing good can happen. The town-- when I say the repair is going well, it is a hard thing for me to talk about. I am not a particularly clever man, and much of this is new to me. When you make a mistake with metal, you can melt things down and start afresh. It is irritating, and it costs in time and soot and sweat, but it can be done. There is a comfort in iron, knowing that a fresh start is always possible. But a city is not a sword. It is a living thing, and living things defy simple fixing. Roots cannot be reforged. They scar, and broken branches must be cut and sealed with tar, and this makes me angry, as it always has, and my anger has no place to go. It was easier when I was young. I could use my anger like a hammer against the world. I was so sure of myself and my friends and my rightness. I would hammer at the world, and breaking felt like making to me, and I was good at it. And while I was not wrong, neither was I entirely right. Nothing is simple. I do not work in wood. I am not brave enough for that. There is a comfort in iron, a promise of safety, a second chance if mistakes are made. But a city is more a forest than a sword. No, it needs more tending than that. Perhaps a city is like a garden, then. So these days, it seems I have become a gardener. I dig foundations in the earth. I sow rows of houses. I plan and plant. I watch the skies for rain and ruin. I cannot help but think that you would be better at this, but circumstance has put both of us in our own odd place. You are forced to be a hammer in the world, and my ungentle hands are learning how to tend a plot of land. We must do what we can do. Did you know that there are some seeds that cannot sprout unless they are first burned? A friend once told me that. She was-- she was a bookish sort. I think of gardening constantly these days. I wear your gift, and I think of you, and I think it is interesting that there are some living things that need to pass through fire before they flourish. I ramble. You have the heart of a gardener, and because of this, you think of consequence, and your current path pains you. I am not wise, and I do not give advice, but I have come to know a few things: sometimes breaking is making, even iron can start again, and there are many things that move through fire and find themselves much better for it afterward. I have enclosed a gift. Once it was a sword, but it has changed. It is a small thing, and silly. Please forgive an old man for his foolishness. Still, I hope it brings you some small comfort. Kindly, Kerr.

"I left my pursuits of base interests and began to obsess over a cure for this before it took me. I "burned through servant after servant to find anything on such a disease. Everything failed. "Everything. "Thordak somehow noted and recognized my ailment. He said, 'You are unwell. A rare malady upon you. "'It will claim you, in time. However, I've traveled the world, I've gathered many secrets, and I know "'how to be rid of it. To burn it out of your system with a fire you will never find. I've done "'it before. I can burn away the worst of illnesses.' "Now, I am a creature that can pierce any lie by nature. I know in my heart that he spoke the truth "that day, that dragon. When asked what he wanted in return, he said, 'Your servitude.' We made an "agreement. He would return once he marked his domain. We discussed the terms. "However, he did not return. I grew furious and sought answers only to find that he was brought "low and sealed away by some assembled others, some fools from Emon. It took me years of seeking, but "I found his whereabouts. I was not going to let my chance to strike away this bloody curse slip from "me, so I met him on the fire plane. Over the years, I saw his swelling, his pained form. He "spoke of plans, ideas for vengeance and domination, but he would not relinquish the "secrets he promised me until I released him. "I proposed the Conclave. I assembled the others. I negotiated the agreements. I corrupted the "binding stone. I prepared the Pyrah gate. I did everything! "As time went on, Thordak's clarity muddled. It seemed his bindings, the power that he was "absorbing, was beginning to drive him mad, so we did not have any more time. I needed to initiate "the escape before he lost enough to forget our agreement, the means to even fulfill his side of "the bargain. No celestial solstice as planned, but Winter's Crest would have to do. And with Thordak "freed, the Conclave assembled, Tal'Dorei was razed, divided, and won. "But Thordak still withheld his words. He laughs at my requests. I see now that he does not mean to "tell me, and never really did, as his mind began to go. He enjoys his seat of power over all of "you, over me. I want him dead! I want to watch him be torn apart, I want to see his eyes go cold "and in that very moment, I want to call his spirit back and bind his word to tell me how I can save "myself. And then laugh at his misfortune as I tear what's left of him. "That is why I come to you. I have not the power to take him myself."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Thordak will experience all of those things. He will burn and he will suffer and you will not be there to watch it happen.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Keyleth?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You want to feel the burning inside of you? Oh, you will feel it, Raishan. But it will not be from Thordak or whatever proposed cure he made up. The burning you feel will be from the souls of ten thousand Fire Ashari as they sear your flesh, and the last thing that you will see will be my face as I watch you suffer, as you watched a quarter of my civilization burn!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Child, I commend your bravery in the face of certain doom, but think before you give in to "such base passions. There is much to be gained by us working together, and so much more to be lost."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, you commend me for bravery? Oh, Raishan, for someone who is supposed to be so smart-- I am not afraid! I know what you are. You are a parasite. You walk around calling yourself a magnificent ancient dragon. You are nothing more than a leech. You consumed the energy of my people for years! And we're supposed to just trust you?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Child, your anger is misplaced--"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (shouting) Call me child one more goddamn time!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I move behind Keyleth.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I did not slay a single one of your people. Thordak's release destroyed the top of that "mountain--"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (shouting) Which you did! You unleashed the mad dog, you bitch! This is your fucking fault! (quieter) He's just a mad king. As you said so yourself, you're the master planner! But your plan backfired, didn't it? So now you've come to us, and you think that you can formulate some other master plan that's still going to somehow get you what you want! You dumb fool. When will you fucking learn?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Keyleth."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Raishan.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Do not mistake my grace in this room for need of conflict, nor foolhardy wishes. If I "wanted each one of you dead, I would be chewing on your bones right now."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think, perhaps, if I may be so bold as to tidy up what Keyleth is trying to drive home here, is that for all intents and purposes from this side of the table, you strike me as a desperate creature who's pretending that he has a choice to be here and has brought-- she, excuse me. That is another conversation. You've brought very little to the table. We are not impressed with your notions that somehow we can work together. You need us, and this is all you bring?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I bring information--"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (scoffs)

name: MATT
dialogue: "I bring knowledge of Thordak--"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Where is Asum?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I know where Asum is--"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Where is Asum?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Let's start with that.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Let's stop pretending you have a choice here.

name: MATT
dialogue: "The one you call Seeker Asum is alive, in Emon, still working amongst the Clasp. The story I "gave you was mostly truth, peppered with necessary deceit to place me here amongst you for the time I "needed. He is there to secure survivors against Thordak. "I infiltrated the ranks of the Clasp, gained his trust, which allowed me to find your whereabouts, "and so I came. He sent me on a mission to notify you of his plans, which, by the way, along with "Brotoras, Goldhand, and the Clasp's cooperation, they have a plan to strike at the Cinder King."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Insight check. Well, hold on. No. 13. Never mind.

name: MATT
dialogue: Slippery dragon. (laughter) There's no reason for you to believe or disbelieve. It's just words to you right now.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What's their plan?

name: MATT
dialogue: "One that'll fail, of course. You see, they put their knowledge in what a red dragon is "capable of. They believe that by quelling the flames or stoking some nature of the crystal in "its belly's magic, there would be a way to stop him. And there is a path to be taken there, yes, "but their knowledge is faulty. They don't understand the nature of the enchantment, and "should they attack, they will burn in the flames of their own righteousness."

name: LAURA
dialogue: What's your illness?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I wish I knew the extent of it--" And you watch as Asum's form grows a little more green in places, the scales unfolding, and as the image, though still in the halfling form, where the scales rest you can see a series of deep, purplish-black veins that ride up the side of the throat, and across the chest and the arms, and they pulse with each heartbeat. "It withers my "constitution. It makes me weary. I've sat with this for nearly a hundred years. My brain is not "dull, but I wish not to have this brilliant intellect waste away into ash because I couldn't "find an answer."

name: LAURA
dialogue: So you come before us and you tell us you're weak?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, weak by my standards."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You're weak by mine, too.

name: LIAM
dialogue: If we were to work with you, and that is a massive fucking if, if we were to work with you and Thordak were to fall-- Paint us a picture, what can we look forward to after that? What happens to you, where do you go, what happens to Tal'Dorei?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I have no interest in this mass domination. Most of these petty creatures that you call your "brethren, they live amongst their cities, and that's fine. My happiness lies in returning to my "home in the Rifenmist, where I can pillage the eastern and southern coasts. Or I can ride out "amongst the Viridian Ocean and steal what is necessary to survive and enjoy my network of "followers and spies. Far away from where you live."

name: LIAM
dialogue: You might as well be feeding us nursery rhymes.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Sounds like a life happily ever after.

name: MATT
dialogue: "If you're uncomfortable with my proximity, post the fall of the king, I will happily take my "presence elsewhere. Gather my people, my belongings, and find a roost, somewhere across the "Ozmit perhaps."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm comfortable with that being a conversation that happens later.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, obviously, but I don't believe anything she says.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You're sure that Thordak has a cure for you?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I have spent many years trying to untangle what could be the lie behind those eyes, and I am "certain. There is a confidence with knowing and withholding. It is stronger than the strongest of "bluffs, and I've seen that confidence in the Cinder King. A cruelty in that knowledge, that "smugness."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Is he still insane?

name: MATT
dialogue: "By most standards, has been for some time, but it continues to slip. His narcissism grows to "dangerous bounds."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What about the white dragon?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Before we would consider any terms, we would need the white dragon removed from the playing field.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Could be a good way for you to show us your loyalty, even though you have none. But know, Raishan, whatever deal we strike does not end in you leaving my sight. You're going to die. You're going to die, even if I have to die doing it.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Amusing."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Really, this is a conversation about whether or not we wait to try and kill you until before or after the Cinder King. That's fair, I think.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You think that because you took surprise upon Umbrasyl, the brute, his inferior intellect, "that you will have the opportunity to strike me down? You have no idea what I'm capable of, no "matter what malady festers within me."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, we know.

name: MATT
dialogue: "This is your home, right, Percival?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It is.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It would be a shame for it to suddenly no longer exist."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can we please just fucking kill her now?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm not Keyleth. Your threats, they won't bend me, because I believe you. I believe that you would rend this entire city asunder. That's why I'm at the table. I am conscious of where we are, I'm conscious of who you are, and I'm conscious of what you need. I'm just trying to make sure that everybody's clear that the minute that red dragon dies, all bets are off. You know it as well as I do. And you should be wary, because only one side of this table is underestimating the other.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Which side is it?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Thank you, Grog.

name: SAM
dialogue: Can I do a perception check to make sure that this being is actually in the room and is not just some sort of phantom?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We've seen this before.

name: SAM
dialogue: 17. Oh wait, am I proficient? No, 19.

name: MATT
dialogue: 19, okay. The entity you see before you does appear to be physically present, to the best of your knowledge. No one's touched it or attempted to, but it does seem to be present with you.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: All right, I love a good story, so do you have a plan?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: One step at a time. White dragon.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Vorugal is a beast. Simple of mind. Eager to kill, eat, sleep. That's about the extent. As "long as it's given enough land and cattle to devour, it seems happy. It enjoys the hunt; it "enjoys the challenge."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: How willing do you feel to be a participant in his demise?

name: LIAM
dialogue: A lot better if you'd be willing to shed a bit of blood.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Get your hands dirty.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, she's already done that.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Our agreement, should this go forward, does not end when the Cinder King dies. I demand the "opportunity to converse with the spirit from the corpse. "Once that's done, then you may pull your rug out from under me, if you will. I wish you the best of luck."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, I assume once he's dead, either you'll turn on us or you'll run away. Either way works for me.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, we're getting a bit ahead of ourselves. Are you going to scrap with the white dragon with us or not?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can you talk him into flying off, leaving everyone alone?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, I want a dead dragon.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You see, whereas I have the aptitude to know where my alliances stand, Vorugal is, of the "entire Conclave, the closest Thordak has to a lap dog."

name: LAURA
dialogue: So dead, then.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Probably the best bet, yes."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes, Grog?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I have a question. Do you want to talk to Thordak's dead spirit, or are you after the big shiny jewel in the middle of his chest?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I have no interest in whatever enchantment shackles him to his insanity. I merely wish to "draw from him the secret I've been promised."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Insight check to see if he's lying.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Ditto!

name: MATT
dialogue: Insight check, both of you guys, go.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, that was terrible!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Ugh, 13.

name: MATT
dialogue: Seems to be telling the truth.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, sure.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, yeah, sure she does.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: He's telling the truth.

name: LAURA
dialogue: She.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: She's telling the truth.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Once the white dragon's off the board, then we will hammer out whatever promises can be made, but until then, there's just many players on the field to say one way or another.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Have you been here as Asum this whole time? What have you been doing?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Gathering information, like I do."

name: LAURA
dialogue: What do you do, sleep in his room like a halfling?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, do you wear his clothes, and use his soap, and brush with his toothbrush?

name: MATT
dialogue: "No, I moved down to the stables and found a soft bit of hay. Yes, I sleep in his bed and his clothes."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's a lot of attitude to what I feel is a simple question. It's gross.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's pretty gross.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It must be so humiliating for you that you need to turn to us for help. You do have my pity in that regard.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It isn't the most optimal circumstance, but I think we both have much to gain."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Why do you think Thordak is the only one with knowledge of a cure?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Because everywhere I've sought the information seems to have been destroyed by "Thordak once we made the accord."

name: LAURA
dialogue: If you tell us what the disease is--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Because that puny little druid that cursed you-- well, don't forget you're dealing with a puny little druid right here.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You could take a look if you like, but I myself do not know its nature."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Have you tried Greater Restoration? (laughter)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That seems to be the solution to all of our problems.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's the chicken soup of Dungeons and Dragons.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Chicken soup for the DND soul.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's feed a curse, starve perma-death.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Please, go ahead.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes, I have."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What was the question?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I've tried all forms of cleansing magic. I've bent many diviners to my aid, and all have "failed! This isn't a simple magic, this was a spirit curse, this was something far more "powerful."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Sounds like a job for me. (spits) Come on.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You don't have to.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't want to."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Spit smells funny, you know.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Is it two days until the white dragon?

name: LAURA
dialogue: How long do we have?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Wait, will Thordak know if we do something to Vorugal?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Of course.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's likely. Very quickly, yes."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Why?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Keeps a close watch on his subjects. He's paranoid. Requires us to continuously "check in, which I have been."

name: LAURA
dialogue: You've been checking in from where? Here?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I have my means in my room, yes."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Does he know where you are?

name: MATT
dialogue: "No. As far as he knows, I'm currently somewhere on the outskirts of Westruun attempting "to forge some sort of vengeance for what happened to Umbrasyl."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: If he did find out he was here, it would be very easy to turn the two of them against each other.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So when Vorugal flew over... did he not sense you?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm very good at avoiding the sight of those who would seek me if I wish not to be seen."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Was he seeking you, or was he seeking Whitestone?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Based on the correspondence that was put out by Thordak, he was very perturbed at the death "of the black dragon that you've slain. As such, sent a rather large assortment of his and "Vorugal's wyvern army to sweep the entire middle eastern side of Tal'Dorei in search of you, I "presume. "Thankfully, your allies put up some sort of illusory barrier, which I did not disturb during "that time, to whatever consolation that is to our agreement."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It is of great consolation. In fact, I would go so far as to say that I am willing to say that these talks will continue post the destruction of the white dragon, so long as these talks take place in Whitestone.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We won't have much time to talk after the destruction of the white dragon.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We'll have enough. And if there is no Whitestone to hold talks in, there will be no talks.

name: MATT
dialogue: "This is true."

name: SAM
dialogue: One moment. Game this out for me, friends. If this is all bullshit and Thordak has sent this little lady here to trick us into traveling with her to Draconia, where Thordak is lying in wait to kill us the second we get there, well, then if we're making a deal for this little lady to kill on our behalf, why do we need to go? Can we just stay in Whitestone and you go kill the white dragon for us? You're powerful, aren't you? Why do you need us?

name: MATT
dialogue: "You see, if I were to utilize my full potential, which would be required to fell "Vorugal-- as idiotic as the creature is, it's still a very dangerous and cunning foe."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Not for you. You're so clever.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, you can pretend to be Vorugal's-- something, pet hamster-- for a while until you kill him in his sleep.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Maybe I overestimated your intelligence, but in doing so, would immediately paint a target "on my back for Thordak. I think it's best that I remain in his good graces, as we all flank up "unexpectedly when the time is right."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: He is correct.

name: MATT
dialogue: "She!"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm really enjoying that.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I would also say that if she wanted to set a trap with three dragons on us, they would all be here right now.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Also, they could've avoided it entirely and waited for us to go to Draconia, as opposed to having someone come by to remind us that we were going to Draconia in the first place. It seems like an awful lot of work.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I still don't really know why we need her to begin with. We're powerful enough. Why don't we just kill her now?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Honestly? Because it would damage the castle.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, don't provoke--

name: SAM
dialogue: What is that move? Don't do that.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Are you inviting?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm saying the choice is yours. Either we work together, or you all fall."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Come on. Even my simple mind sees the advantages here.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Keyleth. All we're debating is the order in which they die.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: She was first on my list.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't recommend lists. The only reason I'm stopping you from doing this-- and I swear this is the truth-- is because this is my home.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But this could be our best chance.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There would be nothing left.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Could be the easiest--

name: MATT
dialogue: "Half-elf. Look at me. Your worldview is clouded by optimism that does not belong in "Exandria. There is good, there is evil, but this world has been remade many times because life is "destruction. You should know this as a purveyor of life in its own right. The cycle lives on. The "chaos perseveres. Everything grows, eats, then dies or is eaten. You can put whatever fine "dressing on it you like."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, shut the fuck up, sick bag.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: She's not making this easy to walk away, you guys!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Percy is right. We don't want the people of Whitestone to fall like the people of the Ashari.

name: LAURA
dialogue: More deaths do not make it right, Keyleth.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You're going to get yours. You're going to get it.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Are you telling me you have not claimed a life or two in your time? Do you think your goals "and your attempts to save those close to you have not been wrought with bloodshed?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, I know the consequences of every step of my actions. It is you, Raishan, who did not realize the biggest consequence is standing in front of you right now.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Do you think you have not stepped on an anthill to get to your destination?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I don't give a flying shit.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I merely stepped on an anthill to get to mine."

name: LIAM
dialogue: You're just fucking winding her up, man.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Understand, there are different levels of thought, intellect, and intent here. I come to you "because we have much to gain together. Or lose everything by not listening to what I have to say."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You will join us in the fight against the white dragon.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I will, if you promise to let Thordak's soul be mine."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Nope, that's not the deal.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We're talking about a second round of negotiations.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We will consider your offer once the white dragon is dead, not a minute before.

name: MATT
dialogue: "This isn't a negotiation."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: This is everything of a negotiation, you fool.

name: MATT
dialogue: "What am I getting out of this?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Your life!

name: SAM
dialogue: An opportunity to prove yourself to us.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: A cure to yourself.

name: LAURA
dialogue: A chance to take down Thordak. You said yourself you can't do it on your own.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We haven't danced with a dragon that now stands breathing.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Your desperation is so obvious.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We walk away, and you die. Or we stay, (whispering) and you die.

name: MATT
dialogue: "If I aid you with the tearing of Vorugal as a show of goodwill, in response, you keep my true "nature secret between those in this room."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh. Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You maintain that I have access to the length and breadth of Whitestone."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Wait a minute. Why the length and bread of Whitestone?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Largely because I have interests in deciding my plan against Thordak. Let's just say "some of it may include a trinket or two that have come in your way on your travels."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are you fully aware of what lies beneath Whitestone?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I have some ideas."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Would you like to see it?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I have seen it already."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Have you?

name: LAURA
dialogue: You've been down there?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I've been here for some time, my dear."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Then why didn't we meet down there? Why are you so scared of it?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, if you've seen it, tell us what it is.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I know. You know.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Of course he--

name: SAM
dialogue: You say it first.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm not telling you anything. That was not part of the negotiation."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: How big is it? If you've seen it. (laughter)

name: SAM
dialogue: Describe it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: One dead white dragon and then--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh jeez, what is that?

name: MATT
dialogue: Raishan snaps her fingers. You see a spark, and you notice a brief burst akin to a minor illusion. No sound, nothing, just the image of a tiny black orb.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Shit! She's seen it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: One dead white dragon, and then the negotiations continue. We will speak to no one of what you truly are, although we may caution others that we're looking a bit sideways at Seeker Asum.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I would recommend none of that. Any suspicion means I'm being followed. If I'm "followed and feeling threatened, the person you told may not survive. We do not want that, but I'm "going to look out for myself, so anyone you tell, you're putting in danger."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's also fair.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Anyone you touch, you're then putting yourself in danger. If any of our friends wind up dead, we're looking at you first.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Fair enough."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Have you done anything with the rest of our friends?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Where's Asum? Did we already cover that?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, we already covered that.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I was very angry. I couldn't hear a whole lot.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Whitestone will not fall. If Whitestone falls, all deals are off. If Whitestone is attacked, all deals are off. You keep it off the radar.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's already off the radar. I just will not touch the radar."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That'll do.

name: LIAM
dialogue: What is radar?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't know."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Do you never go into my room? Do you never look at what I'm working on?

name: SAM

name: TRAVIS

dialogue: I don't know.

dialogue: All right.

name: TRAVIS

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Grand Poobah de Doink of All of This and That.

dialogue: Grand Poobah de Doink of All of This and That.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Of All of This and That. It comes with no money and no land, but it is a title.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm unfamiliar with protocol. A Grand Poobah, how do you address them? Is it a "your Majesty," a "your Highness," "your Grace?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No it's "Hey you, over there." "Hey, you guy."

name: SAM
dialogue: Hey, you guy.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yes, my humble servants.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: "Sweet chestnut."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are those all official names?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, yes. They're used in very different ways.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well look, let's keep it on the low-low, right, I don't want too many people getting jealous, so like only in private quarters will you address me by my official title.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Okay, or the shortened versions thereof.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, which I look forward to learning.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You will enjoy them. I'm sure we will all enjoy them.

name: SAM
dialogue: This is a great day, Grog.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It is, right? Man, I just keep coming up in the world. Coming up, against all the odds. I feel like an Eminem song in the background right now. Eight Mile, bitches. Let's go inside.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Didn't even bother to insight check, did you? That's great. That makes me so happy.

name: SAM
dialogue: Percy, don't forget, you promised me one of those guns.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'd actually have to teach you how to use it, you are aware of that?

name: SAM
dialogue: Maybe you can teach me first, and when I've learned, you can give me one.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Maybe we'll have that conversation. I'm going to take a look at their various levels of repair. I want to take a look at how they look, how many of them need work, how many of them are at least functional.

name: MATT
dialogue: Most of them need work. A number of them backfired during the actual battle, and the other ones were not taken very good care of, so you're probably going to need to run a few repair checks on that. You have the materials at your disposal, you have your workshop.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm going to do this not in private, but I'm going to be, then I want to look at Ripley's gun.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. You take a good solid look at Animus, get a feel for it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I've got it!

name: MATT
dialogue: Thank you, Travis.

name: SAM
dialogue: (belches)

dialogue: Wow.

dialogue: Oh my god, really?

dialogue: Oh, me?

dialogue: Yeah, you.

dialogue: Hey, so remember when you showed me your boobies during the fight with Kern?

dialogue: Oh, you saw them?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Only out of the peripheral.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay, yes?

dialogue: I wanted to say thank you on a very delayed timeline by giving you this potion of superior healing. (laughter)

name: LAURA
dialogue: Thank you so much, Grog.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, so if they ever get jacked up again, heal them, because I fight better with boobies around.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'll remember that.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Okay, cool.

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Deal.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Thank you so much.

dialogue: This is mean.

name: LIAM
dialogue: That was spectacular.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I missed everything. I'll watch it on the preview because this is a--

dialogue: Isn't it breast cancer awareness month? It is, right?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Now I'm aware.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Check your boobs, ladies.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's important.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Don't let them get jacked up.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Okay, I'm going to do my best to clean and work on these guns tonight, and at some point, I'm going to send a guard to find Vax.

dialogue: Vex, you've gone and looked for Vax and Keyleth. After you guys had your conversation about everything, eventually you catch up to-- are you guys still together? Yeah, so you find the two of them.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Hey, did you find anything?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Sort of. I wanted to talk to you and probably Percival, as well.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, I communed with my deity--

name: LAURA, MARISHA
dialogue: The Raven Queen.

name: LIAM
dialogue: That's the one! And she said something that I don't know what she meant.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I asked about this Yenk, and she said everything we needed to know we saw on the way to the sphinx.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Which one?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's what I said!

name: LIAM
dialogue: She didn't say.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm drawing a blank, I don't know.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Everything we need, we saw on the way to the sphinx.

name: LIAM
dialogue: So I remember the more recent trip better. What happened the first time?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, it's here--

name: LIAM
dialogue: It was under the Slayer's Take.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes, under the Slayer's Take.

name: LAURA
dialogue: But there was a ziggurat, as well.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes. Then the second time--

name: LAURA
dialogue: We went down a cavern, and there was a name.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Right. Had to do the whole name trial.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Grog almost drowned.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So the first one was near where the Cindergrove is.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Right, and she worshipped the goddess of knowledge.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Osysa was her name.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We just spoke to her.

name: LAURA, MARISHA
dialogue: Ioun!

dialogue: So maybe we need to talk to Ioun, no? Maybe we just talk to a god. That's impossible unless you're--

name: LIAM

name: LAURA
dialogue: Worthless, really. Yeah. That's a nice cloak you have there, Keyleth.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's a little baggy, but thank you.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I gave you a cloak once, and you stopped using it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: This is true. It looks lovely, though, stacked next to the rest of my clothing. Do you want it back?

name: LIAM
dialogue: No, I do not want it back.

name: LAURA
dialogue: He only gives cloaks to those he really cares about, Keyleth. Really cares about.

name: LIAM
dialogue: This is really awkward, and I'm going to walk the fuck out of here. Good night, ladies.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I got a wink from Vex!

name: LIAM
dialogue: I go off looking for Percy.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Good man.

name: MATT

name: LIAM
dialogue: Hello?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, good. It's you.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Do you mind?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Not at all. I was actually hoping you would stop in.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Gods! What does all this shit do?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Mostly break, quite successfully.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Just like us. I just broke in the temple that you--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I assume it was vague and unhelpful?

name: LIAM
dialogue: It was.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Excellent!

name: LIAM
dialogue: First, I don't think I ever officially thanked you for it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You're welcome.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Thank you. How are you feeling, buddy?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (sighs) I'm terrified, but other than that, I think I'm good.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I came here for a reason, you're the brain, you're the one that hangs brain. I don't know what to make of my conversation with the higher power. I asked about Yenk. I don't know if it was the gynosphinx or the not-gynosphinx?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I would assume it was the sphinx that was guarding her treasure. Oh! You should take a look at this. And I point at the open book with the picture. Look what we have. That is our friend.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, is that Yenk?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, it's one of Yenk's brethren.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Did you follow me down here? I said I didn't fucking want to--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, obviously Keyleth's there, so I figured I was, too!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I thought you were working in the middle of--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: My door's open. I'm in my thing, but it's open, and I've already sent people to send for--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I said "Hi, Percy." It's not my fault no one notices I'm around. It's not my fault I'm a fucking wallflower.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You scared the shit out of me. This is some nasty business. This is what we're dealing with?

dialogue: Yes, and if all goes well, which it never does, that will be fighting the white dragon, and possibly the green dragon. And one of the two of them will kill the other, and then we swoop in and clean up what's left.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I don't know if it's smart, but I'm really curious.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I know. I understand; I feel the same way. It's probably not going to work. It's probably going to go terribly.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I think it might.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think it might work. I'm feeling good about that.

dialogue: Do we even know how to use the Gate scroll exactly? Scanlan has to use it, right?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, the little guy can pull it off.

dialogue: It's going to have to be either Scanlan or me but--

name: SAM
dialogue: Hey, guys!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Scanlan! Hey!

name: SAM

dialogue: Hey, Grog! Come on in.

dialogue: Have you ever been here? Look at all this fucking esoteric bullshit!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Wow.

dialogue: No-- yes, that is something in a jar. It's not a brain, though.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What's that a picture of?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, that's the goristro.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh. What are the other ones?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, one is called a snake lady. A marilith.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are they all together, or is it the one guy?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I think it's just the one guy. Hopefully, other things can't come through. Can they? Read that scroll again, Scanlan.

name: SAM
dialogue: What, my Gate scroll? Yeah, well, I left that at home today, but I think it calls the thing that you call for. You give it a name, it goes, it grabs it, it brings it in.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It doesn't bring other things through? Doesn't leave the gate open?

name: SAM
dialogue: The gate does stay open for as long as your conjuration, which is about a minute.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So other things could come through.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, that is true--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But you could close the gate once it passes through.

name: SAM

name: LIAM
dialogue: You're selling yourself short.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm really good, but I'm not quite that good, so I can cast it, but it carries a risk. If luck is not on my side, it will not work.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Like, it burns when you pee risk, or it's going to fall off in three months risk?

name: SAM
dialogue: Like it won't work forever. I get one shot. If I don't do it right, it's gone forever.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are we talking about your penis, still?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes. My penis will fall off.

dialogue: That is terrible.

dialogue: We will have Raishan with us.

dialogue: Allura or Gilmore.

name: SAM
dialogue: Is she an arcane caster?

dialogue: Raishan has had everyone fooled for a long time.

dialogue: Do we know where Kima and Allura are?

dialogue: You haven't checked in to see if they're here or not.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, they could be at the castle?

dialogue: Should I call for a guard?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Call for a guard.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (loudly) Guard!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There's one literally down the hall.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh. (stage whisper) Guard!

name: MATT

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, no, please don't use my official title. If you would, could you go see if Lady Kima and Lady Allura are around?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Do you wish for me to fetch them?"

dialogue: Yes. Go forth, quickly, with haste.

dialogue: What time is it?

dialogue: It's mid-afternoon. You guys have spent the day doing research and checking things out. You woke up in the morning and you had your conversation with Raishan, so it's two, three in the afternoon.

dialogue: I have another question. How far are we, timeline in the year? How close are we getting to Winter's Crest?

name: MATT
dialogue: You are close to three months past it, so you have a ways to go before it's Winter's Crest again.

dialogue: When's the next solstice?

name: MATT
dialogue: The celestial solstice? You're not sure, actually. Make a nature check.

dialogue: There's not a summer solstice and winter solstice?

name: MATT
dialogue: There are solstices, yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: 24. The next solstice is going to be in about a month. Roughly 28 days.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Whatever relevance that has.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: So none at all.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, I see what you're getting at.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Thordak was busted out on the winter's solstice, right? Also, the Briarwoods were rushing to try and get the ziggurat up and running in time for the solstice.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Right. Important day, is that?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Very important day, where nature and stars tend to align and planes can blur a little bit.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Can I ask a quick question? I really like this plan to use the gate thing and go attack Vorugal. I don't even feel like we need Raishan for it. Shouldn't we lure her away to somewhere and then fucking kill her?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: This is luring her away somewhere.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: The sooner she dies, the happier I'll be.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We get her over there, and then we kill her afterward.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: But we'll be weak and she's on the fringe, because remember, she's barely helping out?

name: SAM
dialogue: What is she going to be doing to help us, anyway?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We haven't decided.

name: LAURA
dialogue: She was going to be another magic user, dressed as a human, or something.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I like tricks, but Ripley got us pretty good, and I don't feel like walking right into another trap one week before another fight.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I think better to get Raishan away from here, and in that fray, she might not be touched, but she might be whittled down a little bit. That's better than nothing.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: She'll spend some power.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We have to get her away from Whitestone. We have to.

dialogue: I guess we couldn't get her anywhere with a low ceiling, where her dragon form doesn't have such an advantage?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think the ceiling would give.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, I mean a cave or something.

name: SAM
dialogue: We could do that.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: How?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Vorugal lived in a cave.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, but a little cave. A cave that Asum would fit in.

name: MATT
dialogue: That wasn't a cave, it was inside a chasm. A giant ravine.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think far away on another continent is a great idea.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What about the little cave in Glintshore?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm happy just to take her. She's going to follow us already.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, here's my question. I'm sure she's anticipating us turning on her. What would you do if you were a green dragon anticipating people turning on you?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It depends. If I needed them, I would put myself in a position of safety, make myself useful, and then make sure I was back somewhere where they would not attack me as quickly as possible. If I didn't need them, I would turn on them immediately after the fight.

name: LIAM
dialogue: She's going to put out the barest amount of effort to help us from behind.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: If we die, her plan foils. If we do not feel she put in enough effort, her plan also foils.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I picture Thordak going, "Raishan, use your treachery and intellect and go kill Vox Machina."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: My feeling is use your treachery-- Where are we? We're in my shop right now? Okay.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Keep that in mind. We could be getting spied on. Are we being watched?

name: MATT
dialogue: You have no sense of being watched by any exterior force.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Also, we know we're walking into this shit. That's no surprise.

name: SAM
dialogue: And our plan doesn't necessarily have to be kill Vorugal, turn and kill Raishan right there. We can keep playing with her for a little while longer.

name: LAURA
dialogue: She can sense lies.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: All right, so we buck up. We go through with it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We go through with it. We made an agreement. I say we honor it until such point as it is deeply inconvenient.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'm down.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can I go find Zahra?

dialogue: You can, yes.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Vax, your boy.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Arguably so, yeah.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Your boy. I'm thinking of creating a company of shot for the castle with these guns. Do you think that would be a position that would suit him? Guards that would be forbidden from carrying these weapons outside the walls of the castle itself, and would arm the parapets if there was an attack from a dragon.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I do. I don't know how good a judge of character I am, though.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Hopefully, a better judge than I am.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You know, I have face-planted more than any of you, maybe. I have with that boy. I can see it in his eyes. We're up to our elbows in blood. There has to be room for a little bit of redemption in this world.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm a big believer in second chances. At least, I am now.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's a good idea.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I wanted to check with you. I thought this was something that I assumed you would have some insight into.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Do we have time to teach them how these things work?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: He may already know a bit. He spent some time around them, which is also why I thought it might be helpful.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Do you want to talk to him?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, I figured we would talk to him. I'm still not 100%. We are going to be fighting these dragons, and I am not at my best.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, you probably need to get to bed, but why don't we go find him before it grows too late?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'll continue to work on these. Bring him down when you find him.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I will. Thank you. I head out.

dialogue: Tinkering check?

dialogue: Yes.

dialogue: Stop that. Where did all my dice go? Okay, apparently I have three. Dex, proficiency, if I recall? Okay. That's a 29, a 27, and a 13.

dialogue: Okay. Rudimentary in their design, but functional. You manage to clean them all and repair the ones that were heavily damaged earlier and make them functional again without an issue. During that time, Keyleth, you were going to mention something, you said?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: And Zahra.

dialogue: Ioun is the god of knowledge and spreading of knowledge and was what the temple that Osysa watches beneath the Slayers' Take is based around. It's also what the ziggurat beneath the city used to be: a temple to Ioun, before it was corrupted by the Briarwoods.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Scanlan, do you still have those Ioun stones?

name: SAM
dialogue: I have an Ioun stone.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay. Was Raven's Slumber the name of the temple?

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's my necklace.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's your necklace that's got Trinket in it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: When we're not in the city. He's out of the necklace. Yes, he's always around.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What if we go back to that temple?

name: SAM
dialogue: And do what?

name: MATT
dialogue: Vax is gone right now.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm also gone.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: She's been helping me clean.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Never mind, keep going. I'm just trying to figure this out.

dialogue: All right. Vex, you go ahead and find Zahra, who's in the process of still researching in her room, her and Allura, while she was focusing on the ziggurat and the essence of it. So you find her and her tomes are spread out, and she's actually fallen asleep on her desk in her room.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Knock-knock? Zahra?

name: MATT
dialogue: Puts her wand out in your direction. "Darling, I'm so sorry! I didn't mean that."

name: LAURA
dialogue: How are you? How are things?

name: MATT
