name: LAURA
dialogue: I never noticed the drool, don't worry.

name: MATT
dialogue: (chuckles) "Good, just trying to figure out what we can from these siphons."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Anything interesting?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Not yet, though it's been a lot of fun throwing things into them and watching them go away."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Speaking of, you've been very busy, I know, with all of your research, but do you remember what we spoke of before we left?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Remind me."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Arrows of dragon-slaying?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh, yes! I was able to muster one."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay, that's wonderful! One is better than none.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That is all I've been able to get done in time." She pulls out a small case and opens it. It looks a little roughshod, not quite as perfect, but she says, "The enchantment took."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Wonderful! This is costly, what do I owe you?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh, for this?" Let's find out.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I hope this isn't a lot.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: 5,000 gold.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That would come to roughly-- on the market, about 30,000 gold pieces."

name: LAURA
dialogue: But she made it, so that's not how much it would be, right? Zahra said it wasn't that much before.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's mostly done? I could keep working on it, if you like, and make it all done."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh. Okay. But that's 30,000 gold pieces?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, for cost and time. I'd put it more about 12, for a friend."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Jesus. Man.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Better make it work, then. Better wait.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'll wait. You keep making this awesome.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Okay. Sorry dear, I haven't had a lot of time."

name: LAURA
dialogue: (dryly) No. I know you're so busy.

name: LIAM
dialogue: The romance is over. (laughter)

name: LAURA
dialogue: Mark it back down to one in my-- Zahra, you're amazing.

name: LIAM
dialogue: (dryly) No, it's great. It's super cool.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We're going into battle pretty soon. These fuckers are pretty dangerous, so I'm concerned.

name: MATT
dialogue: "So should I balk on the research and focus on--"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Keep doing what you're doing. If you find the time--

name: MATT
dialogue: "Noted."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Thank you, Zahra.

name: MATT
dialogue: "No worries, dear. I should make some tea." She rubs her eye a little bit, gets up. "Have a "good night, Vex." Walks by. As she exits the room as you stand there, her tail whips you in the back.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I deserved that!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Mary is going to see this!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Mary said it was only five, okay.

dialogue: Mary says a lot of things.

dialogue: As she walks up, it's midday. She's not armored at all. She's wearing a standard linen shirt that's sweat through. It looks like she's been doing physical labor work and she comes up with dirt smeared in her face. "Grog, it's been a while!"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It has! Yeah, you little badass.

name: MATT
dialogue: (chuckles) "You big badass. What can I do for you?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh. Yeah. The thinkers are inside the room.

name: SAM
dialogue: Hey. Where's Allura?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Do you need me to get her, as well?"

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, the guard was supposed to get you both.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Ugh. I'll be right back." She leaves for a bit. You wait a little bit longer. Eventually, she comes back with Allura. Allura not quite as dirty as Kima. They both arrive. "Hello, "I'm glad to see you've returned. Can I help you?"

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, I don't normally need to ask for help with magic, but this Gate scroll that I have here, is this something that you can do?

name: MATT
dialogue: "This is beyond my magic."

name: SAM
dialogue: Forget I ever showed it to you. Doesn't exist.

name: MATT
dialogue: "No, this is incredible. This is very powerful magic."

name: SAM
dialogue: I know it's really cool, but you shouldn't know about it. It's bad news.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I think it has quite a bit of utility, to be honest. Do you need this, or could I--"

name: SAM
dialogue: No, I do need it, desperately, yes. It's very vital to our mission.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, all right."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Whoa, wait. Do you have a use for it in mind, in particular?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, this is the kind of spell that I could copy into my spellbook, and once I'm able to "utilize it down the road it would be at my disposal."

name: SAM
dialogue: Would that make this scroll inactive?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It would destroy the scroll, but I would be able to utilize the spell in a few years, maybe."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: How long does it take to copy down the scroll? A couple seconds?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It takes a few hours, maybe."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What is this voice I'm hearing?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I just wandered back. I'm done talking to Zahra. Hey. The door's open.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Be careful with that. From what I can glean from the enchantment, it offers you quite a chance "to pull pretty much anything to your side, but no real bindings on what you pull through."

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes. I think I understand how it works, but I don't know if I'll be able to do it when the time comes.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No bindings on what comes through? You might get more than you bargained for?

name: MATT
dialogue: "There are many a mage who ended up trying to bend something to their will and weren't seen "ever again."

name: SAM
dialogue: I think what she's referring to is once we pull the thing through, it acts of its own volition. We can't tell it what to do.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We stay clear.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Okay. But will its friends come through?

name: SAM
dialogue: Probably not?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Probably is good enough for me.

name: SAM
dialogue: (sighs) All right.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Once we pull it through, how do we keep it in place long enough for--

name: SAM
dialogue: We don't, we pull it through right in front of--

name: LAURA
dialogue: How do we get in front of--

name: SAM
dialogue: I could be invisible.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Allura, thank you so much for your time. Please don't let us disturb you any longer.

name: MATT
dialogue: "No worries, I'm about to ready continuing to strengthen the veil with Shaun--"

name: SAM
dialogue: Also I don't know if you'd heard, but Tiberius fell.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh. I'm sorry to hear that. These are dangerous times. I've got something I've got to "do. Stay safe. Be careful with that." She walks out of the room, a little dazed, and rubs the top of Kima's head, and you watch her leave.

name: LAURA
dialogue: How is she?

name: MATT
dialogue: "She's stretched a little thin these days, to be honest."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Her and Gilmore both.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well there's a lot going on, and a lot needs to be found and a lot needs to be done, "and a never-ending barrage of responsibility. Which I despise. Where are you guys off to?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, something you might enjoy, actually.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Really?" You see this big, toothy grin curl across her face, and her fingers twitch. "So?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Feel like killing a dragon?

name: MATT
dialogue: (excited chuckles) "I was hoping you'd say that! Let me get my armor. How soon? When?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Pretty soon. We only save you for the big fights.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All righty! Stay right here. I'll be right back!" She darts off with a spring in her step and a little chuckle as she heads down the hall.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Quick, before she comes back.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What? It would be the best bag ever, come on.

name: SAM
dialogue: Won't she ask why Asum is with us?

name: LAURA
dialogue: No.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Here's what I think. She's going to find out eventually, and then what do we say when they all know we've known the whole time?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Look, when we start attacking Seeker Asum, then we kill Kima. What? She's probably a dragon, too.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Shit. I totally did that, didn't I? But she wanted to come! And fight the dragon. I'm an idiot.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Look, we don't have to tell her. As soon as we hit Raishan, she'll reveal herself, anyway. That was our agreement, not tell, right?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But then what happens when Kima goes, did you guys know?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah. She didn't ask.

name: SAM
dialogue: Paints us as pretty shady folk.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: These are the people we need to trust us. They are our allies.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: She has kept secrets from us, and we have a perfectly legitimate reason for not telling.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'm with Percy on that.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That was also years ago!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, we have a very-- fine! We still have a perfectly reasonable reason for not telling anyone, which is that if we tell people the city gets destroyed.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And they get destroyed!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You are welcome to tell her, and then we have to deal with the city being destroyed.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Plus, Kima is a total bash brother, and if she gets to find out she gets to kill two dragons instead of one, I don't think she's going to be upset.

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't know, we're putting her in a lot of danger.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: As opposed to staying here.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And we were aware, and we could have told her. She going to be angry at not telling her the full parameters.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: She will.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, did see her, though? She's sweaty. She's working on the outside of houses.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: This is not someone we want to lose our trust.

name: SAM
dialogue: She could help protect the city, it could go under siege.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: She's a soldier. They're used to not being told things.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No, she is not a soldier in our manifested army! She is our friend and ally. There is a difference right now. This is a different duty and relationship.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I feel like I got us into this, and I'm really sorry about that.

name: SAM
dialogue: We can get her out of it really quickly.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We can tell her not to come.

name: SAM
dialogue: We can tell her that it never happened.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You saw how excited she was! It's her choice! If she's our friend and ally, let her choose.

name: SAM
dialogue: She'll choose a fight every time.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But she'll choose a fight unaware of exactly what she's getting into.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, we can make that clear, then. Tell her that there are aspects of this fight that sadly must remain secret, that it's far more dangerous than we could possibly even explain--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yep, what he said.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And that things may go completely tits-up.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: This is Lady Kima we are talking about! She is one of the most hard-headed people we know. She is going to push until we tell her what happened.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Even if we tell her the truth, she's still going to want to come.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So then either we tell her the truth and trust that she can keep a secret, or she doesn't come. She's going to find out, and I don't want to lose her trust.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't want to tell her.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Percy--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, I'm happy for her not to come because I don't want to tell her, because I don't trust--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I don't trust anyone right now.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I barely trust us to keep this secret, let alone another person.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh my god, honestly. All right. To a vote.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What are we voting on?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Whether we bring Kima or not.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: She's going to be mad at us either way, so it depends on if she's mad at us now or even more angry at us later.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I want her to fight a dragon. All those in favor of Kima not going to fight a dragon, raise your hand. All those in favor of Kima going to fight a dragon, raise your hand.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You're abstaining?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm not there.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh shit!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I grab my earring. I'm like, Vax, where are you? Can you hear me?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm sure I'm more than 500 feet away.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, look, she's then going to wonder why we uninvited her. We are lying to her no matter which way we take right now.

name: SAM
dialogue: If you want I can wipe her memory of the fact that we offered--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh my god!

name: LAURA
dialogue: If she finds out, she is going to be really super pissed.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm okay with this plan.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Removing an ally from a fight.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I feel like she should come.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Taking one of the guns and going, nah! I want that gun to trust me.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Look, I want her there more than anything. I don't want to lie to her and I also don't want her dead and I don't want to drag her into a situation she could have known more about.

name: SAM
dialogue: I defer to the Grand Poobah's will. I will change my vote to yes.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: There could be ears listening.

name: SAM
dialogue: I know. Don't worry, I'll wipe their minds, too. Let's bring her.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You really won't.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Let's do it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So we're bringing her?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes. And what's our plan? Do we go to sleep and wake up and go? How do we get there?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We go in the morning.

name: SAM
dialogue: How are we getting there?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Tree Stride.

name: SAM
dialogue: We're going to burn her spell in the morning to get there? Shouldn't we go now, sleep there?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, I was assuming we would go there tomorrow, set everything up, and then have it happen the day after. We can go camp in our house, deep in--

name: SAM
dialogue: With Raishan? In my house? Raishan's not getting in the mansion, ever.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: By the way, that two-week time period we had. How far into that are we?

name: SAM
dialogue: Two days?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, you got a handful of days left.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Okay. Just checking.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We go there, we set up. Raishan can handle herself.

name: SAM
dialogue: Fine, let's go.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We're going? Well, you know what? I've got to handle something first.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh boy.

name: MATT
dialogue: While this is happening: Vax. What can we do for you?"

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, first, how's he coming along?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well he's a bit rough around the edges, but he's actually a pretty decently trained fighter."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, I'd agree with that.

name: MATT
dialogue: Kynan's quiet.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm on de Rolo business right now. Can I borrow the boy?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't know. Do you want to be borrowed?" "I suppose. Did I do anything?"

name: LIAM
dialogue: No, you're fine. Take a walk with me?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Sure."

name: LIAM
dialogue: I need to head back to the castle.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Let me just--" And he hands the blade over to Jarett, who takes it and sheathes it on the side.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Jarett. He'll be back tomorrow for a little more, all right?

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right. I shall prepare. Don't do anything stupid, boy." He smiles, and comes up and starts walking with you but keeps about a foot and a half, two feet between the two of you. He seems to still be putting a boundary there.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Hey. Listen to me. I wanted to give you a little more time. I wanted to. And I don't think we have it. Things are moving fast. You didn't know what was going on. I don't fault you; I fault myself. That day you showed up-- look at me. I had a point, but I made sport of you while making it, and that is on me. And I'm sorry for it.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm sorry, too. I should have taken it for the lesson it was, and I was too dumb and young to "let it get through my thick skull."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Hey, man. I'm a little bit older than you, but I'm a massive fucking shithead. I've made plenty of mistakes, and I only knew how easy it was for shit to blow up in your face, and now it has. Percival and I want to offer you a means of squaring yourself off.

name: MATT
dialogue: "What do you need?"

name: LIAM
dialogue: This city is in danger, and it needs people watching it, and I know you're training. Percy-- I'm sorry, Percival-- has a task for you, and I think it's well suited for you. You were around Ripley, you were around her other men, and you know how to use a sidearm.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I've toyed with it. I wouldn't say I'm a great shot, by any means."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Sure. But the number of people who know how to use those things I can count on two hands. Here. We have guns now. We need people to use them, so I want you to come and talk to Percival for a bit, and we're going to work out a plan for you to show some people the ropes.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right. Okay."

name: LIAM
dialogue: This is your second chance. I don't doubt you're going to make the best of it. I truly do not. And again, I was going to wait on this, because I can see the pain in your eyes, but there isn't time. And I want you to be well equipped, so I want you to take these. And I hand him two of the three daggers that I bought that day, and I take out the Keen Dagger, which requires attunement. These are mine, and now they're yours. Water under the bridge, and I don't want to hear a word, just walk with me to de Rolo.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Okay. Thank you."

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm sorry.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm sorry." He walks along with you, eventually leading you back to Percy's workshop where the instruction is given for the weapons. Anything beyond that he doesn't understand about the rifles. Nothing construction, general outfitting. He seems to be more of an adept student than you expected. He's got some intellect to him, at the very least, he can pick up the details pretty quick. Quick learner, when he puts his mind to it. About this time, as you're having this discussion, you can hear the bounding of armored feet, and bursting through the partially open door you see, fully armored, eager, hair pulled back in a tight braid, big old maul scraping on the stone behind her. "All right. When are we doing this?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Tomorrow.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Tomorrow? That's--" (laughter) "Does it have to be tomorrow?"

name: SAM
dialogue: Why, what are you doing tomorrow?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's really quiet here. I'm getting extremely bored."

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh. You want to go now?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I mean, whenever you need to, I'm just saying--"

name: SAM
dialogue: We could go now and camp there.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That'll give Kik a chance to replenish.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, that's true.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I don't see any difference in Raishan being able to kill us in our sleep here or there.

name: LIAM
dialogue: She could stay in the shittiest room in the mansion, Scanlan.

name: SAM
dialogue: She's not getting in the mansion. She can go sit in the fucking snow and go to sleep, for all I care.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm very confused right now."

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Do the thing. (laughter)

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's only ten minutes now. It's only ten fucking minutes.

name: SAM
dialogue: The whole shebang, or just what we said right now? Just what we just said right now, just that? Great.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, wait! Might as well test the waters.

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay, yeah. Good. Nine minutes and counting.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Okay, hang on, whoa. I need some clarification here." The hammer slams down onto the stonework.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Shut the door, lock it. This is not how I wanted this to go down, but apparently this is how it's happening-- wait a minute. Your boy is gone by now, right? We sent him out.

name: LAURA
dialogue: He's gone.

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughs) No, you guys were teaching him about the guns when she came back.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You never know when it's out of character or in character--

name: MATT
dialogue: Mind you, he seems largely confused and doesn't seem to know what's going on.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm going to go take the boy for a stroll and show him how this is going to work and explain to him everything. Gentlemen, you actually plan how we're going to kill dragons. Excuse me. Give me strength.

name: LIAM
dialogue: All right, quickly. Kima, we need to talk to you about something very important, and if it doesn't go well, Scanlan is going to erase your memory, but--

name: MATT
dialogue: "Excuse me?!"

name: SAM
dialogue: I can do crazy things.

name: MATT
dialogue: "No, nobody's doing that to me!"

name: LIAM
dialogue: Of course not, because you are so cool. Cool as a cucumber. We're in a bit of a predicament. We are going to Draconia so that you can fight not one but two dragons. Here's the thing: one of the dragons is here right now, is coming with us in disguise--

name: MATT
dialogue: Immediately the maul gets grabbed, she says, "Here?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, I think you're doing it wrong. Scanlan--

name: LIAM
dialogue: We've got eight more minutes!

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, we don't.

name: SAM
dialogue: Lady Kima. We, in order to kill one dragon, are entering into a deal with another.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Before we kill it.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Are you crazy?!"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I know, that's what I said.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Pure stupidity.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Obviously, yes!"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Hear him out.

name: SAM
dialogue: If we do this, it could help us kill the dragon that killed Tiberius.

name: MATT
dialogue: "And you think you can trust this dragon?"

name: ALL
dialogue: No.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Come on, guys!"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: All right, look. The dragon is actually poisoned by a curse. She's very weak.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Great! Perfect!"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We plan to take advantage of that.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Why don't we kill the dragon here, and then kill the other dragon there--"

name: LAURA
dialogue: She'll fuck up Whitestone. It'll give us away. We have to get away from the city.

name: SAM
dialogue: Lady Kima, you're looking at a group of idiots who have felled dragons, killed beholders, negotiated with sphinxes, gone to other realms and other planes, and somehow managed to get out of it more or less alive.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You are a lucky bunch of sons-of-bitches, that I'll give to you!"

name: LIAM
dialogue: You know what also this is like?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm keeping an eye on the time.

name: MATT
dialogue: She leans on her hammer.

name: LIAM
dialogue: This is what this is like: this is just like the Underdark, with one exception. We worked with that fucking asshole thinking he might have some redeeming qualities and he didn't, he turned on us, right?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yeah, and who told you that? Who told you that was going to happen? Who at the very first "moment you showed him to me said, 'This guy is going to try and kill you?'"

name: LIAM
dialogue: But on the side, he helped us get as far as he did, but then he got shot through the head, but that's water under the bridge! This time, we know that we're dealing with a fucking piece of shit. We're going to turn on the piece of shit and kill her. The whole plan is to get them all to turn on each other, and then we mop up the messy bits afterwards.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Seven minutes!

name: LIAM
dialogue: One dragon or two dragons? You want to play? Let's play.

name: SAM
dialogue: Or you can let us go into this without you. And probably all die.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yeah, you're all going to die!"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You were ready to run with us, girl!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh, I'm coming with you, because I'm not going to let you die!"

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, you are?

name: MATT
dialogue: "God. Stupid bunch of gits, I swear. Bahamut, are you serious? (scoffs) This is "ridiculous. I'm not going to tell anyone you made this plan until it's done, because this is "stupid as shit."

name: SAM
dialogue: It could be. But with you by our side, it has a slightly better chance of going correct.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes, it does."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Kimmy, can you be cool?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Please don't call me that."

name: SAM
dialogue: Lil' Kim.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Can you be cool?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Where's the dragon?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's in Draconia.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Six minutes.

name: MATT
dialogue: "What about the one that's here?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's hiding.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Hiding?"

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's going to show up after the fact. In Draconia.

name: MATT
dialogue: "So this whole deal, you just don't trust me enough to tell me where the dragon's sleeping in "our place right now? You're all acting very weird."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We made a deal.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's for your own protection. We can't tell you everything.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What if you go running off? What if you go try to kill it in here, and Whitestone gets destroyed?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Please."

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's a temptation. Believe me, we know.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It is very tempting, trust me, yes it is. But I'm also not stupid."

name: SAM
dialogue: After all we've been through--

name: LIAM
dialogue: We've all almost died a hundred times.

name: SAM
dialogue: We're asking you to trust us blindly in this scenario, and I know that it's not ideal, but we have saved you before.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And Kima, please remember: between me and you, of all people, before we trusted the illithid, we trusted you.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well we trusted her.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You're right. I didn't trust you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I was about to say--"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: They trusted you. I didn't. I'm getting to my point! But we grew past that, and now I trust you more implicitly than most people in this world.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Good."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: This is precisely why you people need me!

name: LIAM
dialogue: I think all these words are fucking it up. She seems down. I think we should just get it on.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Here's the thing, though: you have to pretend like you don't know. It's super important.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Right. Can you be cool?

name: MATT
dialogue: "You're asking me to lie?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well. Pretend.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm not real good at lying."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: How about you just don't say anything?

name: MATT
dialogue: "That I can do."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay. Perfect. And don't attack.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Four minutes.

name: SAM
dialogue: Should I wipe her memory?

name: TRAVIS, LAURA
dialogue: No.

name: SAM
dialogue: Might be easier, at this point.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, we're good.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You come near me with any sort of magic mumbo-jumbo, I'm going to clock you in the head, Scanlan."

name: SAM
dialogue: Lady Kima, I don't know what you're talking about.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I love you, but I'm going to clock you in the head if you try and wipe my memory, little gnome."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Kima. We've got three minutes left. Kima.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Until what?!"

name: LAURA
dialogue: He can choose any ten minutes he wants, really.

name: LIAM
dialogue: That's true. You know our mind, you know what our plan is. You're kind of a firebrand, do you think it might be better for you not to know-- you know now, but to not know going in and then you kill everything on sight when we're there?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I have no idea what you're talking about, and this is really starting to frustrate me. Are "we going to kill a dragon?"

name: LAURA, TRAVIS
dialogue: Yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We're going to kill two dragons?"

name: LIAM
dialogue: One to two dragons, yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Great, okay. What's the plan?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We leave tonight.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We go.

name: SAM
dialogue: We go where the dragon is, we're going to release bait. When the dragon is done with the bait, we go in and kill the dragon.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yep, pretty much.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And then another dragon.

name: SAM
dialogue: Maybe a third after that.

name: LAURA
dialogue: If we're totally weak, though, we can't fight the second dragon right away, we have to save up our strength and then fight her after so we don't die.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm not going to lie, I admire your drive and gusto. Just be smart about this."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Look at that, she says she can't lie, and there she did it so well.

name: SAM
dialogue: I thought you were gone.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm listening in to this whole thing through the earphone as I'm talking. That's how I keep telling you how long you have, because I'm laughing so much.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right. Well, then."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm going to go talk to the Sun Tree.

name: SAM
dialogue: I thought we were going? We're leaving now?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Just gather your shit. I'll meet you there.

name: SAM
dialogue: Where?

name: TALIESIN, MARISHA
dialogue: The Sun Tree.

name: LIAM
dialogue: She's our ticket there.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Don't talk to anyone, Kima.

name: MATT
dialogue: "If we're leaving soon, I'm sticking with you guys."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm going to let Asum in on our plan.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Hey, Scanlan, could you wipe Kynan's memory, please?

name: SAM
dialogue: Kynan?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, he's here.

name: SAM
dialogue: Kynan didn't really hear anything.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, I left with him.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You left with him?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I haven't been in the room because I took him away.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I redact that statement. Excellent.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, that's why Percy left.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I see. I was focused on the fire--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, no. I've walked Kynan to show him how I would like things to function.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, and as you're listening in you gave him all the instruction and he takes it in pretty well. Jarett catches up with you, and you both coordinate with that. All right. You head to the Sun Tree while the rest of you gather the rest of your materials and supplies.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm going to-- well, if we have time. I'm going to attune my cold-snap armor to me, so I'll probably not have my bracers attuned.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, so that's two damage off any of your ranged attacks. So keep note of that.

name: LAURA
dialogue: But I get, what, cold resistance and added AC, or something?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm going to attune Animus and drop the gloves of missile snaring for this fight.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Free wet willies.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you attune the weapon, there's a brief familiar dark glow on the weapon, and all the three names that exist on the barrel all dissipate. It's now a clean barrel.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh no.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, all right. We'll have to have a talk about that. Is it all right if I let Asum know what our basic plan is?

name: SAM
dialogue: What, that we're leaving now?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We're leaving now, we'll be heading there, the fight will be tomorrow. There will be a creature that we will lure and bait the white dragon with, we will attack at the end. We expect to see her participation. If we are not acutely aware of it, all deals are off.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Sounds good to me.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I relay that information.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Do you go to Asum's room?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I knock.

name: MATT
dialogue: You knock on the door.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Asum?

name: MATT
dialogue: A voice goes, (shushes). You hear lowered voices from the other side of the door for a moment.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I walk away, assuming that Asum will know where to find me.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's it?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I go back to gathering my things, pulling powder and shot out of what was necessary.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. About ten minutes go by, and as you're gathering things Asum approaches. "I'm sorry, "Percy. I was indisposed."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I apologize. I hope I didn't disrupt anything important.

name: MATT
dialogue: "No. I was keen enough to cover, but both the Cinder King and the Frigid Doom are under the "impression that there is no mounting danger."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Tonight, we go to Draconia.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Very well."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Tomorrow, we fight the dragon. We will bait him with another creature of great strength--

name: MATT
dialogue: "Might I ask what creature of great strength you intend to bait Vorugal with?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't think anything you've ever heard of before.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Try me."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: What the hell. I pull out the book and show him the picture.

name: SAM
dialogue: (whispering) Her.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Sorry. Thank you.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, it's Asum right now.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's confusing, man.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yeah. There's a lot of gender issues in this.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Reaching into the Abyss! That's curious."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I figured that quite possibly, in private, you and I have the closest dispositions.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I can see that kinship, as well."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Once that fight has concluded, we mop up whatever is left. We expect to see your participation in some form. I understand if it can't be direct.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I can be of aid, I just have to remain inconspicuous. I cannot be seen to be part of this "confrontation."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Obviously.

name: MATT
dialogue: "And all shall be fine."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We may have some extra people with us, as well.

name: MATT
dialogue: "This was not discussed. Who would you intend to bring into this deal?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That, sadly, I cannot inform. Although there will be Draconians. They are disinterested in our politics.

name: MATT
dialogue: "And disposable?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I would hope not. But I understand your point of view. I will say for the sake of this encounter, our point of view will be dominant. But I understand and respect yours. When dealing with ants, you must respect the needs of ants. Surely you understand?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I follow. All right."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: So there will be that. We will have a couple of accompanying members as well, but since you're staying hidden, it shouldn't be a problem. I would recommend not showing up in this form, at the very least.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh, in this form? I have many forms I can take. I have an idea. Very well. Fetch me when "you're ready."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We will be leaving on our own. You will have to meet us there. I'm sure getting to Draconia shouldn't be too much of a problem for you?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Why not travel with you and your band? That seems like a waste of magic."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It does, but sadly we are trying to keep our own reality quiet. The needs of ants. And also, they don't want you around. They don't trust you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I understand that, but if you're going now, it takes me at least three, four days of travel "over the ocean to get to Draconia."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Surely you can find a faster way. You got here very quickly. You so rarely lie that I'm so fascinated that when you do, I think I'm starting to get your tells, just a bit of them.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You're a funny little man."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I take that as the highest compliment.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, then. I'll see you tomorrow."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: See you tomorrow.

name: MATT
dialogue: And Asum turns around and exits.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I turn the corner, get far enough away, and drop to my knees and breathe deeply for a minute.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well done.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Head to the Sun Tree.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. You guys make your way to the Sun Tree. While you're walking, Keyleth, you head there, as well. Is there anything you wanted to do before they arrive?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes, I wanted to go underneath in our little Sun Tree cave that we carved out.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. So you go beneath the tavern, into the basement, down into the little tunnel beneath that leads to the Sun Tree's roots.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah. And I cast Commune with Nature.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (laughs) There's so much pressure on this. Is there a way I can put my hand inside the Sun Tree?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Wow.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: It's less of a merger and more as you touch and connect to the roots, your consciousness and the Sun Tree's consciousness can combine.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You're holding the roots.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Dear diary--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Today I talked to the Sun Tree.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Dear Sun Tree--

name: SAM
dialogue: It was so turgid.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Turgid?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It was an appropriate usage of the word! Very well done, very good.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay, I'm going to cast Commune with Nature and try and connect with the Sun Tree.

name: MATT
dialogue: You grab the roots and feel the warmth flow through your hands and there your consciousness connects with that of the Sun Tree, and you are both present in that same plant space.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Sun Tree?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Hey, Keyleth." (giggling) "Been a while."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Hey Sun Tree.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Hey, Keyleth."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Without burning a question, can I personally ask you, how are you doing, man?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Doing all right."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah?

name: MATT
dialogue: "A little cold, but... Whitestone."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay, man, yeah. Hey, Sun Tree?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yeah, Keyleth?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So you're overtop all these arcane ley-lines across the whole globe, right? I've traveled a lot of places here lately. What are all the cities that the other arcane ley lines fall across?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't rightly know."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can I sense it through the Sun Tree's roots?

name: MATT
dialogue: Which, as he converses with you, he says, "I've been here a long time. Don't really get "around much, being a tree." But you do feel this light, fuzzy, blue, almost like a mist energy, like a particle energy that is coalesced around Whitestone and above it, and it shoots off in six different directions, some that curl up northwards, some that curl out over the ocean, and you see them spider out in places and then go beyond your peripheral. The ley-lines only spider out past the Alabaster Sierras; you can't see much further than that.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Are there any cities, any places of interest I can see that we've been through before, where they happen to cross?

name: MATT
dialogue: Let me look at the specifics of Commune with Nature real fast.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm trying to see if I can use the Sun Tree to extend my vision a little further.

name: MATT
dialogue: Unfortunately, the spell only lasts for up to three miles.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah. I want to extend a little further?

name: MATT
dialogue: You sense that yes, these ley energies do travel much further and surround the world and make a network of various magical pathways, but unfortunately the Sun Tree and your vision right now doesn't go far beyond Whitestone. "Yeah. It isn't a lot."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So the ziggurat, the spinning orb of death that happens to be right underneath you, are you in touch with what that might be feeding?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Can't say I do."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Goddamn it, Sun Tree! Goddamn it!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Keyleth, calm down. I'm happy to answer your questions, invite you to my space. Just "because I'm not an all-seeing tree, don't be angry with me."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm not angry with you, Sun Tree.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Angry in general. Just chill."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's really easy for you to say, Sun Tree.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yeah, it is." (laughter)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay. All right. Sun Tree.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yeah, Keyleth?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You're a tree from Pelor, yes?

name: MATT
dialogue: "More or less."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Have there been the attention of any other gods on Whitestone right now? That you can sense? Or can I sense? I'm asking the Sun Tree out of humor, but can I sense it? I'm assuming the tree doesn't actually know fucking shit.

name: MATT
dialogue: The tree may know a lot, just, the right questions need to be asked. The Sun Tree says, "To "be perfectly honest, Keyleth, even Pelor's grace left this place hundreds of years ago. His "presence is here in bits and pieces, but when I was first taking seed, the gods were much more "present, much easier to read. Kind of lonely nowadays."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's so sad.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I know, Keyleth. I know."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You've got me, Sun Tree. I'm here. You shouldn't be lonely.

name: MATT
dialogue: "When you're around, Keyleth, nobody can be lonely."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Aww, that's so-- aww.

name: LAURA
dialogue: He's saying that as you're holding on to his roots.

name: MATT
dialogue: Don't make it weird, Laura.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Sorry.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It was weird five minutes ago, Matt!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay, Sun Tree. I don't think I have much time left, but is there anything-- you said you're lonely. I just want to say if you ever want to talk, I'm here. You know you can confide in me. If there's anything you want to say, I'm all ears, you know?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I appreciate that."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah?

name: MATT
dialogue: "You've got to come to me." (laughter) "But when you do, hell yeah."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You know, I didn't really get any of the things I was looking for, Sun Tree, but I still feel a little better. Thank you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That's all that matters, Keyleth."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah! You're cool, Sun Tree.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You're cool too, girl."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Aww! Not as cool as you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Probably."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah. Okay, I'm going to be walking through you here in a minute, so I wanted to let you know that there's going to be eight people going through, so don't feel alarmed.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh boy."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Does that hurt you?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It tingles a little."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That's all right."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm sorry. I'm not going to stop doing it, but I'm sorry.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I appreciate it."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: All right. Bye, Sun Tree.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Bye, Keyleth."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Has anybody seen Keyleth?

name: MATT
dialogue: As you go up top, the whole group is gathered there, currently.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: She's downstairs with her wood.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh. Did you have fun?

name: LIAM
dialogue: You seem way more relaxed than even an hour ago.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You smell of pine.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And sap.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yep. I'll have whatever she's having.

name: SAM
dialogue: Are we ready to do this?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Sure.

name: SAM
dialogue: Hey, before we go, Lady Kima. (singing) When the gnome hits your eye like a big pizza pie, you've been mind-melded! (speaking) I'm going to wipe her mind. It's too risky.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Of what?

name: SAM
dialogue: Of the whole conversation. It's too risky.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's a lot of mind--

name: SAM
dialogue: Nope! It's a ten-minute conversation.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Ten minutes, when he wants it.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right, what's your spell DC on this?

name: MATT
dialogue: Well, you didn't have your hand cone out, though, when you did it.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, you're going to bust me on that? 19, then. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: Kima's eyes blink for a second. "Didn't I warn you, Scanlan Shorthalt, not to try and wipe my mind?!"

name: SAM
dialogue: (yelps)

name: MATT
dialogue: She's taking a hit. Natural 20. (gasps) Right there. Okay.

name: SAM
dialogue: (nervous laugh) This is how I die.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm okay with this.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I was feeling relaxed.

name: MATT
dialogue: You take 35 points of damage. 27 of it blunt damage from the actual impact with the hammer; the rest of it's thunder damage. As her Holy Thunder Maul slams into the side of your head and sends you skidding ten feet across the ground, coming to a halt.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That felt fair.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, he deserved it.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Damn right, he did."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, he had good-- there's a lot at stake--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Vax. Let it be.

name: LAURA
dialogue: How about we get through the tree before we talk anymore?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I love you guys, but--"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, no, he had that coming.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It was a good swing.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Thank you. I've been tense recently, anyway."

name: LIAM
dialogue: I pull the gnome up and cast Lay on Hands and give him ten hit points. You all right, buddy?

name: SAM
dialogue: (groaning) You passed the test. You're worthy of coming with us on the journey.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We can only apologize for him so much.

name: MATT
dialogue: "This is true. Shall we get on with it?"

name: TRAVIS, TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We're popping in far enough away, right? In the tree grove up above the chasm?

name: LIAM
dialogue: There was that sideways tree?

name: MATT
dialogue: The sideways tree was where you came through, but you found a tree above that you could get to.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And I grew a tree, right? Didn't I grow some trees?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I pick one of those trees.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. You finish your Transport Via Plants spell. The portal opens. You all begin darting through, Kima darts through. Who's the last one out?

name: TALIESIN

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You're an elephant in the Cloak of Displacement.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But whenever I Beast Shape I absorb my items.

name: MATT
dialogue: That would have been something to mention earlier, so going forward the attacks will have disadvantage, but you have to remember that for it to have an effect.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But they're just now rolling.

name: MATT
dialogue: He hasn't attacked yet, he's rolling because a Fireball just blew up in his face!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I got a natural 20, so I'm good.

name: MATT
dialogue: So that's half damage to you. You said it was 26 damage?

name: MATT
dialogue: So 13 points of fire damage to Percy and Grog, and a full 26 points of fire damage to you. That puts you at a total of 42 plus 26, so 68. You're still up. The elephant that's now storming through the center-- hold on, I have to go with the battle music for this now.

name: SAM
dialogue: Where's your battle map?

name: MATT
dialogue: --storming through the center of the foyer, is now spinning around, flames exploding, engulfing Percy, Grog. The elephant is now covered in blood and scrapes. That finishes your go. Grog, you're up.

name: SAM
dialogue: Before I'm done I'm going to inspire Grog and say: Grog, remember. They never forget! (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: Take your d12 inspiration.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Thank you. I'll take two strikes at the elephant's ass. That's a one.

name: MATT
dialogue: With disadvantage.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh. Well, that's a one, so.

name: MATT
dialogue: I know. You still have the second attack.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's a two.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (heavy footsteps)

name: MATT
dialogue: So as you go--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Wait, it's not a two!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: So the second one was 16, the first one was a 15.

name: MATT
dialogue: It still hits. You rolled a two and it still hits because its AC is 12. It's very big and easy to hit. Go ahead and roll damage on the next attack.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh, nice. What a joy!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's not hard to hit an elephant.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Can we also say that the two winos have come down to watch?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, we're staring from the top of the stairs at all of it happening.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: The first one is 20, with four points of necrotic damage.

name: MATT
dialogue: You only hit with one.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh, that's right.

name: MATT
dialogue: How much was that, 20 points?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, 20.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, so Keyleth, you yourself take 12 points of damage. As your axe swings through and slams into the elephant, the elephant's form suddenly vanishes, as your axe cleaves through Keyleth a little bit, causing her to fall back and catch herself.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Is Percy still on her back, piggy-backing?

name: MATT
dialogue: In a second, Percy goes (thud) on the ground next to you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (pained noise)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Percy, you've been riding Raishan! Die, evil witch!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Grog! It's Keyleth.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, Grog, thank you! That elephant ate me! You saved me!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I did?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You did.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Sometimes I don't know if you guys would live without me. I'm really glad I'm around, sometimes.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I can't imagine it. I legitimately cannot imagine it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Ooh, is that my helmet?!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It is!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Ayy, Fredrickstein the Science Guy, nice job! Look at that! That is beautiful.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (whispering) He's drunk.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: The elephant ate this too.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's Dr. Fredrickstein, please.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Is there poo on it?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No, it's good.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's clean. It's perfectly reasonable.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Ooh, the mask's on the back. Did you write on the inside like I said?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It is engraved in Elven on the inside, it's lovely.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It looks like writing. What's it--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's your title, sir.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, that? It's Elvish.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh, it's Elvish? So not everybody knows what my title is.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's meant to be secret.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Very smart. Did you see my title?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I did, it's impressive.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I wrote it down.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Did you? Oh dear.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I knew it was going to be handy.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I will put on the new mask slash horned helm.

name: MATT
dialogue: It feels impressive.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Does it?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Actually, because now the mask is facing the back, right? Can I fucking turn it around and put the mask on the front, with the horn sticking out the back like a big Nike swoosh?

name: MATT
dialogue: You can. It's not as comfortable, but it definitely feels badass.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (muffled) I don't feel like this is the best--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You sound very intimidating.

name: LIAM
dialogue: He got polymorphed into De Niro. (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh my god.

name: SAM
dialogue: I feel like I'm going to have to write some house rules from now on.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It'd be good to have a list of things to ignore, I agree.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You need some of those blue guys with an aerator at all times down in those cellars.

name: SAM
dialogue: Blue man group?

name: LIAM
dialogue: One of your blue guys! The blue guys! That disappears with this place--

name: SAM
dialogue: My hundreds of--? There's no guys here. They're all female servants. I don't know how many times I need to say this.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, nobody farted in our wine tonight. We had to drink it regular.

name: SAM
dialogue: I am sorry for your loss, because it's really excellent once you let it breathe and open up.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's pretty good right now.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well, now that I got my helmet, are we going down to the ship?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I propose that we have an evening's rest. In the morning--

name: LIAM
dialogue: We should go now.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No. Maybe you need to rest.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, I think we need an evening's rest.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I have 25 hit points. I'm fine!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah. Well, Pike is resting because she was hurt quite badly.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, but did you see her fun buns, though? I did those.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I didn't.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You did her fun buns?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, I pulled little fun buns--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh! Okay! That's good--

name: LIAM
dialogue: What do you think I meant?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I didn't think anything, I'm going up.

name: LIAM
dialogue: What else does fun buns mean except for little, cute, little hairballs on your hair?

name: SAM
dialogue: I'll give you a book later.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, yeah! You have a book?

name: SAM
dialogue: I have a few. I have a library.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Oh, gosh! Neither Vax nor Liam knew there was anything other than little cute hair buns-- Fun buns. What is a "fun bun" besides a fun bun? MATT: Ask Larkin. You guys! We got to find Larkin!

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. All right, so you guys take your long rest. You regain your spells, you're all full hit points, you regain half your max hit dice. So if you spent more than half of your hit dice, you still--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Do we keep our hit dice from our Heroes' Feast? If we never got rid of them? Or are they gone?

name: MATT
dialogue: No. By the time you'd wake up, they'd be gone, probably.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Can you use the hit-- never mind.

name: SAM
dialogue: When they wake up in the morning, Vax has a bill under his door for three bottles of wine. And Vex for one bottle. And Keyleth for a construction bill of 5,000 gold pieces.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I promptly rip the fuck out of my bill.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I think it's a scam, and I throw it away.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

name: SAM
dialogue: It is a scam. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. Well-rested. A fresher day. The mansion, growing fairly close to probably expending the rest of its magic. What do you guys do?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Let's pack our things, head down and take a look at that pirate ship, then head home. Well, that ship. I don't know if it has pirate symbols, but I'm very excited.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So wait, do we need things-- how far under the ice is it?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Probably a bit. Having the ability to melt some ice would probably be helpful. Also, you're going to have to do the tree teleport and possibly we want to deal with reforestation of some kind.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Reforestation. Oh, sure because the Ice Age wiped out--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We have to go out like Captain EO. It's a thing.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah!

name: SAM
dialogue: Just throwing this out there, is there anything to gain by going up to the dragon lair and communicating with Thordak? Is there anything we want to say to him?

name: LAURA, TALIESIN
dialogue: No.

name: SAM
dialogue: Misdirection? Taunting? Anything?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Like, you suck. You can find us at the Glintshore? LIAM: We don't even want to take an hour for me to slip this on and go see if there's anything of value?

name: SAM
dialogue: Up in the lair?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You can do that while we look at the ship.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Not a bad idea.

name: SAM
dialogue: But don't go alone. You can still get hit with traps.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I can look for those. I do like buddies to go. Do you need to go to the boat?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's all in the same place.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah. It's all in the same place.

name: SAM
dialogue: I can hover above you or something.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Let's jauntily head over.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: If there's a problem, we can call the others. We won't be that far away.

name: LIAM
dialogue: All right. Ooh! I slip Whisper into my pack and I put this ring on.

name: SAM
dialogue: (whispers) Ooh! Precious!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Right, so you have to attune to that.

name: LIAM
dialogue: (Gollum voice) Nasty!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Thank you.

name: LIAM
dialogue: (Gollum voice) Nasty!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Nasty woman.

name: LIAM
dialogue: (Gollum voice) She's a nasty woman! (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, I may need a ringtone later.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. All right, great. So you guys have put yourselves together. Kima and Pike joined you downstairs in the foyer. You make your way back out into the ravine just as the magic of the mansion fades. There you can see most of the dragon bones picked entirely off the corpse of Vorugal, except for the ribcage, still remaining as a landmark of the battle that took place with a central tree still sprouting from the top of it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Is it any bigger?

name: MATT
dialogue: No, the magic of Fenthras creates the tree and it stays that size as it sprouts. Who knows if over time it may grow? You haven't had the time to really tell. You guys make your way--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I didn't know you are an artist.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's quite lovely, isn't it?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's pretty amazing, yes. I appreciate this.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You're welcome. I did it for you, Keyleth.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Certainly adds something, doesn't it? To the whole valley. It's quite nice.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah. Green.

name: MATT
dialogue: The weather has cleared up. There's breaks in the clouds. It's still mostly cloud-covered, but you do see glimpses of blue sky here and there. Still cold, still see your breath out in the air. But the temperature does feel slightly warmer than it was the day before. You begin to walk down to the ravine center on the north side of the ravine where Vorugal's lair once resided. You can see hundreds of footprints, up and down, through the snow, through the ravine; looks like there's been a lot of foot traffic to and from while you guys were resting. You make your way to the ice throne of Vorugal and you see a portion of it has collapsed inward. But you also see a lot of foot traffic around, most of the ice spires that remained up there have been broken. The remaining Draconian corpses that were adorning them were taken down, or aren't in sight. And you can see there are a few remaining dragonborn Ravenites that are stepping in and out of the cavern-like chamber that you largely punched through and they continued to excavate it into the night.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: If you could let them know that we're going to make one last venture into the ship and then we'll be on our way.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I walk up to one of the guys going in, and say in Draconic, have you unearthed the giant ship yet?

name: MATT
dialogue: He looks for a second and says, "It is nothing for us. But we've worked around it." He points down, and you can see the portion of it that has collapsed, filled in part at the side and shoveled out in these large chunks of ice that are sitting outside of this cavern area. Parts of the ship have been moved around-- it looks like it's been somewhat damaged. It's not a full ship. It's a large portion of a ship. It looks like in whatever battle or attack that Vorugal took this ship, it destroyed a huge portion of it in doing so and took the rest of it with it, in pieces. And it is a very pretty ship. It looks like it may have been the jewel of a navy somewhere. And here it resides. However, it does appear like the ship has seen many moons since it was originally taken, if that makes any sense. Like, it wasn't brought directly here. It looks like almost a keepsake that Vorugal has moved from lair to lair.

name: LIAM
dialogue: (whispers) Oh, that's legit!

name: MATT
dialogue: Has some sort of sentimental value.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, wow! It had some engraving on it. You speak a lot of languages, right?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well. I speak a couple of languages, I read a couple.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What is it?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Does it look familiar?

name: MATT
dialogue: What languages do you know?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Celestial, Elven, Common.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Sylvan, Primordial, Druidic, Elven.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Giant, Common.

name: SAM
dialogue: Gnomish. That's it.

name: MATT
dialogue: You don't even know Common. No one has understood you this entire game!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Pike speaks Dwarvish.

name: MATT
dialogue: Pike does pick up on it. It is Dwarvish text.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I speak Dwarvish, but I can't read.

name: MATT
dialogue: That is a problem.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I have a belt, yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: It is Dwarven, and as Pike begins reading around it, this-- it's the name of the ship across the mast, which is "The Floebreaker." This ship appears to have been, at least in some way, shape, or form, designed as a means of travelling through very far north icy regions, meant to break through elements of heavy glacier flows and such. The construction of it, as you get closer to the actual bit of the ship that is there, you can see it's very heavily reinforced with metal and has a very rigid structure to it. The fine scrolling that you saw before, it looks to be partially filled with ice at times. So as soon as it broke away, you could see it's actually more of a harsh, broken Dwarvish runic writing to it. The ship has definitely seen a lot of wear and tear. That's about as much you can make out of it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can we get inside of it? Is there anything to see inside of it?

name: MATT
dialogue: You can attempt to climb inside if you want to.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: How much is exposed right now?

name: MATT
dialogue: Just the top of the deck, and where the mast connects to the-- that portion is still frozen into the upper part of the throne. There is no entrance immediately visible, but you can break through some more ice or try to break through the actual deck to get there.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I cast a Flaming Sphere.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. A flaming ball begins to roll on the bridge of the ship.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Where does it look like the most convenient entrance? With ice and stuff?

name: MATT
dialogue: Maybe four feet away from where the ice begins. You can see there is one broken portion of the ship deck, maybe about a three-foot, four-foot hole that you could melt towards if you wanted to.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: All right, I'm going to concentrate my Flaming Sphere on that and start melting it.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. It's taking a while. About how long does the spell last, the Flaming Sphere?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: About a minute, I think?

name: LAURA
dialogue: (hums the Jeopardy theme)

name: MATT
dialogue: All right, Flaming Sphere, up to a minute, yeah. The spell expires, the minute done, and you've managed to melt maybe three inches into the ice?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Grog, go punch it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: How much was it?

name: MATT
dialogue: About four feet of ice.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, fuck that.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Ugh! I got it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I step back.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: And I start going Rocky-ribcage on this big piece of meat.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, make your strength check.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Natural 20.

name: MATT
dialogue: 21. He continues to punch, and punch, and punch, and each one you see the ice crack, pieces of it break away. You get quite a ways to punching through towards the direction that you are currently melting before a lot of the ice crumbles and falls and almost buries you for a second. But you knock it away and pull yourself out of it as you do, scooping the shards that occupied the space where you were and get out of the way.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I cast a Gust cantrip over top of him to keep ice from falling on him.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I hope there's really something in here.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Me too.

name: MATT
dialogue: Keeps punching. You get to one point, and you hit, and you hear a (dull impact). You watch a crack spider up to the top of the throne.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I think we need to go.

name: MATT
dialogue: Portion of the throne above you is now starting to crack and fall onto the side.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I start running out of there.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We should get out. Let's go.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I also back out.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. I need the three of you who are closest to it to make a dexterity saving throw, please.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Can I use my Boots of Feral Leaping?

name: MATT
dialogue: You have advantage on dexterity, though. You'll be fine.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I could've hanged back, but I've been meaning to say this whole time that I was creeping around the thrones, I'm just going to throw that out, that I'm up there.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, so you see this happening. A portion of it, like a whole half side of it has cracked and is sliding down into the cavern that has been excavated by your party and the Ravenites.

name: LIAM
dialogue: So if I'm almost on it, should I be making a dex save as well?

name: MATT
dialogue: If you're almost on it--

name: LIAM
dialogue: I was going to poke around and look around it.

name: MATT
dialogue: Only half of it's collapsing, I'll say sure. Go for it. You who offers me to let you make a dexterity saving throw, yes. I will take it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Really? Did you really do that?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I rolled a one, but I have lots of Luck left. And now I'm fine.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'm not.

name: LIAM
dialogue: So that's a 26.

name: MATT
dialogue: So yeah. You manage to leap off and tumble in the snow to the bottom and don't have to worry about it. Travis?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Eight. With advantage.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Eight.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: 19. But I burned a Resolve.

name: MATT
dialogue: So as you guys dart out, Grog and Keyleth unfortunately are left a little bit behind. You both are pummelled with chunks of hard ice and jagged points of broken frost there, dealing 13 points of bludgeoning and piercing damage to both of you. And you find yourselves partially buried in the ice that cracks off it. You see most of Keyleth's body is currently buried, just her head and arms are out. And Grog, you're about up to your waist now in broken ice and snow. And you're like, (grunts), and pull yourself out.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Look at Keyleth's arm.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, I see it. Can you get her out?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Okay. I start moving the ice and pull her out.

name: MATT
dialogue: You pull Keyleth out.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (coughing)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That didn't go well.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Let's burrow straight into the side, I think, to be on the safe side. Let's stop melting ice.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Isn't it buried completely at this point?

name: MATT
dialogue: At this point, the entire excavation portion-- by the way, as you guys came back, most of the gold and platinum that was in there has been completely removed by the Ravenites over time. And this whole area that has been excavated so carefully left it in a precarious place. Those physical hits by Grog sent that whole south side of the throne to collapse inwards. So it's partially collapsed. There's a large pile of ice, rock and snow. And it's not very accessible from the current standpoint.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Maybe it was one of Vorugal's first kills or something? And it's sentimental?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't know, I'm irritated by it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I think it might have given him a little bit of juice when he was at home.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do you think it has some sort of icy-like--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Extra ability when he was here, maybe.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I could try, and maybe now that the ice is broken I can melt it through it easier?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Why would a dragon keep a boat?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Why would he?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Maybe his woobie, you know--?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Like a blankie.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah. You know about that, Percy?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Some people like collecting ships, you know? Maybe he's a nautical kind of guy.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, guns and ships.

name: LAURA
dialogue: He was a nautical kind of guy.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Right, yeah.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (hums the intro of "Alexander Hamilton")

name: LIAM
dialogue: While we're all standing here with our thumbs in our butts, could I look around and see if I see a little stone, a little palantir?

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a investigation check.

name: SAM
dialogue: Where are you standing?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Ugh, Luck again. Jeepers creepers.

name: LAURA
dialogue: He's up top.

name: SAM
dialogue: If he's up top, I would have been up there with him, too.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm a crow. Circling around, watching him from above.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm invisible.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, I'm watching the area.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. What did you roll? 26? Yeah. You see within the north side of the throne, there are two orbs embedded in the ice, about a foot beneath the surface. Previously you saw more.

name: LIAM
dialogue: In the past, in other locations, you mean?

name: MATT
dialogue: No, meaning when you guys first came to this when he wasn't there, you saw three stones. You now see two. But half of the throne has collapsed as well.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And how far down are they under the ice?

name: MATT
dialogue: About a foot, a foot and a half from the surface.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Never mind.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm going to go find my sister.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (groans) It's--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Hey! I'm invisible! Here I am.

name: LAURA, LIAM
dialogue: Hi.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Did you see it? It collapsed.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes, I saw it. I dodged out of the way.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Good.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm right here.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I know! I'm looking at you.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes, but I'm invisible.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm looking in your direction.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Boop!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Ugh, goddamn it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Remember those little round seeing stones?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LIAM
dialogue: There's a couple under the ice over there. Now, I was invisible so I don't--

name: LAURA
dialogue: You saw them under the ice?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You saw a couple under the ice?

name: LIAM
dialogue: A couple under the ice, a foot or two away.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Where were the other ones?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I didn't see any other ones.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Were they there before it collapsed?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I don't know. I was standing right beneath the throne when the throne collapsed. Then I found them.

name: LAURA, LIAM

dialogue: Maybe.
