dialogue: Thordak, from what I understand, is extremely powerful and influential. That Raishan dragon is a mere pittance in comparison. A small, exponential ant, a pawn, if you will, on the battlefield.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I certainly hope so. And if that's the case, then I think you're right. Go for the king "first. But we must do so with eyes all about us because the last thing we need is to be flanked by "that beast in the center of our attack."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Exactly. We don't want to deal with two ancient dragons.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Can we lure it somewhere else, perhaps?

name: MATT
dialogue: "If we knew where it fucking was." Allura speaks up at this point and goes, "Look. I know "that Thordak's hate for me still burns, hence the reason why they went directly for my tower when "they first arrived in Emon. The one trump card we do have in this is me."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Do you want to offer yourself as bait?

name: MATT
dialogue: "If need be. I'm not saying that's the right plan, but I'm saying it is one thing we can "perhaps utilize in our plan, in our strategy."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Is his hate for you?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think-- There was a ship in Draconia, a northern ship of some kind. I still feel there may be some sort of weapon inside it that may prove useful. It was a ship that had been dragged there by the white dragon. It's been bothering me. And then of course we have whatever it is we have downstairs. I'm not saying we should use it, but it is powerful.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I don't know how we would use it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We can't move it, can we?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We can't touch it.

name: MATT
dialogue: Gilmore pops up again and says, "Exactly. We were poring over that thing for a number of "weeks, until we had to build this barrier. And to be perfectly honest, I am sick of it."

name: LIAM
dialogue: You've got nothing?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, we understand it's a siphon. It's bringing the energy of the nexus somewhere. We "don't know where the other end of it is. Or if it's even functioning properly."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Allura, do you still feel a connection with the soul stone that's inside of Thordak?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, I have no personal connection to it, I know that I was the architect of its enchantment, "and the ruse, of which sealed it within Thordak."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You built it. You must know of some way to disable it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Or a weakness.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We designed it to have no weakness. The intent was to keep him there indefinitely. Perhaps "if we could--"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Asum. You said you have friends, back in Emon still, that have been gathering intel." Asum turns. "Yes, actually. And I was hoping that, as part of our plan today, we could even go and "retrieve some of this information. Perhaps that could teach us more about this soul anchor you "continuously talk about."

name: SAM
dialogue: How can we retrieve this information without going to Emon?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh, we would have to go to Emon."

name: SAM
dialogue: That sounds crazy. Is there any way to not do that?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Perhaps I'll go alone."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: The soul stone has been broken and abused before. I have a feeling there's someone who might have an idea on how to disable it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I really don't, I have no idea.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, Raishan was the one who busted out Thordak in the first place, out of the Fire Plane. So I would assume that Raishan has some idea on how to--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You think? I feel like Raishan would only know how to open up a portal.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, I have a lot of feelings about Raishan.

name: MATT
dialogue: Cassandra speaks up and says, "Well, you've been abroad. You've been gaining arms and allies, "from what you've told me from across Exandria. Let us consolidate our options, our strengths, and "plop it down in front of the Conclave, best we can."

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm no master strategist, but we do have allies that we can call upon, and weapons, and men and arms and troops. However, taking the fight to Thordak in Emon seems foolhardy at best. I suppose this is where the intelligence could come into play. Is there some other place where we could go and try to take back from Thordak, to lure him away from Emon?

name: MATT
dialogue: Asum steps into the conversation and goes, "The thing with that plan is Thordak has amassed "thousands of lizardfolk in Emon at this point that follow his whim. In the nearby mountain ranges, "many from the Stormcrest, that worshipped him the entire time that he was gone. Wyvern riders "originally aided in taking the city that you met, as did I. But since, other allies have found their "way to the Cinder King's sway. Last that I checked, it seemed that there were a number of "allies that he brought over from his time in the Fire Plane as well."

name: LAURA
dialogue: What?!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Fire giants, in the service of the dragon, now walk the streets."

name: SAM
dialogue: So, if we go into Emon, we're facing fire giants, lizard people, and that's before we get to Thordak the Cinder King?

name: LAURA
dialogue: How the fuck are we going to fight him?!

name: MATT
dialogue: "That's what we're discussing today."

name: SAM
dialogue: Does Thordak covet any other territory, or city, or town? Vasselheim? Here? Anywhere that we can lure him to?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Anything he has nostalgic feelings about? Glintshore--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Anything that would piss him off?

name: MATT
dialogue: "You were lucky to draw a creature of such infinitesimal experience and intelligence as a "white dragon away from its home roost. I would be greatly surprised if you had pulled a great, "powerful, intelligent, ancient red dragon from its home turf advantage."

name: LIAM
dialogue: So your prediction is that we have to slog our way through the outskirts of Emon to fight him on his home turf. Is that about the size of it?

name: MATT
dialogue: "That's one way."

name: SAM
dialogue: What's another?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Distract his allies and go straight for the heart. You have allies, like Allura just said, all "throughout the world."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: This is true. We have the Herd, we can go get the werewolves.

name: SAM
dialogue: The Ravenites would help.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Everyone who we ask, everyone who we send in there, we're sending in to their death.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: This is war.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, but it's either death now or death a little later.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We're sending ourselves as well.

name: LIAM
dialogue: So, are we talking about sending everyone we know and everything we have to the outskirts of town--

name: SAM
dialogue: For a full frontal attack. While we bamf into the dragon's lair.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah. We create a massive fucking clusterfuck on the edge of his periphery and we go for the center.

name: LAURA
dialogue: How long did it take you, Allura, to create that heart?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well. The design and the development and enchantment of it are powerful enough to anchor "itself to the soul of a dragon of Thordak's strength. Better part of six months."

name: LIAM, LAURA
dialogue: Six months.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We've probably got a week or two.

name: MATT
dialogue: "And that was with a dozen other hands helping me. Most of the Arcana Pansophical was at "my side for that and we don't have that kind of time."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, we take a day or two and we amass every heavy fucking hitter we have, and we do this. What other choice do we have?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I keep thinking back to Emon where we watched half of our friends die in a second.

name: LIAM
dialogue: A lot of us are going to die.

name: MATT
dialogue: Cassandra sits up a little bit in her seat and goes, "If we are smart about this, we can "minimize the casualties far more now than they would be a week, two weeks, a month, a year from now."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I agree.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: What of Whitestone? We put the city at great risk. How much risk are we willing to take?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Percy, everywhere is at great risk right now.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's true.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We should leave Whitestone.

name: SAM
dialogue: But even getting to Emon, aren't we exposing ourselves to detection and attack?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We are if we wait.

name: SAM
dialogue: We're going to march several armies across the entire continent to get there? It'll take days.

name: LAURA
dialogue: How do we get armies there?

name: LIAM
dialogue: We're going to take a day or two. We're going to figure out how to get who we have to where we need. We're not doing this tomorrow. In a couple of days. Three days. Four days at the most. It's not ideal, but it's what we have to do.

name: SAM
dialogue: We can at least move people to, you know. Where's that town that was established?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Outside of Westruun?

name: MATT
dialogue: There's Westruun, Kymal were the two that you moved--

name: SAM
dialogue: Westruun is close-ish, right, to Emon?

name: MATT
dialogue: Westruun's a little bit further than Kymal is. Kymal is where you sent a lot of the Westruun refugees.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Right.

name: LAURA
dialogue: But they're just townsfolk.

name: SAM
dialogue: But we can at least assemble there, from all the different territories, and then meet up, form a plan, and then march from there.

name: LAURA
dialogue: March on Emon? If we gather our forces, Thordak will notice.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, we've got to do a lot of recon before then. But I think he's got a good point, right? We've got to have like a staging point.

name: MATT
dialogue: Cassandra turns, looks over to Asum and goes, "Recon, actually. Anything else, Asum, you "may have in regards to what we can expect there?" Asum is still slowly walking around the peripheral of the meeting table. "I can tell you that most of the city's wealth and resources, as well as "caches, sealed arcane relics, and weaponry, long held by the Lyceum or the arms of Emon, have been "stolen and thrown atop the victory hoard of Thordak. Most who are part of this rebellion "within the city are doing so with scraps. That is why the Clasp has been so instrumental in the "removal of many of the oppressed folk within the city. Also, the fire that marks Thordak's presence "that have drawn fire and molten rock across the city, as well as the outskirts of the city walls, "scar the landscape and fill the sky with sulfurous clouds and black smoke. The good news is that "smoke can be utilized, should someone have some control over the elements, to be a screen. "However, where the Cloudtop District once stood, there is now but a heated cauldron of glowing "stone and flame. Hundreds of gifts and statues left in Thordak's image litter the outer area, "while a massive cavern dives beneath the central region of the district. Now this cavern, as we've "watched it, we believe it to be the location of Thordak's treasure vault. As well as the "occasional sleeping place of the massive drake we speak of. Thordak is also showing rather intense "signs of physical change since being released from his prison. And his size still remains enormous by "comparison. His eyes now burn with a searing white light. Burning stars in the sky. His jaw ever "dribbles with burning liquid that blackens the ground it touches. The gaps between scales appear "to flare bright with each breath, like a star engine beneath the scales."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (sneezes) Sorry.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Bless you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah. Sorry.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Do you think it's overtaking him?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I've no idea. Allura?" And Allura goes, "Well, if the anchor was indeed removed from the "Fire Elemental Plane, then Thordak would have had his soul torn from his body. That is how the "anchor worked."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So you don't think he actually even fully separated from the plane, he brought the plane with him.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Or at least, maybe a piece. I wasn't there, I don't know the ritual that brought him over."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Maybe then we're looking at this the wrong way. Maybe we go at this through the Fire Plane. Maybe there's something still there.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: A way to sever his connection to the Fire Plane, maybe.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: Allura thinks for a second.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We've got an easy door in.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I could try. But the enchantment itself-- We don't have enough information. It wasn't bound "to a specific place in the plane, it was bound to the plane itself. I don't know how you'd sever it "from the other side."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: From the other side, we'd have to go there.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's called thinking outside the circle.

name: SAM
dialogue: But then once we're there, what do we do?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And we don't even know where to look. I mean, we could at least talk to the Ashari there. They might--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Another ally.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Is there like nothing friendly in the Fire Plane?

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's at least as big as Tal'Dorei. I mean, it's another dimension.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's huge.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's huge, but not many people know the whereabouts. There's still locations and destinations within the Fire Plane. It's navigable.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Maybe all the evil things in the Fire Plane are gone right now and they're with Thordak.

name: MATT
dialogue: Asum steps forward to the table, and puts his little halfling hands on the edge and goes, "Well, it's a shame that we don't have any information about this ritual that freed him from "the plane."

name: LAURA
dialogue: That is a shame. A real shame.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'll see if my compatriots can gather information, but in the meantime we'll do the best "we can to gather similar information."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, we know we don't have a lot of time, but do we maybe want to table this and think on it?

name: SAM
dialogue: At the very least, should we send out some letters, alerting our allies that--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Shit's going down.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's time to start stocking up and getting ready to move?

name: MATT
dialogue: Drake steps forward and goes, "I think that's a fine plan of action. Reach out to all "those you brought in. Hopefully we can get a few of our friends in this as well."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Did an airship ever arrive?

name: MATT
dialogue: They all look at each other, a bit confused. "No."

name: LAURA
dialogue: An airship? Did anyone see an airship flying around?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I didn't see one." And Cassandra goes, "No. There hasn't been an airship here, no. Are we "expecting one?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Mm-hmm.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Good to know."

name: SAM
dialogue: The city is invisible.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes, so they won't see us if they come. If we see an airship, do you wish us to flag it down?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: That would be good.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You trust it?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes.

name: LIAM
dialogue: They are a rarity.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right."

name: SAM
dialogue: Maybe come up with a landing point as well.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Now?"

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, soon.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We have one other possible option in front of us. Show them the medal.

name: SAM
dialogue: No, thank you.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You're not going to show them the medal? Not that, no! No, not that. Please don't whip that out, no one wants to see that.

name: SAM
dialogue: No, not the cube.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We have another ally that we have spoken of.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's a tenuous ally at best. Maybe we shouldn't discuss it until we're 100% sure about it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, that's a big maybe. That's a big maybe. Yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, they're very busy though.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, it's really far away and, then as we were leaving, the people that we talked to about it--

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's fine, I get it! Reach out to your people on one end."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I slowly walk around the table, thinking hard about it. And I stab Seeker Asum three times in the back with my sword.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Let's fucking do this shit! Let's do it! Let's do it!

name: LAURA
dialogue: But we need to know the ritual!

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's too late, he did it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (yelling) Yeah!

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh Percy, no.

name: MATT
dialogue: Go ahead and roll--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's a surprise attack.

name: MATT
dialogue: I know it is.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh god, why? We're in crazy costumes.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Check out the brain on Brad.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We've got Allura and Gilmore, and Drake.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We have a lot of people in the room.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh god.

name: MATT
dialogue: Go ahead and roll. Roll the first attack. With advantage.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We're in a room.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Whitestone's about to be destroyed.

name: SAM
dialogue: And Raishan's about to leave.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Oh man, he's not making you roll stealth, motherfucker.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Why would he? He doesn't--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Because I would. And Hotis did on me.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's different.

name: LIAM
dialogue: No it's not.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's 29.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. As you pull the blade out of the hilt to go ahead and begin to strike-- You're a quick individual. You're also in the presence of an entity that does not trust anyone or anything. You take the blade and swing out in the direction of Seeker Asum. And where your blade strikes, it shimmers through the image. There's a flash, and Asum is suddenly four feet away from the position where Asum was standing. At which point, everyone in the room stands up immediately and is like, "Whoa whoa!" Cassandra goes over and puts her hand towards you, and Asum is taking a few steps back and is like (breathes heavily).

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No tricks in here. No tricks in here, if we're really going to do this.

name: MATT
dialogue: There's this moment of extreme quiet, tension, as Allura's looking at you, looking at Asum, looking around. And there's like this slow, connecting moment of realization throughout the room as everyone's eyes go wide.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: If we're really going to do this, no tricks in here.

name: MATT
dialogue: And with that, we're going to take a break. (screaming)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Amazing!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Taliesin!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Don't trust a man who just kissed somebody! That's a man who's saying fuck it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Backpedal, backpedal, backpedal!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm into it. I'm really into it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes, we know, darling. We know.

name: MATT
dialogue: All righty. Well, we'll go ahead and take a short break here, guys. We'll be back here in a few minutes. And we'll (Victor voice) see what happens next! (normal voice) All right. See you guys here in a minute. [break] Welcome back, everyone, to Critical Role. When we last left off, Clarota, over here-- Let us all marvel at that! (cheering)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It was me all along!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh god. Are you going to leave that on the whole time?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh hell no! I can't see or hear a thing.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It was so short-lived.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Three seconds of costume, that's all you get! (laughter)

name: SAM
dialogue: You can't put just this part on?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, it's really uncomfortable!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Just the helmet?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Do the frigging helmet. I had my arm behind my back for two hours!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Why would you do that?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Commitment!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I have so many guns in my belt! No one can even see them, and I'm still committed.

name: SAM
dialogue: I painted my entire body.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: What is wrong with you people?

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's good. You're good now.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I can't really claim sanity. I just did something mind-bendingly stupid.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You now look like one of your own bullets. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: You have a very Merlin from Excalibur thing going on there right now.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: A dream to some, a nightmare to others. (laughter) Oh, like lightning! Yes!

name: MATT
dialogue: We need more green lights in here to really get the effect.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Go see Excalibur. Not right now, but tomorrow.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right! So, bringing it back in. As your blade swings through and passes through the form of Seeker Asum, it shimmers and then darts backward into the corner of the room.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I immediately sheath and say: No more tricks. If we're going to do this, we need everybody to know what's on the table.

name: MATT
dialogue: At which point, everyone who stood up and held off at the chaos, you see all the faces going off in realization. Asum goes from a defensive position and then stands up again. Crosses the arms.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We're either going to win, or we're not. I was hoping you were going to take care of that.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We're working on that plan as we speak. But pardon me if I take a few-- how do you say-- "careful backups in case one would take a blade and stab at an ally, supposedly."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You know damn well that we're not allies. You know damn well that this is a tenuous relationship. And you know that neither of us trust the other.

name: MATT
dialogue: At which point, Allura puts her hand out and goes, "I'm sorry. What the hell is going on here?!"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We'll get there. I would hope that you wouldn't trust us, and I would hope that you understand that we don't trust you. But we need to make a real plan now.

name: MATT
dialogue: As the tension slowly subsides, Gilmore puts his finger up, "Pardon my momentary ignorance. "Would you like me to cleanse the room?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm hoping for a conversation to start that I promised I wouldn't start myself. I am trying to keep to the letter of my word.

name: SAM
dialogue: It might help if Gilmore were to make sure everyone is on the up-and-up in this room.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Seeker Asum, do you have an opinion on how you would like to proceed?

name: MATT
dialogue: Seeker Asum takes a few steps towards you. Casually looks up to you and goes to pat you on the shoulder. His illusory hand passing through your form. Goes, "I'm quite comfortable where I am "right now. Let us continue this conversation."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The floor is yours if you wish to tell everyone what the real plan is.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Very well! Since my hand has been forced. Hello. Seeker Asum is still back in Emon, dealing "with the difficulty of preparing the current circumstance we're discussing. I am Raishan. "Member of the Conclave. Up until recently, tenuous ally with Thordak the Cinder King, who is now "considered a mutual thorn in all of our sides. I've made an agreement with your Vox Machina for "quite some time. Together, using our combined strengths, we slew Vorugal, the Frigid Doom, over "in Wildemount. We've returned to reconvene. I've provided nothing but honest, upfront, and "necessarily vital information to your victory."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I will confirm everything but "for quite some time" to the room.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I've just been staring at Allura.

name: MATT
dialogue: Allura, you see her fingers are twitching and her arms tense, and there's this very faint air that's blowing her hair ever so slightly, where there's no wind in the air. She's on edge right now and is looking to you guys for guidance, like "Are we doing this?" Cassandra stood up immediately. For the first time in a long time, since Whitestone was reclaimed, Cassandra now resembles more her age than she ever did. She has a look on her face like she's far out of her depth. Understanding the circumstance, there's legitimate fear in her face, and she's looking at Percival with that look of, "What have you done?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Now we can have a real conversation about what's going on. We have an ally on the inside, albeit an untrustworthy one. You'll pardon that, but there's every possibility that this is an elaborate trap. I respect your intelligence far too much to try and pretend otherwise. You understand certainly what I mean? Having this on the table, we now know that there's every possibility that the red dragon knows everything. There's every possibility that we're walking into a trap. Or there's every possibility that we have an insatiably powerful ally. It is a terrible risk.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Or an insatiably powerful enemy.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Also a terrible risk.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Either way, we can now ask about the ritual.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Why don't you inform the room on how you utilized an entire race of people to break the ritual?

name: MATT
dialogue: Everyone's still standing at this point, looking. Cassandra slowly sits down but is still looking between Raishan and Percival. You watch as Asum's form steps towards the center of the room, the flash of green flaring in the eyes with a smile, "The anchor that you speak of was indeed "removed from the Fire Elemental Plane. We discovered that it was indestructible. Good on "you, Allura. Well created. We tried many different ways: rending it, crushing it, sending it "elsewhere without the enchantment tearing Thordak with it. To no avail. In trying to find a way to "bring Thordak through, we needed to bring the soul anchor and the Fire Elemental Plane with it. The "one place where such research could be gathered promptly, fully, was Pyrah. Now, mind you, it was "not my intent for such destruction to rain upon them. I spent many years with them. I got to know "them. They're a fine people. In that time, I learned the ways of temporal travel between "dimensions. The details that allowed me to see the fabric of the Fire Plane, to where we could encase "a bit of it within the soul anchor itself. Once we had managed to crack that essence, I was able to, "from a distance, using the allies at the other end-- Thordak had found friendship with some of the "ousted fire giants. They found comfort outside of the ordning under the shadow of the fire dragon. "In using their deep, rich-blooded past and forging and making, they were able to convert the soul "anchor into something that housed the essence of the Fire Plane. However, we didn't have a means of "creating a hole large enough to bring both through without destroying both in the process. And as "such, we waited for the right time: The Winter's Crest."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You bitch.

name: MATT
dialogue: "To some, maybe. But we called this the Ember Seed. The Ember Seed resides in the center "of this heartstone. That is what is causing Thordak to swell. That is what's driving him mad. "That is what is drawing the very land around Emon to fiery eruption. It is also what keeps his soul "on this plane."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What keeps his soul on this plane?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It keeps the soul intact with his body."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Destroy the stone...

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It can't be destroyed.

name: MATT
dialogue: "In theory. But we've tried. Believe me; we've tried."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And you kept the soul and the stone inside of him?

name: MATT
dialogue: "To remove it would destroy him as well, as the Arcana Pansophical saw fit. So yes, both came "through. Waited for the Winter's Crest, had enough power and understanding of the ritual to open the "entirety of the tear, and Thordak screamed through, flames in his wake. And he laid waste "to your people, not I."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No. You used me. You used us. And my fear that I had originally appears to be true. A lot of this is my fault. I'm willing to accept my onus. The fact that you can't shows all the kind of person that you are. My promise still stands. I'm thinking it might come sooner rather than later.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You do understand that without my aid, you will not succeed?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I understand that without your aid, none of this would have fucking happened in the first place.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes, and there are quite a few in this room that fall in that category." She looks to Allura and Drake.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So it seems all of us can accept our part in this matter, except for you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I accept my part in this matter as well. You don't think I feel duped by this? You don't "think I have many things I wish to tear from the very corpse of that entity? You think I don't want "to see him burn as much as you do? This vengeance that burns within me!"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What would you do if you actually got what you want?

name: MATT
dialogue: "What all of us want: freedom."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I pull out the Spire of Conflux. There are always many solutions to many problems. You think Thordak is the only solution to yours? This staff was birthed from the head of Melora, the same goddess who gave you that curse. What if you wanted me instead? Me and this staff. Maybe I can help you more than Thordak can.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Are you saying you understand the way to remove this? That you know the secret to burning "this wretched disease from my form?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm saying I might be your best chance at salvation. I'm pretty sure this staff is the closest living relic that we have in existence to the god who granted your curse. Thordak is no god. That was your first stupid mistake.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think if I might translate. What my friend here is trying to relate is that, perhaps when the dust has settled, your salvation may either be found in the withering corpse or cackling smile of a creature that you are subservient to, who will take great delight in your destruction. Or perhaps in those you've aided who will feel grateful.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's up to you, Raishan.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And I will advise her to take no revenge until all cards are on the table.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well. Good."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Clearly you are the type of person who looks for answers in other people. You are clearly unaware of accepting any fault or any result of your actions. Why don't you start fresh? Do you really want Thordak to have another sway over you? Another gift, another favor, that he's given you? That he is going to hold over you for all of eternity? Do you really want that? You're stronger than that.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That's why we're working to watch him fall."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Are we?

name: MATT
dialogue: (chuckles) "If you need not my help, just let me know."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh no, Raishan. We don't need your help. Let me say that right now. This all depends on what you want out of the end of the deal.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I wish to be given unfettered, unbothered, unwatched control over the corpse upon his death "to extract the information I need. I will leave your very sphere of existence and understanding "until the end of your days."

name: LIAM
dialogue: What happens if we say no to that?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh, then I'll find another way."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Spoiler alert: we're saying no to that.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Unfettered I'm fine with. It's unwatched--

name: MATT
dialogue: "Then watch! Watch, for all I care. It will be Greek to you anyway."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: She's taken way too much. She doesn't get to leave!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: She's already left.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, I walk over around the table towards Asum. I try and poke her in the shoulder. Him.

name: MATT
dialogue: It passes through the form.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: This is the deal that we are offered. This is the deal that's on the table. We are in a tenuous position of power.

name: SAM
dialogue: You can stop poking, Grog.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: She's not here!

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's crazy.

name: SAM
dialogue: Give her one more good poke.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: How do we get in contact with you when we know when we move and how?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, what is your next step through your journey?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That is the question. Now that everything's on the table, I'm sorry to shock everyone. I was hoping not to be the cause of it. I was hoping that it was time for everything to be on the table. But this is actually what we're dealing with. This is the complexity. This is the battlefield.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: So we have to rally our forces to us, and we have to do some really smart recon. Do we make her a part of that or no?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, the more distance that we keep, the better.

name: SAM
dialogue: From her?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes. She will probably be, I imagine, in our way on occasion.

name: LIAM
dialogue: But no one make any mistake. She's lying to our faces. She is not telling us what she wants or what she wants to do. You have a whole plan!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Assume what you will."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Shut the fuck up! You've been droning on for an hour! Shut the fuck up. You're not telling us what you want. You fucking shit bag. Fuck you!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Keep great company."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Does anyone really believe that this is all going to be fixed if we work with her?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I say we take a recess. Gather our thoughts. Raishan, my offer still stands. If you want to come and find me, I know you know how. Maybe we can commune with Melora together.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You do not comprehend the magics that you even speak of. It's cute. Look, I agree. Distance "is of aid to us at the moment. If anything, I should probably cut off the information of "Vorugal's fall. I should speak with the Cinder King and still establish my allegiance from his "perspective."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Can you cut off that information? I would imagine that would be far too much.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Cut it off, no. But I can attempt to guide the fury, if you will."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Will he know it was us?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I can guarantee it."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Can you keep him from attacking Whitestone?

name: MATT
dialogue: "For a time, maybe."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can you guide his fury in a way that would be beneficial to the plan?

name: MATT
dialogue: "If I knew what the plan was, yes."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You were saying ideally, if we could get him away?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't think we're going to get him away--

name: SAM
dialogue: We're going to do recon. We're going to send out word to gather our forces-- where?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: What if he knew where we were?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We don't know yet.

name: SAM
dialogue: Let's find out, let's pick a place.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: What if you knew where we were? What if we found a place? We pick our battleground. He discovers where we're hiding.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And Raishan rats us out.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And Raishan discovers this information.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Would certainly put you in the good graces of the Cinder King.

name: MATT
dialogue: Raishan takes a moment and thinks.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You are searching for us right now, are you not?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I am indeed, but Thordak has been using us as the attack."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, he's not going to leave his nest.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So what if we kill you?

name: MATT
dialogue: "What do you mean?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: How does Thordak know you're alive?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Because I check in every now and then to remind him."

name: LAURA
dialogue: What if he sends you out, and we kill you?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And you never come back? He'd be forced to be the one to have to leave the battlefield.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: If he knew where you were headed.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You're a clever girl. I'm sure you can make a ruse to make you look convincingly dead.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You wouldn't even have to tell us where you were hiding. You could just hide. And we could ready ourselves.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That is an idea. Hmm. Take your recess. I'll take mine. There may be something to this plot."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And we can all assume that when we exit this room, that our tenuous alliance is still that. Correct?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I would hope that there's no more errant blade pokery?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Now that I know your tricks.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We do it to everyone. Don't worry.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We actually do, now that I think about it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, that's kind of true.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We're also not alone here. Allura, how does this sit with you?

name: MATT
dialogue: Allura is sitting right now, she's listening to everything with her hands crossed. Shakes her head and goes, "To be perfectly honest, this bothers me a great deal. But the fact that "Whitestone still stands does speak volumes at the least."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It does.

name: MATT
dialogue: "With the cards being in our favor."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's not the first devil I've made a deal with.

name: MATT
dialogue: "No."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Doesn't always turn out well, Percival.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Doesn't always turn out terribly, either.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Regardless, I have a lot to think about. As do we all." And Allura slowly turns her head and looks up, probably for the first time since she sat down, to the illusory Raishan's Asum form. "Asum lives, then?" "Indeed he does. Indeed he does." And Allura turns her head back and goes--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can I do an insight check?

name: MATT
dialogue: Go for it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Does she know if Asum is up to something no good? 25, I think? Better double check that. 25.

name: MATT
dialogue: 25? Okay. It's hard to read the demeanor of Raishan in general. It's this middle ground of neutral expression with a half-cocked grin. Information flows at this consistent rate of being generally difficult to read. The beat of hesitation is meant for emphasis, more than covering, if that makes any sense. So it seems to have an honesty to it, if you could read any honesty from Raishan.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Raishan, now that we know you're you, do you have to continue the ruse of being Asum, or can you bring him here?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I can certainly bring him here if you'd like. However, he is doing quite a lot of good "with the Clasp, and Brom and Tofor underneath Emon right now, and they've managed to "save many lives and continue to do so."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Maybe you could pop him over then? Just for a little bit.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well--"

name: LAURA
dialogue: You're quite powerful.

name: MATT
dialogue: "What do you have need for Asum?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: I want to hear what's going on with the Clasp. I want to see for myself that he's alive.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We're actually going to have to have a conversation with the Clasp, because we're going to purge the city once the dragon is gone.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Why don't you go see him yourself?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, I like her idea. I want to see him here.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah. I feel a little better here. It would go a long way to earning some trust.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, make your choice. Either I intercept and begin to work towards Thordak's ruse and set "a space that convinces him perhaps I've fallen into your hands, or I go retrieve your friend from "Emon. I'm not your errand boy, and we have a limited time here. Which is more important?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Sure you are. You are our errand boy. We are your vessel to what it is you want. So get busy, and do it quickly. After all, you're very powerful. But that changes day by day, doesn't it?

name: MATT
dialogue: "So, Emon it is. Very well. Back in a day."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We will start figuring out and discussing a place for the final battle. We will find a place that is advantageous. Your input, if you feel the urge to give it, is always welcome. At least to me.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's going to be very difficult to pry the Cinder King from his nest."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Your supposed death will go far for that.

name: MATT
dialogue: "If anything, but I have no guarantees."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: As long as everything is on the up and up, and as long as we do not catch you in deep deceit.

name: LIAM
dialogue: (whispers) Good luck with that.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We will make sure that the plan moves in the direction it is meant to.

name: MATT
dialogue: "One day then."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: One day.

name: MATT
dialogue: And the image (disappearing noise).

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: He's going to send Asum to us.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: So Allura, so it's clear: Seeker Asum is Raishan.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And has been since Raishan's appearance in Whitestone.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And we didn't know until 48 hours ago? Tops?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Now, can we maybe make sure that everybody in the room is who they say they are?

name: SAM
dialogue: Go stab everyone, Percy. One at a time.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you say that, everyone pulls back from the table.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm a dragon too! (evil laugh)

name: LIAM
dialogue: Hi. Larkin.

name: MATT
dialogue: There he is!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I apologize. I didn't know what else to do.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You thought you were going to stab him!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes you did, Percival.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That was not a play!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, let's be real about it. "No tricks in this room!"

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, you shifted gears very quickly there.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No tricks.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I've told no lies in this room.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Uh-huh.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (fake cough) Whiff!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I tell that creature no lies. Ever. That is a green dragon. There is no tricking it, there is no deceiving it. There is just telling as much truth as you can get away with.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you're talking, you feel a tug on your right arm. And you look over and you see Cassandra, who has come over to your side and is pulling on your sleeve with a very intense look in her eye. She goes, "Percival. I can watch Whitestone. I can get the people fed. I can keep "the people armed. I can organize the day to day. I can't keep it safe from that."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Which is why I would ask everyone to please not antagonize it.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Percival. Percival! I don't know what you dragged us into in this, but I need you to pull us "out of it. I can't do this."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I've moved the battle. That is the best that I know how.

name: MATT
dialogue: "How long have you known?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Two days.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Not long, Cassandra.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Two days.

name: SAM
dialogue: Maybe three.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We were forced.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The day before we left to kill the white dragon.

name: SAM
dialogue: There's a time difference.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And if we had told any of you, your life would have been in danger.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: This was the best way I knew to keep her from destroying this city outright. This was the best way that kept her from telling the red dragon where we are. And the longer that we can keep her a tenuous ally, the longer Whitestone will stand.

name: SAM
dialogue: When she does come back with Asum, this plan that we started in on-- it's a good one?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think so.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, we have Raishan convince Thordak that we're amassing forces in Kymal or something. Thordak sends Raishan to get us. We "kill" Raishan.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Mm-hmm.

name: SAM
dialogue: And then Thordak comes to check on our dead bodies?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We send word of a dead dragon.

name: SAM
dialogue: How can that plan fail?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I mean, I'm not the only one who thinks she's more dangerous than he is at this point.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh yes. I think if we give her access to Thordak's body afterwards, we're asking for a lot of trouble.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Which is why if Keyleth can figure out a way to cure her of this disease, it takes a big card off the table.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We've got 24 hours.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I have ideas.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We have more than that, because it's going to take quite a while. That's how long we have to make a plan.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Question. What if we do actually just kill her?

name: SAM
dialogue: Raishan?

name: LAURA
dialogue: When we fake that we're killing her, what if we kill her?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Just actually kill her?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: She's going to be expecting that, and it will not work.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: And she's super slippery. She just totally like evaded Percy's sneak stabby-stab.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Is there anyone around right now?

name: MATT
dialogue: Oh yeah, no. Allura, Drake--

name: LIAM
dialogue: 20, natural 20! For perception.

name: MATT
dialogue: For perception?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah. I said, "Is anyone around?" and I rolled a 20.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys are still in the war room.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I know, but you know what I'm talking about. You know what I'm talking about.

name: MATT
dialogue: Oh!

name: LIAM
dialogue: There it is, it's right there. Invisible fucking Larkin dwarf dragon.

name: MATT
dialogue: You don't see anybody else around.

name: LIAM
dialogue: All right. That's a 20.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Should we continue this conversation downstairs?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: First, is everybody who they say they are? Please, if you would be so kind.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh yeah, Allura. Can we light your sage real quick, make sure everybody's on the up and up?

name: MATT
dialogue: Allura sits up and says, "Well, I mean, it makes sense. Asum is the one that requested we not "move the war room down to the--"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: So why don't we move the war room now?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I think that would be the best, yes. Let us all adjourn to the new space at the ziggurat. That "should at least keep things honest."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: Allura picks her robes up and--

name: SAM
dialogue: Grog, your beard might go away.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (gasps) No!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, it's in there.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It just won't grow while he's down there.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I mean for science, right? Let's go. You look really good without a beard, Grog. I've always thought so.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You shut up, you. (laughter) We can go down there, I don't care.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: All right.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. You guys make your way down to the ziggurat. The guards come and start carrying chairs and other elements of the war room. Eventually, you're all led down through the tunnels, which have been a little more refined and given an actual more comfortable path past the now-defunct whitestone refinery that the Briarwoods had originally established. You enter the ziggurat room. It has more lighting to it than it previously did. A number of torches now line the walls, the sconces that are lit as the guards progress upward. You can see the reflection to the green glass-like Whitestone material that permeates the outside of the ziggurat. And not right by it, but partially upward there's a small wooden platform that's been where the main base of operations for research and study is here. You see a number of desks set out. It's been built alongside of the large pyramid-type structure. And eventually, you all adjourn up into that space. As you go up there, you all feel a significant drop in enchantment. All of your magical items, all of everything, gradually fades in this space. So, Grog, you actually feel your musculature-- the Titanstone Gauntlets themselves, the effect begins to completely fade back to your classic, Grog-like strength.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I feel totally fine.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Are the walls still like people?

name: MATT
dialogue: Oh, do you want to go to the top of the ziggurat and check?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Not yet. After the meeting.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Did they have like a clean-up crew down there?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's a guy on a scaffold with a scrub brush going, "Ew. Ew."

name: LAURA
dialogue: They're really clean naked bodies now.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Brush cleaning out the fingernails.

name: MATT
dialogue: At this point, they're looking around. Everyone who's journeyed with you towards this new meeting place, the ziggurat, is of the same physicality they were at the meeting room. Any illusions that would have been cast aside or dispelled at this point seem to not be present. So everyone is, by all intents and purposes, who they say they are.

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And this also means it would probably be impossible to scry in this room.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: Allura nods. "Yes, actually. Yes."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Excellent. This is where all talk must happen now.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Where it should have been happening.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: So now you know what we've been dealing with for the past 72 hours. She did help with the death of that dragon. In fact, I doubt we would have survived without her aid. She could have very easily left us there to die.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's true. She actually revealed her entire form during the battle. Which is quite diseased.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: At least it appeared diseased.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: She's definitely not as strong as the others, but far more clever.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And she knows where we are. And what our plans are. And every inch of this place. Including this thing.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well then, what do you presume we do?"

name: SAM
dialogue: We don't really have a choice, we have to work with her to some extent. We can make it hard for her, and we can be assholes to her, and go tell her to get Asum for us. But other than that, we have to work with her.

name: LIAM
dialogue: What's the benefit of working with her?

name: SAM
dialogue: Because if we don't, she can destroy Whitestone whenever she feels like it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: What if we tell her we're going to fake her death, and then we kill her for real?

name: SAM
dialogue: That's fine, if she ever gets close enough for us to kill her.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: She's not going to.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: She evaded it really easy.

name: SAM
dialogue: Why would she need to come face to face with us in that plan, ever? She could say, "I'm going "to go meet them in Kymal. Oh, I died!"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Our best bet is maybe-- hopefully enough of us still have our strength. Maybe at the end if she has been ravaged by the red dragon.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I agree.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And then we try to defeat her after that?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I agree. Our play is the finish line. That's it. Not a moment before.

name: LAURA
dialogue: But we have to beat her to it. If she gets a hold of that stone--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's what she wants.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Our hope is to break the stone.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We can't break the stone.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Only because no one has.

name: SAM
dialogue: If we draw Thordak to us, at least we control the battlefield. She could still be lying in wait to pounce on his body the second we kill him.

name: LIAM
dialogue: If. We have to hope that she's actually going to fight with us. She's done it once. We don't know that she's going to do it again. We don't know.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: They mentioned moving the stone that shouldn't have been able to have been moved. Correct? They moved it inside of Thordak, and then Thordak left with the stone in him, right?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes, which I don't think should have been possible.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Right. So how did they do it? Because I'm also looking at another thing that is supposedly immovable.

name: LAURA, MARISHA, TALIESIN
dialogue: Supposedly.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, it's possible. Nothing is impossible.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Are you suggesting we put the vortex of doom inside one of us?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Kind of, yeah. That's what I was--

name: MATT
dialogue: Allura immediately puts her hands up and goes, "No! No. No. No."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: There's got to be a way to move it.

name: SAM
dialogue: To do what, though?

name: MATT
dialogue: "This is an absence of magic. It is a void of magic. It is a maw that devours magic. The "enchantment that we put within Thordak is pure magic."

name: LIAM
dialogue: And you've been working on it for months, and you are smarter than us.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Right. No way to transport it? None at all?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It could be the only thing that could break the stone!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Think about it. If we could get that stone next to the vortex, he'd be fucked.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Right! So what, we take a few wooden two by fours and push it along? Look, everything I know, "everything I've studied, everything I've spent my entire life working for is useless near that."

name: LAURA
dialogue: This is a temple to Ioun, right?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It was."

name: LAURA
dialogue: The goddess of knowledge?

name: SAM
dialogue: Sure.

name: MATT
dialogue: "The only person I know of who rightfully worshipped Ioun was Brom."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Brom?

name: SAM
dialogue: Of the Clasp?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Arbiter Brom. He was of the council with us."

name: LAURA
dialogue: And he's in Emon, potentially?

name: MATT
dialogue: "According to Raishan. With Tofor and--"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Brom's with Asum?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: What holds it there? It's a shame we can't open a giant door and push it down here.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What did you just say?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We can't do it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What? Say it again, one more time?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's a shame we can't open a giant door and push the dragon in here.

name: SAM
dialogue: How on earth could we--?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We couldn't do it. It won't work. Because that side of the door won't open by its very nature. No door can be opened to this room. No one can get in or out without someone walking.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You couldn't have used the gate scroll in here.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm trying to even conceive of a machine that could move this. But I don't understand why it's here in the first place.

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't think the secret to defeating Thordak is moving this thing.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's a shame we couldn't. We have a line in the sand of how close we can get to this thing with magic, correct?

name: MATT
dialogue: "This way." And she leads you back down the ziggurat, out to the entrance where you guys entered this large chamber. And about 20 or so meters back, you can see there is a specific wooden support beam that is structured within this tunnel. And on that beam, elements of it are painted black. And she goes, "This is the perimeter in which the siphon devours magic "inward."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: How big is it? How big is it, roughly?

name: MATT
dialogue: What, the--?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Perimeter.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'd say it'd take a half-mile?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Damn, this place is really big. And it's encased in stone, yeah? Kind of, right? Were we encased in whitestone? Right?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: In stone. I've got a terrible idea.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Tell me!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: What happens to magical creatures when they enter the circle? Have we experimented at all to find out what would happen to a magical creature? A creature whose very essence is magic?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't know."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (sighs) There's no humane way to do this.

name: SAM
dialogue: Sure there is! Kiki, get a fey creature in here.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, that's what I was thinking, send him in.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh yeah, they die and they go right back to their plane.

name: SAM
dialogue: No, I think they just die.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And even if they do go back to their plane, they may not be able to in there, they may wither and actually die. I just wanted to put that on the table.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Are you trying to make me feel better about any of this?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't want to lie to you about this. I've been practicing intense levels of honesty, if not telling the whole truth.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Sidebar. Do we have all the Vestiges that the sphinx told us about?

name: SAM
dialogue: No.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What else is there?

name: SAM
dialogue: There's one in the Fire Plane.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Something for Pickle.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: The Dawn Martyr. Dawn Martyr?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I know I'm not the smartest one in the group, but we don't know what the fuck we're talking about with this little sphere. Why don't we go find that last Vestige and see what it turns up?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I don't know if we have a lot of time--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We have time. In a day.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I mean, only if we--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: In a day she returns. We chose a place, we move our forces in there. We have days where she could be looking for us, and then when she disappears it's going to take a day or two for him to really find out. It will be about three to four days before anything actually happens.

name: SAM
dialogue: What are we doing, going after this Vestige when-- can any of us even use it?

name: MARISHA, LAURA
dialogue: Pike.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well, I can. Kima might. I'm not much for poetry, but it seems sort of poetic that Thordak came from the Fire Plane, and the last Vestige we're looking for is in the Fire Plane.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Also, we might be able to find some information on the stone.

name: LAURA
dialogue: This is true.

name: SAM
dialogue: The Fire Plane isn't just like Dallas.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It actually is quite like Dallas. I think that's a very reasonable comparison.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's a horrible place where we could all die.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well, so was the Feywild, and we didn't--

name: SAM
dialogue: We're risking our hides for something that might benefit one of us, maybe.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, that's what we've been doing this entire time.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's basically all of our choices at this point.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We could go in with the rest of the Fire Ashari that are there. We can meet up with Cerkonos. Is this whole ziggurat encased in whitestone?

name: MATT
dialogue: The ziggurat itself is built from stone, and then the upper exterior of it is covered in this green glass-like substance that is distilled whitestone residuum.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I have a plan. It will take a little bit of time, but it's vicious.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It probably wouldn't work. Well, let's find out what happens to a creature inside here before we--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: A regular creature or a Feywild creature?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay, I actually do have Conjure Woodland Beings.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's not a magic creature though, it's a woodland being.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No, woodland beings can be like fey creatures.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Really?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Mm-hmm.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Something small.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Do it! Oh my god, do it!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Just a fairy. Just a teeny little fairy.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: What level's that? That is--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Third level.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Wait, if you like conjure it outside and walk in, is it going to go poof and disappear?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Potentially. We'll find out.

name: MATT
dialogue: A fourth level, you mean.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Sorry, fourth level.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, so you can create some fey creatures, yeah. What are you summoning?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What makes sense?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What's going to squeal?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We're on one side of the line. Send it to the other, see what happens.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'll summon a--

name: SAM
dialogue: Little pixie!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: A little-- (stutters) A little pixie.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (copying Marisha) Lalittle lilittle li-- A little pixie.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: A lillul lillul pixie.

name: SAM
dialogue: Hi, little pixie! Go in that room!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: This may be, by the way, how we deal with Raishan.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What?

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. So you conjure a pixie?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Sure. And I send her in.

name: MATT
dialogue: Pixie flies in. Continues to fly in. Nothing happens.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Pixie's fine?

name: MATT
dialogue: Pixie seems fine.

name: SAM
dialogue: Pixie's not a magical creature, I guess.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Isn't it, though?

name: SAM
dialogue: Has magic, maybe. Isn't a magical being.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Can you make the pixie do something? Try and have the pixie do something magical.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah. I have them. Can't they cast like Confusion or something like that? Or can they cast--?

name: SAM
dialogue: Polymorph.

name: MATT
dialogue: They can cast Confusion, they can cast Polymorph, they can cast things like that.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Hey! Try and Polymorph me!

name: MATT
dialogue: Pixie turns around and nothing happens.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Nothing?

name: MATT
dialogue: Pixie looks confused. "What? Sorry."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's all right, you did very well. How do you feel? Do you feel all right?

name: MATT
dialogue: Technically, this pixie--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Touch it.

name: MATT
dialogue: We'll say for the purposes of this, sure. There is very basic communication. The pixie is--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Tinkerbell.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, Sylvan is the language that it speaks, so it is close enough to Elvish that those who speak Elvish can like interpret elements of it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, I know Sylvan. I know Sylvan. Hey! How do you feel?

name: MATT
dialogue: "A little queasy, that's all."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Queasy? Yeah?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's weird."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Hmm. Hey, will you do me a favor and don't hold it against me?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Why don't you let it leave?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Just go do it! Just do it!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Will you go touch that black orb?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No no no, don't do that!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah yeah yeah, go touch it. She meant what she said.

name: MATT
dialogue: I mean, she's only listening to her, so--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, it doesn't matter what Percy says.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Do it. Fucking do it.

name: SAM
dialogue: Let's see if it goes to the other world.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You don't know where it goes.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's right, I don't know.

name: LIAM
dialogue: No, you don't know what she's talking about. It's Esperanto.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You don't speak Sylvan.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I've already done my dumb stuff for the day.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Stab stab stab.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It would've been so badass!

name: MATT
dialogue: All right, so yeah. You continue to walk as the pixie floats up towards the top of the ziggurat. You get to the top and you notice that no, all the bodies have been removed. It's been cleaned up.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's just an empty pyramid-y thing now.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, it's like this empty platform now with the walls, encased within a small colosseum. And there it is, the general spinning black marble. The pixie approaches and like--

name: LAURA, TALIESIN
dialogue: (whines worriedly)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah! Yeah. You got this.

name: MATT
dialogue: Touches it, and you watch the pixie go-- and is gone.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Hmm. So as we expected, yeah.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well, hold on. Wait.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Wait.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I don't think she's coming back, yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Hey Allura, how many things did you throw in the orb?

name: MATT
dialogue: You see her in the back leaning against the wall like she's seen this a hundred times. "Oh, "many things. Chairs, outfits, pieces of stone, metals. We've put all kinds of things."

name: SAM
dialogue: Any animals?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Anything alive?

name: MATT
dialogue: "No, nothing living!"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What was the biggest thing you put in there?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Your desk chair. Cassandra said it would be all right."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (sighs) Yes.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Have you put a box around it? Just encapsulated it completely?

name: MATT
dialogue: "We tried, and upon moving it, once it contacted it did not move with the box. It just "crushed and absorbed the box itself."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: So. I have an interesting request which may end up being too complicated. I'm not sure.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Probably.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Can we build a teleportation sigil directly above it? Outside of its range?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Given the better part of a year, yes."

name: LIAM
dialogue: So you're saying there's a chance?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Can we build one in the hallway leading to this room?

name: MATT
dialogue: "A temporary one, as in like a--"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Like a spell.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Like a brief spell, yes. I can do that now. It's the permanent installation of one that takes "an exorbitant period of time."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: As long as we have some way of knowing what point at which we re-enter this room. Then we at least have a way of having it chase us into its range.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh man.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Or better still, if we run one way and it runs the other.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Have you been in contact? Have you attempted to scry, or do a Locate Object spell on anything that you've thrown in? Probably?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes, but unfortunately there's been no way of connecting anything that goes through. It just "vanishes."

name: SAM
dialogue: I think that's a fucking terrible idea.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (chanting) Fire Plane.

name: SAM
dialogue: What are you talking about? We can't lure a dragon into a teleportation circle big enough to get a dragon through, and then somehow assume that the dragon's going to keep running into the room with no magic? And then what are we also going to assume? That it's going to jump into the crazy Vecna circle and become a ninth level of hell after that? We have no idea! That's a terrible idea! I'm vetoing it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I third that.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The cereal shiller has a point.

name: LIAM
dialogue: That idea's not grrreat! (laughter)

name: LAURA
dialogue: You've been waiting! Waiting to find a time to say it, haven't you?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Nope! Just drunkenly popped in my head.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes, Grog. You have a point?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Fire Plane.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: If we are going to do the Fire Plane, if that is going to happen, then we cannot go until preparations start getting made for the place at which we're going to have this confrontation. We need to pick a point, preferably far from here. Is there a ruined city?

name: SAM
dialogue: What, for us to lure Raishan-slash-Thordak to?

name: LAURA
dialogue: What about Fort Daxio?

name: SAM
dialogue: Fort Daxio's near Emon. And so is Kymal.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, it's north of Emon. Kymal's east of it. And the Ironsea Ridge. But Kymal's filled "with civilians."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Fort Daxio has an army gathering there already, right?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, Fort Daxio has a piece of an army. Most of it went to Syngorn and we haven't heard since."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Fort Daxio at least does have soldiers already.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, Syngorn is gathering their forces as well.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Have you reached out to Syngorn, let them know this was going to happen? You mentioned that "they were coming to power?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: We have.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, we need to reach out to the resources we have and call them in."

name: LAURA, LIAM
dialogue: Yes.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Everyone, is Fort Daxio where this confrontation is going to happen?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We haven't been to Fort Daxio.

name: SAM
dialogue: We should probably go check it out. But everyone wants to go to the Fire Plane, get some armor.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We go to Fort Daxio to start everything up. While they prepare, we can maybe make a trip to the Fire Plane once things are prepared. They will not need us to organize the armies and gather forces.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's really frustrating. I feel like we have all the pieces here. I just can't figure it out.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We have all the pieces buried underneath every civilian.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm really obsessed on this ziggurat thing. Have you thrown any whitestone into the ziggurat?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, don't do that.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm sure they already have.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We have."

name: SAM
dialogue: It's going to be fine, Keyleth. After we kill Thordak and Raishan becomes super-powerful, Raishan will come here and get the Vecna orb and unleash all sorts of hells on the world, and then we'll know what it was!

name: LIAM
dialogue: I mean, that's basically what's going to happen.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's a very good plan.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, I mean, we can't really do anything about it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Which is why it's frustrating, because I feel like we can beat her to the fucking punch.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, I think Thordak's a fucking meathead and we should take care of Raishan ahead of time.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You already know how I feel.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think you're mad to think we can do that. I think that you're mad to think we're actually going to see her again before the final confrontation.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, we're not going to see her.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think she's going to stay far, far away.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No. She knows.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I took that shot specifically to see where she was sitting and see where we were sitting with her.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You took that shot specifically to stab her three times in the back, Percy.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It also worked that we found out she wasn't there.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes, revisionist history.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I thought you were practicing honesty.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's like saying I farted because my stomach hurt, and then I found out it stunk as well.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I was aware it could go horribly wrong, which is why I was prepared to say something.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Likely, there's a master plan; we understand.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm not saying it was the best plan.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Cool. Fort Daxio then? Check it out?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Does anybody else have anything to say to this?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We basically don't have a plan. We're going somewhere until we come up with a plan in the meantime.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, we're preparing all of our forces at Fort Daxio.

name: MATT
dialogue: Cassandra says, "If Fort Daxio is to be the place where this is to go down, then that will be "the place we'll send our allies."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Jesus. Let's put all of our eggs in one basket.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah. But what else are we saving them for? This is it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: This is the omelette. Where do we want our allies? Far away from the red dragon?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You don't feel like we are stepping into every trap that Raishan has laid?

name: SAM
dialogue: What else can we do?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Kill Raishan first!

name: SAM
dialogue: You can't heal the disease. We can't control this orb. There's nothing else we can do.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It doesn't matter! We just need her to believe that I can cure her disease.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Let's be honest. Raishan wants Thordak dead. That's her endgame as well.

name: LIAM
dialogue: That's the only thing we can count on.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Because right now Raishan could have us all dead.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are you saying you want Raishan to go with you one-on-one so you can do the Melora thing, and then maybe you take her out? And you want a shot at it before we try anything else? Because I'll grant you that.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I could try. That's what I was trying to bait her into.

name: LAURA
dialogue: She's not going to show up.

name: MATT
dialogue: Allura brings her hand up, "I've done plenty of research on these. I mean no offense to you, "Keyleth, but you convincing an entity that exists on deception through deception to believe you in "that regard? And based on that conversation, she already seems to see through that ruse. I would "not recommend it."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Allura, any chance you know the Gate spell?

name: MATT
dialogue: "No, that is far beyond my capabilities."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah. Rare spell, that.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm not mad in thinking that trusting this creature is the only option available at this point. I say "trust". Walking in this direction is the only direction available at the moment. Any attempt to counter her at this point leads to our destruction. She has us.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, no, we got that. So does anybody want to do anything else before we go to Daxio?

name: SAM
dialogue: The only thing else that we can do before we go to Daxio is to send word to our allies. I think we should grab Kash, send him out a quick list of who we need to contact. Ravenites. Feywild wolves.

name: LAURA, LIAM
dialogue: Syngorn.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Zahra, Kash.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Your people, Keyleth.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Kima. Allura.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Wolves are on another plane. Herd is wandering.

name: LAURA
dialogue: J'mon.

name: SAM
dialogue: That's by flute. Wait. What about our brotherhood of-- what do we belong to? Not the Clasp--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Slayer's Take.

name: SAM
dialogue: The Slayer's Take! We can get them too, right? We have money, we can hire them! We have a hundred thousand gold!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You want to hire them... Oh.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We could take out a contract against the red dragon.

name: SAM
dialogue: Sure.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We can hire them to kill a red dragon.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah. What are we going to do with that money when we're dead? Nothing.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We are sending everyone we know into one centralized location. Do we really feel like that's a good idea?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, this is what we've built towards.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Is it?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We're building a trap. Where would you put them?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We didn't talk about throwing everyone we loved into the frying pan. That was not the trap.

name: SAM
dialogue: What did you think we were making allegiances for? Just to hang out with them? We need them to fight and die for us!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm down for the cause of the war. Just not when it's a stupid fucking plan!

name: SAM
dialogue: We're going to be there too!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We don't have a plan! We're just asking everyone to meet in one location.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, we're talking about building an army.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And then doing what with them?

name: LIAM
dialogue: To kill the general.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And then doing what? They're just going to be sitting there! They're going to be sitting ducks!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They're not going to be sitting there. We're going to make tactical decisions about where to place everyone in and around the fort.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I've accepted that people are going to die. I've accepted that. I do not condone sending people to their slaughter when we don't have a goddamn plan.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, what's your counter proposal? Because I feel like we're making a plan here.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I don't think that it's smart to put every potential ally we know in one spot. Can we not divide it up? Can we not find places nearby?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They won't all just be in the fort. Everyone is going to be placed.

name: SAM
dialogue: Once we get there and survey the area, we can come up with a comfortable plan. You can make some caverns for them to hide in.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We're going to also create ways of making sure the dragon can't take flight. We're going to make sure that everyone has a purpose and a place. It will not be just a giant swath of people ready to die.

name: SAM
