dialogue: It's a one-handed sword, so I'm not sure. What is your--

name: MATT
dialogue: It has to be a light melee weapon in both hands, it looks to do this, unless you have a feat to fix that.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Which I do.

name: MATT
dialogue: You have the-- Do you have Dual Wielder as a feat?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, so yes, you can use the longsword and Whisper in the other hand.

name: LIAM
dialogue: But it's attunement, so I have to choose something.

name: MATT
dialogue: You'd have to chose that over--

name: LIAM
dialogue: This would supersede Whisper. Yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What? Whisper is a Vestige.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I understand that, but this is very strong, and with wings I could go anywhere.

name: MATT
dialogue: Do note. As part of the rogue ability-- I'm just double-checking here, but I'm pretty sure-- The attack must use a finesse or a ranged weapon. Technically I'm allowing-- Actually, no, I'm allowing it to be a finesse.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You're allowing it? You're allowing it?

name: MATT
dialogue: Well, because it's strength or dex. I'm sticking to my choice.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Okay. So it's light.

name: MATT
dialogue: It's not light. It's finesse. Meaning you can choose strength or dexterity.

name: MARY
dialogue: I have a question. Last time I saw you, you were looking for the Vestiges.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes.

name: MARY
dialogue: Did you find them?

name: LAURA
dialogue: All of them! All of them! Well, all of them that we know about.

name: MARY
dialogue: Do you know what to do with them?

name: SAM
dialogue: They are all super powerful, and are awesome, and you'll see them in battle tomorrow.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's all we know, is that you fight with them. That's all we know. Why, do you know more?

name: MARY
dialogue: Is there any information we can glean from Osysa at all, in Vasselheim, of how to use them?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, it would mean traveling to Vasselheim.

name: MARY
dialogue: That's true. Is there any way to get there, just quick and bamf in and just--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Last time we went somewhere quick and bamfed in--

name: MARY
dialogue: It was a long time?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Things went poorly. But we could speak to her. We could talk to her.

name: LAURA
dialogue: One of us could go and bamf back. And be back tomorrow morning.

name: WILL
dialogue: Well, you said you used them.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, we've been using them

name: WILL
dialogue: So then you know what they do, for the most part, right?

name: ALL
dialogue: Yeah.

name: WILL
dialogue: Why waste a trip?

name: MARY
dialogue: What if there's a way to combine them?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We tried. We put them all in a pile... (laughter)

name: WILL
dialogue: That didn't work? Piling them on top of each other didn't work?

name: SAM
dialogue: They didn't become a robot.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Not as much as we hoped it would, no.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah. There are other Vestiges, too, that are out there.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You have a potion of haste, yeah?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, potion of speed.

name: LIAM
dialogue: What if you gave me that and I gave you my boots?

name: SAM
dialogue: Real quick, who needs the fire protection?

name: MARY
dialogue: I don't; I'm resistant.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: If we have plenty of potions, I'll take it so I don't have to use a concentration spell.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Ditto. My plan is to stay away from the fire, but if I can't, that would certainly help.

name: WILL
dialogue: My plate is partially fire resistant.

name: SAM
dialogue: Vex? You don't need it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Fire resistance?

name: SAM
dialogue: Didn't I give you that? Oh, I gave you cold resistance.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah. I need fire resistance.

name: SAM
dialogue: What did you give me?

name: MARY
dialogue: Chlamydia.

name: SAM
dialogue: Acid resistance.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, yeah, that's right.

name: MARY
dialogue: Sorry. I was just in Australia. I got it from a koala. I'm kidding.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I could take off my bracers--

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's up to you. I don't want to--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: There's also the discussion--

name: SAM
dialogue: What. More discussions?

name: LIAM
dialogue: You take the boots, I'm on the potion. I have Whisper and this sword.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Are we going to try and lure Thordak out of his lair as a challenger?

name: SAM
dialogue: No, we're going to sneak into his lair, right?

name: WILL
dialogue: You're going to corner it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: He's not going to leave his lair anymore; he knows we're coming

name: MARY
dialogue: So, just very briefly, what is the plan?

name: SAM
dialogue: The plan, as I understated it, is: we send a vicious army to attack at the gates, all over the place, drawing out Thordak's forces in an epic battle. Blood, sinew, and gore everywhere, while we slip under the city, unbeknownst to Thordak, in the tunnels with the Clasp leading us. Leading us right to the center of town where we pop up, and surprise Thordak! He didn't know we were coming! He thought that there was an army at the gates! And we stab him real quick and leave.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Done. And we also find whatever it is he's protecting and kill that too.

name: SAM
dialogue: And at some point Raishan comes and helps us.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Hey! What's up?

name: WILL
dialogue: How you doing?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm really sorry. About all of that.

name: WILL
dialogue: No, it's no problem. It's great.

name: MARY
dialogue: I have a question. Do I know about the machine? Have I been told about that? Did Raishan tell me about that?

name: MATT
dialogue: Which one?

name: MARY
dialogue: The machine that Thordak is building, or whatever the heck he's--

name: MATT
dialogue: Thordak, as far as you know, has let nobody down there, Raishan included. And you have no idea what machinations Thordak is--

name: MARY
dialogue: But I do know about it.

name: MATT
dialogue: I mean, you know as much as they do. It's come up in conversation previously, yes.

name: WILL
dialogue: And you said we're going into the tunnels? Does anyone know the way through the tunnels?

name: SAM
dialogue: The Clasp does. They're an order of rogues and thieves who hate us. But they're going to help us.

name: MARY
dialogue: Do you trust them?

name: SAM
dialogue: We totally trust them because they are scoundrels and liars. And we have no other choice.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It doesn't serve them to lie to us.

name: MARY
dialogue: This sounds like a wonderful plan!

name: WILL
dialogue: It doesn't serve the scoundrels and liars to lie and be scoundrels?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It doesn't serve them in this moment, no. You know, if you're always a liar and a scoundrel, then no one will ever trust you to do anything, they're only conveniently liars and scoundrels.

name: WILL
dialogue: I love this plan, this is great.

name: SAM
dialogue: (laughs) It's pretty air-tight.

name: WILL
dialogue: Yeah. I don't see any room for problems. So you want to go in and corner the dragon where he lives and is most powerful--

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, yes!

name: WILL
dialogue: His back to the wall, and no escape--

name: SAM
dialogue: He can escape at any moment, he can fly.

name: WILL
dialogue: Just us, though? Not the entire army which we are using as a diversion?

name: SAM
dialogue: Just a partial group. Yes!

name: WILL
dialogue: But the scoundrels are going to lead us to him?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, he has his own army.

name: WILL
dialogue: Of course.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: So we need to keep his army distracted so we're not fighting a dragon and an army. So those armies will hopefully either distract the armies or; if he chooses not to send the armies to fight the rest of the armies that we've brought, all of our armies also converge on the dragon's nest and then we have everybody there.

name: WILL
dialogue: You're engaging all of your forces in one play? If he holds his forces back, why not send in skirmishes to see what happens first?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, I like this plan. He's good.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, we have people that we can do for that. Although, it's not just one army we have. We have groups of them, technically. I was just--

name: WILL
dialogue: Attacking in one place?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, no. All around the city.

name: WILL
dialogue: Is there a weak point?

name: SAM
dialogue: Our plan. (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Don't you laugh! No! No! You don't get to laugh. That scares us. Sadly, the only weak point is--

name: LIAM
dialogue: We either go with the shitty hand we've been given, or we lie down and let him steamroll over us.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes, but we can also try and formulate at least a vague plan, so that we all don't die within a single--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think this is a vague plan so that we don't all die.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: All right, okay. Let's build off of what Kash has.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: If it's too specific, then it's going to go wrong too quickly--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Hang on, hang on. He's right.

name: MARY
dialogue: Plus we don't know what to expect. We have to be ready for anything.

name: WILL
dialogue: We feint the city. Send skirmishes in to feint the city so they don't know where the main attack is coming from. They'll have to defend every wall. What you then do-- what you want them doing, because they're defending the wall, they won't know when the serious attack is coming from. Then you send them towards one fortified position. That would draw everybody to the one fortified position, but that's also a feint. And you come in the backdoor. That's always the way you do it. Meanwhile, we'll take the scoundrels and liars. And hopefully they're going to take us to corner the giant thing that wants to kill all of us, in the place where he is the most powerful.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, that one!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm actually very okay with this plan.

name: SAM
dialogue: We should have him with us always! (laughter)

name: MARY
dialogue: I totally agree.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Do it! Let's do that, let's do that!

name: WILL
dialogue: Let's do that! Okay! Great plan! Oh my god! Who's in charge? Who's leading your ground forces?

name: SAM
dialogue: We have no leader. Except we do have a secret weapon: we have a dragon who definitely wants something that we don't know about. Who might or might not be working with us.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We also have another secret weapon!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We have two dragons.

name: SAM
dialogue: We have a sword that is a dragon-slaying sword.

name: LIAM, MARISHA
dialogue: A whole other dragon.

name: WILL
dialogue: We should just kill each other now and just save the trouble. We got to plan something!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Scanlan, you do remember the flute, right?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, I carry it with me always. I use it all the time.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I wonder how long it'll take? To bamf over when we play the flute? Is it instantaneous or is it like, it takes a day?

name: SAM
dialogue: We'll never know.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We'll find out. (laughter)

name: SAM
dialogue: I'll be dead long before it works.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Six months later, "Where is everybody?" (laughter)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I told you we were going to die if we didn't have you.

name: WILL
dialogue: No, you're going to die even with me! But I'm going to be the guy going, "Hey, we could have "planned this better!"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Right, yeah.

name: MARY
dialogue: I think you've given them a really good plan.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, no, that's great! Let's do that!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There is no situation that anyone is going to come up with where we're looking good, and this is going to work well. There's just-- there's a dragon in the middle of the city with an evil army and we have to deal with it, and there's just no positive way to deal with that.

name: MARY
dialogue: Are we taking Raishan with us?

name: SAM
dialogue: Raishan, I feel like she's going to meet us there.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It just seems so highly defeatist to already plan for-- you know, defeat.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's not planning for defeat. It's recognizing that no matter what, ten minutes into it, everything that we thought we knew is going to be wrong anyway.

name: WILL
dialogue: At least tell me you're not going to send all your forces in at the same time. You're saving a reserve.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Of course.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay. Then we need to talk about the forces that are going in. More armies are talented than others.

name: SAM
dialogue: We're not sending them all in?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, we're not. We are going to surround the city.

name: WILL
dialogue: I need one supreme general who's going to be in charge of everything. Who stays back as we're attacking.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Daxio is going to do that.

name: MARY
dialogue: All right.

name: WILL
dialogue: And the men trust him?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes. He's the leader of the army.

name: WILL
dialogue: Okay.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: He's all right.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Then we need to get this plan to him.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, we need to talk to him.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We have communications.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So we're going to have waves of assault from one position, have other people flank in from another position--

name: WILL
dialogue: And you're attacking a fortified city?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Fortified-ish. Well, the hope is actually-- also we have the 50 men from Fort Daxio. We can bring them in underground as well, and just have them pop up--

name: LAURA
dialogue: And open the gates?

name: WILL
dialogue: So you could bring forces with us to come up in the middle of the city?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: WILL
dialogue: That's good. We should have talked about that in the beginning.

name: SAM
dialogue: I also think there's a SWAT team that's available to us.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: He thinks there's a SWAT team.

name: WILL
dialogue: You should-- you should talk less.

name: SAM
dialogue: Smile more? (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think you smile just the right amount.

name: MARY
dialogue: I use my Awakened Mind to speak to Kash telepathically. You can't respond out loud, so don't. You know how I feel about Raishan. You know what I've experienced with her. Keep an eye on her. Don't trust her. If you see anything while we're out there, you let me know and we'll take her out. All right, darling?

name: SAM
dialogue: Kash, why are you drooling and staring off into space? (laughter)

name: WILL
dialogue: Was-- was I drooling?

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, just a little.

name: WILL
dialogue: That's my bad, I'm sorry.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You were talking so much a second ago, and--

name: WILL
dialogue: I was thinking about how I can't wait to die tomorrow. Yeah.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, why don't we finalize this plan tomorrow when we meet with the general who will be-- what, commanding half the forces?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I think we need to meet with the general, like, tonight.

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay. Let's go.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Right now.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Meet or telepathically communicate?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I think we should send a message through Allura. She can just scribble a note and send it to him.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Also that way, he'll have less time, less effort defying us.

name: SAM
dialogue: Why-- why not go talk to him?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah. I feel like you can't really scribble an elaborate battle plan in a 25-word message.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's not written down, it's all telepathic conversation.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But the Message spell that Allura is using only allows for very minimal conversation. It's not exactly-- She can't have a full-blown conversation with them.

name: MATT
dialogue: It's a long-distance Twitter.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah. A hundred percent.

name: SAM
dialogue: Let's go to him.

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right, let's go. Right now. I still think we should eat a Heroes' Feast before we go. Just in case.

name: SAM
dialogue: When Vex wants to spend money, I'm in agreement.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What's the difference, really? Just to be prepared.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, it blows a spell.

name: LAURA
dialogue: But the day is almost up. It will protect us all day tomorrow.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What time is it?

name: MATT
dialogue: After this much conversation, it's getting closer to sunset, probably an hour after--

name: SAM
dialogue: Oi, Pike! Can you do a Heroes Feast for us?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Sure!" (laughter)

name: SAM
dialogue: Thanks, Pike!

name: MATT
dialogue: "No problem!"

name: MARY
dialogue: You're so tiny, I didn't even see you. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, she then goes ahead and casts Heroes' Feast. Same cost. Same cost as-- It also cost her 6th-level spell slot. Which I'll mark.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You don't have to, we have party funds for this, dear.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. So Heroes' Feast has been summoned for you guys.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Did you just give me 800? I'm just pocketing your 800, and I'm putting it in the party gold. So thank you.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's the same thing.

name: MATT
dialogue: So you guys are going to speak to Allura, then?

name: SAM
dialogue: No. We're doing a Heroes' Feast.

name: WILL
dialogue: I was told there was brunch.

name: MARY
dialogue: I was promised brunch!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do we know exactly where the Syngorn army is? How far away from--

name: MATT
dialogue: That, you would have to talk to Allura about. She's acting as the information nexus for everyone. It takes an hour. You all have to sit and devour the meal for an hour, for 12 people.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: For your party, your two allies there, and Gilmore, and Jarett, Drake, anybody else you want to bring along. And as you guys, for the next 24 hours--

name: LAURA
dialogue: And Trinket.

name: SAM
dialogue: Do you need it?

name: LAURA
dialogue: No.

name: WILL
dialogue: Wait. That was you at the beginning? (laughter)

name: LAURA
dialogue: Shh-shhh--

name: MATT
dialogue: Kima-- you'd have to choose between Kima or Jarett.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Or Kima or Trinket.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We have to choose between Kima and Jarett to come? Or to eat?

name: MATT
dialogue: To eat. You only have up to 12 people for the meal.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Kima. She's in the fray.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yeah. He can stay back, he has a crossbow.

name: MATT
dialogue: All righty, so, that being the case, gonna roll 2d10 to see how much everyone's maximum hit points increases.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, we don't need to do Grog.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, we do.

name: SAM
dialogue: He's not here.

name: MATT
dialogue: That's a really good roll. That's an eight and a nine. So there you go. All of you gain 17 additional max hit points for the next 24 hours.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Wow, that's awesome.

name: MATT
dialogue: That's actually really, really good. So keep a note on that.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And then we're immune to fear and poison, right?

name: MATT
dialogue: And you're immune to poison and the poisoned condition.

name: SAM
dialogue: And we have advantage on wisdom saving throws.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right, I'm marking this here.

name: WILL
dialogue: I feel so much healthier. And the bacon is great. Fresh lox.

name: SAM
dialogue: Zabar's.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm so hungry now!

name: MARY
dialogue: Hollandaise wasn't that blender stuff, it was the real thing.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right, so you finish your meal. You summon Allura, she comes and enters the room. She looks a little frazzled, a little sleepless, but she's keeping it together. "All right, what do you "require?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We were curious if you knew the location of the Syngorn army?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes, we've been keeping in contact. They look to be arriving about early afternoon "tomorrow, at a far enough distance from Emon. Their illusionists have been keeping a blanket in "front of the army to dissuade any visibility and giving away their position in advance."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, that's so comforting.

name: WILL
dialogue: You have numbers?

name: MATT
dialogue: "They are at-- let's see here, they're at 2,000 troops."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay. All right.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Give or take, and--"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do you know the status of the other armies?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, that is the Syngorian force and the three Daxio-- the Dusk regiment, the Tide "regiment-- The Dusk, the Gale, and the Tide regiments with the Syngorian forces."

name: LIAM
dialogue: And all together is 2,000?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes. A little over 2,000."

name: WILL
dialogue: Are they all foot?

name: MATT
dialogue: "They are all foot, yes. Unfortunately, with the time given, and the transition to and from the "Feywild, there was an inability to bring with them most of their beasts of burden and horses. Many of "them were left to scatter shortly after the Conclave's attack."

name: SAM
dialogue: Is there an elite SWAT team task force?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I believe that's-- there is one, and they are called Vox Machina."

name: MARY
dialogue: I've heard of them.

name: WILL
dialogue: Are there shields?

name: MATT
dialogue: "They do have shields."

name: WILL
dialogue: How big?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Uh, depends on the regiments. I mean--"

name: WILL
dialogue: Can we form a phalanx, is my question.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I-- Yes, that is--"

name: LIAM
dialogue: He has been training military in Whitestone.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Specifically the Tide regiment is a frontline shield phalanx."

name: WILL
dialogue: And how big is it?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't actually have numbers on that. You'd have to talk to Mikael on that. The "Warmaster."

name: WILL
dialogue: And they're going to be attacking a fortified location?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes, the outer walls of Emon are guarded by a wall. The wall has sustained damage through the "Conclave's initial attack and there has not been, as far as I know, intent to rebuild, or at least a "force to be able to since then."

name: LAURA
dialogue: So if we could get in, talk to the Clasp, and have them find a way to open the gates, it would help the armies.

name: WILL
dialogue: Well, that's the thing, is you'd have to hold the gate once it's open. That's gonna be the hardest part. But 50 men could easily do that.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Plus the Clasp, which hopefully will be willing to fight.

name: SAM
dialogue: Hey, where's our stone golem?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Far away.

name: SAM
dialogue: He's gone.

name: WILL
dialogue: How many-- do we know the numbers that are inside the city?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Not specifically. As far as the lizardfolk army-- from what we've heard from Asum, from Brom, "from Raishan, the estimates are somewhere in the neighborhood of eight to nine thousand, and at "least five to six hundred wyverns that are--"

name: WILL
dialogue: So we don't control the air?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Not on a wide scale, no."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We have a single battleship.

name: WILL
dialogue: We're attacking a fortified location with no siege engines, outnumbered three to one.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Their fortified location also does not have siege engines, just air force.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Their air force is also giant wyvern beasts.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Now, understand, lizardfolk are not the most hearty, the most well-trained. They're a "chaotic force at best and even the bit of unification they've had under Thordak's banner is "thin. You've already had luck cutting down a few of their main sources of tactics; I believe the "general that you slew outside of Daxio was one of their main organisers. That's a big blow to their "tactic brigade. Who knows who else is in cahoots with Thordak since he took power, but we've been, "in previous encounters, chipping away at their capabilities. Thordak also does have under his "command a number of fire giants that he brought with him from the Fire Plane. However, you also "slew their general."

name: WILL
dialogue: Are they superstitious?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Not to my knowledge, no."

name: WILL
dialogue: Any type of religion; a devil figure in their religion?

name: MATT
dialogue: "There are. They exist among many various devils."

name: WILL
dialogue: I'm wondering if we have the illusionist drop the shield when the army gets there and create an illusion of one of their giant beasts that they're afraid of on one side of the wall. Scatter fear among all of them.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It could work. The big fear there of course is that they work for a creature they already fear quite a bit.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I think Thordak might be scarier than any of their gods at this point.

name: WILL
dialogue: Thordak will be busy, hopefully. We want to move them away from the gate so that the 50 men can come up through the city and hold the gate.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think a carrot would be easier than a stick. I think it would be better to find a force for them to rush toward, than to find something for them rush away from.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do we know how many spellcasters are in the Syngorn army?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I do not have those numbers, unfortunately."

name: WILL
dialogue: That could be interesting.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: More carrot, less stick.

name: WILL
dialogue: You might not even need to see the soldiers, just the dust rising from their boots.

name: MARY
dialogue: And the horses charging, if you can make that kind of illusion.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We need to figure out how many spellcasters.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That would be a conversation with the Warmaster."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: They can throw down long-range, large, covering spells.

name: SAM
dialogue: Let's go talk to the Warmaster.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well we don't know where they'll be exactly until tomorrow.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Have that conversation at the ready."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: All right, hang on, how about this? We know that they're to arrive in Emon by the afternoon. We can just try to connect with them in the early morning and march in with them, then split when we get closer to the gates.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And then meet the 50 men at Greyskull Keep.

name: WILL
dialogue: Do we have access to anything that goes boom?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: A little bit. Do I have anything possibly still leftover at Greyskull, any of my supplies?

name: MATT
dialogue: You do have a small cache of blackpowder at your disposal. It's about a cask.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I make it myself, half the time.

name: WILL
dialogue: A cask in the right place against an already damaged wall could punch a hole.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It could.

name: WILL
dialogue: And if we're underneath, and the foundation is already weakened, we'd be trapped but the army could get inside.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Do you still have that siege arrow or is that gone now?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I do, I have a siege arrow. And Grog does extra damage against buildings and walls.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes I do!" (boom) slams his fists together, and as they hit you hear what sounds like a very localized sound of a rockslide. Just like (boom).

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Rad.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: So we do have a siege arrow which will basically do the damage of-- It's a wall-shatterer. It's designed to bring down stone.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So it damages stone, specifically? The siege arrow?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yes. It damages anything that is liable to siege.

name: WILL
dialogue: And it can be fired by anybody?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes, but it is weirdly weighted and she's probably the one you want firing it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm a really good archer.

name: WILL
dialogue: I remember, when I brought you back from the dead.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, oh my god thank you so much.

name: WILL
dialogue: You're welcome, not a problem.

name: MARY
dialogue: What am I, chopped liver? I get nothing? I think it was both of us, I believe.

name: WILL
dialogue: That could be interesting, though.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes it could. I'd forgotten about that.

name: WILL
dialogue: Well because what they'll be expecting is for 50 men to come in and hold the gate. What if holding the gate is actually a distraction? And then we punch a hole through the wall and go in the back door.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes. I like it.

name: WILL
dialogue: But we're going to be in the tunnel, we're working about the top right now.

name: MARY
dialogue: But if we can scatter their forces front and back, we'll have the center to come in underneath, and that way if they figure it out they'll have to come from either side.

name: WILL
dialogue: The 50 men holding the wall, the chances of any of them getting out are slim, but they're going to know that going in.

name: LAURA
dialogue: These guys are legit!

name: SAM
dialogue: We are the worst people.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Apparently! Which is terrible. It really, really is.

name: WILL
dialogue: It's the end of the world, they know what's happened.

name: MARY
dialogue: You've been dealing with dragons, we've been thinking about it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm still concerned we don't have enough air support for the 500 wyverns.

name: MARY
dialogue: I think we might have to let that go.

name: MATT
dialogue: Allura chimes in and goes, "As far as I understand, that's part of the reason you're "bringing the mages with you."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes, well I'm thinking--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Ground to air.

name: WILL
dialogue: How big is the airship?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I wasn't wanting to necessarily tap into this resource unless necessary, but I think it's necessary. I can contact the Air Ashari and have them specifically on air support.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And they can get themselves here quick, like you?

name: LAURA
dialogue: They can go through trees, instant!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It can hold two dozen people on that ship, right?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We need all of the Ashari.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's about three cannonade?

name: MARY
dialogue: Is there anyone that could put an illusion on the airship to make it seem like another dragon?

name: SAM
dialogue: I could put a slight illusion on it but it'd be pretty easy--

name: WILL
dialogue: I'm just wondering if there's a way to draw their air force to the airship and then blow it up?

name: LIAM
dialogue: We also supposedly have a green dragon as an ally.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh yeah!

name: LAURA
dialogue: I fucking forgot the Ravenites said they would help us, too! I just remembered.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, we sent word to them, didn't we? Didn't we send word to everybody?

name: MATT
dialogue: You sent word to a few specific entities, not the Ravenites.

name: LAURA
dialogue: How long would it take?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Vox Machina, swearing that they're going to call you back for four years. (laughter)

name: LAURA
dialogue: Fuck. Are they too far?

name: MATT
dialogue: They're like a continent away.

name: WILL
dialogue: Wait, you can bring in air force?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I can contact my father at the Air Ashari.

name: SAM
dialogue: Do that. We also need to contact Gilmore.

name: WILL
dialogue: If you control the air, you control the battle.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Gilmore is accompanying you, and I believe Kima is going to come along as well".

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We also have your friend.

name: MATT
dialogue: "The airship we don't know quite exactly where it is and when it will arrive. I don't know "if we can count on it being there by the time you make this assault, but they're going there as soon "as they can."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It has cannonade as well and it is designed to hold sieges in the air, so it will keep many of them busy, and they're not that bright.

name: WILL
dialogue: If it's not coming though, you can't count it among them.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We can't count on anything.That would be--

name: WILL
dialogue: Huge.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can you message Korren?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I've not met Korren."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, shit.

name: MATT
dialogue: "If you could take me to him--"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Uh-huh. Yeah, right. Yes. Because we're not leaving until the morning now. Sure, yeah. Oh man (gasps) who wants to go see my hometown, you guys?

name: SAM
dialogue: (dubious noise)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay. You know what? I wasn't looking at you, Scanlan. Okay. I can show you where I went to school!

name: MARY
dialogue: Keyleth, we need to get back here as soon as possible.

name: WILL
dialogue: You went to school? (laughter)

name: LIAM
dialogue: That was catty.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We were like back in school suddenly, that was great!

name: WILL
dialogue: I formally apologize.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That went so John Hughes, so quickly. (laughter)

name: LAURA
dialogue: Are we expecting you back tonight?

name: MARY
dialogue: And the rest of us can rest, yes?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Rest and prepare for everything you can, for tomorrow this happens." (liquid pouring)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I swear if you're aerating wine under there I'm going to be so upset. (laughter)

name: WILL
dialogue: I just saw it out of the corner, it was great!

name: MATT
dialogue: All you had to do was ask, I'm working toward getting the break, buddy!

name: SAM
dialogue: (sigh) Feels so much better!

name: MARY
dialogue: Before we go to bed, I would like to talk to Vex very quickly.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you guys are going to prepare to make your way to the Air Ashari, Zahra pulls you aside.

name: MARY
dialogue: Darling?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes?

name: MARY
dialogue: I have major concerns about Raishan. I don't know that we can trust her, I just want you to keep your eyes on her. While you were gone, I tried as hard as I could to glean anything from her, and the closer I thought I got-- I found out that I knew nothing about her. And she knows everything about me.

name: LAURA
dialogue: She knows everything about all of us, dear.

name: MARY
dialogue: Don't trust her.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Not even for a minute.

name: MARY
dialogue: Don't trust her. If it comes to it, I'll go down taking her out.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'd rather you didn't.

name: MARY
dialogue: So would I.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I have to do it, I have to insight check Zahra to make sure she's really Zahra!

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh shit.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make an insight check.

name: LIAM
dialogue: No that's good. That's good.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I love you.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Pretty good.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I can also say there's an easy way to do this--

name: MATT
dialogue: Turn that way real fast.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Just go downstairs.

name: SAM
dialogue: (in surfer accent) Hey guys, don't forget: December's theme is "revolution!" Featuring items from Assassin's Creed, Mr. Robot, Firefly and more! Don't forget to go to lootcrate.com/criticalrole, and enter 'critical role' for 10% off, my bruh!

name: MATT
dialogue: That's the worst use of Seeming I've ever seen! (laughter) All righty.

name: LAURA
dialogue: When did you even speak to her?

name: MARY
dialogue: While you were gone. You know I've been spending time-- she's been down in the ziggurat.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes?

name: MARY
dialogue: So I've seen her. I've seen her form, as I guess you have as well.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes.

name: MARY
dialogue: After Rimefang, I sort of became obsessed with dragons.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I know the feeling. (laughs)

name: MARY
dialogue: Yes, it's a wonderful feeling, isn't it? But I also know that she was part of it, and the minute a dragon says 'trust me' is the minute you don't.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Especially her.

name: MARY
dialogue: Especially her. So while you were gone, I tried. I tried to find out as much about Thordak as I could.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Just know that we don't trust her.

name: MARY
dialogue: All right.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I don't even know if she's really sick.

name: MARY
dialogue: I actually believe her in that respect. But Thordak is the only one that can cure her, and if that's the case-- if she believes that-- then we are nothing. We are expendable to her the minute she sees Thordak. That's the carrot that he has put in front of her, is that 'I will heal you', and he hasn't done it yet. I don't think he will.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I don't think he really can.

name: MARY
dialogue: If he does, we're fucked. That's all.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You're not alone in this, at least.

name: MARY
dialogue: Good. That's good.

name: LAURA
dialogue: She's not our friend.

name: MARY
dialogue: She can be persuasive. Thank you, darling.

name: MATT
dialogue: You separate for the evening to gather your mind, gather your supplies and prepare for the coming battle. While the rest of you find yourselves resting for the evening, Keyleth and Vax find yourselves walking towards the Sun Tree to make your journey.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Is Allura coming with us, too?

name: MATT
dialogue: If you want to ask her to come with you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I thought she was.

name: MATT
dialogue: I'm sorry, yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: She doesn't have to.

name: MATT
dialogue: You're right, no, she goes with you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay, come on, Allura, let's go!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Of course! Certainly."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's great, we have these really great crepes that we make. It's like our hometown special.

name: MATT
dialogue: "If there's time, I would love to have some. Don't know if we'll have time."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay, okay!

name: MATT
dialogue: So you all walk your way down to the Sun Tree. You open the portal. Immediately on the opposite side you see-- as it is nighttime in this part of Exandria's hemisphere-- what looks to be a beautiful, simple village made of curved wood, almost dome-type structures, but not huts, there's no thatch. They're really well-crafted, long, intricate strips of wood like it's been grown to a specific shape. It creates these interesting domiciles that are all built, you see beyond that, on the edge of a sheer cliff, and the minute you step through the wind hits you. There is a strong wind immediately on the outside of this tree, and you feel your cloak being blown to the side. You look over behind the tree that you just stepped out of, and it's another cliff that vanishes into darkness below. The Air Ashari village of Zephrah lies at the very top of this mountain range. For a brief second, you get vertigo, glancing over your shoulder. Keyleth steps through with a big smile on her face. You see Allura step through, and as soon as she sees this happen she clasps and keeps her hair down, not wanting to be like you right now with your hair (blowing) in the wind. You take a few steps toward the village. Probably close to 100 homes at most, built into the mountainside. It goes up into a hill with trees that surround the outskirts of it. You see small lights that are lit throughout so it has this firefly feel glimmering through. As soon as you step maybe ten or 15 feet from the tree, the wind just stops.

name: LIAM
dialogue: What happened to the wind?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I mean, we're Air Ashari, we don't have to live in a hellscape our whole lives! Come on, we control it, it's great! (sighs) Doesn't it smell good? It smells so fresh up here, you know? You don't have to deal with the pollution down there. Oh look! Over there, that's where I learned to shapeshift into a squirrel for the first time--

name: MATT
dialogue: "Keyleth? Keyleth. We're here on business--"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah no, then let's start walking!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Please lead on."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay, yeah. And over there was the first time that my dad taught me how to fly. He just pushed me off the cliff--!

name: LIAM
dialogue: I have my hand on her back and I just start--

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughing) Pushing her forward? You eventually make your way back. There are a number of trees that are grown through some of the buildings, or buildings are built around them, or from them. It's a very beautiful, simple, natural-looking series of structures that are all so smooth in their design that it was obviously bent with some druidic magic to craft this space. Currently there is nobody you see visible walking through the city, most everything is closed off for the night. The little lantern-like lights you saw before are coming from the inside of these buildings.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's a quiet mountain town, everything closes at like five, it was actually annoying growing up.

name: MARY
dialogue: You live in South Pointe?

name: LIAM
dialogue: That explains so much. (laughter)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I told you it was remote!

name: MATT
dialogue: I want both of you to roll a perception check.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: 14 total.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. As she's talking and you guys are walking, you notice a little dark spot, just covering past the stars, arcing quickly in your direction.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I spin her around and tilt her head back. What's that? Do you know what that is? Is that normal?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do I know what that is, is that normal?

name: MATT
dialogue: Once you see it, you recognize the trajectory of it. This is a person rocketing toward you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, that's a person! (laughter) No really, is this normal?

name: MATT
dialogue: It's normal for you, because this is a person riding a skysail.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, it is normal for me? Oh, like a--? Yeah!

name: MATT
dialogue: As the person swoops up and then lands-- it's a sort of glider. It resembles a pogo stick in the fact that feet are placed on top of it, and elements are grasped on the side. It's a large, leather-winged structure that immediately folds up and is held like a staff to the side.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Whoa, that's nifty! Hi!

name: MATT
dialogue: Standing before you is Korren, your father.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Dad!

name: MATT
dialogue: He looks surprised. He lands in a very aggressive, coming-to-see-what's-going-on-type way, and as soon as he looks, "Keyleth! I wasn't expecting--"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Hi! Village looks great! I see you guys have been keeping up with the landscaping, this is awesome. Hi, how are you?

name: MATT
dialogue: He hugs you, but it's a tense hug and he pats your shoulder. "We're good. I--"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What's wrong?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, things as they are, I know you're probably here for not a passing visit. Am I "correct in this assumption?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I mean, I guess you could say it was going to be passing in that we don't have a lot of time. We're here to ask for help, for the Air Ashari's aid.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We were waiting for specific word based on our last conversation. We have ways of finding "information about what's going on in the world, with the armies that have been mounting making "their way towards Emon we've been keeping a watch on the gathering energy toward the west coast of "Tal'dorei. We were preparing ourselves. So if you've come to ask for our aid, we're ready."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Why do I sense trepidation in your voice?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Because we know what we face. Because my daughter is going to war against something that we "watched tear through the countryside not long after you were born. I'm just concerned as a "parent. That is all."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You sent me on this path to prove myself worthy and a hero. I'm following what I thought you wanted of me.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You are, and I'm proud of you. I just want to do what I can to help safeguard that."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I will continue my duties as I promised from the beginning.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Of course".

name: MARISHA
dialogue: As those supersede being your daughter.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Of course."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And I am here for unfortunate reasons, and I wish I wasn't. We need the best. We need as many of the top soldiers that we have. I'm looking at you, at my people, for air support. There's about five, maybe six hundred, maybe even more wyverns covering the city. So far we don't have a lot of options.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We know wyverns well, that's the good news. We can probably facilitate this request."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I was hoping maybe some of the best nature manipulators could create a hazardous storm ahead of time? See what we can do to take out as much in bulk.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We can do that. Yeah."

name: SAM
dialogue: (whispering) She went to school.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I know, I got educated!

name: MATT
dialogue: "We can do that. When is this set to happen?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Tomorrow afternoon.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right, we'll get our conjurers together and begin building a storm front. We'll send it "mid-day tomorrow. Then what sign should we look for to enter the fray?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh shit.

name: SAM
dialogue: Just anything.

name: LIAM
dialogue: A flare, we have flares. Kiki, we have flares.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We have flares. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: "Very well." (laughter)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We're spitballing this as we go, dad. So we can work on a sign together, right?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Sure, I mean, if we're creating a sky of rain and darkness, just make the sky itself a sign."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I can do that.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right. Something I'd know, something I'd recognize."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We'll go in there and tear as many of those wyverns as we can to the ground."

name: LIAM
dialogue: You're not alone, there is an army of elves marching as we speak.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: The Syngorn army.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We've seen them traversing. Their illusions are strong but their illusions are faced towards "the city. We have the luxury of knowing their magic. So, yes."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: With all due respect, if you have seen through their illusion, does that mean-- I'm sure many of Thordak's spies could do the same?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It depends on who he has on his side. I hope that's not the case."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, me too. Are you going to come as well?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I do not wish to live in a world where the dangers that continue to press upon the free "peoples of this or any land draws my daughter to the front lines to fight, kill, and possibly die, "and I stay back and do nothing. So yes, I will be there." MARISHA What about Zephrah? What about the village? Who is going to watch it while you're gone? "We have enough to spare for this and protect our people. Besides, as you well know, the "protections in this village prevent wayward fliers."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay. This is Vax, by the way.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We've met."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, you have.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Good to see you."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He came with me. So--? Yeah. See you tomorrow, I guess?

name: MATT
dialogue: "See you tomorrow."

name: LIAM
dialogue: A great many people are grateful for your aid, as am I.

name: MATT
dialogue: "And I'm grateful for yours."

name: LIAM
dialogue: You're a good man.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Prove to me you're one as well." (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Cleaning the shotgun.

name: MATT
dialogue: "But we have a lot to plan, I'm sure you do as well."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Good night." He pulls you in and kisses you on the forehead, and gives you a long look.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I just give him a big hug in response.

name: MATT
dialogue: He holds you there for a second, then looks back over at you as he's holding her.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I just nod my head.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I miss you, Dad.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I miss you, too. When all this is done, do you still intend to finish your Aramente? Do it "quickly. Come back to us, please. You're missed."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You have my word. I won't let you down.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I know. Anyway." He slams on the ground and the leather flares out into arcing-looking fingers, and he steps on.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Are these the new models? They've really upgraded them.

name: MATT
dialogue: "No, you've just been gone for a while."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Have I been gone that long?

name: MATT
dialogue: "You've been gone a while."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, they look great!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Thank you."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay, all right, okay, bye.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Good night." As the wind picks up under him, the skysail begins to lift and glide off. He heads back toward the village.

name: LIAM
dialogue: That is fucking cool. We should get out of here.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, we should.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Allura?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes, I believe we should. Well, it was nice to meet him."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, that's right. Sorry, I should have introduced you, I guess.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I was waiting." (laughter) "As are the expected pleasantries of diplomacy. But it seems you had it all taken care "of, so it's fine."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Sorry, I got distracted by talking to you as my father and not as Allura!

name: LIAM
dialogue: It was so weird though, you were standing directly behind him. (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's all right, don't worry, it is a bit cold, if we could get back please?" She's rubbing her shoulders and arms a bit.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That was my dad, let's go.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right, you guys head back, exiting out the Sun Tree, making your way back.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I catch her by the arm. I can't wait to come back. Let's go!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: When we come back, I'll have to show you the first time I--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Let's go! Let's go, please! (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: You make your way back to castle Whitestone, preparing your materials, your weapons, your minds and your disposition for the coming war tomorrow.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I have a quick thing!

name: SAM
dialogue: Shit, Taliesin, shit!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I knock on Vex's door. I have a bag, and I go to Vex's door and knock on her door.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Hello, who is it?

name: SAM
dialogue: It's a bag of dicks.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You're terrible. It's me, I have something to show you.

name: LAURA

dialogue: We haven't really discussed it, but--

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, no, no, but we have talked about doing it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Or even breaching the south gate alone would be-- If all four gates are being--

name: WILL
dialogue: Any time we go out and we attack a gate, they're going to bring all of their forces to that gate. What they're not going to be suspecting is a wall being ripped down. And once you open a wall, you can't close it. You can close a gate.

name: LAURA
dialogue: What's the weakest wall?

name: MATT
dialogue: "That would be the eastern wall."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's also near Greyskull Keep.

name: MARY
dialogue: Oh, that's the arrow that you're going to use, yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: "While we are not in a position to use siege weaponry, we do have most of our mages at our "disposal, and they have prepared a modicum of siege-based arcane spells at their disposal. name: LAURA
dialogue: We will have air support.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I called in assistance from the Air Ashari, from the north. They're maintaining the skies.

name: MATT
dialogue: "The Ashari are aiding us as well?"

name: WILL
dialogue: Do you know how many?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Did dad tell me how many?

name: MATT
dialogue: He said roughly a hundred.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, shit. Thanks, dad. Roughly a hundred.

name: WILL
dialogue: If I can make a suggestion? If you get into the city, don't move through the alleys. You're going to scatter your forces. Move into the city and fortify a position. So then you've opened a gate inside the city. Move the command center inside the city, and defend from there.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That is indeed part of our push, however, we are rather vulnerable from the air. So with the "Air Ashari giving us air support, that will allow us the ability that we need to push forward as a "singular unit, from unit to unit, in its own right. You are entering from where?"

name: SAM
dialogue: The sewers.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes. We have a secret entrance in our keep, if we can still access it. If not, there is an entrance to the sewers towards the water. We were told of it by the Clasp, right?

name: SAM
dialogue: I've also used a tunnel to get out, at some point.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's right, when you were looking for Kaylie.

name: MATT
dialogue: That was Westruun.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's the same sewer system, though, right?

name: MARY
dialogue: It's the same basic layout of a city, yeah, right?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Wait, wait, the Traverse Junction. What's the Traverse Junction?

name: MATT
dialogue: "The Traverse Junction is-- was-- is, as far as I know, still attached to the Lyceum, but--"

name: SAM
dialogue: The Lyceum's unguarded!

name: MATT
dialogue: "The Lyceum is partially destroyed, and is filled with the remains of the enemy."

name: SAM
dialogue: I remember that.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's not what I meant, then. That wasn't the thing that I meant to say.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And we know Thordak has made an underground basin. He only emerges when someone challenges him, or offers their loyalty.

name: MARY
dialogue: Were we supposed to meet the Clasp in a specific place?

name: SAM
dialogue: We've just got to get to a sewer.

name: MARY
dialogue: So we just need to find a sewer and then we're going to reconnoiter with-- Is that the right word? Anyway-- with the Clasp. And at that point, we shall make our way through--

name: MATT
dialogue: All right.

name: WILL
dialogue: And that's when the thieves and liars will take us to the thing that's going to kill us all? We're very excited about the plan.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I can tell."

name: WILL
dialogue: Yeah. Do we have the 50 soldiers we need, or do we need to ask them for 50?

name: SAM
dialogue: Did they ever show up? Did the 50 soldiers from Fort Daxio show up?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I had heard that Daxio had fallen. There are survivors?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well. There were. There were about 55 soldiers.

name: MATT
dialogue: "They haven't found their way to us yet, then. We'll keep an eye out."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They might be headed towards Greyskull, if I recall. I believe they were heading there.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's true. They should be crossing paths very shortly.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: 50 men can move quietly.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So after you cut through all of the lizardmen like butter, you'll make your way to Thordak?

name: MATT
dialogue: "That's the intent, to push in towards the Cloudtop. And, based on how well you and/or any of "the air forces have been able to puncture the defenses, push in towards the creature itself and "unleash everything we have at the beast. name: SAM
dialogue: Well, not Asum. We know where he is.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And Brom.

name: MARY
dialogue: I thought Brom was at Whitestone.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Don't say that word out loud.

name: MARY
dialogue: I said it to you, quietly.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, very quietly.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We'll gather what we can. We don't really know what's actually in there, yet.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And we can't trust anyone within the city limits.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Understood."

name: WILL
dialogue: Do you have a time frame? For your attack?

name: MATT
dialogue: "We are intending, once the men have been fed, once the men have been able to rest and "prepare their armaments, we were going to attack upon sundown, yes."

name: WILL
dialogue: And you plan to breach the city when?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Hopefully within the first hour of the attack."

name: WILL
dialogue: Really?

name: MATT
dialogue: "That's the intent."

name: WILL
dialogue: How far do you think we can make it in the tunnels in an hour?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Pretty far, to be honest, especially if we're-- Well, no that's--

name: SAM
dialogue: 20 blocks.

name: WILL
dialogue: You making that number up?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yep.

name: WILL
dialogue: You just pulled that out of nowhere.

name: SAM
dialogue: Absolutely.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's the highest number he knows. Grog's not here; I have to do something.

name: SAM
dialogue: An hour-- We can probably make it, I don't know, we can make it deep into the city, but not all the way to the center, can we?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, not in an hour.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's a maze in there. But the tunnel from our keep in, if it's intact, was not that far.

name: MATT
dialogue: "If you were to traverse the tunnel system in advance of our attack, that would perhaps aid "us in syncing our maneuvers."

name: SAM
dialogue: So we should go now.

name: WILL
dialogue: That would be the goal, is to act as point for the entire army.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That would indeed be the goal."

name: LAURA
dialogue: So, what, the minute we pop out, we send up a flare?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Some sort of a sign. Hopefully something not quite as easy to read as a sign of aggression. "We've taken much care to not be seen this far."

name: SAM
dialogue: Or we could just wait for sundown and then go, knowing that they're going to strike at the same time.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We go now.

name: SAM
dialogue: No, I mean, once we get in there, we wait until we pop out, until it's getting dark outside.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I mean, what kind of symbol do we send up in a sky full of wyverns?

name: LAURA
dialogue: What if we're not in position by sundown?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: The Ashari are already looking for a symbol. I plan to be aiding them. They should be helping us with--

name: SAM
dialogue: What about a storm?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, there will be a storm.

name: WILL
dialogue: Wait, there's a storm coming?

name: SAM
dialogue: Can you make one?

name: MATT
dialogue: As you guys actually glance over, you can see in the eastern sky, past the Iron Seat Ridge, there is an extremely dark, building stormfront that is just looming, miles off in the distance.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: See? Told you.

name: SAM
dialogue: What about-- Kiki, what if you just made some lightning strikes to signal the start of the fight?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think nature itself is going to make some lightning strikes.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, I've got my whole Skywrite thing. I've got my whole Skywrite thing; I can make a symbol in the air out of clouds, which isn't as terrifying as everyone has thought it is in the past. We just need to pick a symbol--

name: LAURA
dialogue: It just has to be subtle, something your dad will recognize, huh?

name: MARY
dialogue: A phoenix or something.

name: WILL
dialogue: How is the storm going to affect your attack, is my question.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We are trained to undergo warfare in many different forms of terrain and weather."

name: MARY
dialogue: My concern is that if we wait until this storm comes in, the sewers will be flooded. We need to go in now before the storm gets here.

name: WILL
dialogue: But if we get lost in there and the storm comes, it'll be flooded while we're in there.

name: SAM
dialogue: The storm isn't a real storm, isn't it Air Ashari?

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, no, no, it's Air Ashari.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: But it's still a real storm.

name: MATT
dialogue: "If there is rain to come with the storm, that is fortuitous, for much of the city still "burns. But fire we can quell with a storm would be helpful."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's a-coming man. It's coming.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Right, good to know this."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, let's go.

name: SAM
dialogue: To Greyskull Keep?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Look for-- Keep your eye on the sky.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I will have two of my hawkeyes keeping an eye at the clouds"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: There will be a symbol. It will be super obvious when it's determined. You'll be like, "Oh, "of course, it couldn't have been anything else". When you see it.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I look forward to solving your riddle. You as well, stay safe."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Don't know what the fuck it's going to be. It could be a big "VM" for Vox Machina, I mean like you know-- We could be like, Now! Fucking attack!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Are there clouds overhead now? Above the city.

name: MATT
dialogue: If you look up, it's-- the weather over here's been fairly clear. There are a few wispy white clouds, but nothing that is indicative of a storm, yet.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: If the storm has taken the city, there will be a break in the storm, of a perfect circle, where we are attacking--

name: WILL
dialogue: The eye of a hurricane.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The eye of a hurricane. If it is not a force, we can certainly look for it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And if the skies are clear, they'll not be clear.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It will be a nice column that will--

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right. Then--"

name: WILL
dialogue: Look for the stillness in the storm.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We shall. Travel safe, travel swift."

name: MARY
dialogue: Safe journey.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You as well, good luck."

name: SAM
dialogue: Be pleased. Remember, the plan is chaos.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Total chaos.

name: WILL
dialogue: Chaos can work.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Chaos works very well.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We make our way to Greyskull.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Back to Greyskull.

dialogue: All right. As you guys make your way towards Greyskull Keep. name: LAURA
dialogue: I wink.

name: WILL
dialogue: Dale? Where you been, man?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Wait! Kash?"

name: WILL
dialogue: What the hell's going on?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Going to die today, what are you doing?"

name: WILL
dialogue: Pretty much the same thing man, how's Anne?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Anne's not doing too well."

name: WILL
dialogue: Aw, I'm sorry to hear that.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yeah, she was in the city when the dragons attacked."

name: WILL
dialogue: No! She wasn't.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yeah."

name: WILL
dialogue: Oh, that's horrible!

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's okay, we're going to kill them today, right?"

name: WILL
dialogue: We're getting there buddy. Good to see you, you're looking good.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Good to see you too, you too!"

name: WILL
dialogue: All right, I'll see you later, man.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right."

name: WILL
dialogue: That was-- I haven't seen that guy in forever. So bizarre. Sorry, let's go.

name: SAM
dialogue: Small world man, small world.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And we're walking and we're walking and we're walking.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I feel like I've had that awkward four minutes of like every con ever. Oh god!

dialogue: As you guys exit the side ranks of the current encampment, as they are all preparing, the sun itself growing maybe about two hours out from touching the horizon, you can see, in the distance, on some of the outer embankment and small structures that litter the walls of Emon's surrounding fields, you see Greyskull Keep, a very welcoming, longtime coming return. name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh shit. Oh shit, oh shit. You roll a 20. And then you--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, natural 20!

name: MATT
dialogue: Nice!

name: SAM
dialogue: Natural 20 right here as well.

dialogue: Really? Eh! Natural 20 bros!

dialogue: Natural 19, I haven't added yet.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Fuck you.

dialogue: Ten!

dialogue: Should I cast Pass Without a Trace on all of us? Is it too late? Can I just add it to everybody's if I cast it now?

dialogue: As you guys were going stealthy, I'll say sure. Because you would have known, at this point to do so. If you want to spend your spell slot to do that, sure.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I do.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And that's plus ten, right?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, it adds ten to all of your rolls.

name: LIAM
dialogue: 35, now.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: 35, 35 with the plus ten. 35.

dialogue: (coughing) Sorry, I so inhaled my spit, keep going.

dialogue: Don't do that. That's bad.

name: WILL
dialogue: Make a breathing saving throw.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (coughing) I'm still dying for a second. Go on, guys.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I rolled double ones. (wheezing)

dialogue: You guys make your way to Greyskull Keep, front door's open. Like, partially ajar. Not locked.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I move in, forward.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, you head inside first.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm going to poke my head in first.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a perception check.

dialogue: You take a moment and look around, listen carefully. No sound.

name: LIAM
dialogue: So far so good. I'm going to move further in. And continue to-- I'm going to check for traps.

name: MATT
dialogue: Go for it. Investigation check.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Fine, sure, investigation is an 18.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Nothing appears to be trapped here. If anything is out of place, you know this area pretty well, so.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We're making our way to the doorway, we peek in now.

name: MARY
dialogue: Is it very dark in there?

name: MATT
dialogue: There are no current set torches or candlelight whatsoever, there are a few openings that bring some light in. Specifically from Sarenrae's temple. But other than that, it is pretty dark in the hallways.

name: MARY
dialogue: Can I see anything with darkvision?

name: MATT
dialogue: With darkvision, you're fine. As you guys glance around and begin to scatter throughout the keep, you can see signs that it has been lived in. name: LIAM
dialogue: Like, the whole place?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LIAM
dialogue: So all the way up the stairs, to our bedrooms, to his laboratory, all that's clear?

name: MATT
dialogue: All of it's empty, but a lot of things have been taken.

name: SAM
dialogue: Can I go in the kitchen and just sort of sense magic, or do an arcana check or something, to see if there's any--

name: MATT
dialogue: There is a Detect Magic spell, if you have that.

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't have that.

name: MATT
dialogue: Then you would be hard-pressed to detect if it's present necessarily.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Is your poop still around?

name: SAM
dialogue: My poop is still there, it's just inert. It's just poop.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Did somebody steal the poop?

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, is it still there in the jar that I left it in?

name: MATT
dialogue: Actually, there is a broken jar on the ground. It looks like somebody discovered it and wasn't quite sure what it was, and then discovered what it was.

name: MARY
dialogue: This isn't pudding! (laughter)

name: LIAM
dialogue: This single scoop tastes funny.

name: MARY
dialogue: Gelato? (retches)

name: MATT
dialogue: The behavioral patterns of the way things are left, it looks like people have come in through, rummaged, grabbed what they needed to survive, or what seemed of value, and left. name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I figured.

name: MATT
dialogue: Your cask is still there. And a few esoteric tools that they didn't really understand, or too big to maneuver, are still there. But most of your toolset is gone.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Grabbing what's useful, and maybe as a lark I might try and run a wire from my inert glove to Cabal's Ruin to see if I can actually get the charge to travel through it if I punch something.

name: MATT
dialogue: If you want to use one of the charges, you can try that.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yeah, I'll use a charge-- I'll hold. I'll find out in the moment, won't I?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, that you will.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Try it on the day.

name: WILL
dialogue: Is this your castle?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, this is our house. This is our keep.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's a keep, not a castle.

name: MARY
dialogue: This is lovely. It's a little cold.

name: SAM
dialogue: But it's seen better days.

name: MARY
dialogue: But the bones are good.

name: WILL
dialogue: Lot of space.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's a fixer-upper.

name: MARY
dialogue: Good location.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm going downstairs to the entrance, and I'm going to check it out. And use Divine Sense at the entrance.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, make an investigation check.

name: LIAM
dialogue: All right. That's good. That is a 24.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Divine Sense doesn't trigger anything off. Nothing gets you riled up in that sense.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Feathers are in place?

name: MATT
dialogue: Indeed, yes. Except the two that were cut earlier from Kashaw. But you do find the hidden entrance, or the exit I guess you could say from the keep, left as it was, untouched. The seam still smooth, covered in dust.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Nothing hinky with it?

name: MATT
dialogue: Nothing hinky, no traps.

name: SAM
dialogue: Let's go down to the secret path. We're in a hurry now, we've got to get into the city.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, I show Kashaw the cask, by the way. I have some powdered death, if you like. This will explode very loudly.

name: WILL
dialogue: How much damage?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You know, I've honestly been too nervous to ever find out. Because everybody who plays with this loses a limb eventually.

name: WILL
dialogue: Is it heavy?

name: MATT
dialogue: You hear this faint echoing voice in the back of your head that says, "Learn from my mistakes..." (laughter)

name: WILL
dialogue: I say we bring it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's my plan.

name: SAM
dialogue: Can I just give you a quick note? Planning Kashaw is very staccato. He's very clipped. I feel like when you're just talking normally, you're so warm and pleasant. name: WILL
dialogue: (breathes) Let's go. (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: To the tunnels.

dialogue: All right. Grog happily takes the cask under his arm.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Don't drink that, Grog.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh come on! One--"

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, none of it. No-- (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: "Okay."

name: MARY
dialogue: He could fart explosives if he did.

name: SAM
dialogue: Matt's Grog and Matt's Trinket are very similar.

name: MATT
dialogue: To be fair. You guys all-- single-file, because this tunnel is not very wide, it's maybe four feet wide-- you make your way through and it's a long, musty tunnel. It smells of damp earth and dust.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We need to pass out these healing potions before we get anywhere.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, why don't everybody bunch up for a second then?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah.

dialogue: Is there light in there? Do you need light, are there torches?

name: MATT
dialogue: There is no light.

name: MARY
dialogue: I cast Light.

dialogue: All right, we have three greater healings, five regular healings, and two superiors. Who needs what?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'll take a greater.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Superior, please. I'm weak as fuck.

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right, take one.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'd like to take a greater as well, because I'm always far away.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Greater for me." Grog raises his hand.

name: LAURA
dialogue: He wants one? MATT "Please." You want a greater or--

dialogue: "Yes, please."

dialogue: Okay, we have one greater left. Five regulars, so I'll pass out regulars to-- Do you need any? You, you--

name: WILL
dialogue: I should be okay with healing, but if you'd like I'll take one.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm all right. I still have a couple.

name: MARY
dialogue: I have one normal, and two greater, and one superior.

dialogue: There's one superior left. Oh, you already have a superior?

dialogue: I have a superior, two greater, and one normal.

dialogue: Oh shit. You have a fuckton of potions!

dialogue: I'll take a superior and one of them fire resistance, please.

dialogue: Take the superior, Scanlan.

dialogue: I need the stuff.

dialogue: Zero superior and four fire potions. I'm taking one of the fire potions as well, so that's three fire potions left.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: If I could have a fire potion?

dialogue: Yes, two fire potions left.

dialogue: Should Pike have a fire potion?

dialogue: Pike has fire resistance.

dialogue: I don't know, I've only met her once.

dialogue: I would love a fire resistance potion, if one exists.

dialogue: Of course darling, whatever you need.

dialogue: You want to take two regulars?

dialogue: Sure.

dialogue: I'll take the fire resistance. All right, one fire resistance.

dialogue: As you guys are awkwardly passing this down this singular tunnel, having to almost chain it back and forth.

dialogue: I load up Grog's camelback with healing potions.

dialogue: Now, the potion of invulnerability. Is there someone specific we need to give that to?

dialogue: "It sounds really neat."

dialogue: Well, Grog already halves all of his damage.
