name: MARISHA
dialogue: Definitely not true.

name: LIAM
dialogue: That's full bullshit.

name: SAM
dialogue: What? You think you care about me?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yes.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes, asshole! Yes.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, I'm sorry, you're right. You like me because I make jokes, and I play songs, and I give you a warm place to stay at night, and I feed you fucking chicken, and I heal you in battle. But you don't really care about me. Come on. Let's be honest with each other. You don't really give a shit about me.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I've changed my outlook on life because of you! What the fuck are you talking about? Of course we all love you--

name: SAM
dialogue: Prove it.

name: SAM
dialogue: Prove it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: How?

name: LAURA
dialogue: What do you want us to do?

name: SAM
dialogue: We traveled into the fucking nine hells to get Pike a set of armor. We went and battled a city of vampires so Percy could feel good about his name. We fought goliaths for Grog. We've traveled across planes of existence so you could fix your fucking daddy issues. But you've never done anything for me. Ever! You've never risked anything, you don't know me, you don't know anything about me. What's my mother's name? What's her name? Easy question. Died in front of me. Killed by a goblin. Biggest part of my life. What's her name? My father. Is he alive or dead? How old am I? Where's my fucking dog?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We did get the dog.

name: SAM
dialogue: You don't care about me.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We did get your dog.

name: SAM
dialogue: Did you?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, we didn't.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We did, I searched--

name: LIAM
dialogue: I've asked your age.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I thought I did the magic search. Fucking hell.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's fine. I'm just a little hungover from being dead, and I just have been thinking for a while, and, you know. Grog has Pike. Vax has Keyleth. Percy has Vex. But Scanlan has no one, and I had one chance at one real relationship with my daughter, and I feel like you've gone and fucked it up, too. Because you don't really know me, and you don't really know what my relationship is with her, and what I've promised her, or anything, really. And it's fine. When I met you all, I was just a funny little man playing songs, and that's all I'll ever really be. And that's okay, because I can take care of myself.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You don't have to, Scanlan. Nobody knew that any of this was going on. How many times have we asked you if you're all right and you just laugh and joke? We can't help you if you don't tell us what's going on.

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't need your help.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, apparently you do, darling.

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't like that very much at all.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Get used to it. Nobody likes needing someone.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Scanlan, do you think any of us could have gotten here without each other? I thought you knew that more than the rest of us. Maybe we just thought you didn't need us as much as you felt like we didn't.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I thought you were the only one who had everything figured out.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I did too.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well then, I must be a very good liar.

name: MARISHA, LAURA
dialogue: You are.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I thought for months, what haven't I got figured out that Scanlan has got figured out? I've been trapped in the mud for months, wondering what I could do to get where you are. Scanlan, you fucking saved the world with us. If your daughter can't see that, then she can't see anything.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah. If you really respected me, you wouldn't pick me up like some sort of dwarf and pick me up and put me down and take off your fucking armor and treat me like a fucking child.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You've thrown some of us like baseballs. I don't know what that is.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Scanlan. Do you wish we wouldn't have brought you back? Should we not have done that?

name: SAM
dialogue: I just wish you wouldn't have brought her into this.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Scanlan--

name: SAM
dialogue: I had one shot with her, and now how will I ever show her that I can be trusted? How will I ever show her that I can protect her?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, maybe you should fucking talk to her.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, you're a better father than most of us have ever had.

name: SAM
dialogue: You're right. I should talk to her.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You should!

name: SAM
dialogue: I should! I should. And I will.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Don't treat her like a fucking sacred object, treat her like a daughter, Scanlan.

name: SAM
dialogue: Fine. You're right. I will. I will. I'll talk to her. Listen. I don't know what adventure we're going on next, but I think you should go without me.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Really?

name: SAM
dialogue: Vex is right. I should talk to her. I should be here for her. I don't know why I wasn't with her in the first place. I didn't need to go with you to kill the dragons. I should've just been with her in the first place. Probably just scared to. I should just be her father and stay.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Can I ask you a question?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah. No, I will not go whoring with you one more time.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No. I was gonna ask you what your mother's name is.

name: SAM
dialogue: It was Juniper.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'm sorry I didn't know that.

name: SAM
dialogue: Thank you for asking.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Is your father still alive?

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't really know. He makes things. Made things, I don't know. His name is Vicou.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'm glad you're back. Whatever you want to do now that you are... it's up to you, mate.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm sorry if we had selfish intentions.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We did have selfish in--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah. Grog knows what I'm trying to say.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We didn't think about those things. We didn't. We thought about what you meant to us. It may not feel like much, to us it feels like a bit, but now that you're here...

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Scanlan, as much as you can say that you were just the funny guy who played music and made jokes, I don't think you realize how desperately we need that. That's nothing to scoff at, that's not a talent that many of us naturally possess. You've taught me so much about the brightness of the world, and to look at the light side of things.

name: SAM
dialogue: I guess it's just easier to laugh at the world when you don't care about it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's not true. You do care.

name: SAM
dialogue: I know.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's why he's an asshole now.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We've never had one conversation, you and I, about my mother. Where my sister and I came from. Did you know Thordak killed her?

name: SAM
dialogue: I think that's come up.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We've never talked about it. Not once. Because I didn't want to talk about it. I didn't push into your private life. If you wanted to talk to me, and you did, about your daughter. We did. We talked in the sewers of Westruun about your daughter because you wanted to talk about her. We love you, Scanlan, and if you want to talk about your mother or your father, we will. You have not been exactly forthcoming.

name: SAM
dialogue: That's fair. I haven't been. But I also don't-- I don't have anyone. I have to take care of myself. That's all.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We have survived a fucking hellscape. All of us.

name: SAM
dialogue: (quietly) I didn't.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You are standing before me, talking to me. You did.

name: SAM
dialogue: I did not. I died. Twice.

name: LIAM
dialogue: That's fucking semantics, Shorthalt.

name: SAM
dialogue: In a row.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You've been brought back. You're standing here. Your daughter is there and needs you.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm being kept alive by some fucked-up weird magic. Before I met you people, I would have never-- the worst I would have gotten in is a bar fight. And I would have won. 'Cause I would have been a liar and a cheater. And now, I didn't help any of you in the last fight. I didn't do anything. The fight before that, I didn't do anything--

name: LIAM
dialogue: What about the fight before that?

name: SAM
dialogue: -- I'm useless!

name: LAURA
dialogue: (tiredly) No, you're not.

name: SAM
dialogue: -- I'm out of my league. I'm out of my league. Listen, it was fun. It's fun. It really has been fun to travel with six legends. It's fun. It's fun to say that your friends are legendary fighters. It's fun!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Excuse me! Speaking as someone who has been fucking depressed for a long time-- Look me in the eye. I was shit for months. And you are one of the main reasons I am out of that now. We would be dead, all of us, if it weren't for you. The first time we fought Raishan, we would all be dead. You are in a pity party right now, and I know you're hurting, and I'm sorry you're hurting, and I love you. But you are lying to yourself, that you have been no use to us. You are lying to yourself. If you wanna retire, if you wanna go off with your daughter, that's fucking wonderful. I encourage you to do it. But don't lie to yourself.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, that's just it. I'm a really good liar.

name: LIAM
dialogue: (pleading) Scanlan.

name: SAM
dialogue: Just give me some time.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (timidly) Hey-- hey, guys? We're friends, right? Are we friends?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Worse, family.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Family.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's fair.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And for fuck's sake, sir, I will say I died in that fight too.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's not fun, is it?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No. And let me tell you something. Whatever lie you were trying to feed your daughter out there about the man she thought you might be, that you just thought you could tell her and then she would walk away and never actually meet you or get to know you. So that maybe she would never see what a shit you can be. And you can be a shit. That fucking girl out there is a shit too. She's a miserable, lying shit. And for fuck's sake, the thing that brought her back here was the things about you that you don't like about yourself. And don't think that they don't count, either. You're a shitty person, we know! That's not the fucking point. The point is for just one moment-- one moment-- once in a blue bloody moon... You come through in a way that others can't. And you do it, and we love you for it, and you are worthwhile, there's a reason we just nearly went mad trying to bring you back. And it was not pity. And we didn't bring her-- we brought her here so that maybe she would snap you out of wherever the fuck you were going to. And I know you're not out of there yet, I've been where you are and I know it's shit. And I would really recommend, as somebody who misses an awful lot of people, that you are honest with that girl and maybe discover that she actually likes you. As a person. Because you are actually likeable as a person! I know, it's coming out of my mouth. I can feel the shit from it but it's true. And for fuck's sake, get to know her and stop making false promises that you can protect her, and you'll always be there. 'Cause you can't and you won't. No one can. And you're fucking lying! And it's sick. Be a man. Be a man. I've seen you be a man, I know you can fucking do it. And when you're done with that, and we will leave you with that fucking shit girl, I would like you to look up my parents' name. You can find it on every fifth hallway in this fucking city. And then I'm out.

name: MATT
dialogue: (hoarsely) You leave the room?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Mm-hm.

name: MATT
dialogue: (clears throat) Okay. As you push the door open-- it's still partially ajar-- and as you push it open, leaning against the wall just by the door is Kaylie, and you can see she has tears streaming down her face.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I give her a big hug, a kiss on the forehead--

name: MATT
dialogue: She doesn't let you. As soon as you go for it, she just kind of smacks it away--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (makes an air kissing noise)

name: MATT
dialogue: --turns into the room, and just kind of walks past everyone and grabs her bag off the ground. Slings it over her shoulder, grabs her violin case. "So, you coming?"

name: SAM
dialogue: ...Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Grab your things. Be waiting for you downstairs." And she walks out.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Really? Just like that?

name: SAM
dialogue: I have to.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Where're you going to go? What're you going to do?

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm just gonna be a Shorthalt for a while. And I'm just gonna figure out what that means. And... it's great being part of a team, but you gotta know who you are first. So I gotta go figure that out. And I gotta go figure out what she is, too. And when I do, I'll come back and find you. And if you really need a place to stay, I'll advise you to buy some tents, 'cause you won't have a mansion anymore. I know you'll be fine 'cause you all have each other, but for now, I just need to have me for a while. I love you all. I even love Percy... and his parents, Frederick and Johanna. And I'll go with Kaylie.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Wait. I reach into the Bag of Holding and I grab my salt-lick rock and I toss it to Scanlan.

name: SAM
dialogue: What's this?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It's yours now. When you miss us-- I know you will-- give it a lick.

name: SAM
dialogue: (choked) All right, I will.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I grab the Gatestone off the end table where we left it with him and hand it over to you as well.

name: SAM
dialogue: You'll need this.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'd rather it go to you.

name: SAM
dialogue: When Vex tries to give you something, you take it. All right. Don't die.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Scanlan... We'll miss you.

name: SAM
dialogue: (exhales) I hope so. And... well, you said I was right. Let's pick up that conversation later. I'll go out the door.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. As he walks down the hall, you hear his feet across the stonework echo quieter and quieter until you can't hear it anymore, and you all stand in stunned silence in the chamber.

name: LIAM
dialogue: (draws in a breath) Fuck.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I just pick up a pillow and throw it at the door.

name: MATT
dialogue: It opens slightly. The pillow lays on the ground smattered with vanilla pudding.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Did he take all his things with him?

name: MATT
dialogue: I would say he would've grabbed his things as he left, yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, that didn't go like I thought it would.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No. No it didn't.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Kinda wish we would've gone drinking in Vasselheim now.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We might've missed him if we had.

name: LIAM
dialogue: (wearily) We saved the continent, why does everything feel like shit?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: He's alive. That's what really matters.

name: LIAM
dialogue: But he's our liar, Grog.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (tearily) And he hates us, now.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He doesn't hate us. I just... think we've all just discovered that maybe we have a lot more secrets about ourselves than we've all ever let on.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: He needs time. We have that.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (angrily) Fuck him! Fuck him for not saying anything sooner.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I dunno.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And fuck us for not asking. (sniffs)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I think Percy's right. We're worse than friends, we're family. And family leaves.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes. They do.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can we not be family? Can we, like, redact that?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I don't think so. I think it's too late.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I step out into the hallway. Do I see Percy at all?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm around the corner, up on the--

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm outside of-- If you went far enough, you'd see me.

name: MATT
dialogue: You eventually find Percy, yeah.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Hey.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Hi.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Rough one, that. Question:

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yeah.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Do you have any, like, sneaky people in your employ here in the castle.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: 'Course.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Wouldn't you feel better if we had someone just keeping an eye on them? Bit explosive, the two of them together.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm torn. I don't know if he'd like that.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I don't know if I care. (laughs)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't know if I do, either. I keep thinking, I could just shout right now and half a dozen guards would stop them.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah. It'd be half a dozen dead guards, though.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, what's half a dozen dead guards these days?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Good point.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There's tale of a brothel in the west end of Whitestone. I don't know if it still exists but I'm sure if you go drinking in that area, you might find something. Sorry.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No, yeah. Yeah. I'll go give it a look.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: When you're in the mood.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Now's good. Yeah, I'll be back after nightfall. Gonna go out for a bit.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Grog.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I know we don't always agree, and I know that I can be unkind but... you know you're family, right?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I don't know much, but I do know that.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's nice having an older brother again.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I leave.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So what, just-- the half-elves are left alone in a room covered in pudding?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. (all laugh) Yeah, basically.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Way to paint a tableau.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Crying.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. Crying in your pudding.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Angry.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think 'crying in your pudding' is actually a British saying.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do you think that if we would've not covered the room in pudding, that he would have stayed?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I start cleaning it up. Well, he seemed pretty pissed that I went and got Kaylie, even though he ran away with her at the first chance he had.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And you had to stay in a shitty BnB, a brothel and-- (laughs)

name: MATT
dialogue: You see that Pike is still kinda shaking her fist in the corner right now. She doesn't say anything during this whole exchange.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Pike--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Pike, are you okay?

name: LIAM
dialogue: How you doing, Pickle?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, right, Pike. Right.

name: MATT
dialogue: He needs to do this... Right? He needs to do this.

name: LAURA
dialogue: He says he does.

name: MATT
dialogue: What do we need to do?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I have no fucking clue.

name: MATT
dialogue: I need to get a drink.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah. We could always go back to Vasselheim and pick up on that little drinking.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm not gonna go anywhere, Keyleth.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I don't wanna go back to Vasselheim.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I mean, we can drink anywhere. Vasselheim doesn't have to be in that equation.

name: MATT
dialogue: Where else do we have to go? Away from here. I just want to be away from here.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Pike--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I have to go to the water ashari. I have to.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And before too long, we have a demon who wants you and I dead in the night. We have to deal with it.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. Anything else?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Pike, you know the Ozmit Sea. You've sailed it, yeah?

name: MATT
dialogue: It's been a while, but yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We might need you for the water ashari.

name: MATT
dialogue: I can do that.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Seems like-- I guess all of us are picking up on our own individual paths from here? I guess.

name: MATT
dialogue: Why can't we still help each other out?

name: LIAM
dialogue: We can. Of course we can. Pike...

name: MATT
dialogue: His path is his own. He has to do his thing alone. We don't have to be alone.

name: LIAM
dialogue: No. No, we don't. We just wanna slow things down for a while. It's been a long couple of months.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Is Scanlan right? Have we become too close to each other? Do we need to all take our individual time like we've done in the past?

name: LIAM
dialogue: No, we just need to not have our lives on the line every day. For a little while. Or ever. Retirement's not a terrible idea. I mean, what's the takeaway here, from Scanlan? Can't hold anything in. Fuck. You know that I've always looked up to you, for everything? That I've tried to model myself after you. Do you know that? And you. You know that she's my best friend, right? You know that.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: 'Course.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You know that I'm madly in love with her, right? You know that, right? We don't need to joke about it or dance around it anymore. You know that I'm in love with her, right?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Obviously.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Obviously.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What are you getting at, Vax?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I just don't-- He left because he felt like we didn't know him. I'm scared to death about what I have to give to a fucking god, eventually. I'm scared of that. I don't want to do that, but it's going to happen, and it's destiny. I'm scared about that. There. That's out. Do you have anything that you're holding in? You're in love with Percival. We all know that, right? It's plain as day, right?

name: LAURA
dialogue: My take-away from Scanlan is that we all talk too much. And I leave the room.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And then I look at Vax and Percy, and say--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, I'm not there.

name: MATT
dialogue: Percy's not there

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, sorry. Vax and--

name: MATT
dialogue: Pike.

name: SAM
dialogue: They're all individually going to the room next door. (all laugh)

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, they're all just congregating in the next chamber.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And that's where Scanlan's waiting.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's like a Black Mirror episode

name: SAM
dialogue: Everyone's reading highlights.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Crack out the aerator, yo.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Highlights.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Blacklight.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's the basement in Westworld. We all just go catatonic.

name: MATT
dialogue: Pike kinda walks up to you as they walk out of the room and puts her gauntleted hand on your shoulder and just says, "We all make mistakes, I make 'em a lot."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: You have a lot of other people to look up to, aside from just me.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I've learned that.

name: MATT
dialogue: His path is his own. And he'll come back. Right?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I don't know. But he's our friend. I like having him around.

name: MATT
dialogue: Me too. (sighs) Let's get a drink.

name: LIAM
dialogue: What? MATT Let's get a drink. Let's get a drink. You wanna go in town?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LIAM
dialogue: All right.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I chase down Vex, and we do the same thing.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys all individually find your way through the rest of the afternoon to discuss, cope with and ruminate on the separation of Scanlan. Going through all the different emotions you feel that are necessary, and whatever activities you proceed to distract yourself with. Grog.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (laughs) Crying in a corner.

name: LIAM
dialogue: (mock-crying)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Crying on bosoms. (mock-crying) (all laugh) I'll pay for this.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yes, you will. That's extra. (all laugh) And strangely not uncommon.

name: LIAM
dialogue: He's wrapping up the show, I can tell. So I came to give Sam a hug.

name: LAURA
dialogue: He's not! No, he's not!

name: MATT
dialogue: He's not, actually. I don't know where you got that idea.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, I was just getting in a mid-game hug.

name: MATT
dialogue: There you go! (laughs)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: This is awkward.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys still got shit to do.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Guys, no. Stop it.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys made promises, you're still on a timeline for some things.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: You still have things to do.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No, we know.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We know.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We know.

name: MATT
dialogue: Don't take that as Sam closing the curtain here. Still got shit to do.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I know, but... I craved that, so I took it.

name: MATT
dialogue: No, that's okay. Cross-table hugs are fine.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That was weird.

name: MATT
dialogue: The next morning comes around, you're all in various states of hungover; should you have chosen to imbibe with the rest of the party.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Heavily.

name: MATT
dialogue: Grog eventually wanders in, less hungover but more meek about how his previous day was.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Not my best night.

dialogue: You've got your safety tags.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Let's do it, let's--

dialogue: All right, let's go.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right.

dialogue: It's a traditional Ashari tradition.

name: LIAM

name: LAURA

dialogue: (laughs) You guys find your way to the Sun Tree. Utilizing Transport via Plants you find yourself (teleportation sound) thrust through the trunk of the Sun Tree, and emerging on the opposite side, on the cusp of a deep bowl-like valley that goes probably for a good mile and a half, or two miles across, before you reach the other side of this crest.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Tary! That's two times! You've teleported two times.

name: SAM
dialogue: (gasps) Oh my god, every time it's amazing. Wow, thank you. Thank you all. Where are we?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Uh.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well.

dialogue: Central Cliffkeep.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We are in the central Cliffkeep

name: SAM
dialogue: Of?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Of Tal'Dorei. And of the central-- Of the Cliffkeep Mountains.

name: SAM
dialogue: So cool.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah! (all laugh)

name: MATT
dialogue: You glance around, and there are the edges of a forest here. A lot of them are stockier trees, and things that live in harsh environments, and a lot of them are rooted in cracks in the ground, and portions of the rock that have split open. Down within this valley, you can already see what appear to be dozens and dozens of trenches, that seem to have been dug. And there are areas of this valley that appear to have eroded or collapsed. Like small, long rockslides that are just kind of dotting the edges of the mountain walls. Down towards the center you can see, also, a cluster of dozens and dozens of small abodes, it looks like. Homes, huts, structures made of rock. This is Terra, this is the Earth Ashari village here. Currently guarding over the localized rift to the Earth Elemental plane. You guys are traversing down into it?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yep

name: MATT
dialogue: It takes you a short time, you find one of the paths that kinda zigzags down the side of this mountain drop, and make your way in towards the center. The sun is now-- I'd say at this time, just over the very top, kind of noon-ish portion of the day. You begin to walk your way in and it's very warm here, partially because the-- It's northern enough where usually it's a colder temperature on the island-- Don't you even, you motherfucker.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Wow. You lasered in on that like nobody's business!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (gunshots)

name: MATT
dialogue: I'm a little sensitive (all laugh) But the further down you get it is just-- The tree line has stopped and it is just rock, stone, that is reflecting the light and it is warm. You're starting to find yourself sweat in your full armor as you traverse deeper and deeper into the center of this mountain valley.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's always like 20 degrees warmer in the valley.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (laughs) Terrible.

name: MATT
dialogue: Disadvantage on the next roll. (all laugh)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: To get to Critical Role, take the 101 with the 5 to get up to Burbank to get to Critical Role.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: From beautiful downtown Burbank.

name: SAM

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: Exactly.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I like Tary.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are we killing these?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Stop-- No, no? These are-- Grog!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Sorry, but--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They're sending us to the things we're going to kill.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh! Okay.

name: MARISHA

name: MATT

dialogue: Lambchop-looking motherfucker.

name: SAM
dialogue: Just a stick. Just a stick. It doesn't do anything.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's from the walking company.

The two to the-- Flanking the central figure appear to be human, male and female, both very short, kind of tossed hair. Then at the center you see what appears to be a surprisingly short, but very stocky and thick, half orc female. As she approaches she has-- the hair is woven back into these thick braids that are pulled into a singular, what looks like a topknot, on the upper back of her skull. Her jaw protrudes a bit, you can see the two lower fangs kinda pushing past the lips.

name: MARISHA

dialogue: No, this is--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: All right.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Right.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Kaitiaki, Dryden.

name: MATT
dialogue: Kaitiaki.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: How are you?

name: MATT
dialogue: We are well.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Have you talked to Cerkonos or Korren at all?

name: MATT
dialogue: Not recently, no.

name: MARISHA

name: MATT

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: I will pass this along.

name: MATT
dialogue: To the Vesrah. Very well. I could help you with this information if need be.

dialogue: Is Patisse indisposed?

name: MATT
dialogue: No. No, right this way.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I mean it would just be nice to, like, say hi. While I'm here at least.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Very well." They turn around and begin to lead you back towards the outskirts of the city, not directly into Terra itself, but as you approach, and walk past, you can see the ground here-- every ten minutes or so you feel a sudden shift, and a slight quake beneath your feet. The landscape here, the closer you walk to the center of the village, seems to be in this perpetual state of shifting rock. And you watch as different areas kind of collide. Areas of stone kind of (cracking noise), and rocks tumble down. Parts of it break and crack and reform. At one point, as you guys are not maybe 200 feet out from the first major structures, the ground has one major spike. (loud rock slide) And you hear this heavy rolling rumble, and you watch as, maybe 300 feet off from the side, a new pinnacle is formed. Two big plates kind of (crack), jut upward, one kind of coasting over the other and coming to a halt. There is very heavy localized seismic activity as part of the proximity to the rift of the earth elemental plane here. And you watch as three druids come rushing out of the side of the Terra tribe, and as they focus, the rocks (crumbling noises) crumble back down and subside. The central mountain landscape, here, brought back to a momentary beat of peace and quiet.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm like a New Yorker on a subway.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. Just going straight in.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm just like, whatever. Used to this.

dialogue: Architexture?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Architexture.

name: MATT
dialogue: Right. As you progress inward, and some of the other Terra Ashari--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Shut your mouth, you wouldn't even know what architecture is!

name: MATT
dialogue: Different visual representations. Some appear to be more ornamental. Jewelry seems to be here, like jewels and metallics used, it seems to connote a level of prestige within the tribe, and every individual that walks, usually with a cluster or protectors around them, or at least, seems to be in a place of notable importance within groups, seems to be more adorned in this natural-based jewelry. name: LIAM

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Rockcaller. Rockcaller. Oh Jerry! How you been? How's the kids?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Jerry! Jerry!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Jerry! JERRY!

dialogue: What looks to be a heavy wooden doorway, built out of a series of tree trunks that are strapped to this one area. But it seems to reside from the center of the cheeks and through the jowls and then crosses across the neck and then across the arms all the way down to the fingertips.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (quietly) Tight.

name: MATT
dialogue: And there are certain portions which are broken up by hard lines, it's like this parallel intersection multiple times as the tattoo progresses down. Very, very loose, almost a flowing central shoulder-based robe that tosses down the front of the body and meets with a long skirt that drags behind him as he steps out. And as he looks over in the direction of you, you can see the eyes are very hardened, dark, deep brown in color, and the sockets are very weathered, his skin texture in general is pretty weathered. He looks over towards you, clean-shaven, short white hair, puts a hand up. "Keyleth, you grace the Terra with your presence. What can we be of service to you for?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I stand more in attention, more formal. Good to see you, Patisse, it's been quite some time.

name: MATT
dialogue: You as well.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I just came to check in after the recent events in the world, make sure everyone was okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: Everything seems to be fine. We've been intent of care to the rift, and from the word that seems to have passed quickly since your arrival over the past few days, it's come to our attention that Thordak no longer sits in the center of the city of Emon.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's correct. We've also slain his right-hand man, Raishan, who seemed to be the mastermind of the entire orchestration.

name: MATT
dialogue: Good. Good and well done.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Thank you. I couldn't have done it without your help and training, so I appreciate that.

name: MATT
dialogue: You are but a seed, you allowed it to germinate. So what do you need?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, I'm intent on continuing on with my Aramente now that there's relative peace in the world. The Vesrah people are quite insular, of course. I was wondering if you could give me some advice on how to get there and any advice in general on dealing with them?

name: MATT
dialogue: It has been a long time since I've attended any sort of gathering with the Vesrah. It is for people of our skill set not the easiest of journeys, as many of us are capable of traversing through the sentinels of nature. Unfortunately, most of the tree life that exists around Vesrah is beneath the water.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Right.

name: MATT
dialogue: So your most likely form of transport will be that of a vessel across the waves.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Who's their headmaster there now? Do you know?

name: MATT
dialogue: The headmaster there-- Uvenda, the heart of the tides.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Uvenda.

name: MATT
dialogue: Uvenda.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Uvenda, the heart of the tides. What can I expect of this Uvenda? Uvenda.

name: MATT
dialogue: Not what you'd expect. I'll leave it at that.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's very vague of you, Patisse.

name: MATT
dialogue: Well, what would be the fun if I were to unveil the next fold of your Aramente?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No, you've got a point. Do you recommend by ship or would flight be more appropriate?

name: MATT
dialogue: If you have the means, that is up to you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: All right. Any other words of encouragement?

name: MATT

name: SAM

name: MATT
dialogue: Good, keep it that way.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He's new.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can I ask a question? Is that all right?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Of course.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Is it polite?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: (quietly) Hi, sorry. You mentioned that the water Ashari live under the water.

name: MATT
dialogue: They don't live beneath the water, not entirely.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay, I thought maybe they were like mer-people or something, I wasn't sure.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That would be awesome.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, right? That'd be really cool.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Cool. So we'll see them above land then if we're flying.

name: MATT
dialogue: Some of them, yes.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Some of them. All right, that was my question. Thank you for your answer. Thank you.

dialogue: Are there any other landmarks or ways of navigation to find them? They're an island in the middle of the Ozmit sea.

name: MATT
dialogue: It's not the island of usual appearance. The beaches and sands of Vesrah are built upon a great circular reef. And part of the city lies above, part of it lies below.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (quietly) Sick.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (quietly) Awesome.

name: MATT
dialogue: Look for the white sands beneath the surface. Some structures will be visible from above. It would lie quite a ways to the southwest, not too far from the Hespit. I would recommend perhaps procuring the service of someone who knows the sea well.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes. We were going to look into trying to do that. Well, is there anything you need from me, Patisse, before we head on?

name: MATT
dialogue: No. Just do your best to have your friends keep the location of our village to themselves.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Don't worry, we have many places we'd prefer to keep this way.

name: MATT
dialogue: Good. I trust you all. Safe journeys. Keep her safe.

name: TALIESIN

name: LAURA

dialogue: -- yeah, yeah. It's akin to the cinnamon challenge in a way. (all laugh)

dialogue: (coughs)

name: LAURA
dialogue: No. No, he won't claim him. What can we do?

dialogue: "The power that is at our disposal could perhaps bring him back, though his form may be "different than you recall."

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. The feathers scatter off as Keyleth is now returned to her half-elf image.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, yeah. Any--

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right." And she walks back to the altar, and you can see where there are a series of these statues. There's four of them in the center and there's one large statue in the center. name: MARISHA
dialogue: While she does this, I come over the earpiece and I say, Grog, Percy, quick, get back up to the central tower. Quick.

name: LAURA

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I am trusting that they are.

name: MATT
dialogue: With the distance of the earpiece, you can hear them. Yes.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We're on our way.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh thank god. Thank god. Is everyone still alive down there?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Barely. Yes, for the moment.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Vax is down. So hurry.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We're on our way.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you're finishing the statement, you watch as Uvenda is climbing down with one hand and has something cradled in her left arm as she's like (grunts), almost slips for a minute and sets herself down back on both her feet and rubs her lower back. "You'll get there one day."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Please hurry.

name: MATT
dialogue: And she unfurls her arm, and you can see there's a conch shell. A small conch shell, but a conch shell. And she goes, "Whoever you're wishing to speak to, think of them and whisper it into the shell."

name: MARISHA

name: LAURA
dialogue: How do we know if it worked?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah? I second that statement.

dialogue: "She'll hear you. It's up to her whether or not she can act." And she hands the conch over to one of the assistants, takes her staff back up. "Now, we offer the service still, should you not "hear anything. We are more than willing to try and restore him to whatever form we can."

name: LAURA
dialogue: How much time does-- How long is too long?

dialogue: I don't want to wait too long. Let's just wait a little while longer and see if we hear anything from Pike. She's very smart. She'll hear us.

name: MARISHA

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

dialogue: I don't care.

Eventually, you're led to sit in the center of this semi-circle, and as everyone gathers and takes their seat, you hear the occasional kid crying and people muttering to themself, and eventually everyone shushes as Korren, now wearing a very old ceremonial long light blue and white robe wearing what looks to be some sort of a somewhat tattered, like a scarf that's wrapped around his neck and drapes off each of his arms. It's thick and it's long and it almost touches the ground around him, but you can tell from the way he holds it, and his arms consistently rest at this crooked position that it has some symbolism to this ceremony. As he steps up under the tree and turns around everyone gets very quiet, and the wind seems to almost stop on the outside of this barrier. The rushing, perpetual gust of air seems to almost hold its breath for this. He clears his throat. And as he looks up to everyone, you swear this tree begins to slowly produce cherry blossoms as his words continue. "For long, we of the winds have awaited the procession of our "tradition. With the passing of our elder voice, Dwala, it was my wife Vilya who was selected to "take the Aramente. Beautiful and full of determination, she accepted her path. And while "she did not return to us, the destiny she set is now seen as one of preparation. Her journey was "not in vain, for it was her love that produced our daughter. It was her guidance in joy that taught "our child compassion. It was her discipline and understanding that forged young Keyleth's spark of "intuition and unlocked her adept connection with nature and the winds. We mourn the loss of our "Vilya, but take pride that she lives on in the eyes of our own, returned, beloved woman of the "winds. Here we bring together our collective voices to bless upon my daughter, the memory of "Vilya, the champion of Guasar, the mantle of our destiny." And as he puts his arms up, from around you to each side, Keyleth, you watch as young acolytes begin to approach from each side, arms down. All seemingly carrying these various pieces of dark green, leather-like material. And as they come together, they latch them into place and slowly build this mantle. "Ring clear our voices "to unite our breath and grant our strength to her guidance and wisdom, as Keyleth takes the rightful "and earned responsibility of leading our people into this next generation." At this point, the assembled mantle is placed into Korren's arms. And you now see this beautiful neck and shoulder piece that rests past to the elbows, but limp and without body, in his hands. As he holds it there and the rest of the acolytes step back and find their place, seated, he lifts his arms up a bit and begins to just sing a singular note (sings). And everyone around you in Zephra begins to join in in this singular note. Do you choose to join in as well?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Sure.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you do, the notes begin to separate and harmonize instinctually. It creates this symphony, this beautiful tangling of hundreds of voices from all across the spectrum. And what at first may seem to resemble a discordant hymn, finds this perfect spread of every note you've ever heard, musically merging as one. As he does this, instinctually, Keyleth, without even thinking, you rise and begin to walk towards him. Like the spirits of generations before you are lifting you by your shoulders and elbows, and bring you up before your father. You find the breath leave your lungs, the inside of your mouth is dry.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: You're unable to understand what it is that's driving you, but before you know it you're standing before your father, looking up into his eyes as all of these voices just swirl around you, this weird warmth. The nerves in your stomach still climb to the top and vibrate within your chest. As your father places this mantle over your head and shoulders, and it comes to rest on you, heavier than you expected, but it fits well. As he places this, the green fades to a golden brown and red and orange and yellow. And the green leaves almost drip back into a long, springing trail of a cloak behind you that seems to grow with each passing surge of these voices around her, until it reaches the ground and curls behind. Eventually the cloak stops. The voices soften, and come to silence, as you look up once more into your father's face. "Rise, my daughter, and become "Keyleth, Voice of the Tempest." He steps back and bows his head. Steps off the platform. And you stand and turn, and it's just you at the base of tree, looking about at all of Zephra before you, quiet, silent. And your friends before you, at the front of the crowd.

I couldn't have done any of this without not only the support of every person in Zephra, and every person of the Ashari tribe, members of Emon, Tal'Dorei, Marquet, even Wildmount. In my journeys, I've learned being a leader is a global effort, one that takes the wisdom of many. Most importantly, I couldn't have done any of this without Vox Machina. And the pieces of them that I've taken away and have desperately tried to emulate in each one of them over the years. Each one of them with qualities that I admire and strive to embrace. Grog, with his strength and his unyielding loyalty. Vex, with her self-confidence and utter fearlessness. Vax is one of the most compassionate people I think I've ever come across and one of the most brave, even if it's maybe foolish. Percival, with your intelligence and your sensibility, is always there to be my balance. Scanlan, with his charisma and his wit. Pike--

Every cherry blossom in the tree releases, and drifts past her from behind, before getting caught up in the wind just past her, causing this swirl of pinks and reds and whites behind her. Everyone around rises up, and they all begin to cheer and clap. All together. You look around and watch the rest of these blossoms slowly drift. You look and see your friends around you. You look around and you see your mother, out of the corner of your eye, just the memory of her. You sense that if she could be here, she would've been. Your father steps up and takes your hands and just says, "I'm so proud of "you. And there's much to be done, I know, but I'm proud of you." And he takes your hand, and holds it up once more. dialogue: I guess.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Primarily, the people of Zephra look to you for guidance when choices are hard, difficult."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You are the acting head of law, like I've been all this time. If there is conflict, if there "is difficulty, if there is a challenge that presents itself, that requires the wisdom of a "leader to step in--"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Right.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That's when you're called upon."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So, (sighs) I'm confused. Was the Aramente my training to be a leader? You apparently prepared me as best as you could before I left, I don't know how well you all did (sarcastic laugh). So I'm just wondering if I need to expect that again, is this just me figuring this out again? Or do I have guidance?

name: MATT
dialogue: "The nature of the Aramente is fluid. I have not taken it as I am not the leader. It is "tradition and it is both, as far as I understand, a series of challenges and lessons tailored to "whatever a person seems to be seeking or what you can draw from that, but also to interface with the "other tribes and establish that connection between all the leaderships."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I did that (laughs). You're right, you haven't taken it, but that's been about 5% of my journey, all of the lessons that I've learned have been in the in-between.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That is part of the Aramente itself."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I know. I guess... I don't know. Just trying to figure out how to navigate this, like the leader I'm expected to be. You know, Dad, you didn't tell me a lot about the world and sometimes I think I get angry at you for that.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You're not wrong to have these thoughts."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Why didn't you tell me that the world could be so cruel and mean? Why did you never tell me that?

name: MATT
dialogue: "We tried, but you can only tell someone so much. Do you not think we spent days warning you "of the dangers and difficulty? We didn't thrust you out in the world with a smile, going 'have fun.' "We told you it was challenging, we warned you of the people you might interface with that "you couldn't trust. And for the first legs of it, we had a few scouts keeping an eye."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Just to make sure you were safe."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay. It just sounds like it was advice coming from people who didn't really fully know.

name: MATT
dialogue: "To be fair, when every parent has a child come of age, you can only coddle them so far. "Every bird has to be kicked out of the nest for it to learn to fly. Not because we want to, but "because that's how things are."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I know, and I thank you for that. I guess I'm just wondering what's next. Now what?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Now, as leader of these people, you go and learn how best we can establish ourselves in this "countryside. Where once we-- (sighs) Gwessar, or Tal'Dorei as the humans call it, all of our "civilizations are merging. Isolation that we've relied upon is becoming less and less viable."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I agree.

name: MATT
dialogue: "And so part of, I think, what you have already begun, is finding a way to bring not just "the Ashari, but Zephra as well, necessary friendships and allies."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Our people need to be connected to the rest of the world that we've sworn to protect. I understand the need for our isolation but I often wonder if we had a few close allies on alert, if the Thordak incident might've have gone a little bit differently.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I agree."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I still need time, with Vox Machina. We still have things we need to complete. And then I promise I will return.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right. Come back. Do what you need to. You're not bound to this mountain. Just know that "your heart is here, and we'll call for you if we need you. And when you're not needed beyond it, "this is your home."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Thanks, Dad.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm proud of you." And his professional exterior falls away and he just steps forward and gives you a big, warm, fatherly embrace and just holds you there.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay, Dad. Thank-- okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Sorry." He rights his posture, shoulders back.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I do the same. Adjust my mantle a bit. Another question. Do I have to wear this like all the time? It's a little unwieldy. It feels a little froufrou-y. Kind of ceremonial. It's just a little, feel like I'm going to trip on it.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You know, do what you like. It's yours."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay. 'Cause going upstairs in it, like in the heels, it's a little unwieldy. I mean, it's beautiful! I'm going to go get a drink.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You probably should."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay. Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right."

name: LIAM
dialogue: You read lips, what're they talking about?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Ah, they were talking all about you, actually.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I don't believe you.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, yeah, yeah.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Why would they be talking about me?

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's this whole conversation about you.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You are full of shit.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, I heard she was saying how much she admired you, and he was saying, "Er. I don't think "I feel it as much," and she was like, "No, really, Dad, you just need a chance to really talk to him," and he was like, "No, just believe me, I did talk to him, and I don't feel that way."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah. Yeah, I'm--

name: LAURA
dialogue: And then she was like-- Never mind. (laughter)

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm so glad I confide in you. I have you to lean on. You are the rock in my life. What would I do without you?

name: LAURA
dialogue: They actually said that, as well. They were talking about how amazing I am. (laughter)

name: LIAM
dialogue: While she's talking I start to walk away, quietly as possible.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'm so happy right now.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (laughs) So good.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Ah, deception.

name: MATT
dialogue: So as the ceremony dies down, the evening comes to rest, the night sky takes over and you can still hear the gentle whistling of the winds through the various cracks and crevices in the mountainside. You are brought to your respective temporary abodes for the evening to rest, and to plan, and plot what you wish to do going forward. So, what do you want to do?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, figuratively or literally go to hell, I imagine.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, are we doing this? Tomorrow morning, we're heading out to hell.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, I mean, what're we going to--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: First things first.

name: LAURA
dialogue: First things first what, Grog?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Right.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Squad leader. (laughter)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: How do we get there?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, she's got Plane Shift, right?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I can get us there.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Very easily, actually. That's the easy part.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We don't take, like, a ship?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, sadly we can't.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No ships.

name: LIAM
dialogue: No, but we don't know exactly where we're going to land, right?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Correct.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, we know the city that we want to go to.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I can get us somewhere within the City of Dis. I don't know if--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Dis city.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Built Dis city!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Man. This is going to go great.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It was too easy!

name: LIAM
dialogue: I mean, when we went to the City of Brass, we did not shift into the City of Brass. We dumped quite a ways away.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It was, yeah. But on the outskirts.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah. So we have no control over that, so--

name: LAURA
dialogue: We could pop into it. We could pop out of it.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah. So, whatever plan we come up with, one branch of the future is complete bullshit improvisation for if we fall into the shit.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Right.

name: LIAM
dialogue: So there's no planning for that. So if we don't fall into the shit and we land somewhere relatively safe, what're we going to do? How're we going to play this? This is hell.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, it is complicated. And, as hells go, there could be worse hells. I've been reading.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Shocking.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Thank you. I've been looking into this, and it seems that where we're going has a very, very structured hierarchy. It's very ordered, the society makes sense, and wherever we find this creature that we have to slay, there will probably already be forces working against him that will be happy to ally with us to help that happen. They're vicious psychopathic creatures that only function because they maintain these rules with each other about how they're supposed to act.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's very ordered.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think it would be possible to find people who would be delighted for outsiders to come in and do their dirty work for them.

name: LAURA
dialogue: However, Scalebearer, big high guy. Really important guy said not to make a scene. He said if we make a scene, that would go poorly.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Says him. Psh.

name: LIAM
dialogue: There's no point for sextuplets. We can't do that. That's not going to work.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No. They can see through things. It's going to be complicated as well because we have value as well.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh, I got it! We kidnap the president of hell and we assume his visage.

name: LIAM
dialogue: What's a president?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: His name is Asmodeus. And no, we are not kidnapping Asmodeus of Hell.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Why?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I think he's probably kind of powerful.

name: LIAM
dialogue: He's really heavy.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Might be hard to lift him up.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Have you seen him?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I've seen sketches.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You have?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes. Well, I mean, I don't know how correct these are--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Morning! Morning has come!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, wow!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, my.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: These are a power surge in there.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We talked all night and we squared it away and we're going to hell!

name: MATT
dialogue: You talked all through the night. No rest was had. (laughter)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's very bright.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We're going to be offered things there. There's going to be deals made.

name: LIAM
dialogue: So we're talking negotiation or bullshitting our way. One or the other--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's going to be negotiating, probably with someone who'll give us cover if we do some dirty work.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I mean, is it similar to the City of Brass? It sounds so similar.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They have a lot in common, yes. It's even more structured, though. There's quite a complex-- I alone have identified 13 different caste systems within their function.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Caste systems?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There's imps, spine devils, barbed devils, chain devils, bone devils. There's all these different kinds of devil, and each devil has to answer to a different devil. They answer specifically to the devils that have fealty over them, who in turn are at constant war with the devils who are in fealty to other devils, and archdevils, and greater devils, who in turn all owe their fealty to Asmodeus.

name: LAURA
dialogue: But we are not devils.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We are not devils.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Therefore, weak and liable to be taken as slaves.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We are not even slaves. We are consumables.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I don't know. I feel like we've gotten a bit of a reputation for ourselves. I'm sure that word has spread. We're not, you know--

name: MATT
dialogue: You would know this.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: Percy, through your research. It's not terribly uncommon for mortals to wander through the City of Dis specifically because it is where goods, gold, and largely souls are traded to and from various structures or entities within the hells and beyond. To just consume or eat someone means nothing. The true worth of a soul is in corrupting it. And they do so through enticing, through corrupting their morals, through driving mortals through bargains and pacts to end up twisting into entities of order and evil as well, and then claim the soul of that. Contracts are a big thing.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And then turning that into a lemure. Yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, into a lemure, or other forms of soul-based energy. But contracts are a very, very important part of the whole economy.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So the person that we made a contract with was a devil that ended up being the one that killed Pike, right? That was a devil disguised as a demon?

name: MATT
dialogue: Ah, no. That was a demon disguised as a devil.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, that was super confusing.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: Confusing?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That was the one that we wished our way out of the contract.

name: MATT
dialogue: Correct. Yes.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, we don't really have that anymore.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I was very proud of that.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, we don't have a wish. Okay, so we make no deals when we go.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No deals. No contracts.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No deals. No contracts. No shaking of hands. No signing of anything.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No accepting of gifts.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Feel like I'm going to forget this.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You are.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Just don't touch anything.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh no. Don't touch anything.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Might have to make you special gloves that don't have any fingers.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I've got special gloves.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Even specialer gloves.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Like a muff.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That we can wear over those gloves.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Like a what?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Like a hand muff. (laughter)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You're going to make me a special hand muff? (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: Taryon does pipe in, he's like--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We could put little ears on, we can make it like a kitten!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh, but I've such fine handwriting! If we need to sign anything, just let me know. I'm happy to."

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, Tary, no signing anything.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Nope.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I've signed a lot of contracts in my time. My father used--"

name: LAURA
dialogue: No signing of contracts.

name: MATT
dialogue: "-- to do contracts throughout the countryside."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Although I'm sure you're good at reading contracts as well.

name: MATT
dialogue: "This is true!"

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes. You can read them, but don't sign them. How about that?

name: MATT
dialogue: "How about if I read them and I like it?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: No. No signing. (laughter) Unless you want to stay in hell.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Agree to disagree."

name: LAURA
dialogue: And we come back here.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Your current contract with us actually stipulates that you can't have another contract enacted until you confer with all of us.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Exclusivity.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: He goes through his bag and pulls out the contract. "I stand corrected."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm very thorough.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I don't even remember he signed a contract.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Doty, write this down. Be more careful about exclusivity in future contracts." (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't think you were there. This might have been just him and me getting drunk at one point.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Is there any worth to only a few people, or one or two, going in to get a lay of the land, once we get there? Instead of just moving in our truffle-shuffle normal formation.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I feel like that could be very dangerous, for one person to go in alone.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes, I agree.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'll do it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Grog, no.

name: LIAM
dialogue: No.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'm very stealthy.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Last time you were alone-ish, you almost killed two guards.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What is the problem with that?

name: LAURA
dialogue: In Vasselheim.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We got away with it, right? Did we get caught? Did we get caught, Tary?

name: MATT
dialogue: "No! We did-- Did we get caught?"

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't know. I still have-- I only remember half of what happened."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Tary is very excited about my plan. It's affecting his memory of what happened.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Right.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I think I blocked it out. But what I remember was interesting."

name: LAURA
dialogue: You could always look in Doty's diary and find out exactly what happened.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, peruse the last 90 pages for the last hour.

name: MATT
dialogue: Takes the book and starts thumbing through real fast. You look over at Doty who still has chunks and clusters of bits of red hair from the somewhat removed goatee.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Fu Manchu?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. His secret goatee.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So, Percy. We know a lot of things and people move through the Nine Hells. What does it say about rakshasas in there? Where do they fall in the caste?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It doesn't actually say where rakshasas would fall in the caste, does it?

name: MATT
dialogue: There wasn't a terrible lot of information. Not all the devils are in the same system. There is a promotion-demotion system in which devils advance and are demoted based on their elements there. But there are other fiends that exist in that space that aren't part of that system. Rakshasas are a little bit outside of that system. Succubi, incubi, they're a little bit outside of that system. There are other fiendish creatures that actually traverse between both the Abyss and the Hells based on what their interests are. So that's predominantly the structure of the devils that are--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: In Dis?

name: MATT
dialogue: Well, that are built within the Hells as their primary domain.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Percy, help me understand, since you've read so much about this.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes. Whole page. (laughter)

name: LIAM
dialogue: Good on you. So if the Raven Queen escorts souls-- If you're an absolute, terrible shit of a person and the Raven Queen escorts you over to the other side, we're going to be wandering amongst the souls of the damned? People who die go to where we're going?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: If they're under contract, this is where they go.

name: MATT
dialogue: And many who sometimes aren't under contract go there as well.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh really?

name: MATT
dialogue: And you would know this, actually. The Raven Queen, as part of the laws of the cosmos that hold the various planes together, the Raven Queen does indeed escort good souls to the positive planes, the upper planes, and not-so-good souls to the lower ones.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Actually, I know that from reading a lot about the Raven Queen. I can answer that for you.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: If you don't use a turn signal, if you have a vanity plate, you go to hell. (laughter)

name: LIAM
dialogue: Thank you. I know they get escorted to the other side. It just seems like an odd idea to be walking in a city full of the thrown-away. I'm talking to the air right now.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, we're absolutely listening.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm sorry. Keep going.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It was the best thing you never heard. (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That changed the game forever.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I miss Scanlan Shorthalt so badly.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Because he listened to you so much more?

name: LIAM
dialogue: No, he's just my buddy.

name: ALL
dialogue: Aww.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Speaking of just our buddy--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: As we move on.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Really?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, that's difficult.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Phone a friend? What do we do?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't know. I've been thinking about that, the best way to--

name: LIAM
dialogue: I mean, Hotis-- How long has it been, DM?

name: MATT
dialogue: Since?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Since Pike wasted his sorry ass.

name: MATT
dialogue: It's been, offhand, a couple of months.

name: LIAM
dialogue: A couple months. I mean, I don't think one more day is going to kill us, if we want to go get her. You know. (laughter)

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's difficult. (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I know, I do bring it up, though, that it is one those things that we should talk about.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I mean, if the fates allow.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes. I feel like we would have to find someone to Send Message.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: There is a Message spell, maybe in the form of a text.

name: MATT
dialogue: Just blackmail the writers of Blindspot.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah. (laughs)

name: LAURA
dialogue: Ashley is in New York. (laughs)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: This is one of those things where I thought I would just bring it up now before we go running in there.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Oh, I was just trying to guilt Matt into playing Pike, but--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I am okay with that too.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, it's Ashley's character, though.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I mean we kind of did--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Pike, Tary, what else? (laughs)

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, just throw all the NPCs at me. (laughing)

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's not the Thordak battle, there's not 87 miniatures on the board!

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, but I mean, it could be, we don't know.

name: LIAM
dialogue: All right, well, we're all going to die.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We'd also have to see if Ashley would be down with us, you know--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I thought I would bring it up.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I just thought I would bring it up--

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys could Jaeger her again.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: -- 'cause it is one of those things that is pretty clutch down there.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Not prepared, but we never are.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Nope. So we kidnap the president. (laughter)

name: LAURA
dialogue: Definitely. I'm liking it more.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So, I'm curious, if-- Rakshasas aren't necessarily part of the system, and this guy tends to come in and out and just make people's lives a living hell. (laughs) Hell! We're going! Puns!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Good. Slick.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Then maybe no one would miss him. In fact, maybe people down there don't like him. You know?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The feeling I get reading-- the more I read about this place, is no one likes anybody down there, and so if we can figure out a way to be convenient about it, you can disappear anybody.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Also, didn't someone tell us that if they get trashed they are treated like shit there?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: He's probably not well-respected.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We've trashed his ass twice.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: When we went to the City of Brass we were owned, right? That's what let us move around so freely?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We don't have to do that here.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Are you sure-- okay.

name: LIAM
dialogue: (sighs) I mean, we thought it was getting us around but it clearly wasn't.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: There's nothing that we need to think about like that so that we have--

name: LAURA
dialogue: So we should just go down, act like we're evils, like our souls have been claimed by another devil already.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Honestly, the more we act like us, the more people are going to try to tempt us into things.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I could use Alter Self or try and change into something that's devil-y.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can't they see through that?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They'll probably see through it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I have a question.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yes?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Because that is an interesting question, because--

name: MATT
dialogue: Illusions are different than actually physically changing yourself.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Right. It's transmutation--

name: MATT
dialogue: Correct.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Because Shapechange is considered a transmutation spell, whereas Seeming was an illusion spell.

name: MATT
dialogue: Seeming was an illusion. Illusions and--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You actually become that thing.

name: MATT
dialogue: As far as you know, the pit fiend you encountered is the only creature that saw through an illusion.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: However, illusions and transmutation spells, things that actually physically alter your form, that's not considered an illusion. You are actually changing your physicality, so Alter Self would not be something that a creature with Truesight could see through.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can I Alter Self to a succubus?

name: MATT
dialogue: I mean, you could alter yourself to look more--
