dialogue: I'm not entirely sure. I mean, they didn't react-- Did they react strangely to you when we came into the bar?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Not that I noticed, no.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: So does that mean that he has to change again now?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I don't think it matters what he turns into, I think people will be able to tell the aura that he carries with him.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What? A bit like a process of divination-- (laughter) -- like, he changes, and then we know what it is or not, what?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think that's actually very impressive, it is actually a process of divination, technically, that's just very--

name: SAM
dialogue: Some sound reasoning.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Somehow you wandered right back to it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Don't lose your wits down here, it's real important.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No.

name: LIAM
dialogue: This is just an extra wrinkle into a larger problem. So, what's the move now?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, I can do this for about another 55 minutes! Before we'd have to sleep before I can do it again!

name: SAM
dialogue: Do we have to go anywhere? Are we late to any appointments?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I forgot what it was you left to go do, actually! (laughs)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: She was going to research the notion of other options other than dealing with the deal we have downstairs.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Right!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I was going to go see if I could get a bead on where Hotis is. Oh! What, guys, check this out, this is what I freaked 'em out with. And I go back into the erinyes form.

name: MATT
dialogue: You watch the wings (whoosh) unfurl, her skin going pale--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: All right.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (deeper voice) Check it out. Check it out, that's pretty hot, right? It makes my--

name: SAM
dialogue: That is amazing!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: -- it makes my voice a little smokey when I'm down here too, right?

name: SAM
dialogue: Whoa! Whoa!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I know.

name: SAM
dialogue: What are you right now?!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm an erinyes.

name: SAM
dialogue: How do you spell that?! Doty, take that down! Erinyes!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: How do you say it?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's with an 'e'.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: E-R-I-N-Y-E-S.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Ear-in-es.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Air-in-es.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Erin. Like Erin-yes!

name: SAM
dialogue: Wow.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, it's got yes-bait right in.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well. Do you still want to look into other options, or do we want to just-- We could take the deal. We could reverse the deal.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Wait, you said they like left you alone once you changed into that thing?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well, why didn't you just keep going, then?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, changing into this thing meant that I had to drop concentration on my Locate Creature spell.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Ohh.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I can only concentrate on one thing at a time. It gets-- Especially this, it's a lot to mentally focus on.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's very impressive.

name: SAM
dialogue: You know, in my readings of this place, the Hells-- Of any hell, really (laughs)-- They typically are, at least in literature, reflected as horrible places where lots of bad things happen wherever you go. So having a deal presented in front of us that is not horrible is, I think, a pretty winning deal. I mean, I feel like we're already ahead of the game if we are not being actively murdered during the course of events.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I would also like to point out that the definition of 'research', in this instance, is just reading the notes that I took last week, reading and doing actual research.

name: SAM
dialogue: I do my own reading, thank you.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You did! You did reading of the notes I wrote.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, then I guess we're in accord. (laughs)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, don't you, like, brainy buddies just like exchange notes every day, anyway?

name: SAM
dialogue: Of course!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't feel like I should have lost that one.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I noticed--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: (sighs)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Just let it go, Percy. I noticed we're being watched, I think at every turn. There was a little imp guy watching me when I came in.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Was it actually an imp? Imps are very common. Everyone's being watched, it's a city under surveillance.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We saw an imp back in Krieg's house, did it look like that?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Gold armor? Or wasn't that the one at Krieg's house?

name: MATT
dialogue: It did not have gold armor, the one that you saw at Krieg's.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Which one did we see? Was it just-- I don't--

name: LIAM
dialogue: The little bastard in the library at Krieg's house.

name: MATT
dialogue: Well, that was in Krieg's-- Technically it wasn't in Krieg's house--

name: LIAM
dialogue: No?

name: MATT
dialogue: That was in father, what's the character's--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It was upstairs in the--

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, it was the first-- when you first came to Emon, it was the ally to your father, Vax.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh!

name: LIAM
dialogue: Oh, that's right.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, shit, that's right, your dad!

name: MATT
dialogue: And he was the one that was found slain, or was in the process of being killed by--

name: LIAM
dialogue: That's right, that's right.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: In the basement?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh my god, that was a long time ago!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: A long time ago.

name: LIAM
dialogue: The slaying, right. The slaying was in the basement, but the imp was in a library upstairs--

name: MATT
dialogue: Yes! Yes.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I forgot about that. I kept a ring off that demon that we killed. It's in the bag of holding.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Wait, did you really?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yep.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's like seven haircuts ago.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, get that--

name: SAM
dialogue: Whip it out.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Get that-- can I-- Get that out. Get that out.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Why, what do you want?

name: SAM
dialogue: Might be useful.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'll trade you something for it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Percy--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: My glasses.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Your-- (laughs) (laughter)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You! You! I'm not going to fall for that!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It was worth-- the joke was worth the ring alone, I would imagine. We were going to give it back, we just want to see it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: So that big demon, that like body slammed me on that spike? Piece of shit. I took this ring off of his finger, forever ago. And I kept it. I take it out.

name: SAM
dialogue: Let's have a look! I'll cast Identify on it.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. The ring has no specific magical properties to it, but it is a signet of some kind. There is a symbol on it-- Roll a religion check, actually.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Can I aid with a history or religion as well?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Sorry, that's from like, three years ago.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Can I help with him with that? History or religion?

name: MATT
dialogue: This would be religion.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: All right.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's one of the oldest things in this bag.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: There's only one other thing that's older.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: An 11 on top of that, so--

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay.

name: LIAM
dialogue: What's the one thing that's older?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It's an onyx statue that we found down in the cell that you were in.

name: MATT
dialogue: That he was in, yeah. So, the two of you both conjecturing about it, the symbol here is one that you picked up specifically in the tome you did research earlier. It is the symbol of Asmodeus.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It is the symbol of Asmodeus, I would have instantly recognized it, at this point.

name: SAM
dialogue: Asmodeus. I was going to say that as well.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You, of course you were going to say Asmodeus, because it's like written six times in my notes, and I'm literally staring at a sketch of it in my notes.

name: MATT
dialogue: Asmo-day-us.

name: SAM
dialogue: I feel like we're sympatico on this.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Can we use it? Is it something that'll get us like, a backstage pass to an audience of some kind?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm going to take a long look at this thing. Is this some sort of mark of-- Is this a marker? Some sort of favor marker? Is this a signet of stature? Is this a-- You don't just put this on anything.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It's mine, don't forget.

name: MATT
dialogue: It seems, from best you can tell-- Make an intelligence check, actually.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: All right.

name: SAM
dialogue: I should probably assist.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yeah, please.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yep, me too.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, yes please.

name: SAM
dialogue: We got two natural ones.

name: MATT
dialogue: (laughs)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Did you really?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Holy shit!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's a nose ring!

name: SAM
dialogue: I think it's a, uh. A contact lens!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think that it is, in fact, a-- some sort of-- I don't know, it's a-- Napkin ring. (laughs) For tiny napkins.

name: MATT
dialogue: As far as you guys know, it looks pretty damn important. That's the only thing you can ascertain.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Let me, let me see if I can get something out of it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's fine, I don't care.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can I scry on it?

name: SAM
dialogue: Scry?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Like scry and see if it shows me something?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh! Object scry?

name: MATT
dialogue: Let me see.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Is that-- a thing I-- no?

name: MATT
dialogue: I mean, if you focus on an item, you can use that item to try an improve a scrying attempt if you're looking for a specific individual or location.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Individual.

name: MATT
dialogue: But I don't think the Scrying spell directly allows you to, to--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There is a spell that does that, though-- Object History.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, we don't have that.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I don't have that.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: If you're curious, the person it belonged to is dead.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We killed him.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, I know.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The symbol on this object, though, is more or less the ruler of this dimension, so it could be useful for something.

name: SAM
dialogue: Why don't we keep it handy, no pun intended, and we'll just flash it if we get in trouble, and see if that helps us.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: How is that a pun?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I was actually thinking the same thing, I don't understand how that was--

name: SAM
dialogue: It's a ring. I said handy.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's a stretch.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I caught it. (laughter) I'm sorry to say.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well. Are we taking this deal, or are we... not?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are we doing it on our own?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You know, this imp that I saw did have sparkly gold armor, he may be like an important imp. I'm just saying, I feel like everyone's here wanting to make a deal. It might be good to talk to others.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Vex, you're being awfully quiet, what do you think we should do right now? (laughter)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (laughs) Yeah, Vex!

name: MATT
dialogue: Vex, at this point, is watching the whole thing, and she goes, "Well, to be perfectly "honest, I haven't heard much detail about this deal that you apparently seemed to make. What do "we make of the deal?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The owner of this establishment we're staying in works for a man he doesn't like. Is curious what would happen if he wasn't working for that man, if he was suddenly, for reasons, unavailable. And for that, we would probably be arrested, if we dealt with it inappropriately, and we would be in a position to be-- make our enemy accessible, I suppose. We have to be a bit cagey, there are ears, apparently, everywhere. Even here.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I feel like we don't need to make a deal to go murder someone to get arrested. I feel like I could just go streaking in the street and just say words, and we would get arrested.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: As, actually--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's true.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Strangely, excited by that plan as I am--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Why do we need to commit this crime, and then suffer the apt consequences?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, but Keyleth, once we're arrested, he's supposed to, like, shuffle us in, y'know, on the low-low, into--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can he get us out?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, where we need to be, yeah. Out never came up.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Out never came up?!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You're our out. We leave all of this behind once all that's taken care of.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Then why do we need him as our in?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Because we have no other plan at this point.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: At this point we have no other plan.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You were supposed to go find something, (singsong) but you got followed by demons.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes, I did. Yes, I did. I could do-- attempt something similar. Potentially with a higher-level version of my Locate Creature spell--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What if the guy he wants us to kill is like a real piece of shit?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: They're all pieces of shit!

name: SAM
dialogue: Everything down here is a piece of shit.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Does anybody have a problem with that? It's just like, y'know, piece of shit: (killing noise), and he's gone.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: The only problem I have with it--

name: SAM
dialogue: I like it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Thank you, Tary.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: -- and the only reason I'm even being vaguely hesitant about any of this is because they're all pieces of shit, including the one that we're making any sort of bargain with.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Okay.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And they are professional bargainers, and I know we're missing something.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We kill him, too.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's a Lawful Evil dimension. If he wants his boss dead, that means that there's going to be someone else above him. If we kill one guy, who's all going to want to kill us?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Did he ask, like, a decision by a certain time?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't recall-- So, I said I would have it within a day or so, if I recall--

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, you said 'fairly promptly.'

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well, fuck, we've got a day! Let's go explore, see what we can find.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And if we're going to decide to trust him, we could also show him the ring and see what he makes of it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Not the ring! God, not the ring-- I mean, I, fuck, I totally forgot about that ring until now.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He's literally still holding it in his hand in front of your face, you just--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, I need it back.

name: SAM
dialogue: What will you do with it?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Me?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'm going to wear it!

name: SAM
dialogue: All right!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah. Does it fit on any of me giant, Oscar Meyer fingers? (laughter)

name: MATT
dialogue: It fits partway down your pinkie, but it gets caught on, like, the first knuckle.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Ooh, look at you! Oh my gosh! Wow.

name: MATT
dialogue: It's like he went to Claire's.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Property of Asmodeus! Ass-modeus--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: This never ends well. Let's forego disguises.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh, wait, you ready to go?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We're going to just drain ourselves the more we pretend to be something we're not, and obviously it's not helping us not attract attention.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Vax, you got any problem with that?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I mean, I don't know what the deal is with the people who are interested in me. I can't tell if one's better or worse. But we're just going to go waltz out into town and see what happens, is that the idea?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, we could-- Keyleth could keep her wings and armor, and they'd be probably, possibly, less likely to question any of us if we're walking around with someone of reasonable stature.

name: SAM
dialogue: If I might remind you: for 50 minutes, now, at this point now, right? So then we're all dead.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yeah, then we're all dead.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Well, we just-- It's like curfew. We have to be home in about 50 minutes.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What about you? Do you have like a magic jock strap you can rip off and change into something?

name: SAM
dialogue: I've already done that. We're all tieflings because of me.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Not me, bitch.

name: SAM
dialogue: You're-- abnormal.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Oh. Thank you.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Kiki, the prison that you saw, did you get an idea for how big it is?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: The what? The prison?

name: LIAM
dialogue: The prison. That we need to break into or get arrested and pulled into--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I didn't see how big. It seemed immense, and like it was probably pretty big underground? But I couldn't-- can't be for sure.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I would say it would be safe to assume that a prison in hell would be so big that there would be sayings such as 'as big as filling-- try attempting to fill a prison in hell.' I feel like this is just-- I think we're like walking into idioms, at this point.

name: SAM
dialogue: But if this gentleman, if I may call him a gentleman, can escort us to the right cell block, or whatever, that might be very, very handy. I don't want to spend any more time in hell than we have to, and as much as I usually hate employees revolting against their employer, I feel like we've got a bird in the hand, so to speak, and we should strike while the iron is hot, if I can use many, many cliches all at once.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Wait for it, wait for it.

name: ALL
dialogue: Hey!

name: LAURA
dialogue: What's going on?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Hi!

name: LAURA
dialogue: I was listening in the car!

name: SAM
dialogue: We're about to Say Yes to the Dress, and go and follow this plan, I think.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It was the one? It was the one?!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, do you want to take the contract? And we go kill (burps) big shit guy and go to prison? Or do we try and, like, take a day and see what we can find on our own, without giving ourselves over to this-- arrangement?

name: SAM
dialogue: (whispers) I don't want to walk around this place!

name: LAURA
dialogue: (South African accent) We're going to kill the big guy. Oh god! I'm in South African.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, you are. Vax.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Ah! (babbling)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What's your vote?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, well, hold on, I've got one more spitball idea. Vex?

name: LAURA
dialogue: (accent still off) Yeah! Yes.

name: LIAM
dialogue: That gate stone that we've used so many times, does that only work on the material plane? Does it work--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, here's the thing, darling. I gave the other gate stone to Scanlan.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Right!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It won't get us out of here, no.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We don't have one.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Would it take us off this plane, though, or no?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, it would take one person off this plane.

name: MATT
dialogue: It would only take one person, and they have to be on the same plane of existence.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So, no, it wouldn't take anyone anywhere.

name: MATT
dialogue: You would know that. Based on the enchantment.

name: LIAM
dialogue: So that's a dead end. All right.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Also, I heard you guys talking about the guys with the gold armor?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Uh-huh.

name: LIAM
dialogue: While you were standing two feet away?

name: LAURA
dialogue: While I was standing right here, I heard you guys talking about it?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And those guys, they're guards of the city! Those imps in the gold armor, we were warned about those guys!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We were?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah!

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, why didn't you chime in before?! (laughter)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, fucking speak up.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, I wanted to! But I was biting my nails really hard.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You know, we have a day or so. Does anyone else think that we should maybe not take the first deal that presents itself in the first tavern that we step into in the city? Does that not seem super convenient?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I mean, what are our chances of walking around town and going like, 'hey, that prison, 'right? Right over--'?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I mean-- (transforming sound) (deeper voice) We've got about 50 minutes, if we still want to go.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I mean, also, if we want to get, y'know, pinched and put into this prison, what are the chances that we-- if we start shit here, are we just going to get killed in the streets? Or dragged off? It doesn't seem very solid to me, but I don't have any other idea.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: All right, time for a vote!

name: SAM
dialogue: I agree.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Tary, what's your vote?

name: SAM
dialogue: I say we take this deal, kill that employer, and go to prison. Oh my god--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Percy?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Jeez, Tary, you've gone straight gangsta in so little time.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, I just want to get the fuck out of here and go back home so I can enjoy some wine!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Starting to crack a bit. (laughter)

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Percy, what's your vote?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I vote we take the deal.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Keyleth?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Keyleth!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I think an extra day of walking around this city could potentially save us years in hell that--

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I don't need an explanation, jesus.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I say we take the deal at sundown.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Okay. Vax?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We don't take the deal.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I mean, I really don't see the harm in spending another day here and getting the lay of the land.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Vex?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I vote for-- For another day here.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: All right.

name: LAURA
dialogue: But if we don't find any leads, we take it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I vote for taking the contract! Me and Tary, we're of a like mind.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, I was just swinging. I swing back.

name: SAM
dialogue: What? You swing back?!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I said I'd take the day.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He said he wants the day.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Bullshit. All right, we take the day.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, Doty hasn't voted yet.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Neither has Trinket.

name: LIAM
dialogue: What, is Doty the center that breaks the tie?

name: SAM
dialogue: Maybe they should arm wrestle for it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Maybe they should.

name: SAM
dialogue: Doty.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Giant grizzly bear.

name: SAM
dialogue: Arm wrestle that bear.

name: MATT
dialogue: Turns towards you and Trinket goes-- (bear grunting)

name: LAURA

dialogue: For Doty.

dialogue: (laughs) Dotty. D.T. Dotye.

name: SAM
dialogue: No.

dialogue: I'm sorry.

dialogue: Have you lost anyone close to you before?

dialogue: This is coming to terms with a little bit of help.

dialogue: Not anymore.

dialogue: No, that's not crazy.

dialogue: Oh!

dialogue: Nice!

dialogue: Yeah!

dialogue: Well, I've been giving that a lot of thought, actually. In fact, if you will humor me, can I read you all something?

dialogue: Drag the last of all the bottles out this time.

dialogue: If we're honoring Doty, I'd love to read to you the last thing that he wrote, well, transcribed before we went into the Hells.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm really excited to hear it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That'd be beautiful.

name: SAM
dialogue: As sort of a memorial to him. This was the last page before. "Doty, take this down." He always writes everything. "As I, Taryon Darrington, embark on a mission into the very "depths of hell, I do so with no fear or hesitation. Though this undertaking is fraught "with peril, I have a secret weapon that no inferno, monster or hellhound can defeat. I am "flanked by the ferocious band of mercenaries known as Vox Machina. In the days since meeting this "ragtag company, our relationship has blossomed. At first, I was viewed as a suspicious outsider, then "as a gallant and trusted colleague, and now, having proven my mettle, accepted as a lifelong "brother and full-fledged teammate. No matter what we face in the Abyss, my comrades would risk their "lives for me, kill for me, and I'm 100% sure each would gladly give his or her life to save mine. "Loyalty like that, you can't put a price on it. But, if I had to, I'd say their friendship is "worth about 210,000 gold. Which, even to me, is a relatively large amount of money. Their faith "emboldens me." (laughter)

name: LIAM
dialogue: This is out of character.

name: SAM
dialogue: "But it's more than that. I've started to wonder. If I have so easily won the confidence of "these battled-hardened titans, perhaps I am even more venerable, more impressive than I ever knew! "Perhaps after this mission, I should return home, newly confident, to confront my father once and "for all. Maybe the time has come to complete my journey here and show my family that I am indeed "worthy to carry the Darrington name. But first, revenge! Soon we will venture to where nightmares "are born, and it's going to be fun, fun, fun. That's all for now, Doty. As always, correct my "grammatical errors before you rest and go fetch my sleep mask and nightshirt." And then we went to hell.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That was beautiful. That was--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Eloquent, very eloquent.

name: SAM
dialogue: He was a special, special robot and--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes.

name: SAM
dialogue: -- he was there for me in all of my darkest times and lightest times and now that he's not there anymore, I just-- I should feel very lonely, but I don't, because I am surrounded by people who truly respect me for who I am. And I know that in that last night before we went to the Hells I wrote that I was ready, finally, to go back and confront my father, but now in the absence of Doty, I've decided to put that aside and stay with you all. Yes, I feel my place is here with you, my rightful place. I won't have access to as much money, but everything else about me will stay the same. And I know that you are all happy that I've made this decision to stay with you as a now-poor adventurer. So maybe this is worth celebrating, I don't know, should we go have a drink in a pub or something?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes, we should.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We should, yes.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yes, we should.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Definitely.

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't like seeing lights at night, it wakes me out of my dream state, so--

dialogue: Does it go over your whole head?

name: SAM

name: SAM

dialogue: Right. Yeah.

dialogue: I mean, we may be here for a while.

dialogue: We may be taking a bit of a break.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes?

dialogue: We had a bit of a list, we've had a couple lists, and we've checked an awful lot off of them, and we're real tired. We're thinking of taking it easy for a bit.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Wouldn't it be fun, though, to just set up shop here and hang out--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Tinker, design--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You could repair things for small change on the side.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, yeah, yeah! That's how you could make some money, maybe tinker for a living.

dialogue: A year, yes.

name: SAM
dialogue: Per year?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, thereabouts.

dialogue: Well, tinkering, to be fair, I don't actually know what tinkering pays because I've never been paid to do it.

name: LAURA

dialogue: A lot of money.

dialogue: Well... I mean, yes.

dialogue: Yeah!

dialogue: We can talk about this tomorrow. Let's just go get him drunk, he'll probably tell you if he's drunk. I'm sorry, you're right in front of me. Let's go have a drink!

name: MATT
dialogue: On the way, because this is on the more northern side, northeastern side of Whitestone, you do see there is a crowd of people. What looks to be a caravan is being packed up. There are a number of carts and horses and things are being loaded up for what looks to be some sort of a fairly large travel pack of people. You do hear the laughter of children coming from the right of you, and then pushing through the crowd, you see Odessa, Illya, and Gren Tal'Dorei, the children, go running past as they're being chased by two aasimar boys, blue skin, running past them, and they're giving a joking chase tickle. You see Kyor nods, and Hunin nods, the kids go running off again, not really paying attention to you guys--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, go get 'em!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Uh-huh!" They both continue off after the kids just as Salda Tal'Dorei walks up from between some of the Pale Guard that are currently helping load things onto these carts. And she sees you all, and comes forth, "Oh, my goodness! It's so great to see you all safe and sound!"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Your majesty.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Hello.

name: MATT
dialogue: The last few times you've seen her, she's looked a little frazzled but still with what remains of her formal attire which she had on her after the attack on Tal'Dorei. Right now, she's dressed very simply. name: LAURA
dialogue: They'll be happy to have you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's been a while, and now that things have calmed down, and from what we've heard that you've "all saved the city, I guess, we're going to bring the children back to their home. We're going to be "taking the Parchwood Way to the Silvercut Roadway, and we have guardians, we have people we've hired "or have agreed to come along and keep us safe. The children have taken a shine to the boys, as if you "haven't noticed. If it's all right, we're thinking of bringing them with us."

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's wonderful.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's very kind of you.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Quite gracious.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We have the Alabaster Lyceum-- once it's up and running again, of course-- and I know the "headmaster there. We can provide a good education for the boys, which, upon talking with them, I "think they're both in dire need of."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Do you need any help with that? We feel a bit of responsibility for them.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Really, it's fine. You guys have done enough anyway, and to be honest, I believe your "sister needs your help here more than we could on the journey there."

name: LIAM
dialogue: Do your kids-- holding up okay?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yeah. We've done as best as we could to shield them from the brunt of the past few months, "but things are cheerier here, definitely, and I think they've "taken that upon themselves as well."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Just be prepared, the Emon you left isn't necessarily the Emon you'll be returning to. It's getting better, but it takes time.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I can assure you that my memory of the place, at least the moments before we left, "couldn't be any more dire than we could return to. Any semblance of calm at our home is welcome. "But--" and she glances over-- "I think Odessa has a crush on Hunin. I don't want to break her heart "by keeping them too far away, so that's--"

name: LIAM
dialogue: Cool mom.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Anyway, I think we're preparing to set out first thing in the morning, and I just want to say "thank you for everything."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Any time. Sorry we couldn't do more.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You've done plenty. I do hope to see you if you decide to still be a part of the Council, "satellite or not."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Grayskull is still there!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, I mean, the children shouldn't be too far, then! Anyway, I should go catch up to them. "It's good to see you all."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's good to see you as well.

name: MATT
dialogue: She glances over at you with a curious look.

name: SAM
dialogue: Good day.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Good day."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: He's new, but he's proving himself quite well.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He's fine.

name: SAM
dialogue: I just lost my best friend.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He's fine.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm sorry to hear that. That's terrible. I understand the difficulty of loss, "believe you me."

name: SAM
dialogue: Does it get better?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It does. With people like this around you, people like them around me, it does."

name: SAM
dialogue: Thank you, kind stranger.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You as well, kind stranger." She continues walking on and catches up with the kids.

name: SAM
dialogue: She seems neat.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes, neat. Neat would be the word I would-- she does all right.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's the most awkward post-conversation conversation I have ever had.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah, yeah, that's pretty awkward.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, there's a pub over there.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Let's go get him laid.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Do I see a soldier of any kind, on this--

name: MATT
dialogue: Oh yeah, there's a number of Pale Guard that have been assigned to this caravan that are helping put things onto the various carts.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm just tapping one. When you're done, please let the palace know that we have returned.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh, yes, of course, sir. It will be done."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We've returned for good, for a while, so no immediate threat anymore.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We went to hell.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I will do this. I will do this immediately."

name: MARISHA

dialogue: Well, you know.

dialogue: No, you're right. We can't punish people who are just hired to do a job. It's fine.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's how we all started out, really.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, I hired you.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: He's got a point.

name: SAM
dialogue: And now, we're so close! Here, let's go to my dad's house, but... I need to make an entrance. I'll be on broom.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Can I be on broom, too, though?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes. Behind me. And I should be front and center. You guys can flank--

name: LAURA
dialogue: Flying V behind you.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, thank you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I catch up to Tary a little bit and I go, hey! Are you special in some way? Is there something about you that's magical and special?

name: SAM
dialogue: Is this a trick question? There's everything. Most things are special about me.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's true. Is there a reason a vampire would want you?

name: SAM
dialogue: What? There's vampires here?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do you have special blood?

name: SAM
dialogue: No? Wait, what?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Can I look at your eyes?

name: SAM
dialogue: I mean, sure? They're the bluest of blue.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's true! Do you know anything about your bloodline? Is there something about you? I feel like I have an essence about you now.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: How much of her brains were left in the rocks?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I know, she got rattled.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, she's gone full Phoebe from Friends.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah!

name: LIAM
dialogue: I'm off to the side with Grog going one, two, three, shoot!

name: SAM
dialogue: My town here, it doesn't have very many high hills, but still, stay on the ground, will you?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay!

name: MATT
dialogue: As you guys make your way into the actual city of Deastok, the architecture here is very tall and as intricate as it is old. The stonework is edged and almost sharp in places, the shape and design of most roofs and windows leaning towards the gothic. You can see similar roots here to some of Whitestone's older buildings and architecture, common space where the original de Rolos traveled once from Wildmount. The architecture here, as opposed to the more built-for-function that a lot of you are used to in Tal'Dorei, anywhere from huts to, I want to push almost Tudor to colonial, this definitely has tall stone archways, tall stained-glass windows, in places. A lot of the buildings, edges, and roofs will come to tiny metal spires where points or occasionally flags or tapestries would hang from in the wind. Very different visual feel than anything you've seen over in Tal'Dorei. As you guys make your way through the streets, in the presentational mode of which Taryon has requested, people do stop and stare. You can hear whispers, some folks pointing, some of the patrols gather to keep a close eye as you pass. No excitement, no parade, no cursing or aggression, just acknowledgement of the arrival of these strangers and a very flashy lord. Eventually, you lead them to the Darrington estate. This is a large, three-story building surrounded by tall, iron pike-topped gates that surround the somewhat octagonal shape of the grounds. The main gate is watched by a single man in a simple leather outfit and a metallic helmet. Who, as he sees you approach goes, "Have you-- sir! Welcome home!"

name: SAM
dialogue: Thank you. Tell the master of the house that we've arrived.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes. Right away, sir!" Opens the gate and rushes off to the front door and disappears inside for a moment. The door opens again, and you see emerging from it a very tall, thin, brass-scaled dragonborn with very fine clothing. His lack of tail speaks of his Ravinite lineage. You recognize this individual as Berthold; he is the servant of the house and quarters. As he approaches he goes, "Oh, Master Taryon, it has been some time! Good to see you in good health!"

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, excellent to see you, too. You've been keeping the grounds quite nice.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We've been doing our best. I take it you--" and he looks over to the woman K'ryyn, goes, "You--" "Yes, I would like to complete my contract." "Very well. Please, follow me inside. This way." The dragonborn turns around. He almost towers over you; he's this spindling tree of a dragonborn. As he leads you into the home, you watch him; he has to dip down to enter the interior of the house. As you step inside the estate, you're immediately hit with the smell of musty carpets, wood oil stain, and some since turned-to-smoke-and-embers burning wood in a fireplace. You see immediately in the darkly lit interior fine tables and well-crafted furniture that clutter hallways, holding vases and dried flowers that probably have been in long need of a change. It's eerily silent. It seems, at least on this floor, empty of pretty much all life except for Berthold. He begins to walk up the stairs. "Right this way. You know." And he heads up the second flight of stairs to the very top of the interior of the estate, and there is the very heavy oak door that marks the study quarters of your father. He knocks lightly on the door. "Master Howard, you have some unexpected guests, including the one you hired to bring your son "home. And is here with your son." There's a pause. You hear a voice on the other side say, "Let them enter." The door creaks open. (creak) Berthold steps back. "I'll wait here." He bows and gestures for you all to step into the room. As you guys step into this study you see, standing right across from you, looking into the fireplace, you occasionally hear the crack and the snap of what looks to be a halfway burned fire. A human man in his late forties. His short blond hair is receding to the top of his head. You can see the firelight glistening across his somewhat oily forehead, and two heavy sideburns that are an uncombed mass that frame the sides of his very hardened square jaw. He is dressed in a nobleman's coat and breeches, though his shoes are nowhere to be seen. Just barefoot on the ground. He looks over and sees you enter and looks towards Taryon and his hardened face turns to a softened smile. "My son."

name: SAM
dialogue: Papa.

name: MATT
dialogue: He looks over to the woman, K'ryyn. "What I've heard is true, and I thank you for your time. "Berthold will see that you are paid." She nods. There is a nod to you.

name: SAM
dialogue: You'll wait for us outside the grounds, and we'll give you your next assignment soon.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That is the arrangement." She leaves the room and you hear Berthold walking alongside her and chatting with her about payment as she leaves. As soon as they walk down the stairs he turns and goes, "I am glad to see you are well."

name: SAM
dialogue: Are you? You sent that woman to kidnap me.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I sent that woman to bring you home. To see that you were safe."

name: SAM
dialogue: She bound and gagged me and threw me on the back of a horse. That's how you brought me home?

name: MATT
dialogue: "You're a hard man to find when you want to be."

name: SAM
dialogue: I am literally the least hard man to find. I tell everyone my name, I wear a gold helmet, and I walk around talking about myself.

name: MATT
dialogue: His smile fades for a moment. "And yet you were very far from these lands."

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, I was. I was living a new life, as I told you I would. I was finding myself and becoming someone.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That is good. Just know that I was worried. You fill your head with these fantasies and ideals "and step out into the unknown. Do you know how many men and women are found gutted in the streets "and left and abandoned to rot away in forests by some bandits on the roadside? Not to mention the "various beasts of the wild out there. I was worried about you."

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, I was in danger for much of my time away, but that's not a bad thing, sometimes. Becoming an adventurer or whatever I am now, it wasn't supposed to be easy. It was supposed to be hard, and it was, and it had risks. But along the way, I did much, and I stand before you now as a different man than who left. One who has been through a lot and knows the dangers of the world, but is also a survivor. You know, when I left, I told you I was going to prove myself to you. That I would bring you back stories of my exploits and show you what kind of a man I really was. And I wrote a lot of them down in a book, but I don't think I want to show it to you, because I don't think you deserve to see it. You never supported me as a child, and you don't now. Financially, yes, but not as a father. And the things I did while I was away-- well, the book is a diary now. It's for me, not for you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Taryon... while my parenting may have been strict or distant at times, I didn't reflect "on my care for you. We have a legacy in this family to maintain."

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, I know. That's all you seem to care about.

name: MATT
dialogue: "That's all that matters."

name: SAM
dialogue: It's not all that matters. I know that I carry your blood and that means a lot to you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "This money that you seem to relish in, that you took without asking, the last of our "coffers. Your grandfather started this, and I've done everything to maintain it. And your "interests, your attention, could not be brought to learn and maintain this business after me, so I've "had to turn to Maryanne. It's not that I don't love you, but you have another purpose in this "family. And that is why I've brought you here."

name: SAM
dialogue: And what is that?

name: MATT
dialogue: And you watch as his hands are shaking and he's fidgeting and scratching his chin and running his fingers through his sideburns. "We're impoverished. I haven't been able to pay our staff "in nearly two months. Everything that I had to do to maintain this legacy has come back to bear "fruit, and the debt that we owe is vast."

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't believe you. Where's the money? Where's the family money?

name: MATT
dialogue: He looks around at the rest of you, and you can see now there is trepidation with having this conversation in front of strangers.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's all right. They're with me.

name: MATT
dialogue: He reaches over and grabs off his desk an already opened bottle of some sort of wine. Takes a quick swig and sets it down. Slumps into his chair in front of the fire and rests his face on his hand. "Everything your grandfather Oberon built, it's on the verge of fading away. All the "taxes we claim on our lands now go straight to a syndicate that we owe a lot of money to. Unless "we find a way to pay off the debts of your father and his father before him, we will all be thrown "into the cold or worse. Now, I've seen this storm coming for a while, Taryon. I've spent years "trying to coax a family union with the Truscans; you know this. After much toil and diplomacy, they "have agreed to wed you to their daughter Lydia. This union will bring our family a renewed avenue "to wealth and protection within the empire! We can stave off this terrible end, and you will be a "hero within the family."

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't understand. The way we lived, the way you talked, made it seem like there was endless money, forever.

name: MATT
dialogue: "This stems to your lack of respect."

name: SAM
dialogue: My lack of respect? What happened? How did you ruin us like this?

name: LAURA
dialogue: What is this syndicate you speak of?

name: MATT
dialogue: His eyes dart to you with a fiery hatred, like how dare you speak up right now. "When your "grandfather passed, when you were still but a baby, our lands were nearly taken from us by a "rival barony from within the Dwendalian court. Lord Jaipher found loopholes to revoking our "ownership and titles set by Oberon and in my panic and necessity, I found an ally in the Myriad."

name: SAM
dialogue: In the Myriad?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Through a whispered hint, I met a man named Korshad, who ensured our surviving ownership in "trade for a partnership with him. I signed, not wanting to toss, at the time, my only child "onto the street. But as the decades passed, I did not realize in my haste, the depths of the deal "that I had made. And with many harvests failing in recent years, the agreement now devours our "livelihood from within. They now demand our accrued debt paid in full or they take full "ownership of everything."

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm having trouble wrapping my head around this. You're saying everything I've lived has all been built on this deal with this shady group? You're a criminal? You're just a criminal.

name: MATT
dialogue: "No. No, it is built on what we built as a family."

name: SAM
dialogue: We didn't build anything as a family!

name: MATT
dialogue: "We did, and nearly had it taken away. I did this to maintain it. And I let you live as you all "deserved to live."

name: SAM
dialogue: But Papa, you never told me any of this. You were cold to us, and you told us a bare minimum of what you did and how you ran things.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I hoped to find a way to fix this before I needed to, yet here I am, prostrate before my own "child. Broken." And he starts, like, tears just pour down his cheeks. "I was just trying to make "it right."

name: SAM
dialogue: I didn't know any of this. How would I? And now I have to fix it for you by marrying some girl?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's a marriage of convenience."

name: SAM
dialogue: That's still a marriage.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It means nothing more than political gain. Your life is still yours to live."

name: SAM
dialogue: No, it's not! I have to be here, I have to be with her. I have to live in her castle or she in mine. (sighs) Listen, I've learned a lot from these people over the last year or so. And one thing I've learned is that you are who you are whether you have a lot of money or not. And I don't have that much anymore and I'm still okay with that. And it's not because of the things I own, it's because of the deeds that I do. You've done some bad deeds in your life, and it sounds like you've done them to preserve our family and preserve our legacy, but that's not a reason to do them.

name: MATT
dialogue: He leans forward to you and looks to you with an honest, more honest than you've seen him, very vulnerable expression. "Every man and woman who has money has done bad things."

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, I'm sure that's true. And I assume I'm somehow complicit in this.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You are not. I tried to keep you, your sister, and your mother as innocent as I could. My "back is to a wall now."

name: SAM
dialogue: I'll have to think about this.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Think on it. The choice is still yours; I would not force you into this, but it is a chance "I wish you to contemplate."

name: SAM
dialogue: What have you done to our name? Do people know of this?

name: MATT
dialogue: "No."

name: SAM
dialogue: And if I marry this girl, it will just all go away?

name: MATT
dialogue: "If you marry this girl, we will have the influence and the wealth to pay this debt and cut "ties with the Myriad entirely. We would be a free family once more."

name: LAURA
dialogue: How much debt are we talking?

name: MATT
dialogue: "The last amount we were given: 230,000 gold."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well. That's a lot.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Is there any other way than marriage that you can think of?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I've exhausted the options I have at my disposal."

name: LAURA
dialogue: What if we just wipe out the Myriad?

name: MATT
dialogue: He laughs.

name: SAM
dialogue: They're far too big.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You underestimate the sheer size and how ingrained they are in the society here. This is no "guild. Wildmount is the Myriad in many ways."

name: SAM
dialogue: And if I say no and they take all of our possessions and our estate, everything, what then? We're ruined.

name: MATT
dialogue: "We're on the street. We are but beggars within our own city, at the mercy of those we've "been taxing."

name: SAM
dialogue: How could you do this to us?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Because I loved you. I loved you all, and I did what was necessary."

name: SAM
dialogue: You never told us that. You always talked about bloodlines and legacies and the Darrington name. But you never told us you were proud. You never comforted us. You never cared what I wanted to do or who I wanted to be. I'm cursed with this name now, Darrington. You've sullied our name by enforcing these taxes and just being an asshole to everyone around our whole city, and now I have to live with it or marry this girl to save it. Listen, I'm sorry I left, and I'm sorry I took all of that gold. I did not know it was everything. But what you're asking me is-- I'll need to think. I'm sorry.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I owe you that, at least. I never claimed to be a good man. I never claimed to be a good "father, good husband, but I can try to be better, can't I?"

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, you can. I'm going to go see Mother and Sister. Might my friends stay here the night?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Of course, and enjoy the grounds while you can."

name: LAURA
dialogue: This Korshad, and the Myriad, where do you meet with him?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's been some time, but if you wish to seek him out, ask for who you can speak with the "Many, in the Grumpy Lily."

name: SAM
dialogue: Grumpy Lillian?

name: MATT
dialogue: The Grumpy Lily. You know this to be one of the seedier bars in town.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, okay.

name: LAURA
dialogue: And I'm asking to speak with the Many?

name: MATT
dialogue: You're wishing to speak with the Many.

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, good to see you. Have a good afternoon.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm glad you're safe."

name: SAM
dialogue: Thank you. It's good to see you again.

name: MATT
dialogue: "You too. More than you know, my son."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Do we leave the room?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, let's leave the room.

name: LIAM
dialogue: We could have cut that air with a knife.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So here's the thing, though. You said he like hated you, and he didn't seem like he hated you at all!

name: SAM
dialogue: He's acting differently than I recall. It's been a while. I'm not used to seeing him like this, and honestly, I don't know how to take it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, you can't marry that bitch.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: You can't marry her.

name: SAM
dialogue: It seems like I have to.

name: LAURA, ASHLEY
dialogue: No, you don't.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Got to do it.

name: SAM
dialogue: Grog says I do.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Grog.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Simplest. The shortest distance between two--

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Two points.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yep. Is--

name: SAM
dialogue: Marriage.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Marriage. Yep.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You're getting so smart, Grog! So smart.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Don't be jealous.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I know some about the Myriad, correct?

name: MATT
dialogue: You've encountered them once. Back in Stillben, back at the very beginning of your adventures. The very beginning.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Not me.

name: MATT
dialogue: Percy, this is the first you've heard.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Wait, you?

name: LAURA
dialogue: He wasn't with us yet. We had that other guy he was playing. (laughter)

name: LIAM
dialogue: Rusty. Rusty Trombone?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Rusty Trombone.

name: SAM
dialogue: He was a weird character choice.

name: MATT
dialogue: That's a good name for an artificer. (laughter) As you exit the study and close the door behind you, left in the cold, quiet silence of the house, you continue your conversation.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Where is your sister?

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't know.

name: LAURA
dialogue: How much money did you take when you left?

name: SAM
dialogue: I thought a meager amount. 50,000 gold.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's a lot.

name: LAURA
dialogue: But, I mean, considering the debt that they're in.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's literally more than my entire tribe owns.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, we have a lot more than that in our party fund.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I know. We own more than my tribe owns.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I own more than your tribe owns.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I know. I will say, Tary, I think you are special. You have very large dangling bits. Along with your earring. Very large other bits.

name: SAM
dialogue: Thank you.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We were working on that particular compliment, and I feel like we have a little way to go.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Is it all right? No? I thought that was a compliment.

name: SAM
dialogue: Tell her she did good.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are you cool with your sister?

name: SAM
dialogue: No. I'm not cool with my sister. She's not that great.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Is she married?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Do you think she knows about this?

name: SAM
dialogue: I guess. I suppose she knows about this.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And the last time you spoke with her was when you left, I'm assuming?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, that's right. She was being groomed as the heir to the family, and I was being shut out. My mother is here somewhere, too. She's pretty quiet.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: What do you want to do?

name: SAM
dialogue: I guess talk to them, but we can't go after the Myriad; they're powerful and dark.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What if we offer services, and they excuse part of the debt?

name: SAM
dialogue: No, he offered services, and look where it got him.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Do you know Lydia?

name: MATT
dialogue: You've never met Lydia in your life. You don't even know what she looks like.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm not even sure if that's something that should be entertained.

name: SAM
dialogue: We could go talk to them, but I don't see how that's going to change anything.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Maybe she's a really cool girl that won't be into you and you can just hang out and be besties?

name: SAM
dialogue: Gross.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Hey!

name: SAM
dialogue: No. I like being besties with you. I don't want some rando.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's not fair to her, either.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's not. Honestly, maybe we should just go talk to her first.

name: SAM
dialogue: Lydia?

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, she's in a whole other town.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Here's the thing, you're not going to marry her. Okay?

name: SAM
dialogue: Why not?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Because if he wants to be a better father to you, then he's going to let this go and not let you do this. If that means him being out on the street, that's my opinion.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's harsh.

name: SAM
dialogue: Everything he is, is his status, though. This place, where he lives, his servants. If he's got nothing, then he's just... he'll die.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Sometimes, when you let that go, only then are you able to truly live.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Whoa.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Deep.

name: SAM
dialogue: That is maybe true, but listen. I've been working on this for a year, and I'm starting to get really nervous. I'm down to my last few bits of gold, and I don't know how that would feel to run out.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I don't even have any money.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Because you gave it all away.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Technically, I've got a lot of money.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Money gives you everything you want.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's the best thing.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Hey, but you're thrifty. You're good.

name: SAM
dialogue: No, I'm not thrifty.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yes, you are! Taryon, I've seen make amazing things. You can survive. You've been to the depths of the watery abyss. And you've lived, kind of.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's a bad example.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm really wishing we had taken a lot more money from Thordak. If we had taken more money, everything would be fine right now.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No! That's not the lesson of the story, you guys!

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, money would have solved this.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: No! Not the lesson, not the lesson we're supposed to take away!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, I mean he's right that money would have solved this. But that's not the lesson. Keyleth is right.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I don't have an alternative for the lesson. It's just not the lesson.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We're here. We can figure out a way out of this. We're smart, we're clever, we're powerful. And what's one more cliff?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, we're gods!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Not again.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Not going to say that ever again.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I say we go talk to the Many.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yes, let's go talk to the Many.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I understand this is very complicated. Are we really looking for a solution to fix several generations of your family's misdeeds? It sounds like your father, your grandfather have been navigating murky waters for some time.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I want to find out what your sister knows.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I don't know what the right decision is, either. Do you marry this woman to fix decades of terrible decisions?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't necessarily see how two wrongs right anything here. It's just really kicking the ball down the road while you make another random human being you have not met miserable.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's right.

name: SAM
dialogue: I assume I would be a fine husband.

name: LAURA
dialogue: You'd be amazing.

name: SAM
dialogue: I feel like I'd be okay.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You make really good blondies, and many things besides blondies, as well.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh, this is so depressing. I'm not going to even pretend that this is true. Absolutely not. No. You'll be miserable, and that will make her miserable.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, it's true.

name: LIAM
dialogue: So if we know that that's not happening, then we deal with the problem that is left behind. Which is: do we worry about your family's life, their safety? Are they safe here, or are they gonna be eaten alive?

name: SAM
dialogue: I'd assume they are not safe here. We'd have to convince them to leave, or protect them somehow, or make a deal to at least protect them in poverty.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Maybe we just talk to the Myriad, talk to Korshad and see what we can do. Maybe he needs something, and we can provide it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We are bad news for anybody like that. I'm sure it would be worth their time to get us out of town, possibly get you out of town. You can't be good for business.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right. Well, a quick stop to talk to my sister, possibly, and then let's go at least investigate this contact.

name: LIAM
dialogue: God, this sucks.

name: SAM
dialogue: I appreciate you all being here for me. I'm sorry. I didn't realize that this was going to happen and I don't want-- if you fellows want to go back and just continue on, I can solve this.

dialogue: That is the most Brian Blessed thing ever.

dialogue: That's how rock gnomes sleep, they do a little circle around the cushion.
