dialogue: I just turn into Macklemore.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right. So you make it to your room, left as it was. Most of the furniture is covered in sheets, but untouched as to where you left it the last time you were here. There's a firm layer of dust across most of it, and as you step into the room, with each step you can see the footfalls leaving a small trail on the floor. You have a large shelf of books that line the right wall. You can see the footsteps to and from the bookshelf where it seems like your mother has taken, here and there, little elements of your collection. You see the covered outline of your workbench, which inhabits the far side of the chamber, and a familiar smell of old oil and leathers immediately causes a flood of memories to hit you of growing up in this space. You do see, poking out from one of these sheets, some of the leftover pieces from when you constructed your first Doty, and you see the armored hand, partially open with some of the gears and runes only partially put into the hand and then discarded and left to the side, and it also reminds you of those years. You have this nostalgic wave hit you as you pull the sheet off your bed, and dust it out, and fluff your pillow, and for the first time in a long time, have a night's sleep in your own chambers.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'll cuddle with the Doty arm.

name: MATT
dialogue: It's very cold, but sleep does take you. You guys finish your evening's rest. You awake. After the stress of the previous battle of the day, you all tend to sleep in for the most part, plus the late hour of eventually getting to rest. You all eventually come to later in the morning, closer to noon, but as you wake up, you wake up to the smell of food being cooked. You make your way out into the central foyer area of the estate, and you can see Berthold is running around the kitchen, desperately trying to put together whatever meal is viable, and eventually shouts out, "Breakfast is served!"

name: LIAM
dialogue: What you got, Bertie?

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's... dinner time! Dinner you're having-- breakfast, staying the night, "and the market wasn't open."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Potatoes!

name: MATT
dialogue: "Potatoes. Some bread, might be a bit stale. I made some stew. Breakfast stew. It's just stew, "but you're having it for breakfast. Some mushrooms. That's it. I am sorry."

name: LIAM
dialogue: A lot of carbs.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's like Comic Con all over again.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Is this how we're supposed to eat in the house of Darrington, Tary?

name: LAURA
dialogue: We just used up all of their food and they don't have any left.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm sorry. I'll talk to the help about this.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Can't you pop a crystal off of that helmet of yours and make a banquet?

name: SAM
dialogue: No. I could burn us all alive, though, with one of them.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Not the same thing.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Did we ever discover whether or not the magic jug does coffee?

name: SAM
dialogue: Only one way to find out.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Only one way to find out. Hold on. Be my guest.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Americano.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Nope.

name: SAM
dialogue: How about tea?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Tea.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Nope.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It can make alcohol and poison, but it can't make an English breakfast? Bullshit.

name: LAURA
dialogue: English breakfast ale!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Baked beans and sausages and-- ! No.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, breakfast ale. That works.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you guys complete your breakfast, you notice that eventually Maryanne's voice begins to echo through the stairway. She comes down and goes, "My word, Berthold, what are you cooking this-- " She comes down. You can see her hair is curled in front of her face and pulled back and tied up into this tight bun in the back, and she's just wearing this long, deep blue robe over her casual silk blouse attire and pants. She glances down, holding onto the railing. "Good morning."

name: SAM
dialogue: Good morning, sister. These are my friends, Vox Machina.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Hello.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Right."

name: SAM
dialogue: Grog, Pike, Vex, Vax, Percy, Keyleth.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Pleasure. Brother, I wasn't aware we had company staying."

name: SAM
dialogue: I travel with a group now.

name: MATT
dialogue: "I've heard. I just didn't realize..."

name: SAM
dialogue: I bring news, and I know it's early, but could we have a little family meeting over breakfast?

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's super important.

name: MATT
dialogue: She gives you such a stink eye. "I'll go speak to Father."

name: SAM
dialogue: And Mama.

name: MATT
dialogue: "And Mama." And she heads up the stairs.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: She seems nice.

name: SAM
dialogue: She is not.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I like her a lot.

name: MATT
dialogue: About five minutes pass, and you hear the sound of multiple footfalls as the rest of the Darrington family makes their way down. First you have Maryanne, same attire, but she's a little more put together. You can see now she's left the robe behind to have more of her classic formal presenting-to-company outfit. Behind her you have Mariya, your mother, who is in practically the same outfit she was in yesterday. She really doesn't seem to care at this point, it's more about being comfortable.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Sweat pants!

name: MATT
dialogue: A few feet behind, to his own entrance, there you see with his thick mutton chops and a tied-over, deep red, burgundy coat, Howaardt Darrington. As they all enter, Mariya immediately runs forward and goes, "Oh, I didn't realize breakfast was going to be made!" She goes over and takes a little plate and starts filling it with rolls and potatoes. She goes up and rubs your head a little bit and kisses you on the forehead, and goes, "It's nice to have company."

name: SAM
dialogue: It's nice to be home.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Did you want some stew?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Oh, yes." Howaardt, at this point, is sitting back next to Maryanne, and goes (clears throat).

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh, did you want some as well?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I'm fine for now. Your sister tells me that we are to have a family meeting."

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, and with your permission, I would like to invite my friends to stay for it as well, as it does concern them.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Hey.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Hi!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Charmed.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Very well."

name: SAM
dialogue: I bring you news, and I bring you a proposal, and as a businessman I hope you'll listen to both.

name: MATT
dialogue: He seems keen at the choice of words. "Yes, my son."

name: SAM
dialogue: First, the news. It's good news. First, I will not be marrying this Lydia person. There's no need, and also I think we all know I would not be happy in such a marriage, and we should all be free to pursue whomever we love. That's beside the point. It's not necessary, because I have made a deal with the Myriad. A deal that will spare us from any danger, and clear us from all debt. We-- Well, they, really, carried out a task for the Myriad that has absolved us of the debt that you ran up, and we are free and clear.

name: MATT
dialogue: He looks to Mariya and Maryanne and softens up. "I am... If what you say is true, then this is "indeed a great day, and I owe each and every one of you a great debt. We owe you a great debt."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Let's not get ahead of ourselves, but thank you.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, they don't-- Forgive me for speaking on your behalf. I don't think that they want to collect on a debt. They just did this because we're friends. The forgiveness of debt comes with some strings attached. We will lose most of our property and assets, but we will maintain the homestead here, and all of its possessions and artwork and belongings, we get to keep. We also get the nearby farmhouse and all of the land, and we get a new lease on life, and a new beginning. I think it's an opportunity for our family, and that leads me to my proposal. Father, as much as I have respected you for keeping us safe and providing for us, you have not given us the one thing a family needs, which is love. Real love. You have made sure that we are safe, because you care about our blood, because it is your blood, and you care about the fact that we bear your name, but you haven't given us the opportunity to be a real family, and I believe we can be, if we start out new and fresh together. Here's my proposal. I will come back and live with you, in Wildmount, and I will lead this family to a new chapter. Our business model will change a bit. I propose that we do not engage in real estate anymore, but in another venture. Forgive me, but you have sullied our name.

name: MATT
dialogue: Maryanne, at this point, says, "No, brother, you have!" And you watch as Howaardt puts his hand out in front and dad-hands her, immediately, and pushes her back, not stopping his gaze from you. His jaw clenches tight as he clears his throat and his hands go back behind his body.

name: SAM
dialogue: The Darrington name is one of ill repute. We are scoundrels, and we are land barons, and we are awful people, and now we are penniless awful people. But I feel that we can fix it. What I propose is this: Our home will be vacated by us. We are going to move to the farmhouse, where we will all live as a family. We will tend to the farm, and we will raise crops together. Our home will be turned into the Darrington Fund, for charitable giving, where people who are down on their luck can come and live and get back on their feet. Now, such a fund will need donors, and you have many contacts in the business world. You, and possibly sister, could run this foundation and spread goodness all over Wildmount, instead of badness and evil.

name: MATT
dialogue: There's a flash of movement. Quicker than you've seen your father move, he has grabbed a chair behind him, and thrown it across the room, smashing it against the nearby wall. (heavy breathing)

name: LIAM
dialogue: I take a step forward and unsheathe a dagger an inch and say, we're going to keep this civil today, aren't we?

name: MATT
dialogue: "You have no right to talk to me... You stand here and shame the work that I've done, and "given my life to secure and give to you and your sister, and to uphold the mistakes that my father "made to the best of my ability and fix them. And you waltz in here after a year of adventuring and "just expect me to accept you throwing everything I've worked for into the sewer?"

name: SAM
dialogue: I didn't do that, Father, you did. It's gone. Everything is gone. You don't even own your own house anymore.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It wouldn't be that way if you would've just married that girl."

name: SAM
dialogue: That's not going to happen. In my year of travel, I didn't just dilly-dally around the world having fun. I was learning about the world and about life and about family. I was learning from these fine people what it means to really be a family, and care about each other. I learned from Grog and Vax what it means to be a man, and to be a father. I learned from Pike what it means to be a caring mother. I learned from Keyleth what a real sister is like, one who loves you and cares for you. I learned from Vex what a best friend is like. These are things you never gave us, growing up. I even learned from Percival... the type of man I would want to marry one day. And we never got that at home. And from this day forth, I'm going to create a home, my home, that I own, that values and respects the opinions of each family member. That cares for one another. Where we stick up for each other, and help each other through hard times, and not just rule by decree. If you don't want to be a part of this, that's fine. You can leave my house. But I want you to stay. I need your counsel, and I need your help, and we need you as a father. I need you and Sister to run this foundation for me, to repair our name and our reputation. It could be great. It could be the best thing that's ever happened to us. And there's more. I have an idea. To create something else. A team of adventurers, based here in Wildmount. The Darrington Brigade, led by me, Taryon Darrington. We will fight for justice, and win battles against evildoers, and spread the Darrington name around the continent. I know I'm getting ahead of myself, but I feel like if we embarked on this new adventure together, it could save our name and repair our relationship. As a businessman, I'm asking you to consider it. Because your other options are... Well, they're not great.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make a persuasion check

name: LAURA
dialogue: The deal we made with the Myriad, sir...

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm going to use Luck.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No one would know that you were forced out of your home. Everyone thinks that this was your choice, that you're being charitable.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm going to see if the fates can help me.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You're going to use it now?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh my god.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Cash it in!

name: SAM
dialogue: That's a 25.

name: MATT
dialogue: That's a moment to do it. You see as Mariya, your mother, has now moved to the side of Howaardt, holding his arm. "Honey, there was no other path. This is a gift." He pulls his arm from her and begins to walk toward you. You watch as Maryanne has put on a shocked face, gone pale white, and for a moment, the facade of the adult gives away to the child. "Father." As he walks up to you, you watch as he brings his hand up, and falls into his own hand, and falls to his knees on the ground. He's shaking, he's quaking. His fist is clenched there, and he slams it into the ground, once, twice, a third time, each one a resounding knock of him hitting bone and skin against wood. And he does it again, and again, and again, all the anger and fury being focused into this. As he stops, you can see the blood pouring from the side of the knuckles, and his hand is shaking. He stops and looks at it. (deep breath) And for the first time-- not even the other evening, in which there was a sort of feigned softness to him, that you have read through before and seen-- for the first time you see your father as a broken man. He looks up at you. "I lost "everything. I did this to us." He looks back at Mariya, and Maryanne, and to you. The dampness gathering down the side of his wrinkled cheeks, gathering across the stubble on his chin, and vanishing amongst the cluster of thin, bristly facial hair. "I'm sorry. I'm sorry."

name: SAM
dialogue: I am, too.

name: MATT
dialogue: He looks about at this point. Now, his focused anger has subsided, and this emotional moment realizing that there are strangers at the table, and he (clears throat) "If you could please "give us a bit of time." His hand still clustered there. He looks over to Berthold, who ushers you all out front, you staying behind, Taryon. About ten minutes or so, as you're all awkwardly waiting outside in the quiet. The cloudy day that originally brought you into Deastok is breaking in places, you see hints of blue sky peeking through, and a little bit of sunlight occasionally finding its way across the cobblestone roads of the cityscape. You hear the occasional tweet of birds as they jump from tree to tree. And in this silence you really get to take in the surrounding beauty of this town, even as oppressive and gloomy as your arrival may have been, and the tenseness of the work you had to do in this space. You allow yourself to realize that this is a nice town. You hear the door open once more from the front of the estate, and there you see Maryanne, wet on the cheeks. "My father would like to speak to you, if that's all right."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Sure, sure.

name: MATT
dialogue: She steps back in and Howaardt comes back. He is more composed than he was before. He is back to his presentory self. "When my son left, I was under the impression that his fanciful ideas would "either break him and send him back to me to finally listen to what I had to teach, if luck was "with us. If not, his fool's errand was bound to get him killed. It is by some miracle that he "found you. I don't know what's in store for my children, my wife, myself. There is a lot to "discuss, a lot to decide. Us as a family. And I'm still processing all of it. I'm sorry you got "pulled into all of this, but I'm glad that you gave him your friendship. And I'm sorry you had to "see this." He's hiding his bad hand under the good one. "I'm sure in time I'll come to appreciate "this. Out of desperation and obsession, I became my father, something I promised I would never do. "And I'm sorry." He looks back over his shoulder at Tary, who's a few feet behind him. "I'm sorry." Then he walks back into the house and just--

name: LIAM
dialogue: Sir.

name: MATT
dialogue: He stops a little bit and looks back over his shoulder towards you.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Second chances are a gift. I pray you don't squander it.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You're not the first man to panic at the loss of his shackles. I hope you eventually enjoy the freedom that you've just been given from your legacy.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Legacy." He continues walking into the house.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Sir, may I have your hand, please?

name: MATT
dialogue: He stops. "I'm sorry, what?"

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: May I have your hand? Not in marriage, I worded that strangely. Just your hand that's hurt.

name: MATT
dialogue: He's still clutching and hiding it. He gives you a look of understanding of what you're asking. "I appreciate the offer, but this needs to heal on its own."

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Understood.

name: MATT
dialogue: "This pain shouldn't be fleeting." And he walks away inside.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I have a question. Is there any more stew?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I don't know.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: My stomach is making noises, I'm so hungry.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I feel like we could find better stew. No offense.

name: LAURA
dialogue: So...

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, yes. My place is here. I'm coming back to Whitestone with you, I have to. I have to retrieve Doty and my personal belongings.

name: LAURA
dialogue: But we just finished your room!

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, I'll come visit. I was thinking, for my Darrington Brigade, I'll need lots of recruits, and maybe I could get some down in Whitestone. You know, fine fighters and young trainees. I even have an idea for my first adventuring partner. I think if I sold my old armor, I could afford that drow for a year, and she lives close by.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: This is a lot.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I don't think that's a half-bad idea. We're all very proud of you.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: So proud.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It's very impressive.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I understand legacy and responsibility and I think it's very admirable of you to recognize your place.

name: SAM
dialogue: I've always known that I was not fit to travel with you all, and I know that you all love me, but you don't really like me that much. Oh, I can be kind of a dick sometime.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I like it! I like dicks!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: A year ago, it was definitely true, but now...

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What about the bakery?

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, the bakery! I'm really bad at baking too.

name: LAURA
dialogue: No, but you're so good at selling stuff!

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah, I am.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I feel like some people come in just to see you and see you smile.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, you're definitely the face guy! You're the good salesman!

name: SAM
dialogue: Sure, sure, that makes sense.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You can sell anyone on a shitty cake that you baked!

name: SAM
dialogue: I'll come down and visit a lot.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: What's a lot?

name: SAM
dialogue: You know, once every year, around Winter's Crest. Well, I mean, it's a long way, and I can't Tree Stride or whatever you call it.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I can come get you.

name: SAM
dialogue: Listen, let's not do this now. I'm coming back with you. I have to go get my robit. All right?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, don't expect us to be okay with this. That's not going to happen.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I mean, to be fair, Tary does have a point. I also have a responsibility, and...

name: SAM
dialogue: You're leaving, too?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yes. Well, technically...

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm the chief of my people.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh my god, are we all breaking up?

name: LAURA
dialogue: What?! No!

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: We're not doing this now! What's happening? What is happening?

name: SAM
dialogue: I didn't mean to do this! I didn't know this was going to happen!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There's no more discussion until there's food and caffeine. This is madness.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: We're just hungry! We're just hungry.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: This is hunger talking.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We're just feeling hangry as shit.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Everybody needs to calm down.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We need brunch.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: All right. We'll get brunch back in Whitestone, right, and get out of here?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Let's go to Whitestone. Let's leave. I don't like this place anymore.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Let's go, then. You don't say one word. No, you shut up.

name: SAM
dialogue: I need to go say good-bye to Mama, that's it, then I can go, all right?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: She can come to Whitestone anytime.

name: SAM
dialogue: She literally has no money to travel.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We can make it happen.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Well, say your goodbyes.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right, I'll go find Mom.

name: MATT
dialogue: She's inside right now. As you walk inside, she's sitting at the table where everyone had breakfast, she's eating what was on her plate, alone. She turns around.

name: SAM
dialogue: Mama, I'm sorry to spring all of this on you and I must go back to Whitestone with my friends, to tie up some loose ends, but I'll be back soon. Days, maybe a week.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Be back, please."

name: SAM
dialogue: In the meantime, though, can you think about something for me?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Of course, what do you need?"

name: SAM
dialogue: The charity. Papa and Sister can run it, they have smarter business acumen than I do, but the brigade, I was wondering if you wanted to do it with me. You have a taste for adventure, you could help be our manager! Tend to us when we're injured...

name: MATT
dialogue: "Taryon, I'm far too old for adventure."

name: SAM
dialogue: I don't think that's true!

name: MATT
dialogue: "As an organizer?"

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes, yes! Remember in Escape from Brave Mountain? Remember the kindly old wizard who stayed back and tended to the injured and fed them when they were sick with that mystical plague that they got? You could be that old-- Yes. Think about it. Read the book again. And when I come back, we'll talk.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right. But if you're going out and you're coming back, and I'm to help, "bring back a better outfit."

name: SAM
dialogue: Okay! Do you have a color in mind?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Royal blue."

name: SAM
dialogue: On it. I give her a big hug.

name: MATT
dialogue: She gives you a big hug. As she hugs you, her mouth gets near your ear and she goes, "I'm glad you listened."

name: SAM
dialogue: Me too. Mama, this is going to be fun, fun, fun!

name: MATT
dialogue: She sniffles a bit and pushes you away. "Now go, go! Hurry back! Be safe!"

name: SAM
dialogue: Maybe! All right, let's go.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Do we assume the form of clouds?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, no, this is probably a Tree Stride situation. Let's do that.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: It would have been a very long cloud stride. Is it even possible to cloud stride?

name: MATT
dialogue: It's possible, it's just going to be a long journey.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Tree Stride!

name: MATT
dialogue: Transport Via Plants. Tree Stride is a very different spell.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Whatever, that one. Sorry, that's the fifth level one. The sixth level teleport... transport...

name: MATT
dialogue: I know what you mean, but I was opting for clarification. Transport Via Plants. I know what you mean.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It is. Tree Stride just rolls off the tongue easier.

name: MATT
dialogue: I know it does.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Plant Walk. Tree Trip.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Tree Uber.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Treecycle. Leaft.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Sorry, pull the plug, people, wrap it up.

name: MATT
dialogue: You find the nearest large tree and with a quick snap of your fingers, a flash of druidic energy, you watch as the tree form splits open, revealing the doorway. On the other side, the main thoroughfare of Whitestone. You step through and find yourself back in your home city.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: On the way out, I give the Sun Tree our secret handshake.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Like, a judo strike?

name: SAM
dialogue: You just killed the tree.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Quivering Palm the Sun Tree.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Sun Tree is still doing it the first time, three years ago.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's so slow.

name: MATT
dialogue: You knock on the Sun Tree a little bit, continue walking. First thing that catches your attention, the main square of Whitestone, largely around the Sun Tree, is fairly empty except for a few carts. It's mostly for traversing. There's a small garden that's in the early stages of being set around. As you walk into the main area, you notice that there's a lot of carts that are circling the north end of it, like a small caravan of sorts. You see a series of wagons, some horses that are tied off at a couple of hitching posts off to the side, and you see what appear to be tents and tables with various wares for sale. Fruits, vegetables, some exotic cloths and tapestries, clothing available.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Is this a festival?

name: LAURA

dialogue: I'm Taryon Darrington. I stand up and I say, I've seen this before. He will attack brutally. Drink this. And I shove a Swift Step draught in his mouth. You can run 80 feet now every turn.

dialogue: All right, so you can move pretty fast if you want to.

dialogue: Keyleth is just watching intently, and more importantly watching Grog, making sure he doesn't actually beat him to death. We'll stop this if it gets bad.

dialogue: I take a seat on a bar stool and just start drinking.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yeah, we're sitting next to you.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you're preparing, Grog, this guy who's a little larger than you are, and as soon as he stands up you're like, "Oh!" And he's quicker than you thought. Grog, what are you gonna do?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Are we at a table or the bar?

name: MATT
dialogue: You are, yeah.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: At a table or at the bar?

name: MATT
dialogue: Oh, you were at a table within the bar.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Magnificent. I flip up the table in my hands and I smash it over his head.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, go ahead and roll for an attack.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That doesn't belong to you. That's coming out of my coffer.

name: MATT
dialogue: 25, okay. That hits. Go ahead and roll another d4.

name: JON
dialogue: So I'm quick but not that quick.

name: MATT
dialogue: 12 points of bludgeoning damage to you as he smashes the table over your head. Lionel, the wood splinters and breaks around you, and you hear the crack of the broken wood, and you can feel the splinters shred across the edge of your shoulders, causing the burst of warmth and blood begin to flow to the top of your shoulders, and you're like, "Oh, this is exhilarating." All right. That's your turn? All right, Lionel, you're up.

name: JON
dialogue: Okay! To fight?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You can do anything you like.

name: JON
dialogue: Yeah, I definitely want to fight back because this is fun.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Cool. Here to help.

name: MATT
dialogue: It's a bonus action to rage if you want.

name: JON
dialogue: Yeah, but I like the-- What?

name: MATT
dialogue: It's a bonus action to rage, if you want to do that.

name: JON
dialogue: Yeah, I saw his rage, and I-- no, I'm going to rage, because I want to mimic. Like, hey, I can rage, too! Watch this! So do I roll that?

name: MATT
dialogue: No, no. You're now raging, so now your muscles swell, the veins bulge out, with this big grin on his mouth. When Grog's raging, Grog's angry rage. He's happy rage.

name: JON
dialogue: Oh, check it out! You can see my veins go (jingling).

name: MATT
dialogue: So what do you want to do for your turn?

name: JON
dialogue: I want to go and do... So I run up to him, and I go to do the really cool thing I heard in a cool story where I twist up my fist and I go (whoosh) (pow). I've always wanted to try this, and this looks like a better time than ever to try it out.

name: MATT
dialogue: So, roll for an attack and it's plus ten. We'll say plus ten for this.

name: MATT
dialogue: What's your AC? 17? Go ahead and roll a d4 and add your strength modifier, which I think is a plus five.

name: JON
dialogue: And I am looking for what?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: And you add five for your strength, so you got--

name: JON
dialogue: So, eight.

name: MATT
dialogue: So, eight points of bludgeoning damage. You take four, Grog.

name: SAM
dialogue: Plus three damage.

name: MATT
dialogue: Oh, plus three damage on top of that! So, eight, so 11. Sorry, you take five.

name: SAM
dialogue: He takes half-damage. But you did great.

name: MATT
dialogue: You're both raging. You're both taking the lesser damage of each hit.

name: SAM
dialogue: You get two attacks, but you're raging, so you get a third attack?

name: MATT
dialogue: No, Grog has that ability. He has a different-- he's not a frenzy barbarian.

name: SAM
dialogue: But he does get two attacks.

name: MATT
dialogue: He does get two attacks. So you get to attack again.

name: JON
dialogue: This time, I run around him because I'm super quick and like using this new speed I've never experienced. And I jump on his back from around and I try to choke him.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Grapple.

name: MATT
dialogue: Go ahead and roll an athletics check.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That plus ten.

name: MATT
dialogue: You go ahead and roll an athletics or acrobatics check to resist it.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, shit, his is huge.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: That's not great. That's a 14.

name: MATT
dialogue: 14. You leap up behind him and put your arm up under. His jaw's like concrete, but you still find the one soft part and jam your bulging forearm up into that space and you feel the windpipe (choke) close and clench in.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (choking sounds)

name: MATT
dialogue: And your really, really fast feet are now dangling about two inches off the ground as you're on his back right now. That's the end of your turn. You're currently grappled, Grog, what are you going to do?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: (choking sounds) I'm going to put it in reverse straight towards the wall.

name: MATT
dialogue: Go ahead and roll. Are you just going to stay holding on as you're doing it?

name: JON
dialogue: Yeah. Yeah. Because this is the first piggyback he's ever had.

name: MATT
dialogue: It's kind of fun for a second before you hit the wood. Wham! I'll say, go ahead and roll a strength saving throw to see if you can maintain the hold after the slam.

name: MATT
dialogue: 18. Okay, I'd say that's enough for the strength of the hold. So he keeps holding on after the slam in the back. Anything else you're going to do with your turn?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: My action. I take my elbow, raise it up and drive it into his ribs.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, roll for an attack.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, that's a 28.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, so 1d4.

name: SAM
dialogue: Now he has to roll damage.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Ten.

name: MATT
dialogue: So, ten damage halved to five and you have an ability as reaction, if you remember. It's in your totem abilities that you can use as a reaction.

name: JON
dialogue: Oh! Off a Duck's Back!

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Off a Duck's Back?!

name: JON
dialogue: The duck is my animal totem, you guys. I can explain that later.

name: MATT
dialogue: So, as you go to slam him with your elbow, you hit, but you feel like your elbow slips off his body and doesn't quite do the damage you hoped it would. So you take two points of damage.

name: JON
dialogue: Sweet!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Covered in duck butter.

name: LIAM
dialogue: It's the saxophone player from Lost Boys: greased up!

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: For my second attack, can I throw my head back in a headbutt?

name: MATT
dialogue: Go for it, roll for an attack.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, 23.

name: MATT
dialogue: All right, so go ahead and roll 1d4 plus strength.

name: MATT
dialogue: 11. So you take five points of bludgeoning damage, because you can only use that reaction once per round.

name: JON
dialogue: I took five points.

name: MATT
dialogue: You have to use an action to try and break free of a grapple. So you took five, yeah. So now it's back to your turn. He slammed you into the wall, he's elbowed you twice in the stomach, you've resisted some of it, you're still holding him there.

name: JON
dialogue: Okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: So if you wanted to, because of one of the feats you have, you could turn that into a pin if you wanted to.

name: JON
dialogue: One of the feats I have?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, it's on the bottom.

name: JON
dialogue: Now this is turning into a wrestling match, I like that.

name: MATT
dialogue: Or you could just keep whaling on him.

name: JON
dialogue: I want to take him out. Not kill. He's just having fun.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: It's going down in the Whole Foods parking lot!

name: JON
dialogue: So I'm still hanging on him.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, you're holding onto him by throat, he slammed you against the wall, he's elbowed you in the stomach twice.

name: JON
dialogue: I'm, again, having fun, superspeed. I'm going to, while holding onto him, crawl up his back and jump over and try to land and try to do the move where I do that and throw him.

name: ALL
dialogue: Yeah!

name: JON
dialogue: Yeah, against one of the pillars in the bar, away from the innocent people.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make an athletics check. And you have advantage on this because you're raging, so you roll twice and take the higher of the two.

name: JON
dialogue: Oh, it's just the best?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Roll again. Yeah, roll again, best of two. Better!

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, 22. Grog, I'm going to say, because you're grappled, go ahead and roll an athletics check with disadvantage.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: You got it.

name: MATT
dialogue: It should be one roll, because you're raging, you also get advantage on it, technically.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Just one roll? 24.

name: MATT
dialogue: 24. You reach off, you leap over and you grab him and you go to pull and it's like pulling a pillar. Not budging. You can try again if you want to, or do something else.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh, because he has a second...

name: MATT
dialogue: He has a second attack, yeah.

name: JON
dialogue: I tried to jump over, so now I'm just-- Actually, I did the flip but I didn't pull him, so now I'm just hanging on the front of him. I'm still holding on, but now I'm in front of him, dangling.

name: MATT
dialogue: He's stand-spooning you.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: What is this?

name: JON
dialogue: Yeah, so now I--

name: SAM
dialogue: Reverse pile-drive.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Go for it! Don't think, act!

name: JON
dialogue: Well, I want to start--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What would Chode do?

name: JON
dialogue: Well, this is play for him, so I don't know, this is not an attack, I just want to tickle him. Kind of grinding on him. In a way, trying to use that to his advantage to make him uncomfortable.

name: MATT
dialogue: Make an intimidation check.

name: JON
dialogue: That's an intimidation, okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: Against Grog? Yeah.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Oh! Grog's ticklish!

name: MATT
dialogue: Grog, make a wisdom saving throw.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Minus two. Four.

name: JON
dialogue: You guys get what I'm doing.

name: MATT
dialogue: I'm going to say, for the purposes of this, it catches you so off-guard and it's so unexpected that you're stunned for the next round.

name: ALL
dialogue: Oh!

name: MATT
dialogue: As you do that, you see him walk up and he starts pushing you away.

name: JON
dialogue: Does he let go? I can let go now.

name: MATT
dialogue: You can let go, yeah. He's like, "Uh, uh!" You get a full other turn, what are you going to do?

name: JON
dialogue: Can I run back, and then do a (yelling) and then I just dive in with the biggest punch I can.

name: MATT
dialogue: Go for it. You back away, you leap--

name: JON
dialogue: Yeah, everything I can put into it, all force, because I still want to get a good punch in there.

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah, go ahead and roll for an attack. If you want it, you can make it reckless.

name: JON
dialogue: Yeah, he's definitely reckless.

name: MATT
dialogue: So roll twice and take the higher on each attack.

name: JON
dialogue: 15. What is that?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's a 20.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh, that crits!

name: MATT
dialogue: Go ahead and roll a d4.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: He's also got Brutal Critical, so that adds 2d6 to that, but we'll get to that.

name: MATT
dialogue: Technically, it would add a d4, because he's not using his sword. So, roll that twice and then add your strength.

name: SAM
dialogue: But he's raging, so another three.

name: MATT
dialogue: 16 points of bludgeoning damage to you, Grog. That's eight.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Eight, got it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: How are you doing, Grog? Are you still okay? Are you bloodied yet?

name: SAM
dialogue: He's down 22 hit points.

dialogue: As your first attack, you run in. Right as soon as he looks up, you're smiling as you come at him. name: JON
dialogue: I'm going to do my Wave Kick. That's just something he's always wanted to try, he doesn't know if it'll work. It's where he does a full-body-- and then his foot kicks him right in the groin.

name: MATT
dialogue: Awesome. You've practiced this alone many times, this is your first chance to actually use it. So go ahead and make an attack for your Wave Kick.

name: JON
dialogue: Right in the crotch.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Lionel, with his nunchucks, in the family den.

name: MATT
dialogue: Basically.

name: JON
dialogue: So just an attack?

name: MATT
dialogue: Well, it's reckless, so you roll twice, take the higher.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Roll again. Better.

name: MATT
dialogue: So go ahead and roll a d4 and add your damage.

name: JON
dialogue: One.

name: SAM
dialogue: Plus five is six?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, you only roll the d4 once.

name: SAM
dialogue: So one plus five plus three.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, so nine. You take four points of bludgeoning damage, Grog, and you just took a swift Wave Kick to the groin, as he kind of (whack). Little snap right to the nuts, so it's not like an immediate pain, it's the tap. name: ASHLEY
dialogue: (deadpan) Grog, stop, no, don't kill him.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'm so confused. I've never had another male do that to my body. He shimmied on me. And then he punched me. And then he kicked me in the jellies. I turn around and I leave. (gasping)

name: MATT
dialogue: He just walked away.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's over?

name: JON
dialogue: That was fun, you guys. That was fun.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Pike, do you want to go deal with that?

name: JON
dialogue: I was just having fun. Is he all right?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: He'll be fine.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I've never seen Grog walk away from a fight. He's not fine. What are you talking about?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I didn't say he's fine, I said he will be fine.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm pretty sure this makes you a member of Vox Machina now.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Let's not get ahead of ourselves.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, that's what happened to me, they attacked me and then I was in.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: There was chocolate milk on the way.

name: MATT
dialogue: You see the woman in the back is carrying this mug and is like, "Right."

name: SAM
dialogue: He'll need a straw.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Here's your chocolate milk."

name: JON
dialogue: Anybody else want to fight?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I punch him across the face. (cheering)

name: MATT
dialogue: You get the chocolate milk to your mouth, before (impact sound) knocks it right out of your hand.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Were you standing on the table when this happened? I'm so excited.

name: MATT
dialogue: And you watch, the fist comes across, and the gnome that is in an arc of movement lands on her feet. You look down and you can see the white-haired, fully armored gnome there with her big gauntlets is now there below you, kind of grinning and growling.

dialogue: That was good chocolate milk!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We'll have another.

name: JON
dialogue: I'm bummed about the chocolate. You guys have any more chocolate milk?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yeah."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Another round.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Okay." She wanders off.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Chocolate's expensive, here.

name: JON
dialogue: That was awesome.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: She can take it.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I'm pretty awesome. I finish my ale, flick a money on the bar, and leave. Oh shit, I don't have any money, because I gave it all away. Tary, Tary?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm covering, I'm covering.

name: SAM
dialogue: Thank you, because I don't have much.

name: MATT
dialogue: She goes, "And the table?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Sorry. There's a pile that's been growing on the table of gold for the furniture.

name: MATT
dialogue: "All right, thank you." Brings you another round of chocolate milk.

name: JON
dialogue: Is anybody going to hit me before I drink this?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, I think that's done now.

name: JON
dialogue: I'm not, like, I'm not checking. It's fine if you do. Okay.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Just drink it first.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think it's chocolate milk time.

name: JON
dialogue: Mmm.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Maybe I drink too much. I'm not sure. This is really nice.

name: JON
dialogue: I just want to say, you guys, this is the most fun I've had in a long time. Aes, or you guys call him Scanlan?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Aes is fine, Aes is fine.

name: JON
dialogue: He's all I've known for the past year, you know? He took me in when, you know, things weren't going too well for me. And it's been great. He had a really cool speech about family, I've never heard him talk like that. It was kind of weird, because he's always been this really tough guy, but I don't know if you guys realize that I just found out he lied to me for a year.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, we know. It's why we took you to a bar. He's lied to us, too.

name: JON
dialogue: Well, I know that he lied to you, and I just found out that he lied to me, but it's okay.

name: MARISHA, TALIESIN
dialogue: Yeah.

name: JON
dialogue: Because I realise that he was always there, and even though I worked for him, and, you know, he told me what to do, and would bark orders, he always had my back, and he was the only one who took care of me. So I think you guys should, like, be nice to him. Or--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That's the trouble, he does always have your back, until he doesn't.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: The idiot has a point.

name: SAM
dialogue: Well, let's not call names.

name: JON
dialogue: What's an idiot?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Oh hey, Tary.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You're still here.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes. I am.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I get confused because of the cup.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I know.

name: SAM
dialogue: Taryon Darrington, pleased to make your acquaintance. Hi. I'm going to be leaving soon. (laughter)

name: JON
dialogue: Can I kick you in the nuts?

name: SAM
dialogue: Uh, please don't. I'm very dainty.

name: JON
dialogue: Okay.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Extremely dainty.

name: JON
dialogue: You guys seem like you all enjoy that kind of stuff, it's awesome.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Well, you've met the couple that do.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: You're not wrong. Only Scanlan can make Vox Machina speechless. It's happened a few times tonight. Did you notice that?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Hadn't.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I did.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm really angry.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What do we do?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I want to go see that bloody orb.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Hey, Chode?

name: JON
dialogue: Mm?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Lionel.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Sorry.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You're so good about this normally.

name: JON
dialogue: It's all right. At least you guys are remembering one of my names. I had to come up with a couple-- I used to have ten, just to make it easier for people to even call me a name.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I have quite a few names myself.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Chard? Where did you come from before you met Scanlan?

name: JON
dialogue: Well, I lived in the desert. I woke up, I don't remember much when I was a baby. I'm sure you guys all remember when you were babies, but--

name: SAM
dialogue: Nope. Usually not.

name: JON
dialogue: I always thought that's how it was done.

name: SAM
dialogue: Nope. Nobody does. So far, so good.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Don't break him, please.

name: JON
dialogue: But the only thing I knew, I was orphaned, I didn't-- I never know my parents, 'cause I woke up in a basket, in a small creek, and the only thing that was there were ducks.

name: SAM
dialogue: Wait, wait--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: No, no, no, don't say wait! Go on.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Just let him tell his story.

name: JON
dialogue: And ever since then, ducks have been my spirit animal, and I feel like they bring me strength, and bring me-- make me smarter and they give me courage. So I grew up in the desert. It was a rough time, but--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Were these desert ducks?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah, how'd you know they were ducks? Normally ducks don't live in the desert.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: These must have been very interesting ducks.

name: LIAM
dialogue: They were actually vultures. (laughter)

name: LAURA
dialogue: You're not there.

name: JON
dialogue: What's a vult--

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Nothing-- said a voice that wasn't there. Carry on.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: They were ducks.

name: JON
dialogue: It was a small pond in the middle of the desert. Some people called it an oasis or something.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: An oasis, yes.

name: JON
dialogue: Now, you know, I never saw ducks again there, so, I don't know, but I'm confident they were real.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Migratory, perhaps.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: The ducks blessed you. And your birth and your survival.

name: JON
dialogue: Yeah, I just, uh--

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He doesn't know what a vulture is! (chuckles)

name: JON
dialogue: I realised I was strong, and I could do really, you know, awesome things with my body, so I did-- that kind of helped me when growing up, and then finally I came to the city of--

name: SAM
dialogue: (whispers) Ank'harel.

name: JON
dialogue: Ank'harel.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's a continent, but-- oh wait, no, the continent-- no, Marquet is the continent. Ank'harel is the city, okay.

name: JON
dialogue: Yeah, stupid. (laughter)

name: MARISHA
dialogue: That's fair. I've earned that.

name: JON
dialogue: Ever since I got to the city, I started using it, but people would abuse me, and my body for its, like, abilities. So until one day, I met Aes. He was kind, and he brought me into his family.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Family.

name: JON
dialogue: A lot of talk of family, today.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He talked a lot of family to you?

name: SAM
dialogue: And ducks.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And ducks. Did he talk much more about his family to you?

name: JON
dialogue: No, I didn't-- I didn't know he had a daughter. I mean, there was this really, like, killer babe in our group, I didn't-- where is he? Where's Aes, you guys?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Aes ain't here right now.

name: JON
dialogue: Well, don't tell him, but... I always had a thing for her, but now that I know it's his daughter, yeesh.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: You're not the first.

name: JON
dialogue: Yeah, that's good to know. So. But no, I didn't know much about, you know, he didn't tell me much, I didn't ask a lot of questions. Nobody's ever asked me questions. You guys are great.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Boy, that's not true. But that's good. You're a fascinating creature, sir. Good man.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We like you. We like you, Chode. Lionel. We like you, Lionel. Hey, Lion. C'mere, c'mere.

name: SAM
dialogue: No.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Parchment-boulder-shears. Parchment-boulder-shears! I'm going to teach you.

name: SAM
dialogue: It's like rock-paper-scissors.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay, ready, ready, ready? Boulder, parchment, or shears. Okay. Ready? On three.

name: JON, MARISHA
dialogue: One, two, three.

name: JON
dialogue: I punch her. (laughter)

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Never mind, not disappointed.

name: MATT
dialogue: As this transpires, we come over to you two, having a drink. So you guys find a separate pub.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I figured we just sat under the Sun Tree.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, I've got a flask.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay, so you guys sit under the Sun Tree. It's midafternoon.

name: LIAM
dialogue: This is complicated. Real complicated.

name: LAURA

dialogue: Gross ocular muscles. I just want to make you feel good, man, so I'll just sing to you. I'll hold up my cone, and I'll sing, (singing) Just the two of us. You can't quit me if you tried. Just the two of us. Me and your eye. So I'll Dominate Person.

dialogue: He's back.

dialogue: That is... That's an 11. All right. His grin glazes over and he goes...

dialogue: He?

dialogue: "He. One of the acolytes."

dialogue: "I do not know. They shriek, they eat, they watch. I do not mess with such terrible and "wonderful instruments."

dialogue: How does he get through all the dead?

dialogue: "It protects those of us who are not as esteemed in the arts of necromancy to not be "bothered by the roving, long-dead soldiers of the last war on Thar Amphala."

dialogue: Thar Amphala. Thar Amphala, the city built for the Whispered One, long ago.

dialogue: Who lives in the tower, Vecna? Is that where he is?

dialogue: He just looks at you strangely.

dialogue: It's got to come from him.

dialogue: I'm a really good friend of his.

dialogue: Oh, but he's not back yet!

dialogue: The Mistress Delilah. Where is she right now?

dialogue: Do you? Roll a strength check.

name: MATT

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Is it further?

name: MATT
dialogue: Yep.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Shit. I walk back.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. You join the rest of the group and you watch half your party still stumbling into pieces of stone. Pike, you with your eyes closed, still seeing this burning beacon, this circular sphere wreathed in flame that just licks up as the flames slowly burn out of the bottom of this structure and flicker off into nothing. You step for about two minutes or so in its direction, and the heat gets warmer and warmer and warmer, and then you open your eyes for a moment and you're right in front of it.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Hey, guys, can you see me?

name: LAURA, SAM
dialogue: Can we hear her?

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys can hear her, yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh shit. I open my eyes.

name: MATT
dialogue: You look down and she's right in front of the crystal structure.

name: LAURA
dialogue: She got all the fucking way there? What did you do, Pike?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I just thought about it. I closed my eyes and I started walking.

name: LAURA
dialogue: That's what I fucking did.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, I did, too. Ow.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Open your eyes, Grog.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I walked the other way, and it definitely didn't work.

name: SAM
dialogue: What is she doing that we're not doing? Her hair is partially blue. Maybe we should dye our hair blue, as well.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Maybe you can only get here if you're a believer of Sarenrae.

name: SAM
dialogue: Oh. I'm a believer. Can I try?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: (singing) I'm a believer.

name: SAM
dialogue: All right.

name: MATT
dialogue: You close your eyes?

name: SAM
dialogue: Yeah. I'm going to clutch my symbol of Sarenrae and I'm going to close my eyes and I'm going to see if anything happens.

name: MATT
dialogue: You sit there in silence for about a minute and a half as the darkness is there before you, pitch black. And you're clutching the symbol as hard as you can with your fingers, to the point where it's almost hurting your hand, and you see the faintest distant flicker.

name: SAM
dialogue: I'm going to go towards it.

name: MATT
dialogue: You guys watch Scanlan, eyes closed, begin walking towards the crystalline structure.

name: LAURA
dialogue: It's working for him.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm going to follow him.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm going to try to follow him. I'm not going to aim for the tower, I'm going to try to get to Pike.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. So you're going straight for Pike?

name: LAURA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. And you're following Scanlan?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Yeah. Just nonchalantly.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Vax? Keyleth? Grog?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What do we do?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'm not going anywhere.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Come on, Grog.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'm confused. I want to see what happens to those two when they follow.

name: MATT
dialogue: So what are you guys doing?

name: LIAM
dialogue: How is it working? What are you guys doing?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: They're believers.

name: SAM
dialogue: Maybe you guys have to believe.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Well, I think that the existence of a pantheon of gods is a well-established fact in our world, so I believe.

name: SAM
dialogue: So poetic.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Do I have to believe deeper than that?

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I think, perhaps, you need reverence.

name: MATT
dialogue: Scanlan and Percival disappear into the brush ahead of you guys as you're having this conversation. You, rushing towards Pike, as you're going towards her, you're not getting any closer. You can see things rushing past you, but there's some disconnect, that as soon as you begin to change focus, you're right where you were. Grog and Scanlan. Scanlan, you step forward, and that beacon becomes brighter and warmer, and you feel the warmth and you open your eyes, and you're there next to Pike, in front of the palace. And Grog, you walked alongside Scanlan, and you walked as he watched and you went past the brush and suddenly, you're at the palace.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'm there?!

name: MATT
dialogue: Yeah. Sorry, not Grog. Percy was. You stayed back. I misremembered.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I grab Keyleth's hands.

name: MATT
dialogue: Percival. That's my fault. So Percival, you made it past the boundary with Scanlan.

name: LAURA
dialogue: How did you-- how did-- Shit. We should have followed Pike.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But Percy, you don't believe in anything. This is bullshit!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I believe in plenty of things. But, yeah, no, I agree. This is bullshit.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm going to close my eyes and be like, Sarenrae, I really believe in you. You're so holy, and very divine and beautiful, and I think you do really good things for Pike, and I'm very happy about that.

name: MATT
dialogue: You concentrate. A minute. Two minutes. Five minutes.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Fuck. This is not working!

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: Pike. Pike, do you want to collect the rest of them and lead them back here?

name: LIAM
dialogue: I scoop up Keyleth's hands and I say, you trust me, right?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LIAM
dialogue: Yeah, yeah, you know that good feeling that you have when you hang out with Pike? You know that warm feeling you have. Toasting marshmallows with her around the fire, that kind of feeling?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You know that comes from Sarenrae, so focus on that with me. And we'll go to Pike. Focus on Sarenrae and that marshmallow feeling.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: But that comes from Pike, not from Sarenrae.

name: LIAM
dialogue: You know that's partially true, but not all true. Come on, give it a shot.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay. I try really hard.

name: MATT
dialogue: To?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Think about the marshmallowy goodness that is Sarenrae.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Vax and Keyleth do this. And then what do you do?

name: LIAM
dialogue: Close our eyes and show reverence to her.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. Another five, six minutes of darkness passes. Your eyes are closed. No beacon. Nothing.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Okay. How long will it take me to walk back to them?

name: MATT
dialogue: Do you walk back to them?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I want to walk back to them.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. A minute. You emerge from the brush, and you walk and see Keyleth and Vax, eyes closed, clutching hands, just hoping. And Grog, looking bored as hell.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Okay. Where's Vex?

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm up here, dear.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Okay. Come here. I have an idea. Okay? So everybody, hold onto me somehow.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Hold hands? Like preschool?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Like a train?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Yeah. Just don't let go. And I'm going to think real hard, and maybe we'll all be there together.

name: LAURA, TRAVIS
dialogue: Okay.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Okay. We have to walk, though, right?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Eyes closed.

name: LAURA
dialogue: All right. I'm not closing my eyes. I'm just holding onto Pike's hand.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm still thinking about marshmallows, though.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Thinking about bacon.

name: LIAM
dialogue: I grab Pike by the earlobe.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: That tickles.

name: MATT
dialogue: And Pike, do you close your eyes and follow that beacon once more?

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Yes.

name: MATT
dialogue: Okay. As you guys walk alongside, focusing on Pike and her leading this small pack of friends along through the heavily rolling hills and the pieces of stone obstruction that force you to make your way around. You help guide her around these various obstructions that get in the way. Pike, you're concentrating on this burning beacon of warmth ahead of you. And within three minutes of travel, it seemed almost closer than when you saw her disappear before. You guys look at her, and glance up and you've just come across the threshold of the stones, and you're now in this open sandy patch at the base of this large crystal structure.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Nice! Good job, Pike.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Pikey-poo.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Look at this.

name: MATT
dialogue: So now standing-- (laughs)

name: LAURA
dialogue: (laughing) It's beautiful.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: It's so much more beautiful up close.

name: MATT
dialogue: Standing before this magnificent glass-like structure, you can see the winding shapes and edges clearly ascending in the form of a female torso, rising from beneath the sands to a staggering height. Two wings of glittering crystal curving upward to frame a massive round red gem that shines above the head of the woman, with flames curling from the inside of the facets. This red gem would probably be about twice the size of Grog. It's hard to see the actual height of it here, but it's probably close to a hundred feet tall, the entire structure. Now, you see the shifting flicker of the intense fire that burns within the palace, now, it's causing the shadows cast by all nearby things to dance behind you, and in the inside you can see what appears to be a heavy bonfire almost that is visible beyond a 20-foot domed doorway right at the base of the torso. As you begin to approach the entrance to this crystalline palace-like statue, the heat of those flames that you see inside, roaring and burning quickly, get hotter and hotter on your skin. And as you begin to enter the interior of this structure, the heat feels like it should be getting close to unbearable, but it never hurts. You acknowledge the temperature change, and you're used to knowing this much heat should hurt, but it never does. It's just hot and welcoming. You now stand within the hollow interior of this incredible wonder, looking at a spiraling red tower of orange-red flame that reaches up about 60 feet or so, in this spiral. It's all flame. This large bonfire in the center of this structure. It flares rhythmically, like a very intentional heartbeat. (roaring flames) Giving these whipping sounds of the heat, and the wind and the air that it's tossing upward and out into the rest of the island around you and you now begin to acknowledge the warm winds that were blowing through the island, all seem to be centering and spiraling out from the center of the island. And it's at that point that you see something in the flame begin to take shape. You watch as this dark outline begins to open up as two large wings unfurl from within, revealing feathers of ivory and pearl, like the beach you arrived on, as this 15-foot-tall feminine vision of Sarenrae emerges from the roaring pyre, long curling flames burn as her hair from her beautiful dark skin framing a warm and motherly smile, her eyes gold and brown like the most polished brass. Her robes of light blue unfurl in endless strands that almost seem to tether her to the inferno behind her, and as she emerges from the flame, you can't help but find yourself stunned and awed at the presence. Her standing there unsinged from the flames, slowly descends, still floating above you, her arms out, her wings and hair unfurled, almost like a canopy above the group as you look up at her. Her face turns and smiles onto small Pike on the ground, and you hear her voice for the first time for all of you, but not the first for Pike, who has heard her voice for a very long time. "My Pike, you come "to me after all this time. Such a beacon in a very dark world. Welcome."

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I take a knee. Thank you for letting us come here. It's just such an honor to be in your presence and to meet you in person. I've been a believer of yours for my whole life, and to actually be here in front of you is very humbling.

name: MATT
dialogue: She descends faintly. Her massive form slowly seems to-- not shrink, but shift perspective a bit, where once she was this massive entity before you, seems almost human in size as the hand comes down and reaches and touches the top of Pike's forehead and just runs down the nose, onto her chin. And you see the brow furrow a bit as she says, "You vanished from my sight. You walk paths "cast in shadow. My sands whisper thoughts of sorrow and foreboding. I must know from you all, "what dark tidings bring you before me harboring such emotion?"

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Well, I think last time we spoke, we took on a battle that we were not able to complete and we need your help.

name: MATT
dialogue: "What type of foe do you face?"

name: LAURA
dialogue: You know Vecna?

name: MATT
dialogue: She looks to you a bit. There's a faint bit of recognition. "This entity, this Vecna, is "clouded, even in history. I know little myself, and with my sands, they know little of this undying "king. I imagine by his own design."

name: LAURA
dialogue: He deals in secrets. It's kind of his thing.

name: MATT
dialogue: "What can you tell me?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We have a piece of him.

name: LAURA
dialogue: We do.

name: SAM
dialogue: Yes. Maybe. Well, we can tell you that he is awful, evil, pure evil incarnate, and he wants to be a god.

name: LIAM
dialogue: He has eyes on your territory.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He is something of a demigod now, you could say, and well on his path to ascension.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Ascension?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He wants to be like you.

name: MATT
dialogue: "How?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Or I guess he wants to be like the Raven Queen.

name: MATT
dialogue: You watch the flames grow a little more cool, a little more of a deeper red in color, and the brow furrows more and she pulls back a little bit from Pike. Not in a retraction, but a worried sense that seems to fill the room. The brightness of the outside sky seems to dim ever so slightly. "Ascension? The Raven Queen, you say?"

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He could tell you more, but I know she was a mortal who rose to her godhood, and I know he's looking for a similar path.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Impossible."

name: MARISHA
dialogue: We've seen it.

name: LAURA
dialogue: He's been working on it for a very long time.

name: LIAM
dialogue: And obviously hungry for power.

name: MATT
dialogue: The wings, still unfurled, the tips seem to almost curl in a bit as she, as opposed to floating above you out and about, is now standing tall floating above the ground about five or six feet. Her vision, her eyes seem to drift from you and look out past the glass and crystal to the distant shores beyond as she speaks out, exclaiming the thoughts as they come across her mind. Sarenrae says, "The Ritual of Seeding is one of the Matron of Raven's design. It is the secret rite that "rebirthed her from her mortal trials and granted her the powers to take her place among the Prime "Gods and become custodian to the realms between life and death, fate and the cold of winter. But "this ritual was summarily cast from all knowledge and sealed, intent for eternity, by all who walk "the paths of divinity. None should know this. None should know this."

name: LAURA
dialogue: What about the goddess Ioun? The goddess of knowledge? Would she have known?

name: MATT
dialogue: "She was the one who spearheaded its destruction."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Vecna's been taking over her chapels? Temples?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I know not where Ioun is. She is hidden away. The Dawnfather would know more than I. They "were together when she was wounded. If this ritual has come into the hands of another mortal, where "is this mortal now?"

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: We have his eye in a box. It's powerful and intelligent.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I take out the box.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: He's slowly staked out on the Prime Material plane. Just north of Vasselheim, about 350 miles.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Recently completed a ritual in the Shadowfell.

name: MATT
dialogue: "If he's finished the seed, he's already on his way."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Oh no.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What does that mean? How can we stop him?

name: MATT
dialogue: "The ritual takes some time, from what I recall. I don't know how long. I was not its "architect. I was not the one who sealed it. Ioun would be the one to ask. However, if this is "completed, then the Accord of the Divergence is in danger. If we will have one god on one side of the "Divine Gate and the others on the other, we could not stop him. Understand, in order for any of us "to directly interfere to seal a god like we did once long ago, we would have to tear down the "Divine Gate and that would release an entirely new armageddon upon your world. So either you stop him "and seal him, or you live amongst the only god we cannot stop."

name: LAURA
dialogue: How do we seal away a god?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't know. I was betrayed during the Calamity. I was not present when they began to "seal the Betrayer Gods. You'd do best to speak with maybe some of the others who were more "prominent in that time. You walk in Elysium. This is the realm also of Pelor."

name: LAURA
dialogue: The Dawnfather?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Yes."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Might I ask, does Kord reside in Elysium?

name: MATT
dialogue: "No, but you could perhaps speak with him, too. I don't know much about Kord. We don't see "eye to eye." And if you could see a goddess glance sidelong with embarrassment, this is the closest you'd ever see. "I've fallen from import over recent years, until recently."

name: SAM
dialogue: You?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: No.

name: MATT
dialogue: She looks down at Pike for a minute. "Until recently." And turns back to Scanlan and says, "And don't think your prayers have gone unheard, as well."

name: SAM
dialogue: You heard? I'm new at praying. I'm sorry for all the cursing at first. I had a lot of emotions, and I didn't know if anyone was listening. Apologies, but you heard me at night?

name: MATT
dialogue: "When your heart was true to it, yes."

name: SAM
dialogue: Wow. You won't tell anybody, will you? Because some of that is personal stuff.

name: MATT
dialogue: She smiles and averts her gaze from you. "Do you know if this mortal, this man, this Vecna, do "you know in your heart of hearts, Pike, that this man is beyond redemption? Is there any spark of "hope in his heart to turn him back to the light?"

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Well, I would always hope that in somebody, but at least the time spent with him that we have, it doesn't seem that that's his path.

name: MATT
dialogue: "Well, I trust in your insight, and this is your judgment to make. The greatest judgment you "may ever make. As you walk this path, closer to conflict with this entity, search yourself for any "glimmer, and if there is no redemption to be had, then smite him with all the might I have granted "you."

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Okay.

name: LAURA
dialogue: He's not doing a lot of talking to us.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: A lot of killing, disintegrating.

name: SAM
dialogue: How will we know if he's a god or not?

name: MATT
dialogue: "You'll know. We all will know."

name: LAURA
dialogue: So it hasn't happened yet?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Not yet."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Okay.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: How long do these seeding rituals usually take? How much time do we have?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't know. You would have to ask those who were responsible for sealing it."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Dawnfather.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: I'm so confused. That's it? We didn't walk away from him unscathed the first time, and we're just supposed to try again?

name: MATT
dialogue: "Even in the dark days of the Calamity, the might of our weapons could only diminish the "betrayers who rose against creation. The two that orchestrated our victory and designed the means of "sealing away such terrible evil, I've already mentioned. They would be of more aid than I. The "Knowing Mistress Ioun, as wounded and hidden away as she is, and the Dawnfather, warden to the "Chained Oblivion. His fortress across the fields of Elysium. I could send you there."

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: That would be quite helpful.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: It was hard getting here.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Will he be as accepting as you?

name: MATT
dialogue: "I don't know. I haven't spoken much with the others in some time."

name: LAURA
dialogue: You should throw a party. Invite them all. Get to know them again.

name: MATT
dialogue: She looks down at Pike once more. "My Pike, you've done more than you know. You've been a "guiding light for these wonderful champions and so many more." She reaches down and lifts you off the ground a bit, looking at your face, the bit of sadness that creeps across it as she lifts you up and you guys watch as she glides, passing through the crystal, Pike being brought below the archway as she just lifts her out beyond this crystal structure. She ascends upward about 25, 30 feet or so, holding Pike in her hands out in front of her. And just chucks her. (laughter) No. Holding her close-- and by this point, Sarenrae's form has expanded to almost the size of the crystal structure you came to. You can now see a parallel between her wings and her form and her torso as to the actual incredible presence of this god before you. And leans in, as she shows the island to Pike below and whispers close to your ear, "I'm not lonely here, Pike, for my sands "remain with me, speak with me, and we learn from each other. Look." As she extends her arm, Pike, you look out, and all of the light of the sky seems to shine at once through every pearl, every grain of the beach sand that you've walked across. And where once you saw what was just a barren landscape, you now see thousands and thousands and thousands of people. Opaque. Translucent. Souls of those that have come to Sarenrae since the dawn of creation. Those who swore themselves to good under her banner and at the end of their lives came to become part of the Island of Renewal and forever live with her and amongst the rest of the community of people that are warmed under her light. They all seem to look up at once at you, and you sense them smiling, as the vision fades and the island goes back untouched. She drifts back down and places you on the ground. "You see, one day, you will join us, too. And we "will all have so many stories to share." You now see her hovering over all of you as you step out of this to join Pike on the exterior of this tower. "While I am diminished, my powers limited, "you do possibly face something terrible, unseen since the Calamity. And for this journey, Pike, I "grant you my blessing." And as she reaches her hands out and they expand, her head lifts up, her eyes close, and her wings flare into a phoenix-like flame that just emblazons the sky with light and fire. The heat is more intense than anything you've felt, yet still there's no pain. It's just all-consuming. It's like the rebirth of a phoenix and you're all surrounded by it. For a moment, it's all there is in existence, just this incredible entity. And then the flames slowly die away, except for the flames that currently engulf Pike's gnome form. And as the flames burn away, you can see on Pike the familiar set of wings you've seen her spiritual form hold, which fold in and then dissipate. You now have the Blessing of the Everlight. (cheering)

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Oh my goodness! What is that?

name: MATT
dialogue: You get a plus-two bonus to your constitution.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Okay.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: We'll take a picture and text it to you.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Okay.

name: MATT
dialogue: As a bonus action, you can summon the wings of the Everlight, granting you a flying speed of 40 feet for up to ten minutes. And while you have these wings, any spells you cast that cause creatures to regain hit points heal an additional ten hit points. (cheering) But once this ability is used, you can't use it for another seven days.

name: ALL
dialogue: Oh.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Man, I love her so much.

name: MATT
dialogue: So if you want to take a picture and send that to her. Here we go. Hold onto that and give it to her.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: Is Sarenrae gone?

name: MATT
dialogue: No. Sarenrae is still there, just the flames have burned away.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I'm going to send this to you, Ashley.

name: TALIESIN
dialogue: I'm right here, guys. It's really not cool.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Oh man!

name: LAURA
dialogue: Since Sarenrae is still standing there, I want to say to her-- shit.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Good start.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Shit, sorry. I want to apologize. This feels so stupid. I want to apologize for never realizing what you are and what this could be and for not showing you the reverence that you deserve. And I hope to change that in the future, and I will certainly think differently from here on out.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you look down and look up, where once she was this large entity above you, you look down and look up, and she's right before you. "No apologies necessary. The creation of Exandria, the peoples "that populate it and develop and design, innovate and worship, was with free will to make your own "path. Faith is important to some, but the intent was to instill you with the means of doing and "choosing whatever and however you like. We do not wish reverence of all. Just those who find us. At "least, I speak for myself."

name: LAURA
dialogue: Well, I think you're pretty wonderful.

name: MATT
dialogue: "There is balance to everything."

name: LAURA
dialogue: And I took these from your beach. It doesn't seem right.

name: MATT
dialogue: She takes the pouch from you and pours it out, and as the pearls are about to land, they drift off and dart off back to the location where you originally found them.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: Same. I just thought I wanted to take a little piece with me, but I already have that. I didn't know what it was.

name: MATT
dialogue: As you empty the pearls, they also dart off towards the beach where you first landed.

name: LAURA
dialogue: I just thought they were really pretty.

name: ASHLEY
dialogue: I would have told you before we left, you know.

name: MATT
dialogue: "It's all right. But for everything great that we may have created, you continue to create "far better. Our existence brings threat. We've brought two calamities before. We try and avoid a "third. Whether we diminish in time or just maintain this balance, it's you, and your "children, and your children's children, that hold the keys to the future of your lives, your people, "your culture, and us. So don't apologize."

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Would you say Sarenrae's attractive?

name: MATT
dialogue: Are you asking her, or is this a question to me as the DM?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, that one.

name: MATT
dialogue: She's beautiful. I wouldn't put it in terms of any sort of a sexual object.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: She's just beautiful.

name: MATT
dialogue: She's just an incredibly beautiful, powerful, feminine form. And, to the extent where Grog, who usually being a man who's driven by base needs, not a single thought comes across you in any base or defacing way, it is too powerful. It overwhelms it.

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah, no, she's beautiful.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What are titties?

name: LAURA
dialogue: What even are titties?

name: MARISHA
dialogue: What do titties?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: I'm keeping my little pearl from the beach.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: (laughs) That you've been trying to crush?

name: TRAVIS
dialogue: Yeah.

name: LAURA
dialogue: Terrible. Matt's like, shady shit.

name: TRAVIS

name: MARISHA

dialogue: You can break out. You can. It's hard. But you can do it. Just take the first step. And then you take another one. And then you take another one.

name: MARISHA
dialogue: And I grab his hand, and with that, I cast Plane Shift to wherever he is leading to go.

dialogue: All right. The rest of you gathered hands for this?

name: MATT
dialogue: All right.
